141012.value: 财产关系之评估及中国公寓所有权的制度化

141012.label: Project Objectives
141012.value: to identify the key factors that make condominium associations work. to examine the way in which law reflects and responds to the social and historical variations/dynamic interactions among the stakeholders. to illustrate whether that social practice conforms urban dwellers and property rights under prevailing social theories; and how actors in these condos use legal institutions.
rows: to identify the key factors that make condominium associations work.
to examine the way in which law reflects and responds to the social and historical variations/dynamic interactions among the stakeholders.
to illustrate whether that social practice conforms urban dwellers and property rights under prevailing social theories; and how actors in these condos use legal institutions.

141012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
141012.value: While it is true that the concept ‘property ownership’ is new to Chinese residents, even more foreign to them is ‘condominium ownership’. A condominium association is a forum whereby owners gather together to solve issues relating to condominium management. This new form of association has been attributed by academics to promote social relationships and democratic governance. The success or failure of these associations much depends on the cooperation among unit owners as well as other stakeholders, namely: developers, local governments, and property rights activists. Much has been said about how these associations may help unit owners advocate their rights and solve disputes in day-to-day operation of condominiums. Yet, Chinese courts are witnessing an increasing trend of disputes between owners and developers. However, there is little said about what law can react to ensure a proper functioning of these associations. It has been suggested that laws need to recognize the cultural variations and local norms in order to create an enforceable and functioning legal institutions. This proposed research aims to examine the unit owner’s needs and the relationship dynamics among the stakeholders, with the ultimate goal to suggest how law should respond to it. This study involves conducting empirical studies at four cities: Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen and Chengdu. The unit owners, developers, local government officials, and property rights activists will be interviewed. They will be questioned on their understanding of property rights, their participation in setting up and operation of the condominium associations, and the impact of the associations have on them. In the end, a legal framework will be proposed based on our research findings. 中国经济高速发展的重要指标之一就是其日益蓬勃的住房市场。尽管大厦公寓是中国现阶段的主导住房形式，但公寓所有权却是没有得到足够的立法规范并且成为中国民事纠纷的一个重要来源。本研究在此背景下尝试得出一个能够确定规范公寓管治的架构。除了研究公寓产权人之外，开发商，地方政府以及其他非政府组织（包括财产权民间倡导者，公益诉讼律师和新兴的业主委员会协会等）也会被纳入研究范围。在此基础之上，本项目会深入研究法律如何来反应这些社会和历史以及文化上的差异，以及上述的这些利害关系人之间的关系。需要指出的是， 公寓所有权要符合中国自己现有的公寓市场的现状。 本研究的主要目的是一，指出能够让中国公寓业主团体良好管治的因素； 二， 希望法律（实体国家法律）能够反应和吸收这些历史的，社会的因素和现状； 三，阐述这些业主自治的社会实践能否证明或挑战传统主流的关于财产权和城市居住权的社会理论。

141012.label: Realisation of objectives
141012.value: 1 to identify the key factors that make condominium associations work. Can HOAs make the state, particularly the local governments listen to grassroots activities? The finding is it depends upon certain conditions. To be specific, there is a binary system of laws dealing with condominium governance in China, namely, national laws and local rules. The national laws account for the issues directly impacting democratic control such as “double majorities,” the future binding powers of developer-owned/run management companies and more explicit norms binding transitions from developers to owner associations. The local rules, nonetheless, needs to develop a more sophisticated approach to obstacles indirectly impacting democratic governance such as improving efficiencies and allowing for two-tier management schemes and open-ended executive council membership. At the local level, though trends strongly favor earlier owner control (including fail-safe provisions to override developer machinations), other weaknesses continue to dog the national legislation. These include double majorities which can often delay owner control and/or thwart important resolutions after the owners have taken control of the association. The two case studies conducted are illustrative of how local rules reflects and respond to the dynamic interactions among the stakeholders. Soon after some high-profile disputes or cases were decided or reported, local governments were motivated to amend/flesh out the local rules to deal with some vexing issues in practice. A chart depicting the evolution of Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen local rules have been drawn and published. Second, the state’s capacity (local government) to coordinate governing techniques matters. Local governments are able to exert substantial influence on the success of condominium developments. Their job should not be just administering around the condominium’s edges with local zoning and subdivision ordinances. More importantly, local governments should be actively involved in condominium living, including the dispute settlement. An example would be for a local government agency to monitor and at times to take part in the management of the condominium complexes. For example, when the chairperson of the executive council fails to call a council meeting requested by a council quorum, the local government should intervene and designate one of the council members for the job. This keeps the condominium association functioning by avoiding a deadlock. In this sense, instead of curbing its power and involvements as commonly assumed, the role of local government is far more significant and engaging than simply recourse to a local court when a dispute arises. 2 to examine the way in which law reflects and responds to the social and historical variations/dynamic interactions among the stakeholders. The law design would fail if they do not consider the ways in which the envisioned types of collective action correspond to, or rather challenge, preexisting cultural orientations and values prevailing among those expected to engage in collective action. First, the preexisting cultural traits/factors in Chinese contexts include (1) individualism versus collectivism (i.e., cultural focus on personal achievements and individual rights versus focus on the life of cohesive groups and organizations); (2) power distance, (i.e., socially acceptable measures of interpersonal power or influence between two or more persons; (3) social capital (i.e., the level of generalized trust and reciprocity within a certain group or society). All these are crucial to the success of a chosen condominium governance model in a particular setting. 3, to illustrate whether that social practice conforms urban dwellers and property rights under prevailing social theories; and how actors in these condos use legal institutions. Whether that social practice conforms urban dwellers and property rights under prevailing social theories? It all depends on relevant conditions. The efficacy of majority-based governance within a condominium, and the respect for normative limits placed by the legal reform on minority disenfranchisement, would definitely be impacted by cultural concepts of individualism/collectivism. But such type of collective action is not dependent on rooting out all other societal aspects of individualism/collectivism that do not sit comfortably with such type of collective action. Social capital is yet another cultural dimension that may be critical for assessing the prospects of a successful implementation of a private law reform relying on ongoing collective action. Drawing upon the two case studies, the research finding indicates that to unveil an analytical framework for exploring the interrelations between social practice and institutionalized property rights in different contexts, apart from the cultural factors and local government's engagement, three more factors are relevant: property value, history of use and size of the condominium. When reforming Chinese condominium laws, a balance needs to be struck between flexibility and standardization. Given that the Chinese condominium system is still in an early development stage, more standard documents, such as default rules and a method to calculate a participation quota should be adopted. In the long run, when Chinese condominium owners develop the necessary management skills and knowledge, perhaps flexibility and innovation will gain grounds.

141012.label: Major findings and research outcome
141012.value: 1) An in-depth understanding of the relationship dynamics among stakeholders that is, developers, homeowners, homeowner associations, and local governments in Chinese condominium governance, are critical because they directly impact reform measures as appropriate to specific contexts. 2) The research generates a context-dependent thesis. Private law design would fail if they do not consider the ways in which the envisioned types of collective action correspond to, or rather challenge, preexisting cultural orientations and values prevailing among those expected to engage in collective action. 3) The local government’s role cannot be understated in supporting the institutionalization of condominium governance at this nascent stage of development. State-dominant theories and society-informed theories risk obscuring the dynamics of change in China. The state society relations through the lens of HOAs is symbiotic instead of unidirectional. The local governments’ capacity to coordinate governing techniques varies across regions. 4) The measurement of success or failure of a legal reform on condominiums, more generally, depends on the specific interaction, in the explored society, between the lawmakers’ normative construction of desirable collective action and the self-perception of efficacy and coordination within the relevant organization.

141012.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
141012.value: 1) Drawing upon the data of judicial rulings and interviews on the stages of establishment and on-going governance of HOAs in China, the key goal of a future research is to continue to unfold: How relevant the social practice and cultural values in designing a well-functioning private law? If so, to what extent? 2) While the literature on resistance has flourished, there remains limited scholarship on how China’s state or local governments have responded to this challenge. It is hoped that by employing a further empirical study, one could test that the response of the authoritarian Chinese regime goes beyond simply ratcheting up the use of coercion. Rather, Chinese authorities have incentivized local governments and courts to aggressively respond to homeowners’ protests (whether through law changes or concession), and to address their grievances in a more flexible and coordinated manner.

141012.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
141012.value: This project explores the implications for, and development of, private property rights through the lens of condominium governance in China. Condominiums are the dominant mode of residential property in urban China. In the densely populated urban centres, condominiums are as familiar as they are practical. The percentage of residential properties individually held in condominium form far exceeds other building types and designs. Thus, condominiums are highly significant to the economic fabric of the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and serve as the appropriate real estate vehicle for studying the interrelationship between the private law design, the structure of collective action behaviors, culture values and influences of free market forces. For this purpose, this project attempts to capture the key factors that make condominium governance functioning well in Chinese context.

141112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
141112.value: Promotion is one of the most important rewards in most organizations. Rank-order tournaments are often used in promotion decisions. The best performer in the same cohort is promoted to the next senior position along the hierarchy, and the pay increase and the possibility of further promotion are perceived as the tournament prize. The ultimate position on the intra-organization promotion ladder is usually the Chief Executive Officer (CEO). Such promotion tournaments create an option-like reward structure for senior managers below the CEO position. If they are promoted to the CEO position they get the tournament prize, otherwise they may stay in the same position or find a similar position outside the organization. The accounting literature suggests that stock option compensations and other compensation schemes with option features may induce top executives to manipulate earnings. However, there is little empirical evidence on whether tournament incentives induce earnings management by senior managers below the CEO position and result in low financial reporting quality. This project aims toward filling this void. In this project, I will examine several specific research questions. First, I will study the association between the CEO promotion tournament prize, measured as the pay gap between the CEO and other senior executives, and earnings management by accruals and real activities. Second, I will examine whether the pay gap is associated with higher earnings restatement. Third, I will examine whether tournament incentives motivate senior managers to hold bad news, leading to higher future crash risks. Fourth, I will investigate how equity investors, creditors, and auditors perceive tournament incentives. Finally, I will examine how the association between the pay gap and financial reporting quality varies cross-sectionally. This project is expected to make several important contributions to the literature. First, it will extend our understanding of the economic consequences of tournament incentives. Second, it is expected to further our understanding of how senior managers’ incentives affect financial reporting quality. Finally, it should also have implications for the recent public debates regarding high CEO compensation. Specifically, it will shed light on whether high CEO pay provides incentives for other senior managers to influence financial reporting quality. 在大多數組織里晋升是一項重要的激勵機制。晋升的競爭類似于排名順序錦標賽。同一級別中表現最好的員工往往被提升到下一個更高的級別，而由此獲得的薪酬的提升以及進一步晋升的機會類似于錦標賽的獎盃。在一個公司管理階梯中最高的位置莫過于CEO。那麼這種晋升錦標賽的機制等於為CEO以下的高級管理人員提供了一項類似于期權的報酬結構。如果他們成功的晋升到CEO的位置，那麼就相當於贏得了錦標賽的獎盃。如果沒有成功，他們仍然可以繼續留在原來的位置，或者去別的組織尋找一個類似的職位。會計學領域的多項研究表明期權或其他類似期權的薪酬結構為高層管理人員操縱會計盈餘提供了動機。但關於錦標制度是否導致CEO以下的高級管理人員操縱盈餘，到目前為止實證證據非常少。本課題試圖填補這一空白。 本課題將研究若干問題。第一，晋升錦標制度的激勵力度是否和公司的盈餘操縱相關。晋升錦標制度的激勵力度可以用CEO和其他高級管理人員之間的薪酬差異來衡量。第二，薪酬差異是否和會計重述相關。第三，晋升錦標制度是否導致高管隱藏壞消息，從而導致更高的股票價格突然崩潰的風險。最後，本課題將研究以上現象是否在公司間存在差異。 本課題有可能對現有文獻做出若干重大貢獻。首先，本課題的研究有助於進一步瞭解錦標激勵制度的經濟後果。其次，該課題有助於進一步瞭解高級管理人員激勵制度對財務報告質量的影響。最後，本課題可能對目前對CEO高薪的爭論有意義。具體的說，其研究成果將有助於瞭解CEO高薪是否為其他高級管理人員影響財務報告質量提供了動機。

141412.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
141412.value: 個人抗逆力的社會基礎，對長期發展抗逆力的可持續策略意義重大，並且是未知的領域。抗逆力是面對逆境時維持幸福感。促進抗逆力是一個有價值的策略，因為它建基於個人的力量和社群網絡上。個人力量也重要地倚賴社會基礎，特別是社會交往和社會建構。社會建構的重要在於對信念的傳播和化。與抗逆力相關的是在抗逆之前的抗逆信念。這些信念已經證明是為抗逆力的基礎特質。這樣的抗逆信念可能整體上是關於自己、其他人或者社會，逆境和處理逆境並且取得抗逆力的方法。不過，抗逆信念的起源，特別是放在社會基礎上，基本上是不清楚的。為了從外面促進抗逆力，擴大有關抗逆力的社會基礎的知識是至關重要的。這研究因此設法填補數據方面的不足，以揭示抗逆力的社會基礎。雖然根據社會建構理論社會基礎已經在理論上是相關的，但是它們仍沒聚集足夠的數據。基於實徵主義和後實徵主義的理念，有需要對抗逆力的社會基礎的貢獻的作出調查。根據社會建構理論，受逆境之苦的人將在社會交往中涉及各種各樣關於身分和信念的論證。透過社會交往，特別是受到挑戰而不是受到支持，人可能在信念方面接受的社會建構，並且也許學習或者內化信念。這樣的信念可能形成對逆境的反彈和最終支撐起抗逆力。基於以上發現，一個受逆境之苦的人的樣本，對個人抗逆力的社會影響過程是調查的焦點。研究的必要條件是抗逆信念，社會交往和社會建構的質性探索。這個質性研究部份將涉及9 個聚焦小組。隨後的量化研究部份，將調查1,500人。綜合質性和量化研究部份，將提供關於抗逆力的信念、社會交往和社會建構的知識，特別是關於它們對抗逆力的貢獻。因此，這研究將闡明透過社會交往和社會建構，以促進抗逆信念及抗逆力的必要機制。

141412.label: Major findings and research outcome
141412.value: Resilience refers to adjustment or lack of depression in the face of adversity, which can include those in illness, family members’ decease, financial loss, and accident. People maintain their resilience through actions predicated on beliefs in resilience. The actions and beliefs in turn build on social interaction with various people, including parents, other family members, friends, other peers, mentors, pastors, social workers, and other helping professionals. These people play a key role in constructing beliefs and thus the framework for actions to maintain resilience. This social construction process, nevertheless, is yet unclear, in need of an exploration from the present study. The study thereby sheds light on the social construction process with nine focus groups, consisting of 90 Chinese people, who had experience in maintaining resilience in Hong Kong, China. Results reveal substantive practices in social interaction and construction, involving exchange, negotiation, compromise, trust, and others. Notably, challenge turns out to be stimulating in helping people to incubate beliefs in actions for maintaining resilience. The effectiveness of challenge in turn hinges on closeness, trust, sharing, and civility weaved in social interaction. Nine focus groups elicited ideas from 90 service users engaged with 9 units of social services. These groups consisted of three groups of 30 youngsters, three groups of 30 mid-age people, and three groups of 30 elders. These focus participants had experience in tackling problems and thus were able to share their experience about resilience. They provided ideas concerning all the research objectives, about resilience, resiliency beliefs, actions, social interactions, and their linkages. These ideas, as transcribed, fed to the design of a survey questionnaire in July. The survey proceeded to collect data from 2,340 service users, sampled from 60 randomly sampled social service units. The survey involved the recruitment, training, and deployment of interviewers By surveying 2,340 Chinese social service users in Hong Kong, the study seeks to delineate paths leading to resilience and adjustment. Results reveal that resilient belief and resilient act were prominent determinants of resilience and adjustment. Furthermore, resilient belief and act evolved from social capital in terms of support and sincere talk received. In addition, learning to cope, self-understanding, education, and living with a parent were vital human capital, social capital, or production factors underlying resilience and adjustment. Results thus illustrate the ontogenesis and sociogenesis of resilience and adjustment alike. They imply the essential role of social capital development in social services to promote resilience.

141412.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
141412.value: Future research is valuable in elaborating mechanisms and thus consolidating and advancing capital theory and social production function theory. Such research can notably fill gaps between the availability and activation of capital and using or investing capital in production. This would mean the identification of capital as useful and fungible resources as such, and the deliberate investment and transformation of capital. Meanwhile, future research can also examine the futility of financial capital and social capital in terms of advice. For the former futility, future research can corroborate that income is not a panaceas.

141412.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
141412.value: Results revealed the contributions of human and social capital on resilience and adjustment through social production characterized by resilient act and learning to cope. The most influential form of capital was human capital in terms of resilient belief. Meanwhile, the next important determinant was social capital in terms of receiving social support and receiving sincere talk. These two forms of social capital also contributed to resilient belief. Conversely, adversity, which reflects the shortage or deprivation of capital, displayed an important negative effect on resilience and adjustment. Self-understanding and education as indicators of human capital, and living with a parent as an indicator of social capital offered some positive effects on resilience and adjustment. Human capital in terms of benevolent world belief also manifested some positive effects. By contrast, financial capital in terms of family income per capita did not display a significant effect on resilience and adjustment. As such, results illustrate the ontogenesis and sociogenesis of resilience and adjustment. More specifically, noteworthy results are the prominent influences of (1) resilient belief and resilient act as production, (2) social support and sincere talk received, (3) learning to cope and self-understanding, and the futility of (4) advice received.

141912.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
141912.value: Consumer creativity literature generally focuses on the antecedents to creativity, i.e., which factors or boundary conditions can bolster or hinder creativity in usage of products such as DIY furniture from IKEA. With the growing prevalence of online marketing promotions with a creativity theme --e.g., Zesprit China encouraged consumers to design virtual greeting cards with nature themed graphical elements; firms’ interests are gradually shifting away from the final creative products (e.g, Zesprit greeting card) to the effects of these creative activities on consumers’ cognitions, emotions, and behaviors, i.e., consequences of consumer creativity. Furthermore, although prior research explores creativity implications for firms in terms of branding impact; little work has discussed its implications for consumer choice. A comprehensive understanding of the broad range of consequences of consumer creativity, especially in terms consumer choices, is important for two reasons. First of all, firms may leverage this knowledge to facilitate the sales of novel offerings to consumers. Second, by delving deeper into the cognitive and emotional aspect of consumer creative responses, it is possible to gauge the welfare impact of consumer creativity on their choices, e.g., whether creativity can help curtail dysfunctional consumer behaviors such as overeating, shopaholics, or gambling addiction. By examining the choice consequences of consumer creativity, the proposed study enriches extant literature on consumer creativity. In particular, from a firm’s perspective, we investigate how creativity influences consumers’ openness towards unfamiliar offerings (e.g, dining at a prison-style setting restaurant) and acceptance of novel brand extensions (e.g., Dell Fruit Juice). From consumers’ perspective, we explore how creativity affects mindset concreteness, and subsequently influences consumers’ reinforcement intentions in making sequential choices, e.g., eating healthy in both the main course and dessert of a meal; or resisting tempting yet “bad” choices with self-control resources. We will conduct a series of lab and field experiments to test our predictions. Study 1 is designed to show that creative consumers are more likely to embrace novel products/experience. Study 2 examines whether creativity enhances consumers’ acceptance of novel brand extensions. Study 3 explores how creativity can help reinforce consumers’ intentions to “stay on target” in sequential choices, when the first choice is beneficial. Study 4 investigates how creativity can generate positive affect, which helps replenish consumers’ self-control resources; leading to the reduction of dysfunctional consumer behaviors such as overeating. Together, these studies can offer rich managerial and consumer welfare implications. 消费者创造性研究过去主要关注那些因素可以推动或阻碍产品（例如，宜家DIY家具）的创造性。随着具有创意的网络市场营销活动的流行----例如，Zesprit 中国鼓励消费者以大自然为主题的图形元素来设计有创意的电子贺卡。公司的兴趣逐渐从最终的产品创造性（比如Zesprit 的贺卡）转向创意活动本身对消费者认知、情感和行为的影响。此外，虽然之前的研究探讨了创造性对品牌的影响，但是很少有研究关注到创造性对消费者产品选择的影响。 针对消费者创造性，特别是其对消费者产品选择的影响进行深入研究探索，是非常重要的，原因有两点。一是企业可以利用这方面的知识来促销新产品。二是通过深入探讨消费者创意在认知和情感方面的反应，它可以衡量消费者创意对消费者选择的社会影响。例如，是否消费者创造性有助于遏制非正常的消费行为，如暴饮暴食、购物狂或赌博成瘾。 本研究丰富了现存的消费者创造性研究。从公司的角度来看，我们研究创造性是如何影响消费者对不熟悉产品的接受度（例如，在一个具有监狱风格的餐厅用餐）和对新颖品牌扩展名（例如，戴尔果汁）的接受程度。从消费者的角度，我们探讨创造性可以怎样影响消费者的思维具体化，并随后影响消费者在连续选择中保持自我控制力。例如，在吃主菜和甜点套餐时都坚持选择健康食品；或者时通过自我控制来抗拒 不良产品的诱惑。 我们将进行一系列的实验室实验及实地实验来检验我们的预测。研究一考查消费者创造性是否能让他们更容易接受新产品或新体验。研究二检验消费者创造性能否提高消费者对新颖品牌延伸的接受度。研究三探索了当消费者在面临连续选择，并且第一选择是“正面”的时候，创造性如何帮助消费者固守“正面”目标的意愿。研究四探索消费者创造性的积极的影响如何能够补充消费者的自我控制资源，从而减少非正常的消费行为，如暴饮暴食。总之，对上述问题的研究，可以为企业及消费者提供有益的启示。

141912.label: Major findings and research outcome
141912.value: This research aims to investigate effect of consumer creativity on their evaluations of brands. Consumers’ creative participation is often used by online retailers as a promotional tool nowadays. The authors propose that consumer creativity exerts a positive impact on brand attitudes by affecting their attitudes toward the creative activity itself. Furthermore, consumer creativity moderates the effect of consumers’ perceived level of fit on their acceptance of brand extensions, such that creative consumers will show a higher level of acceptance of distant brand extensions. Our results provide important implications for firms that intend to exploit the promises of online creativity-themed marketing communications. First, because consumers’ attitudes toward the focal brand hinge on their attitudes toward the creative activity, it is important that firms design their creativity-themed activities carefully, so that they are attractive to the users. Second, firms can exploit the creativity edge by launching new brand extensions that target creative consumers.

141912.value: Future research can further examine the specific mechanism through which consumer creativity can influence subsequent choices.

141912.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
141912.value: Making consumers play games, drawing pictures? Well, you are not kidding around. It turns out that by making consumers more creative, they are more likely to appreciate your brand-also more likely to embrace more novel brand extensions in product choices.

142512.label: Realisation of objectives
142512.value: All the objectives listed above have been accomplished. The first three objectives, in particular, the second and the third, have been achieved by developing a full manuscript that fully develops the concept of PEEIM, and examines the moderating effects of PEEIM on the relationship between trust and repurchase intention as well as the relationship between customer satisfaction and trust. We collected online customers data from a major university in the UK to empirically test the relationships. The paper was finally accepted in a top-tier journal, MIS Quarterly. The first objective is additionally augmented by collecting additional data from staff in another university that empirically examines the difference between PEEIM and a similar concept called structural assurance. The results confirm that these two concepts are different, thus establishing the distinctiveness of PEEIM. The fourth objective has been achieved by developing a full manuscript that examines the nonlinear relationship between customer trust and online repurchase intention, and the moderating role of PEEIM. The manuscript was presented at DIGIT Workshop in Dec. 2014 and now the paper is nearly ready for submission to a top-tier journal called Information Systems Research. In addition, we developed another three papers into print that has strong connections to e-commerce, respectively in the areas of virtual worlds and e-marketplaces. These papers are published in leading journals in the IS field, such as Decision Support Systems, European Journal of Information Systems, and Information Technology & People.

142512.label: Major findings and research outcome
142512.value: The effects of e-commerce institutional mechanisms on trust and online purchase have traditionally been understood in the initial online purchase context. Our project extends this literature by exploring the role of ecommerce institutional mechanisms in the online repurchase context. In doing so, it responds to the emerging call for understanding the institutional context under which customer trust operates in an e-commerce environment. Specifically, this study introduces a key moderator, perceived effectiveness of e-commerce institutional mechanisms (PEEIM), to the relationships between trust, satisfaction, and repurchase intention. Drawing on the theory of organizational trust, and based on a survey of 362 returning online customers, we find that PEEIM negatively moderates the relationship between trust in an online vendor and online customer repurchase intention, as it decreases the importance of trust to promoting repurchase behavior. We also find that PEEIM positively moderates the relationship between customer satisfaction and trust as it enhances the customer’s reliance on past transaction experience with the vendor to reevaluate trust in the vendor. Consistent with the predictions made in the literature, PEEIM does not directly affect trust or repurchase intention. Our project has also gone beyond assessing simple effects of trust on repurchase intention to understanding more complex and intriguing impact of trust on online repurchase intention in regard to the operation boundary of trust. In response to the call for further research on the boundary conditions under which trust operates in the e-commerce context, this study also investigates the extent of nonlinearity of the trust-repurchase intention relationship under different perceived institutional contexts. Drawing on prospect theory, we propose that the positive relationship between trust and repurchase intention is concavely nonlinear in perceived effective contexts, but is convexly nonlinear in perceived ineffective contexts. Our hypothesis was empirically examined using survey data collected from online customers in New Zealand and Northern Ireland.

142512.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
142512.value: Future research can take this study further by addressing several limitations of our study. First, our sample was drawn from university personnel. While the university personnel were all online customers with experience in purchasing products online, future research can take this investigation further by drawing research subjects from a more diverse population. Second, as this study exclusively focuses on the general perception of institutional mechanisms, we only theoretically differentiate the effect of PEEIM from vendor-specific mechanisms, laying bare the possibility that the presence of vendor-specific mechanisms may outweigh PEEIM. Although our control variables partially mitigate this concern by capturing respondents’ attention to selected vendor-specific mechanisms, further research could and should empirically examine PEEIM against more local, specific institutional mechanisms. Third, the suitability of the Internet as a shopping medium largely depends on the characteristics of the product sought. Some products are more conveniently bought in traditional shopping environments, while others, such as software, airline tickets, and hotel reservations, are easier to buy online. Thus, product category may act as a moderating variable and should be investigated in future research.

142512.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
142512.value: This study investigates if trust matters to repurchase intention of online customers under different situations. If the e-commerce environment is effectively regulated, trust is not that important. However, if the macro e-commerce environment is ineffectively regulated, then trust plays an important role in enticing online customer purchase behavior. Similarly, when e-commerce environment is effectively regulative, customer satisfaction is important for building trust. Otherwise, customer satisfaction would not be that important for building trust.

142612.label: Project Title(Chinese)
142612.value: 有內生提案權的動態立法賽局研究

142612.label: Project Objectives
142612.value: To develop a tractable and rich modeling framework of dynamic legislative bargaining with endogenous agenda setters. To explore incentives of the policymakers and policy dynamics implied by the interaction of rent-seeking and legislative bargaining. To offer a dynamic game-theoretic foundation of the median voter theorem or the lack thereof. To shed lights on the constitutional reform for countries/regions, such as Hong Kong, that are in transition to democracy.
rows: To develop a tractable and rich modeling framework of dynamic legislative bargaining with endogenous agenda setters.
To explore incentives of the policymakers and policy dynamics implied by the interaction of rent-seeking and legislative bargaining.
To offer a dynamic game-theoretic foundation of the median voter theorem or the lack thereof.
To shed lights on the constitutional reform for countries/regions, such as Hong Kong, that are in transition to democracy.

142612.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
142612.value: Most economic policies are made through the political process. So how the legislative institutions shape policymakers’ incentives and their policy choices has been a central research question in economic theory. In this proposed study I propose a three-player dynamic model in which (1) the policy choice in each period is made through the sequence of proposal making and voting, (2) the policy made in one period becomes the status quo in the next period, and (3) the agenda setter in each period is endogenously determined through an all-pay contest, in which all players simultaneously expend costly efforts to bid for proposal power and the highest bidder becomes the agenda setter in that period. Analysis of the proposed model would point to overlooked incentives of the policymakers and imply rich policy dynamics. First, players with moderate ideological preferences would not compete actively in the political process for proposal power. As a consequence we should expect key positions in the legislature and the government to be occupied by politicians that represent special interests or have radical ideological preferences. Second, the extreme players however would make more moderate policy choices than necessary, due to the incentive to alleviate future competition costs and the incentive to constrain the extreme players on the other side in case they grab proposal power in the future. Third, whether the policy moves to the median policy in the long run depends on how the players value their future payoffs. With sufficiently patient players, even if those with moderate ideological preferences are never recognized as agenda setter, the extreme players would make substantial compromise in policy proposals so that the policy still moves gradually towards the median policy. However, with sufficiently impatient players the long-run policy would be bounded away from the median policy. Therefore the proposed research would offer a dynamic game-theoretic foundation of the median voter theorem in some cases but refute it in the other cases. 經濟政策大多是透過政治程序來制定的. 因此, 經濟理論的其中一個重要課題是: 立法制度會如何提供政策制定者各種誘因, 進而影響最後的政策制定. 在這個研究計劃中, 我要提出一個新的「動態立法賽局」分析架構來探討這個問題. 這個賽局包含了三個特性：(1)政策制定是透過議會當中「提案」和「多數決」的政治程序來完成. (2)政策具有延續性; 政策一旦通過, 便會持續實施直到有改革或是修正案通過為止. (3)提案權是所有參與政策制定的人皆可透過政治角力來爭奪; 而這個部份我用競賽理論當中的「全付競標」模型來分析. 用這個「動態立法賽局」來分析政策制定的制度, 我們可以得到幾個創新卻重要的結論, 也可推得出各種可能的政策演進模式. 首先, 政策立場偏向中間的政策制定者會無意參與爭奪提案權的政治角力, 因此最後掌握提案權力的人必然是政策立場或是意識型態較極端的政客或是特殊利益團體. 第二, 這些立場極端的政策提案者, 若有足夠遠見, 在追求長期利益的誘因之下, 仍會在提案時做出政策上的讓步. 第三, Baron (1996)所推導出來的「一般性中間選民定理」(Generalized Median Voter Theorem) 在我的分析架構之下, 只有在政策制定者有足夠遠見的情況之下, 才會成立. 否則, 在政策制定者短視近利的情況下, 長期政策會在不同的極端政策間搖擺.

143312.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
143312.value: Mobile applications (apps) have existed for years, but clunky user interfaces on devices and hard-to-use application stores made it difficult for consumers to download applications. And then came Apple in 2008 with its App Store for the iPhone. The iPhone, which was easy to use, coupled with the App Store that allowed users to search and download apps from iTunes, turned mobile applications into an overnight success. The Hong Kong Productivity Council revealed a recent survey that showed 90 percent of smartphone users accept apps because they provide useful information, as well as discount coupons and other freebies (CIO Asia 2011). From a broader perspective, companies started realizing that publishing mobile applications in the various app stores offers a viable channel to promote their brands, reach consumers, and eventually sell their products. This is especially true of companies in the media, services, entertainment industries who actively use app stores as a way to market their products. As these mobile apps develop and mature, it will be important to quantify their value for customers, firms and society. While much of the attention in academic research and in the press has been on examining user behavioral differences in the mobile channel versus traditional channels, we believe that important benefits lie in new products and services made available through these mobile apps. While prior work has studied the impact of the mobile web on users’ multimedia content creation and consumption behavior, the value of new mobile apps has remained unquantified. This project contributes by producing the first study that estimates a structural model of user demand in a mobile app setting and measures resultant changes in consumer surplus from the availability of mobile apps. This project adopts an empirical industrial organization (IO) method to estimate the model. We have secured collaboration with a large Asian mobile applications company based in South Korea to collect a unique dataset consisting of app prices, sales quantity and app characteristics. To the extent that prices and product characteristics of mobile apps affect market outcomes, the increasing size of the mobile app store will have profound implications for the future direction of mobile commerce. 移动应用程序（App）已出现相当长的一段时间，但移动设备上不友好的用户界面以及难于使用的应用商店使用户很难下载需要的应用程序。直到2008年苹果开设了针对iPhone的应用商店这个现象才发生改变。iPhone本身的易用性以及苹果应用商店在应用程序的搜索、下载的支持，使整个移动应用市场迅速蓬勃发展。香港生产力促进局最近的一项调查表明，90%的智能手机用户使用移动应用的是因为这些应用可以提供有用的信息，包括优惠券、赠品之类的信息 (CIO Asia 2011). 从更广的角度来讲，很多企业现在已经意识到将适当的应用程序发布在各个应用商店可以提供一个灵活的渠道来提升他们的品牌、吸引更多客户，并最终实现产品的销售。这一现象在广泛使用移动应用作为营销手段的传媒业、服务业、娱乐产业尤其明显。随着移动应用的发展与成熟，如何衡量这些应用为客户、企业及社会带来的价值将成为一个重要的问题. 目前经济学相关的研究及文献主要是集中在用户使用移动渠道与传统渠道行为的差异，我们相信移动应用带来的新的产品及服务蕴含着巨大的价值。先前的许多工作已经研究了移动网络对网络内容的创造及消费行为的影响，但对移动应用价值还没有系统的研究. 本研究的贡献在于提出了一个用于衡量用户需求及应用相关、并度量用户剩余价值与应用程序可用性之间关系的结构化模型。本研究采用实证的产业组织（IO）方法对模型进行估计。我们已经获得了一个大型的总部设在韩国的亚洲移动应用的公司合作，收集了大量应用程序的价格、销售数量和其他的一些特性。在一定程度上移动应用程序的价格和产品特性会影响市场绩效，移动应用程序商店的规模日益扩大，将会对移动商务的未来发展方向产生深远的影响.

First, we have identified and estimated the consumer demand of mobile apps and examined how different users value differently various mobile app characteristics. Second, we built a novel, structural model of user demand and app developer's supply and empirically estimated the model using advanced industrial organization methods. Third, we quantified the consumers' economic surplus from the availability of mobile apps and found mobile apps have enhanced consumer surplus by approximately $33.6 billion annually in the US.

143312.label: Major findings and research outcome
143312.value: In 2013, the global mobile app market was estimated at over US $50 billion and is expected to grow to $150 billion in the next 2 years. In this paper, we build a structural econometric model to quantify the vibrant platform competition between mobile (smartphone and tablet) apps on the Apple iOS and Google Android platforms and estimate consumer preferences towards different mobile app characteristics. We find that app demand increases with the in-app purchase option wherein a user can complete transactions within the app. On the contrary, app demand decreases with the in-app advertisement option where consumers are shown ads while they are engaging with the app. The direct effect on app revenue from the inclusion of an in-app purchase and in-app advertisement option is equivalent to offering a 28 percent price discount and increasing price by 8 percent, respectively. We also find that a price discount strategy results in a greater increase of app demand in Google Play compared to Apple App Store, and app developers can maximize their revenue by providing 50% discount on their paid apps. Using the estimated demand function, we find that mobile apps have enhanced consumer surplus by approximately $33.6 billion annually in the US, and discuss various implications for mobile marketing analytics, app pricing and app design strategies.

143312.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
143312.value: Our app-level data cannot distinguish whether multiple downloads of an app originate from a single user through multiple mobile devices (i.e., a smartphone and a tablet) or whether they are from multiple users. Future research can consider a multivariate probit model to model possible inter-dependency across apps when an average consumer purchases multiple apps per day, provided they have data on individual-level data and the number of apps is not too large. We do not observe app usage data. Future research can consider a unified model of the demand for app usage with discrete app purchase choices, provided they have individual-level data on app usage. Further, our data set does not contain price menu information of in-app purchases. Future research may consider examining how app developers set their price menu of in-app purchases and determine the in-app advertisement price, and how they affect consumer demand and cost function equations. Notwithstanding these limitations, to the extent that prices and product characteristics of mobile apps affect market outcomes, the increasing size of the mobile app industry may have profound implications for the future direction of mobile commerce and mobile customer analytics.

143612.label: Project Objectives
143612.value: Despite the fact that the adjudication committee is key to decision-making in Chinese courts, its detailed operation has rarely been explored. Through systematically examining the archival minutes of the committee’s meetings, this project will uncover the operation pattern of the committees and explore its underlying reasons. Different from previous studies that rely on legal regulations, sporadic interviews, published judgments, media reports, and anecdotal accounts to study the adjudication committee, in this Project we will employ a new method – by directly examining the archival minutes of the committee’s meetings. This method will strengthen the objectivity of the studies and provide a systematic basis for understanding Chinese courts in action. Despite outcries for reform, the core structure of the adjudication committee has remained largely unchanged during the reform period. This Project will explore the vested interests and other forces that countenance the endurance of the committee, and expose the obstacles and institutional inertia that have been hindering its reform. More importantly, because the research findings will be based on systematic empirical data analysis, this Project may provide the necessary impetus for reforming the committee. Through examining whether and how the adjudication committee may provide a shelter for Chinese judges to avoid responsibility for decisions, this Project will provide a unique China’s story on the relationship between accountability and institutional constraints in the courts of authoritarian regimes. It will enrich the literature of comparative judicial politics, which has most drawn from the experience of other authoritarian regimes (Ginsburg and Moustafa 2008; Hilbink 2007; Russell 2001; Solomon 2007).

143612.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
143612.value: How judges and courts make decisions is undoubtedly central to legal studies. Until recently, the existing studies on the adjudication committee, the most important decision-making body in Chinese courts, have been handicapped by the unavailability of systematic data. Collecting data from the minutes of the committee’s meetings and interviews with relevant judges, this Project will expand our prior case study of the adjudication committee to six courts with representative profiles of different levels of caseload, court hierarchy, economic and institutional development, political ideology, and judicial professionalism and transparency. It will document the committee’s operational patterns and reveal their underlying reasons. The outcome of this project will contribute to scholarship on the relationship between courts, judges, and authoritarian regimes, including judicial accountability, power, and politics in China and beyond. It will shed light on legal consistency, trial transparency, due process, judicial corruption, and judicial independence in Chinese courts. It will also generate policy recommendations for legal reforms and provide evidence for broader theoretical debates. 本研究将从中国法院的审判委员会的会议笔录及对有关法官的访谈来研究审委会的运作。它将发现基中的运作规律及根本原因。本研究的结果将增进有关威权制度下法院法官的关系，包括司法可问责性，权力及政治等因素。它将对法律一致性、审判公开、正当程序、司法腐败以及司法独立等问题提供洞见。

143612.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
143612.value: How courts and judges in authoritarian regimes decide cases behind closed doors has rarely been studied, but it is critically important in comparative judicial studies. Primarily drawing on the minutes of the adjudication committee in lower courts in China, this project explores its operational patterns and decision-making process. The data suggest that among the criminal cases reviewed by the committee, very few were difficult or significant, but a relatively high percentage of the suggested opinions of the adjudicating judges was modified. In contrast, many civil cases reviewed were difficult to resolve but the committee offered little assistance. Overall the operation and decision-making of the committee were subsumed by the administrative ranking system inside the court and the authority of the court president was enormous. The analysis also demonstrates the limited role of the committee in both promoting legal consistency and resisting external influences. Instead of achieving its declared goals, the committee has degenerated into a device for both individual judges and committee members to shelter responsibility. The findings compel researchers to reevaluate the role of the adjudication committee in Chinese courts, and the relationship between judges and authoritarian regimes.

144012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
144012.value: 這個研究是探討一個當代中國學者鮮有關注的課題：究竟文化圖像(cultural schema) 如何影響草根抗爭運動的經驗？文化圖像從概念上跟權力和資源關係密切，但同時又可以清晰地跟這二者區分；而在研究草根抗爭時，文化圖像卻往往為社會學家所忽略。是次研究的出發點為在2010年7、8月間在廣州市出現的一連串撐粵語運動。這個為期甚短而被社會學界忽視的社會運動牽涉超過一萬個抗議群眾，到後期警方介入時，拘捕了二十多人，當中包括記者。整個撐粵語運動主要是反對政府建議把部份粵語的電視頻道在亞運會期間改成普通話頻道。 這次表面上毫不起眼的社會運動實際上具有獨特的理論旨趣，因為它跟階級和經濟資源並無直接關連，它主要牽涉到地方為本的身份政治，換句話說，運動的目的旨在維持一種文化模式。情況跟70年代在歐洲和南美洲看到的「新社會運動」有些相似，那時人們觀察到草根抗爭的重點由物質需要轉移到身份政治上。所以撐粵語運動提供了一些新的角度去了解中國當代城市草根抗爭的問題，即是文化圖像如何混進草根政治，並影響其抗爭的手段、動能和結果。 是次研究主要採用個案研究手法，即是研究者主要與撐粵語運動有關的持份者進行訪談，當中包括運動的組織者、參與者、目擊者和支持者。研究更會廣泛接觸受2010年亞運會影響的其他城市和農村持份者，並獲得到他們對事件的看法。此外，研究亦會訪問對事件有興趣的學者，記者和博客。

144512.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
144512.value: An increasing focus on firms’ political connection has been documented in corporate strategy literature. Firms get explicitly connected by hiring politicians as their board directors, or by making firm directors serve as politicians. Firms can also get implicitly connected by making political contributions. These connections have been established by firms’ active efforts to be connected for the purpose of enhancing firms’ benefits from connections. The recent literature documents the importance of geography on firm value. Kim, Pantzalis, and Park (2011) analyze a political dimension to geography and its impact on firm value. Firms whose headquarters are located in states more closely aligned with the party in the White House perform better than those firms located in states which are less closely aligned with the president’s party. This result can be interpreted as being consistent with the notion that firms with high alignment with the president’s party leads to higher policy risk (i.e., uncertainty related to the impacts of changes in government future policy and its implementation) which, in turn, results in higher future returns. Alternatively, their findings can also be interpreted that benefits from connections to the party in the White House causes an increase in cash flows and higher future returns. The main purpose of this proposal is to differentiate these two competing forces of policy risk and indirect political benefits in the context of firm’s access to private debt financing. This attempt is possible under debt financing but it is extremely difficult by studying cross-sectional variations in future returns of firms, because both explanations predict that firms with high political alignment outperform those with low alignment. Firms with high alignment is more susceptible to higher loan interest premium and more restrictive loan contracts, given the fact that policy risk could be translated into the downside risk of the bank loan. Benefit from indirect connections to the party in White House will induce a lower interest and fewer restrictive loan contracts, as opposed to the policy risk prediction. Given the scarce of the literature on the above-mentioned issue, our research will introduce political geography to loan literature and identify the possible link between them. Our research will also broaden the definition of political connectedness to include small-sized firms. Those direct political connections through human ties and contributions can be utilized by big-sized firms with more resources. However, geo-politics can be applied to all firms in a specific state. 公司策略的研究越來越多地開始關注公司建立政治關係的行為。公司的政治關係可能是由於聘用了以往的政治人物為董事會成員，或曾經的董事會成員變成了政治人物。公司的政治關係也有可能通過政治捐獻來實現。以上所述的兩種政治關係，都是公司出於牟利的目的，主動去建立的。 最近的研究表明了地理因素在公司價值方面的重要性。Kim，Pantzalis，和Park（2011）從政治關係的角度分析了地理因素，即本標題所指的政治版圖，以及其對公司價值的影響。他們發現，假如公司的總部位於支持執政黨的那些州，公司具有更好的市場表現。這一現象可以有兩種解釋。一是公司因為所在州在選舉中支持執政黨，會承受更多的政治風險（即政府未來政策制定實施帶來的不確定）。二是公司因為所在州在選舉中支持執政黨，而獲得了政治關係，從而帶來更高的未來現金流和未來收益。 本研究的主要目的是通過研究公司如何獲取銀行直接貸款，來區分上述兩種不同的解釋，政治風險與政治關係。想區分這兩種解釋，通過對企業市場收益的面板數據回歸分析是很難實現的，因為兩種解釋有着相同的實證結果。但在對銀行直接貸款的研究卻有可能實現：假如政治風險的解釋成立，那麼在地理上獲得政治關係的公司更有可能出現銀行貸款的債務風險，於是銀行會對這些公司要求更高的貸款利率以及更多的貸款條款限制；相反假如政治關係的解釋成立，銀行則會對這些公司要求更低的貸款利率以及更少的貸款條款限制。 目前針對以上所述問題的研究還很少，我們的研究把政治版圖因素引入到銀行貸款的文獻分析中，來考察這二者之間可能的聯繫。我們的研究還將拓展政治關係的定義，使其也包括小規模的企業。因為無論是通過人際關係或政治捐獻建立的政治關係，都需要耗費大量的資源，因此只能為大規模企業所用。但通過政治版圖建立的政治關係卻可為所在州中的所有公司使用。

144512.label: Realisation of objectives
144512.value: We have achieved the first project objective by empirically testing the effects of political geography on bank loan premiums and loan contract restrictiveness. Political geography is empirically measured by the Political Alignment Index (PAI) which is the state-level index designed to reflect the partisan alignment of a state’s officers and federal representatives with the president’s party. Our measures of firm-level political geography represent firms’ political proximity to the White House. Firms whose headquarters are located in states more closely aligned with the party in the White House are classified as high PAI firms. Thus, our research extends the definition of political connectedness to include small-sized firms with limited resources, because political connections through human ties, lobbying and contributions can be utilized only by big-sized firms with more resources. However, our geo-politics can be applied to any firms whose headquarters are located in U.S. Our research extends firm’s political connectedness by including indirect and passive connections through headquarter locations. Our research investigates the effects on bank loans of 'indirect' and 'passive' political connections via firm headquarter locations in addition to 'direct' and 'active' political strategies through human-ties, lobbying activities and campaign contributions. By doing so, we have accomplished our second objective of finding the possible links between political geography and bank loan decisions. We find that firms with PAI tend to pay higher bank loan premiums and are subject to more restrictive loan contracts. Our findings are consistent with the notion that policy risk dominates preferential benefits from indirect political connectedness. We have attained our third objective of assessing the relative importance of the two possible reasons (policy risk and/or preferential benefits from indirect political connectedness) why political geography matters for bank loan decisions. We fail to find that the positive relation between firm PAI and loan premiums is more pervasive with government spending. Given our findings in the third objective that PAI represents policy risk, this failure to find more pervasive relation between firm PAI and loan premiums with more government spending is not surprising. The fourth objective is based on the assumption of political benefit effects. We find that preferential loan treatments are more prevalent in firms with ex-politicians on their boards when government spending increases.

144512.label: Major findings and research outcome
144512.value: We find that firms with PAI tend to pay higher bank loan premiums and are subject to more restrictive loan contracts. Our findings are consistent with the notion that policy risk dominates preferential benefits from indirect political connectedness in the bank loan context. We also find that firms with ex-politicians on their boards and with campaign contributions are prone to pay lower loan premiums, consistent with notion that active connections represent preferential benefits.

144512.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
144512.value: Our research can be further developed by investigating corporate political strategies as to how firms' mixture of active and passive connections influences loan premiums and loan contracts.

144512.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
144512.value: Extant literature on political connections has focus on direct and active connections to politicians. Firms use human ties to obtain connections by hiring former politicians as their board directors. Firms also attempt to get connected to politicians by making political contributions and by lobbying. Firms intend to directly influence on politicians and thereby enhancing firms’ political benefits. By introducing political geography, an indirect and passive political connection, to bank loan literature, our research extend the definition of political connectedness to include small-sized firms, because those direct and active political connections through human-ties, lobbying, and campaign contributions can be utilized only by big-sized firms with more resources. However, our political geography can be applied to all firms whose headquarters are located in U.S. Political geography is empirically measured by the Political Alignment Index (PAI) which is the state-level index designed to reflect the partisan alignment of a state’s officers and federal representatives with the president’s party. We find that firms with PAI tend to pay higher bank loan premiums and are subject to more restrictive loan contracts. Our findings are consistent with the notion that policy risk dominates preferential benefits from indirect political connectedness.

145412.label: Project Title(Chinese)
145412.value: 帶有信用評級的主權信用風險建模

145412.label: Project Objectives
145412.value: The main objectives of the current project are two-fold. First, we develop a tractable, continuous-time, rating-based sovereign credit risk model with rich term structure implications. Second, we conduct a rigorous econometric analysis of the model using sovereign CDS spreads. In our model, the credit rating for each country follows a continuous-time Markov chain characterized by a common transition matrix. Countries in different rating groups follow different default intensity processes. Therefore, our model explicitly distinguishes between the contributions to credit risk due to rating change and default. In one version of the model, we allow a global factor to affect the transition matrix of sovereign rating migrations as well as the instantaneous default intensity of each country. We also allow a country specific factor to drive the default intensity of each individual country. Thus, this model also distinguishes between the impacts of global and country specific factors on CDS spreads. We will estimate the model using sovereign CDS spreads of different countries based on maximum likelihood method. While existing reduced-form models typically estimate an intensity process of an individual country, the structure imposed by our model allows us to estimate the global factor using CDS spreads of all countries. It also allows us to estimate the rating-specific default factor using CDS spreads of countries with same rating. Based on our estimate model, we will study the contributions of rating change and default as well as global and local factors to sovereign CDS spreads. We can also study the performance of rating agencies through our rating-based sovereign credit risk model. To understand the nature of the global and local factors, we can study how these factors relate to the global and local macroeconomic and financial variables.

145412.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
145412.value: The recent global financial crisis has highlighted the important role played by credit rating agencies in world credit markets. We have witnessed extensive media coverage of downgrades of sovereign governments (including even the strongest borrower, the US government) by rating agencies and violent reactions to these downgrades from sovereign CDS markets. Rating changes could represent a discrete and material change of the credit quality of a borrower. Moreover, rating downgrades could seriously affect market’s perception of the credit quality of a borrower and limit its access to capital. Therefore, credit rating could have a nontrivial or even first order effect on the borrowing cost of a sovereign entity. Unfortunately, the existing academic literature on sovereign credit risk has mainly focused on modeling continuous evolution rather than discrete change of the credit quality of a sovereign borrower. For example, the reduced-form sovereign credit risk models of Pan and Singleton (2008), Ang and Longstaff (2011) and others typically assume that the default intensity of a sovereign borrower follows a continuous-time diffusion process and completely ignore the role played by ratings. However, in today’s volatile markets with constant changes in the fortunes of nations, existing models might not be able to completely capture the default risk of sovereign borrowers and could yield misleading conclusions, both quantitatively and qualitatively, in studies of sovereign credit markets. Our project bridges the gap in the literature by developing a continuous-time model of sovereign default risk with credit ratings. Our model explicitly distinguishes between two important components of sovereign credit risk: the risk of default and the risk of credit rating changes. Our model provides a rich and yet tractable characterization of the term structure of CDS spreads and will shed new light on the role of credit ratings in determining sovereign CDS spreads. We plan to conduct a rigorous econometric analysis of the model using sovereign CDS data. Our modeling approach makes it possible to investigate the role played by rating agencies during the financial crisis in a systematic way through the sovereign CDS markets. We can potentially answer some of the important questions regarding the rating agencies: their relevance, usefulness and accuracy in assessing sovereign credit risk. 最近的全球金融危機凸顯了評級機構在全球信貸市場上所發揮的重要作用。我們見證了媒體關於評級機構下調主權政府（包括最強大的借債人——美國政府）信用評級的廣泛報導，以及由此帶來的主權信用違約掉期（Credit Swap Default, CDS）市場的劇烈動盪。信用評級的變化代表了借債人信用品質離散的、實質性的變化。此外，評級下調可能會嚴重影響整個市場對借債人信用品質的感知，從而限制其獲取資本的能力。因此，信用評級對主權實體的借貸成本可能有一個非平凡的，甚至是第一位的影響。 但是，現有的關於主權信用風險的學術文獻主要關注主權借債人的信用品質的連續演變而非其離散變化。例如，Pan & Singleton （2008)，Ang & Longstaff （2011）等所運用的簡約模型通常假設主權借債人的違約強度服從連續時間擴散過程，完全忽視了信用評級的影響。然而，在當今不穩定市場條件下，國家財富會發生經常性的劇烈變化，現有的模型可能無法完全刻畫主權借債人的違約風險，並可能在研究主權信用市場時產生令人誤解結論。這種誤解可能是數量上的甚至是定性的。 我們的項目通過研究一個帶有信用評級的連續時間主權違約風險模型來彌補現有文獻的不足。我們的模型將主權信用風險的兩個重要組成部分——違約風險和信用評級的轉換風險，明確區分開來。我們的模型為信用違約掉期利差的期限結構提供了豐富且技術上易處理的刻畫，該模型將對信用評級在確定主權信用違約掉期利差時所起的作用做出全新的闡釋。我們計劃運用主權信用違約掉期數據對模型實施嚴謹的計量經濟分析。該建模方法，使我們可以通過主權信用違約掉期市場，以一種系統化的方式研究金融危機期間信用評級機構所起的作用。我們有可能回答與信用評級機構相關的一系列重要問題：他們的相關性，實用性，以及對主權信用風險評估的準確性等。

145412.label: Major findings and research outcome
145412.value: In this project, we consider a rating-based continuous-time model of sovereign credit risk, which simultaneously captures the cross-sectional and time-series properties of sovereign credit spreads and offers closed-form solutions for a wide range of credit derivatives. In the model, rating transition follows a continuous-time Markov chain, and countries with the same credit rating share similar levels of default risk. One of the greatest advantages of our approach is that it offers a parsimonious and unified framework to capture the credit risk of multiple countries. A simple version of this model, with only 17 parameters, one common and one country-specific factor, can simultaneously capture the term structure of CDS spreads of 34 in-sample and 34 out-of-sample countries well. On average, the common factor, along with credit ratings, explains 34 more than 60% of the variations of the CDS spreads of both the in-sample and out-of-sample countries, whereas more than 50% of the variations of the common factor is explained by the CBOE VIX index and the MSCI World stock index. Our model also yields a natural implied credit rating. With the model implied ratings, the explanatory power of the common factor in explaining sovereign CDS spreads increases to more than 80%.

145412.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
145412.value: The model developed in this project can be modified to study corporate credit risk.

145412.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
145412.value: We study the nature of sovereign credit risk through a rating-based continuous-time model for sovereign CDS spreads. Rating transition follows a Markov chain, and countries with the same credit rating share the same level of systematic default risk. Empirical analysis shows that the explicit modeling of the dependence of sovereign credit risk on rating can enable the model to jointly capture the cross-sectional and time-series variations of sovereign CDS spreads of multiple countries. Consequently, a parsimonious version of the model can simultaneously capture the term structure of the CDS spreads of 34 in-sample and 34 out-of-sample countries well. The common factor, along with the observed ratings, can explain more than 60% of the variations of sovereign CDS spreads of all countries. This explanatory power jumps to more than 80% when we replace the observed ratings with the model implied ratings.

145712.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
145712.value: 你有沒有想過，一些在ctrip.com或amazon.com由用戶提供的產品評論是假的？根據2009年的尼爾森全球網上消費者調查，其中涉及來自50個國家（包括中國）的25,000 受訪者中，70％的受訪者表示，他們看了網上的評論，然後才作出購買。然而，人們越來越關注在線產品評論的可信性。企業有利益動機製造虛假的產品評論，以誇大自己的產品的優點，或詆毀競爭對手的產品。今年早些時候，美國聯邦貿易委員會判罰一家公司通過網絡聯盟營銷商，把一系列的吉他課DVD營銷廣告宣傳作為普通消費者的網上的評論。每日背景報也報告說，一家電腦零售商支付65美分給“網上打手”發布每個“抬價”的評論，以促進公司產品在amazon.com的人氣。欺騙性的網上產品評價，被認為是提高銷售的捷徑，它可以影響消費者的購買決策，並可能對其他供應商的銷售產生不利影響。為促進大中華區的公平交易，並拱衛消費者的權益，確實有一個迫切需要發展有效率和高性能的欺騙性評論審查檢測服務，來識別並過濾掉雙語欺騙性的網上評論。 依靠一個手動的方法來檢測欺騙性的評論是不可行的，原因有二：（1）因為“真理偏見” ，人手檢測是缺乏效能的（2）每天有數量巨大的產品評論發布到Web，人手檢測是缺乏效率的。然而，自動檢測欺騙性的評論是一個非常具挑戰性的研究課題。不同垃圾網站或垃圾郵件，突出的特徵（例如，某些商業垃圾郵件的關鍵字）通常是缺少在欺騙性的評論裡。因而，探測器難以利用評論特徵以進行檢測。而且，網上打手每每刻意隱瞞造假的痕跡，並把欺騙性的評論寫成活脫脫像一個真實的評論。現有的欺騙評論檢測方法往往採用了基於偏差（例如，檢測評論偏離平均評分）或基於相似性的方法（例如，檢測兩個內容很相似的評論）。然而，前一種方法受到其可靠性差的局限。因為，個人可能會偏離多數人的喜好。後者的做法局限於計算的複雜度和檢測時間。因此，現有的欺騙評論檢測方法很難擴展到處理龐大的在線產品評論。此外，現有的方法大多只適用於英文撰寫的評論中。 在設計科學的研究方法引導下，並且立足於人際欺騙理論，我們提出的研究項目的目標如下： • 為了解決現有方法的缺點以檢測欺騙性的網上評論，我們將設計一個雙語審查檢測服務，可以有效地“挖掘”上下文相關的，潛在的欺騙性痕跡，從而提高在多個欺騙內容中檢測的準確性。 • 為消費者提供評價為基礎的購買決策的正確的意見，我們將使用我們的審查檢測服務進行第一次大規模的實證研究，以估量在雙語環境下的在線產品評論的可信性。該數據集將包括數以百萬計從taobao.com，亞馬遜，cnet.com等各大網站取得的產品評論。 • 評估欺騙性網上評論對公司的銷售和消費者的購買所產生的影響，我們將進行全球首個計量經濟分析研究。 這個項目設計的網上評論審查檢測服務，可以應用於電子商務網站或第三方機構監視網站（例如，Reputation.com），以提高整體雙語網上評論的質量和衛生。建議的研究項目將促進公平交易，並在大中華地區提高消費者的福利。

145712.label: Realisation of objectives
145712.value: All the stated research objectives have been fully achieved. More specifically, we have successfully completed the following research work: 1. We have designed and developed an effective and efficient bilingual deceptive review detection service, which can “mine” the latent traces left by deceivers by using a Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) method that is bootstrapped by an ontology. The proposed detection service has been successfully applied to various deception contexts such as Chinese online media, English online media, e-Commerce Websites, and online social networks. 2. We have constructed bilingual benchmark review collections which incorporate contextual deception factors into the reviews crawled from Amazon, Taobao, and other social media data sources. These benchmark collections have been applied to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed deceptive review detection service. 3. We have conducted a large-scale empirical study about the trustworthiness of bilingual product reviews by using the proposed deceptive review detection service. 4. We have designed a novel econometric model to analyze the impact of truthful reviews and deceptive reviews on the actual product sales based on the Amazon data set.

145712.value: 1. We have developed an information theory-based multi-perspective methodology to detect deceptive online comments about products. In particular, a Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) method, which is bootstrapped by an ontology, is applied to “mine” the latent traces left by deceivers. The design of the proposed LDA-based spam detection model was reported and submitted to the journal of Electronic Commerce Research (under second round of review). The effectiveness of the proposed LDA-based method has also been tested under the context of cybercriminal network detection and the related research results published in IEEE Computational Intelligence Magazine. On the other hand, our research work about automated ontology construction which is related to the proposed ontology-based deception detection method has been successfully published in INFORMS Journal on Computing (a journal in the University of Texas Dallas (UTD) journal list). Moreover, our research work about the extraction of contextual factors (e.g., the social relationships of review writers) which can be applied to detective review detection has been published in Decision Support Systems. 2. We have constructed bilingual benchmark review collections which incorporate contextual deception factors into the reviews crawled from Amazon, Taobao, and other social media data sources. These benchmark collections have been successfully applied to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed deceptive review detection service. The details of these bilingual benchmark data sets have been reported in our submissions to Decision Support Systems (under second round of review) and Electronic Commerce Research (under second round of review). 3. We have conducted large-scale empirical studies about the trustworthiness of bilingual product reviews by using the proposed deceptive review detection service. While the absolute rate of deceptive review rate may not be necessarily high across all product categories, the fake (spam) review problem could be serious for certain products or online social media sources. Our research findings are highlighted in our submissions to Decision Support Systems (under second round of review) and Electronic Commerce Research (under second round of review). 4. We have designed and applied a linear regression model to examine the impact of truthful reviews and deceptive reviews on the actual product sales based on the Amazon data set. Our results reveal that negative deceptive reviews can cause detrimental effect on product sales (in terms of the significant drop of sales rank in Amazon’s product ranking).

145712.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
145712.value: With the explosive growth of user-contributed product comments in online social media such as Twitter and Sina Weibo, existing deceptive product comment detection methods simply cannot scale up with these “big data”. For instance, both content- and behavior-based methods utilize the feature of near duplicate contents to detect deceptive reviews. Nevertheless, near duplicate comment detection required polynomial time complexity in general. Given tens of millions of comments posted to online social media every day, existing near duplicate detection methods become impractical. On the other hand, our current study has not examined the “diffusion patterns” of online comments for the detection of deceptive reviews in online social networks. To the best of our knowledge, none of the work reported in existing literature has examined the problem of scalable feature extraction (e.g., extracting near duplicate and diffusion pattern features) from big data for detecting deceptive product comments. For further development of our research work, we will develop scalable computational methods to extract deceptive features from big social media data for the detection of online product reviews.

145712.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
145712.value: In the 2009 Nielsen Global Online Consumer survey, which involved 25,000 respondents from 50 countries (including China), 70% of the respondents said that they read online reviews before making purchases. Nevertheless, there have been growing concerns about the trustworthiness of online product reviews. Firms have financial motivations to generate deceptive reviews (i.e., fictitious reviews that are written to deceive the readers) that inflate the true qualities of their products, or defame their competitors’ products. In fact, the Federal Trade Commission in the U.S. fined a company selling a series of guitar-lesson DVDs $250K for deceptively advertising its products through online affiliate marketers who falsely posed as ordinary consumers. The Daily Background also reported that a computer retailer was paying 65 cents per review to people who posted “shill” reviews promoting the company’s products at amazon.com. Deceptive online product reviews, which are supposedly boost the perpetrator’s sales, can bias consumers’ purchase decisions, and may have a detrimental effect on other vendors’ sales. To promote fair trading and maintain appropriate consumer welfare in the Greater China area, there is a pressing need to develop effective and efficient deceptive review detection services to identify and filter out bilingual deceptive reviews on the Web.

145912.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
145912.value: 近年，Facebook一類的社交網站激增，更成為人們日常生活的一部分。對大部分人來說，社交網站是建立人際網絡和獲取資訊的上佳社交平台；不過，對部分人來說，這類網站卻可引致重大的行為或心理問題。不少國家都把網絡成癮視為全國性的問題，需要政府介入以應對因科技產生的心理病的情況愈趨普遍。自1996年發現網絡成癮的題題後，相關研究大幅增加。近年，研究員把網絡成癮再細分為網絡性癮、網絡賭癮、沉溺網絡遊戲幾類。最近，美國精神醫學會更把網絡成癮正規診斷列入「精神疾病診斷與統計手冊」初稿的附錄，供業界考慮。縱使這個新興全球問題引起廣泛關注，網絡成癮仍然缺乏科學解釋，部分是由於坊間仍沒有一個共通的定義，也沒有一套統一的術語。此外，目前的研究主要集中在界定範圍和訂立量度標準，以及了解診斷、社會及心理風險因素、症狀處理和治療策略等範疇。 在資訊系統研究中，系統如何被採納應用一直是主要研究範圍之一。現時大部分的研究均集中系統應用時所產生的價值和好處，這些研究以應用資訊系統時可為用者帶來裨益為基礎。不正確使用互聯絡技術的概念，在資訊系統研究領域仍然比較陌生，從學術層面理解其發展亦相對缺乏。資訊系統學術界對這個相當重要的領域，無論在理論或實際應用層面均關注不多，此研究計劃旨在提出一個涵蓋面廣闊的理論架構，並將以縱向方式，從理論及實際上探討各項相關因素，了解網絡成癮的發展。 在這研究計劃中，我們會在網上調查Facebook的常用者，以測試研究模型。此外，建立研究模型時，我們會發展及驗證量度的方法。由於我們對科技日益依賴，這項研究計劃將會對理論和應用層面均有重要貢獻。在理論方面，這項研究計劃代表資訊科技文獻裏相對少觸及的一個範圍，並藉着為網絡成癮的情況提供理論解釋，鑑定使用者由習慣使用社交網站演變為網絡成癮的過程，充實現有的研究。我們還將會為這特定的情景訂立一系列新的量度工具。在應用層面，這項研究的結果將有助臨床醫生、教師及家長了解可能導致網絡成癮的過程。此外，研究結果有助互聯網公司設立可持續和健康的網上社交平台。

145912.label: Major findings and research outcome
145912.value: Anecdotal evidence suggests that problematic use of social media has become prevalent among a large proportion of users and led to signiﬁcant behavioral and psychological problems. Nevertheless, theory-driven investigation into this issue is still relatively scarce, and the few existing studies tend to adopt only a conceptual or descriptive approach. This study uses a theory-guided approach and seeks to clarify the development of psychological dependence in the context of social media, with a particular focus on microblogging. Building on the theory of rational addiction, this study hypothesizes that dependence is initially developed from habit. Furthermore, the study draws on the cognitive–affective–behavioral modeling paradigm to hypothesize that maladaptive cognition and affect tend to distort habit into psychological dependence. We have conducted a longitudinal empirical test to validate the underlying mechanism of social media dependence as theorized in our study, with a panel sample of some 470 respondents. We have also developed and empirically validated a corresponding measurement instrument in the process. The key findings are as follows: First, the results show that distorted affect and deﬁcient self-regulation have a positive inﬂuence on social media dependence, suggesting that both of these factors are critical in the development of psychological dependence. In particular, negative affect anticipation is found to be the most important determinant in predicting social media dependence. Second, in terms of the irrational behavioral paradigm, although perceived enjoyment shows a strong inﬂuence on perceived irreplaceability, the relationship between perceived usefulness and irreplaceability is not signiﬁcant. Third, habit offers a notable degree of explanatory power concerning maladaptive cognitions (e.g., in terms of perceived usefulness, ease of use and enjoyment). This ﬁnding indicates that the strength of a habit affects not only the distal system but also the proximal system.

145912.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
145912.value: First, for a large segment of the population, social media dependence may start off as a habit, but it may not always be so. From this perspective, other paths and possible constructs (e.g., social inﬂuence) that may lead to the development of social media dependence should be investigated in future research. Second, it is hard to put a time limit as a correct point in time when social media dependence occurs. In this case, we choose six weeks as an approximate time limit on the basis of prior habit literature. However, future research may employ a more extended longitudinal study with multiple measurement points in time to investigate the timing aspect of the development of social media dependence. Third, since our data involves only certain types of Chinese microblog users, one may question the generalizability of the results even though Chinese microblog users themselves alone constitute a sufﬁciently large and signiﬁcant target population for study. Although the population characteristics of our sample are similar to those of general microblog users, and social media users (e.g., users of Facebook), future research may include other types of samples to increase the generalizability and robustness of the results.

145912.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
145912.value: Psychological dependence in social media should not go unchecked, as it can bring serious negative outcomes for the individuals concerned and for society as a whole. Distorted affect leads to psychological dependence and addiction behavior. Given the central role of the irrational behavior paradigm, individuals who understand the mechanism of addiction should search for substitutes to the use of social media and should help to develop various approaches (e.g., face-to-face communication) for decreasing the user's over-reliance on social media. In addition, our results demonstrate that personal psychosocial characteristics (e.g., deﬁcient self-regulation) facilitate the development of addiction behavior. By identifying the key role of self-regulation, our study suggests that users may reduce their problematic use of social media through strengthening self-control. Our results also help service providers in understanding the mechanism of addiction behavior. As social media has become a new platform for social connection and procurement of information, it is very important for organizations to grasp the underlying mechanism of individual addiction behavior. The critical role of cognition and affect should be noted by service providers as they seek to enable a healthy and sustainable usage behavior.
