154412.label: Realisation of objectives
154412.value: Objective 1 involves characterizing the trajectories (i.e., linear or nonlinear trends) of how social networks form in the first place and grow thereafter. To achieve the objective, we have collected evolutionary data from multiple social networking sites, ranging from friendship networks to microblogging networks and scientific collaborative networks, and then tested a series of theoretical models to fit the empirical data. The approach enables to us answer thoroughly the questions asked under objective 1. Objectives 2 and 3 involve testing two hypotheses (homophily and preferential attachment) about why social networks form and grow. Since the two hypotheses are competing to each other, we have carried out a series of dynamic (i.e., temporal) network analyses based on a unified model to test the hypotheses. The approach helps us to achieve objectives 2 and 3 satisfactorily.

154412.label: Major findings and research outcome
154412.value: For objective 1, we find that the trajectories of the formation and growth of social networks follow a logistic model (i.e., an S-shaped curve) that has been repeatedly documented in the diffusion of other information and communication technologies such as telephone, television, and the internet. What’s new from our study is that we uncover that, while the trajectories at the population level follow the general logistic model, the growth trends of ego-networks at the individual level can be better modeled with several variants of logistic model, including double-logistic model (i.e., double-S curve) and power model (a rotated-L curve). We further develop a pair of concepts (global regularity and individual variability) to integrate the process. For objectives 2 and 3, we find that both homophily (i.e., similarity) between users and preferential attachment (i.e., popularity of centrally located users attracts peripheral users) have a significant impact on the formation and growth of networking ties. Furthermore, the two mechanisms operate at different stages of the process, as we hypothesized as a "stage-dependent model" in the proposal. In particular, homophily plays a greater role for new members of the network whereas preferential attachment becomes increasingly dominant as the members expand their ego-network size. We have published 10+ articles to describe the above findings and relevant methodological challenges/solutions in SCI-/SSCI-indexed journals across social science, business studies, and computer science.

154412.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
154412.value: One particular challenge we have encountered throughout the project is how to sample online social networks so that relevant analyses can be done more efficiently. As it comes out that this is an extremely important but largely overlooked question. We have spent a considerably amount of time in the project experimenting different sampling methods but have not been able to reach a conclusive solution. We submitted two GRF proposals to carry out follow-up studies on network sampling, but unfortunately weren't able to convince the panel members/reviewers about the importance and values of this line of research. We will pick up this research direction in the future when there is funding from an alternative source.

154412.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
154412.value: Online social networks have emerged as a dominant platform for members of the modern society to interact each other. However, it has remained to know exactly how the online ties are initially established and grow thereafter and, more importantly, why the ties are formed and changing. The current study address the two lines of questions based on large-scale data from multiple online social networks such as friendship networks, microblogging networks, and scientific collaborative networks. Two major findings have emerged from the study. First, the growth of online social networks demonstrates a consistent global regularity (S-curve trajectories) at the population level with considerable variability (double S-curve, rotated L-curve, etc.) at the individual level. Second, while homophily (i.e., similarity between users) is the primary driving force for the initial formation of online social ties, preferential attachment (i.e., popularity of central users attracting peripheral users) plays an increasingly important role in the subsequent growth of networking ties. Both findings bear useful implications for a wide range of applications in social, business, and technological settings.

154712.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
154712.value: The genre of landscape painting has long been placed by literati on top of the hierarchy of Chinese art after the Five Dynasties. In spite of the fact that landscape painting played a pivotal role in the artistic discourse in modern China—not to mention that an extensive body of textual and visual material related to the genre is available but has so far been overlooked–no scholarly studies have been conducted paying special attention to the development of the genre in general, and the production and consumption of the genre in particular. This project aims to fill in this gap by conducting an in-depth analysis of the social history of the genre, situating it within the greater social and cultural context of early twentieth-century China. It will investigate the transformation and development of the genre over the early half of the twentieth century, ranging from the intellectual debates on the aesthetic ideology of landscape painting to the inextricable link between the rise of tourism and the genre; the introduction of new historiography of Chinese painting in general and in landscape painting in particular; and the consumption of landscape painting in the art market. Based on an extensive collection of primary material—such as paintings, tabloids, magazines, newspapers, price-lists, manuscripts, diaries, travel guidebooks, and painting catalogues—the project will be well-grounded both empirically and theoretically. By adopting a sociological approach, it will explore and analyse the close relationship between landscape painting and the social development of modern Chinese society, making a contribution toward advancing our understanding of the changing values attached to the production and reception of the genre of landscape painting. 自五代以來山水藝術一直被文人視為中國藝術中最重要的畫科。山水畫在中國現代藝術發展中佔有重要的位置，且有大量相關的文字與圖像材料可供研究。然而，對於山水畫的製作和消費一直未有相關的研究。本計劃旨在補充這個研究上的空白，藉社會學的角度，將山水的製作和和消費置於民國時代的上海，期望能重構山水畫的社會史。本計劃將從社會學的角度探討山水畫的發展和蛻變，討論範圍包括山水美學思想的辯論、現代旅遊發展與山水的關係、新史學對山水史的影響以及藝術市場對山水發展的影響。本研究結合實證與理論，使用大量原始資料，包括畫作、小報、雜誌、報紙、潤例、手稿、日記、旅遊指南及畫冊等，藉此深入研究山水畫的製作和消費與社會之間的緊密關係。

155212.value: 誰能得到第二次的機會？被解僱對領導者就業機會的實質和象徵誰能得到第二次的機會？被解僱對領導者就業機會的實質和象徵性影響

155212.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
155212.value: The proposed research explores why some managers are more resilient to their failure compared with others and get rehired in other organizations despite their dismissal. Being fired by an organization may be seen as a career failure for managers. Managers who experience failure (i.e., dismissal) are likely to lose their reputation as a capable manager because failure reflects lack of leadership and capability (Puffer and Weintrop, 1991; Weisbach, 1988). Thus, scholars have argued that such managers tend not to be rehired elsewhere, and those who are rehired work in lesser capacities or at smaller firms. However, some managers are given further opportunities in same-level organizations despite their prior dismissals. In Major League Baseball (MLB), for example, Frank Robinson was fired from his managerial position by the Cleveland Indians because of poor performance in 1977. In 1981, he became the manager of the San Francisco Giants, but he was fired in 1984. Four years later, he became the manager of the Baltimore Orioles in 1988, and was again fired in 1991. Despite his recurrent dismissals, he became the manager of the Montreal Expos 10 years later, in 2002. Despite this anecdotal example, prior studies have paid little attention to the resilience of managers to career failure. The proposed research attempts to fill this gap in the literature by addressing why some managers are given further opportunities despite their career failure while others are not. The current research addresses the question by simultaneously investigating diverse information on failed managers using data from sports teams. In particular, we argue that both substantial and symbolic information on managerial capability (e.g., performance as a manager and as a player) play a significant role in the reappointment of failed managers. Furthermore, we discuss the moderating effects of contextual factors that affect the interpretation of the substantial and symbolic information on managerial capability. The proposed study has multiple contributions to the existing literature. First, it improves the leadership succession literature by focusing on the career path of dismissed managers. Second, the proposed study extends the stigmatization literature by exploring why some managers are rehired despite their failure, but others are not. In addition, career development and motivation literature also benefit from the current study given that career resilience is a component of career motivation. Lastly, the current study will have practical implications for manager selection. N/A

155312.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
155312.value: An American option is a contract which provides its holder the right to buy or sell a certain amount of underlying asset at a pre-specified price at any time up to the maturity date. In financial markets, most of the financial derivatives such as exchange-traded stock options are American-style, and thus the pricing and hedging of these options is of tremendous practical interest. Compared to European options, the early exercise feature of American options poses a significant challenge in American option pricing and hedging, and makes it one of the most challenging problems in financial engineering. Among the American options, some of them are path-dependent in the sense that their payoffs depend on path history of the underlying assets. These path-dependent options are actively traded in the market. While the pricing of ordinary American option is already challenging, the presence of path-dependent feature makes the problem even more complicated. Typically no closed-form solutions are available for American path-dependent options, and thus one has to resort to numerical methods. Among various numerical methods, Monte Carlo simulation is a popular one in pricing complex American options, which allows for general model settings for the underlying asset. This project aims to propose an efficient simulation method for pricing and hedging American path-dependent options. We call it a kernel method because it stems from the kernel regression estimation in nonparametric statistics. While a direct implementation of the kernel method may be time-consuming, we propose an approximate algorithm which enables a fast implementation. In its nature, the proposed kernel method, along with two other existing methods, namely, the traditional stochastic mesh method and the least-squares method, can be viewed as members in the family of generalized stochastic mesh methods. Compared to the traditional stochastic mesh method, the kernel method does not require any density information, and can be implemented much faster. Compared to the least-squares method which might be biased, the kernel method is expected to be asymptotically unbiased, leading to a convergent estimator as the sample size increases. In addition to option price, we are also interested in its sensitivities with respect to some market parameters, which play important roles in constructing hedging strategies. It is expected that the kernel method may also be applied in estimating these price sensitivities, with little extra computational effort. 美式期权赋予买方在到期日之前的任何时刻行使期权的权利。在金融市场上，大部分的金融衍生物都是美式的。因此，美式期权的定价和风险对冲具有很大的理论与现实的意义。与欧式期权相比，美式期权可以提早行使的特征使得它的定价与风险对冲成为一个极具挑战性的问题。 现实中一些美式期权与标的物的路径有关。这个特征使得它的定价与风险对冲变得更加复杂。蒙特卡洛模拟是常用的处理这类问题的方法。本次研究的这个课题主要是设计一个用于与路径相关的美式期权的定价与风险对冲的蒙特卡洛模拟方法。这个方法主要是利用统计中的核估计方法。然而，直接应用核估计方法复杂度太高，运算时间太长。因此我们讨论一种近似算法使得定价能快速执行。与传统方法相比，此次研究课题提供的方法运行时间快，而且可以从理论上证明会收敛到理论的期权价格。

155312.label: Realisation of objectives
155312.value: In regard to Objective 1, we have developed a nonparametric kernel method for pricing American options based on the well-known dynamic-programming formulation of American option price. We have further derived a backward recursion for the sensitivities of the option prices that play important roles in hedging of American options, by using pathwise derivatives of the price dynamics of the underlying assets. This framework enables the estimation of both option price and its sensitivities in the same simulation run, which leads to a significant saving in computationally budget. Numerical experiments indicate that the proposed method works well and is promising for solving practical problems. These results have been presented in a paper published in the proceedings of the 2013 Winter Simulation Conference. In regard to Objective 2, we have analyzed the asymptotic properties of the proposed nonparametric kernel method with particular focus on the consistency of the estimators. We note that similar asymptotic results have been proved in the literature under unrealistic assumptions that may require stock price to be bounded from above. Our theoretical contribution in this regard is to prove the consistency of the estimators under much weaker regularity conditions that can be verified for commonly used models in option price contexts. In regard to Objectives 3 and 4, we have studied the implementation issues. In particular, we explore different methods of kernel smoothing, especially Nadaraya-Watson estimator and the k-nearest neighbor (kNN) estimator. It turns out kNN offers computational advantages and is faster during the implementation. Efficient algorithms for kNN search have been provided by commercial softwares including R and Matlab. We therefore recommend the use of kNN in practice. We have also investigated the incorporation of variance reduction techniques into the dynamic-programming structure of American option pricing. However, it turns out the improvement over simple kernel smoothing is not significant. One of the major issues is that dynamic-programming (DP) structure involves multiple steps, and the estimation error may be accumulated over steps. Thus finding an efficient variance reduction technique that works for all steps turns out to be challenging, which might not be done in this project. These results are part of the thesis of my former PhD student Guiyun Feng. In regard to Objective 5, we have explored two directions on potential applications. The first one is on numerical testing on whether kernel smoothing is viable for high-dimensional American option pricing and hedging problems. It turns out for dimensions as high as 10, the method works quite well. The second direction is on the investigation of a two-level portfolio risk measurement problem, which has similar DP structure as an American option. We analyze its asymptotic properties in this context and propose dimension-reduction techniques when applying it to large portfolios. It turns out kernel smoothing works very well in this problem. The result is part of a research paper which is currently under fourth-round review with Operations Research. In addition, we have also studied how the proposed kernel smoothing method for hedging parameters, especially delta, can be applied to construct upper bounds for American options. The result is written as another research paper.

155312.label: Major findings and research outcome
155312.value: In this project, we have investigated a kernel smoothing approach, with application to pricing and hedging of American option. We have developed a dynamic-programming formulation of the price and sensitivities of an American option, and proposed to estimate them using kernel smoothing estimators. We have investigated the implementation issues of the proposed method in greater detail, with focus on fast implementation methods and effective selection of parameters. Efficiency of the proposed method is illustrated by numerical experiments, which show that it works very well for American options with dimensions as high as 10. A preliminary result appeared as a conference paper in the 2013 Winter Simulation Conference. We have also studied the asymptotic properties of the kernel smoothing estimators, which help to better understand the curse of dimensionality of the kernel method. We show that the kernel estimators are consistent under mild conditions as sample size goes to infinity. These results served as the main part of the thesis of my PhD student FENG Guiyun. In addition to the application to American options, we also studied the application of the kernel smoothing method to nested portfolio risk measurement, which shares a similar conditional-expectation structure. We have studied the kernel smoothing estimator for portfolio risk under a very general setting, and analyzed its asymptotic properties. To enhance the performance of the method, we have proposed a decomposition method that decomposes a high-dimensional risk measurement problem into a sequence of low-dimensional ones which entail an efficient use of the kernel method. We have illustrated via a representative example that the proposed kernel smoothing method in conjunction with the decomposition technique may serve as a viable tool for practical problems in portfolio risk measurement. These results are summarized in a research paper, which is currently under fourth-round revision with Operations Research.

155312.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
155312.value: A further development related to the project is on the measurement of risk for portfolios that are consisting of American options. Though the kernel smoothing approach may be adapted to the portfolio risk measurement setting in principle, a detailed treatment is not trivial and of great practical interest. We will continue to investigate the implementation details along this direction.

155312.value: An American option is a contract which provides its holder the right to buy or sell a certain amount of underlying asset at a pre-specified price at any time up to the maturity date. Among various American options, some are path-dependent in the sense that their payoffs depend on the path history of the underlying asset prices. The early exercise and path-dependent features pose a significant challenge in pricing and hedging of these options, and make it one of the most challenging problems in financial engineering. This project has proposed an efficient simulation method for pricing American path-dependent options. We call it a kernel method because it stems from the kernel regression estimation in nonparametric statistics. We have proposed a fast approximate algorithm to implement the kernel method. Compared to traditional simulation methods, the proposed method can be implemented efficiently and lead to asymptotically unbiased estimators. In addition to option price, we are also interested in its sensitivities with respect to some market parameters, which play important roles in constructing hedging strategies. We show that the kernel method may also be applied in estimating these price sensitivities, with little extra computational effort.

155412.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
155412.value: This proposal aims to create a treebank --- a database of syntactic parses of sentences in a text corpus --- for the Chinese Buddhist Canon. It is difficult to apply standard techniques for textual analysis to the Canon: with 52 million characters, divided into 1,514 individual texts, its sheer volume overwhelms the community of scholars and students who can read it. Furthermore, since the texts represent translations from Indic languages into Chinese from the 2nd to the 11th centuries, the Canon has a complexity that is challenging. We need new techniques to study vast historical texts over time and space --- the Canon has not only 1000 years of linguistic data but also metadata such as the year and place of compilation and names of translators --- at a scale that was not feasible before we had access to digital collections and computational methods. These techniques would allow scholars to pose questions over the entire scope of the corpus such as, who influenced whom, which concepts survived over time, and macroscopic, structural patterns in the texts. Within this larger context, we propose to address two goals. Our first goal is to create a treebank of syntactically analyzed texts for a subset of the Buddhist Canon. The past decade has seen many digitization and annotation projects for historical texts ranging from classical Arabic to Middle English; we will be the first to build a large-scale treebank of classical Chinese. In this pursuit, scholarship and pedagogy are intertwined: scholars exploit treebanks for quantitative evidence to their research, while students use them as reading support and contribute to them as a learning exercise. Building treebanks is, however, labor intensive. Our second goal is to complete the treebank for the rest of the Canon by leveraging recent advances in automatic natural language parsing. A syntactic parser will be trained on the hand-crafted treebank from the first goal, and then applied on the remaining texts. The resulting treebank for the entire Canon will be openly available to the public. The Buddhist Canon has been an important object of scholarship for centuries. This work advances the process, already underway, of applying emerging methods from computational linguistics to the study of historical languages. It has the potential to complement traditional research and pedagogical methodology with data-driven, quantitative analyses, and gives scholars and students the opportunity to effectively work with much larger volumes of texts than ever before. 此研究項目的目標，是利用計算語言學的技術，為大藏經構建樹庫。 研究的第一步是為大藏經一部分的經卷作句法分析，建立一個小型樹庫。用人手標註樹狀結構非常耗時；大藏經長逾五千萬字，任何人都難以讀畢，遑論分析其句子結構。因此，研究的第二步是利用自然語言處理技術，用電腦製成句法分析器，自動為大藏經的其他經卷構建樹庫。 大藏經是中國文學的重要遺產。大藏經樹庫建成後，不但有助學生閱讀經文，也令佛學家能夠對經文全文迅速地作全面而客觀的統計分析。

155412.label: Realisation of objectives
155412.value: Objective #1: Manually construct a treebank for a representative subset of the Chinese Buddhist Canon, using an existing digitized version We have manually constructed a treebank containing over 50,000 characters from four sutras in the Tripitaka Koreana edition of the Chinese Buddhist Canon. The four sutras were chosen such that they represent different genres and time periods: they come from four different divisions of the Canon, contain both verse and prose, and span almost five centuries in terms of date of composition. The treebank contains word-segmented text, a part-of-speech (POS) tag for each word, and dependency relations in each sentence. We followed the word segmentation guidelines and the POS tagset of the Penn Chinese Treebank. We adapted the dependency relations in the Stanford Dependencies for Modern Chinese for annotating medieval Chinese. We have conducted experiments to ensure a high level of inter-annotator agreement on word segmentation, POS tagging and dependency labeling. Finally, we have reported the construction process of the treebank in Lee and Kong (2014). Objective #2. Automatically create syntactic analyses for the rest of the Canon with statistical parsing methods, using the manually constructed treebank as training data To automatically parse the entire Canon, we used the above treebank as training data and trained a word segmenter and a POS tagger, both with the conditional random fields model using the CRF++ package, and augmented with three external dictionaries of proper names in Buddhist literature. Further, we trained a dependency parser with the MST parser. Using the word segmenter, POS tagger and dependency parser, we created syntactic analyses for each sentence in the Chinese Buddhist Canon. We have reported details on the parsing process and evaluation results in Wong and Lee (2016). Objective #3. Develop a user-friendly interface for scholars to interrogate the treebank for patterns, access the underlying original text and other reference sources in a digital library We have imported the manual treebank both on the ANNIS corpus visualization platform and on a browser-based interface for dependency tree viewing and querying. We have described this interface in Lee, Hui, and Yeung (2013). We have encoded the syntactic analyses for the entire Canon in the standard CoNLL format for dependency trees. We have exploited these trees to study the emergence of the copula in ancient Chinese (Lee and Kong, 2014), and the social network in the Canon (Lee and Wong, under review).

155412.label: Major findings and research outcome
155412.value: 1. We have constructed the first large-scale dependency treebank of medieval Chinese, containing text from four sutras from the Chinese Buddhist Canon. We have shown that the word segmentation guidelines and POS tagset of the Penn Chinese Treebank can be adapted for annotating medieval Chinese; and that the Stanford Dependencies for Modern Chinese can likewise be extended to handle syntactic constructions medieval Chinese. We have demonstrated that two human annotators can achieve a high degree of inter-annotator agreement in terms of word segmentation, part-of-speech tagging and dependency relations (Lee and Kong, 2014). 2. We have shown that the frequency of the Chinese copula increases from the earliest sutra to the most recent one (Lee and Kong, 2014). These statistics provided further evidence on the historical process of the emergence of the copula. 3. We have implemented and evaluated a statistical method for automatically parsing the entire Chinese Buddhist Canon (Wong and Lee, 2016). 4. We have investigated the use of quotative verbs in the Chinese Buddhist Canon. We found that the verb “bai” is used by an inferior speaking to a superior, while the verb “gao” is used by a superior speaking to an inferior. Based on usage statistics for these two verbs, we inducted a hierarchy of the characters in the Canon (Lee and Wong, 2016). 5. We have constructed a conversational network from the treebank. We evaluated the accuracy of the network, and analyzed the network in terms of its protagonists, their interlocutors, and their patterns of interactions, and differences between the Mahayana and Hinayana sections of the Canon (Lee and Wong, under review).

155412.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
155412.value: This research can be further developed along two directions: 1. To manually edit the automatically parsed portion of the treebank The goal is to further improve the annotation quality, especially for syntactic constructions that are rarely or not attested in the training data. More accurate annotations would provide more reliable statistics for the purpose of studying ancient Chinese linguistics. 2. To enrich the treebank with other types of annotations The treebank currently contains only syntactic annotations. It can be enhanced with other kinds of information to cater to other research questions. Information on translation variants, for example, would facilitate study of text reuse; word alignments with the original Sanskrit word would be useful for translation studies. The most useful annotations should be identified through consultation with specialists in Buddhist studies.

155412.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
155412.value: With 52 million characters, divided into 1,514 individual texts, the Chinese Buddhist Canon has a complexity that is challenging since the texts represent translations from Indic languages into Chinese from the 2nd to the 11th centuries. The sheer volume of the text is much larger than the small community of scholars and students who can read it. Standard techniques for textual analysis cannot apply because of intractable issues of scale. We have created a treebank --- a database of syntactic parses of each sentence in a corpus --- for the Chinese Buddhist Canon. Using this treebank as training examples, we have trained an automatic parser to parse the rest of the Canon. This treebank can serve as reading support, help and lend quantitative evidence for linguistics research. We have applied the treebank to leverage corpus linguistics methods to the study of historical languages, for example the emergence of the copula in ancient Chinese. We have also constructed conversational networks to analyze the interactions among protagonists in the text. This treebank facilitates a new synthesis of traditional scholarly goals and data-driven digital analysis, both in terms of fundamental linguistic research and in providing intellectual access to texts.

155712.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
155712.value: 近年，「青少年援交」及「青少年賣淫」等社會現象已引起世界不同地區的研究人員、政策制定者及社會工作專業人員的關注。此項與青少年相關的社會現象在亞洲國家尤其普遍，從九十年代、千禧年代至近年分別在日本、台灣及香港成為廣受大眾關注的社會議題。而「青少年援交」此現象很可能會於未來數十年出現在中國一些富裕城市（如上海）。雖然過去曾有不少研究發佈有關青少年參與援交的模式、原因及後果，但少有研究就大眾對如何處理援交問題作出研究。是項研究便是為了填補這方面的不足。 本著兩位西方學者Hunter(1985)及Triplett等(2003)就「社會或鄰舍管制」所作出的研究，社區對如何處理罪案的回應可以分為四個層面：個人層面、地區層面、刑事司法層面及助人專業層面。由於所屬各個層面的持分者在背景及專業訓練上各有不同，他們或會對同一項社會議題的處理方法持有不同意見。有見及此，比對不同的持分者對援交及其處理方法的立場和意見，確能給予研究人員、政策制定者及專業服務人員一個有價值的參考，以協助他們構思出有效的回應方案。這研究亦探討不同持分者的個人特徵及專業背景、他們對性別角色的態度有否影響他們對處理援交的看法及取向。 是項研究將於2013年1 月至2015年3月進行，整項計劃為期27個月，以問卷收集約1200位持分者的意見，並透過8個焦點小組收取進一步資料。我們將使用這些數據和資料來分析大眾對未成年人士參與援交活動的看法，以及他們對不同回應方法的意向。 首席研究員及其研究伙伴在知識、專業及研究經驗上確能互相補足，在促進研究的實踐的同時亦有助從不同角度分析問題。再者，他們在有關青少年援交及持分者的態度的研究上具有相當的經驗。 此種種的條件相信可以確保是項研究順利進行。

155812.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
155812.value: Population aging increases the demands of social and medical resources. Engaging in health behaviors and social activities not only contribute to successful aging, but also ameliorate the strains in societies. As a lifespan motivation theory, the socioemotional selectivity theory (Carstensen, Isaacowitz, & Charles, 1999) predicts that emotionally meaningful goals are prioritized when future time is perceived as limited. Hence, older adults who likely perceive time as limited may prefer social goals, which are generally emotion-enhancing. However, the extent to which the theory applies to health goals is less well-understood. The distal benefits resulting from health goals may be less emotionally meaningful than the immediate benefits of social goals, and the potential threatening information associated with health goals may also dampen their emotional values (Löckenhoff & Carstensen, 2004). Thus, people with a limited future time perception (FTP) may not prioritize health goals over social goals. Cultural values may also influence the pursuit of health goals through an individual-level factor – interdependent self-construal (i.e., the perception of self as connected with others) that is predominant in collective cultures. Positive stimuli tend to be processed more superiorly than negative stimuli with age. However, this positivity effect is not apparent among Chinese older adults (Fung et al., 2008) and people high in interdependent self-construal (Fung, Isaacowitz, Lu, & Li, 2010), because attending to negative stimuli from others is essential in managing relationships in collective cultures. Hence, older adults with high interdependent self-construal may be more likely to seek and process health-related information than those with low interdependent self-construal. Taking a lifespan perspective, this project aims to compare the selections and prioritization among health and social goals. Study 1 compares the goal dimensions (e.g., importance, emotional meaningfulness) between self-elicited health and social goals across younger and older adults (N=220). The effects of goal dimensions and individual factors (e.g., interdependent self-construal and FTP) on the efforts in goal pursuit will be examined simultaneously in a multilevel model. With the same participants, Study 2 examines the causal effects of FTP on goal prioritization in an experimental setting. Participants will be randomly assigned to three conditions including open-ended future-time, limited future-time, and unchanged future-time. The desired levels of participation in health behaviors and social activities, as well as the prioritization of the self-elicited goals reported in Study 1, will be examined before and after the manipulation across the three conditions. 人口老化增加了社會和醫療資源的需求，從事有益健康的行為和參與社交活動，不僅有利於個人的成功老年化，也改善對社會帶來的壓力。作為畢生發展（lifespan）的動機理論，社會情緒選擇理論 （socioemotional selectivity theory; Carstensen, Isaacowitz, & Charles, 1999）預測，當人認為未來是有限的時候，情感上有意義的目標就會被優先考慮。因老年人可能認為時間有限，他們可能更傾向於社交上的目標，因為社交上的目標一般都提升正面情感。然而，理論在何種程度上適用於有關健康的目標，仍未能很好地理解。雙對於社交目標所帶來的眼前利益，健康目標帶來的長遠利益可能並不在情感上有意義，而且，健康目標潛在使人害怕的信息，也損害他們情感上的價值（Löckenhoff & Carstensen, 2004）。因此，雙比社交目標，未來時間觀有限的人可能不會優先考慮健康目標。 文化價值也可能透過個人層面的因素－互依我（interdependent self-construal；即以自我與他人的關係，作為對自我的認知）－影響對健康目標的追求，而互依我就是集體文化社會中的主流。隨著年齡的增長，正面的刺激往往會比負面的刺激得到較好的處理。然而，這種正向效果（positivity effect），在中國的老年人（Fung et al., 2008），以及互依我較高的人（Fung, Isaacowitz, Lu, & Li, 2010）當中並不明顯，因為要在集體文化的社會中管理人際關係，留意他人的負面刺激是必要的。因此，互依我較高的老年人可能比互依我較低的老年人，更有可能尋求和處理與健康有關的信息。 以畢生發展的角度來看，這研究項目的目的是比較健康目標和社交目標之間的選擇和優先次序。第一項研究會對自我提出的健康目標和社交目標的各範疇（如重要性，情緒意義等），在年輕人和老年人之間進行比較（N=220）。各目標範疇以及個人因素（如互依我，及未來時間觀）對努力追求目標（goal pursuit）的影響，會同時在一個多層統計模式（multilevel model）中作分析。透過同一班研究參與者，第二項研究會在實驗的環境下，測試未來時間觀對目標優先次序的效應是否屬因果關係。參與者將被隨機分配到三個實驗組，包括無限的未來時間觀、有限的未來時間觀，和不變的未來時間觀。在第一項研究中得出的健康及社交目標，它們的期望水平以及排序，均會在這三個實驗組操作的前後作出評估。

155812.label: Realisation of objectives
155812.value: The project study was conducted as planned. All of the project objectives have been achieved. Below summarizes how and to what extent the objectives have been achieved. Objective 1: To compare the dimensions of social and health goals across age groups (Study 1). This project objective was fully achieved. The results showed that older adults rated their self-elicited goals as more emotionally meaningful, important and maintenance-oriented than younger adults, regardless of the types of the goals. The results were presented in an international conference. Objective 2: To examine whether efforts in goal pursuit can be predicted by goal dimensions and individual factors (e.g., future time perception, self-construal) (Study 1). This project objective was fully achieved. Higher levels of emotional meaningfulness and generativity of the goal, as well as a stronger interdependent self-construal predicted a higher level of goal pursuit. Future time perception did not predict goal pursuit. Objective 3: To examine whether the effects of age on goal pursuit can be explained by future time perception (Study 1). This objective was fully achieved. Unexpectedly, age and future time perception were not predictive of goal pursuit. The findings suggested that older and younger adults might be equally willing and/or capable of pursuing their goals. Objective 4: To examine whether the manipulation of future time perception changes the desired levels of participation in health behaviors and social activities using an experimental design (Study 2). This objective was fully achieved. Physical activity intention declined in the limited future-time condition, while increased in the expansive future-time condition. Social activity intention, surprisingly, increased in all future-time manipulations. The results were presented in an international conference and included in a manuscript in review. Objective 5: To determine whether the manipulation of future time perception changes the prioritization of health and social goals using an experimental design (Study 2). This objective was fully achieved. The preference toward health rather than social goals decreased in both limited and expansive future-time conditions. The anticipated ending in both conditions might contribute to a preference toward social goals. No change was found in the unchanged future-time condition, which might be attributed to the resistance to reprioritizing goals given no change suggested. The results were presented in an international conference and included in a manuscript in review.

155812.label: Major findings and research outcome
155812.value: BACKGROUND AND METHODS Both health and social participation contribute to successful aging. Goal prioritization (e.g., between health and social goals) becomes important particularly with the age-related decline in resources. Future-time perspective has been shown to predict physical activity participation. The extent to which future-time perspective may influence social activity and preference toward health (against social) goals, however, has not received much research attention. Using both cross-sectional and experimental designs, this study examined how age and future-time perspective influenced health and social goals. Participants included 131 older and 131 younger adults. They were asked to elicit 3 health and 3 social goals and then rated the goals on several goal dimensions. Participants were then randomly assigned to receive one of the three manipulations of future-time perspective including limited, unchanged, or expansive future-time conditions. After the manipulation, participants ranked the importance of the six self-elicited goals, and reported their physical activity and social activity intentions again. MAJOR FINDINGS The cross-sectional findings showed that older adults more often prioritized health over social goals, and had stronger intention to exercise than younger adults. Future-time perspective did not predict prioritization but mediated the age effects on exercise and social engagement intentions. That is, advanced age predicted more limited future-time perspective and, thus, weaker physical and social activity intentions. Besides, the results showed that older adults rated the self-elicited goals as more emotionally meaningful, important and maintenance-oriented than younger adults, regardless of the types of the goals. The experimental findings showed social activity intention increased with all future-time manipulations (i.e., limited, unchanged, or expansive), while preference toward health (against social) goals decreased in limited and expansive conditions. Despite the differences in subjective sense of remaining time across conditions, all manipulations might induce anticipated endings, which influenced emotion-relevant goals specifically. RESEARCH OUTCOME Three presentations, using different parts of the data, were given in international conferences. The study revealed some inconsistent findings between the cross-sectional and experimental data. The inconsistent findings were organized into a single paper for publication. Currently, the paper is under reviewed in a SSCI journal with an impact factor around 2 in the area of health psychology. The journal editor has invited to revise and resubmit the manuscript.

155812.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
155812.value: This study showed that expansive future-time perspective was associated with stronger physical activity intention, which suggested that the current conceptualization of future-time perspective might share important components with other future-time perspective concepts. Some interesting findings were found on social activity intention and preference toward health goals, which generated some new propositions. First, subjective sense of remaining time and anticipated ending may be two related but distinct constructs of future-time perspective. They may exert independent effects on health and social goals. In the experiment, the effects of an anticipated ending might have overshadowed the effects of the sense of remaining time, which suggested an anticipated ending may be more powerful or relevant to the motivational shift. Future studies may attempt to tease out these effects. Second, the effects of anticipated ending may be specific to emotional goals, which are mainly responsible for the motivational shift. Although health-related behaviors such as physical activity could also be considered in terms of their emotional meaningfulness, its health benefits, which are more future-oriented, may be more commonly recognized than its affective benefits. This above interpretation needs to be tested empirically. A research proposal is suggested to be developed based on the interpretation of the results.

155812.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
155812.value: Successful aging relies on both health and social participation. This study examined how age and future-time perspective influenced health and social goals. Participants included 131 older and 131 younger adults. They were randomly assigned to receive one of the three manipulations of future-time perspective including limited, unchanged, or expansive future-time conditions. The results showed advanced age predicted more limited future-time perspective and, thus, weaker physical and social activity intentions from the cross-sectional data. In the experiment, the results suggested social activity intention increased with all future-time manipulations (limited, unchanged, or expansive), while preference toward health rather than social goals decreased in limited and expansive conditions. Despite the differences in subjective sense of remaining time across conditions, all manipulations might induce anticipated endings, which influenced emotion-relevant goals specifically. The findings suggested that sense of remaining time and anticipated ending may be two related but distinct constructs of future-time perspective. The effects of anticipated ending may be specific to emotional goals, which are mainly responsible for the age-related motivational shift toward emotionally meaningful goals. The findings are valuable to the further understanding of the behavioral changes associated with aging.

160712.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
160712.value: All our cells, at least at one stage of their existence, are embedded in a matrix of proteins and proteoglycans collectively known as the extracellular matrix (ECM). This complex material organises cells into tissues, and provides supportive “niches” in which specific physical and chemical signals work to orchestrate how cells develop, function and interact. Recent studies have indicated that signals in these ECM niches can drive stem cell differentiation and instruct cell fate decisions. These observations imply that artificial manipulations of these extracellular niches may enable therapeutic modulations of tissue growth and regeneration. This goal cannot be achieved until the mechanisms for the action of cell-ECM interactions are clearly delineated. One obstacle is the extreme complexity of the molecular composition of the contact surface between cells and the ECM. In this proposal, we plan to overcome this obstacle by applying proteomic techniques to systematically characterise cell-matrix interface compositions. We hypothesize that tissue-specific ECM proteins represent, at least partially, the biological signals for stem cell regulation. We will support this hypothesis by studying the dynamics of proteins on the cell-matrix interface during mesenchymal stem cells (MSC) differentiation into bone or cartilage. We will then study how the ECM deposited by cultured bone or cartilage cells can direct MSC differentiation, and compare the protein compositions of these ECMs. The outcome is the identification of proteins expressed in the ECM in a cell type-dependent manner. Finally our hypothesis is tested by purifying these cell-type specific ECM proteins and putting MSC put in contact with these proteins. We will monitor the differentiation of the MSC and judge to what extent these purified ECM proteins can instruct cell fate decision. This proposal will provide the first large-scale proteomic characterisation of cell-ECM interactions during MSC differentiation, a data resource that will be useful for numerous future studies. It will also test a fundamental biological concept and will impact on important applications in tissue engineering and regenerative medicine. 所有細胞，至少在生活中的一個階段，都被一種稱為細胞外基質（ECM） 的物質圍繞著。這種複雜的物質使細胞組織成器官,為細胞提供合適的物理和化學信號,使細胞能在合適的生態環境下發育，功能和互動。最近的研究表明，這些ECM的信號可以驅動幹細胞分化和指導細胞命運的決定。未來通過細胞生境的操控，可以使組織的生長和再生的治療調製。 這個目標目前不能實現, 因為 細胞和ECM之間的分子組成非常複雜, 現在仍無法理解它們的功能. 在本計畫，我們通過蛋白質組技術，系統地分析ECM。我們推測，ECM的蛋白包含一些調節幹細胞的生物信號。我們將研究在骨髓間充質幹細胞（MSC）分化為骨或軟骨細胞的ECM蛋白質。然後，我們將研究如何用這些ECM，直接MSC分化，並比較這些ECM中的蛋白成分。 這項研究項目將第一次從大規模蛋白質組途徑, 研究細胞-ECM的相互作用, 將對組織工程和再生醫學, 有重要的貢獻。

160712.label: Realisation of objectives
160712.value: The overarching aim of this GRF project is to understand the change of the biochemical composition of the so-called "cell-matrix interface" when human mesenchymal stem cells differentiate into chondrocytes and osteoblasts in 2D cell culture, and to harness this result to produce cell culture surface that can drive MSC differentiation without exogenous growth factors. The two objectives of the project, formulated in 2013, have undergone substantial changes during the project. We have encountered technical difficulties in purifying and characterising the "cell-matrix interface" of MSC. Our protocol for isolating cell-matrix interface was originally developed for epithelial cells (Tong et al. Mol Cell Proteomics. 9(10):2089-98) and has not worked equally well for mesenchymal cells, likely because the latter adhere to the substrate mainly through focal adhesion complexes. As the protein abundance of focal adhesion complexes is scant, exhaustive efforts have been spent on modifying our protocol for increasing the yield of protein isolation and scaling up the MSC culture. The latter was proven unsuccessful due to the passage limit of MSC, especially when the cells were driven to differentiate, as required by the objective. After one year of struggling, we have yet to obtain enough MSC cell-matrix interface proteins for proteomic analysis. We did have a bonus finding while optimising our protocol for Objective 1, as we have performed a proteomic comparison of the ECM secreted by 10 human cancer cell lines (reported in the previous progress report). To circumvent the technical difficulty involved in protein purification from an in vitro culture system, we turned to study the ECM encompassing differentiating chondrocytes in a growth plate. The differential protein composition of different part of the growth plate should highlight the change of microenvironment during chondrogenic differentiation. To this end, we harvested porcine growth plates and sectioned them to reveal the structural differences of the three zones of differentiation. We proceeded to optimise the solubilisation of these hard tissues, by using acid hydrolysis. Due to the relatively late start of this modified approach, we have not finished the proteomic analysis at this stage. The second objective is to functionally test the roles of the ECM secreted differentiated cells to drive the differentiation of MSC into the respective lineages. We have purified the proteomically characterised the ECM proteins from osteogenic or chondrogenic cell lines. However, we did not observe detectable change in MSC seeded on the ECM deposited by these cell lines. There are minor differences in differentiation rates when standard chondrogenic or osteogenic media were used, but those changes (measured by RTPCR of differentiation markers) were not statistically significant. We hypothesised that the concentration of ECM obtained by decellularising monolayer cultures of cells was too low to effect discernible changes in the differentiation of MSC. We decided to circumvent this obstacle by a two thonged approach. First, to study the effect on a native microenvironment on MSC differentiation, we studied how MSC and chondrocytes cultured on decellularised cartilage responded to differentiation and inflammation signals. As most published protocols on cartilage decellularisation involves the use of detergent, a step that denatures the biochemical components of a tissue microenvironment, we developed a novel approach of decellularisation. In this new procedure, cartilages were first cryosectioned, and then subjected to sanitation in water. All cells were removed after a minute of sonication, leaving behind a acellular section with intact GAG content. MSC and rat chondrosarcoma cells RCS were seeded on these decellularised section and their responses to differentiation media (MSC) and TNF-alpha (RCS) were monitored by RTPCR of marker genes. Preliminary data indicate that the decellularised cartilage accelerated chondrogenic differentiation of MSC and modified the inflammation response of RCS, suggesting that the native tissue microenvironment can modulate the cell functions. We are currently assembling these data, together with data from our collaborators from another project, into a manuscript. The second approach further investigates the roles of different components that constitute a microenvironment. Our question is what happens if the biochemical signals of a tissue niche is totally abolished, when the topographical information is preserved. To achieve this, we adopted and optimised a procedure known as silica bioreplication, in which the nanoscale architecture of a tissue is preserved by fossilisation, while all the carbon-containing molecules are removed by combustion. The remaining material is a replica of the tissue, with the topographical feature of the microenvironment accurately retained, while all biochemical information is eliminated. We seeded MSC on silicilised bovine spinal cord, and observed that a majority of the cells was converted into sphere-like clusters. The remaining adhered cells underwent morphological changes to resemble neurite outgrowths. RTPCR showed that the sphere-like clusters induced by the silicilised spinal cord expressed an increased level of SOX1 and beta-tubulin III (neuronal markers), suggesting that topographical information harboured in a tissue microenvironment, in the absence of biochemical signals, is sufficient in committing MSC into differentiation.

160712.label: Major findings and research outcome
160712.value: Despite the serious technical difficulties we encountered in this project, we have obtained a number of important insights on the role of tissue microenvironment on cell differentiation. 1. We have isolated ECM secreted by 10 human cancer cell lines cultured as monolayers and demonstrated their proteomic compositions were highly diverse. 2. We have demonstrated that the adhesion mechanism of MSC on flat 2D substrate differs significantly from epithelial cells, hence the isolation and biochemical characterisation of MSC cell-matrix interface is not readily achievable. 3. We have developed two protocols for the proteomic analysis of tissue microenvironment. We innovated the dissection of porcine growth plate into the respective differentiation zones and optimised the method of acid hydrolysed to solubilise the hard tissues to peptides that can be analysed mass-spectrometrically. 4. We have developed a novel way of decellularising cartilage that completely avoid the use of detergent. This method enables the investigation on the roles of native tissue microenvironment on differentiation and inflammation. 5. We have used the technique of silica bioreplication for the first time to generate cell culture scaffold that accurately reproduces a tissue microenvironment while annihilating the biochemical signals in the tissue. Using the silicilised spinal cord tissue as a scaffold, we demonstrated that MSC could spontaneously differentiate into neuron-like cells and neurosphere-like clusters as judged by protein and gene markers.

160712.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
160712.value: We are excited by the prospect of using the silica bioreplication technique to study various aspects of cell-substrate and mechanotransduction problems. We are now preparing a manuscript on the effect of silicilised spinal cord on MSC differentiation into neurons. We will examine whether similar observations can be made from the silica replicas of other tissues. We have optimised the protocol for other tissues, including adipose and tendon, and are ready to test their effect on MSC. We have also bioreplicated a fibroblast monolayer, and will use this as a cell culture surface. Our first experiment will be to test whether the silica replica of fibroblast cells can replace feeder cells for ESC culture. Other investigations on the nature of cell-cell interactions will also be conducted. We will also complete the proteomic analysis of growth plate zones, after spending many efforts on optimising the sectioning and solubilisation.

160712.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
160712.value: This project aims to delineate how the environment surrounding adult stem cells changes when these cells mature, and how the chemical signals in this environment can be captured to direct stem cell differentiation. Because this is a relatively nascent field, we have met serious technical obstacles in the beginning and had to refocus our work on renewed directions. We have successfully demonstrated that the extracellular matrix, a mixture of biochemical secretions deposited by cells into the surrounding environment, is highly different for different types of cancer cells, suggesting that each cell type produces a specific type of matrix. We further attempted to validate this observation in a growth plate, a specialised structure into cartilage cells of different maturation stages are located in different parts of the tissue. Then we successfully replicated the tissue environment (this time from a spinal cord) to silica, a biological inert material similar to glass. Interestingly, the topographical feature on this replica can drive stem cells to become neuron-like cells without the use of any chemical factors. These results deepen our understanding of the roles of extracellular environment in stem cell functions and pave the way for further research and applications in this exciting area.

160812.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
160812.value: A large body of literature links early life stress (ELS) with a wide range of adult psychopathology. ELS plays an important role in the development of visceral hyperalgesia in irritable bowel syndrome. Neonatal maternal separation (MS) of newborn rats has been shown to trigger a long-term alteration in responses to visceral nociceptive stimuli in rats, and increase colonic motility in response to an acute psychological stressor, mimicking the cardinal features of IBS. Increasing evidence suggests MS can produce long-term changes in brain function. However, the proximate mediator of supra spinal influences on visceral pain processes is missing. Little research has focused on the impact of MS on subsequent visceral pain processing in the limbic forebrain in adulthood. Recently, our serial studies have demonstrated that glutamate in the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) plays a critical role in the modulation of ACC sensitization and visceral pain in visceral hypersensitive states. Unlike most neurons in the brain, granule cells in the dentate gyrus, continue to be produced during adulthood. Stress in early life inhibits neurogenesis in adulthood. Available evidences showed that MS caused molecular and functional alterations in GABA receptors within CNS suggesting a potential molecular mechanism by which MS may result in altered stress-related behavior. The ACC has a substantial GABAergic termination. Binding studies have reported GABAA and GABAB receptors within the ACC, chronic restraint stress decreased benzodiazepine receptor and GABAA receptor binding in limbic regions. Given the key role of GABA in inhibition of neurotransmission, we hypothesize that reduced GABA and GABAA receptor accompanied with disinhibition in ACC neurons may enhance excitatory transmission in the ACC, which in turn, facilitates visceral pain processing in adulthood. To test this hypothesis, in MS rats the changes in GABAA receptor and GAD67 expression will be detected by immunocytochemistry and Western blot. Electrophysiological recording of ACC neurons will be performed to demonstrate that disinhibition in GABAergic transmission facilitates ACC neuronal responses to noxious visceral stimulation. Further, visceromotor response and conditioned place avoidance will be examined to determine that GABAergic transmissions are directly involved in visceral pain and emotional affective responses to noxious stimuli. Finally, we will focus on genetic overexpression of GABAA receptor in the ACC to prevent the development of visceral hyperalgesia in adult rats following maternal separation stress in infancy. This study will provide a framework to further clarify how cortex neurons modulate visceral hyperalgesia and certain behavioral disturbances associated with early adversity. 大量的文献表明早期的生活压力（ELS）与广泛的成人精神病病理密切相关。早期生活压力对肠易激综合征内脏痛觉过敏的形成起重要作用。新生大鼠母婴分离（MS）模型已被证明可模仿肠易激综合征的核心特征，引起大鼠对内脏伤害性刺激反应的长期的改变，增加急性心理应激反应引起的结肠蠕动。越来越多的数据表明，产后事件，例如母婴分离，会使大脑功能产生长期的变化。然而，最直接的脊柱水平以上的对内脏痛过程产生影响的因素尚不清楚。目前还没有研究关注大鼠母婴分离对成年期前脑边缘系统处理内脏痛信息的影响。 最近，我们的一系列研究表明，大脑前扣带皮层（ACC）的谷氨酸神经递质对调节前扣带皮层致敏和内脏过敏状态下的内脏痛起关键作用。与大多数脑神经元不同，海马齿状回颗粒细胞，在成年后仍可继续生成。早期生活压力抑制成年期的神经再生。现有证据表明，母婴分离引起中枢神经系统中GABA受体在分子和功能上的改变，暗示了一个母婴分离造成的与压力相关的行为改变的潜在的分子机制。前扣带皮层有大量的GABA神经末端。结合实验显示在前扣带皮层存在GABAA和GABAB受体，同时慢性束缚性应激（restraint stress）可减少大脑边缘区域苯二氮卓受体和GABAA受体的结合。 由于GABA对抑制神经递质传递起关键作用，我们推测，GBAB 和GABAA受体减少伴随对前扣带皮层的去抑制作用，增加了前扣带皮层的兴奋性神经递质传递，从而促进了成年后内脏痛的进行。为了验证这一假说，我们将通过免疫组化和蛋白印迹实验检测MS大鼠GABAA受体和GAD67的表达。通过电生理记录前扣带皮层神经元，证明去抑制GABA神经递质传递将增强前扣带皮层神经元对伤害性内脏疼痛刺激的反应。另外，通过内脏运动反应和条件性位置回避（Conditioned place avoidance）确定GABA能神经传递直接参与伤害性刺激引起的内脏痛和情感反应。最后，我们将验证前扣带皮层区域GABAA受体基因过度表达可预防母婴分离压力引起的成年期内脏痛觉过敏的形成。本研究将为进一步明确皮层神经细胞如何调节内脏的痛觉过敏和某些与早期逆境相关的行为障碍提供框架。

160812.label: Realisation of objectives
160812.value: Maternal separation (MS) is the most robust and common model for the disruption of the mother-offspring relationship. It can cause acute and long lasting behavioral and neurochemical phenotype alterations in adulthood, due to repeated activation of stress mediators. In rodents, MS has been well-characterized to model depression, anxiety and visceral hypersensitivity in irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). In the past years we have performed immunocytochemical studies and showed that MS leads to significant decrease GABA and GAD67 expression in the ACC (Objective I). These observation suggested a decrease of GABA synthesis and release. Administration of GABAA receptor antagonist, bicuculine resulted in increase in basal and CRD-induce ACC neuronal firings in the normal rats suggesting that in physiological condition, there is a tonic GABA inhibition of ACC neuronal activity that maintains a low level of glutamatergic excitation. In separated studies administration of GABAA receptor antagonist, bicuculine increase basal and CRD-induce ACC neuronal firings in the normal rats suggesting in physiological condition, there is a tonic GABA inhibition of ACC neuronal activity that maintains a low level of glutamatergic excitation. In the MS rats administration of GABAA receptor agonist muscimol only partially (~55%), suppressed the basal, and failed to reduce visceral noxious stimulation (CRD)-induced ACC neuronal firings to the normal level. In behavioral visceral pain studies (Objective II, visceromotor response to colorectal distension), the MS rats were used for upregulation of GABAA receptor. We performed studies by local application of plasmid vector containing GABAA receptor alpha 2 cDNA together with pEGFP-N1 vector encoded with enhanced GFP, into the ACC using electroporation (Objective III), a technique have been established in our laboratory. However, this treatment did not suppressed visceral pain responses completely (about 45% reduction of visceromotor response). It appears that GABA-mediated neurotransmission is not the predominant mechanism directly involved in the pain modulatory function of the ACC in the rats following maternal separation. Hence, we were unable to confirm our hypotheses that ‘GABAA-receptor-bearing neurons in the ACC may play a key role in the mediation of ACC over excitation and directly involved in the visceral pain intensity in the MS rats.” In addition to maternal separation causes various kinds of emotional, cognitive impairments, we performed Conditioned Place Avoidance (CPA) test (Objective II). The most parsimonious explanation for the CPA behavior displayed by rats following repeated subthreshold colorectal distention when they are located within the preferred chamber is that it is a result of the aversive quality of the stimulation. We have clearly showed a heightened and prolonged CPA responses in the rats that were maternally deprived as pups. These heightened aversive behaviors in the MS rat are correspondence with higher levels of anxiety in open field and elevated plus mazes in the animal models of anxiety reported previously (midterm report). Previous studies have shown that high levels of anxiety are related to impaired decision-making both in animals and humans. In humans, decision-making has been accurately modeled using the Iowa gambling task (IGT). Supporting by this and other RGC grants, we have developed and conducted a decision-making test - the rat gambling task (RGT) (Ref 4,8,9) - and found that, similar to the findings of the most advantageous strategy from the IGT utilized in human studies, most rats can learn to maximize their food reward. We have modified our Objective II and here, reported for the first time that early life stress caused decision-making deficit in adult in MS rats. Brain rhythms are likely to be a fundamental mechanism for modulating, filtering, and redirecting information in the nervous system. It has been shown that oscillations are a key mechanism of dynamical coupling between brain areas. Recent years partially supporting by this grant we have developed a multiple-channel electrophysiological recordings (Ref 4,5,6,8) in awake rats, our publications provided specific evidence that alterations of LFP and spike phases, as well as spike-phase coherence, synchronization in the ACC neural network involved in pain perception and cognitive performance. Notice, beyond our original Research Aims this newly established electrophysiological recording has been applied in this project using adult rats with early life (neonatal maternal separation). This is time concerned and labor intensive experiment. We are the first group using this recording techniques and multiple-channel neural data analyses to explore the dysfunction of anterior cingulate cortex neural network in rats with early life stress, such as such as maternal separation (Ref 10). Our data provided evidences that stress-related psychiatric disorders, these disorders are often comorbid with a variety of other systemic and somatic illnesses ranging from cardiovascular disease to alterations in gastrointestinal tract (GIT) function. Symptoms associated with this disorder include increased stress response, abnormal gastrointestinal motility and heightened visceral sensations (Ref 3 ) which are thought to stem from a dysfunctional brain–gut axis. Previous research has revealed a profound influence of MS on the hypothalamic-pituitary adrenal (HPA) axis activation in adulthood, one of the essential neuroendocrine stress systems. Further studies are wanted to determine if dysregulation of the HPA axis is implicated in the pathophysiology of MS-related disorders, such as anxiety, decision making deficits and brain network desynchronization which have been characterized in the current report.

Recent years supporting by this and other UGC grants we have developed a multiple-channel electrophysiological recordings in awake rats to characterize the brain neural network activities. In this study we discovered significant alterations in the theta oscillations in both the basolateral amygdala (BLA) and ACC areas in the MS rats. We observed increases in theta band power in the BLA, but decreases in the ACC. Further, cross-correlation analysis revealed that the theta band oscillations of the LFP between the BLA and ACC became desynchronized in MS rats. The desynchronization of the theta band oscillations, induced by maternal separation as pups, suggests that the BLA and ACC may then only loosely interact for dynamic information transfer, which may disrupt neural network assemblies and affect synaptic plasticity (References 10). These observations from the large-scale electrophysiological section of this study confirm that impairment of functional coupling between the BLA and the ACC may contribute to behavioral dysregulations in MS rats. Our observations may serve as fundamental notions regarding neurophysiological biomarkers for cognitive impairments induced by early life stress.

160812.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
160812.value: In summary, neonatal maternal separation induced anxiety-like behavior and poor decision-making in the rat gambling task. In parallel, we observed decreased synchronization between the major brain areas (basolateral amygdala BLA, and the anterior cingulate cortex ACC), combined with alteration of theta band activity in the BLA and ACC, which was associated with interrupted spike field coherence (SFC) between the BLA and ACC. These data are consistent with the theory that oscillatory synchrony, particularly phase synchronization, provides an overall principle for integrating information between different cortical and subcortical regions during complex cognitive processing. These observations may help revise fundamental notions regarding neurophysiological biomarkers to treat cognitive impairment induced by early life stress. A limitation of the current study, which produces a potentially relevant confounding issue, is that the electrophysiological recordings obtained were not conducted in the behaving animals during the decision-making task. Directly assessing the effects of MS on the BLA and ACC activities during the event-related choices made by animals should provide useful evidence in future studies.

160812.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
160812.value: Repetitive separation of rat pups from their mother for three weeks-neonatal maternal separation (MS) is a well-characterized model of early-life stress, used to model depression, anxiety and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), a functional gastrointestinal disorder, which is thought to involve a dysfunctional interaction between the brain and the gut. In our study, several behavioral tests were used in order to evaluate the emotional, cognitive variation, and memory processing. The result displayed that significant higher degree of anxiety of MS rats in elevated plus maze test, and cognitive deficit in Morris water maze. Making a decision under complex and uncertain conditions is a basic cognitive process for adaption that relies on the integration of several executive functions. Early life experiences have been shown to alter prefrontal cortex structure and function; here, we provide evidences that MS impaired decision-making, and the associated neuronal functional alterations in the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and basolateral amygdala (BLA) network in adulthood. To the best of our knowledge, the present study is the first to characterize the disruption of theta band oscillations, as well as impairments in the functional coupling between the BLA and ACC circuit, accompanied by anxiety and decision-making deficits in early-life stress.

161212.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
161212.value: The failure of regeneration after proximal peripheral nerve (PN) injury causes a catastrophic loss of motor and sensory function. This in turn results in a decreased quality of life for patient and an enormous economic burden to society. There is, therefore, an urgent need to develop new therapeutic interventions for this, and other injuries to the central nervous system (CNS). Our PN connect our brain and spinal cord to the rest of our body, controlling all volitional muscle movements. However, they are fragile and very easily damaged. Injuries of PN induce a loss of motor neural control of target organs. PN can regenerate after injury, and if the site of damage is close to the muscle controlled by the damaged nerve, full muscle function is frequently restored (distal nerve injury). In contrast, if the site of damage is far from the muscle controlled by the damaged nerve (proximal nerve injury) or injury involves complete transection of PN, recovery of muscle function is minimal. How to improve function recovery in proximal PN injury? Researchers and clinicians believe that by increasing the speed of axonal regrow, one can achieve better functional recovery. Therefore, studies in the past decades focus on enhancing the rate of axonal regeneration despite the fact that minimal function recovery has been reported. Why? We have performed a study to address this and identified a growth-associated gene, a small heat shock protein 27, accelerated intrinsic axonal growth and greatly enhance motor function recovery. Further studies showed that there is a “critical period” in mice and humans - if accelerated axons fail to reach the muscle within the critical period, no reinnervations and function recovery will occur. It seems to be a very basic concept but it explains the failure of motor recovery. This major finding initiates new research efforts in understanding how to delay critical period and possibly overcome it, in order to achieve return of motor function. In current proposed study, we aim to address directly, what molecular determinants are necessary for critical period. We will perform a major screening to determine what key molecules favor growth of regenerating axon during critical period and test these molecules in animal model of critical period. We will also examine the unexplored protective effects of Hsp27 on CNS neuron to see if increase intrinsic growth of these axotomized neurons will give them the capacity to regrow. 由於近端周圍神經於損傷後不能成功再生，令患者損失了其運動和感覺功能。這不僅導致一個患者的生活素質大大下降，並對社會帶來巨大的經濟負擔。 因此，迫切需要開發新的方法去治療周圍神經損傷及中樞神經系統損傷。 我們的周圍神經是連接大腦和脊髓，與及身體的其餘部分, 控制所有肌肉的運動。然而，周圍神經是脆弱的，很容易損壞。周圍神經損傷會引致喪失運動神經對目標器官的控制能力。在正常情況下周圍神經於損傷後可以慢慢地再生，只要是損壞的部位靠近由受損神經控制的肌肉（遠端神經損傷), 肌肉功能經常會完全恢復。但是，如果受損的神經是遠離控制的肌肉（近端神經損傷), 或周圍神經被完全切斷，肌肉功能的恢復是極有限的。 如何提高近端周圍神經損傷後的功能恢復？研究人員和醫生認為，通過增加軸突再生的速度，功能恢復得較理想。因此，過去的研究集中在提高軸突再生的速度，但運動功能恢復仍然並不理想。為什麼呢？ 我們已經進行了一項研究，以解答這個問題，並確定了一個與神經元的內生增長相關的基因，小熱休克蛋白27，這基因加速神經元的內生增長及軸突生長，大大提高了運動功能的恢復。進一步的研究表明，在小鼠和人類有一個“關鍵時期” - 如果軸突無法在關鍵時期連接至肌肉，運動功能不能恢復。這似乎是一個非常基本的概念，但它說明了運動功能不能恢復的原因。這一重大發現將開拓新的研究方向和領域，了解如何延緩及克服關鍵時期，從以恢復運動功能。 在目前的建議研究中，我們的目標是直接查究在關鍵時期的必要分子。我們將進行一個重要的篩選，找出在這「關鍵時期」裏有利於軸突再生的分子，並在動物模型測試這些分子對在關鍵時期裡軸突再生的影響，以致能否完全恢復運動功能。我們也將研究小熱休克蛋白27對中樞神經系統的神經元的保護作用，看是否增加這些受傷神經元的內生增長將恢復他們的再生能力。

161212.label: Realisation of objectives
161212.value: All Objectives were fully accomplished. Figures and Reference list are attached to Part C: Section 12 Other Impact. 1.1 To examine the temporal dynamic of axonal regrowth after PN injury during critical period: We examined if human (h) heat shock protein (Hsp) 27 transgenic (Tg) mice could overcome the critical period (crushed sciatic nerve 4 times at 9-day intervals) by quantifying numbers of axons and neuromuscular junction (NMJ). One week after the last crush, axonal growth was significantly higher in hHsp27 Tg than the littermate (LM) mice (1). We examined if this accelerated axonal growth also evident at later time point. Axon number was similar in hHsp27 Tg and LM mice from proximal to distal to the injury site on days 30 (Fig. 1) and 60 (Fig. 2). hHsp27 Tg mice regenerating axons arrive at the target muscle much earlier than LM mice, but both groups regenerated similar number of axons by day 60. Promoting effect of hHsp27 on early NMJ re-innervation was evident in hHsp27 Tg mice on day 60 as 21% increase in NMJ re-innervations was detected in plantar muscle (most distal) (Fig. 3). Additional work including weekly electromyography (EMG) recording and muscle atrophy analysis were performed (2). EMG recording allows detection of functional NMJ transmission at target muscles to quantify motor functional recovery. Compound muscle activated potential amplitude was more than doubled in gastrocnemius muscle (proximal) of hHsp27 Tg mice starting from week 5 and reached the same level as in LM mice at week 8 (Fig. 4A). Strikingly, the promoting effect is more prominent (40% increase) in plantar muscle (distal) of hHsp27 Tg compared to LM mice (Fig. 4B). Dry weight of gastrocnemius (Fig. 5A) and plantar muscles (Fig. 5B) were measured on day 60 after the last crush. LM plantar muscle showed significant muscle atrophy (over 20% weight drop), as compared to hHsp27 mice. 1.2 To determine if accelerated regenerating axon or guidance cues responsible for successfully motor function recovery in hHsp27 Tg mice: Motor function recovery depends on successful formation of NMJ at the motor endplate (1). We investigate if enhanced NMJ re-innervation could improve functional recovery during critical period (1). We crushed the sciatic nerves 4 times at 9-day intervals to prevent reinnervation for 37 days, which missed the critical period results in limited functional recovery (1), and assessed functional recovery for 60 days after the last crush. We first assessed the sensory function by pinprick assay which measured successful return of sensory axons into the hind paw skin. Sensory function is fully recovered on day 21 in hHsp27 Tg as compared to day 37 in LM mice (Fig. 6A). Motor function recovery was first assessed by toe spreading reflex, which is a measure of plantar muscle function. Initial response was recorded at Day 17 in hHsp27 Tg mice; however, first response was delayed to day 29 in LM. Toe spreading reflex in injured hindlimbs was completely regained in hHsp27 Tg; however, LM mice only regained approximately half of the function (Fig. 6B). Quantitative analysis of hindlimb footprints demonstrated a decrease in sciatic function index (SFI) during the first 2 weeks. hHsp27 Tg group showed gradually returned of motor function over time whereas SFI remained significantly lower in LM group from weeks 3-6 (Fig. 6C). Animals remained healthy as reflected by their body weight (Fig. 6D). We performed additional work to crush the sciatic nerves 5 times (45 days denervation) and our ongoing study shows that comparable sensory function recovery in hHsp27 Tg and LM mice (Fig. 7A). Limited motor functional recovery is observed in both groups of mice (Fig. 7B-D). 1.3 Screening of key growth molecules at the terminal Schwann cell (TSC) for potential therapeutic approach: We performed proteomic analysis on denervated target muscles and identified desmin that was highly upregulated after injury (5.3-fold) by 2-d gel electrophoresis (Fig. 8). Desmin is a muscle specific type III intermediate filament (3), and acts as cell scaffold to modulate the positioning of membranous compartments and organelles (4). However, the role of desmin in neuron is unknown. We showed that desmin is weakly expressed in uninjured DRG neurons, and strongly upregulated in preconditioned DRG (5 days post sciatic nerve transection, SNT) neurons (Fig. 9A) and desmin-positive neurons increased significantly (Fig. 9B). Desmin transcripts were significantly upregulated in preconditioned compared to uninjured DRG neurons (Fig. 9C). Desmin protein expression was upregulated at day 3 after SNT and remained high in the first 2 week post-injury (Fig. 10). It suggests that injury-induced upregulation of desmin might play a role in axonal regeneration. To test this hypothesis, we performed in vitro and in vivo loss of function assay by siRNA silencing. We knockdown desmin expression in preconditioned DRG cultures, and observed a significant reduction of desmin-positive DRG neurons (Fig. 11A). The knockdown efficiency and neurite outgrowth inhibitory effect (>2.5-fold) was demonstrated in DRG neurons (Fig. 11B-C). Finally, we performed a very important proof-of-concept experiment to examine the in vivo effect of desmin knockdown on axonal regrowth and PN regeneration. We knockdown desmin expression by in vivo siRNA silencing for three consecutive days, and examined peripheral axonal regeneration by nerve pinch test. In line with our in vitro data, the distal extent of axonal regrowth was reduced by 50% 3 days after injury (Fig. 11D). Proteomic data showed that myosin regulatory light chain 2, ATP synthase subunit beta, and beta-enolase were upregulated, which involved in modulation of microglia migration and nervous system injury (5-7). We therefore examined the role of microglia and its association with laminin in axonal regeneration since laminin is the major extracellular matrix in the peripheral nervous system. Our results indicated that primary microglia displaced classical (M1) and alternative (M2) activation after injury (8). The transition from M1 to M2 phenotypes is strongly associated with morphological changes and laminin localization (9). The identification of phosphoglycerate kinase 1, histone triad nucleotide-binding protein-1, and 4-aminobutyrate aminotransferase from proteomic analysis that are closely related to neurotransmitter metabolism (10-12). We therefore performed a large scale metabolomics analysis to screen over 40 neurotransmitters in motor cortex that contribute to axonal regeneration after peripheral nerve injury. We published these pilot screening results and part of the characterization work is still ongoing (13). We also proposed to examine the expression of Chondroitin sulfate proteoglycans (CSPG) in TSC. CSPG is a growth cone repulsive molecule that we detected no expression in the motor endplate of denervated muscle 60 days post-injury (Fig. 12). 2: To test the capacity of regeneration-associated gene to promote axonal regeneration in CNS neuron: To further examine the regenerative capacity of CNS neurons in hHsp27 Tg mice, we performed additional work (not proposed in original proposal) to examine in vitro and in vivo axonal regrowth of RGCs. We confirmed that RGCs (>80%) expressed high levels of hHsp27 in adult retinae sections (Fig. 13A). We purified RGCs from postnatal mice (14, 15), and there was no significant difference between the LM, hHsp27-positive/-negative RGCs in neurite outgrowth (Fig. 13B-D). Ongoing studies show that forced expression of hHsp27 induced modest but significant axonal growth at 0.2mm distal to crushed site, yet hHsp27 Tg mice showed similar extent of axon regeneration as LM at 0.4-0.8mm distal to the crushed site after optic nerve injury (Fig. 13E-G).
