161212.label: Major findings and research outcome
161212.value: In current proposal, we demonstrate for the first time that forced expression of human Hsp27 improves functional recovery during the critical period of peripheral nerve regeneration which usually show limit functional recovery. We confirm the promoting effect by multiple approaches including histology, electrophysiology and animal behavior. The accelerated axonal regrowth is evident in hHsp25 Tg mice during the first week of injury contributes to the speedy recovery of sensory function and the much improved motor function 2 months after 37 days of muscle denervation. Ongoing work shows that mitochondria trafficking play a key role in axonal regeneration of dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neurons. We performed a proteomic analysis on target muscle collected within and outside the critical period, and identified 15 proteins such as desmin. We performed in vitro and in vivo loss of function assays by siRNA silencing. Knockdown of desmin show significant reduction of axonal regrowth from axotomized DRG neurons in cultures and in adult mice measured by nerve pinch test. Our ongoing studies further investigate the promoting effect of desmin on functional recovery after injury. Future studies to characterize the other identified proteins will pave the way for identification of novel regeneration-associated genes. We show that the involvement of microglia as suggested by proteomic data demonstrates a strong association of M1/M2 phenotypes with laminin expression. We also perform a metabolic analysis on over 40 neurotransmitters in motor cortex after peripheral nerve injury to identify major pathways involved in functional recovery. Finally, we propose to test hHsp27 in regenerating axotomized retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) in cultures. We are able to purify RGCs from neonatal mice for neurite outgrowth assay. There is no significant difference between hHsp27 Tg and LM mice in axonal outgrowth. We then examine RGC survival and neurite outgrowth in animal model of optic nerve injury (ONI). hHsp27 shows no survival promoting effect but induces moderate axon outgrowth from RGCs after ONI, which requires further studies. Seven papers were published in top Journals in the area of Neuroscience and Biomedicine. One of my PhD students (Pallavi ASTHANA) is directly involved and trained in current studies. We presented the work in the largest Neuroscience Meeting in the US for three consecutive years. I also present the major findings generated from current studies as Keynote and Planetary lectures in Hong Kong. Pallavi won the best poster presentation twice during the HK Neuroscience Meeting in 2014 and 2016.

161212.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
161212.value: Our proteomic studies identified 15 proteins such as desmin and performed a series of loss of function assays on desmin only due to time limitation. Further loss of function studies can be performed on other proteins identified by 2-d gel such as annexin A6, RNA binding motif protein endocrine-specific protein 18 and cytochrome c oxidase subunit 7c in which siRNAs are commercial available. Future studies could be performed to overexpressing or conditionally knocking down these target protein (corresponding genes) to fully study in vivo function. hHsp27 forced expression could overcome critical period but the underlying mechanism is unknown. The proteomic data gain new insight into the potential role of mitochondria (cytochrome c) in axonal regeneration. Our ongoing studies therefore focus on the mitochondria trafficking at the distal axons of axotomized DRG neurons by time-lapsed analysis in cultures. We find that hHsp27 not only enhances the rate of mitochondria trafficking but also increases the size of mitochondria in hHsp27 overexpressing DRG neurons. Our pilot studies indicate that it involves the modulation of mitochondria fission (Drp1) and fusion (Mfn1, Mfn2 and Opa1) proteins, which requires further studies. The proteomics data provide new insight into the therapeutic potential in treating peripheral nerve regeneration.

161212.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
161212.value: Peripheral nerve injury is common nervous system injuries. Occupational hand injuries often result in permanent motor dysfunctions which greatly affect patient’s quality of life and productivity. It exerts heavy burden on health care system with no effective treatments associated with loss of function, except limited options to manage the symptoms (physiotherapy). Current study aims to identify and test the proteins involved in critical period in peripheral nerve regeneration. Identification of proteins/genes, which will pave the way for a better understanding of how to increase intrinsic growth capacity of injured neurons as this is essential to all form of axonal regeneration in nervous system repair. We believe that knowledge gained from current studies will provide insight into the development of novel therapeutic opportunities to manage the catastrophic loss of functions caused by nervous system injuries such as spinal cord injury and neurodegenerative diseases. Our ultimate goal is to identify potential therapy for treating not only PNI but also other traumatic physical injuries, which normally do not regrow their injured axons after injury, to regenerate and restore complete function. It will greatly improve the quality of life for patients with nervous system injuries which usually result in a permanent disability.

200212.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
200212.value: In order to model physical or biological growth processes in which memory effects (describing the history of the underlying quantity; e.g. the population size or the stretching of a membrane), the resulting mathematical equation is a (linear or semilinear) ordinary or partial differential equation that contains an integral term (corresponding to a positive, non-increasing convolution-type memory kernel). Such integro-differential equations are much more difficult to solve than the (local) differential equations since, owing to the dependence of the memory kernel on time, one has to re-compute the entire history term at each time step. Hence one is interested in working with a variable time step that is chosen adaptively (based on a posteriori error estimates and given error tolerance) so as to minimise the computing time.

200512.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
200512.value: 在此项目中，我们建议设计与提高plasmonic 人工电磁 材料非线性过程的两个泛欧谐振带 。第一个泛欧振带旨在泵激光的波长范围： ~ 1.2-1.4 µ m内产生共鸣时。在谐振波长泵浦的能量将会在器件内强烈区域化，从而提高非线性光学过程和诱导的折射率变化预计将会加大。第二个泛欧振带的设计是对应探测激光波长的宽带共振(从 super-continuum 波长光源： 1.5 微米至 1.7 微米). 第二个泛欧波段的共振性质能增大的瞬态反射探头信号的敏感性。因此，在两个泛欧谐振带泵对齐和同时探测激光时两个泛欧谐振带可以单独进行调整。这种设计可以提供了更大的自由，实现可调谐异向介质超快光开关。此外，作为三次谐波 (THG) 发射是可见区域中i.e. 就是它的错相位时间比瞬态反射过程快，它可以用於監視超快泵浦激光和探頭信號之間的相互作用。

200512.label: Realisation of objectives
200512.value: We have studied the linear and non-linear optical properties of Fano-type metamaterials. We first studied the coupling between surface plasmonic polariton (SPP) modes and micro-cavity modes (Nanoscale, 5, 9129 (2013)); we fabricated a plasmonic grating–cavity hybrid structure consisting of a two-dimensional silver nanoparticle array on a planar nanocavity by using a standard e-beam lithography technique. We observed clear coupling of the SPP and the cavity modes with anti-crossing characteristic analgoues to Rabi-splitting. In this work, we have experimentally and theoretically studied the efficient energy exchange between SPP and F–P cavity modes via a Rabi-analogue splitting in a hybrid plasmonic nanocavity. We believe that such efficient energy exchange between SPP and cavity modes facilitated by Rabi-analogue splitting could provide new concepts for developing nanophotonic devices working in the visible spectral range. We then introduce an organic conjugated polymer with large third harmonic generation effi ciencyinto a gold/ITO-based plasmonic crystal. Large surface plasmon-enhanced third harmonic generation in the metal–polymer hybrid plasmonic crystal was observed and the result opens a new avenue to develop novel nonlinear optical plasmonic devices (Adv. Optical Mater. 1, 522 (2013)). The device consists of 2D gold disc-array was fabricated on top of ITO surface by using e-beam lithography and gold lift-off process. Then PFO thin film with thickness of 140 nm was spun-cast on the gold nanostructure to form the hybrid plasmonic device. In this work we experimentally demonstrated surface plasmon enhanced third harmonic generation from the metal–organic hybrid plasmonic crystal. The metal–organic hybrid configuration provides us with new concepts to develop novel nonlinear optical devices with subwavelength electromagnetic wave confinement. We further demonstrated that harmonics generation can be also produced from using another optical non-linearity strong polymer, F8BT, deposited onto a gold-fork micro-structure (Adv. Optical Mater. 2, 389 (2014)); we studied both the linear and non-linear optical characteristics of the device. The results demonstrated that the combination of gold-fork microstructure with organic thin film provides new platforms in producing nonlinear optical radiation of optical vortex, beam splitting of the nonlinear optical processes, etc.

201212.label: Project Objectives
201212.value: Identify and quantify HULISws compounds in ~120 fine aerosol samples collected at four representative sites in the PRD region. Develop and optimize the analytical methods for the characterization of HULISws using GC-MS and UPLC-HRTOFMS. Determine the temporal and spatial variation of HULISws compounds, calculate their relative contributions to the total HULISws, and investigate their relationship with the major aerosol phase constituents. Identify the primary/secondary and anthropogenic/biogenic sources of HULISws in the region using the measured organic tracer data. Assess the influences of meteorological conditions and major gaseous oxidants on HULISws composition, and determine the factors that can affect the formation of HULISws in atmospheric aerosols.

201212.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
201212.value: 类腐殖质物质(HUmic-LIke Substances, HULIS)是大气微细颗粒物(PM2.5)中有机物质的重要组成部分。在珠江三角洲地区采集的PM2.5中，约有44-67%的水溶性有机物由水溶性HULIS (HULISws)组成。然而，迄今为止我们对PM2.5中HULIS的具体化学组成和它们在大气中的来源及形成方式仍知之甚少。本项目拟建立基于质谱技术的HULISws的分析方法，结合不同的色谱-质谱联用技术的特点对在珠江三角洲地区四个不同的采样点一年内采集的120个PM2.5样品中的HULISws进行定性定量分析。同时我们也会对测得的不同HULISws组分在不同采样点不同季节的变化以及他们与PM2.5中其他主要气溶胶组分的关系进行分析。我们初期的研究结果表明，芳香羧(包括羟基苯甲酸、1,3-苯二甲酸、4-羟基-3-甲氧基苯甲酸和3,5-二甲氧基-4-羟基苯甲酸等)，脂肪族羧酸(包括来自生物源的二次有机示踪物)，和硝基氧有机硫酸盐是香港大气PM2.5中的HULISws的最主要的三大组分。这意味着机动车排放，生物质燃烧，和二次生成可能是本地区大气气溶胶中HULISws的重要来源。本项目将使得我们对珠江三角洲地区的大气气溶胶中的HULISws的化学组分及来源有更深入及透彻的了解，从而帮助我们进一步探索HULISws对大气气溶胶的吸水性、光学性及毒性的影响，为城市大气PM2.5污染控制积累基础数据并提供科学依据

201312.label: Realisation of objectives
201312.value: Objective 1: Four water-soluble porphycenes were synthesized based on classical method which consists of many steps (13-16 steps) with quite a few low-yield reactions. It took us 13 months to obtain our first target porphycene. We then looked for alternative synthetic route and discovered a synthetic reaction that allowed us to accomplish our synthetic goal with only 7 steps. Three new porphycenes, including our best two drug candidates which are reported in our attached manuscript, were prepared using this more convenient high-yield route. All seven porphycenes prepared were structurally characterized, evaluated for their photodynamic therapeutic (PDT) application in both aerobic/normoxic (well-oxygenated) and hypoxic ([O2]<1%) conditions towards the nasopharyngeal carcinoma (HK-1) cells. Six of these porphycenes gave promising results as potential normoxic (type II) and hypoxic (type I) PDT agents. Two of them, namely, TBPoS-OH and TBPoS-2OH, shown very potent photo-cytotoxicity (LD50=65 nM) under hypoxic conditions. Their activities were 15- to 20-fold more potent than the current best hypoxic PDT drug, EtNBS, developed by T. Hasan's group at Harvard Medical School in our parallel experiments. Objective 1: The photophysical properties, including two-photon absorption cross-section and singlet oxygen quantum yield, were measured for these porphycenes. Their application as potential bifunctional tumor-imaging and PDT agents was demonstrated. Objective 1 & 2: Indole-3-acetic acid (IAA), a non-toxic prodrug, thought to be important in our original research plan, was found neither necessary nor enhancing in our observed PDT activities mediated by these porphycenes. Thus, this research objective was considered irrelevant and therefore not pursued. Objective 3: The underlying mechanism (type I vs. type II) of the photodynamic activities of these porphycene-based photosensitizers was investigated via identification of their photo-oxidation products with IAA under hypoxic and normoxic conditions. To achieve this objective, we must first determine the characteristic/marker product(s) derived from type I (hypoxic) and type II (aerobic) photo-oxidations of IAA. A variety of well-studied photosensitizers were used to oxidize IAA under hypoxic (type I) and normoxic (type II) conditions and their corresponding photo-oxidation product profiles were obtained by LC-MS-MS technique. Out of the more than 12 IAA oxidation products seen, indole-3-carbinol and o-formamidobenzoylacetic acid were identified as the characteristic product from type I and type II photo-sensitization, respectively. But, due to insufficient amounts of some of the porphycenes available, this study has not completed yet.

201312.label: Major findings and research outcome
201312.value: 1. A total of seven porphycene-based photosensitizers were synthesized using the classical 13-step route and a significantly shorter route (7-step) developed by us. 2. These photosensitizers were all evaluated for their photodynamic therapeutic (PDT) activities under both normoxic (type II, singlet oxygen-mediated) and hypoxic (type I, electron transfer) conditions, with 6 of them showing significant activities under both conditions towards nasopharyngeal carcinoma HK-1 cells. 3. Two porphycenes, TBPoS-OH and TBPoS-2OH, shown very potent PDT activities under both normoxic (LD50=53 nM) and hypoxic (LD50=65 nM) conditions with low dark cytotoxicity, very fast cellular uptake and predominantly apoptotic cell death mode. [A JACS Communication manuscript, attached in Part C, is ready for submission next month.] International (provisional) patent application on hypoxic anti-tumor PDT application of these compounds will be filed shortly, as their activities were shown to be superior to the best, recently patented, hypoxic PDT drug, EtNBS, from Harvard Medical School. In fact, there are only a handful of such agents reported currently. 4. Indole-3-acetic acid (IAA), a proposed target substrate for our PDT agents, was shown to be neither necessary nor enhancing in the observed PDT actions of these porphycenes. Thus, the pursuit of Objective 2 is not considered relevant. 5. On Objective 3, the action mechanisms of these porphycene-based PDT agents under normoxic (type II) and hypoxic (type I) were investigated by first establishing the characteristic/marker product(s) of IAA using series of well-known types I and II photosensitizers (Rose Bengal, methylene blue, etc.) as reference standards using LC/MS technique. Indole-3-carbinol and o-formamidobenzoylacetic acid were identified as types I and II sensitization products, respectively. [A manuscript describing this important finding will be ready for submission early next year.] 6. An in vitro hypoxic PDT setup has been designed and purposely-built for this project. This design is versatile enough to be applicable as a tool for cell-based evaluation of all potential hypoxic PDT drugs. We intend to look into the possibility of patent protection of our design.

201312.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
201312.value: 1. Further structural modification on our lead compounds will be carried out to optimize the PDT activity of these porphycene-based photosensitizers. 2. 3D tumor model and/or tumor xenograft on nude mice will be used to further establish the hypoxic PDT activity of these compounds. 3. In vivo experiments, including pharmacokinetic study, using small animals will be conducted to evaluate the drug properties of these compounds. 4. 201312.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
201312.value: Photodynamic therapy (PDT) represents an emerging alternative cancer treatment modality. It is inherently more selective than conventional chemotherapy because it uses laser light which can precisely target the tumor tissue, which has been dosed with the originally non-toxic PDT drug and converted it into toxic drug to kill the cancer cells. However, all currently clinically approved PDT drugs require oxygen for their actions. But, within the tumor, there often exist pockets of tissue where the oxygen level is very low. Consequently, the effectiveness of these drugs is compromised and not all cancer cells can be eradicated, thus allowing possible recurrent attack and migration. In this work, we have developed a new kind of PDT drug that shows potent activity even under low oxygenation environment, therefore opening up the possibility of a complete eradication of all cancer cells in one single treatment.

201412.label: Realisation of objectives
201412.value: All four objectives have been successfully achieved. Rotaxane organocatalysis presents a new direction toward controlled one-pot catalytic reactions. By combining molecular switches and catalysts, fluorescence and pH-responsive switching along with the exclusive selectivity of dual catalytic reactions are demonstrated. A newly designed [2]rotaxane catalyst containing an anthracene group was used to visualize the catalytic reaction process upon switching the macrocycle. A novel fluorescence-tagged switchable [2]- rotaxane catalyst with two catalytic sites (secondary amine and thiourea) was synthesized. The fluorescence of [2]rotaxane can be reversibly switched “ON” and “OFF” upon the addition of acid and base, which is correlated to the position of the rotaxane’s macrocycle and the catalytic properties of either thiourea (ON) or amine (OFF). The rotaxane catalyst was also found to be acid−base switchable, exclusively masking the secondary amine or thiourea from crown ether in different pH environments. The rotaxane catalyst can be applied to a two- or three-component system, selectively giving the desired product. Four sets of three-component catalytic reaction systems of acetylacetone (A) or dibenzoylmethane (B) with trans-β-nitrostyrene (C) and (E)-crotonaldehyde (D) were catalyzed by the protonated rotaxane and deprotonated rotaxane with moderate conversion and high selectivity. Four sets of two-component catalytic reaction systems were reported with a better yield in a shorter period. In situ ON−OFF switching of the rotaxane catalyst has also been demonstrated.

201412.label: Major findings and research outcome
201412.value: In summary, novel methods have been discovered to construct the rotaxane dual catalysis and hyperbranched polyrotaxanes with good yields. The rotaxanes could be actuated by the addition of acid/base or gradient change of solvents. We have developed a series of supramolecular recognition motifs which can be actuated by using various types of stimuli such as water, salt, base, and acid. These novel supramolecular complexes were characterized by using NMR, UV/visible absorption, and fluorescence spectroscopies (RSC Adv. 2013, 3, 26382-26390). Moreover, the proposed rotaxane backbone component with thiourea and proline catalytic sites has been successfully synthesized. Iron oxide / porous silica core/shell nanoparticles (Chem. Soc. Rev. 2012, 41, 1911; Chem. Rec. 2016, 16, 458), carbon nanoparticles (RSC Adv. 2014, 4, 18193), hyperbranched dendritic fragments (ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 2014, 6, 6264; New J. Chem., 2014, 38, 3362) and rotaxane dendrimers (Chem. Commun. 2013, 49, 10781) are routinely synthesized. Supramolecular amide hydrogen-bond interactions between bundles of necklace-like chains based on superparamagnetic hollow Fe3O4 nanoparticle beads could be indirectly quantified by shear stress and magnetorheological analyses (New J. Chem. 2014, 38, 6125). A new [2]pseudorotaxane with dibenzo[24]crown-8 crown ether-dibenzylammonium binding which was formed by slippage approach at different solvents and temperature, had been isolated and characterized by NMR spectroscopy and mass spectrometry. The [2]pseudorotaxane was stable at room temperature. The dissociation rate of [2]pseudorotaxane could be tuned by using different stimuli such as triethylamine /diisopropylethylamine and dimethyl sulfoxide. In particular, the dissociation of [2]pseudorotaxane by an excess of TEA/DIPEA base mixture possessed a long and sustained, complete dissociation over 60 days. Other stimuli by DMSO possessed a relatively fast dissociation over 24 h (Int. J. Mol. Sci. 2015, 16, 8254). A novel rod-like β-FeOOH@poly(dopamine)–Au–poly(dopamine) nanocomposite is developed for recyclable catalysis (Dalton Trans. 2015, 44, 9538). A novel fluorescence-tagged switchable [2]rotaxane catalyst with two catalytic sites (secondary amine and thiourea) was synthesized. The fluorescence of [2]rotaxane can be reversibly switched “ON” and “OFF” upon the addition of AcOH and TEA, which is correlated to the position of the rotaxane’s macrocycle and the catalytic properties of either thiourea (ON) or amine (OFF). The rotaxane catalyst was also found to be acid−base switchable, exclusively masking the secondary amine or thiourea from crown ether in different pH environments (Org. Lett. 2016, 18, 976). A facile method was developed to synthesize Fe3O4/polydopamine dual shelled microspheres with a hollow interior (J. Mater. Chem. A 2017, 5, 2947).

201412.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
201412.value: With the development of the rotaxane catalyst and polyrotaxanes as novel smart nanomaterials, they showed excellent tunable specific catalytic activities. The development of our [2]rotaxane-based organocatalytic systems and their dendritic and nanoparticle materials with various modes to control the organocatalyst’s properties on demand would certainly give insights on the design of more sophisticated smart nanomaterials for future’s chiral/achiral catalyst needs for complex cascade catalytic reactions.

201412.value: Rotaxane organocatalysis presents a new direction toward controlled one-pot catalytic reactions. By combining molecular switches and catalysts, fluorescence and pH-responsive switching along with the exclusive selectivity of dual catalytic reactions are demonstrated. The development of our [2]rotaxane-based organocatalytic systems and their dendritic and nanoparticle materials with various modes to control the organocatalyst’s properties on demand would certainly give insights on the design of more sophisticated smart nanomaterials for future’s chiral/achiral catalyst needs for complex cascade catalytic reactions.

201612.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
201612.value: MicroRNA (miRNA) has recently emerged as a new and important class of cellular regulators. Strong evidence that aberrant expression of miRNA is associated with a broad spectrum of human diseases, such as cancer, diabetes, cardiovascular and psychological disorders. However, the short length and low abundance of miRNA place great challenges for conventional techniques in the miRNA quantitation and expression profiling. In this work, we propose a direct and ultrasensitive and mulitplex detection assay for miRNA without sample amplification. A self-assembled protein nanofibril acts as an online preconcentrating sensor to the target miRNA. Lock-nucleic acid (LNA) modified molecular beacon (MB) is the probe and signal generator. This work will further extend to clinical samples of Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma (NPC) patients’ tumor tissue, as well as blood and saliva such that a non-invasive sampling approach is adapted for early clinical disease diagnosis and prognosis, and clincial new drugs testing. The success of this project will certainly open up new avenues for development of highly sensitive and accurate detection systems to both biomedical reearches and a wide variety of clinical applications. 微核糖核酸(miRNA)是一種非編碼性的短序列核酸，新年的科學研究證據指出miRNA除了是一種新型的細胞調節劑外，在人體內miRNA水平的異常表達與多種不同疾病，如癌症、糖尿病、心血管病等，都有著非常密切的關係。因此，科研界認為miRNA將能夠作為一種新型疾病的生物標記物，以透過測量miRNA的水平及其表達作為對疾病早期形成的診斷之用。可惜，基於miRNA的短序列以及其於體內極低的濃度令傳統的定量及表達譜分析帶來很大挑戰。本專案擬開發一種直接、超敏、而且省卻樣品預處理的多元miRNA檢測方法。新的檢測靶miRNA生物感測器將會建基於我們先前已開發的自組制澱粉樣蛋白纖維作為檢測平台。作為檢測探針的鎖核酸分子信標將捕捉溶液中的靶miRNA並進行液相雜交，而所得的雜交體將會於蛋白纖維上進行預富集，從而令分子信標的螢光信號於全內反射螢光顯微鏡下的信噪比得以大幅提高。澱粉樣蛋白纖維檢測平台的應用將會透過對癌症病人的臨床樣品檢測進行確應。我們將會收集鼻咽癌病人的血液及唾液作為此平台的臨床測試物進行生物傳感檢測，並將所得的結果與傳統的聚合酶鏈反應檢測法進行對比。研究成功的話，此高敏且準確的平臺將為生物醫學研究及臨床檢測應用上帶來全新的發展。

201612.label: Realisation of objectives
201612.value: We have achieved the project objectives under this GRF project. We have successfully developed and reported a direct, specific and highly sensitive yet simple detection assay for miRNA without sample amplification. A self-assembled protein nanofibril acted as an online pre-concentrating sensor to detect the target miRNA. Locked nucleic acid (LNA) of complimentary sequence was served as the probe to capture the target miRNA analyte. The quantification was achieved by the fluorescence intensity measured with total internal reflection fluorescence microscopy. A detection limit of 1 pM was achieved with trace amount of sample consumption. This assay showed efficient single-base mismatch discrimination. The applicability of quantifying circulating mir-196a in both normal and cancer patient’s serums was also demonstrated. We also advanced the assay to differentiate the expression of a nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) up-regulator hsa-mir-205 (mir-205) in serum collected from patients of different stages of NPC. To overcome the background matrix interference in serum, a locked nucleic acid-modified molecular beacon (LNA/MB) was applied as the detection probe to hybridize, capture and detect target mir-205 in serum matrix with enhanced sensitivity and specificity. A detection limit of 500 fM was achieved. The as-developed method was capable of differentiating NPC stages by the level of mir-205 quantified in serum. Taking advantages of the self-assembly of the hair-pin structure DNA, a novel and efficient enzyme-free dual signal amplification strategy for live cell mRNA imaging has been also successfully developed by using a smart nucleic acid hairpins-based nanosystem. To extend the development of detection assays for cancer biomarkers, a direct and ultrasensitive multiplex assay using an immuno-magnetic platform has been developed for the quantification of trace amounts of circulating cancer-associated antigens in serum. In addition, a direct method in detecting cancer biomarkers using dark field microscopy (DFM) was also developed. The trypsin quantification with fluorescence resonance energy transfer (FRET) has been established. A new technique of single particle scattering intensity measurement has been constructed for the quantification of cancer-related biomarkers. Taking the experience gained from the self-aggregation of the amyloid peptides, a new inhibitor compound DBA-SLOH was developed to effectively prevent the Aβ1-40 and Aβ1-42 peptides from self-aggregation and forming toxic oligomers. This multifunctional fluorescent molecule shows promising potential as a theranostic agent for the diagnosis and therapy of AD. With the financial support of this GRF project, we were able to accomplished several pieces of good work which are published in international peer-reviewed journals, including Analytical Chemistry, Biomaterials and Chemical Science, etc..

201812.label: Project Objectives
201812.value: We propose a framework to study and analyze non-negative rectangular tensors for the hub and authority scores of objects, and the relevance scores of relations in multi-relational data. On the theoretical side, we will study and analyze existence and uniqueness of limiting probabilities in the tensor model. On the algorithmic side, we will also develop efficient iterative algorithms to solve a set of tensor (multivariate polynomial) equations to obtain hub and authority scores and relevance scores, and analyze the convergence of the proposed algorithm. Applications of our methods to community discovery will be considered, studied and analyzed. We extend our tensor model to multi-dimensional non-negative tenors for identification of interesting and explainable local communities in multi-dimensional network data.

201812.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
201812.value: Evaluation of object importance or popularity is an important research problem in information retrieval that can assist in many data mining tasks. In the literature, there are several link analysis methods to evaluating object importance and information search such as PageRank, HITS and SALSA. However, in these link analysis methods, a single relation type is focused and studied. In this proposal, we are interested in data with multiple relation types represented by non-negative tensors. There are many data mining and information retrieval applications in multi-relational data which objects have interactions with the others based on different relations. For example, researchers cite the other researchers in different conferences based on different concepts/topics; papers cite the other papers based on text analysis such as title, abstract, keyword and authorship; and webpages link to the other webpages through different semantic meanings. Such additional links structure can provide a better way of incorporating multiple relations into objects for calculation of objects importance and information search. On the other hand, the number of objects in these applications can be very large, and easily be over a million. This research proposal is centered on the development of effective and efficient non-negative tensor based computational methods for analyzing large-scale and multi-relational data. The main contribution of this proposal is to propose a framework to study and analyze non-negative rectangular tensors for the hub and authority scores of objects, and the relevance scores of relations in multi-relational data. The basic idea of our framework is to consider a random walk in non-negative rectangular tensors, and study in such random walk, limiting probabilities of visiting objects for hub and authority scores and using relations for relevance scores. By making use of these limiting probabilities, we can rank relations and objects as a hub and an authority, and perform query search in data mining applications. On the theoretical side, we will study and analyze existence and uniqueness of limiting probabilities in the tensor model. On the algorithmic side, we will develop efficient iterative algorithms to solve a set of tensor (multivariate polynomial) equations to obtain hub and authority scores and relevance scores, and also analyze the convergence of the proposed algorithm. Applications of our methods to community discovery will be considered, studied and analyzed. We extend our tensor model to multi-dimensional non-negative tenors for identification of interesting and explainable local communities in multi-dimensional network data. 在信息檢索,評價對象的重要性或普及是一個重要的研究課題,可以幫助許多數據挖掘任務. 在文獻中,有幾個鏈接一個單一的關係型分析方法, 如PageRank,HITS,SALSA. 在這個計劃中, 我們興趣的是多重關係數據與非負張量表示的關係類型. 有很多是多重關係數據挖掘,如研究人員 引用其他研究人員在不同的會議上根據不同的概念/主題;論文引用其他文件標題,摘要,關鍵字和文本分析的基礎上著作權,和網頁鏈接到其他網頁通過不同的語義的含義。這些額外的鏈接結構可以提供一種更好的方式納入為計算對象的重要性和信息的多重關係為對象的搜索.另一方面,在這些應用中的對象的數目,可以是非常大的,很容易被超過百萬.本研究建議為發展有效和高效的基於非負張量的計算方法用於分析大型和多關係數據. 主要貢獻是提出了一個框架,研究和分析非負矩形張量在多關係數據. 我們的基本思想是考慮在非負的矩形張量中 研究一個隨機遊走隨機漫步的概率分析. 通過利用這些概率,我們可以排名樞紐和權威的關係及對象, 並執行查詢搜索中數據挖掘應用.在理論方面，我們將研究和分析存在唯一張量模型的概率方案. 在算法方面,我們將制定有效的迭代算法來解決張量(多元一套多項式)方程,得到概率,同時也分析該算法的收斂性. 我們的方法應用在多維網絡數據解釋社區發現,將予以考慮,研究和分析.

201812.label: Major findings and research outcome
201812.value: In [Output #4], we proposed a new framework to study the hub and authority scores of objects, and the relevance scores of relations in multi-relational data for query search. The basic idea of our framework is to consider a random walk in multi-relational data, and study in such random walk, limiting probabilities of relations for relevance scores, and of objects for hub scores and authority scores. In [Output #6], we generalize this framework to a more general situation suitable for different applications. In [Output # 1,2], we analyze the proposed model by studying a limiting probability distribution vector of a transition probability tensor arising from a higher order Markov chain. Theoretical results are established to support the proposed model. In [Output #5], we further study the Birkhoff--von Neumann theorem for a class of multistochastic tensors. The analysis provides a theoretical framework for future development of tensor models in higher order Markov chains. By using the proposed tensor models, applications in imaging sciences and data mining are published in [Output #3,7].

201812.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
201812.value: Conventional machine learning considers the availability of a large amount of labeled data to train a model in the same instance or feature space. In many data mining applications, labeled data is limited and expensive. It is interesting to employ tensor models for machine learning strategies. In particular, we would like to study how to use tensor models for transfer learning that can use knowledge transferring from a source domain to a target domain or even in a co-transfer learning framework that can perform learning simultaneously by co-transferring knowledge across different feature spaces. Also in social networks, user actions are constantly changing and co-evolving. In the future work, it is required to adapt the proposed model to be time-varying. As probability distributions are non-stationary in this situation, we must consider and study statistically dependence in time-varying Markov chains for items of different dimensions to obtain the affinities among them in order to find an evolution of communities across different time stamps.

201812.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
201812.value: There are many information retrieval and data mining applications where multiple relation types are involved. In such applications, objects have interactions with the others based on different relations. For example, researchers (or papers) cite the other researchers (or the other papers) based on different concepts/keywords, proteins interact with the other proteins under different conditions, webpages link to the other webpages via different semantic meanings. We refer to the data of this type as multi-relational data. One natural way to represent the multi-relational data is using tensors, also known as multi-dimensional arrays. In this project, we successfully study and analyze tensor models via higher order Markov chains, and present interesting theoretical results for further mathematical development and application results for the other possible applications in data mining and imaging sciences.

201912.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
201912.value: Lakes Magadi, Natron and Nasikie Engida, which lie in the rift valley of southern Kenya and northern Tanzania represent three differing responses to evaporation of closed saline water bodies with no outflow. Lake Magadi is dry for much of the year with exposed sodium carbonate (trona), but is flooded seasonally. Lake Natron fluctuates annually in area and salinity but normally has surface water. Nasikie Engida is fed by perennial hot-spring inflow and maintains a shallow saline lake all year. All three lakes have varied in water depth throughout the last one million years as a result of climate change and tectonics, periodically becoming fresher, deeper, and occasionally uniting as a single large lake. The sediments include several unusual deposits with uncommon minerals. During fresher periods, limestones have formed. Trona precipitated during dry periods and forms extensive deposits today in all three lakes. Siliceous gels have accumulated in parts of the basins near sites of hot-spring inflow. The Pleistocene deposits of each of these lakes contain abundant sodium silicate minerals such as magadiite and abundant quartzose cherts. Although most of these cherts were originally attributed to alteration of a magadiite precursor, a recent re-evaluation has suggested that some might have had a microbiological origin, or were precipitated from silica-rich hot spring waters on periodically emergent mudflats. This project will revisit questions concerning the origins of sediments in the Magadi-Natron Basins through a systematic study of the ancient and modern deposits and a renewed investigation of the modern lake brines, rivers, springs and groundwater inflows. We will provide field descriptions of new sediment sections and return samples for chemical, sedimentological and microfossil analyses that will improve our understanding of the past environments in which those deposits formed, and refine the geological history for the region with a better constrained chronology of geological events. We will also obtain short cores from the saline lakes and recover modern sediment samples to enhance our understanding of recent sedimentary and early diagenetic processes. The resulting data will be used to develop models of chemical and biochemical sedimentation in an arid rift basin through time, which will assist in reconstructing the geological history of the Magadi-Natron region, and in assessing the origins of analogous ancient sediments elsewhere (e.g., Eocene Green River Formation, USA). In particular, the new research will help to explain the processes involved in the formation of trona, magadiite and non-marine cherts in general. 馬加迪(Magadi)、納沖(Natron) 和納賽其．英吉達(Nasikie Engida) 是位於肯尼亞南部和坦桑尼亞北部的東非大裂谷之間的三個天然鹹水湖。它們的水體不向外排出。它們代表三種不同封閉鹽湖的蒸發方式。馬加迪湖除了季節性洪水流入，全年大部分時間呈現乾的天然鹼狀態。納沖湖的面積和鹽度每年處於不斷變化之中，但通常都會保持一定的水面。然而，納賽其．英吉達湖由於常年溫泉水的流入，使其一年四季均保持較低的水位．在過去一百萬年間，由於氣候變化和板塊運動，所有這三個湖泊的水位都發生了改變。例如周期性地變為淡水和具有較深的水位。偶爾，它們也會連成一片，形成一個大湖． 這些湖泊的沉積物有各種特別的物質以及不常見的礦物質。在它們當中，石灰石沉積物形成於淡水湖期間。在乾旱年代，加速了天然鹼的生成並成為今天三個湖泊中最大量的沉積物。矽膠體沿著溫泉流道附近的盆地累積．在所有三個湖泊的更新世沉積物中有豐富的矽酸納礦物，比如耐米粘土和石英硅質岩。僅管所有這些硅質礦物最初被歸於早期耐米粘土的演變，但是最新的研究認為它們有可能源於微生物或者源於周期性形成的含硅豐富的溫泉水泥灘。 該研究項目將重新探討馬加迪—納沖盆地沉積物起源的問題。它將包括對遠古和當代的沉積物進行系統性的研究和對現代湖泊的鹹水、流入河流、泉水以及地下水重新展開調查。通過對新沉積物斷面的野外考察和對樣品的化學以及微生物化石的分析將改進我們對這些沉積物形成環境的認識。同時通過對地質形成年代的分析，使我們可以更加精確地反映該地區有關地質變化的歷史。我們還將在鹽湖上鑽取短的沉積物岩心樣品和復原現代沉積物樣品，從而加深我們對該地區現代沉積和早期成岩過程的理解。 有關研究所得數據將用於發展乾旱斷裂盆地化學和生物化學沉積物的年代模型。這將有助於重建馬加迪—納沖地區的地質史和評論其他類似古沉積區域的起源（例如美國懷俄明州始新世時期的綠河沉積形成）。特別是該研究將有助於解釋天然鹼、耐米粘土和非海洋硅質礦物的形成過程。

201912.label: Realisation of objectives
201912.value: The major objectives have been achieved with samples collected from all of the sedimentary units in the region, including the Oloronga Beds, Green Beds, High Magadi Beds and the Evaporite Series. Hot and cold spring, stream and lake waters were collected and analysed. Detailed hydrochemistry has been established for the Nasikie Engida and Bogoria Basins. The lithologies recognised in these sediments include zeolitic silts, trona and nahcolite facies representing evaporative stages in the basin histories, with the latter deposits also implying inputs of mantle CO2. Magadiite studies are still ongoing, but we have discovered abundant trace fossils - an unusual feature of sediment that forms in a highly saline setting. Cherts have been examined in the Magadi Basin, with evidence suggesting their origins are related to hydrothermal inputs on the margins of a saline lake basin. The Quaternary history has also been evaluated with conclusions that show a transition from early to middle Pleistocene fresh water lakes, through a series of meromictic water bodies to the contemporary saline pans of the region. Paper publications have been delayed by the sad passing away of a very close relative of my co-investigator. It has taken him some time to adapt to the event and this delayed writing somewhat. Nevertheless, publications have started to come through with two accepted and one being reviewed. Several more are in various stages of preparation.

201912.label: Major findings and research outcome
201912.value: A number of rift-specific factors operate in the Magadi-Natron Basin that influence lake sediment geochemistry and deposition. Driving forces have included faulting, subsidence and the eruption of a variety of volcanics with contrasting major and trace element compositions. These basic factors, in turn, have led to changes in 1) orographic rainfall over uplifted rift shoulders; 2) rain shadows over subsiding rift axes; 3) increasing aridity over the Magadi-Natron region; 4) catchment size and accommodation space with time; 5) meteoric circulation along faults; 6) carbonate accumulation; 7) evaporite precipitation; 8) hydrothermal circulation, silica supply and deposition; and 9) mantle CO2 emissions along faults. Some factors change from rift inception, but others tend to develop during more mature rift development. The saline, alkaline lake in the southern region contain a semi-continuous record of about 1 million years. Uranium series and radiocarbon dates provide a chronology for the last 350,000 years. The deposits include fifteen major facies types that were deposited in fresh to highly saline lakes, wetlands and playas. The sequence is distinctive from others in the Kenya Rift in lacking major pedogenic horizons, reflecting its tectonic sump location and continuity of aquatic environments that have been maintained in part by geothermal and/or meteoric springs. Seventeen geochemical and four mineralogical zones and subzones are distinguished together with six major diatom stages. Ca:Na ratios decline and (K2O+NaO)/AL2O3 ratios increase upwards, reflecting increasingly saline-alkaline palaeolakes. REE patterns became increasingly varied as increasingly alkaline carbonate brines evolved. Trace elements document a reduced basaltic influence above geochemical Zone G2 possibly caused by grid faulting. Calcite and Mg calcite in older deposits give way to zeolitic sediments and then zeolites plus trona in younger sediments. Diatom Stage D1 includes basal limestones with shallow water floras that give way to sediments formed in fresh to saline water, but with no diatoms preserved except in cherts and limestones. Stages D2–D5 formed in a meromictic lake that gave way to a shrinking saline lake and playa during the Holocene (D6). Diatoms indicate that water chemistries ranged between pH 7.4 to 11.5 when diatoms were present.

201912.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
201912.value: The research has documented a variety of past and present environments, as well as saline lake processes, that have changed in response to broad climate controls and region-specific tectonic and volcanic factors. The detailed understanding of the region's geology will provide a valuable model for ongoing GRF-funded studies in the northern Kenya Rift, where the Suguta basin occupies a similar tectonic sump location. The latter study also involves investigations of ancient sediments (Miocene to Pleistocene) in the Tugen Hills, which include a number of saline lake deposits. It is anticipated that these can be compared with the more recent deposits in Magadi-Natron region and the geochemical models that have been developed there, in order to unravel a long 15 million year record of environmental change.

201912.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
201912.value: The study area includes a wide range of chemical sediments that have formed in several different lakes and which have accumulated as a result of several unusual controlling factors. An important part of understanding how these form relates to the unusual water chemistries in the region, which in turn reflect a relatively high proportion of inflow from hot springs (up to 90% at Lake Nasikie Engida). The hot springs have contributed unusually high sodium and bicarbonate (and other elements). The extreme aridity in the present area has subsequently evaporated these source waters to a high degree producing a number of uncommon deposits (cherts, trona, zeolites). It has also become evident that there are large volumes of carbon dioxide rising along faults that have contributed to the formation of the trona (and nahcolite). This study has also shed light on past environmental change in the region with a record of up to one million years having been developed.

202012.label: Project Title(Chinese)
202012.value: 确定有限混合模型成份的个数及相关的应用。

202012.label: Project Objectives
202012.value: We will first consider finite continuous multivariate Gaussian mixture models, to study properties of the likelihood function and how to construct a penalized method to determine the number of components for such a model. We shall discuss some numerical issues and proceed to realize the method in practice. The asymptotic properties of our method will be explored to ascertain asymptotic consistency, and subsequently we will also consider an extension to finite non-normal mixture models. The best way to use the finite Gaussian mixture model to estimate multivariate density functions will be determined, since it can be used to approximate any continuous multivariate density function. We will seek an efficient way to estimate the multivariate density function, different from that in the nonparametric multivariate density function estimate method. It is notable that the finite mixture regression model can capture change in a regression model. We will study properties of the finite mixture regression model without knowing the number of regression mixture components, and seek a uniform penalized method to determine the regression mixture component and to simultaneously select important model variables. We will investigate the best way to use our method for finite mixture models to classify the observational data as several Gaussian populations, with application to dimension reduction methods such as Slice inverse regression in order to avoid imposing a linear condition on the observations. Such an imposition is restrictive, since it implies that the multivariate random observations should then follow an elliptical distribution asymptotically. A mixture of factor analyzers model can be very useful in pattern recognition and other scientific fields, as it can exploit local properties of the data. We will investigate how to determine the number of mixture components and latent factors simultaneously, and then proceed to analyze a kinematic and EMG data from biomechanics. We will extend our proposed method to determine the number of components in high dimensional finite mixture and mixture regression models, and investigate consequent dimension reduction in a high dimensional setting. Finally, we intend to apply our procedures to high dimensional classification problems, and to analyze some high dimensional data from physical therapy, biomechanics and Computer engineering.

202012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
202012.value: 有限混合模型是经典的参数统计模型的一种推广。它提供了一种数学和统计的方式去模拟大量的，各种各样的自然随机现象。这类模型在生物，基因， 工程，经济，医学和社会科学上都有很多应用。对统计方法，诸如聚类分析，判别分析，图像处理和生存分析上都有很大的贡献。但是，当模型中混合成分个数未知的时候，有限混合模型不是一类规整正则的统计模型。如果混合模型的成分过多，对数据无法提供很好的解释。如果成分过少，对数据结构就会欠缺很好的逼近。 因此，对于优先混合模型，一个重要的问题就是如何确定模型中成分的个数。 在我们的计划中， 我们会先观察惩罚似然函数在有限混合模型，特别是有限高斯混合模型的应用，研究如何用惩罚似然估计确定有限混合模型的成分个数。 方法的相合性，以及有效的EM算法都会得到研究。同时这些研究，会推广到非高斯混合模型，比如柏松混合模型等。在另一方面，我们知道，任何的连续的多元随机分布函数，都可以被有限高斯混合模型所逼近。所以我们会研究如何应用有限的多元高斯混合模型去估计一般连续的多元分布函数。这样，就可以对一般的连续多元分布函数提供一种简单的数学表达和解释。我们也会考虑成分个数对分布函数估计的影响，找到一种适当的途径去决定成分的个数，使之有效的估计多元分布函数。混合回归模型是一类很重要的统计回归模型。我们将提供一类统一的惩罚方法，去有效的估计回归模型中成分参数，以及决定回归成分的个数。现在很多降维的方法，都依赖于线性条件，间接等价于要求观测数据分布满足椭球假设。基于有限混合高斯模型，我们将提出一类降维的算法，使之避免对观测数据分布线性假设的依赖。混合因子分析模型在模式识别以及其他领域上有很多的应用。这类模型，可以发掘数据局部的性质。 在今天，高维是数据的一个典型特征。在我们的计划中，我们将观察高维的有限混合模型。 我们将寻找一种有效的方法确定高维有限混合模型中成分的个数。然后将其应用到降维的方法中去。

202012.label: Realisation of objectives
202012.value: First of all, we have proposed a regularization method to determine the number of components of Gaussian mixture model. The paper has been published by Statistica Sinica. Our method can consistently determine the number of Gaussian mixture model. The Gaussian mixture model with unknown number of components is not a regular statistical model, we have shown that the classical or related L_1 regularization methods, such as LASSO, SCAD or MCP cannot correctly and consistently determine the number of components for the model, and hence we proposed a logarithm function based penalty to determine the number of mixture components. We did not only investigate the numerical performance of our proposed method, we also studied its theoretical properties. However, the difficulties of the theoretical investigation is out of our expectation because of the unbounded support area of the Gaussian mixture distribution and its identifiable problems. Hence it took our long time to correct and made our proof rigorously. Finally we have successfully finished our theoretical investigation. The published paper has been noticed by some researchers from different fields such as machine learning, bioinformatics and econometrics. We perfectly finished our objective 1. We have applied our proposed method for the unsupervised learning of mixture model for longitudinal data. The proposed method can not only determine the number of regression components, but also can efficiently estimate the significant coefficients. Furthermore, we consider the mixture regression model for longitudinal data. We suggest to use two steps to improve the efficiency of the model estimation. It is obvious that our investigated mixture regression model is a more generalized mixture regression model. First, it is based on a mixture generalized linear model structure. Second, since we investigated the longitudinal data, we consider the covariance structure of the data to improve the efficiency of our method to determine the number of regression components. We believe that our finished work surpassed our objective 3. We have done some numerical and theoretical studies to use the finite Gaussian mixture model to estimate the unknown density function. The performance is not bad, and even out of our expectation. One important advantage of the proposed method is that it can be directly applied to high dimensional density estimation. For multivariate dimension data, the proposed density estimate is much better than the classical kernel estimation. However, we also notice the disadvantage of using Gaussian mixture models. In sometimes, we have to use a Gaussian mixture model with large number of components to approximate the density function, and make further statistical inference difficulty. Hence now we try to use more generalized exponential mixture model to replace the Gaussian mixture model to estimate multivariate density functions. We did not only try to estimate the density function efficiently by the finite mixture model, but also try to control the number of components of the final finite mixture model, so that the following inference become more interpretable. To achieve objective 2, we find the new problem for our original proposed method, that using the Gaussian mixture model to estimate the density function cannot control the number of the mixture component, hence further investigation for the density estimation based on the exponential mixture model is still ongoing. We also applied our method to mixture of factor analyzers, combined the idea used to achieve objective 1, we proposed an EM algorithm to determine the number of mixture components and the latent factors simultaneously. We did a lot of numerical studies and have shown its good performance. Since the model is some complicated, the selection of the tuning parameters for the proposed method is some difficult, we suggested a simple plug-in method to determine those tuning parameters and have shown its not bad performance. Though the numerical results of the proposed method is not bad, because of complicated structure of the model, its theoretical investigation is hindered. We still think how to investigate the properties of the proposed method for mixture of factor analyzers from theoretical insight, and the application of the proposed method for the kinematic and EMG data from biomechanics is ongoing. We also tried to use the proposed method for the objective 1 to achieve the objective 4. We face the similar problem as the objective 2. When we use the Gaussian mixture model to classify the data, sometimes we classify too many components such that some components have small numbers of the observations, and cannot directly dimension reduction method to reduce the dimension of the data. Now we are trying to use two approaches to overcome such problem. First, we have tried to use the exponential mixture model to replace Gaussian mixture model to classify the data, and then use the dimensional reduction method, second, we wish to use some prior information to reduce the number of Gaussian mixture components for the data. Theoretical investigation for these two approaches from dimensional reduction insight is ongoing. For the last objective, we have investigated the properties of two dimensional Gaussian mixture model, and suggested two step method to determine the number of components for high dimensional finite mixture model. First, we used the screening methods to compare the likelihood function of finite Gaussian mixture model with pure Gaussian model, then selection significant variables. Next step is based on those selected significant variables to use finite Gaussian mixture model to model data and determine the number of components of the final mixture model. Because of deferrals for finishing first 5 objectives. Now this project is only finished some investigation for the difference of the finite Gaussian mixture likelihood and pure Gaussian likelihood to the same two dimensional data.

202012.label: Major findings and research outcome
202012.value: 1. The finite Gaussian mixture model with unknown number of components is an irregular statistical model, the L_1 similar regularization methods are not appropriate to be used to determine the number of components in the model. It is determined by the speed to zero for the derivative of penalized parameter under the likelihood function and under the penalized function. See Huang, Peng and Zhang (2017), Model selection for gaussian mixture models 2. A logarithm form penalized function is proposed to determine the number of significant components of the finite Gaussian mixture models. The numerical and theoretical investigation has shown the good performance of the proposed method. Model selection for gaussian mixture models. 3. We also proposed to use the proposed method for the generalized mixture regression model. We just showed that the proposed method cannot only consistently selection the significant of regression components, the parameters in every components can be also efficiently estimated, see Xu, Peng and Huang (2017) , Unsupervised Learning of Mixture Regression Models for Longitudinal Data. 4. Based on the similar idea, we suggest a regularized method to estimate mixture of factor analyzers and proposed a plug-in method to select the tuning parameters in the model, see Zhang, Peng, Chan and Hyvarinen (2013). 5. In the unfinished project, we found when the finite Gaussian mixture model to estimate arbitrary density functions, it often used the finite Gaussian mixture model with too many components to estimate the density function. It is also investigated by some research work in vision problem, for example see Cao, et al. (2015). Low-Rank Matrix Factorization Under General Mixture Noise Distributions. 6. This funding also gave much support for my other work. Cheng, Honda, Li and Peng (2014) suggested nonparametric screening method for ultra-high dimensional longitudinal data, and Yu, Zhu, Zhu and Peng (2013) use the Dantizig method for dimensional reduction problems. Lin and Peng (2013) suggested a smoothed rank method for the linear transformation regression model. Li, Peng, Dong and Tong (2014) proposed a method to estimate the confidence simultaneous band for the link function of the single index model, then suggest methods to testing the link function. Cui, Peng, Wen and Zhu (2013) proposed a regularized method to estimate high dimensional additive model, the proposed method cannot only select significant variables, but also adaptively estimate the linear function as a linear function, recover the exact form of the original component functions.

202012.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
202012.value: The finite mixture model is very useful model. Our proposed method to consistently determine the number of components in the model improves the efficiency of the following model estimation and inference. Our further research will focus on investigate the properties of the following maximum likelihood estimation and relative inference problems. The finite mixture model is an irregular statistical model, though the proposed method can consistently determine the number of component in the model, However the convergence rate of such estimate is much smaller than classical convergence rate. But in practice, we can always obtain some prior information about the data. Those prior information can much provide the model estimation efficiency. Our next task is to study what kind of prior information can be used to improve efficiency of the finite mixture model estimation. Estimation of finite mixture model depends much on EM algorithm. Improving computation speed for the model estimation is some challengeable, especially for most of big data. Hence the other further development of our research will focus on the realization of the algorithms for the finite mixture model estimation and inference.

202012.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
202012.value: The finite Gaussian mixture model with unknown number of components is a famous irregular statistical model. We found the classical regularization method cannot consistently determine the number of components for such model. Hence we proposed a new regularization method to correctly determine such number. Such method has wide applications. It can be used to determine the number of regression components for mixture regression components. It can also used to estimate the density function for the multivariate random observations. The performance are not bad. The proposed method can be also applied to more complicated data analysis. We applied it to estimate factor analyzers model, and suggested a plug-in method to select the tuning parameters, and then improved the computing speed for the complicated model estimation. Finite mixture model is a very useful model to discover variation among the data. The research work can be used to assess the variation of data and find a good way to model data, especially those big data collected by different sources. From theoretical insight. our method which correctly determine the number of components of the finite mixture model also provide a way to improve the efficiency of the model estimation and further inference.

202112.label: Project Objectives
202112.value: We will begin by considering the nonlinear equation when the fourth-order diffusion parameter is zero. The first theoretical goal is to obtain an a priori estimate for the gradient of the solution. An operator splitting method will be developed. The convergence of the splitting method will be analyzed. The goal is to separate the difficulties that arise from the nonlinear effect and the fourth-order diffusion in the numerical analysis. Efficient numerical schemes will be designed to separately solve the nonlinear equation and the linear fourth-order equation. The stability, accuracy and efficiency will be analyzed carefully in order to guarantee the conservation of the characteristic properties of the solution, -e.g. the energy decay property, the gradient bound of the solution and power laws.

202112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
202112.value: This project focuses at a fourth-order nonlinear parabolic equation which has been utilized extensively to model interfacial coarsening dynamics in epitaxial growth with slope selections. Although existing mathematical analysis for the model predicts the pyramid-like growth of the crystal, it cannot provide all growing details which are frequently crucial in applications. This motivates the PI’s research in the field. The PI will concentrate on numerical investigations of the aforementioned fourth-order epitaxial growth equation. A number of key numerical issues such as the stability, accuracy and efficiency will be studied along with large time simulations, since the simulations are appropriate to the precise understanding of the surface growth instability of the continuum epitaxial growth model at large times. Novel computational algorithms will be accomplished based on theoretical results acquired. It has been a great challenge in numerical analysis in the treatment of interactions between the fourth-order diffusion and the nonlinear second-order effect exhibited throughout this project. 本項目主要研究被廣泛用來描述有斜率選擇的薄膜外延增長過程的四階非線性拋物方程。 現有的分析可以成功描述最終的金子塔狀晶體結構，但是卻不能詳細描述實際中也非常 關心的薄膜具體增長過程。這驅動了本項目的研究。 申請人將針對上面提到的四階外延增長方程進行深入的數值研究。深刻理解已有的連續 外延增長模型刻畫薄膜增長的不穩定機制需要長時間的模擬。基於此事實，本項目將著 重研究大時間模擬相關的數值穩定性、收斂性和數值算法的效率。 基於獲得的理論結果，申請人將在本項目研究中設計新穎高效的數值方法，用來平衡處 理方程中四階擴散項和二階非線性驅動項的競爭關系。相關的數值分析，也是本項目的 巨大挑戰所在。

202112.label: Realisation of objectives
202112.value: The objectives of this project have been achieved successfully. Under the support of this GRF grant, we have developed an operator splitting method for the nonlinear fourth-order diffusion equation governing the molecular beam epitaxy growth. An a priori estimate for the gradient of the solution has been given. The stability and convergence of the proposed numerical schemes have been analysed.The characteristic properties of the solution, -e.g. the energy decay property, the gradient bound of the solution and power laws, have been conserved in numerical simulations.

202112.label: Major findings and research outcome
202112.value: 1. We obtained new upper and lower gradient bounds of the nonlinear diffusion equation modeling the epitaxial growth of thin films with slope selection in d ≤ 3. By using the method of mild solutions, a refined well-posedness theory is also worked out, which allows initial data to be in the “critical” space. These results could be used in a better error estimate of the aforementioned equation. Please refer to the following paper for detail: Dong Li, Zhonghua Qiao and Tao Tang, Gradient bounds for a thin film epitaxy equation, under review. 2. We investigated an operator splitting method for the thin film epitaxial growth equation with slope selection in Xiao Li, Zhonghua Qiao and Hui Zhang, Convergence of a fast explicit operator splitting method for the molecular beam epitaxy model, under review. The original problem is split into linear and nonlinear sub-problems. For the linear part, the pseudo-spectral method is adopted; for the nonlinear part, a 33-point difference scheme is constructed. Here, we give a compact center-difference scheme involving fewer points for the nonlinear sub-problem in comparison to the difference scheme in the existing work. Besides, we analyze the convergence rate of the proposed algorithm. Numerical results have demonstrate the conservation of the characteristic properties of the solution, -e.g. the energy decay property, the gradient bound of the solution and power laws. 3. We also developed other types of splitting method for thin film epitaxial growth equations in Zhonghua Qiao, Tao Tang and Hehu Xie, ERROR ANALYSIS OF A MIXED FINITE ELEMENT METHOD FOR THE MOLECULAR BEAM EPITAXY MODEL, SIAM Journal on Numerical Analysis, 53 (2015), Pages: 184-205. Zhonghua Qiao, Zhizhong Sun and Zhengru Zhang, STABILITY AND CONVERGENCE OF SECOND-ORDER SCHEMES FOR THE NONLINEAR EPITAXIAL GROWTH MODEL WITHOUT SLOPE SELECTION, Mathematics of Computation, 84 (2015), Pages: 653-674. The stability and error analysis have been performed carefully there. The proposed methods have been used by other researchers in developing efficient numerical schemes for gradient flows problem. In a recent work below, we used these methods to solve a two-phase flow problem in the oil industry. This work sets the stage for a broad extension of efficient convex-splitting semi-implicit schemes for numerical simulation of phase field models with a realistic equation of state in complex geometries of multiple spatial dimensions. Zhonghua Qiao and Shuyu Sun, TWO-PHASE FLUID SIMULATION USING A DIFFUSE INTERFACE MODEL WITH PENG-ROBINSON EQUATION OF STATE, SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing, 36 (2014), Pages: B708-B728.

The stability and error analysis will be studied for the thin film epitaxial growth equation with slope selection with the a prior estimate obtained in this research.

202112.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
202112.value: The fourth-order nonlinear parabolic equation approach has been utilized extensively to model interface coarsening dynamics in epitaxial growth with slope selections. The mathematical analysis for this partial differential equation is challenging. It does not fulfill the maximum or comparison principle, so it is difficult to analyse its corresponding evolution process. In this research, we first considered a nonlinear diffusion equation with bi-harmonic dissipation modeling the epitaxial growth of thin films with slope selection. The optimal local and global well-posedness were established for initial data with critical regularity. Lower and upper bounds for the gradient of the solution in physical dimensions d ≤ 3 have been exhibited. These theoretical results could help to understand the mechanism of slope selection and the dependence on the dissipation coefficient. An operator splitting method has been investigated in this project. The equation is split into nonlinear and linear parts and solved with efficient numerical algorithms.The convergence of the splitting method has been analyzed.With the developed robust and efficient numerical schemes, we may be able to investigate other gradient flow equations.

202512.label: Project Title(Chinese)
202512.value: 非線性可積系統的數學和數值方面

202512.label: Project Objectives
202512.value: The objectives of this project are to study the mathematical and numerical aspects of nonlinear integrable systems. We plan to investigate the algebraic structures of explicit solutions for discrete integrable systems in terms of determinants，quasideterminants, and pfaffians. Meanwhile, attention will be paid to the connections among extrapolation, integrability, orthogonality, and their interplays in numerical analysis. We intend to: (i) study the integrable properties and algebraic structures for those discrete systems whose molecule solutions are expressed in terms of Hankel (or Toeplitz) determinants and pfaffians, (ii) derive new non-commutative extrapolation algorithms by using designants and Clifford algebras and study singular rules and cross rules for the resulting algorithms; we further seek soliton solutions for the corresponding non-commutative integrable systems via quasideterminant techniques, (iii) derive new sequence transformations in terms of pfaffians and further construct convergence acceleration algorithms for implementing these sequences and establish the links between these numerical algorithms and discrete integrable systems, (iv) investigate new connections between discrete (and q-difference) integrable systems and orthogonal polynomials (and their q analogues) in more detail, as the meanings of such connections are not fully understood, (v) apply integrable system theories to Krylov subspace methods to obtain new and interesting algorithms for computing solitary waves of physically meaningful nonlinear wave equations.

We intend to: (i) study the integrable properties and algebraic structures for those discrete systems whose molecule solutions are expressed in terms of Hankel (or Toeplitz) determinants and pfaffians,

(ii) derive new non-commutative extrapolation algorithms by using designants and Clifford algebras and study singular rules and cross rules for the resulting algorithms; we further seek soliton solutions for the corresponding non-commutative integrable systems via quasideterminant techniques,

(iii) derive new sequence transformations in terms of pfaffians and further construct convergence acceleration algorithms for implementing these sequences and establish the links between these numerical algorithms and discrete integrable systems,

(iv) investigate new connections between discrete (and q-difference) integrable systems and orthogonal polynomials (and their q analogues) in more detail, as the meanings of such connections are not fully understood,
(v) apply integrable system theories to Krylov subspace methods to obtain new and interesting algorithms for computing solitary waves of physically meaningful nonlinear wave equations.

202512.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
202512.value: The modern history of integrable systems begins with the numerical discovery of solitons [Phys. Rev. Lett. 15 (1965), 240--243] for the Korteweg–de Vries equation. The importance of solitons stems from the fact that they exhibit particle-type interactions, and they also characterize the long term asymptotic behavior of the solution. Integrable systems provide the key to our understanding of these remarkable interactions. They appear in different areas of physics, both in the classical and quantum domains. The theory of integrable systems has been an active area of mathematics for the past forty years. Different aspects of the subject have fundamental relations with mechanics, applied mathematics, algebraic structures, theoretical physics, analysis, geometry, and so on. The main focus in this proposal is on the mathematical and numerical aspects of nonlinear integrable systems. We plan to study the algebraic structure of explicit solutions for discrete integrable systems in terms of determinants，quasideterminants, and pfaffians. Meanwhile, attention will be paid to the connections among extrapolation, integrability, and orthogonality, and their interplays in numerical analysis. In particular, we will study the interrelations among discrete integrable systems, orthogonal polynomials (and their q-analogues) and extrapolation methods, and their applications to numerical algorithms. 可積系統的近代歷史始於對Korteweg–de Vries方程從數值計算發現了孤子 [Phys. Rev. Lett. 15 (1965), 240--243]。 孤子的重要性在於，它們展示了粒子類型的碰撞並且刻畫了方程解的長時間的漸進性質。無論是在經典力學領域還是在量子力學領域，都有著它們的身影。 在過去的四十多年中，可積系統一直是數學領域中的活躍分支。從不同的角度出發，可積系統和力學，應用數學，代數結構，理論物理，分析，幾何等等都有著根本性的聯系。 本研究計劃側重於可積系統的理論運算和數值應用。我們計劃研究離散可積系統顯示解的代數結構，包括行列式解，擬行列式解以及pfaff解。同時關注可積性、外推和正交性之間的關系以及它們在數值分析中的相互影響。 特別地，我們將會研究離散可積系統、正交多項式（包括q-類推）和外推算法之間的相互關系以及它們在數值算法中的應用。

202512.label: Realisation of objectives
202512.value: (a) Concerning the first objective, our attention has been mainly paid to non-autonomous discrete integrable systems. As a result, we derive a non-autonomous discrete extended Lotka–Volterra equation. The molecule solutions of the systems are also obtained. Besides, we present a systematic procedure to derive discrete analogues of integrable PDEs via Hirota’s bilinear method. This approach is mainly based on the compatibility between an integrable system and its Bäcklund transformation. (b) The second and third objectives have been realized in the following ways: we have found some generalized E-transformations, and the corresponding recursive algorithms for their computations are also studied. Besides, we have found a generalization of the vector sequence transformation and the corresponding non-commutative extrapolation algorithm. (c) As for the fourth objective, by introducing some special bi-orthogonal polynomials, we have derived the so-called discrete hungry quotient-difference (dhQD) algorithm and a system related to the QD-type discrete hungry Lotka–Volterra (QD-type dhLV) system, together with their Lax pairs. (d) The fifth objective has been successfully realized in this way: new integrable discretizations have been found for the famous NLS equation and the KdV equation. By applying the Fourier pseudo-spectral method to the space variable, we calculate the first five conservation quantities at different times. The numerical results indeed verify the conservation properties.

202512.label: Major findings and research outcome
202512.value: Continuing from the midterm progress report, new results are: (a) In [He, Hu, Tam, and Zhang 2016], we propose a new algebraic method to construct non-autonomous discrete integrable systems. The method starts from generalizations of convergence acceleration algorithms related to discrete integrable systems. The non-autonomous version of the corresponding integrable systems are derived. We also obtain molecule solutions of the systems. We propose a generalization of the multistep ϵ-algorithm, and then derive a non-autonomous discrete extended Lotka–Volterra equation. Since the convergence acceleration algorithm from the lattice Boussinesq equation is a particular case of the multistep ϵ-algorithm, we have arrived at a generalization of this algorithm. Numerical experiments on the new algorithm are presented. (b) In [Zhang, Hu, and Tam 2015], a new integrable discretization of the nonlinear Schrodinger (NLS) equation is presented by discretizing the time variable. The new discrete system converges to the NLS when we take a standard limit and has the same scattering operator as the original NLS. Hence both the new system and the NLS possess the same set of infinite conservation quantities. By applying the Fourier pseudo-spectral method to the space variable, we calculate the first five conservation quantities at different times. The numerical results indeed verify the conservation properties. (c) In [Zhang, Chang, Hu, Hu, and Tam 2015], we present a systematic procedure to derive discrete analogues of integrable PDEs via Hirota’s bilinear method. This approach is based on the compatibility between an integrable system and its Bäcklund transformation. We apply this procedure to several equations, including the extended Korteweg-de-Vries (KdV) equation, extended Kadomtsev-Petviashvili (KP) equation, extended Boussinesq equation, extended Sawada-Kotera (SK) equation, and extended Ito equation, and obtain their associated semi-discrete analogues. In the continuum limit, these systems converge to their corresponding smooth equations. For these new integrable systems, their Bäcklund transformations and Lax pairs are derived. (d) In [Chang, Chen, Hu, and Tam 2015], we derive the discrete hungry quotient-difference (dhQD) algorithm and a system related to the QD-type discrete hungry Lotka–Volterra (QD-type dhLV) system, together with their Lax pairs. These two known equations are extensions of the QD algorithm. When applied to a higher analogue of the discrete-time Toda (HADT) equation and the quotient–quotient-difference (QQD) scheme proposed by Spicer, Nijhoff and van der Kamp, two extended systems are constructed. We call these systems the hungry forms of the higher analogue discrete-time Toda (hHADT) equation and the quotient-quotient-difference (hQQD) scheme, respectively. In addition, the corresponding Lax pairs are provided.

202512.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
202512.value: (Continuation from Section 6.1 due to insufficient space) (e) In [Zhang and Tam 2014], with the help of some reductions of the self-dual Yang Mills (sdYM) equations, we introduce a Lax pair whose compatibility condition leads to a set of (2 + 1)-dimensional equations. Its first reduction gives rise to a generalized variable-coefficient Burgers equation with a forced term. Furthermore, the Burgers equation again reduces to a forced Burgers equation with constant coefficients, the standard Burgers equation, the heat equation, the Fisher equation, and the Huxley equation, respectively. The second reduction generates a few new (2 + 1)-dimensional nonlinear integrable systems, and in particular, a kind of (2 + 1)-dimensional integrable couplings of a new (2 + 1)-dimensional integrable nonlinear equation. (Section 6.2): There still exists potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action. More concretely, we have: (a) Some other new discretizations for more integrable systems are expected to be obtained, say the Boussinesq equation. (b) Our current research is mainly concerned with the link between some special bi-orthogonal polynomials and some discrete integrable systems. There is great potential for further developing our research to establish connection between some skew orthogonal polynomials and some new discrete integrable systems.

202512.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
202512.value: The modern history of integrable systems begins with the numerical discovery of solitons for the Korteweg–de Vries equation. The importance of solitons stems from the fact that they exhibit particle-type interactions, and they also characterize the long term asymptotic behavior of the solution. Integrable systems provide the key to our understanding of these remarkable interactions. They appear in different areas of physics, both in the classical and quantum domains. The theory of integrable systems has been an active area of mathematics for the past forty years. Different aspects of the subject have fundamental relations with mechanics, applied mathematics, algebraic structures, theoretical physics, analysis, geometry, and so on. The study of the connections and their interplays among extrapolation methods, integrable systems and orthogonal polynomials will be very profitable to the fields of integrable systems and numerical analysis. The research on the algebraic structures of explicit solutions for discrete integrable systems in terms of determinants, quasideterminants, and pfaffians serves as a starting point for the derivation and design of a number of new integrable numerical algorithms whose interest is rapidly growing among workers in the field.

To evaluate the performance of new delivery systems in-vitro.
