203012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
203012.value: Cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs), the cyclin regulatory subunits and their natural inhibitors, the CDKIs, are central to cell cycle regulation; their functions are commonly altered in tumor cells. It has been shown that CDK’s isoform and substrate-selective inhibition can be achieved and they can potently inhibit CDK2/Cyclin A and CDK4/Cyclin D1 kinase activity. The transducible form of Cyclin groove inhibitor (CGI) peptides have also been shown to induce cell cycle arrest and selective apoptosis in tumor cells in vitro. However CGI is not practical enough as clinical anti-tumor agents. The major drawbacks of the CGI as anti-tumor agent in vitro/in vivo are the cell internalization, its sensitivity to enzymes in vivo and effectiveness monitoring/evaluate via in-direct screening. The real-time evaluation of the anti-cancer effectiveness and in vitro/in vivo imaging for cyclin A/D specific peptides is still very difficult. Recent research on CGI has been carried out to detect the level of cyclin in solution samples and as in vitro imaging probes via conjugation with organic fluorophores. Although, they are sensitie enough for decent prognosis, these chemosensors have broad emission bands, short luminescence lifetime (~ns) and low signal-to-noise ratio. Lanthanide ions have large Stokes shifts, sharper fingerprint emission peaks and longer emission lifetimes (~ms) and therefore could overcome the above problems. Furthermore, our blueprint also includes cyclin-specific lanthanide complexes with particular peptides and chromophores that could be excited in the near infra-red region via multi-photon excitation. Our research team has the knowledge on lanthanide coordination chemistry, spectroscopy, peptide chemistry and in vitro biological applications, which are proved by our previous publications on responsive luminescent lanthanide materials towards various biological tasks in solution/in-vitro. To further support our work, we have performed several proof-of-concept experiments to consolidate our proposal: 1) synthesis of a cyclin A-specific europium complex with tailor made synthetic peptides that could be excited linearly and by two-photon to give responsive fingerprint europium emission; 2) improved rate of cellular uptake; and 3) photocleavage linker for the release of the peptide in solution via suitable excitation. This proposal could be a big step forward in developing a new generation of lanthanide complexes conjugated with responsive chromophore and cyclin specific peptide as dual probes – imaging and anti-tumors. It is hoped that success in research could also lead to success in practical usage. 细胞周期蛋白激酶（CDKs），细胞周期蛋白调节亚基，以及其天然的抑制剂（CDKIs）是细胞周期调控的核心，它们的功能往往在肿瘤细胞中被改变。研究证实周期蛋白激酶的异构体和底物选择性抑制可以有效的抑制细胞周期蛋白激酶2(4)/细胞周期蛋白A(D)的激酶活性。但是细胞周期蛋白槽抑制剂作为临床应用的抗肿瘤抑制剂还不够现实。近期的研究通过在周期蛋白槽抑制剂上连接有机荧光团来检测细胞周期的的水平，并将其作为体外成像的探针。尽管其具有足够的预制灵敏度，但这些化学响应器的发光带较宽，放光时间较短（纳秒级），信噪比较低。稀土离子有大的斯托克斯位移，窄的指纹发射峰以及较长的发光时间（微秒级）等特点，应此引入稀土离子可以解决以上那些问题。此外我们的计划中也包括有特定多肽和发色团的细胞周期蛋白特异性的稀土配合物，其可以由近红外光通过多光子激发。这一研究提议将是在开发新一代的具有生物成像和抗肿瘤双重作用稀土配合物探针中迈出的一大步。

203012.label: Realisation of objectives
203012.value: For objective 1, more than fifteen biocompatible lanthanide complexes/materials have been synthesized and visualized by a non-toxic excitation wavelength by two or multi-photon absorption (near-infrared excitation) and conjugated with cancer targeting (Cyclin A/D) specific peptides (P1: -GAKRRLIF-NH2; P2: -GGAKRRLIF-NH2; P3: -Hex- GAKRRLIF-NH2). For objective 2, five lanthanide complexes have been synthesized and they show strong two-photon absorption cross section (> 30GM, excitation at 750 nm) in aqueous solution and gave responsive lanthanide emission upon binding with our proposed anti-cancer regulators - Cyclin A and Cyclin D. The responsive two photon absorption cross-section of cyclen based europium (Eu) complex Eu–L2–P3 (Dalton Transactions, 42 (2013), 13495-13501) is around 86 GM upon binding with Cyclin A. (The two photon absorption cross section of Eu–L2–P3 in water is 32 GM, GM = 10−50 cm4 s per photon per molecule, excitation at 750 nm). We confirmed that Eu–L2–P3 is suitable for two photon in vitro imaging. Multi/two-photon confocal laser scanning microscopy oﬀers excellent resolution for three-dimensional images of fluorescent labeled live samples with specific excitation in the micrometer range. Upon two-photon excitation, simultaneous absorption of the two infrared photons that are specific to the fluorescent molecules used as specific labels towards biological structures, organelles, and molecules results in emission in the visible region for image construction. Eu–L2–P3 has also shown responsive europium emission in vitro by the two-photon excitation in two photon confocal microscopy upon binding with Cyclin A. The selectivity of Eu–L2–P3 for Cyclin A has been confirmed with numerous positive and negative control experiments. For objective 3, in this project, we have investigated the energy transfer mechanisms between the lanthanide ions, the proposed chromophores and the tagged proteins (Cyclin A/D), in order to achieve the best sensitizing effect when applied in in vitro imaging. For example, one europium complex have shown specific binding with cell cycle regulator - Cyclin A (Eu–L2–P3 in Dalton Transactions, 42 (2013), 13495-13501). Eu–L2–P3 did not show significant variation (only intensity increased proportionally) between the 5D0 → 7F1 (magnetic dipole) and 7F2 (electronic dipole) transitions, indicating that the complex Eu–L2–P3 would bind to cyclin A, without considerable change to the antenna. Despite this, the “long range eﬀect” can be observed via the 5D0 → 7F4 transitions; in contrast, the 7F4 oscillator strength seems to be related to changes that do not aﬀect the direct surroundings of the Eu ion but only bulk properties of the medium after the Cyclin(s) bind with our complexes. For objective 4, the in vitro and even ex vivo studies (imaging and anticancer effects) of the synthesized lanthanide complexes/nanomaterials in objectives 2 and 3 have been done with several cancer cell lines. One nanomaterials and two water-soluble europium complexes showed selective anticancer effect. The IC50 value (cytotoxicity assay) of the reported complexes/nanomaterials in normal cells, such as MRC-5 is 0.5 mM, but it is 0.001mM in cancer cells, such as HeLa (Dalton Transactions, 42 (2013), 13495-13501; Journal of Materials Chemistry B, 2 (2014) 84-91; Chemical Communications, (2015) 14022-14025).

203012.label: Major findings and research outcome
203012.value: 1. Six water-soluble europium complexes (Eu–L1–Pn and Eu–L2–Pn, n = 1, 2 and 3) with one antenna chromophore, two diﬀerent linkers (L1 and L2) and three proposed cyclin A speciﬁc peptides (P1: -GAKRRLIF-NH2; P2: -GGAKRRLIF-NH2; P3: -Hex- GAKRRLIF-NH2) have been synthesized. As imaging agents, complexes with peptides P3: -Hex-GAKRRLIF-NH2 showed high selectivity to cyclin A in numerous cancer cells. When it comes to responsive optical signal changes, complex Eu–L2– P3 exhibited a threefold emission enhancement upon binding with cyclin A (100 nM cyclin A, ϕ = 8% to 21%, log KB = 5.83, detection limit = 5 nM), and this could be initiated by the shortened distance between the antenna and the lanthanide after they bind/get into cyclin A. It is promising that our compounds (especially compound Eu–L2–P3) could serve as the template for structure-guided eﬀorts to develop potential imaging therapeutics on the basis of selective imaging of CDK2/cyclin A activity. (Dalton Transactions, 42 (2013), 13495-13501) 2. Up-conversion luminescent lanthanide nanoparticles (NaGdF4:Yb3+, Er3+-P1, ~70 nm, P1 = GFLRRKAS-NH2) have been synthesized with tailor-made peptide for in-vitro detection and inhibition of cyclin D activities. They demonstrate real-time signalling with upconverted emissions (NaGdF4:Yb3+, Er3+) under NIR excitation, significantly inducing cell deaths by the interruption of cell mitosis after specifically binding to the cyclin D groove in-vitro. (Journal of Materials Chemistry B, 2 (2014) 84-91) 3. A water-soluble photo-responsive anti-cancer bioprobe, PtEuL, based on a cisplatin-linked europium-cyclen complex has been designed and synthesized for controlled cisplatin release by linear and two-photon induced photocleavage in water/in vitro with turn-on and long-lived europium emission as responsive tracable signals. (Chemical Communications, (2015) 14022-14025) 4. A water-soluble and emissive Eu-complex (EuL1) bearing a DO3A(Eu3+)–pyridine–aza-crown motif has been prepared and its Cu2+ complex has been demonstrated to be a smart luminescence “off-on” gate for H2S detection (as potential cell regulator) in water with a nanomolar detection limit (60 nM). EuL1 binds to Cu2+ ion selectively (KB = 1.2 x 105 M-1) inducing a 17-fold of luminescence quenching and forming a 1:1 stoichiometric complex (EuL1-Cu2+), which responses to H2S selectively with restoration of the original Eu emission of EuL1 followed by a further 40-fold luminescence enchantment, forming a 1:1 stoichiometric complex (EuL1-Na2S, KB = 1.5 x 104 M-1). Without Cu2+ ion, EuL1 showed a non-specific binding towards H2S with only 5-fold luminescence enchantment. (Chemical Science, 7 (2016) 2151-2156)

203012.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
203012.value: With a range of specific features towards cyclin A/Cyclin D (high selectivity, strong binding, low detection limit and threefold responsive emission quantum yield enhancement) and the unique photophysical properties of lanthanide (long emissive lifetime and fingerprint in vitro emission bands), our findings (lanthanide complexes) can be applied as a direct, live, time-resolved imaging agent for cyclin A/Cyclin D in biological applications, for example as anti-cancer agents. It is believed that our comprehensive study in this project could definitely be a big step forward in developing a new generation of lanthanide complexes conjugated with responsive chromophores and cyclin-specific peptides as a new generation cyclin A/D-specific imaging probes. It is hoped that success in this research could pave way for success in practical usage and cast new light on the future development and application of lanthanide cell-penetrating peptides.

203012.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
203012.value: Cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs, i.e. Cyclin A/D), the cyclin regulatory subunits, and their natural inhibitors, the CDKIs, are central to cell cycle regulation; their functions are commonly altered in tumor cells. The amount of Cyclin A/D in cancer cells is always very large whereas in normal cells, the concentration of Cyclin A/D is very low; therefore, interfering with the binding between CDK and Cyclins can inhibit the growth of cancer cells. In this project, we made some lanthanide-based complexes and nanomaterials conjugated with Cyclin A/D-specific peptides and evaluated their photophysical properties, cellular uptake efficiencies and their selective inhibition effects between cancer and normal cells. The results clearly indicate that the materials are suitable for imaging and anti-cancer treatments. By further creating a responsive fluorescent change, our complexes/nanomaterials will kick-start a new generation of smart and selective chemotherapeutic agents with capable of performing imaging and inhibiting the growth of cancer cells.

203112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
203112.value: Many fluorescent dyes, such as fluorescein and cyanine dyes, are well known markers for locating various organelles, thus enabling many in-vitro/in-vivo molecular processes to be monitored. However, bioimaging using these organic fluorescent dyes often suffers from the problem of having significant background noise, which are caused by autofluorescence of the biological samples, scattered light from solid substrates, and the luminescence from the optical components, even via two-photon excitation. To solve this problem, increasing attention has been focused on time-resolved fluorescence technique using lanthanide complexes as fluorescence labels. Time-resolved spectroscopy can determine the excited lifetimes which provide insight of the excited dynamics and the decay pathways of the excited chromophore/materials. With this technique, it is possible, for example, to extract information based on differences in their fluorescence lifetime. The nano-second autofluorescecne can be eliminated via time gated system. Therefore, clean and clear in-vitro images can be obtained by the milli/micro-second imaging agents. The main objective of the research proposed herein is to develop new organic-lanthanide complexes as novel time-resolved imaging luminescent bioprobes which can be excited and emit in the “tissue-transparent” near-infrared region. These new complexes can be used in in-vitro organelles/signaling pathway imaging and can be further developed into in-situ sensing method for targeting disease, i.e. gastric adenocarcinoma. Recently, we have demonstrated that ytterbium(III) porphyinato complex, through Yb(III) 5F5/2  5F7/2 transitions, can serve as near-infrared (NIR) emissive probe in solution/in-vitro. To support this proposed work, we have performed the following proof-of-concept experiments: (1) we have successfully synthesized water-soluble porphyrin-based ytterbium(III)/neodymium(III) complexes that could be excited by one- (linear) and two-photon to give responsive emission with high quantum efficiency; and (2) we have observed an enhancement of neodymium(III) emission via linear/two-photon excitation upon binding to phosphatidylserine derivatives. With these preliminary results and the development of NIR to NIR confocal microscope in our sister institutions, we are poised to develop a new generation of time-resolved in-vitro imaging probes that are highly sensitive, selective and could give a remarkable emission enhancement to reveal concentrations of phosphatidylserine derivatives for early diagnosis of cancer and also further extend our finding as bio-conjugation to label particular antibodies for biomedical applications. This proposal could be a big step forward in developing much higher resolution of in-vitro/in-vivo imaging probes for practical biological applications. 目前,螢光素類和花菁染料等螢光染料已被廣泛應用於細胞器的螢光標記,和體內或體外細胞內分子事件的即時觀測和動態研究。然而大多數有機螢光染料在用於生物成像時,其樣品基體和一些雜質在此區域也會有吸收或螢光,再加上光散射和光學器件本身螢光的影響往往會產生較為嚴重的背景干擾,即使採用雙光子激發誘導螢光成像技術,也很難有效避免這類缺陷。 為了解決這個科學難題,人們開始關注具有獨特光學性質的稀土配合物類螢光探針,利用先進的時間分辨螢光光譜技術進行成像研究。時間分辨光譜一種能觀察物理和化學的瞬態過程並能分辨其時間的光譜,應用這個技術,可以根據不同的螢光壽命進行一些資訊的提取和分辨,其中螢光壽命在納秒級別自發螢光可以通過時間視窗進行有效消除,而螢光壽命在微秒或毫秒級別的螢光物質可以進行高清晰度的體外成像。 因此,我們這項研究計畫的主要目標是開發系列稀土配合物螢光探針,通過近紅外範圍波長範圍的雙光子激發誘導產生能穿透深層組織的近紅外螢光,並利用時間分辨光譜進行成像。這些新型稀土配合物可用於體外細胞器成像,和標記比如胃腺癌組織。最近我們研究發現,稀土卟啉配合物中稀土離子5F5/2→5F7/2激發態到基態衰减產生近紅外螢光,從而應用於體外近紅外螢光成像。為了進一步論證研究計畫的可行性,我們初步成功合成水溶性稀土卟啉配合物,充分證明無論通過單光子還是雙光子都能激發誘導高量子效率的近紅外螢光,另外當三價釹卟啉能和磷脂醯絲氨酸衍生物結合,導致三價釹離子近紅外光暈顯著增強。利用兄弟院校近紅外共聚焦顯微鏡,初步研究結果激勵我們致力於開發新一代高靈敏性和高選擇性的螢光探針並應用於時間分辨光譜成像研究；另外由於三價釹卟啉的近紅外螢光強度和磷脂醯絲氨酸衍生物的濃度相關,從而可用於癌症的早期診;同時我們將進一步將卟啉配合物和特定標記抗體耦合,真正用於生物醫藥用途。我們研究計畫的成功進行將為開發具有真正應用價值的高解析度的體外或體內螢光探針作出重要貢獻。

203112.label: Realisation of objectives
203112.value: For objective 1, twenty porphyrin-based lanthanide complexes have been synthesized and well-characterized. All these lanthanide complexes have shown high linear emission quantum yields and also strong two photon absorption cross sections (>50GM) in the aqueous solution. For objective 2, we have chosen 10 porphyrin-lanthanide (Yb/Nd/Er/Gd) conjugates and their absorption and emission spectra were measured. A significantly higher 1O2 quantum yield was observed for the gadolinium-base porphyrin conjugates compared to their same structures with Yb/Nd/Er(III) counterparts. However, the cell uptake rate of these conjugates with similar molecular weight and charge is not influenced by the change of lanthanide(s) in porphyrin. From objectives 1 and 2, we have been chosen a potentially theranostic gadolinium complex - Gd-N. In objective 3, Gd-N have great potential of serving as an anti-cancer torpedo boat equipped with impressive visible-to-NIR emission for imaging, discriminating radar for tumor cell selectivity, and, above all, powerful 1O2 generation. Through a string of in vitro and in vivo studies, we believe that the effectiveness and advantages of our Gd-N had adequately corroborated that our Gd-N does lend itself to being a potential next-generation smart dual-functional PDT agent. In objective 4, reactive oxygen species (ROS) are consistently produced and eliminated in living cells, which are closely related to cell proliferation and death, and even the pathological situations like inflammation, carcinogenesis and metastasis. Elevating or reducing ROS can be used as a strategy towards cancer therapy. Normally, photodynamic therapy makes use of exogenous but light controllable ROS production agent to realize clinical application. Many kinds of PDT agents have been designed and synthesized for the potential uses of different purposes, while most of them are aimed at cancer therapy. We have previously developed a novel gadolinium-based PDT agent Gd-N, which can sufficiently produce ROS to kill cancer cell . Then we used Gd-N as a model molecule to make oxidative stress in IGROV1 cells that are labeled with isotopic amino acids for quantitative proteomic analysis. We discovered that lysosome was the most affected organelle along with down regulation of a majority of acid hydrolyses as well as proton pump ATP6V/TCIRG1 complex localized on lysosomal membrane. Lysosome is an important organelle for cell homeostasis and removal of misfolded proteins or damaged organelles. From the above results, we can propose that when serious damage is done to lysosome, cells will take two strategies to eliminate the damage, a) shut down and down regulation of proton pump to relieve the acidic environment of lysosomal lumen, and b) degradation of lysosomal hydrolyses. Both of the two methods are aimed at avoiding the destructive activities of hydrolyses to other cell structures. Besides, we also observed dysregulated phosphorylation of 106 proteins and 1050 oxidized proteins. Through kinase substrate mapping and conserved sequence pattern analysis, we founded MAPK3 and CaMKIIalpha are the kinases respectively in charge of down or up regulation of proteins upon oxidative stress. Furthermore, intrinsic pathway and regulation pattern for cellular oxidative stress may be adopted to answering instant ROS crisis like PDT treatment, or age related unsatisfied clearance of oxidative stress in neuron tissues, for example, the Parkinson disease. Given that we surprisingly discovered that the ROS induced oxidized proteins were most enriched in Parkinson disease related pathway, we hope these results can be useful hints for both future neurodegenerative diseases research and PDT agent development.

203112.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
203112.value: The PI has already designed several photodynamic therapy agents which have been successfully applied in different subcellular localization in various cancer cells. However, the selectivity of cancer and normal cells is one of the major limitations. In the long term, we envision the use of these synthesized in vitro imaging PDT drugs incorporated with different vectors to enhance their target specificity in clinical practice. We would like to further develop several lanthanide complexes systematically as fast, responsive biomedical probes for targeting and monitoring diseases, in addition to delivering the drug in vitro, in-situ and in vivo with a combination of biochemical, molecular and structural approaches.

203112.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
203112.value: In this work, we have been demonstrated a new modality of PDT through the design of true dual-functional PDT and imaging agents which specifically target cancer cells. In this design, the PDT drug can be localized specifically on the anionic cell membrane of cancer cells and its laser-excited photoemission signal can be monitored without triggering the phototoxic generation of ROS to the tissues. Nonetheless, this project reaffirms the effects of linker on cells, which is an important design parameter for the new generation of PDT agents based on porphyrin-metal complex conjugates. This treatment modality opens up a new direction in the development of “precision medicine”. Our work in this project here can be promising and applicable for the development of long-term live cancer cell tracking and imaging, as well as modern practical photodynamic therapy.

203212.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
203212.value: Owing to the numerous advantages of organic semiconductors for device applications including low cost, lightweight, ease of fabrication and feasibility for flexible devices, organic optoelectronics and photonics have developed rapidly in the past decades. Organic solar cells showing promising potential as alternative inexpensive and renewable energy sources have also received considerable attention from both academia and industry. In addition, the multiphoton absorbing materials offer many advantages for the technological applications of biological imaging and sensing, frequency up-converted lasing, high capacity data storage, photodynamic therapy, as well as three-dimensional microfabrication. As part of broad program in developing efficient and stable new functional materials for optoelectronic and electronic applications, we propose to develop novel fused aromatic derived low-bandgap polymeric systems with high absorptivity and charges carrier mobility for solution-processable, high-efficiency heterojunction photovoltaic devices as well as to design and synthesize novel series of highly extended and coplanar ladder-type π-conjugated oligomers with high fluorescence quantum yields and large multiphoton absorption cross-sections for multiphoton excited fluorescence and lasing applications. 有機半導體材料在過去數十年裡得到了快速發展，這主要歸功於其優點眾多，包括製造成本低，材料重量輕，製備工藝簡單，有望應用在柔性可捲曲系統中。其中，有機太陽能電池作為一種有良好前景的廉價可再生能源，引起了學術界及工業界的極大興趣。此外，多光子吸收材料在生物成像和傳感，頻率上轉換激射，大容量數據存儲，光動力學治療及三維微結構加工等技術應用方面顯現出了很大優勢，亦引起了廣泛關注。作為眾多光電子材料研發項目之一，我們建議：開發具有吸光性好，電荷遷移率高的新型稠環芳烴類低能隙聚合物，用於可溶劑處理、光電轉換率高的太陽能電池器件；同時設計合成量子產率高，多光子吸收強，分子延展性和共面性俱佳的新型梯形共軛低聚物，用於多光子激發熒光和激光領域。

203212.label: Realisation of objectives
203212.value: (1) A novel series of heteroatom–substituted naphthodithiophene and dithienylbenzothiadiazole alternating copolymers namely, PNTP, PNBO, PNfTB, and PNffTB were designed and synthesized in which heteroatom including fluorine, oxygen or nitrogen was incorporated into electron-deficient benzothiadiazole units of the resulting copolymers. The bulk heterojunction (BHJ) OSCs fabricated from the blend of heteroatom–substituted copolymer and PC71BM using diiodooctane as a solvent additive with ZnO/Al as a double interlayer in an inverted device structure afforded power conversion efficiency up to 5.05%. In addition, the solution-processed bottom gate bottom contact based OFETs fabricated from PNfTB exhibited an enhanced hole mobility of 0.14 cm2 v‒1s‒1 with an on/off current ratio of 107. Our results suggested that incorporation of heteroatoms into the donor-acceptor polymer backbone would be a useful strategy to enhance the functional properties for applications in OSCs and OFETs. Two novel naphthodithienothiophene-isoindigo copolymers, P1 and P2 were designed, synthesized and their photovoltaic and field-effect properties were also investigated. The NDTT-based copolymers exhibit broad absorption profiles throughout the visible spectrum up to ca. 800 nm. Polymer-fullerene bulk heterojunction solar cells that fabricated from a blend of P2/PC71BM using diiodooctane as a solvent additive, afforded the highest power conversion efficiency of 3.54%. Solution-processed polymer field-effect transistors based on P1 with bottom-gate bottom-contact geometry exhibited promising hole mobilities of 0.070 cm2 V-1 s-1. Novel series of air-stable and highly extended fluorinated naphtho[2,1-b:3,4-b’]-bis-[1]- benzothiophenes derivatives, NBBTF-n (n = 8, 10, and 12) as well as naphtho[2,1-b:3,4-b']- bisthieno-[3,2-b][1]- benzothiophene derivatives, NBTBT-n (n = 6, 8, 10, and 12) and NBTBTF-10 were developed. The influence of various alkoxy-side groups including straight chain with different chain length and branched chain on the FET device performance were also investigated. The OFET devices based on NBTBT-10 fabricated by vacuum deposition exhibited the best performance with a hole mobility of 0.25 cm2/Vs. In addition, fluorinated naphtho[2,1-b:3,4-b']bisthieno[3,2-b][1]- benzothiophene, NBTBTF-10 showed good p-type transistor behavior with a hole mobility of 0.24 cm2/Vs which was achieved at a lower annealing temperature of 140 °C, suggesting the important contribution of the dipole-dipole interactions induced by the fluorine atoms in the molecular packing. The OFET devices based on annealed NBBTF-10 films exhibit superior hole transport with mobility up to 0.35 cm2 V-1 s-1 to that of NBBT-10. Both, NBBTF and NBTBT frameworks show promise as a useful building block to construct organic semiconductors for high performance organic electronics. Novel benzodithieno[3, 2-b]thiophene (BDTT) derivatives bearing various alkoxy-side chains were synthesized and characterized. Organic thin film transistors (OTFTs) based on these compounds were fabricated, in which BDTT-4 based as-fabricated devices exhibit remarkably high-performance with a carrier mobility up to 2.6 cm2 V‒1 s‒1 and a current on/off ratio over 108, which is the highest value of acenedi(thieno)thiophenes-based OTFT devices so far. Naphthodithiophene is used for the first time as the π-spacer for metal-free organic dyes in dye-sensitized solar cells (DSSCs). Four new donor–(π-spacer)–acceptor organic dyes using triarylamine or carbazole as the electron-donating group, cyanoacrylic acid as the electron-withdrawing anchoring moiety, and naphtho[2,1-b:3,4-b’]dithiophene as the linker were synthesized. DSSCs based on these dyes as photosensitizers had efficiencies ranging from 3.98% to 4.60%. The highest efficiency was 4.60 % with a Jsc of 10.8 mA cm-2, a Voc of 657 mV, and a fill factor of 64.0% under 100 mW AM 1.5 irradiation. The effects of the recombination processes at the TiO2 surface and FTO substrate in a DSSC based on I-/I3- electrolyte by selective surface passivation using silane and/or TiO2 compact layer (c-TiO2) have been investigated. At high light intensity, the recombination reaction at the TiO2 surface is dominant. In this case, silane passivation of the TiO2 surface can suppress recombination significantly, while the c-TiO2 layer makes little contribution to the reduction of the recombination. At low illumination intensity, the recombination at FTO becomes significant, and this recombination can be reduced by applying a c-TiO2 layer. (2) Novel series of triarylamine-based star-shaped ladder-type ter(p-phenylene)s with various electron-donating or electron-withdrawing endcaps have been synthesized which exhibit a high fluorescence quantum yield and remarkably large multiphoton absorption properties. Although these star-shaped oligomers only consist of short π-conjugated ter(p-phenylene) units, they have been found to show extremely large 3PA cross-section (σmax) up to 3.35 × 10-76 cm6s2 from N(TL)-Ph(3)-TAZ which is comparable to the highest intrinsic σ3 values reported previously. In addition, N(TL)-Ph(3)-NPh exhibits excellent nonlinearity−transparency trade-off with 2PA cross-section (σ2) of 2579 GM emitting at 454 nm which is the highest σ2 for a blue emissive molecule reported so far. Three new biocompatible carbazole-based cyanine fluorophores exhibiting highly selective subcellular localization property including mitochondria and lysosomes with a record high two-photon cross-section of 5130 GM at 910 nm for VPBN have been developed as highly active two-photon fluorescence probes for high contrast and brightness live cells imaging. A novel two-photon active, biocompatible, and macrophage cell-membrane permeable carbazole-based cyanine fluorophore for detection of three biologically important ROS namely, .OH, O2− and OCl− in solution has been developed. A highly RNA-selective and two-photon active fluorescent light-up probe for high contrast and brightness TPEF images of rRNA in nucleolus of live cells based on indole-based cyanine has been developed. A novel biocompatible and photostable ratiometric mitochondrial cysteine (Cys)-selective two-photon fluorescence probe based on merocyanine has been developed. The probe has been successfully applied to ratiometrically image and detect mitochondrial Cys in live cells and intact tissues down to a depth of 150 μm by two-photon fluorescence microscopy.

203212.label: Major findings and research outcome
203212.value: Several novel fused aromatic π-conjugated molecules/oligomers including high hole-transporting naphthodithiophene, naphthobisbenzothiophene, naphthobisthienobenzothiophene, and benzodithienothiophene as well as highly fluorescent ladder-type p-oligophenylene have been developed as a building block for the synthesis of low-bandgap donor-acceptor molecules/materials as well as highly extended π-conjugated oligomers for multiphoton absorbing materials, respectively. As a results, two novel series of low-bandgap donor-acceptor polymers for the bulk heterojunction (BHJ) photovoltaic cells and a novel series of dye-sensitized solar cells have been developed and investigated. Several novel highly active multiphoton absorbing molecules and probes for multiphoton excited emission and multiphoton excited fluorescence bioimaging have also been developed and investigated.

203212.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
203212.value: Elaborating further with a similar design approach, more extended thioacene-based π-conjugated molecules can be synthesized and developed as electron-rich building blocks for the construction of novel low-bandgap photovoltaic materials.

203212.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
203212.value: We have developed several novel fused aromatic π-conjugated moieties/units including high hole- transporting naphthodithiophene, naphthobisbenzothiophene naphthobisthienobenzothiophene, and benzodithienothiophene as well as highly fluorescent ladder-type p-oligophenylene for the construction and development of low-bandgap donor-acceptor molecules/materials for photovoltaic applications as well as highly extended π-conjugated oligomers for efficient multiphoton excited fluorescence applications, respectively. Our findings demonstrated that the newly developed fused thiophene-based π-conjugated units/molecules are useful high hole-carrier transporting building blocks to construct organic donor-acceptor type photovoltaic materials for high-efficiency solar cell applications. It has also been showed that the ladder-type p-oligophenylene structural unit is highly efficient for an enhancement of multiphoton absorption, in particular three-photon absorption properties which can offer an excellent nonlinearity-transparency trade-off. Some of the novel photovoltaic materials developed shows potential for high-performance solar cell applications. In addition, some of the newly developed multiphoton excited fluorescence materials are found useful for practical bioimaging applications.

203312.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
203312.value: Modern technology depends on fast, reliable data processing and storage. Hard ferromagnetic (L1o-phase) FePt alloy nanoparticles (NPs) with extremely high magnetocrystalline anisotropy are considered to be one of the most promising candidates for the next generation of ultrahigh-density data storage systems. The question of how to generate ordered patterns of L1o-FePt NPs and how to transform the technology to the practical application is challenging. Among different types of patterning technology, traditional methods such as UV-photolithography only provide submicrometer resolution and electron-beam lithography is not suitable for the fabrication of ordered nanostructured arrays of magnetic NPs over large areas because of the high cost, complicated procedures and instruments, and the high demand of materials. Nanoimprint lithography (NIL) is a powerful and cost-effective technology for high-throughput patterning with high resolution. It can be used to imprint different kinds of polymers, allowing its wide application in information storage. Since NIL offers sub-5 nm patterning resolution over very large areas, it is indeed desirable for fabricating bit patterned media (BPM). Unlike traditional lithographic approaches, which achieve pattern definition through the use of photons or electrons, NIL relies on direct mechanical molding of the resist or functional materials and can therefore achieve resolution beyond the limitations set by light diffraction or beam scattering by the conventional techniques. Although nanoimprinting has been used with FePt continuous thin films recently, multiple processing steps are necessary for preparing the nanosized bits. It has been difficult to create BPM with FePt NPs by NIL because the mechanical rigidity of NPs does not allow them to transfer the negative pattern of the mask directly. In this proposal, a new series of soluble metallopolymers consisting of Fe and/or Pt atoms will be developed which combine the merits of both FePt NPs and NIL, thereby creating a ground-breaking method for the simple and rapid fabrication of BPM at very low cost using these metallopolymers as single-source precursors. This represents a novel study to adopt NIL to achieve the high-throughput nanopatterning of hard magnetic NPs. The work can be extended to other hard magnetic NPs such as CoPt, Co3Pt and SmCo5. Additionally, the use of low-cost, self-assembly approach involving functional bimetallic block-copolymers would also be adopted for the generation of nanopatterned magnetic metal alloy NPs with well-defined nanostructures. Such investigation provides a new avenue towards fabricating ultrahigh-density BPM for the next generation of magnetic recording technology and sparks new approach to data storage. 現代技術依賴於快速可靠的資料處理和存儲。硬磁（L10相）FePt合金納米粒子（NPs）具有極高的磁晶各向異性，被認為是下一代超高密度資料存儲體系中最具應用前景的材料之一。怎樣生成L10相FePt合金納米粒子有序陣列和怎樣將此技術轉移到實際應用中具有很大的挑戰性。在不同的陣列化技術中，傳統的方法如UV光刻只能提供微米級解析度，電子束光刻不適於磁性納米粒子有序納米結構陣列大規模製作，是因為該法的成本很高，程式複雜，儀器和材料的要求很高。納米壓印光刻（NIL）是一個很有力且成本有效的技術，適用于高產量陣列製作，而且解析度很高。它可用于壓印不同種類的聚合物，使得它在資訊存儲方面得到廣泛應用。由於NIL在大面積上可提供5nm以下的解析度，因此非常適用於製作位元元規則介質（BPM）。與傳統光刻不同，NIL不是使用光子或電子進行陣列定義，而是依賴於功能材料的機械壓印，因此可突破傳統技術中因光衍射或者束散射造成的限制。儘管納米壓印最近已經用於製作FePt薄膜，但製備納米點仍然需要多個處理步驟。 利用NIL直接將FePt NPs製備成BPM比較困難，這是因為納米粒子的機械剛性很難直接複製模具上的反樣結構。在本專案中，將合成一系列新穎的含Fe和/或Pt原子的可溶性金屬聚合物，把FePt NPs和NIL的優勢結合起來，以這些金屬聚合物為單一母體來源，建立一個獨創方式用於BPM的簡單快速低成本製作。這是一個利用NIL實現硬磁NPs高產量納米陣列化的新穎研究。該工作還可以延伸到其他硬磁NPs如CoPt，Co3Pt和SmCo5。另外，也可以利用功能性雙金屬嵌段共聚物的低成本自組裝去生成納米結構定義良好的磁性合金納米粒子陣列。這個調研將為製作超高密度BPM用於下一代磁記錄技術提供一個新的道路，引發資料存儲的新方式。

203312.label: Realisation of objectives
203312.value: The PI has recruited one Ph.D. student to work on the project and he graduated in 3 years. So far, the PI has secured 8 publications from this project (including 1 paper in Adv. Funct. Mater., 2 papers in J. Mater. Chem. C, 1 paper in Polym. Chem. and 1 paper in Nanoscale, etc.). The graduate student has received good training in several areas of modern science and technology in Hong Kong. A series of solution-processable mononuclear and binuclear metallopolymers were synthesized and characterized which can be used as polymer precursors to afford hard magnetic NPs (e.g. FePt, CoPt, PtGe, FePd, etc.) and other metal nanoparticles by pyrolysis. Two approaches were developed, one using a bimetallic polymer and the other using the polymer blends made up of two mononuclear precursors. The composition, magnetic properties and nanostructures of these nanoparticles were extensively studied. Their structure-property relationship was established. These molecular materials can be used as templates to make metal nanoparticles or metal alloy nanoparticles by a single-step pyrolysis. Soft nanoimprint lithography was applied on these polymer materials to fabricate nanoline and nanodot arrays of nanoparticles and the nanopatterns were characterized by atomic force and magnetic force microscopies. This forms the basis of fabricating perpendicular magnetic recording systems in the bit patterned media setting. These metallopolymer precursor approaches are thus promising for uses in ultrahigh-density data storage applications. As far as the GRF proposal is concerned, the PI considers that he has addressed in full all the issues relevant to the objectives concerned.

203312.label: Major findings and research outcome
203312.value: Hard ferromagnetic (L1o phase) FePt alloy nanoparticles (NPs) with extremely high magnetocrystalline anisotropy are considered to be one of the most promising candidates for the next generation of ultrahigh-density data storage system. The question of how to generate ordered patterns of L1o-FePt NPs and how to transform the technology for practical applications represents a key current challenge. The direct synthesis of L1o phase FePt NPs was reported for the first time by pyrolysis of Fe-containing and Pt-containing metallopolymer blend without post-annealing treatment. Rapid single-step fabrication of large-area nanodot arrays of L1o-ordered FePt NPs can be achieved by employing the metallopolymer blend as the precursor through the soft high-throughput nanoimprint lithography (NIL) method. Magnetic force microscopy (MFM) imaging of the nanodot pattern indicates that the patterned L1o phase FePt NPs are capable of exhibiting decent magnetic response, which suggests a great potential to be utilized directly in the fabrication of bit patterned media (BPM) for the next generation of magnetic recording technology. A dot array nanopattern of magnetization with the same periodicity as the dot array pattern in the corresponding atomic force microscope (AFM) image can be observed clearly. The magnetic property of the nanodot patterned L1oFePt NPs was characterized by vibrating sample magnetometer (VSM) and the coercivity of the dot array pattern of L1o-FePt NPs was close to 0.38 T at room temperature, which is suitable for practical application in data storage system, because information is easy to manipulate by an external magnetic field. The MFM images showed that the ferromagnetic properties of the patterns were all well preserved after annealing, indicating that NIL can effectively pattern FePt on silicon substrates at both micro- and nano-scales with the magnetic properties retained (papers 1 and 3). The influence of the pyrolysis temperature on the size and magnetic properties of the resulting FePt alloy NPs has been investigated (paper 4). The method is equally applicable to other non-conjugated copolymers with bimetallic segments in the side chains (paper 5). The work can be extended to other metal nanoparticles such as PtGe (paper 2), FeNi, FeCu (paper 6), CoPt (paper 7) and FePd (paper 8) NPs. In most cases, ferromagnetic nanolines and nanodots, useful for fabricating bit-patterned magnetic recording media, were successfully obtained from the polymer precursors followed by pyrolysis. It was shown that the size of the resultant NPs could be easily controlled by tuning the metal fraction in the polymer.

203312.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
203312.value: The following areas of research work can be further developed in the future: (1) Extension to other hard magnetic NPs such as SmCo5 with higher magnetocrystalline anisotropy. (2) Increase of the areal density of the bit patterned media by reducing the feature size of the stamp used for the nanoimprint patterning study.

The question of how to generate ordered patterns of L1o-FePt NPs and how to transform the technology to the application is challenging. Traditional methods such as UV-photolithography only provide submicrometer resolution and electron-beam lithography is not suitable for the fabrication of ordered nanostructured arrays of magnetic NPs over large areas because of the high cost, complicated procedures and instruments, and the high demand of materials. 203712.value: 求解凸优化问题的特制的临近点算法

203712.label: Project Objectives
203712.value: Algorithmically, by specifying customized proximal parameters we will develop efficient algorithms for some basic optimization models, such as convex minimization with linear constraints and the saddle-point problem. The goal is that these new algorithms should be fully structure-exploiting, easily implementable, numerically efficient and scalable. Theoretically, we will prove global convergence and estimate the convergence rate (or the worst-case complexity per iteration) for the new algorithms. In particular, a completely novel approach will be sought to derive their convergence rates in the ergodic sense, in a technique that can easily be extended to other related algorithms. For applications, we propose to use the new algorithms to solve many problems arising in areas such as image processing, machine learning, statistics and numerical linear algebra.

203712.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
203712.value: The proximal point algorithm (PPA) plays a fundamental theoretical and algorithmic role in Optimization. This project revisits the PPA to develop efficient PPA-based algorithms for some basic convex optimization models. Our philosophy of algorithmic design is to customize the proximal parameters (in metric form) in accordance with the model structures, and thus convert the classical PPA in abstract form into some customized algorithms in concrete form. Further, some advances in the PPA literature will be exploited to accelerate these customized PPAs. The splitting nature of these new algorithms makes it possible to take full advantage of the model structure, to yield easy subproblems with closed-form solutions. Numerically, we expect these customized algorithms to compete with or be even faster than some benchmark methods. The efficiency of these customized algorithms will be verified by application to problems arising in various areas. Theoretically, we will analyze their global convergence and estimate their rate of convergence. 临近点方法在最优化的理论与算法方面都起着十分重要的作用。本项目将对临近点方法进行重访，并针对凸优化中的一些基本模型设计有效的数值算法。我们算法设计的基本理念是根据模型的具体结构，对带有矩阵参数的临近点算法进行量身定制，从而将一般的抽象的临近点方法具体化。而且，现有临近点方法文献中的一些研究进展都可以用来加速这些特制的临近点算法。这些新算法的共同特点是都具有分裂算法的特点，其子问题也可以简单到具有显式解。模型的结构因而得以利用。 我们预期新算法在数值上可以媲美文献中的一些基准性算法，甚至可以比这些基准性算法更快。我们将应用这些新算法来求解一些具有实际应用背景的问题，从而验证这些算法的效率。理论上，我们将分析这些算法的收敛性和收敛速度。

203712.label: Major findings and research outcome
203712.value: As planned, in this project we focused on developing some efficient algorithms based on the classical proximal point algorithm for convex programming models. The main technique developed in this project was how to choose an effective proximal parameter in metric form so that the structure of a given model can be fully exploited in algorithmic design. A new idea of algorithmic design was thus proposed and several new algorithms were thus specified for some canonical convex minimization models and saddle point problems. These algorithms provide efficient solvers to a wide range of specific applications in other areas. Some interesting theoretical problems accompanied with the algorithmic design, such as the convergence rate analysis, were also addressed. These major findings provide useful algorithms and deeper theory to the study of proximal point algorithm, and some application areas as well. The more visible outcome of this project is ten research articles that are all published on renowned journals including several very top ones in the areas of optimization, machine learning, inverse problems and scientific computing.

203712.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
203712.value: The findings of this project can help us better understand the classical proximal point algorithm, broaden the applicable range of this algorithm, and potentially inspire more insightful research on this topic. In particular, some more efficient algorithms based on our proposed idea such as some preconditioned versions, have been witnessed in the community.

203712.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
203712.value: In this project, we studied the proximal point algorithm in the convex programming context and proposed the technique of customizing its proximal parameter by taking full advantage of the structure of a given model. A series of customized proximal point algorithms were thus proposed. Theoretically, we rigorously proved the convergence for all the proposed algorithms and further estimated their convergence rates. We also applied the proposed algorithms to a variety of applications in areas of machine learning, numerical linear algebra, image processing, etc. To the best of our knowledge, this was the first time to study how to customize the proximal point algorithm in according with the structure of a given model. The techniques developed in this project have been used by other peers in the community and we believe they will continue to receive some attentions in the coming years.

204112.label: Project Title(Chinese)
204112.value: 一些基于模型无关参数的估计方法

204112.label: Project Objectives
204112.value: We propose an asymptotic composite approach in terms of the asymptotic presentation of the initial estimators. To this end, we provide a unified framework to utilize model-independent parameter such as quantile, bandwidth or tuning parameter in the corresponding estimation methods, and vary their values to define a series of initial estimators. This method is very general and can be applied to various problems in parametric, semiparametric and nonparametric statistics. The theoretical behavior will be investigated. Model-independent transformation-based estimation shall be used to define least squares estimators that are robust against the distribution of error, computationally inexpensive and stable, with no need to solve many estimating equations and without nonparametric plug-in estimation for some semiparametric transformation models, This transforms the nonlinear estimating equations to simple linear least squares involving only one estimating equation. The generalized linear and nonparametric transformation linear models are the examples to consider. A proper model-independent transformation can be used so that the estimation will be free of the nonparametric model-dependent transformation in the transformation linear models. As a by-product, we can also define an estimator of error variance without using residuals. Our approaches are very different from those existing in the literature. We will also apply composite quantile regression to single-index models, and show its advantage over the existing quantile regression approach. to assess the efficacy of the proposed methods in practical applications, we shall conduct extensive simulation studies and analyze a number of real data problems. This research aims to advance novel methodologies to promote estimation accuracy of the powerful methods, with a deeper understanding. The impact of this research is expected to be widespread, significantly extend beyond the classical statistical methodologies.

204112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
204112.value: 在这个项目中，我们提出了两种新的方法来增进文献中一些普遍使用的方法的估计精度。这两种方法分别定义了模型参数的估计通过改变与模型无关的参数的取值。在一种方法中，针对与模型无关的参数的取值，构造一组初始估计，然后通过使用一个初始估计渐近的线性表示，建立模型独立的参数的值与初始估计之间的一个线性回归去得到一个最小二乘型综合估计。这个综合估计可用于去获得更准确的估计，如分位数回归模型：比现有的非参数回归估计更快的收敛速度；和变量选择中估计更小的偏差。由于对维预测向量问题，需要求解太多的估计方程。另一种方法可以处理经典方法-如非线性最小二乘-的计算负担和不稳定性。当应用到广义线性和半参数转型模式，第二种方法很简单实施，也是关于任何误差项的分布稳健的。在一个充分必要条件下，它可以将非线性，甚至半参数模型的变量选择问题转化为线性模型的问题。去增强的估计精确性，我们也可以通过一组与模型无关的变换，定义最小二乘型复合估计。 显然，这一研究项目研究了一些基本估计理论中存在的问题，并期望新的方法和 理论对统计科学有持久的影响。

204112.label: Realisation of objectives
204112.value: 1. We have proposed an asymptotic composite approach. The theoretical properties have been investigated and the numerical studies have been conducted to examine its performance in finite sample cases. 2. The numerical studies suggest its merit compared with existing methods when the number of covariates is large. 3. The composite quantile regression approach has been applied to the single-index model. The comparison has been conducted in finite sample scenarios. Thus, all the objectives have been achieved.

204412.label: Realisation of objectives
204412.value: 1. Thermal hydrosilylation was operated to create Si-CH=CH-(C6H4)-CH=CH-SiNW (SiNW: silicon nanowire) symmetric heterojunctions via Si-C bonds. First, thermal hydrosilylation was operated in a deoxygenated environment to graft HC≡C-(C6H4)-C≡CH (i.e., DEBZ) onto a medially-doped n-Si wafer via forming the Si-C contacts, to create the Si-CH=CH-(C6H4)-C≡CH semi-heterojunctions. Thermal hydrosilylation was optimised in terms of the molecular surface coverage and anti-oxidation of the DEBZ-grafted Si surface. Second, metal-assisted chemical etching (MACE) of a medially-doped n-Si wafer was operated to create SiNWs with atomic scale smooth surfaces. Third, the optimized thermal hydrosilylation was carried out to immobilize n-SiNWs on the free molecular ends of the semi-heterojunctions via forming the Si-C contacts, to create Si-CH=CH-(C6H4)-CH=CH-SiNW heterojunctions. It was planed to generate Si-HC=CH-(C6H4)n-CH=CH-SiNW (n=1, 2, 3). HC≡C-(C6H4)n-C≡CH (n=2, 3) isn’t commercially available. We collaborated with Dr. Shan Jin at Central China Normal University, to synthesize HC≡C-(C6H4)n-C≡CH (n=2, 3). Despite our enormous attempt, we failed to synthesize the molecules of interest with high purity (at least >98%), which is necessary to sufficiently prohibit electric signal of molecular contaminants from screening charge transport through the molecules of interest. In order to study charge transport through the molecular junctions as a function of molecular length to disclose the charge transport mechanism, alternatively, we studied the family of CH2=CH-(CH2)n-CH=CH2. Preliminarily, we utilized UV hydrosilylation and the two-step-grafting approach to generate Si-(CH2)n+4-SiNW symmetric heterojunctions via forming the Si-C contacts. The UV hydrosilylation is optimized to maximize the molecular surface coverage and anti-oxidation of the UV-treated Si surface. 2. Molecular grafting on Si is qualitatively and quantitatively characterized. First, an AFM tip was manipulated to mechanically verify the formation of the heterojunctions. When a SiNW is covalently attached to a semi-heterojunction via forming the Si-C contacts, one can hardly shift the grafted SiNW by an AFM tip. Second, ATR-FTIR and Raman spectroscopies were used to characterise the molecular grafting by detecting molecular vibrations, especially monitoring the stretching vibration of the Si-C=C contact at ~1600 cm-1. Third, XRD was used to quantitatively evaluate surface coverage of DEBZ on Si wafer, and to measure Si(2p)-O% to quantitatively study DEBZ-induced surface passivation against Si oxidation. Fourth, based on the quantitative evaluation of the molecular surface coverage and anti-oxidation, the thermal hydrosilylation was optimized by engineering hydrosilylation temperature and reaction duration. 3. A CAFM tip was manipulated to precisely locate a SiNW covalently attached to the molecular heterojunctions on a Si wafer, and a bias voltage in a range of 2 to (-2) V was applied across the heterojunctions to monitor electrical current (I) through the heterojunctions. To avoid Si oxidation, the CAFM-based electrical measurement was carried out in a nitrogen-protected chamber. A plot of (I/πdl) versus V (bias voltage) was made, where the located SiNW has a diameter of d and a length of l. Conductance of single-molecule heterojunctions (G) was calculated by d(I/πdl)/dV. To precisely evaluate G, first, the differential was calculated at small bias voltage since high bias voltage may significantly alter or even destroy the molecular/contact configurations in the heterojunctions. Second, contact resistance of (Si:CAFM bias source) and (SiNW:CAFM tip) should be minimized. The CAFM tips were fabricated by coating the AFM tips with Au via physical vapour deposition. Deposition rate, coating thickness and post-deposition annealing were engineered to optimize the adhesion of the coating metal layers to the AFM tip. To quantitatively evaluate the contact resistance, the Si-SiNW heterojunctions without molecules were created by spraying the as-generated SiNWs on H-terminated Si, and then the SiNW was located by a CAFM tip for monitoring the plot of I versus V. Under a sufficient force applied to the SiNW, the Si-SiNW heterojunctions perform as an Ohmic resistor, having a small electrical resistance that is equal to the contact resistance of the symmetric heterojunctions. Under the given force, multiple heterojunctionks were located and measured to statistically evaluate G. As a result, a CAFM-based approach was devised to reliably evaluate the charge transport through the molecular heterojunctions having the Si-C contacts. 4. A bias voltage was applied to the molecular heterojunctions via the CAFM tip in a range of 2 to (-2) V, and electric current (I) was monitored. The Si-(CH2)8-SiNW heterojunction performs as a positive diode, which is amplified with the force applied to the SiNW. On the contrary, the Si-CH=CH-(C6H4)-CH=CH-SiNW heterojunction isn’t a diode, but has a symmetric I-V curve. Since we failed to synthesize HC≡C-(C6H4)n-C≡CH (n=2, 3) with purity over 98% (as explained in the point 1), we could not study charge transport through the π-conjugated molecular junctions as a functional of molecular length. 5. On basis of the point 3 & 4, we successfully demonstrate the reliable study of SiNW-based molecular electronics without electrical and mechanical perturbation from the electrode-molecule contacts.

204412.label: Major findings and research outcome
204412.value: 1. MACE is optimized (2.4 mol/L HF, 0.02 mol/L AgNO3, room temperature, etching duration of ~30 min, and without solar illumination) to fabricate medially n-doped SiNWs with atomic scale surface smoothness. 2. Engineering the porosity of SiNWs is of fundamental importance, and a simple method is devised to reduce the porosity and reflection loss of SiNWs using a sticky tape. This work was published in Nanotechnology 26 (2015): 185501 (Refer to Part C, 8, No. 4), and was highlighted in Nanotechnology Lab Talk (http://nanotechweb.org/cws/article/lab/60901). 3. The fabrication of mesoporous SiNWs using MACE was reviewed and published in JSM Nanotechonology & Nanomedicine 3 (2015): 1035(Refer to Part C, 8, No. 2). 4. Thermal hydrosilylation of HC≡C-(C6H4)-C≡CH on SiNWs is optimized to create SiNW-CH=CH-(C6H4)-C≡CH semi-heterojunctions with compact molecular packing and excellent anti-oxidation of the SiNWs. The results were published in Sci. Lett. 4 (2015): 155 (Refer to Part C, 8, No. 1). Before the hydrosilylation of SiNWs, it is necessary to passivate SiNWs with H-termination. It is well known to use 40% NH4F to passivate Si wafers. However, 40% NH4F tends to etch SiNWs, and the etching rate varies with the doping level, surface crystalline orientation and porosity of SiNWs. The etching mechanism was studied and published in J. Phys. Chem. C 118 (2014): 17870 (Refer to Part C, 8, No. 3). 5. The optimized thermal hydrosilylation is utilized to create Si-CH=CH-(C6H4)-CH=CH-SiNW symmetric heterojunctions. 6. UV hydrosilylation is optimized to create the Si-(CH2)8-SiNW symmetric heterojunctions. The optimized hydrosilylation is operated under UV excitation of 254 nm, power density of ~100 μw/cm2 at the sample surface, deoxygenated environment, and duration of 0.5 hour. 7. The Si-(CH2)8-SiNW heterojunction is a positive diode amplified with the force applied to the SiNWs. On the contrary, the Si-CH=CH-(C6H4)-CH=CH-SiNW heterojunction isn’t a diode, but has a symmetric I-V curve. Single-molecule heterojunctions of Si-CH=CH-(C6H4)-CH=CH-SiNW having the π-conjugated electronic structure are more electrically conductive than those of Si-(CH2)8-SiNW having the σ-electronic structure. Furthermore, the π-conjugated electronic structure makes the self-assembly of DEBZ compact to eliminate the dissymmetric molecular configuration in the heterojunction, leading to the symmetric I-V curve. The self-assembly of the σ-based Si-(CH2)8-SiNW is prone to be less compact, resulting in the dissymmetric molecular configuration and diode performance.

204412.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
204412.value: 1. The synthesis of HC≡C-(C6H4)n-C≡CH (n=2, 3) will be further optimized to enhance the purity over 98%. Thermal hydrosilylation will be optimized to generate Si-CH=CH-(C6H4)n-CH=CH-SiNW heterojunctions (n=2, 3), and charge transport through the π-conjugated heterojunctions as a function of n (=1, 2, 3) will be studied to investigate the charge transport mechanism with respect to the molecular length. 2. UV hydrosilylation will be employed to create Si-(CH2)n-SiNW heterojunctions (n=6-10), and charge transport through the σ-heterojunctions as a function of n will be studied to explore the charge transport mechanism in terms of the molecular length. 3. It will be studied the charge transport as a function of temperature, to further investigate the charge transport mechanism.

204412.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
204412.value: Molecular electronics are to study electron transport through electrode-molecule-electrode heterojunctions. Spontaneous formation of Au-S bond leads its wide utilization as the electrode-molecule contact to study molecular electronics. However, the Au-S contacts have mechanical and electrical instability and high contact resistance. A Si-C bond is stronger than the Au-S bond, possibly leading to improving the mechanical and electrical stability and reducing the contact resistance. It is desired to fabricate Si-C-molecules-C-Si symmetric heterojunctions, which can be hardly achieved due to the limited development of nanofabrication techniques. This work utilizes hydrosilylation to create Si-HC=CH-(C6H4)-CH=CH-SiNW (SiNW: silicon nanowires) and Si-(CH2)8-SiNW junctions. Conducting atomic force microscopy is used to evaluate an electrical conductance of the symmetric heterojunctions as a function of bias voltage. It is found that the Si-(CH2)8-SiNW heterojunction is a positive diode, amplified with the force applied to the grafted SiNW. The Si-CH=CH-(C6H4)-CH=CH-SiNW heterojunction isn’t a diode, and has a symmetric I (current)-V (bias voltage) curve. Single-molecule-heterojunction conductance of the Si-HC=CH-(C6H4)-CH=CH-SiNW heterojunctions is higher than that of the Si-(CH2)8-SiNW heterojunctions. This project contributes to devising a reliable method to study molecular electronics without electrical and mechanical perturbation from the electrode-molecules contacts, paving the way for hybridizing molecular electronics with the mature silicon-based manufacturing technology.

204612.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
204612.value: Transcription factors are one of the largest classes of DNA-binding proteins that regulate gene expression by binding to specific DNA sequences within the regulatory regions of genes, thereby controlling essential biological processes related to cell development, differentiation and growth. Certain transcription factors have the ability to regulate an entire subset of genes and thus their activity is tightly regulated under normal physiological conditions. Aberrant transcription factor activity has been associated with the development of a number of diseases including cancer, developmental disorders and inflammation. Advances in the biomedical sciences have validated transcription factors as disease markers and potential targets for therapeutic intervention. Consequently, there is an urgent need for the development of simple and economical methods for the detection of transcription factors in biological systems. Traditional approaches for protein detection are time-consuming, expensive, or involve radiographic techniques. In this proposal, we aim to develop an oligonucleotide-based, label-free luminescent detection method for transcription factors using structure-specific transition metal complexes that can transduce the structure-switching response of the oligonucleotide into a luminescence response. Our preliminary results have demonstrated that a ruthenium complex can function as a luminescent probe to monitor the structure-switching response of an unlabeled oligonucleotide in response to the transcription factor NF-κB. We will build our preliminary results by rationally designing and synthesizing a series of new platinum(II), iridium(III) and rhodium(III) complexes as selective luminescent probes for G-quadruplex or duplex DNA using a combination of molecular modeling, biochemical and biophysical techniques. We will investigate several oligonucleotide designs and rigorously optimize the DNA sequence in order to maximize the selectivity, sensitivity and response time of our assay. We envision that the long phosphorescence lifetimes of transition metal complexes can be exploited for the in vitro detection of transcription factors in highly fluorescent biological media such as human cellular and nuclear extracts by use of time-resolved luminescence spectroscopy. Our proposed methodology is highly simple, sensitive, rapid, selective, low-cost and amenable to real-time and high-throughput analysis. We anticipate that the proposed technology could be highly useful to both academic and biomedical researchers worldwide working in the field of transcription factor biochemistry, and could be potentially applied for the clinical diagnosis or treatment of human diseases. 转录因子是DNA结合蛋白质中最大的一类蛋白质，它通过结合基因调节区域的特定基因序列来调节基因的表达，因此，它可以控制与细胞发育、分化和生长的生物必需过程。有些特定的转录因子可以调节全部基因的表达，因此，在正常的生理环境下，它的活性被紧密调节着。许多疾病的发展包括癌症，发育障碍和炎症都与转录因子活性异常相关。生物医学科学的进步已经证明了转录因子是疾病标志物和疾病治疗的潜在靶点。因此，急切需要开发一种简单、低廉的检测生物系统中转录因子的方法。 传统的蛋白质检测方法非常耗时、昂贵；或者需要借助造影技术来完成。在本研究中，我们将开发一种基于寡核苷酸的，免标记的发光检测转录因子的方法，该方法中将使用结构特定的过渡金属复合物的发光响应来转导转录因子引起的DNA结构的变化。我们的初步结果显示钌复合物可以作为一个发光探针来监测转录因子NF-κB引起的免标记寡核苷酸的结构变化。

204612.label: Realisation of objectives
204612.value: In this funding period, we have successfully achieved all of the project objectives and completed the project on the luminescent label-free oligonucleotide-based detection of transcription factors using the novel transition metal complexes. Firstly, we have designed and synthesized a series of novel transition metal complexes with different scaffold as luminescent probes for distinguishing changes in oligonucleotide conformations. We found that rhodium(III) was not an ideal candidate for the construction of luminescent probes for DNA, presumably due to their weak spin-orbit coupling effect, and thus could not form efficient 3MLCT excited state complexes capable of intense phosphorescence upon UV irradiation. The rhodium(III) analogues did not show significant luminescent enhancement and were generally unselective towards various DNAs. On the other hand, most of the iridium(III) complexes show very good luminescent properties and a series of novel iridium(III) complexes were found to be selective for G-quadruplex DNA, possibly due to the fact that these complexes can interact effectively with the G-quadruplex structure via end-stacking interactions or loop binding interactions. The binding affinity and selectivity of the complexes for G-quadruplex DNA were evaluated by a series of experiments, such as UV/Vis absorption titration and G-quadruplex fluorescent intercalator displacement (G4-FID) assays, fluorescence resonance energy transfer (FRET)-melting assay. The luminescent intensity was significantly enhanced in the presence of various G-quadruplex DNA sequences (such as PS2.M, Pu27 and Pu22). In contrast, no significant change in the luminescence of complexes was observed upon the addition of ssDNA, dsDNA or DNA/RNA hybrid duplex. The experiment results indicated that these iridium(III) complexes could be used as G-quadruplex selective probes in the G-quadruplex-based sensing assay. And then we utilized the G-quadruplex-selective metal complexes for developing a label-free G-quadruplex-based assay for HIF-1α assay. The detection for HIF-1α is based on the high specificity of the chosen complex towards G-quadruplex DNA over random coil DNA and duplex. In the presence of HIF-1α, the binding of the transcription factor to its cognate sequence protects the duplex substrate from exonuclease digestion, allowing a G-quadruplex-forming motif to be released after nicking by Nt.BbvCI. Furthermore, optimization experiments have been conducted to detect HIF-1α levels in biological samples. Moreover, we have demonstrated that HIF-1α levels in cell extract could be monitored using this assay. All of these works have been published in peer-reviewed journals, such as Chemical Communication, Chemical Science, Analytical Chemistry, Biosensors and bioelectronics, Scientific Report and so on. Meanwhile, our expertise in DNA-based luminescence sensing assay has been recognized by recent review articles in high impact factor journal (Acc. Chem. Res., 2014, 47, 3614; Analytica Chimica Acta., 2016, 913, 41; ChemPlusChem, 2017, 82, 8).

204612.label: Major findings and research outcome
204612.value: In this funding period, we have explored the effect of incorporating substituents such as halogen, nitro, aliphatic and/or aromatic substituents to different positions of phq/ppy/bzq ligands scaffold to vary the steric, electronic and/or lipophilic properties of the complexes for maximizing the binding of these complexes to the grooves of either duplex or G-quadruplex structures. To achieve this goal, we have synthesized a number of octahedral iridium(III) complexes bearing different C^N and N^N ligands which are designed to interact with the grooves of DNA and then investigated their luminescent response towards different DNA confirmations experimentally. Afterwards, we investigated the luminescence behavior of these iridium(III) complexes towards different types of DNA. Some of them were weakly emissive in aqueous buffered solution, however, the luminescent intensity was significantly enhanced in the presence of various G-quadruplex DNA sequences (such as PS2.M, Pu27 and Pu22). In contrast, no significant change in the luminescence of complexes was observed upon the addition of ssDNA, dsDNA or DNA/RNA hybrid duplex. The experiment results indicated that these iridium(III) complexes could be used as G-quadruplex selective probes in the G-quadruplex-based sensing assay for the detection of biological targets such as transcription factor (Sci. Rep., 2016, 6, 22458). Furthermore, we have also developed a luminescent platform for the detection of interferon gamma based on the G-quadruple selective iridium(III) complex (Chem. Comm., 2015, 51, 16033). Two more sensing platforms were developed for the selective luminescence switch on detection of protein tyrosine kinase-7 (Chem. Sci., 2015, 6, 4284), nicking endonuclease activity (Chem. Sci., 2014, 5, 4561), insulin (Anal. Chem., 2016, 88, 981), and Cs+ ion (Biosens. Bioelectron., 2016, 77, 609). Meanwhile, our expertise in DNA-based luminescence sensing assay has been recognized by recent review articles in high impact factor journal (Acc. Chem. Res., 2014, 47, 3614; Analytica Chimica Acta., 2016, 913, 41; ChemPlusChem, 2016, 82, 8).

204612.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
204612.value: Further optimization of the luminescent label-free oligonucleotide-based assay using the novel transition metal complexes can potentially detect a range of transcription factors such as c-Jun, STAT, HIF-1, Myc-Max and TATA binding protein. Previously, we only performed the detection of transcription factor in solution. However, we can also investigate the application of the luminescent assay to detect transcription factor activity in biological media including human cellular and nuclear extracts.

204612.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
204612.value: In this project, we have synthesized some novel transition metal complexes as luminescent probes and utilize them in the detection of transcription factors. Among these complexes, we selected out some complexes with specific selectivity towards G-quadruplex DNA over ssDNA or dsDNA. The selective binding of the selected complex for G-quadruplex DNA over dsDNA may be due to the bulky nature of the dinuclear complex, which prevents intercalation with dsDNA. As the consequence, the identified complex from a library of mononuclear and dinuclear Ir(III) complexes was subsequently employed for developing a label-free G-quadruplex-based assay for HIF-1α assay. The detection for HIF-1α is based on the high specificity of the complex towards G-quadruplex DNA over random coil DNA and duplex. In the presence of HIF-1α, the binding of the transcription factor to its cognate sequence protects the duplex substrate from exonuclease digestion, allowing a G-quadruplex-forming motif to be released after nicking by Nt.BbvCI. Furthermore, we demonstrated that HIF-1α levels in cell extract could be monitored using this assay. This label-free G-quadruplex-based luminescence switch-on platform is easy-to-use, user-friendly and cost-effective compared to conventional DNA footprinting, Western blotting, affinity chromatography, ELISA, and gel-based assays, which usually require complicated operation procedures and time-consuming preparation.

210412.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
210412.value: Cloud storage systems can provide pervasive data access service to customers at anytime from anywhere, with very high data reliability and durability. Despite a large number of cloud storage services readily available so far, commercial cloud storage services are only used by a small fraction of personal users and enterprise users. We believe that a successful cloud storage service needs to have a strong economic incentive to attract active customers. The major challenge to the service provider is to recover its costs from charges to cloud users, and the charges should be maintained at a competitive level. This project aims at designing a new architecture for next-generation cloud storage services based on the rich theoretical foundation of economics, game theory, auction theory, and network coding. Different from existing cloud storage service, we design incentive mechanisms through online double auctions to attract cloud users to contribute their local resources such as disk storage space and outbound network bandwidth. Combining the resources at data centers and cloud users, we further design pricing models for the free retail market of storage service, such that cloud service providers can make profit, cloud users are charged fair prices, and overall market efficiency is maximized. In order to guarantee high data availability and durability with minimum overall cost, we propose to design a new network coding scheme as the underlying technology for reliable storage management. Different from existing coding schemes, our new network coding scheme is tailored for the hybrid storage structure composed of highly reliable storage devices at data centers and unreliable storage devices at cloud users. Considering the computational complexity of coding and decoding process, we propose to implement the network coding function by Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) which can improve the level of user satisfaction and significantly save the power cost at data centers. 云存储服务可以随时随地为客户提供无处不在的数据访问服务，并提供非常高的数据可靠性和耐用性。尽管市场上已经有很多公司提供云存储服务，仅仅很少一部分个人用户和企业用户在使用付费的商用云存储服务。我们相信，一个成功的云存储服务需要有一个强大的经济诱因来吸引客户。云服务供应商面临的主要挑战是如何通过一个具有竞争力的收费机制来收回成本并取得盈利。 本项目旨在为下一代云存储服务设计一个新的架构，其理论基础包涵经济学，博弈论，拍卖理论，以及网络编码。与现有的云存储服务不同，我们提出通过在线双向拍卖来设计一个全新的激励机制，用以吸引云用户贡献他们自己的本地资源，例如磁盘存储空间和网络带宽。这样可以大大降低云服务商的成本。通过整合数据中心和云用户的资源，我们进一步设计一个存储服务零售市场的定价模型，使得云服务供应商可以赚取利润，云用户的收费是公平合理的，以及整体市场的效率得到最大化。此外，为了用最低的成本来保证数据的高可用性和耐用性，我们建议设计一个新的网络编码方案。与现有的编码方案不同，这个新的网络编码方案是针对新架构下的混合存储结构：它既包括高度可靠的数据中心存储系统，又包括云用户端相对不太可靠的存储设备。考虑到编解码的高计算复杂度，我们还提出通过图形处理单元来实现编解码的的功能，这样还可以显著的节省电力成本。

210412.label: Realisation of objectives
210412.value: Cloud storage service has become an attractive option for enterprises and individual users because of its high data reliability and availablity. However, the cost of commercial cloud storage service is still very high. For example, the annual fee of Dropbox Pro service is $99 per TB. The high price comes from the cost of hardware, electricity, and bandwidth. The main objective of this project is to explore different ways to reduce the cost of providing reliable cloud storage service. We have achieved this objective from three different aspects. First of all, we proposed a user-assisted cloud storage architecture, which can aggregate the scattered storage spaces at cloud users' computers as a procured storage pool. Such a pool can be used to augment service provider's data center resources by reducing storage cost and bandwidth cost. With the help of coding techniques, a pool of unreliable disks can offer very reliable data service, and hence the value of this distributed storage pool is significantly increased. Observing that private Bittorrent is one of the most successful applications that can motive their users to contribute their resources to the community, we conducted a measurement and analysis study on private Bittorrent communities. In order to encourage cloud users to contribute their local resources, we designed an online procurement auction scheme which allows cloud users to sell their space storage space to service providers at a price that is accepted by both sides. Our auction scheme is turthful and guarantees a provable competitive ratio against optimal offline algorithms. Secondly, we consider the storage retail market where cloud users can buy storage spaces from service providers. The key issue is how to determine the unit price such that the service provider's profit can be maximized. This is a challenging problem because the user demands are sensitive to the price. We designed a dynamic pricing scheme that can automatically adjust the cloud storage unit price by observing the historical demands in a previous time window. For each accepted user request, we also solve the space allocation problem to minimize the cost. Thirdly, we developed a highly efficient erasure coding scheme for cloud service providers to achieve high reliability and durability,while the impact of computational overhead of erasure coding is minimized by exploiting the computing power of off-the-shelf GPUs. To further reduce the electricity cost at data centers, we studied the impact of DVFS technique on GPU power consumption.
