447712.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
447712.value: Language is in constant flux, caused by changes in the I(nternalized)-languages in the minds/brains of individuals. Language change is necessarily related to language acquisition, since children plant the seeds of change by hypothesizing grammars that may be different from the adults'. Generative studies over the last fifty years have developed acquisition-based theories and models of language change, addressing issues such as the direction of change, the gradualness vs. abruptness of change, and how innovations may arise and spread through a community of speakers (Halle 1962, Kiparsky 1968, Lightfoot 1991, 1999; Roberts 2007; Niyogi and Berwick 1995; Yang 2000). Empirical studies of language variation and change have provided interesting generalizations on the transition, embedding, and actuation problems of language change (Weinreich, Labov and Herzog 1968; Labov 1972, 1975), such as the irreversibility of change (Shen 1997), the constancy of the rate of change across linguistic contexts (Kroch 1989), and the reality of lexical diffusion in syntactic change (Wang 1969, Yue-Hashimoto 1993, Zhang 1995, 2000). While previous studies of Chinese have tackled the relationship between language change and language acquisition in the context of sound change (Shen 1997), virtually no attempt has been made in the area of syntax. This project will document in detail an ongoing syntactic change in Hong Kong Cantonese: the insertion of the nominalizer ge3 between a noun and a sortal classifier, a change relevant to our understanding of how the count-mass distinction is manifested in the language. The innovative structure will be studied against a broad age and time spectrum, using interviews, elicited narratives, grammaticality judgment tasks, naturalistic and experimental data from child language of an earlier period, as well as radio and television shows of different periods. Framed in a broadly mentalist perspective, the study addresses issues such as (i) the extent to which the variation among age groups (apparent time data) will reflect changes evidenced in speakers from different periods (real time data); (ii) how the syntactic change originates and spreads through the language, with reference to functional load and lexical diffusion; (iii) whether the diffusion of the change can be approximated by a logistic function, and whether the rate of change is constant across contexts; and (iv) whether the ongoing change has been restructuring the Cantonese nominal in a fundamental way. Our detailed documentation of the syntactic change will provide a solid empirical foundation for studying the relationship between grammatical change and language acquisition. 語言演變與語言獲得具有必然的關係：語言不斷演變，導源於人們大腦中的語言系統 (內在語言)發生演變。由於兒童在獲得語言的過程中所推導出的語言系統可能與成人的語言系統有所不同，他們是語言演變的誘因。 過去五十年，生成語法學者建立了以語言獲得為基礎的理論和一些語言演變的模型，探討語言演變的方向、演變的漸進性與突變性、以及新興形式如何在語言社群中產生和擴散等問題(Halle 1962; Kiparsky 1968; Lightfoot 1991, 1999; Roberts 2007; Niyogi and Berwick 1995; Yang 2000)。通過大量對語言變異和語言演變的實證研究，學者們就語言演變如何衍生和實現、如何嵌套在社會結構當中等問題(Weinreich, Labov and Herzog 1968; Labov 1972, 1975)，提出了一系列具啟發性的假設，其中包括語言演變不可逆轉 (Shen 1997)、同一種語言演變在語言內部各種相關結構當中的演變速度恒定(Kroch 1989)、以及句法演變跟語音演變一樣顯示詞滙擴散特徵等規律(Wang 1969; Yue-Hashimoto 1993; Zhang 1995, 2000)。 儘管漢語在語言演變與語言獲得的關係上已有語音方面的研究(Shen 1997)，但卻沒有任何針對句法演變的研究。本研究詳細記錄當前香港粵語的一種句法演變，即在個體量詞與名詞之間加入名詞化語素「嘅」。此現象有助於了解粵語如何體現可數與不可數的區別。本研究採用不同方法觀察這個結構在不同年齡層及不同時期的表現：包括面談，誘發敘述，句法判斷，較早時期的兒童語言的自然語料及實驗數據，以及不同時期的電台錄音。 本研究以內在語言理論架構為出發點作以下探索：(一)探討虛擬時間數據(同一段時期不同年齡層之間所反映的差異)是否符合實際歷時數據(不同時期相應年齡說話者之間的差異)；(二)參照功能負荷和詞匯擴散等理論概念，分析句法演變如何衍生並在語言內部擴散；(三)計算此演變的速度以及如何以相關的數學函數來概括；(四)了解粵語名詞短語的內部結構是否發生了根本性的重組。透過詳細記錄一種粵語句法演變的進程，本研究以堅實語料為基礎，探索語言演變與語言獲得之間的關係。

447712.label: Realisation of objectives
447712.value: Our study has revealed that ‘ge3’-insertion in Hong Kong Cantonese is not categorically based on the sortal vs. non-sortal classifier distinction. Instead, the insertion occurred in both sortal and non-sortal classifier contexts, at a higher frequency with certain classifier subtypes, for example, the general sortal classifier ‘go3’ for sortal classifiers, and the fuzzy quantity classifier ‘di1’ (“some”) for non-sortal classifiers. Our media recordings hint at the relevance of genre type to ‘ge3’-insertion, though this factor will need to be further investigated. [Objectives #1 and 3] We have shown that ‘ge3’-insertion is prevalent in nominals with demonstrative determiners as well as in nominals with numeral or quantifier determiners. ‘Ge3-insertion is not limited to noun phrases carrying a quantity interpretation; instead it is found in nominals carrying definite, indefinite as well as quantity readings. In fact, our corpus data reflect a greater percentage of ‘ge3’-insertion in demonstrative contexts than in numeral or quantifier contexts. This pattern of use suggests that the forces motivating nominalizer insertion in Mandarin, which is favored in contexts where quantity is foregrounded (see below), must differ from those that operate in Hong Kong Cantonese. [Objective # 1] Our preschool child language production data did not reveal any occurrence of the insertion structure. On the other hand, our cross-sectional grammaticality judgment data indicate that the primary school children gave the highest acceptance of the innovative structures, for all nominal types and all classifier subtypes tested, compared to secondary school and university students. These judgment patterns suggest that the syntactic change is likely to have originated from the pre-adolescents, confirming reports of previous scholars on the initiators of language change. The age differentiation results, which provide apparent time data, seem to accord well with our real time data based on corpus research, which traced the emergence of the innovation to the middle of the 20th century. [Objectives #2, 3] Recent literature in syntax has pointed to the complex factors surrounding the nominalizer insertion phenomenon, demonstrating that it is not true that such an insertion is totally prohibited from sortal classifier contexts. For example, a Mandarin sentence such as ‘Yi liang ge de pingguo jiu zugou le’ [one-two-CL-DE apple just enough SFP] (“Just one or two apples are enough”) is quite acceptable with the nominalizer ‘de’ inserted after the general sortal classifier ‘ge’. On the other hand, some non-sortal classifier contexts disallow nominalizer insertion, such as the group classifier ‘shuang’ (“pair”), as in ‘Wo mai-le yi shuang-de kuaizi’ [I buy-ASP one pair DE chopsticks] (“I bought a pair of chopsticks”). Our study of ‘ge3’-insertion has cast further doubt on the linkage between nominalizer insertion and the count-mass distinction in Chinese. The use of nominalizer-insertion as a diagnostic for the count-mass distinction in Mandarin or Cantonese is therefore hardly tenable. [Objective #4] In our corpus and experimental data, we have failed to find semantic differences between nominals with and without ‘ge3’ inserted. On our analysis, the Cantonese nominalizer differs from its Mandarin counterpart ‘de’ in its not having a strong referential feature, and in its tendency to cliticize to a preceding dimensional adjective to form a complex adjective. These two factors, as well as the inherent ambiguity of the Cantonese nominal, may have cued the learner to postulate a left-branching structure to the noun phrase, resulting in ‘ge3’ merely serving as a prenominal modifier marker or an attributive linker. In other words, the nominal with ‘ge3’ inserted and its counterpart without ‘ge3’ insertion are identical in meaning, with the ‘ge3’ functioning as a mere morphological marker of modification, similar to ‘no’ in Japanese. [Objectives #4, 5] We have documented a syntactic change in Hong Kong Cantonese that appears to arise from internal causes and not on language contact (with either Mandarin Chinese or English). The fact that the Chinese nominal has been assigned a right-branching structure as well as a left-branching structure by syntacticians points to the potential ambiguity of the noun phrase, which poses an acquisition problem for children. Our study also vindicates the validity and usefulness of the model of language change in generative grammar, in which grammatical change is conceptualized as changes in the I(nternalized) languages of members of the speech community. Grammatical change may be initiated when children postulate a slightly different internalized grammar than the parent’s based on the parental input. This variation between parent and child will not be easily perceptible and will not cause communication problems at the beginning, since both grammars are compatible with identical or largely overlapping surface strings. However, as the change spreads, the output of the child’s internalized grammar will diverge from that of the parent’s more visibly, and will constitute a different language input for the next generation of speakers. [Objective #5] Our study may be the first study to observe diachronic change through apparent time in the context of Chinese grammar, since previous such efforts have focused exclusively on sound change. [Objective #5]

447712.label: Major findings and research outcome
447712.value: Our diachronic and synchronic data provide clear evidence that nominalizer insertion in Hong Kong Cantonese had emerged before the 1980s, earlier than the period reported in previous studies (Lee and Lei 2014). The nominalizer insertion structures have spread to a variety of nominal structures, including [Demonstrative-CL-N] and [Numeral-CL-N] contexts (Lee and Lei 2013). The innovation is sensitive to general constraints on syntax: it does not spread to [CL-N] structures, in which the classifier cliticizes to the following noun (Lee and Lei 2015b). A classifier item effect was observed with the general classifier ‘go3’ 個, which accounted for 60% of all tokens of ‘ge3’-insertion with sortal classifiers. A subtype effect can also be observed among non-sortal classifiers, with ‘ge3’-insertion occurring primarily with the fuzzy classifier ‘di1’, kind classifiers and quasi classifiers (Lee 2014). The classifier item effect is also reflected in acceptability judgment: the general classifier ‘go3’ had much lower acceptance in ‘ge3’-insertion structures than the other classifiers: the functional classifier ‘gin6’ (sortal) or the kind classifier ‘fun2’ and the group classifier ‘zaa6’ (non-sortal) (Lee and Lei 2015b). Nominalizer insertion in Cantonese is motivated by different reasons than the factors that license ‘de’-insertion in Mandarin. The vast majority of ‘ge3’-insertion tokens denote definite or indefinite reference rather than a quantity reading. We have failed to replicate the purported facilitating effect of numeral phrases for ‘ge3’-insertion, suggesting that it is not the numeral phrase per se, but rather its non-referential quantity reading, that could facilitate the innovation (Lee and Lei 2015a). The primary school students accepted the innovative structure significantly more than high school and university students, for both sortal and non-sortal classifiers, for all classifier subtypes and for all nominal structures. We take this as evidence that the syntactic innovation may have originated from older children and adolescents (Lee and Lei 2016). It is hypothesized that the syntactic change arose as a result of structural ambiguity, with the nominal amenable to both a right-branching and a left-branching analysis, with certain Cantonese-specific factors favoring the latter. If such an analysis is correct, the nominalizer can be seen as evolving into an attributive linker marking prenominal modifiers, which function as specifiers or adjuncts (Lee and Lei 2016). In sum, ‘ge3’-insertion nominals are part of the mental grammars of HK Cantonese speakers, even though they are more marked than their counterparts without ‘ge3’. The phenomenon is clearly a robust ongoing syntactic change which has internal causes.

447712.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
447712.value: Two manuscripts based on six conference presentations will be submitted for publication in the coming year, reporting corpus findings on the rise of nominalizer insertion structures in Hong Kong Cantonese over a span of 150 years, as well as experimental findings which shed light on the effects of classifier type, classifier subtype, nominal structure, and meaning focus in facilitating ‘ge3’-insertion. Evidence for age differentiation in speakers’ sensitivity to this grammatical change will be furnished, and possible mechanisms that might have motivated this syntactic change will be hypothesized. In the coming years, we will conduct further analyses of our findings using statistical techniques on language variation that we have learned about from attending the conference ‘New Ways of Analyzing Variation Asia Pacific 4’ in April 2016, namely quantitative variationist analyses with multiple regression and Linear Mixed Effects models using Rbrul (Johnson 2009). We will further investigate the following issues: (a) To what extent does ‘ge3’-insertion vary with genre type? (b) Does the acceptability of ‘ge3’-insertion decline further when a wider age spectrum involving older informants is examined? (c) In what ways does the spontaneous use of ‘ge3’-insertion correlate with speakers’ judgments of acceptability of these structures?

447712.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
447712.value: The project has documented in detail the rise of an innovative grammatical structure in Hong Kong Cantonese in recent decades: noun phrases with the nominalizer ‘ge3’ inserted between a sortal classifier and a noun, as in ‘nei1-go3-ge3-ping4-gwo2’ ‘this-classifier-ge3-apple’(“This apple”) or ‘saam1-go3-ge3-ping4-gwo2’ ‘three-classifier-ge3-apple’ (“Three apples”). The insertion began to be attested in the 1950s and 1960s, and increased in occurrence from the 1970s onwards. It was found in a variety of noun phrase structures, with demonstratives, numerals or quantifiers in prenominal positions, and carrying definite, indefinite or quantity interpretations. The nominalizer insertion does not seem to be conditioned by classifier type; it does not occur more frequently with non-sortal classifiers (e.g. ‘fun2’ “type-model”) than with sortal classifiers (e.g. ‘go3’); nor is it facilitated by the presence of numerals or quantifiers. Using corpus as well as grammaticality judgment data, we have established that the grammatical change is likely to have originated from older children and pre-adolescents. This phenomenon is significant not only because it records an important aspect of cultural change in Hong Kong, but it may also represent a syntactic change due to structural ambiguity, with children re-analyzing the Cantonese nominal as a left-branching rather than a right-branching structure.

447712.value: 11.1 Research exchanges and consultation with Professor Charles Yang Research exchanges and consultation sessions were held with Professor Charles Yang of the Department of Linguistics and Computer Science, University of Pennsylvania during his visit to the Language Acquisition Laboratory of the Chinese University of Hong Kong between October 14 and 18, 2013. Professor Yang, an expert working on language acquisition and language change, gave us valuable comments and feedback on our research findings. 11.2 Research exchanges and consultation sessions with Professor Liu Danqing Research exchanges and consultation sessions were held with Professor Liu Danqing of the Institute of Linguistics, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences during his visit to the Language Acquisition Laboratory of the Chinese University of Hong Kong on March 20, 2014. Professor Liu, an expert on language typology and Chinese dialectal grammar, gave us insightful comments and feedback on our research findings. 11.3 Development of a mini-corpus containing ge3¬-insertion nominals extracted from media data We have built a diachronic database of ge3-insertion nominals extracted from a variety of textual and media sources on (Hong Kong) Cantonese from the 19th Century till the present day, covering a span of 150 years. Each ge3-insertion nominal is coded with its linguistic structure and the neighboring context in which it occurs. The datasets include: (a) Written texts of Cantonese published in the 19th Century [1828 – 1931] Extraction of ge3-containing nominals at this earliest time point was based on two databases: The Early Cantonese Colloquial Texts: A Database’ (Cheung and Jiang 2012) and ‘The 19th Century Early Cantonese Tagged Database’ (Yiu 2012). The first database consists of 7 textbooks on Cantonese published between 1828 and 1924. The second database consists of 10 books including Cantonese textbooks for foreigners and bibles published between 1872 and 1931, with a total of around 160,000 characters. No valid tokens of ge3-insertion occurred in this dataset. (b) Hong Kong Cantonese films produced in the mid-20th Century [1952 - 1966] We extracted two valid tokens of ge3-insertion nominals during this period from ‘The Linguistic Corpus on Mid-20th Century Hong Kong Cantonese’ (Chin 2012), which consists of transcripts of 21 Hong Kong Cantonese films produced between 1952 and 1966, with a total of around 200,000 characters. (c) Radio and television broadcasts in the late 20th Century [1968 – 1982] We have extracted 86 valid tokens of ge3-insertion nominals from audio and video recordings of radio and television programs of the late 20th Century produced by the Radio Television Hong Kong (RTHK) that are made available online on the website ‘RTHK Memory’ (http://app3.rthk.org.hk/special/rthkmemory/). We selected 9 radio programs (a total of around 6 hours 20 minutes) and 15 television programs (a total of around 6 hours 40 minutes) broadcast between 1968 and 1982, summing up for around 13 hours of recordings in total. (d) Radio and television broadcasts in the 21st Century [2007-2013] Four hundred and seventy valid tokens of ge3-insertion nominals in present-day Hong Kong Cantonese were extracted from a total of around 36 hours of audio and video recordings of radio and television programs broadcast between 2007 and 2013 from a number of online sources, covering a variety of program type and topic and comprising speakers of different ages. A full transcription on six hours of selected recordings was completed. (e) Radio broadcasts at specific time frames in the last two decades We have also extracted ge3-containing nominals in the radio broadcasts of similar program type and topic recorded at three specific time points in the last two decades, namely 1991, 2001, and 2011, based on data we acquired from RTHK for the current project. This set of data consists of 36 hours of recordings in total, with 12 hours from each time point. 11.4 Building of a media database containing university lectures conducted in Hong Kong Cantonese We have recorded university lectures conducted in Cantonese by ten native speakers of Hong Kong Cantonese on the campus of the Chinese University of Hong Kong during the spring term of 2014. The lecturers are divided into two age groups: (i) five of them were at the age of 50 or above; and (ii) another five were aged between 30 and 40. The dataset consists of around 15.5 hours from the former group and 18 hours from the latter group. 11.5 Book proposal invitation We received a book proposal invitation from an editor at Routledge, who wished to explore a book publishing possibility with us for our work on language change and language acquisition in Cantonese, to be part of a newly launched book series entitled ‘Routledge Studies in East Asian Linguistics’. 11.6 Paper submission invitation We also received an invitation to submit a revised version of our paper presented at IACL-24 (Paper entitled ‘Nominalizer insertion in Hong Kong Cantonese: Is it a real syntactic change?’) to a special issue on the theme: ‘When New Dialectal Data Meets Theories’, in ‘Language and Linguistics’, an SSCI- and A&HCI-indexed international journal co-published by ILAS and SAGE.

448412.label: Project Title(Chinese)
448412.value: 产权结构以及控制权对金融稳定性的影响

448412.label: Co - Investigator(s)
448412.value: Mr Chen, Tao Prof Xuan, Yuhai

448412.label: Project Objectives
448412.value: Did banks with larger control-ownership wedges perform worse during crisis? Do shareholder rights and bank regulation mitigate the effect of wedges on bank risk taking incentives? Did too-big-to-fail, presence of multiple large shareholders and ownership identities affect the link between wedges and bank performance during crisis?
rows: Did banks with larger control-ownership wedges perform worse during crisis?
Do shareholder rights and bank regulation mitigate the effect of wedges on bank risk taking incentives?
Did too-big-to-fail, presence of multiple large shareholders and ownership identities affect the link between wedges and bank performance during crisis?

448412.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
448412.value: The financial crisis from 2007 onwards has caused the largest collapse of market capitalization in the global banking industry since the Great Depression. Poor governance is among the key factors that have been accused for contributing to the crisis (Diamond and Rajan, 2009). Several studies have started to investigate why some banks perform better than others as the performance of banks varies significantly around the world (Beltratti and Stulz, 2011). Focusing on the crisis period, existent research has investigated the effects of CEO incentives, funding structure on bank performance (e.g., Fahlenbrach and Stulz, 2011; Beltratti and Stulz, 2011). Beyond the crisis period, papers have examined large shareholders’ cash-flow rights (Laeven and Levine, 2009), and family bank control (Mock et al., 2011). An essential but hitherto overlooked factor is the deviation between the control rights and cash-flow rights of the large shareholders of banks. In the presence of the divergence between voting and cash-flow rights, large shareholders may seek to expropriate other investors for their own private benefits. The intuition is that for firms with excessive control rights, dominant shareholders are more able to enjoy benefits by “tunneling” the gains from risk-taking activities if the risky projects turn out to be successful. On the other hand, if the risky projects fail, large shareholders bear little loss as they have relatively small cash-flow rights. Therefore, holding cash-flow rights constant, greater voting rights afford the dominant shareholders extra risk-taking incentives to gain more power to divert upside gains at the expense of other shareholders while bearing relatively little downside risk. In this paper, we directly investigate the relation between the control-ownership wedge and bank performance using a newly built, large-scale, and hand-collected data set on bank ownership and control structures for all the public and large private banks around the world during the recent crisis period from 2007 to 2009. We measure the deviation between control rights and cash–flow rights by computing the cash-flow and voting rights of the ultimate largest owner of each bank and obtain detailed information of the banks in the universal sample. Our primary hypothesis is that banks with larger control-ownership wedges will engage more in risk-taking activities, which consequently leads to worse performance during crisis. Further, we will look at the factors that influence the relation between the control-ownership wedge and the performance changes, in order to infer the mechanisms through which the risk-taking behaviors can be mitigated. 本项目旨在从产权结构以及控制权角度来研究银行业风险以及稳定性的重要影响因素。利用全球金融危机作为天然试验， 本项目将探讨金融机构的产权结构和控制权对其在金融危机中的表现与业绩的影响。通过这些探讨，本项目将加深对由于产权以及控制权分离而导致的道德风险， 掏空以及隧道效应等委托代理人问题的理解并作出对金融稳定性有益的政策建议。

448412.label: Realisation of objectives
448412.value: The project has generated two papers. One is forthcoming in Journal of Financial Economics ("Spare tire? Stock markets, banking crises, and economic recoveries"), and another one is under review at Journal of Monetary Economics ("Financial Innovation: The Bright and the Dark Sides"). For the second paper, it is also solicited by the editor of Journal of Banking and Finance (Prof. Bekaert) for a guaranteed publication. When we started collecting the data for this project, we found two competing papers which are already in the working paper stage. These two papers eventually published in JFE and JBF, respectively (" excess control rights, financial crisis and bank profitability and risk" published in 2015 JBF and "Excess control rights, bank capital structure adjustments and lending" published in 2015 JFE). We then decided to differentiate our projects from theirs by focusing more on the real economic recovery (the JFE paper) and the impact of financial innovation on financial stability (the second paper). In the first paper, we continue to examine the role of investor protection during the banking crisis, with a different focus on economic recovery (rather than financial stability). We find a very strong pattern that stronger shareholder protection facilitates economic recoveries by helping firms raise alternative external capital from the equity market. In the second paper, we examine the impact of financial innovation on financial stability and economic growth. We find that financial innovation is positively associated with bank growth, but also higher bank fragility and worse bank performance during the recent crisis. These effects are more profound in countries with deeper securities markets and more stringent regulatory frameworks. Nevertheless, we find a net positive impact of financial innovation on economic growth. In our analyses, we also control for the banks' foreign ownership structure. Therefore, on top of the ownership structure, we find an important factor (i.e. financial innovation) which affects financial stability.

448412.label: Major findings and research outcome
448412.value: I am attaching the abstracts of the two papers as a summary of the main findings. In the first paper, we tried to answer the following question "Do stock markets act as a spare tire during banking crises, providing an alternative corporate financing channel and mitigating the economic severity of these crises? Using firm-level data in 36 countries from 1990 through 2011, we find that the adverse consequences of banking crises on equity issuances, firm profitability, employment, and investment efficiency are smaller in countries with stronger shareholder protection laws. These findings are not explained by the development of stock markets or financial institutions prior to the crises, the severity of the banking crisis, or overall economic, legal, and institutional development. " (Levine, Lin and Xie, 2015) Taken together, this suggests the importance of shareholder protection in enhancing economic stability. In the second paper, we explore the impact of financial innovation on financial stability and economic growth. Specifically, "Based on data from 32 countries over the period 1996-2010, this paper is the first to assess the relationship between financial innovation, on the one hand, and bank growth and fragility, as well as economic growth, on the other hand. We find that financial innovation is associated with faster bank growth, but also higher bank fragility and worse bank performance during the recent crisis. These effects are stronger in countries with larger securities markets and more restrictive regulatory frameworks. In spite of these seemingly ambiguous findings, the net effect of financial innovation on economic growth is positive: financial innovation allows countries and industries to better reap growth opportunities and fosters economic growth." (Beck, Chen, Lin and Song, 2015) Taken together, these two studies are in the same line with the proposed idea on investor protection and financial stability, but with a much broader and deeper analysis. Furthermore, it goes beyond the scope of financial stability by looking at the effect to the real economies.

448412.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
448412.value: We are looking at other important factors (e.g. social and cultural factors) which might affect economic resilience and stability. These studies will generate important policy implications.

448412.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
448412.value: In the first study, we find that in countries with strong shareholder protection, stock markets act as a spare tire during banking crises, providing an alternative corporate financing channel and mitigating the economic severity of these crises. In the second paper, we find that financial innovation increases bank growth but also the banking instability. The impact is more profound for countries with a deeper security market and with more stringent regulations. The net effect of financial innovation on economic growth tends to be positive.

448712.label: Project Title(Chinese)
448712.value: 自動化交易對美國國債市場的影響

448712.label: Co - Investigator(s)
448712.value: Prof Jiang, George Prof Lo, Ingrid Ka-man

448712.label: Project Objectives
448712.value: Understand how automated trading responds to information changes in the Treasury market Understand the effect of automated trading on market liquidity Understand whether automated trading enhances or hinders price discovery upon arrival of information Understand whether automated trading is responsible for extreme market volatility and price jumps.

Understand the effect of automated trading on market liquidity
Understand whether automated trading enhances or hinders price discovery upon arrival of information
Understand whether automated trading is responsible for extreme market volatility and price jumps.

448712.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
448712.value: Algorithmic trading, i.e., automated trades executed by computer program, has become more prevalent in financial markets in recent years. The effect of algorithmic trading, nevertheless, is still a relatively unexplored topic in the finance literature. In particular, there is little research yet in the fixed income market. We aim to fill this gap in the literature and study the impact of algorithmic trading in the U.S. Treasury market. The U.S. Treasury market is one of the largest financial markets in the world, with trading volume comparable to the U.S. equity market. Algorithmic trading has increased significantly in the Treasury market in recent years. According to Safarik (2005), over 50% of trading volume on BrokerTec, a major electronic trading platform of the U.S. Treasury securities, originates from automated trades. Given the importance of the Treasury market, we are interested in the role of algorithmic trading and its effect on market activities and the price discovery process of Treasury securities. The data used in our research is from BrokerTec and contains information of all transactions and limit order book over the period of 2003 to 2011. We identify an order as originated from algorithmic trading if the speed of reaction to changes of market conditions is beyond human capacity. The long sample period and vast dataset allows a detailed analysis on algorithmic trading in the US Treasury market and provides more statistical power than existing studies using data from equity market. This research project focuses on the following set of questions. The first question is how algorithmic trading is used around macroeconomic news announcements. Pre- and post-announcement periods represent different market environment. Traders have to assess the impact of announcement quickly to place new orders or cancel/modify existing orders. Computer programs are better adapted in handling such trades than human traders due to fast moving market conditions. The second question is whether algorithmic trading adds or reduces market liquidity. As algorithmic trades respond to information shocks quickly and potentially with large volume, do they supply or absorb market liquidity? The third question is whether algorithmic trading facilitates or hinders the incorporation of public information into bond prices. That is, does algorithmic trading help to speed up the price discovery process? Finally, we examine the impact of automated trading on price stability. It is generally believed that algorithmic trading is at least partially responsible for recent high market volatility and extreme returns. 我們的目標是研究自動化交易在美國國債市場的影響。美國國債市場是世界上最大的金融市場之一。國債市場在近幾年顯著增加了自動化交易。由於國債市場的重要性，我們研究自動化交易對市場活動的影響和債券的價格發現過程中的作用。 在我們的研究中所使用的數據來自BrokerTec來自其中包含的所有交易和限價訂單簿2003年至2012年。在這個研究項目中，我們的目標是要解決以下的問題。第一個問題是宏觀經濟新聞發布如何影響自動化交易。宏觀經濟新聞發布前和會後公佈期間，代表不同的市場環境。交易商公佈需要評估宏觀經濟新聞的影響影響，迅速將新訂單或現有訂單的取消/修改。自動化交易能夠更迅速地評估宏觀經濟新聞的影響。第二個問題是，自動化交易能否影響市場的流動性。由於自動化交易的速度快，自動化交易能否利用速度在提供或吸收市場的流動性呢？第三個問題是自動化交易能否促進或阻礙公共信息納入到債券的價格。最後，我們分析自動化交易如何影響價格的穩定

449012.label: Co - Investigator(s)

449012.label: Project Objectives
449012.value: To develop a clinically useful and culture-specific multi-family group intervention for families of children with ADHD in Hong Kong; To evaluate the cross-cultural applicability and efficacy of various interventional strategies for the Marlborough model of multi-family groups, with specific attention on any variation that might depend on cultural context, by using data on Chinese families of children with ADHD in Hong Kong To identify new theories of change so developed by using the data set generated in this research including the family experiences toward multi-family group intervention and their subjective experience in the group process.

449012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
449012.value: This cross-disciplinary study aims to inform both theories and practice for families of children diagnosed with Attention Deficit/ Hyperactivity Disorders (ADHD) in a Chinese context. In the belief that family is an asset of the child, assessment and management of children with mental health needs is family centered in the West. Althugh multi-family group (MFG) approach has shown to be an empirically promising approach in the UK for families in distress and for parents who feel incompetent of managing the childcare problem, little research has been conducted in Hong Kong to examine how theory was used in developing intervention materials and intervention strategies, and in assessing the treatment efficacy for Chinese families of children with ADHD. In view of the cultural difference between the East and the West, an attempt is made to develop and document a culturally-specific and socially relevant model of MFG and to assess, in a different context, three sets of hypotheses regarding the efficacy of this approach. The study will be implemented in two phases. The first phase, a qualitative study, aims to develop a practice manual based on the participants’ feedbacks of 5 groups. Data will be collected through literature review, an analysis of the videotaped group sessions, and the focus-group interview. The second phase will be an outcome study in which a before-after-two-group design will be employed to assess the efficacy of MFG and to identify significant moderators (e.g., severity of problems) accounting for variability in treatment response to MFG. A total of 128 parent-child dyads will be recruited, to be randomly assigned to the 8 control groups (CG) and 8 experimental groups (EG). For both ethical and practical reasons, all participants will receive the routine psychiatric care comprising medication and professional support. For the EG, MFG programme comprising 42 hours will be additionally offered. The duration of the MFG programme will last 6-months. The MFG programme offered will be standardized in adherence to the practice manual developed in the first phase. The outcomes will be assessed by teacher’s rating, parents’ and children’s self-reports pre-treatment, post-treatment and at 3-month follow-up, using standardized measures. Participants will attend a focus-group interview and respond to a Client Satisfaction Form at post-treatment phase seeking their views regarding the extent to which the MFG programme has met their expectations. Knowledge generated from this study will be made available to helping professionals to help these families in Hong Kong. 研究概要 此跨專業的研究旨在探索適合患有專注力失調及過度活躍症(ADHD)兒童的華人家庭的理論及實務介入手法。西方社會相信家庭是孩子的資產和資源，固他們在評估和管理兒童心理健康均以家庭為本的角度出發。 多元家庭小組(MFG)是其中一個以家庭為本的介入手法。在英國，這手法已發展多年並一直用於幫助有管教孩子困難的家庭。儘管多元家庭小組享譽西方，香港學術界甚少對此作出深入研究，或評估其對於患有專注力失調及過度活躍症兒童的華人家庭的治療成效。中國家庭的管教方式深受傳統文化的影響；父母在教養孩子上多以「管」的方式進行。這獨特的概念在中國社會裡代表着家長對孩子的關心和教導，而非如西方社會所演繹的敵意、具攻擊性、不信任或支配(Chao, 1994)。由於文化上的差異，此研究嘗試發展一套適合香港本土文化及社會相關的多元家庭小組手法，過程之中將引證三項假設，並探索此手法在不同情況下的治療成效。 此研究包括兩個階段。第一階段以質性研究的方式進行，目的是根據三組參加者的反饋，發展一套實務手冊。此階段將透過文獻回顧、分析小組錄影片段及進行焦點小組作資料搜集。 第二階段將進行成效研究─參加者將被分為控制組和對照組，研究團隊於小組前後向兩組收集反饋再作出比對，測試多元家庭小組在當中的成效之餘，並藉以識別影響參加者對治療的反應的重要因素，例如家庭所面對的困難的嚴重性、家庭的社經地特徵等。此研究將邀請一共96個家長-孩子組合參與，他們將被隨機分配到6個對照組及6個控制組。考慮到倫理及實務上的需要，所有參加者將在研究過程中接受定期的精神科專業支援及藥物照顧。研究中，控制組將參與一系列一共42小時的多元家庭小組服務，包括一個四小時的心理教育講座、四天密集式的小組活動、及兩次每兩個月進行的跟進服務。每個多元家庭小組服務將持續六個月。研究團隊將把多元家庭小組服務及當中的活動歸納及劃一，並於第一階段發展一套實務手冊。多元家庭小組的成效將會透過老師對孩子的評分、家長及孩子的自我評分來評估。這測試將採用標準的評估方法，並於治療前後及小組後三個月進行。小組後將邀請參加者出席焦點小組並填寫服務滿意程度問卷以收集他們對於服務是否能滿足他們的期望的意見。此研究成果期望能豐富本港助人專業人士在幫助有需要家庭的知識及技巧。

449112.label: Co - Investigator(s)

449112.label: Project Objectives
449112.value: (1) how the parties/candidates engage in strategic coordination and try to induce strategic voting of the voters; (2) the strategic voting behavior of the voters; including the proportion of voters that vote strategically, the factors that affect strategic voting (including voter information, parameters of the electoral system, socio-economic background, and political attitude of voters, etc.), and the pattern of strategic deliberation among voters; (3) If there will be strategic voting or “split-ticket voting” (voting for two different parties in two votes) when most of the voters can cast two votes in the 2012 Legco election; (4) If voters undertake strategic coordination on a family basis; that if members of a family deliberate together and allocate their votes according to certain strategic considerations.

449112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
449112.value: This project studies strategic voting behavior under proportional representation in the 2012 Legislative Council election. It will study how common it is for voters to give up on “hopeless” candidates or leading lists that have “excess” votes, and cast their votes for “marginal” candidates. It will also examine the phenomenon of family coordination in voting behavior, and study if the voters will adopt “split-ticket” voting when they have the opportunity to cast two votes, one for geographical and one for functional constituency in 2012. The project will examine the factors that affect strategic voting in various forms and at various levels, including different parameters of the electoral system, voter information about the race, household variables such as size and structure, political affiliation, and the like. The results of this project will shed much light on the voting behavior under proportional representation. It also allows us to understand how voting behavior affects party formation and future political development in Hong Kong, which enables us to better predict the political changes in the coming years. This research studies the phenomenon of strategic voting under proportional representation in the 2012 Legislative Council elections. By dint of a two-step survey, the research team hopes to study if and how voters strategically vote for marginal lists, distribute their votes to different lists among their family members, and split their votes to different parties among their geographical and functional votes. 本研究旨在實証地檢視在2012年立法會選舉中的策略投票狀況。透過兩階段的民意調查，本研究將審視選民是否會策略性地將票投給選情吃緊的候選人名單、會否在家庭中分票、以及會否在地區直選和功能選舉策略性地投給不同的政黨名單等。

449112.label: Realisation of objectives
449112.value: 1. The fieldwork collected extensive and comprehensive data to ascertain how the different parties and candidates faced strategical situations, including strategic coordination at the candidate level, inducing strategic voting of the voters, and prevent their own supporters from deserting them because of strategic voting considerations. 2. There is a certain percentage of voters who practised strategic voting in the PR elections, the proportion of which is lower than commonly expected from anecdotal evidences and candidates' evaluations. It seems that there is no clear and systematic pattern about who are more likely to vote strategically. 3. There is a certain amount of 'split-ticket' voting when voters consider how to use their two votes, one for the geographical constituency, and one for the functional constituency (DC II). Both the candidate interviews and surveys confirm this. 4. As reflected from our two stages of surveys and interviews, there is a small portion of voters who will engage in family voting. Due to the small number of cases, it is difficult to establish a definite pattern of family voting.

449112.label: Major findings and research outcome
449112.value: 1. The considerations about strategic voting form a central part of the campaign strategy of parties and candidates. Interviews showed that they always have in mind how to induce voters to vote strategically, and then prevent their votes from slipping awaty because of strategic voting. 2. From the voters' perspective, it seems that there are not that many voters really practicising strategic voting as commonly expected. Similarly, there are a small portion of voters who will coordinate their voting on a family basis, but the proportion is not big. 3. Further breakdowns showed that the pattern or direction of 'strategic voting' is quite diverse. There is no clear direction of strategic voting, which means its impacts on the eventual election result was uncertain. The impact of strategic voting on the election result may have been overstated. 4. There is a certain percentage of voters who practised 'split-voting' when they have two votes. That is, they applied different voting standards and used different criteria when they voted for the geographical constituencies, and the functional constituency (the 'super-DC' seats). Overall, the results showed that the institutional environment of the Hong Kong electoral system induced the voters and candidates to act strategically. The overall effect on the electoral outcome may be lower than commonly believed.

449112.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
449112.value: 1. This research can be replicated in future Hong Kong elections, as long as the electoral system remains largely unchanged. These should include studying strategic behavior at the candidate level, considerations of strategic voting at the voter level, voting of family as a unit, and split-voting between GC and FC voting. 2. More detailed research on the microscopic level can be conducted, especially regarding family-voting or family as a unit of voting.

449112.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
449112.value: In recent years, strategic voting has become an important pattern of voting behavior that affects election results in Hong Kong. This means that voters will desert their most-preferred candidate, in favor of others, because they believe the former has no chance to win or have "too many" votes. Through voter surveys, candidate interviews, and in-depth interviews of the voters, this research finds out that a certain portion of voters did vote strategically. For candidates, how to induce or prevent strategic voting always form an important part of their campaign strategy. The proportion of voters who practised strategic voting, however, are less than commonly estimated by the candidates. The 2012 election also marked the first time when most voters have two votes: one in geographical election and one in the "super-DC" seats. Research shows that some voters practice 'split-ticket' voting (voting for two separate parties strategically) when they have two votes. A small proportion of voters practice strategic coordination at the family level, distributing their votes according to a certain strategic calculation. The pattern of distribution, however, is very diverse.

449312.label: Realisation of objectives
449312.value: All three objectives stated in section 5.2 have been fully achieved. Participant recruitment In our original proposal, we proposed to recruit 250 individuals with recent-onset schizophrenia spectrum disorders at two specialty outpatient clinics and one community-based psychiatric rehabilitation organization and follow them up three times over one year at baseline, 6-, and 12-month. Recruitment was much more difficult than we anticipated given the number of people who met our inclusion criteria and were willing to participate was much fewer. Thus, we exhausted all possible outlets in Hong Kong and extended our recruitment strategies to psychiatric outpatient clinics at five hospitals (i.e., Kwai Chung Hospital, Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital, Kowloon Hospital, Queen Mary Hospital, and United Christian Hospital) and six non-governmental organizations (NGOs, i.e., New Life Psychiatric Rehabilitation Association, Baptist Oi Kwan Social Service, Caritas Hong Kong, The Mental Health Association of Hong Kong, Richmond Fellowship of Hong Kong, and Stewards). Within the study period, we successfully recruited 217 individuals (87% of the planned sample size) with recent-onset schizophrenia spectrum disorders from all sites available for recruitment after lengthy negotiation and engagement with relevant parties. 158 participants were followed up at 6-month and 138 participants were retained by the end of the study period at 12-month. A 64% retention rate for the 12-month follow-up was achieved, which is similar to other large-scale overseas studies conducted among people with schizophrenia spectrum disorders with a one-year follow-up (e.g., 59% retention rate was found in the study conducted by Rüsch and colleagues (2015) . Multimethod approach As stated in the original proposal, we employed a longitudinal mixed qualitative and quantitative method design to investigate the stated objectives with an aim to capture a more comprehensive understanding of consumer-defined recovery. For qualitative method, we invited participants to take part in a semi-structured interview, the Indiana Psychiatric Illness Interview (IPII; Lysaker, 2002), which was carried out by a trained interviewer. During the interview, participants shared their personal narratives on their experience during the course of illness, their sense of personhood, and attitudes towards their recovery process. The interviews were audio-taped and transcribed, and then coded using the Abbreviated Metacognition Assessment Scale (MAS-A; Lysaker et al., 2005) and Scale To Assess Narrative Development (STAND; Lysaker, Wickett, Campbell, & Buck, 2003) across all three time points. For quantitative method, a number of assessments were carried out by our trained research staff. These included the assessment of clinical symptoms, illness awareness, occupational and social functioning as well as executive functioning. Cognitive tests were also performed by our trained research staff including the Wisconsin Card Sorting Test and verbal fluency task. In addition to the above assessments, a battery of self-administered questionnaires was completed by the participants assessing their perception on a wide range of constructs including personal recovery, life satisfaction, self-stigma, well-being, depression, and service engagement. To complement with a cross-informant approach, we invited mental health practitioners and service providers to provide objective assessment on participants’ service engagement. Analytical methods Given the amount of data collected at each time point, we cleaned and coded the data throughout the study period. To address objective 1, we conducted the abovementioned qualitative and quantitative assessment across three different points, including baseline, 6-, and 12-month post-baseline. Even the descriptive data will be very informative for researchers and service providers to explore the changes in their illness awareness, personhood, and recovery over time as such data is currently not available elsewhere. To address objective 2, we first investigated how illness awareness and personhood affected life satisfaction among people with schizophrenia. Hierarchical linear regression was conducted to understand the relationship between illness awareness, personhood in terms of life satisfaction as well as self-stigma process and content during the course of the one-year study period. Specifically, we examined if baseline self-stigma content and self-stigma process moderated the relationship between baseline insight and life satisfaction at 6-month and 1-year follow-up. Baseline life satisfaction was put in block 1 as covariate. Baseline insight, self-stigma content, and self-stigma process were put in block 2, followed by the interaction terms (i.e., self-stigma process x insight and self-stigma content x insight) in block 3. The uniqueness of this investigation rests in including both self-stigma process and content into the investigation along with insight over the course of one year. We are the first research team to propose such conceptualization and splitting self-stigma into content and process as separate constructs influencing recovery. Besides self-stigma, we also unpackaged recovery into three distinct and interrelated components of clinical, functional, and personal recovery. Alongside with assessing the adverse impact of having schizophrenia on the individuals, which is common theme among researchers, we extended the investigation to exploring the extent to which people with schizophrenia may experience flourishing, moderate mental health, and languishing well-being as defined by Keyes (2007). Our investigation breaks away from the traditional focus on clinical recovery and expand into investigating possible experience of hedonic, eudaimonic, and social well-being, which are advocated by the World Health Organization to be important components of mental health for all. Hierarchical multiple regression was conducted to understand how various dimensions of recovery at baseline would be related to overall well-being as well as hedonic, eudaimonic, and social components of well-being at 6-month post-baseline. Clinical recovery (i.e., positive and negative symptoms of psychosis) and functional recovery (i.e., social and occupational functioning, and everyday functioning) were entered into the first block of the regression model, followed by personal recovery in the second block. Besides, hierarchical logistic regression analyses were used to determine the effect of recovery variables at baseline on flourishing and languishing at 6-month post-baseline. To examine the moderating effect of clinical and functional recovery, the interaction terms of independent variable and moderator variables were added into the subsequent block of the regression models. For objective 3, structural equation modeling was employed to examine the longitudinal effects of family support and recovery orientation of services on personal factors such as self-stigma and the progression of recovery (i.e., recovery participation and outcomes). We hypothesize that family support and service orientation at baseline (predictors) would predict recovery participation and self-stigma at 6-month post-baseline (mediators), which would in turn predict recovery outcomes at 12-month post-baseline (outcomes) after controlling for the effects of significant covariates. Measurement models, with each construct treated as a latent factor manifested by three observed parcels, were defined to test the underlying psychometric structure of the latent factors. Following the testing of the measurement models, we tested the structural models with hypothesized relationships among the latent factors. We also will be conducting cross-lagged analyses to investigate the causal effects of personal and service factors on recovery and participation to account for the autoregressive effects of personal and service factors and recovery outcomes over time.

449312.label: Major findings and research outcome
449312.value: The promotion of insight among people with schizophrenia posed a dilemma as higher insight is linked to positive clinical outcomes but negative psychological outcomes. To unravel this dilemma, we unpackaged self-stigma into negative meaning of the illness (content) and the recurrence of such thoughts (process). We found that baseline insight was predictive of lowered life satisfaction at six-month when self-stigma content and process was high. Baseline insight was predictive of better life satisfaction at one-year when self-stigma process was low. Findings suggested the detrimental effects of insight can result from the presence of cognitive content and habitual process of self-stigma. Future insight promotion interventions should address both self-stigma content and process among people with schizophrenia so to maximize the beneficial effects of insight. As to well-being, based on the categorization by Keyes (2007), we found that 28.2% of the participants were considered as flourishing; 52.5% were moderately mentally healthy; 19.3% were languishing. These results were enlightening as it demonstrated that people with schizophrenia can continue to flourish inspite of their illness. The percentages were consistent with the figures found among people with psychiatric diagnoses in the United States (Keyes, 2005; McGaffin et al., 2015 ). While clinical recovery was predictive of better hedonic well-being at 6-month, personal recovery was found to be the strongest predictor on different dimensions of well-being, above and beyond the effects of clinical and functional recovery. Moderation analysis showed that the effect of personal recovery on well-being did not depend on clinical and functional recovery, which implied that people can be involved in the process of personal recovery regardless of their clinical stability and functional competence. Given the salutogenic effects of personal recovery, our findings provided strong justification for a greater emphasis on person-centered, recovery-oriented services to promote the well-being of people with schizophrenia. To examine how self-stigma and service engagement at 6-month mediated the relationship between perceived recovery service orientation and family support at baseline on personal recovery at 12-month, a structural model was tested. Structural equation modeling results demonstrated good model fit (CFI=.96, TLI=.95, RMSEA=.06). Recovery service orientation and family support at baseline were negatively associated with self-stigma and positively associated with service engagement at 6-month; reduced self-stigma and higher service engagement were positively associated with personal recovery at 12-month. This indicated that recovery orientation of providers and family support can directly influence a person’s self-concept and engagement with service, which affect their recovery.

449312.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
449312.value: The present study has extended our previous research on the discrimination on recovery (Mak et al., 2017) and the common sense model of mental illness (Chan & Mak, 2016). We plan to examine these models using a cross-lagged design. The narrative (qualitative) and quantitative data on illness awareness across a year which has much potential in understanding how individuals make sense of their illness and how their narrative can be transformed into empowerment to fight against stigma and an identity beyond patienthood. As we found self-stigma content and process were detrimental to life satisfaction among people with schizophrenia, we are collaborating with New Life Psychiatric Rehabilitation Association on a self-stigma reduction program based on Acceptance and Commitment Therapy to investigate whether the program can tackle both content and process of self-stigma and facilitate the building of valued living among mental health service users. As we showed personal recovery as the most potent predictor of well-being among people with schizophrenia, this provided empirical support in advocating for recovery-oriented practices in local mental health services organizations. The PI is collaborating with four NGOs in a longitudinal evaluation of peer support workers on service orientation and recovery of their service users.

449312.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
449312.value: This study examined recovery experiences among 217 people with schizophrenia over one year. The study was significant by accounting the effects of a comprehensive set of personal, family, and service on a range of psychiatric and well-being outcomes. The findings laid a solid foundation for consumer-oriented research and practices. Our investigation revealed that the majority of people with schizophrenia (80.7%) are enjoying at least moderate levels of well-being. Our findings also showed that their well-being does not depend entirely on their symptoms and the ability to manage tasks in their daily life. Rather, it signifies the importance of developing personally valued goals and identity beyond being a patient. We found that illness awareness may contribute to better life satisfaction only in the absence of negative meaning to their illness and the recurrence of such stigmatizing thoughts. We also found that if the services received are conducive to recovery and they are supported by their family, people with schizophrenia would participate more actively in their treatment and have better self-concept. All these predict better recovery. We suggest that greater emphasis be placed on family education, person-centered and recovery-oriented services. We should also address self-stigma sooner to maximize benefits on their well-being.

449312.label: Other impact (e.g. award of patents or prizes, collaboration with other research institutions, technology transfer, etc.)
449312.value: Findings of the present study pointed to the importance of promoting personal recovery among people living with mental illnesses. We are working closely with different mental health service agencies in Hong Kong to ensure that therapeutic interventions and psychiatric rehabilitation services are geared towards personal recovery. In addition to the previously mentioned collaborations, the PI is collaborating with New Life Psychiatric Rehabilitation Association in a randomized controlled trial of the Wellness Recovery Action Plan® (WRAP), a self-management program for people with mental illness, on their self-stigma and well-being. Our findings also shed light on the establishment of peer-led services in Hong Kong. The PI is in the discussion with four NGOs (New Life Psychiatric Rehabilitation Association, Baptist Oi Kwan Social Service, Caritas Hong Kong, and Mental Health Association of Hong Kong) in the evaluation of their Recovery College in the coming three years. In addition, we are actively disseminating the importance of personal recovery and the impact of stigma to the broader community through collaborations with different stakeholders and community-based organizations. The PI has co-found StoryTaler, a community-based social action group that promotes mental health and fight against stigma. Based on our study findings, psychoeducational materials were developed and posted on the Facebook page, with a weekly reach of 100,000. The study findings also received attention from the Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust (HKJC). The PI has submitted a proposal to HKJC to implement recovery-oriented and well-being programs and large-scale anti-stigma campaigns in the community in the coming three years. References: Keyes, C. 449412.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
449412.value: The current study aims to investigate the relationship between the writing proficiency of pre-service ESL teachers and their assessments of student scripts. Two research questions are pursued: (1) In what ways does the writing proficiency of pre-service ESL teachers differ as characterized by the distinguishing features inherent in such teachers’ writing performances? (2) What is the relationship between pre-service ESL teachers’ writing proficiency and their assessments, as reflected through the quantitative scores and qualitative comments of students’ written scripts? In addressing the two research questions, the study therefore comprises two parts: Part I applies a discourse analysis of the writing performance – incorporating analytic discourse categories – of pre-service ESL teachers to identify teachers’ differing writing proficiencies. These features are selected and quantified on the basis of previous theoretical and empirical studies assessing L2 writing proficiency. Results of Part I will be analyzed to group the pre-service ESL teachers into three levels of writing proficiency. Part II then investigates whether pre-service ESL teachers at the three levels of writing proficiency differ in their assessments of student scripts. For this purpose, six teachers from each of the three levels will be randomly selected to score student scripts, which consist of 45 written scripts of secondary students. The 18 teachers will be consequently involved in think-aloud sessions to provide verbal comments to explain and justify the scores they awarded. Data, from both quantitative and qualitative sources, will be analyzed as follows. In Part I, results from the discourse analysis of the selected features will be investigated to depict a complete picture of the different writing proficiencies of the pre-service ESL teachers. In Part II, the scores assigned by the teachers at three levels will first be analyzed through Many-Faceted Rasch Measurement (Linacre, 2011), with the comparison of verbal protocols being followed in terms of the similarities and differences of both the product and process of teachers’ assessing behaviors. Findings of the study will contribute in three ways. First, the data of actual writing performance will provide empirical evidence for identifying different levels of writing proficiency of pre-service ESL teachers. Second, the link between the writing proficiency of pre-service ESL teachers and their assessments of student scripts will be established. Third, the findings will have a sustainable contribution specifically to teacher evaluation, the training of teacher language proficiency, and the improvement of teachers’ assessment literacy in high-stakes and L2 classroom writing assessment. 本研究旨在探索香港職前英文教師的寫作能力和對學生寫作評價之間的關係，以解決兩個研究問題：第一，有不同寫作特徵的職前英文教師，寫作能力有何不同？第二，根據學生寫作的量性分數和質性評價，職前英文教師的寫作能力和對學生寫作的評價有何關係？為解決上述兩個研究問題，本研究主要分為兩個部分： 第一部分採用語篇分析法，以各種語篇類別，仔細分析職前英文教師的寫作能力，當中的語篇特徵是根據多個二語寫作能力理論和實證研究所篩選及量化的。其後按照分析結果，將英文教師的寫作能力分為三個組別。 第二部分研究三個寫作能力組別的英文教師在評價學生寫作方面有否區別。研究員將在每組內隨機抽選六位教師（共十八位）對四十五篇中學生的英文寫作測驗卷進行評分。隨後，這十八位教師將參與有聲思維研究，以口頭解釋評分準則。 本研究將用以下方式，分析所得的量性和質性資料。第一部分，藉所選取的寫作特徵，對教師寫作表現進行話語分析，以描繪出英語教師不同寫作能力的面貌。第二部分首先使用多面Rasch模型，分析教師對學生寫作的評分，其後就教師在評價結果及過程上的異同，比較英文教師對學生寫作評價的口頭報告。 本研究的結果會有以下三方面貢獻：第一，本研究收集英文教師實際寫作表現的資料，為界定職前英文教師的不同寫作能力提供實證依據。第二，本研究建立職前教師寫作能力和評價學生寫作之間的關係。第三，本研究對教師評估、教師語言能力培訓、以及提升教師評價高階寫作和評核學生二語寫作的素養，均有長遠的貢獻。

449612.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
449612.value: Tranquil spaces are under threat throughout the world from transportation noise and industrial sound especially in densely populated areas. They are vitally important to health and well being and the relief of stress from sustained attention necessary in urban living. For this reason tranquility spaces are often referred to as “restorative environments”. Therefore it is important to elucidate, identify, protect and if possible enhance the benefits of these areas. A tool is required to facilitate these key tasks. The study will conceptualize the understanding of tranquility and see whether or not some places are considered tranquil in Hong Kong. If these exist, what are their characteristics and how do people perceive such places? As tranquility is often associated with noise, the method will involve the assessment of traffic noise and the measurement of the percentage of natural and contextual features at the scenes. Validation and subsequent analysis will involve the adoption of Tranquility Rating Prediction Tool (TRAPT) that was tested elsewhere. This unique tool is useful in identifying valued tranquil spaces and can be used by a range of stakeholders including administrators, planners and those charged with park and countryside management. The proposed research will evaluate the usefulness of tranquil spaces in the Hong Kong situation by first validating and calibrating its predictions using local residents. The tranquility assessments in this study will be compared with those used to develop the prediction tool and will enable the tool to be validated so as to suite the local situation. Once refined, its applicability will be demonstrated in 6 contrasting environments in urban and rural parks and open spaces. For this purpose the range of tranquility in the selected areas will be predicted. In addition to this, a questionnaire survey of users of these selected areas will be used to further evaluate perceived tranquility, benefits and reasons for any enhanced ratings or shortfalls. The results and analysis generated will add to the growing body of knowledge in this discipline and help decision makers, planners and those with responsibility for the management of open spaces and countryside environment. This will help to relate perceived tranquility to the degree of relaxation reported by questionnaire respondents and in addition their personal levels of anxiety. This link will be important in establishing the tool as a measure of the restorative nature of an environment which relates directly to important issues of health and well being. 項目名稱：寧靜概念的闡述和在香港的評級工具 在世界各地，特別是人口稠密地區，交通噪音和工業的聲音使寧靜的空間受到威脅。在城市生活中，寧靜的空間對身體健康和舒緩壓力有重要意義。出於這個原因，平靜的空間通常被稱為“復元環境”。因此，闡明，識別，保護這些地方，并且在可能的情況下加強這些領域的益處至關重要。爲了完成這些關鍵任務，我們需要建立一種工具。 這項研究將概念化的理解安寧，看看香港的某些地方是否被認為是安靜的。如果這種安靜的地方確實存在，他們有什麼特點以及人們怎樣看待這樣的地方？寧靜往往與噪音相關聯，該方法將涉及交通噪音評估以及對自然和情境特徵的觀測。驗證和隨後的分析將涉及“寧靜等級預測工具”（TRAPT）。此工具已經在其他地方進行過測試。這一獨特的工具對於鑒定有價值的寧靜空間有著重要作用，并且適合一系列的利益相關者使用，包括行政人員，規劃者和公園及鄉村的管理者。本次研究將首先通過對本地居民的調查來評估寧靜空間對香港的重要性。 本實驗所採用的寧靜程度評測方法將對比其他研發寧靜程度等級預測工具過程中所用的評測方法。實驗將對此種預測工具加以測試和完善以使之適用於香港本土情況。待完善後，實驗將在城鄉公園及其他開放空間中選取六種環境展示工具的可行性。為達此目的，實驗將對所選環境的寧靜度進行預測。此外，實驗內容還包括向所選環境中生活的居民派發問卷，借此進一步評測居民所感知的寧靜度（perceived tranquility）、寧靜度提高的好處及寧靜度等級變化的原因。實驗結果和分析資料將豐富該研究領域的現有知識，並對決策者、規劃者及負責管理開放空間和鄉村環境的工作者有所助益。實驗還將有助於將所感知的寧靜度和問卷受訪者回饋的放鬆度及個人焦慮度相聯繫。該聯繫為此種預測工具的可行性提供了有力佐證，證明其可用于測量與健康和民生議題直接相關的環境的修復特性。

450012.label: Project Title(Chinese)
450012.value: 知識產權與製藥業：香港監管框架的評估

450012.label: Project Objectives
450012.value: Critically analyse Hong Kong's legal framework relating to intellectual property rights and pharmaceuticals patents; Collect and evaluate the views of all relevant stakeholders; Provide a forum for relevant stakeholders to share views, concerns and suggestions; Compare policy choices and relevant laws in other jurisdictions; Recommend amendments modernizing relevant laws to best enable the government to meet the needs of all stakeholders.

Collect and evaluate the views of all relevant stakeholders;
