464212.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
464212.value: The aim of this project is to determine the incidence, risk factors and potential impact of chronic postsurgical pain in contemporary surgery. Persistent pain for months or years is a well-recognized complication after major surgery. However, results of recent epidemiological studies, and data from our own research suggested that this may also affect patients receiving minor procedures such as hernia repair or breast lump excision. We have recently shown that a number of intraoperative interventions such as nitrous oxide administration, regional nerve block and minimally invasive surgical approaches, may reduce the risk of persistent pain. Unfortunately, existing studies are limited in their methodology and generalizability. Therefore the risk factors associated with chronic postsurgical pain remain uncertain. We propose to conduct a large prospective multicenter cohort study in 5,000 patients undergoing a wide spectrum of surgical procedures, in order to determine the current incidence of, and the risk factors for, chronic postsurgical pain. The experience and impact of pain that has arisen and persisted for 12 months after the initial surgery will be recorded using established instruments. The risk factors leading to the development of chronic postsurgical pain will be explored with multivariable logistic models. Our secondary goals are to determine its impact on patients’ daily living and social activities and to identify potential target interventions for the prevention of chronic postsurgical pain. The findings of this study should be of considerable social and economic significance. Given that a large number of patients undergo surgery worldwide, even a small incidence of chronic postsurgical pain would indicate an addition of millions of patients being disabled by chronic pain annually. These patients will need long-term follow-up, repeated interventions and may become dependent on and addicted to strong analgesics, such as opioids. If, as we believe it will, our study confirms that the incidence of chronic postsurgical pain is significant, a strong case arises for devoting increased resources to address this health problem. 本項研究的目的在於探討現代手術中慢性術後痛的發生率、危險因素以及潛在影響。 持續數月乃至數年的慢性疼痛是廣為人知的大外科手術後的並發症。然而，最近的流行病學調查結果，以及我們自己的研究結果均表明，慢性持續性疼痛同樣會發生在例如疝修復和乳房腫塊切除等小手術後。我們最近研究發現，一些術中乾預措施，例如給予二氧化氮、局部神經阻滯和微創手術方法，都可以降低術後慢性痛的發生。很遺憾，現有的研究受到其方法學和普遍性的限制。因此，慢性術後痛發生的危險因素目前尚不知曉。 我們計劃進行大樣本的前瞻性多中心隊列研究，納入5000名接受廣泛的外科手術患者，從而探討當前慢性術後疼痛的發病率及風險因素。對於初次手術後出現、並持續12個月的疼痛經歷及其影響將使用既定的儀器進行記錄。可能導致疼痛發生的危險因素將使用多元回歸分析進行研究。我們的另一個研究目的在於探索慢性疼痛對於病人日常生活和社會活動的影響，以及確定乾預目標從而預防慢性疼痛的發生。 本次研究的發現將會對社會和經濟有很重要的意義。全世界每年都有大量的病人接受手術，即使只有很小的發生率，也意味著每年發生慢性疼痛的病人將會數以百萬計的增加。這些病人將會需要長期的護理、重複的干預措施，以及依賴強效鎮痛劑（例如阿片類藥物），甚至成癮。如果正如我們所認為的，我們的研究結果可以確定慢性疼痛的發生率是很顯著的，那麼更多的資源需要投入來解決這個健康問題。

464212.label: Realisation of objectives
464212.value: We have completed a large prospective multicenter cohort study to determine the incidence of, and risk factors associated with chronic postsurgical pain. Between January 2013 and December 2014, a total of 5,006 patients in five district and university-affiliated teaching hospitals in Hong Kong. The Persistent Pain after Surgery Study included a representative sample of adult patients, aged ≥ 18 years, undergoing a surgical procedure that includes a skin incision will participate in the study. Both in-patient and ambulatory surgery will be included. A total of 7,115 patients were identified, 70.4% of patients consented for the study and were included in the study. Only 3 patients could not be contacted at 12-month after surgery, therefore successful follow-up was completed in 99.5% of patients. Overall, 606 (12.1%) patients reported pain over the wound at 12 months after surgery. This was higher than we anticipated and therefore we have sufficient power to develop a risk prediction model, and to report the impact of chronic postsurgical on patient’s quality of life and functional performance. In addition we were able to identify agents that may be useful to prevent chronic postsurgical pain.

464212.label: Major findings and research outcome
464212.value: At 12 months after surgery, 606 (12.1%) of patients had pain over the wound that had been persisted from the index surgery (Objective 1). Among patients with pain, the median pain score (0 = no pain; 10 = worst pain) was 3.2. Thirty-three percent of patients had moderate-to-severe pain (pain score ≥ 5) and reported features of neuropathic pain. These patients were taking regular gabapentoids, tricyclic antidepressants, nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs or tramadol. A third of the patients also underwent cognitive behavioral therapy training. Patients with chronic postsurgical pain reported significant difficulties with general activity, mood, walking, relations with others, sleep, and enjoyment of life. Chronic postsurgical pain also impaired mobility, self-care, and usual activity, in addition to provoking discomfort, anxiety, and depression (Objective 3). We have conducted a logistic regression analysis, the risk factors [odds ratio (95% confidence intervals, CI)] for chronic postsurgical pain included (Objective 2): (1) Younger age (per year) 1.37 (1.23-1.52) (2) Female 1.27 (1.03-1.55) (3) Diabetes (using insulin) 2.31 (1.35-3.94) (4) Preoperative pain syndrome 2.21 (1.72-2.83) (5) Surgery for fracture 1.97 (1.34-2.90) (6) Open abdominal surgery 1.60 (1.21-2.11) We have also conducted an exploratory regression analysis and found that nitrous oxide reduced chronic postsurgical pain, odds ratio (95%CI): 0.52 (0.35-0.77). We have therefore conducted an analysis to test the hypothesis that intraoperative nitrous oxide provided long-term analgesia as a post-hoc analysis of a large randomized controlled trial. The ENIGMA-II chronic pain analysis found that nitrous oxide did not impact on chronic pain, but benefits may still be possible in Asian patients (Br J Anaesth – paper accepted). Similarly, ketamine given during surgery and continued for the first day after surgery reduced chronic postsurgical pain, odds ratio (95%CI): 0.63 (0.47-0.83). This however requires confirmation with large clinical trial (Objective 4). In addition, we have conducted a genetic association study. In this substudy, blood samples from the patient cohort were genotyped for a total of 768 single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) from 65 genes using the GoldenGate BeadArray assay. We found single nucleotide polymorphism in gene for cathepsin G and brain-derived neurotropic factor (BDNF) reduced the risk of pain, odds ratio (95%CI): 0.57 (0.23-1.42) and 0.75 (0.62-0.91), respectively (Anesthesiology 2015; 123: 838-50). Please note that although we acknowledged the GRF grant in both publications, unfortunately the actual grant reference number was incorrect in Anesthesiology.

464212.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
464212.value: In our study, we have identified that ketamine is a potential interventions that may reduce chronic postsurgical pain. We have designed a large randomized controlled trial to determine the risks and benefits for the use of ketamine to prevent chronic pain after surgery. In our genetic association study, we have identified two important molecules (cathepsin G and BDNF) that may predispose the development of chronic postsurgical pain. They are plausible therapeutic targets for future drug development. Laboratory investigations are currently underway to develop a peptide that may block the increase in BDNF during development of chronic postsurgical pain.

464212.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
464212.value: Persistent pain for months or years is a devastating complication after major surgery. We have conducted a large, multicenter, cohort study of 5,000 patients to characterize the epidemiology of chronic postsurgical pain in a wide variety of contemporary surgery. In the Persistent Pain after Surgery Study, we found that about 12% of patients reported chronic pain over the wound site that had persisted from the index surgery performed 12 months ago. Chronic postsurgical pain adversely affected quality of life and significantly impaired general activity, walking, sleep, and enjoyment of life. Chronic postsurgical pain also provoked anxiety and depression. We found younger patients, female, patients with history of diabetes, prior pain syndrome, having surgery for fracture and open bowel surgery were at higher risks. Finally, in an exploratory analysis, we found that intraoperative administration of nitrous oxide and ketamine may prevent chronic postsurgical pain. However, their proposed therapeutic effects need to be tested by large clinical trials.

464412.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
464412.value: 本课题的研究目标是研究模式植物拟南芥中甾醇类植物激素--油菜素内酯（BRs）增加缺氮胁迫下花青素合成的机理。 作为甾醇类植物激素，BRs 在结构上和动物及昆虫的甾醇类激素相似，而且在植物界广泛存在。过去三十年的大量生理学研究表明，BRs几乎可以影响植物生长发育的每一个方面，包括细胞分裂、细胞伸长、种子萌发、生殖发育及衰老等。除此之外，BRs还被证明能增加植物对多种逆境（包括生物逆境和非生物逆境）的抗性。为了了解BRs的作用机理，人们在过去十多年里在模式植物拟南芥中开展了深入的分子遗传学研究，并确立了一条从细胞表面BR受体到细胞核转录因子的信号传递途径。尽管如此，人们对BRs调节诸多发育过程的分子机理仍知之甚少。 氮素（N)是植物生长发育的必需营养，也是限制农业生产的一个重要因子。为保证世界作物产量和粮食生产，人们每年要在农田里投入大量氮肥，但这同时也给我们赖以生存的环境造成了很大危害。因此，创建具有高氮肥利用效率或对低氮胁迫有高抵抗力的植物，对农业高产和环境的可持续发展都至关重要。BR作为一类重要的植物激素，可以增强植物对多种逆境的抵抗力，但目前还不知它们是否参与了植物对营养胁迫的反应。我们最近在拟南芥中的研究发现，BR能增强植物对低氮胁迫的耐受性，而这似乎与BR处理的植物中花青素（Anthocyanin）的合成增加有关。本课题的研究目标是探讨缺氮胁迫下BR 如何诱导植物中花青素的合成，以及增加的花青素合成是否与BR诱导的植物抗逆性有关。

464512.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
464512.value: The aim of this study is to investigate the molecular mechanisms used by human Enterovirus 71 (EV71) to escape from the antiviral effects of the Type I Interferons. The recent outbreak of Enterovirus 71 (EV71) infected over a million children and caused approximately 1,000 deaths in China. To date, no effective vaccine or therapy has been used to prevent or treat EV71 infection. While interferons have been used successfully for decades in the treatment of patients with Hepatitis B and C viral infections; however, interferons have not been effective in the treatment of EV71 infections. Our team has investigated the mechanisms of EV71 infection and the treatment strategies, and has identified an essential viral component that functions as an antagonist to interferon signaling. We have found that EV71 antagonizes the Type I interferon signaling by downregulation of interferon alpha receptor 1 (IFNAR1). In this study, we will identify the host protein target(s) of EV71 and explore the mechanisms used by EV71 to downregulate IFNAR1. The results of this study will provide new insight into the viral strategies used to antagonize the Type I IFN response and will facilitate the development of new antiviral therapies for Enterovirus 71 and other picornaviruses. 腸病毒EV71對抗幹擾素信號轉導的分子機理研究 本研究的目的是揭示人腸病毒EV71如何逃避I型干擾素的抗病毒效果。 最近， EV71在亞太地區特別是中國大規模爆發， 感染100多萬兒童，導致約1000人死亡。 目前， 既無疫苗也無有效的藥物防治這種病毒。 儘管干擾素用於治療病毒感染（如乙肝病毒， 丙肝病毒）已有二三十年， 但對EV71感染的療效甚微。 我們研究團隊在研究EV71的感染機理和治療方面有良好的工作基礎， 發現了病毒蛋白可有效的降低I型干擾素受體， 從而阻斷了干擾素的抗病毒效果。 本項研究將尋找宿主細胞內的EV71靶標，並揭示EV71病毒下調干擾素受體的分子機理。

464712.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
464712.value: PPARδ和SIRT1的相互作用对糖尿病和肥胖状态下血管内皮功能的保护作用 近年来，以胰岛素抵抗，血脂异常、中心性肥胖、和高血压等疾病合并出现为特征的代谢综合征（MS）患者迅速增多，成为公众健康的主要焦点。其中大部分患者主要死于代谢综合征引起的心血管和肾的并发症，因此，建立和开发改善心血管功能，尤其是肥胖相关的糖尿病的心血管功能的策略显得尤为紧迫。血管内皮功能的正常与否是能否维持血管稳态的基础，也是心血管未来功能好坏的重要线索。最近的报道强调了PPARδ在糖尿病中增加胰岛素信号敏感性的治疗潜力。但是，大部分研究还主要集中在PPARδ对代谢的影响，对于PPARδ在调节心血管功能中的作用知之甚少。 衰老方面的研究表明NAD依赖的脱乙酰化酶sirtuins家族的SIRT1蛋白（Sir2同源物）可能是代谢综合征和心血管疾病的一个新的治疗靶点。但是SIRT1介导的在糖尿病和肥胖状态下的血管内皮保护作用的分子机制还不明了。本研究将探索PPARδ 和/或 SIRT1对糖尿病血管功能障碍的保护作用及PPARδ 和SIRT1的可能的相互作用。这一研究结果将为SIRT1和PPARδ作为改善糖尿病和肥胖想关的血管疾病的潜在的重要药物靶点提供科学依据。

464712.label: Realisation of objectives
464712.value: In Objective 1, we proposed to investigate whether SIRT1 activation ameliorates endothelial dysfunction associated with diabetes and obesity. We obtained the following results showing the effect of SIRT1 on endothelial dysfunction. This objective is well achieved. Endothelial-specific overexpression of SIRT1 rescued endothelium-dependent vasodilation inhibited by risk factors. Human SIRT1 (SIRT1-Tg), and mutant SIRT1 (H363Y, SIRT1-mut) was overexpressed in the endothelium by Icam2 promoter in C57BL/6 mice. Different risk factors such as high glucose (HG), lysophosphatydylcholines (LPC), or angiotensin II (AngII) were used for ex vivo incubation of isolated aortic segments, before endothelium-dependent dilatations (EDR) was performed. We found that HG (30 mmol/L, 36 h), LPC (30 μmol/L, 16 h), and AngII, 0.5 μmol/L, 16 h) impaired EDR in wild type (WT) (Figure 1A-C). Similar impairments were also found in aortas from SIRT1-mut mice (Figure 1G-I). However, EDRs were protected in aortas from SIRT1-tg mice treated with HG, LPC, or AngII (Figure 1D-F), indicating that endothelial SIRT1 overexpression protects against endothelial dysfunction induced by various cardiovascular risk factors. WT, SIRT1-Tg, and SIRT1-mut mice were fed with high fat diet for 3 months to induced obesity (DIO). Endothelial function was measured in aorta and resistance mesenteric arteries. Similar reduction of EDR was found in aorta from WT and SIRT1-mut mice (Figure 2A, C), which was absent in aortas from SIRT1-Tg mice (Figure 2B). In addition, flow mediated dilation (FMD) which is another parameter of endothelial function was examined in mesenteric resistance arteries. FMD was significantly reduced in DIO WT and SIRT1-mut mice but preserved in DIO SIRT1-Tg mice (Figure 2D-E). SIRT1 overexpression increased Akt and eNOS activity in DIO mice. Phosphorylation of Akt at Ser473 and eNOS at Ser1177 was examined in aortas from WT, SIRT1-Tg, and SIRT1-mut mice. The decreased eNOS and Akt phosphorylation in WT mice aorta with DIO was not found in aortas from SIRT1-Tg mice (Figure 3A-D). Phospho-Akt was also reduced in aortas from DIO SIRT1-mut mice compared to its control, despite that p-Akt was higher in SIRT1-mut control mice (Figure 3A, C). Phospho-eNOS remained low in both control and DIO SIRT1-mut mice (Figure 3B, D). ROS production in the endothelium was measured by DHE fluorescence en face. Aortas from DIO WT and SIRT1-mut mice have significantly more ROS production than those from DIO SIRT1-Tg mice (Figure 3E-F). These data indicate that SIRT1 overexpression improves NO bioavailability by upregulating Akt and eNOS activtity while reducing ROS production. In Objective 2, we proposed to investigate whether PPARδ plays a key role in the endothelial protective effect of SIRT1 activation. Our data showed that resveratrol, a SIRT1 activator, promotes PPARδ transcriptional activity and the beneficial effect of resveratrol was absent in PPARδ mutant mice. This objective is well achieved. Phamacological activation of SIRT1 improves endothelium-dependent vasodilation in db/db mice through PPARδ. Because we observed upregulation of Akt and eNOS activity in SIRT1-Tg mice, while our previous study showed that PPARδ agonist GW501516 (or GW1516 in short) upregulates Akt and eNOS activity, we wondered whether SIRT1 may also improve endothelial function through PPARδ dependent mechanism. We used aortas from db/db mice, and treated with different pharmacological tools. We showed that SIRT1 activator CAY10602 (2 μmol/L, 24 h), or resveratrol (20 μmol/L, 24 h) improved EDR in aortas from db/db mice, which was inhibited by co-incubation with SIRT1 inhibitor sirtinol (10 μmol/L) or EX-527 (5 μmol/L) (Figure 4A-B), indicating that resveratrol, like CAY10602, works through SIRT1 in the endothelium. Importantly, co-incubation with PPARδ antagonist GSK0660 (5 μmol/L) inhibited EDRs improved by CAY10602 or resveratrol in aortas from db/db mouse, while PPARγ antagonist GW9662 (5 μmol/L) did not have such effects (Figure 4C-D). Next we used Ppard-wt and Ppard-mut mice fed with high fat diet to induce endothelial dysfunction and some DIO mice were treated with resveratrol orally for 2 weeks. DIO Ppard-wt and Ppard-mut mice showed similar impaired EDRs in aortas. However, resveratrol treatment improved EDRs in aortas from Ppard-wt, but not Ppard-mut mice (Figure 5A-B). In addition, FMD was also enhanced in DIO Ppard-wt mice treated with resveratrol, but not in DIO Ppard-mut mice (Figure 5C, E). The effect of CAY10602 was also tested in isolated aortas from DIO Ppard-wt and Ppard-mut mice, which showed similar improvement of EDR in WT but not mutant mice (Figure 5D). Both in vivo and ex vivo results indicated that the protective effect of SIRT1 activation might be mediated through PPARδ directly or indirectly. Activation of SIRT1 upregulates PPARδ in endothelial cells. To further verify whether SIRT1 activation upregulations PPARδ transcriptional activity, we examined PPRE luciferase activity in HUVECs treated with resveratrol with or without inhibitor sirtinol, using GW1516 as the PPARδ ligand. In HUVECs with exogenous overexpression of PPARδ, reseveratrol increased PPRE luciferase activity, similarly compared with GW1516, which was inhibited by sirtinol (Figure 6A), indicating resveratrol increases PPARδ-induced transcription. In Objective 3, we proposed whether SIRT1 contributes to the protective effect of AMPK/PPARδ on endothelial function in obese and diabetic mice. Our results demonstrated that effect of SIRT1 was lost in Ppard mutant mice, indicated that it is mediated by upregulating PPARδ activity/expression in Objective 2. Meanwhile, in aorta from Ppard-mut mouse, the expression of SIRT1 reduced, indicated that SIRT1 expression in endothelium may be partially dependent on PPARδ (Figure 6B). Because AMPK is considered to be upstream of PPARδ, AMPK expression and activity was unaffected in aorta from Ppard-mut mice. However, pharmacological inhibitors of PPARδ, GSK0660 did not counteract the action of resveratrol or CAY10602, indicating that although the expression of SIRT1 might depend on PPARδ, the functional effect of PPARδ activation especially to increase NO bioavailability was unaffected. This confirms that instead of interaction between PPARδ and SIRT1, SIRT1 may be upstream of PPARδ, and the effect of SIRT1 in the endothelium is dependent on PPARδ expression. This objective is also achieved.

464712.label: Major findings and research outcome
464712.value: 1. Activation of SIRT1 by resveratrol ameliorates endothelial dysfunction in obese mice through PPARδ We used endothelial-specific overexpression of human SIRT1 and mutant SIRT1 to show that SIRT1 protects against endothelial dysfunction in isolated vessels induced by cardiovascular risk factors, and also in vivo in high fat diet fed mice, indicating the beneficial role of SIRT1 in endothelium. Second, by using Ppard mutant mice, we showed that resveratrol improves endothelial function through upregulation of PPARδ expression/activity. This part of results is under preparation and is intended to submit to one of AHA journals for consideration of publication within 6 weeks. 2. PPARδ Is Required for Exercise to Attenuate Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress and Endothelial Dysfunction in Diabetic Mice. Diabetes 2016 Nov; db161039. Epub ahead of print PPARδ is a crucial mediator for exercise to exert beneficial effect on vascular endothelium in diabetic mice. In db/db mice and high fat diet -induced obese mice, four weeks treadmill exercise restores endothelium-dependent vasodilation of aortas and flow-mediated vasodilation in resistance mesenteric arteries; whereas genetic ablation of Ppard abolished such improvements. Exercise induces AMPK activation and subsequent PPARδ activation that helps to reduce endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress and oxidative stress thus increases NO bioavailability. Chemical chaperones, 4-phenyl butyric acid and tauroursodeoxycholic acid decreases ER stress and protects against endothelial dysfunction in diabetic mice. Our results demonstrate that PPARδ-mediated inhibition of ER stress contributes to the vascular benefits of exercise and provide potentially effective targets for treating diabetic vasculopathy. 3. Paeonol protects against endoplasmic reticulum stress-induced endothelial dysfunction via AMPK/PPARδ signaling pathway. Biochem Pharmacol. 2016 Sep 15;116:51-62. doi: 10.1016/j.bcp.2016.07.013. Paeonol increased the expression of 5' adenosine monophosphate-activated protein kinase (AMPK) and PPARδ expression and activity while restoring the decreased phosphorylation of eNOS. The present study delineates that paeonol protects against tunicamycin-induced vascular endothelial dysfunction by inhibition of ER stress and oxidative stress, thus elevating NO bioavailability via the AMPK/PPARδ signaling pathway. 4. Metformin protects endothelial function in diet-induced obese mice by inhibition of endoplasmic reticulum stress through 5' adenosine monophosphate-activated protein kinase-peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor δ pathway. Arterioscler Thromb Vasc Biol. 2014 Apr;34(4):830-6. doi: 10.1161/ATVBAHA.113.301938. Metformin restores endothelial function through inhibiting ER stress and oxidative stress and increasing NO bioavailability on activation of AMPK/PPARδ pathway in obese diabetic mice.

464712.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
464712.value: These studies have helped us to understand better about the important role of PPARdelta in the regulation of vascular function, particularly in mediating the vascular beneficial effect of physical exercise and metformin treatment to diabetic mice. We are currently making endothelial specific PPARdelta knockout mice and we will use these mice to further demonstrate the important link between endothelial PPARdelta and Sirt1 to protect vascular function. We will examine whether PPARdelta and Sirt1 are critically involved in vaso-protective actions of antidiabetic and hypotensive drugs using these mice.

464712.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
464712.value: Vascular endothelial cell dysfunction is the initiating event of a variety of cardiovascular diseases including hypertension, stroke, coronary heart disease, and diabetic vasculopathy. Endothelial dysfunction is manifested by reduced acetylcholine-induced vasodilation and flow-induced vasodilation in large and small arteries, which is mainly mediated by nitric oxide. The longevity gene SIRT1, which mediates the effects of caloric restriction to extend lifespan was showed to be beneficial in cardiovascular diseases. Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor δ (PPARδ) agonists have been recently suggested to have therapeutic potentials in reversing insulin resistance in diabetes and obesity. We aimed at investigating whether the interaction between SIRT1 and PPARδ play significant roles in protecting endothelial function in type 2 diabetic mice. We found that SIRT1 protects against endothelial dysfunction in obese mice induced by high fat diet feeding. We found that SIRT1 activation increases nitric oxide production in endothelial cells. SIRT1 activators can increase Akt and downstream eNOS activity. We also found that SIRT1 activator resveratrol, the active component from grape skin, improves endothelial function through PPARδ dependent mechanism. These results demonstrated that PPARδ may be the effector of SIRT1, and explained the mechanism of drugs targeting SIRT1 that can be potentially useful for cardiovascular diseases.

464912.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
464912.value: Tendon injuries have always been a major concern. Top athletes such as Liu Xiang, Usain Bolt and Rafael Nadal have faced difficulties in their sports career due to tendon injuries. Tendon injuries are difficult to heal, with a high chance of pathological failed healing. Poor healing outcomes of tendon injuries cause many patients to withdraw from sports, becoming less productive at work and being impaired in daily activities. No existing treatments can solve the problem of poor healing capacity of tendon. In this project, we propose to investigate the potential of modulation of reduction/oxidation (redox) status to promote tendon healing. Redox modulation refers to the modulation of the levels of free radicals by anti-oxidants. As free radical is necessary for normal biological functions, complete abolishment of free radicals would be deleterious; yet overproduction of free radicals (oxidative stress) will cause tissue damages and compromised healing capacity. We have developed a vitamin C surgical irrigation saline to exert protection aginast oxidative stress. Experimental evidences showed that this product can promote restoration of mechanical strength of healing tendon. Redox modulation at early healing stage promotes tendon healing probably by affecting recruitment of reparative cells. In this project, we plan to investigate the effect of redox modulation on cell recruitment and cell survival for tendon regeneration. Apart from intra-operative redox modulation by surgical irrigation saline, we will explore the possibility of extending the antioxidant supplementation into post-operative rehabilitation phase in order to get extra benefits for tendon healing. In cases of painful chronic tendon injuries, redox disturbances may play a role in the pathogenesis. We will also examine if exaggerated oxidative stress can lead to failed tendon healing in this project. With a better understanding on the roles of redox balance on tendon healing, it is possible to develop antioxidant-based health products for tendon injuries such as dietary supplements or products for topical application in near future. 肌腱損傷一直以來都受到大眾關注。頂級運動員如劉翔、拿度、保特等，就長期因肌腱損傷而在運動生涯上遇上不少困難。事實上，肌腱損傷不但難以癒合，而且極容易發生癒合失效的病變。如果康復的情況未如理想，傷者大都不能重返運動場上，甚至連工作和日常生活都會受到影響。現時並沒有能有效解決肌腱自癒能力低下的治療方法。故此，我們建議研究氧化性調節對肌腱損傷的影響，藉此尋求促進肌腱癒合的方法。 氧化性調節是指利用抗氧化劑去調控自由基的水平，從而影響細胞的活性。由於身體的正常運作需要自由基，因此全面清除所有自由基將會帶來災難性的後果；但是過量產生的自由基(氧化應激)也會引發組織損傷，影響癒合效果。我們根據這個想法開發了維生素C手術沖洗液，希望能保護身體組織在手術期間免受氧化應激的過度影響。實驗證明，這個產品能有效促進肌腱損傷癒合，改善康復肌腱的機械強度。由此推斷，氧化性調節在癒合初期起作用的原因，可能與癒合細胞的召集和保存有關。有見及此，我們建議研究氧化性調節對肌腱細胞的召集和保存的影響，從而尋求促進肌腱再生的方法。除了在手術期間調控氧化應激之外，我們會研究將補充抗氧化劑延長到手術後康復階段，觀察是否能進一步促進肌腱功能的恢復。此外，在引發長期疼痛的肌腱病方面，氧化性調節的紊亂也可能對病變產生重大影響。因此我們也會研究過量的氧化應激是否會誘發肌腱癒合失效。透過了解更多氧化性調節在肌腱癒合中的作用，我們將有可能開發出以抗氧化劑為基礎去護理肌腱損傷的健康產品。諸如膳食補充劑或軟膏等適用於肌腱創傷和肌腱病的產品，也許能在不久將來面世。

464912.label: Realisation of objectives
464912.value: We have completed all work related to the objectives during the period. Tendon derived stem cells (TDSCs) were isolated from human hamstring tendon and rat patellar tendon to investigate the effect of redox modulation on clonogenicity, chemotaxis, survival and tenogenic activities of TDSCs. As compare to control with normal culture media, culture media containing H2O2 or ascorbic acid were added to the culture for examination of the effect of redox modulation. Different concentration of H2O2 (100uM, 200uM, 500uM) and ascorbic acid (100uM, 200uM, 500uM) were used. Chemotaxis was measured by Boyden chamber assay. Caspase assay and alamar blue assay were used to reveal the survival of TDSCs. Real time PCR of pro-collagen IA, elastin, tenomodulin and scleraxis were performed to reveal tenogenic activities. Rat patellar tendon window injury model were used to investigate the effect of extended antioxidant supplementation (ascorbic acid) and imposed oxidative stress (H2O2) on tendon healing. The healing outcome was examined using various assessment tools. Major outcome were assessed via histology, longitudinal high resolution ultrasound and Doppler ultrasound. Longitudinal gait analysis was performed to follow the functional recovery. All of the assessments were carried out at 6 weeks post-injury. The effect of extended antioxidant supplementation and imposed oxidative stress on tendon healing was compared with the saline control group. These findings have been presented in different international conferences and two manuscripts are under preparation.

464912.label: Major findings and research outcome
464912.value: Effects of redox modulation on clonogenicity, survival, chemotaxis and tenogenic activities on TDSCs There was no significant difference in size of CFU in the presence of different doses of both ascorbic acid and H2O2. However, 50uM of H2O2 and ascorbic acid did not alter the total number of clones, but significantly reduced dense clones and increased the number of diffuse clones. Almost all dense clones treated with H2O2 or ascorbic acid were tenomodulin positive. Cell viability was significantly enhanced in all ascorbic acid treated groups. In addition, low dose and mid dose of ascorbic acid increased cell proliferation while high dose of ascorbic acid reduced proliferation. On the other hands, only mid dose of H2O2 increased cell proliferation, low dose and high dose of H2O2 did not alter proliferation. Both ascorbic acid and H2O2 treatment increased caspase expression but the percentage of increase in caspase expression was higher in the H2O2 group as compared with the ascorbic group. Similarly, low dose and mid dose of ascorbic acid enhanced cell migration; while the high dose had no effects on cell migration. On the other hands, low dose of H2O2 slightly enhanced cell migration and high dose of H2O2 suppressed migration. Tenogenic activities were reduced as shown by the down regulation of tenomdodulin and elastin mRNA expressions after H2O2 treatment. In addition, formation of calcium nodules was increased after H2O2 treatment in Alizarin Red S staining assay. This implicated that oxidative stress could reduce tenogenic activities of TDSCs and increased osteogenic activities. Effect of extended antioxidant supplementation on tendon healing Results of extended antioxidant supplementation on tendon healing did not significantly improved tendon healing as compared with a single dose of ascorbic acid injection in histology, vascularity and biomechanical properties. Effect of imposed oxidative stress on tendon healing Weekly subcutaneous H2O2 (50uM and 500uM) injection over patellar tendon at week 3-5 post injury were performed. Low dose of H2O2 significantly increased vascularity, tendon volume, cellularity, matrix disturbance, impaired fibrillogenesis, reduced ultimate stress and elastic modulus as compared with saline control and high dose of H2O2 injection groups. In addition, low dose of H2O2 increased pain associated limb idleness in the injured side. These observations suggested that failed tendon healing in this animal model was caused by oxidative stress and resembled most tendinopathic features in humans. This animal model is useful for investigation of pathogenesis of tendinopathy and development of new treatment strategies.

464912.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
464912.value: Based on the above observation in the in vitro and in vivo study, we confirmed that redox modulation affects both recruitment and survival of TDSCs. This might help to explain the beneficial effects of antioxidants to improve tendon healing in previous animal model. The adverse effect of high dose of ascorbic acid might due to the pro-oxidant property of ascorbic acid. Further study on the appropriate dose of ascorbic acid might help to promote the use of antioxidant in tendon healing. Pathogenesis of tendinopathy is multi-factorial. In this study, we demonstrated that oxidative stress lead to a failed healing response on injured tendon which resembled most of the human tendinopathic changes. This animal model is useful for investigation of the mechanism involved in the oxidative stress induced failed healing response and development of new treatment strategies.

464912.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
464912.value: This study presents experimental evidences for the effects of redox modulation on clonogenicity, survival, chemotaxis and tenogenic activities on tendon derived stem cells. Oxidative stress, H2O2, might favor diffuse clone formation. Ascorbic acid enhanced cell viability. Low dose and mid dose of ascorbic acid enhanced cell migration, cell proliferation. However, high dose of ascorbic acid reduced cell proliferation and suppressed cell migration. High dosed of H2O2 did not affect cell proliferation, but suppressed migration. H2O2 also reduced tenogenic activities and increased osteogenic activities. Prolonged ascorbic acid treatment on injured tendon did not improve tendon healing. Prolonged H2O2 treatment on injured tendon caused failed tendon healing and resembled tendinopathic changes as human. These pathological changes were attributed to oxidative stress which is presumably involved in overuse. This animal model is useful to study the mechanism involved in the oxidative stress induced failed tendon healing response and development of new treatment strategies.

465112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
465112.value: Secretory carrier membrane proteins (SCAMPs) are integral membrane proteins mediating endocytosis in animal cells. All SCAMPs are predicted to have four transmembrane domains (TMDs) and cytosolic N-terminus with NPF (Asn-Pro-Phe) repeats. Using the animal SCAMP1 homolog from rice and transgenic tobacco or Arabidopsis cells expressing GFP fusions with the rice SCAMP1, we have previously demonstrated that SCAMP1 was localized to both plasma membrane (PM) and early endosome, identified as trans-Golgi network (TGN), as well as in cell plate during cytokinesis, whereas SCAMP1 reached the PM via an ER (endoplasmic reticulum)-Golgi-TGN-PM pathway, which is subsequently internalized from PM to vacuole via the multivesicular body or prevacuolar compartment for degradation in plant cells (Plant Cell 19:296-319; Plant Physiology 147:1637-1645; Plant Journal 61:826-838; Plant Journal 65:882-896). The Arabidopsis thaliana and rice (Oryza savita) genomes contain five and six SCAMP homologs respectively (termed AtSCAMP1-5 and OsSCAMP1-6 respectively in this proposal). However, the functional roles of SCAMPs in plants remain largely elusive. To further study the biological functions of SCAMPs in plants, we have recently identified the animal EHD1 (the C-terminal Eps15 homology domain-containing protein 1) homolog from Arabidopsis (termed AtEHD1) as being a SCAMP1-interacting protein in Arabidopsis cells and showed that AtSCAMP3 may function as a channel protein in microinjection Oocyte clamp experiments. We thus hypothesize that members of plant SCAMPs may function as channel proteins and that the plant EHD proteins may regulate the endocytic trafficking and/or function of SCAMPs in plants. Therefore, the central goal of this proposal is to illustrate the functional roles of selective Arabidopsis and rice SCAMPs in plants using a combination of molecular, cellular and genetic approaches. First, using RT-PCR, in situ hybridization, promoter and western blot analysis with newly generated SCAMP antibodies, we will study the temporal and spatial expression profiles of various SCAMPs in Arabidopsis and Rice plants. Second, we will carry out structural and immunoEM (electron microscope) studies to characterize the SCAMPs-positive organelles or vesicles in these SCAMPs-rich plant cell types or tissues. Third, using co-expression for subcellular localization, co-immunoprecipitation and FRET (Fluorescence Resonance Energy Transfer) analysis of transient expression in Arabidopsis or rice protoplasts, we will study the mechanism and functional implication of SCAMP1-EHD1 interaction in plant cells. Last, using both loss-of-function and gain-of-function approaches in transgenic Arabidopsis plants, we will study the functional roles of selective AtSCAMPs members in plants. Our long-term goal is to illustrate the biological functions of SCAMPs in plants. 分泌载体膜蛋白（SCAMPs）是一类跨膜蛋白，在动物细胞中主要参与介导胞吞作用。在拟南芥和水稻基因组中分别有五个和六个SCAMP同源基因序列，然而植物中SCAMP的功能作用还不为所知。此项研究计划的中心目标是结合分子、细胞和遗传手段阐明拟南芥和水稻中某些SCAMPs的功能。此研究的长期目标是揭示植物中SCAMPs的生物学功能。

465112.label: Realisation of objectives
465112.value: Objective 1: We have selected peptide sequences from 5 Arabidopsis and 7 Rice SCAMPs based on specificity and antigenicity. Antibodies were raised by injecting synthetic peptides into rats and rabbits. To test for specificity, antibodies were affinity-purified and tested in western blotting. Obtained results showed that an antibody against Arabidopsis SCAMP5 detected a strong band of 37kD in the membrane fraction of Arabidopsis seedling protein extract, similar to the predicted size of endogenous Arabidopsis SCAMP5. Further western blotting analysis revealed the specificity of the antibodies as it can detect a strong band at the size of 62kD in the membrane fraction of tobacco BY-2 cells overexpressing the GFP-fusion of Arabidopsis SCAMP5. In order to characterize the structure of SCAMP-positive organelles and transport vesicles in plant cells, we have carried out immunogold EM (electron microscope) studies in SCAMP-rice cell types or tissues of Arabidopsis and rice plant. Ultra-thin sections were prepared from high-pressure freezing/frozen substituted tobacco pollen tubes, BY2 cells and roots of Arabidopsis seedlings, and immunogold-labelled with specific SCAMP antibodies. We found that SCAMP proteins localize on plasma membrane (PM), trans-Golgi networks (TGNs), cell plate (CP) and clathrin coated vesicles (CCVs) in these cell types. In the process of identifying sub-cellular localization of AtSCAMPs, we have discovered a type of Golgi-derived secretory vesicles (GDSVs) which are distinct from TGN and TGN-derived vesicles. With the use of Nicotiana tabacum pectin methylesterase (NtPPME1) as marker, we have identified a distinctive TGN-independent polar exocytosis pathway in plant cells, with results from the following experiments: 1) GDSVs labelled by NtPPME1-GFP are distinct from organelles on the conventional post-Golgi exocyotic pathway in immunogold electron microscopy and confocal immunofluorescence experiments; 2) In polar exocytosis, GDSVs labelled by NtPPME1-GFP were transported to PM/CP directly and without passing through TGN, as revealed by pharmaceutical treatments, dynamic studies and super-resolution imaging experiments, marking the pathway distinctive from conventional Golgi-TGN-PM/CP secretory pathway. Taken together, we have demonstrated that NtPPME1-labelled GDSVs highlighted an alternative polar exocytoic pathway from Golgi which is TGN-independent. This pathway is believed to function in secreting NtPPME1 for cell wall formation during cell expansion and cytokinesis. These results have been published recently in Plant Physiology in 2016 (included in this report as a resubmitted MS). Thus, we have achieved the original objective 1 fully. Objective 2: We have carried out a number of subcellular localization and interaction studies using transient expression and confocal imaging techniques to study the molecular mechanism of interaction between SCAMP1 and Arabidopsis EHD1. We hypothesized that SCAMP1 and AtEHD1 are interacting partners in plant cells, as SCAMP harbours tripeptide Asn-Pro-Phe (NPF) motifs in its N-terminus, which are capable of binding with Eps15-homology (EH) domain, a protein-protein interacting domain commonly found on effectors of vesicle formation in eukaryotic cells. Arabidopsis EHD family proteins are paralogs of mammalian EHD proteins, which harbor EH domains. To test this hypothesis, we carried out Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) and bimolecular fluorescence complementation (BiFC) between SCAMP and AtEHD1. FRET analysis showed that SCAMP1 interacted with AtEHD1. To further test if SCAMP1 interacted with AtEHD1 via its NPF motifs, we mutated 2 NPF motifs on SCAMP1 to alanine, and fused with N-terminus of YFP (YN) while the full-length EHD1 fused with C-terminus of YFP (YC), and subsequently co-expressed in protoplast derived from tobacco and Arabidopsis by transient expression. BiFC results showed that NPF motifs are essential for SCAMP1 to interact with EHD1. To elucidate if SCAMP1 interacted with AtEHD1 on internal membrane such as trans-Golgi network, we carried out localization studies for AtEHD1. We have generated GFP-fusion of EHD1 and expressed it in tobacco BY-2 cells and Arabidopsis plants. Cytosolic punctate structures labeled by GFP-EHD1 fusion or endogenous EHD1, labelled by specific antibodies raised in rabbit and rat anti-sera, are distinct from the Golgi apparatus and prevacuolar compartment (PVC), but partially colocalize with a TGN marker. EHD1-positive structures do not lie on the endocytic pathway as judged by FM4-64 labelling. Pharmacological studies revealed that Brefeldin A, but neither Concanamycin A nor Wortmannin, inhibits EHD1 PM-recycling. During interphase, EHD1 and a Rab11 homolog RabA1g partially colocalize as cytosolic punctae, but highlight the developing cell plate during meiosis. Immunogold electron microscopy of high-pressure frozen/freeze-substituted samples identified the EHD1-labeled compartment as a population of vesicles in close proximity to the TGN. These are morphologically similar but biochemically distinct to TGN-derived vesicles. Using an inducible RNA interference (RNAi) approach, we showed that EHD1 knockdown by RNAi could hamper root development and cell plate formation in Arabidopsis. These results had been submitted to Plant Physiology early this year and it is currently under resubmission in 2016. Thus, we have achieved the original objective 2 fully. Objective 3: We hypothesized that AtSCAMP homologs participated in the delivery of pectin materials for cell plate formation. To test the hypothesis, we have utilized gain-of-function and loss-of-function approaches in probing functions of SCAMPs. We have generated Arabidopsis plant lines overexpressing SCAMPs proteins. We have also ordered T-DNA insertional mutant from SALK institute and screened homozygous mutant for Arabidopsis SCAMP3. The obtained results indicated that Arabidopsis plants overexpressing AtSCAMP3-GFP have a higher percentage of dry weight than wild type, indicating that there might be an increased cell wall materials deposition in SCAMP3 overexpressing plants. Apart from the changes in dry weight, there are no observable developmental phenotypes. We reasoned that is caused by gene redundancy of 5 SCAMP proteins in plants. In light of this, we have focused on elucidating the function of AtSCAMP3. We also hypothesized that plant SCAMPs participated in regulation of ion exchange on plasma membrane, as a mammalian study revealed that SCAMP interacts NHE7, a (Na+, K+)/H+ exchanger localized to trans-Golgi network and post-Golgi vesicles. Overexpression of SCAMP might increases the ion exchange on plasma membrane due to higher turnover of NHE7 on plasma membrane. To test the hypothesis, we have carried out patch clamp analysis on frog oocyte overexpressing AtSCAMP3. Results showed that a voltage-dependent current was observed in oocyte overexpressing AtSCAMP3, confirming that AtSCAMP3 would play a role in regulating ion exchange. We are in the process of preparing a short manuscript. Thus, we have largely achieved the original objective 3. In conclusion, all the 3 objectives in the research project have been successfully achieved, and this could be demonstrated by the publication as well as the research findings included in this completion report. The finding sheds light into the research in Golgi-derived vehicles and mechanism in endocytic recycling. Moreover, this project has also nurtured several graduate students, and brought publications in renowned plant- or molecular biology- related journals.

The specific antibody has proven for great use in our recent publication in Plant Physiology 2016. 2. We have identified an unconventional, trans-Golgi network (TGN)-independent polar exocytosis with the use of Nicotiana tabacum pectin methylesterase (NtPPME1) as marker. Results from confocal immunofluorescent and electron microscopy immunogold labeling have supported the existence of Golgi-derived secretory vesicles (GDSVs) which are distinct from secretory vesicles derived from TGN. These GDSVs transported NtPPME to plasma membrane for cell wall formation during cell expansion and cytokinesis. These findings have been published in Plant Physiology in 2016. 3. We have examined the molecular mechanism of interaction between SCAMP1 and EHD1 in plant cells. We have demonstrated that NPF motifs of SCAMP1 are essential for SCAMP1-EHD1 interaction in plants. Furthermore, we have identified the cytosolic punctate structures of EHD1 resided on a population of BFA-sensitive but ConcA-insensitive vesicles recycling to PM from TGN. EHD1 localization on cell plate during meiosis and root developmental defects brought by knockdown of EHD1 expression by RNA interference suggested that EHD1 probably function in redirecting proteins for cytokinesis in plants. These results have been submitted to Plant Physiology and currently under resubmission. 4. We have investigated the functions of selective AtSCAMPs in Arabidopsis plants. We have demonstrated that SCAMP may take part in the transport of cell wall materials to cell plate for its formation. We have developed an electrophysiological platform system to investigate the potential voltage-dependent potassium current in SCAMP-overexpressing frog oocyte and mammalian cell line and hence the functional role of SCAMP. SCAMP might participate in regulating ion exchange on plasma membrane. 5. With partially support from this project, we have also trained several excellent postgraduate students with outstanding research outputs as demonstrated by publications of their thesis work in a number of international journals. 6. The project has resulted in a list of outstanding publications in international journals including Plant Cell, Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America, Plant Physiology, Journal of Experimental Botany, Plant Journal, Autophagy, Molecular Plant, Molecular Biology of the Cell, and Trends in Plant Science.

465112.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
465112.value: Our studies on the trafficking and functions of plant SCAMPs have shed lights on our discovery of Golgi-derived, TGN-independent secretory pathway marked by NtPPME1 and also the recycling vesicles marked by EHD1. At the end, these proteins have served as molecular markers for distinctive pathways and expanded our understanding towards the complexity and plasticity of protein trafficking pathways in plants. Nevertheless, we shall further expand our understanding on the molecular players of these pathways via cargo identification with proteomics techniques on affinity-purified vesicles, which could give further information on the functions of these pathways. With the availability of chemicals libraries, chemical genetics screening can take part in identifying chemicals which target these pathways specifically, which would give further aid to cargo identification and probing functions of pathways. The cargo screening strategy described here shall be applicable to all vesicles labelled by EHDs and PPMEs. Further research could be done to investigate the possible cross-talk between pathways marked by SCAMP, EHD1 and NtPPME1 as well as their functional implications in plants.

465112.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
465112.value: This RGC-funded project aims to investigate the expression profile, subcellular localization and molecular mechanism of the two plant proteins AtSCAMP and AtEHD1. Results derived from this study have provided new insights about the molecular machinery of AtSCAMP-AtEHD1interaction, and their functional implications in plants, with potential implications in future study of trafficking mechanisms of Golgi-derived vehicles as well as the endocytic recycling in plants.

465312.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
465312.value: Subjective tinnitus is defined as the perception of sound in the absence of an acoustic stimulus. It is a common condition in the general population. However, the majority of patients suffers from subjective tinnitus with no identifiable causes, and for some tinnitus can seriously affect the quality of life. Despite a variety of therapeutic alternatives, a consistently effective treatment remains elusive. Most treatment methods have not been verified by research, and there is no widely accepted treatment that has been shown to be effective in controlled investigations. Thus, prospective, controlled studies are needed to provide clear evidence for the efficacy of specific treatment methods. Sound therapy is one of the most commonly employed treatment methods for tinnitus. Sound, usually music, environmental sound and noise have all been known to provide relief from tinnitus-associated distress, distract attention away from tinnitus, and reduce the contrast between tinnitus and the background acoustic environment to facilitate habituation. Applications of customized sound in tinnitus management based on modern theories about tinnitus mechanisms have recently emerged. Existing approaches include the customized tinnitus frequency notched sound therapy which utilizes the concept of cortical reorganization. In the notched sound therapy, the cortical region responsive to the tinnitus frequency is not stimulated. It has been shown to be effective in a small number of subjects but has not been verified in randomized controlled trials. The aim of this study is to investigate the treatment efficacy of tinnitus. We propose carrying out a randomized controlled trial of sound therapy efficacy on tinnitus. To achieve sufficient statistical power to detect the treatment difference, 135 subjects with subjective tinnitus will be recruited and randomly assigned into one of the three groups: 1) customized tinnitus frequency notched sound therapy; 2) customized sound therapy and 3) active no-treatment control group. Immediate and sustained outcomes will be compared using the 1) Chinese Tinnitus Handicap Inventory, 2) Chinese Tinnitus Questionnaire, 3) self-rated visual analogue scale on tinnitus loudness, and 4) tinnitus loudness matches measured psychoacoustically. Intention-to-treat analysis will be employed. By using the rigorous study-design of randomized controlled trials, results from this study will not only provide strong evidence in support of clinical-decision-making in tinnitus management, but also provide a greater understanding of tinnitus mechanisms. 主觀性耳鳴定義為在沒有聲音刺激下感覺到聲音。在一般人口中，此乃常見的症狀。然而，大部分患有主觀性耳鳴的人士均沒有明確病因，當中有些耳鳴情況更會嚴重影響患者的生活質素。雖然現有各種不同類型的治療方法，但是仍未有一種是持續有效的。大部分治療方法尚未經研究證實，亦沒有一種受廣泛應用的方法是在對照研究下確認為有效。因此，必須進行前瞻性對照研究來證明某種治療方法的成效。 聲音治療是其中一種最常採用的耳鳴治療方法。聲音，通常指音樂、環境聲音及噪音，能夠減低耳鳴所帶來的困擾及分散患者的注意力，並且利用降低耳鳴與其他聲音雜訊的差別去幫助患者適應。最近出現一些根據現代耳鳴機制原理發展出來，以定制聲音來治療耳鳴的方法。現有方案包括利用大腦皮質功能重組理論去定制耳鳴頻率缺口的聲音療法。在缺口聲音治療中，大腦皮層的耳鳴頻率反應區不會受到刺激。小數受試者已證明此療法有效，但是仍未有隨機對照試驗證實其成效。 本研究的目的是調查耳鳴治療方法的成效。我們建議採用隨機對照試驗去研究聲音治療的效力。為了達到足夠的統計功效，我們將招募135名患有主觀性耳鳴的受試者，並隨機分成三組：1) 定制耳鳴頻率缺口的聲音療法;2)定制聲音療法;3)沒有積極治療對照組。研究亦以下列四種指標進行即時及持續性的成效對比：1)中文版耳鳴障礙問卷;2)中文版耳鳴問卷;3)自我評估耳鳴響度;及4)以心理聲學方法量度出的耳鳴響度。此研究採用治療意向分析法。透過嚴謹的隨機對照試驗設計，這項研究的結果將不僅為耳鳴管理臨床決策提供有力的證據，也有助於進一步了解耳鳴機制。

465312.label: Realisation of objectives
465312.value: In order to address the objectives, we performed a randomized controlled trial. 67 subjects were randomized prospectively into 3 groups: 21 subjects for customized tinnitus frequency notched sound therapy (CNS), 22 subjects for customized sound therapy (CS), and 24 subjects for no treatment (NT). Block randomization with a block size of six and allocation ratio of 1:1:1 was used. Both the subjects and the assessors were blinded to the treatment assigned, except for the no-treatment group. Outcome measures used including two self-assessed tinnitus questionnaires (the Chinese Tinnitus Handicap Inventory (THI-CH) and the Chinese Tinnitus Questionnaire (TQ-CH)), a self-rated visual analogue scale (VAS) on tinnitus loudness, and the tinnitus loudness matches at the tinnitus frequency and at 1000Hz. Assessments were done at baseline, immediate after 6-month of intervention, 6-month after termination of intervention and 12-month after termination of intervention. Intention-to-treat analysis was conducted to handle the cases that drop out. Inferential statistical methods, such as analysis of variance and multiple regression analysis, were applied to compare the measures of the two treatment groups as well as the control group. The effect of the intervention was measured by the standardized treatment effect size. In addition, the effect of a set of independent variables, including subjects’ age, gender, hearing level, duration, laterality, and pitch of tinnitus, with adjustment for baseline characteristics, was studied. Interactive effects, such as baseline hearing level and tinnitus distress (i.e., TQ-CH score), were also investigated.

465312.label: Major findings and research outcome
465312.value: Overall, 81 subjects were screened and 14 subjects were not enrolled in the study. The main reasons for screen failure included multiple tinnitus tones reported and no reliable tinnitus frequency could be matched, TQ-CH score < 30 and with hearing threshold higher than 70 dBHL at the tinnitus frequency. In total, 67 subjects were randomized to the three groups: 21 subjects for customized tinnitus frequency notched sound therapy (CNS), 22 subjects for customized sound therapy (CS), and 24 subjects for no treatment (NT). All subjects allocated to the CS and CNS groups completed the 6-month intervention, while 2 subjects in the NT group withdrew from the study without coming back for the post-intervention assessment. There were 42 male and 25 female participants with an average age of 53 years (SD = 11). Most subjects had no or mild hearing loss at 500, 1000 and 2000 Hz. THI-CH and TQ-CH total scores at baseline were similar between all three groups. The three groups are comparable in terms of hearing level, tinnitus pitch and loudness matching. Reductions in the THI-CH and TQ-CH scores (decrease in tinnitus distress and related problems) were observed in all treatment arms. However changes in both scores in the CS group were significantly larger than the changes in the CNS and NT group observed at the treatment endpoint (right after the 6-month intervention) (p < 0.05). Analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) with intervention group as factor and TQ-CH baseline value as covariate was used for estimation of the treatment effects. The analysis was performed using the last-observation-carried-forward approach. Results of the analysis showed the reduction of TQ-CH score was significantly higher in the CS group and the CNS group when compared to the NT group (p = 0.18, partial eta squared = 0.12). While the changes between the CS and CNS group yielded no statistical significance at the pre-defined endpoint. No relevant change of the HADS score, tinnitus loudness matched at the tinnitus frequency and 1k Hz, and VAS of tinnitus loudness was observed. During the follow-up period, further reductions in both THI-CH and TQ-CH scores were observed in all three groups. However the changes were not statistically significant. Correlation analyses were conducted and revealed no significant effect of the studied independent variables, including subjects’ age, gender, hearing level, duration, laterality, and pitch of tinnitus.

465312.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
465312.value: While we are recruiting subjects for this study, we have encountered many patients who have mild hearing loss and would probably benefit from other sound therapy such as a hearing aid fitting. In order to collect evidence for amplification in tinnitus relief in these patients, we have proposed to perform a randomized controlled trial investigating the efficacy of amplification and customized sound therapy. The proposal has been awarded the GRF 2017/18 (18100117) and will be started on 1st January 2018. One of the treatment group will be receiving the customized sound therapy which has been used and proofed to be effective in the present study.

465312.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
465312.value: Subjective tinnitus is the perception of sound inside the head in the absence of acoustic stimulation. It is a common condition in the population and is associated with variable severity and symptom response. Acoustic stimulation or sound therapy has been commonly employed in tinnitus management. However, there is no standardized procedure or protocol in using therapeutic sound. In this project, we investigate the immediate and long-term treatment effect of two sound therapy approaches: customized sound (CS) therapy and customized notched sound (CNS) therapy. Our results showed both CS and CNS therapy are effective treatment when compared to no treatment, as it provided significantly better immediate treatment effect after six months of intervention.

465412.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
465412.value: In recent years computer assisted tumor surgery has had a major impact in changing the nature of limb-salvage surgery for malignant tumors of bone. Very precise resections can now be planned enabling surgeons to preserve the very distal segments of bone and to avoid unnecessary sacrifice of a major joint. Accuracy Error in computer based surgery is the difference between what was planned and what was finally achieved. As a result of this hidden error surgeons may inadvertently cut into the tumor resulting in recurrence or this may affect the alignment of prosthesis resulting in unfavorable outcomes. There is very little data on to what extent this deviation happens in clinical practice. Our project aims to establish this important safety standard by measuring the error attained when expert surgeons use computer navigation for bone resections in cadavers. In addition, we shall compare an alternative to the computer based navigations systems is a cost effective patient specific cutting guide that may reduce the error seen in navigation. This project may have a significant impact on the quality of life and function of children and young adults affected by bone tumors. The project may allow a wider application of the joint sparing technique of surgery in communities without facilities for expensive computer based navigation technology. 465412.label: Realisation of objectives
465412.value: Twelve fresh frozen cadaveric bodies including whole pelvic bones were obtained from Life Legacy Foundation USA. CT scans with a slice thickness of 0.625 mm were acquired. The CT DICOM images were imported into MIMICS program (Materialise, Belgium) in which individual bone segmentation, surgical planning with virtual bone resection was performed. A virtual multiplanar bone resection was simulated at each of the hemipelvis. Twenty-four pelvic bone resections were virtually performed, that included 12 iliac bone resections and 12 partial acetabular bone resections. Twelve bone resections (6 iliac and 6 partial acetabular) had been assigned to a Navigation group (n=12) in which resection would be performed under the guidance of computer navigation. The remaining 12 bone resections were performed in a Patient Specific Instrument (PSI) group (n=12) with the help of patient-specific cutting guides. In the Navigation group, the virtual bone resection planning was translated to the navigation system (OrthoMap 3D, Stryker) while patient-specific cutting guides were manufactured in accordance to the resection planning in the PSI group. The 24 cadaveric operations (12 Navigation and 12 PSI groups) have been successfully performed in 4 separate occasions and finally completed at the end of Dec, 2013 (Figure 2 & 3 in Wong KC et al. 2015. Int J Comput Assist Radiol Surg. 2015 Jul 7). To determine the accuracy of resections using the two techniques, we obtained CT scans of all the resected pelvic bones in Jan 2014. The achieved and the planned resection planes were compared using engineering softwares (MIMICS and Geomagic Verify). The absolute distance between all the points on the achieved plane and those on the planned plane was calculated as deviation error. Based on the methodology, the project objectives have been achieved.

465412.label: Major findings and research outcome
465412.value: All bone resections were performed successfully, as planned in the Navigation and the PSI groups. The mean maximum deviation error from the planned resection was no different (p=0.08) for the Navigation and the PSI groups: 3.6 versus 2.6 mm, respectively. The mean average deviation error from the planned resection was also no different (p=0.1) for the Navigation and the PSI groups: 1.9 versus 1.4 mm, respectively (Table 1 in Wong KC et al. 2015. Int J Comput Assist Radiol Surg. 2015 Jul 7). In this cadaver study, we showed that both navigation and PSI-assisted technique for the simulated pelvic resection could achieve clinically acceptable accuracy of reproducing the planned bone resection with a mean deviation error of < 2 mm from the planned. The result concurred with the accuracy of the two techniques reported in other clinical, sawbone or cadaveric studies. When we compared the accuracy between the two techniques in simulated pelvic bone resections, no statistical difference was noted. Based on our results, after surgeons plan and perform virtual bone resections and precisely define bone resection planes in pelvis using appropriate engineering softwares, the virtual resection planning may be transferred to the real surgical procedure with high degree of accuracy using either navigation or PSI techniques. The mean time required for the bone resection was greater (p=0.004) for the Navigation group than for the PSI group: 16.2 versus 1.1 minutes, respectively (Table 1). The mean time required for the bone resection in the Navigation group was significantly greater than that in the PSI group. The greater operative time in the navigation group was due to the fact that time was required for the placement of patient tracker, system calibration and image-to-patient registration prior to the navigated bone resections. Also, as the existing navigation system does not support a navigated saw, the surgeons had to manually control the direction of the sawblade for the resection under the visual guidance on the navigation display. The intraoperative use of PSI is simpler. Once the PSI is correctly placed on the predetermined bone surface, a physical image-to-patient registration is completed. Surgeons can focus on the operative field while performing the bone resection as the cutting slots of the PSI confine the sawblade to the specific planes of the planned resection.

465412.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
465412.value: Though the time required for bone resections was significantly shorter in the PSI group, the PSI technique does have an inherent problem of the correct placement of PSI on the predetermined bone surface at the surgery. Currently, the correct placement of PSI is largely subjective. Further studies are needed to determine the amount of bone contact for correct PSI placement and investigate some objective methods to ensure the correct placement. As both Navigation and PSI techniques can achieve accurate bone resections, both techniques have its own strengths and limitations. It is logical to investigate bone resections by combining the two techniques. The real-time visual feedback under navigation guidance may help to confirm the correct placement of PSI while PSI can confine the path of a sawblade that is not possible by a navigation system. The combination of the two techniques may be useful in more complex geometric bone resections that require custom tumor implants for reconstruction.

465412.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
465412.value: Inaccurate cuts in bone tumor surgery may result in residual tumors, tumor recurrence and patients’ mortality. Computer-assisted approaches have been developed to improve surgical accuracy for better results and limbs function. The methods include the assistance by computer navigation or patient specific guides. However, the two techniques have not been compared and contrasted, in particularly for those difficult operations in pelvic bone tumors. The study was to examine and compared the accuracy of a pelvic operation using navigation-assisted and patient specific guides in a cadaveric setup. The results showed patient specific guides’ technique enabled surgeons to reproduce their surgical plans with similar accuracy but with less operative time when compared with navigation assistance. It is the first study to show this result. The patient specific guides may be a simpler alternative in bone tumor surgery. This research can also provide the basis for further evaluating different surgical techniques in real clinical settings.

465612.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
465612.value: Nasopharyngeal cancer (NPC) is endemic in Hong Kong. Early NPC can be cured by radiotherapy, but it can be difficult to detect small cancers. At present the standard tests for diagnosing NPC are endoscopy followed by an endoscopic biopsy, but these tests may miss early cancers which are buried beneath the wall of the nasopharynx or in a small recess of the side of the nasopharynx. Our previous research funded by the RGC used magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to detect NPC. That study compared the diagnostic accuracy of MRI for NPC detection against that of endoscopy and endoscopic biopsy, and it showed that MRI detected NPC missed by the other two tests. Furthermore, it is the only published research to show that MRI has the highest detection rate for NPC, MRI detecting all cancers while endoscopy missed 10% and endoscopic biopsy (targeted biopsy or random deep biopsies) missed 5%. However, at the close of our previous study there were subjects without a diagnosis of NPC who nevertheless had shown MRI abnormalities which were suspicious of early NPC. We believe a follow-up study will identify more patients who had early NPC and show even greater benefits of MRI. Therefore we plan to follow-up all patients in whom no diagnosis of NPC had been made by the end of our previous study. We will re-calculate the diagnostic accuracy of the original MRI, endoscopy and endoscopic biopsy, based on this newly acquired follow-up data. Our research should lead to the wider application of MRI for NPC detection in clinical practice, which should lead to the earlier detection of NPC and in turn to better patient survival and reduced treatment toxicity. 鼻咽癌是香港常見疾病，早期的鼻咽癌可以通過放療治愈，但它可以是難以察覺的小癌腫瘤。目前的標準測試是用內鏡診斷鼻咽癌，接著用內窺鏡抽取活檢，但這些測試可能會因為早期癌腫瘤隱藏在鼻咽壁下方，或在一個鼻咽側的小凹位置，而錯過診斷。 我們早前由研資局撥款的研究，是使用磁共振成像來檢測鼻咽癌，這項研究是以鼻咽癌的磁共振成像檢測，來比較內鏡和內鏡活檢診斷的準確率，當中顯示，磁共振成像可檢測其他兩項測試所遺漏的鼻咽癌病例。此外，它是唯一一個已發表的研究，證明MRI 檢測鼻咽癌能得出最高的診斷準確率，MRI檢測到所有癌腫瘤，而內鏡則錯過了10％，內鏡活檢（靶向活檢或隨機深活檢）錯過了5%。然而，在我們之前的研究中，亦有受訪者雖然沒有診斷為鼻咽癌，但亦顯示MRI異常，被疑為早期鼻咽癌。我們相信，一個隨訪研究將確定更多有早期鼻咽癌的患者及顯示更大的MRI好處，因此，我們計劃隨訪所有在之前的研究中沒有顯示患鼻咽癌的病人，在內窺鏡檢查和內鏡活檢診斷的基礎上，重新計算原來MRI的準確率。我們的研究必會把MRI廣泛應用在鼻咽癌診斷上，亦促進更早檢測鼻咽癌，進而改善病人的存活率和降低治療毒性。

465612.label: Realisation of objectives
465612.value: Objective 1 1. 126/169 (74.6%) patients from the previous study with suspected NPC, without a diagnosis of proven NPC at the time of completion of the previous study, have undergone a follow up examination of the nasopharynx at a minimum of 36 months after initial investigations (range 36–84 months) using MRI and endoscopy (n=113), MRI (n=4) or endoscopy (n=9). 43 patients did not undergo further examination of the nasopharynx (29 refused further investigation, 10 died of disease unrelated to NPC, 4 lost to follow-up). 2. NPC was present in 1/126 patients, a cancer detected on the original MRI (Grade 4), but endoscopic examination and endoscopic biopsy, together with a repeat biopsy targeted to the site of the MRI abnormality were negative at that time. MRI examination at 43 months showed a slight increase in the size of the stage T1 tumour which now also was detected by endoscopic examination and confirmed by biopsy. MRI was confirmed to be absent in the other 125/126 patients, of whom the prior MRI (9), endoscopy (6), or MRI + endoscopy (1) had been designated as positive for NPC. Objective 2 Final diagnostic accuracy of MRI for NPC detection, and comparison of diagnostic accuracy of MRI with Endoscopy and Endoscopic Biopsy was assessed in 203 patients (129 males, 74 females, mean age 49.79 years),78 patients with NPC (77 with biopsy proven NPC in the prior study and one with biopsy proven NPC in this follow-up study) and 125 patients without NPC (based on absence of a tumour in this follow-up study). MRI detected 78/78 (100%) patients with NPC (Grade 4 =76; Grade 3= 2) and 115/125 (92%) without NPC (Grade 1 =32; Grade 2=83). MRI mistakenly diagnosed NPC in 10 patients (Grade 3 MRI). 9 prior false positive MRI examinations occurred in the presence of a true negative endoscopy, and one prior false positive finding in the presence of a false positive endoscopy. In the absence of NPC at follow-up, these 10 prior false positive MRI results have been attributed to asymmetrical benign lymphoid hyperplasia. Endoscopy detected 69/78 (88%) and missed 9/78 (12%) NPCs (7/9 tumours not identified by endoscopy involved the pharyngeal recess). Endoscopy identified 118/125 (94%) patients without NPC and mistakenly diagnosed NPC in 7 patients who had lymphoid hyperplasia, 6 involving the adenoid, all of which were correctly diagnosed as benign on MRI. Endoscopic biopsy detected 73/78 (94%) patients with NPC.

465612.label: Major findings and research outcome
465612.value: Major findings Nasopharyngeal MRI had a higher sensitivity than endoscopy or endoscopic biopsy (100% vs. 88% and 94% respectively), the difference being statistically significant between MRI and endoscopy (p=0.003), and of borderline significance between MRI and endoscopic biopsy (p=0.059). Nasopharyngeal MRI had a lower specificity than endoscopy or endoscopic biopsy (92% vs. 94% and 100% respectively) the difference being statistically significant between MRI and endoscopic biopsy (p= 0.002), but not between MRI and endoscopy (p= 0.617). Research outcome 1. Nasopharyngeal MRI identified cancers in the nasopharynx that would have been missed using the current standard of endoscopy and endoscopic biopsy. In order to diagnose NPC at an earlier stage nasopharyngeal MRI should be considered for patients who have clinically suspected NPC despite a negative endoscopic examination for NPC. Those patients in whom the MRI examination is positive for NPC, especially patients with a Grade 4 MRI, should undergo an endoscopic biopsy targeted to the site and depth of the abnormality, while those with a negative MRI examination can be spared a biopsy. In the future it may be possible to avoid a biopsy in patients with a negative endoscopy in whom the MRI is positive based on a Grade 3 pattern in the nasopharyngeal wall (asymmetry in the lymphoid hyperplasia pattern), but larger studies would be required to confirm this finding. MRI should be considered also for patients with a positive endoscopic examination for NPC in whom the initial endoscopic biopsy is negative. Those patients in whom the MRI examination is negative for NPC, including patients with lymphoid hyperplasia of the adenoid based on a symmetrical stripped appearance, can be spared from further biopsy, while those with a positive MRI examination for NPC should undergo a repeat endoscopic biopsy targeted to the site and depth of the abnormality. 2. NPCs may grow very slowly and remain endoscopically occult over several years providing a wide window of opportunity for diagnosis of early stage tumours.

465612.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
465612.value: MRI detects small early cancers buried in the pharyngeal recess or a submucosal location that cannot be diagnosed using current investigative tools. The advantage of MRI for early NPC detection and potential benefits in terms of survival are likely to be even greater in asymptomatic patients detected through EBV DNA serology screening programs. Therefore future MRI studies will focus on using MRI to detect subclinical NPC in this group of patients.

465612.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
465612.value: Nasopharyngeal endoscopy and biopsy form the standard test for the detection of nasopharyngeal cancer (NPC). However, some cancers may not be visible through the endoscope because they lie beneath the wall of the nasopharynx or are buried in a small recess that comes off the side of the nasopharynx. In these cases random deep biopsies are taken to sample the nasopharynx but even after this invasive procedure has been performed cancers may be missed. This study based on a three year follow up, evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of an alternative NPC detection test, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), and compared it against endoscopy and biopsy. This research showed that MRI is a very sensitive test for detecting NPC. MRI detected more cancers (MRI detected 100%, while endoscopy missed 12% and biopsies missed 6% of NPCs), which could translate into earlier treatment, less treatment toxicity and improved survival for NPC patients. MRI also correctly excluded NPC in 92% of normal subjects and so could replace deep invasive sampling biopsies. This study also revealed that NPC may grow slowly remaining hidden from endoscopic view for three years, thus showing that there is a wide window of opportunity to identify early cancers.

466012.label: Major findings and research outcome
466012.value: Allergy occurs when a person's immune system mounts an abnormal response with IgE to a normally harmless substance called allergen. According to the World Allergy Organization, allergy now becomes a major global public health issue. For the patients with allergy, avoiding causal allergens is the best way to prevent and control allergy. Allergen identification has therefore been an important step in allergy diagnosis, treatment and management. In this project, we applied the lab-on-a-disc (LAOD) concept with a cell-based assay for ‘Basophil Activation Test’ (BAT). LOAD is a centrifugal fluidic micro-device based on centrifugal force to drive reagents and cells to various chambers through channels and valves for reactions. In our project, two generations of LOAD have been developed. Clinically, BAT is a flow cytometric assay for allergen identification using patient’s basophils. However, basophils represent only 1% of the leukocytes in blood and their reactivity declines very fast after blood taking. In view of these limitations, we used a human basophilic line KU-812 and acridine orange (AO) as a fluorescent reporter to show and mimic release of allergic mediators. Encouraging results were obtained from this assay and LOAD for IgE and non-IgE type allergens testing [1]. In the second generation, LOAD was coated with indium tin oxide and power-enabled for thermal control [2,3]. By using this platform, we demonstrated for the first time that triptolide was able to suppress the fMLP-mediated degranulation in KU-812 among other herbs from the traditional Chinese medicine [2]. This serves as a good example how LOAD can be used as a viable technology to test allergy and to screen agents that alleviate allergy symptoms. This platform has been showcased and reported in local exhibitions and newspapers [4,5]. 1. Ho HP, et al. Allergen screening bioassays: recent developments in lab-on-a-chip and lab-on-a-disc systems. 466012.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
466012.value: Our lab-on-a-disc (LOAD) system with temperature control can test both the allergens for the IgE-mediated allergy and also the non-IgE type allergic triggers. It is a powerful tool for testing allergy and screening agents from traditional Chinese medicine or natural products to alleviate symptoms of allergy. More tests should be done on LOAD to fine-tune its utility.

466012.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
466012.value: Allergy is common in children and adults all over the word. Avoiding causal allergens is the best way to prevent allergy. Allergen identification is therefore important for the disease management. In this project, we developed a compact disc-like set-up called lab-on-a-disc (LOAD) using a basophil cell line to identify what allergen the patient is allergic to. LOAD is a centrifugal micro-device based on spinning to drive reagents and cells to various chambers through channels and valves so that signals from allergic response can be determined. Two generations of LOAD were developed. In the second generation, we coated our LOAD with a conductive transparent medium (indium tin oxide) for thermal control. Apart from testing allergens, our LOAD can be used to screen agents to lessen symptoms of allergy.
