540912.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
540912.value: Hotel companies have adopted various environmental programs to protect the environment, to save costs, or to build an environmentally-friendly image (Chan, 2008). Among different environmental programs, environmental technologies can play a key role in assisting hotel companies to improve their environmental performance. In other words, environmental technologies can help hotel companies not only save energy and water and reduce waste but also achieve higher customer satisfaction. Based on the investigators’ in-depth literature review, it is evident that there has been limited research undertaken in the hospitality field on environmental technologies’ current level of use in hotel companies. Given this gap in the hospitality field, this research project aims to (1) investigate the current use of environmental technologies in hotel companies, (2) evaluate the factors that motivate hotels to deploy environmental technologies and (3) identify potential barriers for these companies in adopting such technologies. In order to achieve these research aims, a two phase research methodology will be employed. First a series of semi-structured interviews will be conducted with senior managers in three hotels in Hong Kong. Following this, a questionnaire will be developed and forwarded to senior managers in Hong Kong. Results from semi-structured interviews and the questionnaire will be analyzed and the research findings will be disseminated through publishing articles in top-tier journals in the hospitality field. It is believed that study results from this proposed research project can contribute to the body of knowledge by sharing and discussing empirical findings related to which environmental technologies are currently used in hotels in Hong Kong, what motivate and prevent hotel companies in deploying such technologies. Given the fact that there has been limited research in this area, the study findings will have clear theoretical implications as well as practical implications for hotels in Hong Kong. 摘要: 為要支持環境保護、降低營運成本或建立健康的形象，酒店業機構會推行不同的環保計劃﹝Chan，2008﹞。在眾多的環保計劃中，環保科技對於協助酒店提昇環保表現有着舉足輕重的作用。環保科技不但能為酒店節省能源和水以致減少廢棄物，它更有助提昇顧客的滿意度。根據作者廣泛的文獻考查，過往對於環保科技在酒店服務業推展的研究是非常有限，所以本研究的目標是：1) 調查酒店對環保科技的使用；2) 分析促使酒店推行環保科技的因素；3) 識別可能阻礙環保科技推行的因素。為達成這些目標，本研究會分成兩個階段。首先研究員會對任職在三所酒店的高級經理進行一系列半結構式的訪談，繼後會因應訪談資料而設計出問卷，並分發於香港不同酒店的高級經理。訪談及問卷調查所得的結果會加以分析並計劃刊登於頂級的酒店業學術期刊。作者相信把這項研究的結果分享以及討論能對香港酒店業推行環保科技的有着重大的貢獻。鑒於在這課題上被刊登的文獻非常有限，此項研究對香港酒店業有着清晰的理論及行動意涵。

540912.label: Realisation of objectives
540912.value: The main aim of this research project is to investigate the environmental technology adoption in Hong Kong hotels. The five specific objectives established for this research have been well- achieved. The first research objective in this study is to explore how hotel managers generally view the impact of environmental technologies. Our findings reveal that almost all the hotel managers interviewed agreed that environmental technologies have become more important in recent years as the technologies have matured and offer help to hotel operations. They further suggested that environmental technologies can be used to help monitor and improve a hotel's environmental performance, especially the energy efficiency. The positive attitude of the managers towards the adoption of environmental technologies definitely increases the applications in the hotel context. An important research objective in this study is to investigate which environmental technologies hotel managers tend to support more. We found that the environmental technologies most commonly used in the sampled were light-emitting diode lights (LED), T5 fluorescent tubes, motion sensors, the key-card system, and water-cooled chillers. We also examined where the technologies are used and the benefits obtained from the usage. For instance, according to the findings, LED lights are normally used in hotel guest rooms, food and beverage outlets, and other public areas such as hotel lobby and parking areas, as the device can help a full-service hotel save up to 80%-90% of the electricity when compared with quartz lights. T5 fluorescent tubes are mainly used in back-of-house, corridors, and staircases to replace the incandescent lamps, which can help save up to 70%-80% of the electricity. Motion sensors are normally used in staff toilets, staff changing rooms, and staff entrances in order not to influence guest services. A key-card system is utilized to turn power to guest rooms on and off, resulting in possible savings of 25%-40% on guest room energy bills. When not faced with budget or technical constraints, the hotel professionals preferred solar-based renewable energy-related technology, food-waste decomposers, and energy-saving chillers. The findings provide a framework for hospitality researchers and practitioners to better understand the use of environmental technologies in the hotel industry. In this project, the team also investigated the factors motivating hotel managers to adopt and implement environmental technologies. From the findings, we identified eight main motivators: (1) incentives provided by the government; (2) attitudes of owners and senior managers; (3) corporate social responsibility; (4) improved image and competitive advantage; (5) cost saving and operational improvement; (6) technological maturity; (7) availability of reliable technologies at reasonable prices; and (8) sufficient resources. Analysis of these eight factors revealed that the decision to adopt environmental technologies is determined more by external coercive forces than by internal forces. In addition, investigating barriers preventing hotel managers from adopting environmental technologies is another important research objective in this study. Through the in-depth semi-structured interviews with senor hotel professionals including general managers, financial controllers, directors of engineering department, and environmental management system managers etc., the team successfully identified several specific barriers to the adoption. The barriers can be further grouped under three main categories: (1) product-related barriers, external barriers, and (3) internal barriers. With the identified motivators and barriers, we also achieved the final research objective by recommending some possible strategies for enhancing hotel managers' intention to adopt the environmental technologies. These possible strategies include (1) improving product knowledge of key buyer (e.g. head of engineering); (2) working with hotel associations to lobby government; (3) starting with small-scale environmental technologies; (4) educate hotel customers; (5) adopting technologies with minimal effect on guest services; (6) incorporating green ideas when building a new hotel; (7) highlighting tangible benefits to owners; (8) working closely with financial controller; (9) sharing environmental technologies and knowledge with sister hotels etc..

540912.label: Major findings and research outcome
540912.value: The primary purpose of this research project was to investigate the use of environmental technologies in the hotel industry and the potential barriers/motivators to the adoption. The research findings suggest that the most commonly used environmental technologies are LED lights, T5 fluorescent tubes, motion sensors, key-card systems, and water-cooled chillers. The findings also indicate that the LED lights are normally used in hotel guest rooms, food and beverage outlets, and other public areas such as hotel lobby and parking areas, as the device can help a full service hotel save up to 80%-90% of the electricity when compared with quartz lights. T5 fluorescent tubes are mainly used in back-of-house, corridors, and staircases to replace the incandescent lamps, which can help save up to 70%-80% of the electricity. Motion sensors are normally used in staff toilets, staff changing rooms, and staff entrances in order not to influence guest services. A key-card system is utilized to turn power to guest rooms on and off, resulting in possible savings of 25%-40% on guest room energy bills. Water-cooled chillers, a main component of a centralized air-conditioning system, are also commonly installed to supply cool air to Hong Kong hotel buildings. When compared with air-cooled model, the chillers can save about 40%-50% of the electricity used. It is clear that the Hong Kong hoteliers appeared to focus on first saving energy, rather than saving water and reducing solid/food waste, when considering using environmental technologies to improve their operation efficiency. Despite the benefits, some potential barriers to the adoption were also identified in the study. The main barriers to such adoption can be grouped under three areas: product-related barriers, external barriers, and internal barriers. Product-related barriers include the immaturity, unreliability, high initial cost, and ongoing maintenance requirement of the environmental technology. External barriers include inconvenience cause by government, unpredictable weather, and the potentially negative effect of such technologies on customer service. Internal barriers include the physical limitations of the building, a lack of owner initiative and resources, budgetary priorities, the potential influence of the technologies on daily operations, and the short duration of hotel management contracts. Together with some motivators identified in the study, specific recommendations are also put forward. The investigators hope that the research findings will be used by hoteliers to increase the adoption rate of environmental technologies in the hotel industry.

540912.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
540912.value: Responding to call for further research in these areas, it is hoped that the findings of this research study will stimulate further research in our field globally about adoption of environmental technologies in the hospitality field. Future studies can collect data from hotel companies in other countries to conduct a cross-cultural study. The studies can also investigate the issues further to elucidate the differences and similarities between hotels in different size or class categories.

540912.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
540912.value: This study investigates the use of environmental technologies in the hotel industry and the factors that motivate/hinder hotel companies to/from the adoption. It's found that the environmental technologies most commonly used in the sampled are light-emitting diode lights, T5 fluorescent tubes, motion sensors, the key-card system, and water-cooled chillers. The study also identifies numerous barriers and motivators to the environmental technology adoption. Specific recommendations for overcoming these barriers and motivating hotel managers to adopt the technologies are also put forward. The study contributes to the field by expanding the body of research on hospitality environmental management as well as the environmental technology applications in hotels. It builds on previous research studies on environmental management and technologies to identify areas that must be addressed by hotel managers, which is a valuable contribution to the literature. In addition, it provides a framework for hospitality practitioners to better understand the use of environmental technologies. The knowledge of the benefits that could be gained from some environmental technologies would be particularly useful for hotel managers who need to select and decide what environmental technologies should be adopted in hotels.

541112.label: Project Objectives
541112.value: To examine Chinese patterns of seeking help for emotional and mental problems, and the use of professional mental health or medical services, based on a representative sample of Beijing urban residents; To assess the existence and extent of structural and cultural barriers to the use of professional mental health or medical services, in terms of accessibility, affordability, and acceptability; To further explore and understand the motivations behind the decision to seek or not seek help through professional, informal, or alternative means, particularly on the part of those who are very psychologically distressed; To suggest effective policy strategies and practice interventions to reduce the existing barriers to help seeking for emotional or mental health problems and to enhance the quality of professional mental health service provision in urban China.

541112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
541112.value: The state of mental health in China has gained prominence due to the increase in the population’s economic and societal stress. Still, few people seek professional help for emotional or mental problems. Where do urban Chinese seek help when they experience these problems? What barriers do they perceive when they attempt to access professional services? Based on the findings of a pilot survey of 1,474 urban residents in Beijing in 2009, this project seeks to further analyze Chinese patterns of seeking help for emotional and mental problems, and the structural and cultural barriers that limit the use of professional mental health or medical services. The project will take advantage of the fact that the Research Center for Contemporary China (RCCC) at Peking University will be conducting the biennial Beijing Area Study (BAS) in 2013 and 2015. Under the present proposal, I will contribute 40% of the total direct costs of the survey. By so doing, I will not only be able to access the information provided by the standard questions (on demographics, employment, family, neighborhood, health status, and finances) but also be allowed to add questions in four areas: mental health, help seeking, service use, and perceived barriers. Employing spatial probability sampling technology, we aim to develop panel data on 2,500 representative residents of Beijing, while not confining ourselves to those with registered residency (hukou) status. In addition to the longitudinal survey that will investigate the help-seeking behaviors and significant predictors of the whole sample, focus group interviews will be held for the most psychologically distressed subgroup to further explore the motivations behind the decision to seek or not seek help from professionals or others. The research will enable us to better understand the choices of Chinese people when experiencing emotional or mental problems regarding help seeking and service use. The study also has implications for future policy decisions and practice interventions that aim to reduce existing barriers and enhance the quality of mental health services. The findings and their implications will be critical to the sustainable development of mental health service provision in urban China. 由於人們經濟與社會壓力的不斷增加，精神健康問題在中國愈益緊迫。然而，尋求專業精神健康幫助的人仍是少數。當遇到情緒或精神問題的時候，人們到哪里尋求幫助呢？當試圖使用專業服務的時候，人們會遇到哪些障礙呢？本研究基於2009年對北京1474個城市居民初步調查的發現，試圖進一步分析中國城市居民對精神和健康問題的求助模式，以及制約專業精神健康或相關醫療服務使用的制度與文化因素。本研究將利用北京大學中國國情研究中心兩年一度進行北京地區社會經濟發展跟蹤調查（BAS）的平臺，於2013年和2015年實施跟蹤調查。問卷內容除了基本的有關人口、就業、家庭、社區、健康和經濟狀況的問題外，還包括測量精神健康、求助行為、服務使用及制度與文化障礙的問題。調查會採用GPS輔助的區域抽樣方法，調查樣本計畫為2500個。目標人群將不受戶籍限制，包括北京城市居民及外來人口。除了跟蹤調查外，我們還計畫對調查中情緒或精神問題較嚴重的群體進行焦點小組訪談，以進一步瞭解他們尋求或是不尋求專業幫助決定背後的動機。這項研究將有助於我們進一步瞭解中國居民尋求專業精神健康幫助或使用相關服務的情況，從而為未來的政策制定和實務幹預提供啟示，以減少目前存在的障礙，提升精神健康服務的品質。研究的發現及啟示將對中國城市精神健康服務的持續發展至關重要。

541212.label: Project Objectives
541212.value: Theoretically, this research aims to develop a dynamic framework of control processes to explain and predict the pathways and consequences of external control and fate control. Methodologically, a multi-method approach will be adopted to test the hypothesized framework, in search of converging evidence from cross-sectional, prospective, and experimental designs. Conceptually, this project will differentiate related but distinguishable concepts of control in the literature and demonstrate the discriminant validity and functional utility of social axioms. Practically, the proposed framework offers an alternative perspective to conventional approaches of coping and adjustment, and will shed light on how social axioms affect cognitive appraisal and psychological well-being.

541212.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
541212.value: Psychologists have extensively investigated how personality constructs influence social behavior and mental health, and revealed important psychological processes underlying traits, values, and attitudes. The domain of beliefs, however, has received scant attention from personality and social psychology researchers. Past work on beliefs was mostly focused on how people view themselves. Other than Rotter’s (1966) locus of control and Wrightsman’s (1974) beliefs about human nature, researchers rarely studied how people view the world around them and the social environment in which they function. Leung and colleagues (2002) proposed a set of general views about how the world functions, termed “social axioms”, which refer to generalized beliefs about people, social groups, social institutions, the physical environment, or the spiritual world (Leung & Bond, 2008). The present research seeks to test the pathways and psychological outcomes of fate control, a belief that life events are predetermined, predictable, and alterable, and to empirically distinguish it from its conceptually overlapping construct, external locus of control, which denotes generalized expectancies for life events as stemming from external forces. Specifically, it is hypothesized that external control will predict emotion-focused coping positively and in turn predict psychological distress, and that fate control will predict problem-focused coping positively and in turn predict psychological adjustment. A multi-method approach incorporating cross-sectional, prospective, and experimental designs will be adopted to test the hypothesized model in both laboratory and real-life settings among college students and community adults. Theoretically, this research will offer an alternative perspective on the psychological consequences of internal versus external control, and identify differential mechanisms underlying control-related constructs. Practically, the results can enrich coping strategies that are built on conventional Western theories on locus of control, and provide implications for interventions with world-views in counseling and psychotherapies, which are especially relevant to Chinese cultural contexts.

542112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
542112.value: Channel coordination is known to be a core subject of modern supply chain management. Over the past decades, much research effort has been devoted to exploring the detailed mechanisms of achieving coordination in a supply chain with supply chain contracts under the assumption that the supply chain agents are perfectly rational (and they always make “deterministic” optimal decisions). However, recent empirical research via behavioral experiments has well-demonstrated that decision makers in the real world are rarely perfectly rational and their decisions will vary from time to time. It thus gives rise to the important research questions on (i) how well do these “coordinating” contracts perform when the supply chain agents are only “boundedly rational (BR)” (i.e., not perfectly rational)? (ii) What is the supply chain contracting mechanism which can maximize supply chain efficiency with BR supply chain agents? (iii) Is it beneficial to the supply chain when a more rational agent acts as the channel leader? In light of this, I propose to study analytically the performance of supply chain contracts with BR supply chain agents. In order to get more analytical insights, I will first consider the case when the manufacturer is perfectly rational and construct the analytical supply chain model with a BR retailer. Popular forms of supply chain contracts such as returns, rebates, two-part tariff, etc will be examined and their performances in enhancing supply chain efficiency with a BR retailer are explored. After that, I will investigate these contracts' performances under the case with both a BR manufacturer and a BR retailer. The effects brought by different degrees of bounded rationality of the manufacturer and the retailer on the supply chain’s efficiency will be investigated. Finally, I will extend the analysis and findings by exploring the challenging cases with (i) channel leadership with BR agents, (ii) social preference of fairness, and (iii) multiple BR retailers. For the extension with multiple BR retailers, I plan to study both the homogeneous and heterogenous cases in which the degrees of bounded rationality of the retailers are assumed to be the same and different, respectively. I believe that this project will contribute significantly to the supply chain contracting and coordination literature and generate many useful academic and managerial insights. 渠道協調是現代供應鏈管理中共知的一個關鍵問題。過去幾十年中，在假設供應鏈代理是完全理性的（而且他們也總是做出確定性的最優決策）條件下，大量文獻研究了供應鏈契約協調的細節機制問題。然而近期行為學實驗的實證研究有力的證明現實中的決策者很少是完全理性的，而他們的決策也會經常變化。由此引出以下重要的研究問題： 1 當供應鏈代理只是有限理性時（即非完全理性），這些協調契約績效如何？ 2 當供應鏈代理是有限理性時，用以最大化供應鏈效率的供應鏈契約機制是什麽？3 當更為理性的代理做為渠道領導時，是否對供應鏈有利？鑒於此，我建議研究在供應鏈代理為有限理性時的供應鏈契約績效。爲了獲得更多的分析性結論，我先考慮製造商是完全理性的而零售商是有限理性的情況並構造一個供應鏈模型。我將研究在零售商有限理條件下，退貨、折扣及二部定價等常見的供應鏈契約形式在提高供應鏈效率的表現。之後，我將研究在製造商和零售商都是有限理性的條件下供應鏈契約的績效。關於製造商和零售商的有限理性程度對於供應鏈效率的影響，我將進行探索。最後我將分析和延伸研究結果到以下具有挑戰性的案例中：（1）供應鏈代理是有限理性的渠道領導，（2）公平的社會偏好，（3）多個有限理性的零售商。對於多個有限理性零售商的問題，我將假設零售商的有限理性程度相同及不同時，對同質及不同質案例進行研究。我相信這個研究項目對供應鏈契約和協調的文獻具有顯著貢獻，並提出許多有用的學術觀點和管理理論。

542112.label: Realisation of objectives
542112.value: We basically achieved all the objectives. To be specific, we started by conducting both analytical and empirical (behavioral) research on the topic and derived many important results. A behavioral experiment paper was published in a behavioral science journal, and a related multi-methodological research paper was also published in Production and Operations Management. After that, we mainly explored boundedly rational decision making in supply chain systems from two perspectives. The first perspective is on the situations when the supply chain agents are not perfectly rational and they only make the optimal decisions with a higher chance. For this perspective, we published two papers, one in Transportation Research - Part E and one in International Transactions in Operational Research (P.S.: The Society journal of IFORS). We also developed two papers, one under the 2nd round review (after major revisions) by Decision Sciences, and one under the first round review by Operations Research. The second perspective is on the situations when supply chain agents are "biased" and hence fail to make perfectly rational decisions. In this domain, we published four papers in Naval Research Logistics, INFORMS Service Science, Annals of Operations Research, and Transportation Research - Part E, respectively.

542112.label: Major findings and research outcome
542112.value: For the major findings, this project’s findings can be classified into three types: (A) Bounded rational agents making random "optimal decisions": We investigated the supply chain coordination challenges with (i) the scenario when both the supplier and the buyer are boundedly rational, (ii) the situation when the supplier is perfectly rational and the buyer is stochastically risk sensitive, (iii) the supply chain in which the retail managers are boundedly rational, and (iv) the use of social media data which relates to the decision maker's degree of bounded rationality. We focused our attention on how the supply chain agents' random "optimal decisions" under bounded rationality affect the supply chain's performance as well as the coordination contracting mechanisms. Many interesting managerial insights were obtained. (B) Multi-method analysis: We explored the use of a multi-methodological approach to explore supply chain management problems. We conducted experiments with human subjects and derived a few important results on how bounded rationality may affect the setting of supply chain contract parameters. We also discussed the significance of applying the multi-methodological approach in exploring supply chain operations management problems. (C) Decision bias: When decision makers are not perfectly rational, they make decisions with bias. This relates to the idea of bounded rationality. In this domain, we investigated various situations in the context of supply chain management. For instance, we examined the situation when consumers are loss averse and derived the respective stocking, procurement and product design policies. We studied the situation when the supply chain agents are risk sensitive and explored how optimal decisions in the supply chain can be made. We derived many novel managerial insights, especially on how supply chain contracts and measures can be employed to enhance channel performance when the supply chain agents are not perfectly rational. Supported by this project, we already published eight papers in well-established "SCI/SSCI" journals such as Production and Operations Management, Naval Research Logistics, Annals of Operations Research, Transportation Research - Part E, INFORMS Service Science, etc. Two papers are under review by Decision Sciences (2nd round) and Operations Research (1st round).

542112.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
542112.value: Owing to time limitation, two very important papers supported by this project are still under journal review. We plan to work hard and get them published. Furthermore, our current analysis focuses on bounded rationality in a single product two-echelon supply chain. We can consider the more complex and general supply chain in the future.

542112.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
542112.value: Supply chain contracts play a crucial role in modern supply chain management because they help to achieve channel coordination. However, very little is known about how to improve performance of supply chains with bounded rational agents. Based on the existing literature in operations management and economics, this project focuses on exploring the corresponding supply chain contracting challenges. This project has generated a lot of important analytical and empirical findings. We believe that the insights derived from the theoretical analyses not only contribute substantially to the supply chain management literature but they also help advance our knowledge in how bounded rationality affects supply chain contracting mechanisms in the real world.

542312.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
542312.value: The purpose of this research is to explore the preferred combination of spa rate restrictions as perceived by mainland Chinese spa customers. China, as the world’s largest emerging market, is becoming a major source of customers for hospitality businesses around the world. In addition, characteristics of the Chinese culture such being highly collectivist and oriented toward in-groups as imply that Chinese customers’ preferences might be different from those of other customers. The five selected rate fences are pricing by therapists, pricing by peak and non-peak period, pricing by weekdays and weekends, pricing by type of reservation, and pricing by reservation time. These rate fences will be presented to the participants along with three levels of rates for a 60-minute aromatherapy massage which is the most popular spa treatment. The conjoint analysis will be utilized to generate combinations of rate restrictions for participants to rank the combinations from the most-preferred to the least-preferred combination. This study intends to initiate a new research stream in the context of spa rate fencing by providing insight into the preferences of Chinese customers. 本研究之目的是探討中國內地顧客對於水療價格限制首選組合的看法。中國是世界最大的新興市場，中國遊客將成為全世界酒店業的主要客源。此外，中國文化的特色，例如高度的集體性與團體出遊，意味著中國內地遊客的喜好可能與其他顧客不同。五個所選價格柵欄的定價分別按治療師、旺季與淡季、平時工作日與週末、預定類型以及預定時間來進行的。 這些價格柵欄將介紹予參與者，同時亦就水療最有人氣的一個鍾香薰治療按摩給出三個價位。本研究將用聯合分析來得出價格限制的組合，讓參與者評價排列這些組合，排出從“最喜歡”到“最不喜歡”的順序。本研究旨在對中國內地顧客喜好進行深入介紹，提出水療價格柵欄限制方面的新研究方向。

542312.label: Realisation of objectives
542312.value: All the research objectives were met successfully and we published the results in 2 manuscripts. A questionnaire was used as the data collection instrument. The questionnaire was prepared in English and then translated into simplified Chinese using a back-to-back translation method to ensure its validity. The back-to-back translation method minimizes the possibility of unnecessary misunderstanding due to differences in linguistic expression. Moreover, the questionnaire was pilot tested among 21 Chinese respondents who had spa experiences and revealed only minor problems that were subsequently amended in the final version. Chinese travellers visiting Hong Kong were selected as the sample. The face-to-face survey was conducted at Avenue of Stars in Tsim Sha Tsui using a convenience sampling approach. The Avenue of Stars was chosen because it is the most visited attraction in Hong Kong. To increase the response rate, incentives were offered to the respondents when seeking their participation. In total, 400 questionnaires were collected over a period of about two months. Of this, 28 invalid questionnaires were discarded due to missing data, leaving 372 questionnaires to be included in the analysis. This sample size is typical of that employed in commercial conjoint studies. We analyzed the data using conjoint and cluster analysis.

542312.label: Major findings and research outcome
542312.value: the main findings from the first manuscript are the following: The purpose of this study was to segment spa customers based on their preferences for spa rates and restrictions. A survey was conducted using a self-administrated questionnaire distributed to Chinese visitors in Hong Kong with spa experience. Four distinct customer segments were identified by combining conjoint and cluster analyses: treatment-oriented spa goers, guarantee-sensitive spa goers, price-sensitive spa goers, and fewer days advance booking seekers. The results support the effectiveness of combining conjoint and cluster analyses in market segmentation studies. The findings will be useful for spas in designing rate fences preferred by different types of customers, which could in turn increase spa revenue. the main findings from the second manuscript are the following: Purpose – This paper aims to segment spa customers based on their preferences for a set of spa attributes. With the considerable growth rate of the spa market, it is vital for spa professionals to understand spa-goers’ preferences. However, academics and industry professionals have not devised a structured method by which to manage spa customers. Design/methodology/approach – A survey was conducted using a face-to-face survey with visitors to Hong Kong who had visited a spa. By applying conjoint and cluster analysis, customers could be categorized into distinct segments. Findings – Four customer segments were identified: spa enthusiasts, high spenders, value seekers and price-sensitive spa-goers. Spa enthusiasts were the largest segment among the four, followed by value seekers, price-sensitive spa-goers and high spenders. Research limitations/implications – Given the limited academic interest in the area, this study contributes to the literature by providing insights into spa-goers’ preferences and how those preferences can be used to segment spa-goers. Practical implications – Based on the different needs, preferences and socio-demographic characteristics of the four segments – spa enthusiasts, high spenders, value seekers and price-sensitive spa-goers – spa industry managers could customize their strategies and design different spa services and packages to meet the needs of the four segments. Originality/value – The combined use of conjoint and cluster analysis provides a new method of market segmentation in the spa industry. This study could help spa professionals to design customized spa products for the distinct segments, and thus retain and attract more spa visitors.

This is one of the first study of its kind and we hope that more research will be built upon the preliminary findings we established related to preferences of Chinese spa customers and segmentation of these customers.

542412.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
542412.value: The academic year 2012-13 marks the beginning of a new era in Hong Kong higher education as it sees the first phase in the transition from a three-year to a four-year undergraduate curriculum. The academic structure will therefore shift from a seven-year secondary-school system culminating in a narrowly focused sixth form curriculum followed by an even more specialised university programme to a six-year system culminating in a broadly based senior-secondary curriculum followed by an initially less specialised university programme. The transformation of the undergraduate curriculum will not, however, be accompanied by a change in the medium of instruction, which, in the majority of cases, will continue to be English. The new generation of undergraduates will therefore be required to make the transition to English-medium studies a year earlier than before and with more limited academic knowledge, experience and skills than graduates of the traditional system. This generation is also likely to include a significant proportion of students from Chinese-medium schools, who therefore not only face the challenge of adjusting to the demands of university studies but also of adapting to teaching and learning in English. Research into the school-university transition indicates that the first year is a crucial stage in the process of socialisation into the undergraduate role and a sensitive touchstone for the quality of the entire student experience. These findings underline the importance of ensuring that the new generation of students make a smooth transition to English-medium studies. It is with this fundamental objective in view that the proposed study has been designed. The study seeks to identify and understand the language-related challenges the first cohort of such students experience when making the transition to English-medium studies and, on the basis of this understanding, to propose practical measures to facilitate this process. The study will be of immense practical value for institutions, departments and language centres in Hong Kong as it will provide a wealth of information, insights and strategies to underpin learning and teaching in the first year of the new curriculum. It will also be of considerable theoretical significance for scholars in the fields of English for specific purposes and higher education studies as it will be one of the few language-focused longitudinal investigations of the first-year experience and will therefore make an original contribution to the literature on the challenges that non-native users of English face when making the transition to English-medium higher education. 迎接高等教育以英語為教學語言的挑戰:香港新課程下的本科生體驗 二零一二至二零一三學年是香港本科課程由三年制改為四年制的首個過渡階段, 標誌著香港高等教育新時代的開始。傳統七年制中學課程包括了頗偏狹的高中教程，緊接著的大學課程專門程度更高；新六年制中學課程的高中教程則旨在打好學生各方面的基礎，並與專門程度較低的大學課程接軌。雖然本科課程轉型，但以英語作為教學語言的方針在大多數情況下維持不變。相比傳統學制的畢業生，新一代的大學生不但需以有限的學術知識、經驗和技能來應付以英語為教學語言的學習，而且，其當中也包括了以中文為教學語言的中學畢業生。這些學生不僅要適應大學學習的要求，更要適應以英語「教」和「學」。 有關中學至大學之過渡的研究顯示，學生升上大學的第一年是他們適應本科生角色的重要階段，也是其整體學習體驗質素的一塊敏感試金石。這些研究結果都強調必須確保新一代的學生能夠順利過渡到以英語為教學語言的學習模式。本研究是鑑於此基本目標而設計。本研究旨在確定和理解新學制下第一批過渡到以英語為教學語言的本科生將體驗到與語言相關的問題和挑戰，利用研究所得的基礎，提出切實可行的措施來改善整個過程。本研究將對本港的學術機構，部門和語言中心提供有關豐富的見解和策略，以鞏固第一年新課程的學習和教學，甚具實用價值。此外，本研究是少數以語言為中心，關於本科生第一年大學學習體驗的縱向研究，將解構非英語為母語的英語使用者在過渡以英語教學的高等教育時面對的困難，更為在「英語作特定用途」的領域及高等教育的研究學者提供具建設性的理論，並為有關範疇的文獻作出具原創性的貢獻。

542412.label: Realisation of objectives
542412.value: The study’s four interrelated objectives were realised through the collection of substantial sets of qualitative and quantitative data. The main thread of the project was a longitudinal study of a sample of 4-year-cohort students (n=40). The participants’ experiences were tracked in semi-structured interviews conducted towards the end of each of their first four terms at university. Each round of interviews had a specific purpose guided by the study’s objectives. Round I centred on the participants’ initial adjustment to university study; Round II was based on the items in a campus-wide questionnaire (see below); Round III concentrated on learning styles, the transition from general to discipline-specific education, and time allocation; Round IV sought to uncover turning points or critical moments in the process of ‘becoming’ an undergraduate. Altogether, 122 interviews were conducted, which were subsequently wholly or partially transcribed. The longitudinal strand of the study enabled us to identify and understand the language-related challenges that students experienced when making the transition to English-medium higher education (objective 1) and to determine the strategies they employed to overcome the challenges of studying in a second language (objective 2). This evidence provided the basis for proposing measures to facilitate students’ transition to English-medium university study (objective 4). The study’s quantitative strand enabled us to categorise the background factors that helped or hindered students’ adjustment to life and learning at university (objective 3). This information was derived from a campus-wide questionnaire survey completed by 1,486 students at the end of the 2012/13 academic year (i.e. at around the same time as Round II of the longitudinal study). This strand of the study also included two short, open-ended questionnaires conducted in October 2012 (n=1,181) and in April 2014 (n=422), which, in their different ways, contributed to the realisation of objectives 1, 3 and 4. In terms of the number of participants involved and the range of methods employed, the project is one of the most comprehensive studies of the student experience undertaken outside the Anglophone world.

542412.label: Major findings and research outcome
542412.value: The study has generated a number of important findings, some of which have public-policy implications. While the findings suggest that by the end of the first year most of the participants felt that they had adjusted moderately well to the demands of university study, many of them evidently experienced extremely taxing transitions in the first semester. Their principal difficulties concerned learning and using discipline-specific vocabulary; adjusting to the norms, practices and expectations of a new learning environment; managing their time and workload efficiently; and researching, planning and writing unfamiliar academic genres. The evidence suggests that many graduates of Chinese-medium schools were lost in transition in the first semester. The survey findings indicated that such students generally entered university with lower proficiency in English than their counterparts from English-medium schools and thus unsurprisingly experienced greater difficulties executing key study and English-language skills than their classmates from English-medium schools. The interviews indicated that Chinese-stream students were initially overwhelmed by a deluge of unfamiliar lexis in often incomprehensible lectures and readings, although, by the end of the year, they had managed to come to terms with the demands of university study through a combination of diligence, determination and relentless practice. Irrespective of school teaching medium, most of the longitudinal study participants felt that they had ‘become’ undergraduates by the early weeks of year 2, i.e. had largely relinquished the learner identity formed at school and embraced the array of assumptions, behaviours and practices associated with ‘being’ a fully-fledged university student. By this stage they had a clear sense of their lecturers’ expectations; many of their travails in the first year stemmed from their uncertainty over precisely what their instructors required. Thus, one of the main lessons to emerge from the study is that teachers of year 1 students need to be explicit about their expectations. The study has already generated four accepted or published papers in international journals and two articles under review. Two other articles are near to completion and one other substantial article is in preparation. The study’s findings have been presented at international conferences and in research seminars organised by the Applied Linguistics Research Group at the University of Oxford. The study’s methods and findings have also been presented and discussed in postgraduate subjects and seminars at the Hong Kong Polytechnic University and in the EMI Oxford course for university teachers organised by Oxford’s Department of Education.

542412.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
542412.value: The most obvious avenue for further development would be to track the experiences of students throughout the four years of their university studies. This indeed was our original idea for the current project, but this is difficult within the timeframe of a GRF project, which is typically three years. This explains our decision to focus on the first two years at university. Another possible direction would be to conduct a comparative study of the school-to-university transition or the undergraduate experience. During his sabbatical leave at the University of Oxford in 2015, the PI established links with Prof David Lasagabaster of the University of the Basque Country, who is a prominent scholar in the area of English-medium higher education. Prof Lasagabaster’s research context has certain parallels with Hong Kong in that it involves three languages: regional (Cantonese, Basque), national (Putonghua, Spanish) as well as the shared global language (English). It may be possible to develop a project proposal involving collaboration between PolyU, the University of the Basque Country and Oxford’s Department of Education, which has a research centre focusing on English-medium instruction (under the auspices of which the PI and Prof Lasagabaster gave presentations in November 2015).

542412.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
542412.value: The academic year 2012-13 marked the beginning of a new era in Hong Kong higher education as it saw the first phase in the transition from a three-year to a four-year undergraduate curriculum. This project aimed to identify and understand the language-related challenges that students in the first 4-year cohort experienced when making the transition to English-medium university studies, to determine the strategies they employed to overcome these challenges, and to categorise the background factors that helped or hindered their transition. These objectives were accomplished through campus-wide surveys and four rounds of interviews over two years with a representative sample of students. The information derived from these data-gathering exercises enabled the investigators to propose practical measures to help students overcome their main challenges. The participants’ principal challenges lay in comprehending and using specialist vocabulary, assimilating the autonomous style of learning required by lecturers, and planning, researching, and writing long coursework assignments. The participants reported a myriad of coping strategies such as compiling vocabulary lists and consulting Chinese textbooks, but essentially they sought to overcome the challenges of the school-to-university transition through strong achievement motivation, supportive peer networks, effective learning strategies and relentless practice.

543112.label: Project Objectives

543112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
543112.value: Rising costs associated with new medical technology development and growing demand from aging populations have made it increasingly difficult for many countries to finance their public health care systems. To relieve the strain faced by their public health care providers, many countries are now carrying out health care reforms. One important approach they adopt is to subsidize citizens to purchase health insurance and to seek private health care service. In this research, two typical subsidy schemes are proposed to be studied. One is an unconditional partial subsidy scheme which is implemented in Australia under which customers seeking private care are partially subsidized without any pre-requirement. The other is the full subsidy scheme under which the customers are fully subsidized by the government when they are routed from the public system to the private system under the condition that their waiting time in the public system reaches a pre-determined threshold level, as implemented in the United Kingdom. For each scheme, we adopt queueing economic theory to model the congestion of the public system and to derive customers' equilibrium choice between the private and public systems. Based on our equilibrium analysis, we then investigate the optimal design of each subsidy scheme. We have initiated a preliminary study along this direction and obtained some interesting results regarding the comparison results over the two schemes. We show that the preference over the above two schemes depends on the size of total available budget. If such a budget is very limited, then partial subsidy generates a larger social welfare than the full subsidy scheme; otherwise, the full subsidy scheme prevails. This research needs to be extended to a much richer setting which could generate very insightful views and suggestions to health care policy makers. The results in this research can shed light on the implementation of the proposed health care reform by the Hong Kong SAR government in 2010. 新的医疗技术和人口老龄化使得越来越多的国家政府对公共医疗系统的财政支持感到吃力。 为了缓解政府的财政压力以及解决顾客等待时间过长的难题，很多政府对医疗系统进行了改革。 其中一项是实施补贴机制。 本研究对两种典型的补贴机制进行比较研究。 一种是无条件部分补贴机无条件部分补贴机制。 比如，澳大利亚政府就对购买医疗保险的居民进行部分补贴。 一种是基于等待时间的完全补贴机制。比如，英国政府对居民的看病等待时间设定上限，一旦病人的等待时间到达此上限，该病人可以到私立系统免费看病，成本由政府负担。本研究拟采用排队论模型来研究顾客的等待时间，并且利用博弈论模型来研究顾客的选择行为。 初步研究表明， 当政府预算很充足，基于等待时间的完全补贴机制优于无条件部分补贴机制。 相反，如果政府预算很少，无条件部分补贴机制胜出。

543112.label: Major findings and research outcome
543112.value: One major finding is that, when a private healthcare system is requested to support itself financially, governments shall pay enough attention to the public healthcare capacity. A large public capacity can make the private system difficult to survive and it will lose scale economy, which makes the social welfare worse. Hence government shall consider to subsidize private system, either through subsidizing patients directly or help private system set up their capacity. This finding is very important for the policy makers to understood the relationship between the public and private health care systems. This work appears on the M&SOM journal. Two more papers are published on Operations Research Letters. I also compared the subsidy schemes used in the health care systems in different countries. I compared the full subsidy scheme with partial one and find that the former is better in meeting the waiting time target for the health care system while the latter is better in achieving a lower cost for the society. This outcome is written in a working paper, which is currently under the third round review with the POM journal.

543112.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
543112.value: I am also cooperating with Dr. Qian Qu of a Singapore university to further study the two subsidy schemes when customers have different information on the system congestion.

543112.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
543112.value: In a two-tier public-private healthcare system, public system is supported financially by governments while private system must do the self-financing. As the capacity of public system expands, the private system may face difficulty to survive due to difficulty to attract demands. Governments hence can consider another way to improve the social welfare: subsidize patients to use the private system, instead of directly expanding the public system. Two ways are typical: either partially subsidize all patients or fully subsidize those long-waited patients. We compare the two schemes through building queueing models. We find that partial subsidy can reduce the total cost while the full subsidy can meet the service target requirement easily (the percentage of patients who must be served within a time limit must be less than a targeted point ).

543512.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
543512.value: The term World Chineses (全球華語), though not as common as World Englishes, is becoming more and more widely used with the increasing popularity of Chinese as a second language and with the Chinese diaspora spreading and growing. The lexical variations among World Chineses, such as region-specific neologism (new words), meaning variations of the same word, and the use of different words to express the same meaning, are easily observed and often studied. However, such studies are typically based on incidental observations and lacks in both coverage and rigor to give a systematic account of the core and variable properties of World Chineses. The availability of comparable corpora (i.e. two or more corpora with similar topics and coverage) of different variants of Chinese enabled corpus-studies of such lexical variations and heralded many possibilities of research on World Chineses. For instance, the LIVAC synchronic Chinese corpus generated exciting and comprehensive studies on lexical variations among different Chinese communities and recently completed Chinese Gigaword Corpus offered additional possibilities. Yet, to better understand the dynamicity of World Chineses and how variants of World Chineses can overcome their differences to communicate efficiently, we need to study grammatical variations of World Chineses. In this study, we propose a comparable-corpus-based approach to study grammatical variations among three of the most dominant form of World Chineses: Mainland, Taiwan, and Hong Kong; while including Singapore Mandarin for some of the studies. An innovative statistical method for automatic comparison and extraction of possible patterns of grammatical variations is adopted. Such variations are then carefully studied by linguists to offer explanatory generalizations and to make possible predictions. We will focus on three sets of constructions anchored by verbs: light verb constructions, VO compounds, and aspectual markers. All grammatical variations will be documented and generalizations will be given. Our study will be the first such comprehensive study of World Chineses and will shed light on how typological characteristics of Mandarin Chinese and its unique orthography contribute to and restrict possible variations. We also expect results of our study to be incorporated in the proposed World Chinese Dictionary. 隨著華語熱的不斷升溫以及華語使用者在全球各地的不斷增長擴散，“全球華語”這個名詞也越來越為廣泛使用。全球華語的詞彙差異，如地域性新詞語，同名異物詞語，同物異名詞語等已有廣泛研究。然而多數前人研究只基於學者的局部觀察，因而無法對全球華語的核心及變異屬性做出全面系統性的描述。可比語料庫（兩個或兩個以上基於類似主題和內容的語料庫）的出現使得語料庫為本的詞彙差異研究成為可能；同時，這些可比語料庫也為全球華語的其他研究創造可能。比如基於LIVAC共時語料庫的研究已在華語詞彙差異方面獲得可喜的成果，新近建成的Gigaword語料庫更是為全球華語差異研究提供更多的資源和機會。除了詞彙差異，為更好地瞭解全球華語的動態性並克服各變體之間的差異從而進行有效溝通，我們更需要研究全球華語的語法差異。本項目正是基於可比語料庫的全球華語語法差異研究。我們以大陸，台灣和香港三個主導的華語變體為研究主體（同時在一些相關研究中加入新加坡華語），利用創新性的統計模型自動比較並抽取包含語法差異的構式，再經由語言學專家對統計結果進行細緻分析，從而對語法差異給予理論上的歸納概括和解釋，並預測差異趨勢。本項目中，我們集中研究三個動詞相關的構式，即輕動詞結構，動賓（VO）復合詞，體標記。本項目將是第一個基於可比語料庫的全球華語語法差異的研究，也將揭示漢語的類型學特點及其獨特的文字系統在引發或限制語法差異方面所起的作用。

543512.label: Realisation of objectives
543512.value: For Objective 1, comprehensive account of grammatical variations of two regional World Chineses: Mainland Mandarin and Taiwan Mandarin, has been provided, with the assistance of large-scale comparable corpora, statistical tools, as well as computational algorithm. Unfortunately, we were not able to obtain large scale tagged comparable corpus for Hong Kong Mandarin. Hence the study on comparison with Hong Kong Cantonese was limited manual comparison instead of corpus based stochastic modelling. This unfortunately seriously restricted publishability of our results involving Hong Kong Mandarin variety. For Objective 2, stochastic models have also been explored to provide comprehensive descriptive account of syntactic variations. Two major statistical models (i.e. mixed-effect logistic regression model and Chi-square test) were utilized for both light verb constructions and VO+O constructions. Since the grammatical variations more tend to be preference/tendency differences, probabilistic syntactic model was adopted, to study the grammatical variation from a continuous/probabilistic perspective. The results show that with the annotated features, statistical models are very effective in differentiating grammatical variations. For objective 3, solid empirical and theoretical basis were provided, with the help of comparable corpora, for the description of grammatical variations in the first comprehensive dictionary of World Chineses. We found that variations among World Chineses are rarely, if ever, based on absolute grammatical judgment but instead on preference and distribution of certain grammatical constructions. This suggests that a corpus-based dictionary of grammatical usages including distributional information will be the best model for a comprehensive dictionary of World Chineses. For objective 4, the correlation among language variation, language alternation and language change has been discovered through the study of VO transitivization. The results of statistical analyses present that there is a close interaction between language variation and language alternation. The language variation across regions to a large extent lies in the differences in alternation preferences. In other words, the grammatical variations are not as simple as simple feature or behavior difference, but in fact difference in the patterns of alternations. The relationship between alternation and language change can also be discovered under the theoretical framework of Lexical Diffusion Theory. With this correlation, it is possible to build the bridge between language variation and change. In the study of VO transitivization, the relationship of language change and language variation has been carefully examined. For objective 5, the theoretical issue of whether grammatical variations of light verb constructions are dependent on its argument-structure has been explored. The variation differences in the syntactic type of the external objects have been carefully investigated. A re-classification of taken objects was proposed, and this may also help with the annotation standard for POS tagging in the corpus. For objective 6, the theoretical issue of whether the grammatical variations of VO compounds are dependent on the degree of lexicalization of these compounds has been examined. The correlation between transitivity and separation ability for VO compound in Mandarin Chinese was empirically examined. The results show that inseparable VOs are more likely to be used in a transitive way, compared to separable ones. In addition, there is a statistical negative correlation between transitivity and separation ability, i.e. the more a VO sequence is lexicalized, the less likely it can take an object. We further empirically prove that the grammatical variations of VO compound are to a large extent depend on the degree of lexicalization. The differences in separation and transitivity between Mainland and Taiwan actually indicate the different stages that Mainland and Taiwan VO compounds are located in the continuum of lexicalization. For objective 7, verbal semantic systems of the three varieties were compared, including aspectual markers, verbal meanings and argument structures. No systematic differences were found. In conjunction with the results from, our study suggests that variations are largely determined by lexical diffusion.

543512.label: Major findings and research outcome
543512.value: Our most important findings are that world Chinese variations are of the nature of preference and distributions instead of absolute grammatical judgments. In addition, the preferences and distributions are often lexically dependent. That is, among different varieties, different lexical items may have different tendencies. Such lexical idiosyncrasies can sometimes deviate from the overall tendencies of a variety yet the overall tendencies of different varieties are clearly differentiated. This distributional nature allowed us to build a stochastic model to describe and automatic classify different varieties of Chinese. More specifically, the grammatical variations between Mainland and Taiwan Mandarin speaking varieties have been comprehensively studied. Two grammatical constructions (i.e. light verb constructions and VO1+O2 constructions) were carefully explored. For both grammatical constructions, comparable corpus was established based on the extracted data from Gigaword corpus (Taiwan Central News Agency sub-corpus and Mainland Xinhua News sub-corpus). Stochastic models (mainly logistic regression and Chi-square test) have also been explored to provide comprehensive descriptive account of syntactic variations. Based on the comprehensive and definitive accounts of these two widely used and dynamic constructions, the correlation among language change and language alternation have also been discussed. Based on the statistical results, various studies were conducted to discuss theoretical linguistic issues, including variation differences in degree of transitivity; syntactic type of the external objects (for both light verb and VO compounds); whether the grammatical variations of VO compounds are dependent on the degree of lexicalization of these compounds; transition mechanism of VO compounds, alternative choices and word order (for both VO compounds and light verbs). Computationally, machine learning algorithm was resorted to automatically classify and cluster the grammatical variations. For classification, different classifiers were adopted to discriminate the grammatical constructions with the annotated corpora: ID3, Logistic Regression, Naïve Bayesian and SVM that are implemented in WEKA (Hall et al., 2009) and 10-fold cross validations were performed separately on the Taiwan and Mainland corpora. And for clustering, the simple K-Means clustering algorithm was used to test the differentiability of the constructions in both Mainland and Taiwan Mandarin.

543512.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
543512.value: From computational linguistic perspective, automatic identification of language variations poses a special challenge in many Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications, e.g., information retrieval and machine translation. The module of generic linguistic tools adopted in this project can actually have several potentially very useful applications in computational linguistics. Based on large-scale comparable corpora and statistical tool, subtle grammatical variations can be detected very effectively. The ability of comparable corpus-based statistical approach to differentiate Mainland and Taiwan variants of Mandarin Chinese potentially contributes to overcoming the challenge of identification of subtle language/dialect variations among other grammatical constructions, as well as between other languages/dialects. The annotated semantic and syntactic features which are very effective in differentiation language variations in my thesis can also be used for future studies on other lexical categories, as well as between other Mandarin varieties (e.g., Hong Kong Mandarin, Singapore Mandarin, Malaysia Mandarin and so on). Another issue that emerged from our study is the possible relation between language variations and language change. Our result so far suggested that it would be promising to treat variations as early stage of language change and that the same preference/distributional model may be effective in predicting language change.

543512.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
543512.value: In this project, we adopted a comparable corpus driven approach to conduct the fist large scale empirical study of grammatical variations among world Chineses. We did manual analysis of four varieties; Hong Kong, Mainland, Singapore, Taiwan; as well as statistical modeling and automatic classification of Mainland and Taiwan variations. We found that grammatical differences between two Chinese varieties are based on preferences and distributional tendencies. We developed computational tools to differentiate language variants on one hand and to make links between language variations and language change on the other hand.

544012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
544012.value: The growing discontent and grievance among the new generation of labourers have received wide attention because of the suicide cases took place in Foxconn and the strikes that held in various industrial towns in these years. In general, they are relatively better educated and better off materially than the first generation of migrants; but, at the same time, they are facing greater inequality in terms of income and opportunities due to the continuous social exclusion in cities. The rapid increase in inequality and the growing discontent among this disadvantaged group lead us to rethink the impact of the shift of allocation system from state socialism to market capitalism and to examine its stratification and mobility system in the post-reform China. This proposed project is going to study about the social mobility at the lower levels of Chinese society. When the accelerating significance of education in status attainment process is commonly regarded as signs of a more open and competitive occupational system and a growing meritocracy, we will focus on the educational inequality and its implication on the low mobility chances among the disadvantaged groups. Special attention is put on the children of migrants in cities, who have limited opportunities of having their higher education in the urban education system. Due to the institutional discrimination in examination and school admission policies against non-local children, they are not given a chance to continue their schooling after compulsory education, unless they are willing to receive vocational education. In this way, a large amount of the second generation of migrant workers has been systematically diverted away from academic track in the post-compulsory education. Through examining the school-to-working transitions of a group of migrant youth who enroll in vocational training schools, we will explore their educational experience and its relations to their attainment aspirations and outcomes in this proposed project. We will study the curricula and education quality in these schools and the occupational attainments of their graduates. The role of vocational education in the process of social reproduction would be investigated. Given the increasing scale and the growing importance of vocational training in the Chinese education system, its development in post-reform China and its impact on mobility system need further study. Efforts would be put on examining the nature of its training; the economic and political forces behind the development; and its implication on the stratification and mobility structure. 富士康工人的跳樓事件與近幾年各地頻發的罷工引起了社會對新生代工人境遇的廣泛關注。人們開始瞭解到新生代工人對於艱辛打工境遇的不滿與憤怒。誠然，與第一代農民工相比，他們受教育程度普遍較高，物質條件較好。但在城市裏，他們一如既往的被排斥，他們在收入與工作機會上面臨更多的不平等。這群弱勢群體的不滿促使我們對後改革時代的分配制度與社會流動機制進行反思——從國家社會主義轉向市場資本主義的分配制度對中國社會分層與社會流動產生了哪些影響？本研究將探討當下中國社會底層的社會流動問題。 在開放競爭的就業環境中，教育程度反映了個人的市場價值，也成為人們提升社會階級地位的重要手段，此研究的主題是教育不平等給新生代工人的社會流動機會帶來的影響。研究對象為城市的農民工子女。在現存城市教育體制下，他們很難接受較高等的教育：由於農民工子女在考試制度和入學政策上都遭受制度性歧視，他們完成義務教育後，除了進入中等職業學校學習，便無其他升學的可能。於是，大量的農民工子女在完成義務教育之後就被剝奪了繼續受學術性高等教育的機會。 本研究將探討職業技術學校中農民工子女由“讀書”到“工作”的轉變，以期瞭解他們在職校的教育經歷及其與他們對未來期望和畢業現實之間的關係。我們將通過研究學校的課程設置、教學質量與畢業生就業情況，來討論職業教育在社會再生產中的角色。隨著職業教育在中國教育體系中規模與重要性的提升，它在後改革時代中的發展與對社會流動機制的影響也很值得研究。為此，我們將探討職業教育的時代特質，發展背後的經濟政治張力，以及職業教育對於社會階層與社會流動的結構性影響。

544012.label: Realisation of objectives
544012.value: During the project period, I made nine field trips, lasting from 6 days to 15 days, to Beijing, Chongqing and Chengdu to visit 12 vocational training schools that enroll both local and migrant students in the cities. These include 3 schools in Beijing, 3 schools in Chongqing and 6 schools in Chengdu. Our team has successfully interviewed principals and teachers in the 12 vocational schools. Information related to the national and city level of educational and examination policies, enrollment patterns in each of the schools, the learning and training arrangements that set for their students and the employment situations of the graduates were obtained. We also conducted in-depth interviews with 131 vocational school students in the three cities, with 71 of them having been re-interviewed after their internship and graduation. Two third of the informants have rural background coupled with long-term or short-term migration experiences, while others have local city hukou. Through such interviews, rich qualitative data related to students’ family background, their school performance, process of decision making on educational transitions, the knowledge and training received in vocational schools, internship experiences, resources for smooth school-to-work transitions, occupational aspirations were obtained. Through analyzing students’ eagerness of getting a higher educational degree and securing a stable job after graduation, and the diverse strategies used by them to fulfill their goals, we have successfully revealed the constraints and difficulties faced by the poor students with a non-local hukou in the three cities. Also, through a systematic comparison of the educational and occupational attainment between local and migrant students, we have discovered the importance of economic, social and political resources in the process of school-to-work transitions among the vocational school students. To further confirm the diverse patterns of attainment and its association between students’ family and migration background, we have also developed an online survey system with the 12 vocational schools, aiming to collect a large scale of systemic quantitative data from students in the schools. Pilot survey were successfully done in the schools before the summer of 2014, and the main surveys were arranged between October 2014 and April 2015. Unexpectedly, I was informed in December 2014 that the arranged surveys and all interviews in vocational schools in Chengdu were cancelled, soon after I heard similar news from Chongqing schools. We had tried very hard to find out the possible reasons of such cancellations and had also inquired the possibility of resuming the surveys, but both to no avail. In the end, only the data from 2 schools in Beijing and 3 schools in Chongqing were successfully obtained. Partial information of students’ attainment aspiration, economic and social resources for education and occupational performance, and their association with their families’ SES and migration experiences were obtained. As we have difficulties in obtaining the complete quantitative data, we have shifted to focus on getting more interview data in the late stage of our project, and the latter becomes the base of our major analyses on the process of students’ transition from school to work and its relations with their family background and attainment aspirations. Originally, survey, interviews and observations related to students’ learning and internship experience were all arranged by contact schools. As our connection with 12 vocational schools had been cut off from 2015, our team had tried our best to contact previous interviewees, and those who have joined our pilot survey individually. We have successfully recruit 64 more vocational school students for in-depth interviews, and re-interviewed 71 students in the three cities during their internship or after their graduation. We also kept in touch with them via social media sites QQ and WeChat from time to time off the field. Through detailed investigation on students’ concrete positions held in factories or companies during internship, the skills required for their job, and the additional training and professional knowledge received during internship, we have evaluated the nature and quality of training and internship provided by vocational schools. Also, a systematic comparison of the job positions and employment opportunities between vocational school graduates and their colleagues without the credentials become the main source of evaluating the effectiveness of vocational training in preparing their students for future occupations. Furthermore, a thorough study on the history of educational reform, development of vocational education during the post-socialist period, and the establishment of policies related to student internships from 2005 was done. National-level and city-level of examination policies related to students’ hukou background, and their transition rates have also been fully investigated. An examination of the expansion and development of vocational education in the large macro social, economic and political framework effectively shows that vocational education in post-reform China is shaped by the state’s developmentalist agenda with capital expansion. And the youth with rural background, who are systemically diverted to vocational education, have limited chances for upward mobility under the current social and educational stratification structure but are treated as the inexpensive reserve of labour to sustain the development.

544012.label: Major findings and research outcome
544012.value: This research project discloses how the rise of China as the world factory in the last few decades has been accompanied by a rapid expansion in vocational education. Using the theory of human capital investment in neoliberal economies as an analytical focus, the expansion of vocational schooling and internships since 2000s are found to operate in the guise of training skill development, and self-investment that match the needs of rapid industrial and economic development in Chinese cities. Under this macro social, economic and political framework, this project demonstrates how the vocational school students are trapped between the hopes of having a decent job after acquiring educational credentials and the reality that large proportion of the interns and graduates end up working on assembly lines in factories or having low-end, tiring jobs at the service sector. These findings have been well discussed in the two published journal papers entitled “A ‘World-Class’ (Labor) Camp/us: Foxconn and China’s New Generation of Labor Migrants”; and the paper under preparation for journal publication “Learning and Training in a Risk Society: Reflexive experiences of vocational school students in China”. Further the project demonstrates the uneven patterns of mobility opportunities and risk distribution in an increasingly unequal and competitive society in post-reform China. For the youth with rural background, the new educational opportunities fail to give them chances for upward mobility but divert them to cheap and unskillful jobs, similar to the path of their parents who work as migrant workers in urban areas. This project showcases the ‘learning to labour’ process among the emergence of new laboring subjects, with rural-to-urban migration backgrounds and graduation from vocational schools. Although there are new life expectations and dispositions, new nuanced meanings of work among these diligent, skilled and well-educated working subjects who had grown up in the reform period, both the class structure and the labour process of this new generation of laborers are similar to those of their previous generation. Findings are published in the paper “Expansion of Vocational Education in Neoliberal China: Hope and Despair among Rural Youth”, presented in the Conference paper “Education and Social Mobility of Migrant Youth in Chinese Cities”, and further illustrated in a paper under preparation for journal publication “Teasing Paul Willis Out: Class Reproduction and the Difference of Working-Class Culture at Contemporary Vocational Schools”.

544012.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
544012.value: The potential for further development of this project is rich. As we found increasing number of rural girls and boys have entered the urban vocational education system to receive training before seeking employment in the manufacturing and service sector, we propose to look into the gendering process in both formal and informal curriculums of vocational schools. The declining influence of socialist discourse of gender equity, a re-emergence of traditional patriarchal values and the emergence of neoliberal labour market values of human resources in reformed China should have brought diverse effects on the occupational decisions and employment experiences of the young people, and vocational schools should be a suitable site to understand how the young women and young men respond to, negotiate with, or resist the gender order in an increasingly liberated market. I intend to use a gender approach to study the institutional and ideological changes in post-socialist China and their impact on the reproduction of the young working class during their school-to-work transitions under the further expansion of global capitalism. For this purpose, I have already applied for another GRF grant.

544012.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
544012.value: The first generation of migrant workers moved from the countryside to work as factory workers or low-end service workers in cities of industrial zones in 1980s and 1990s. Most of them, having only middle or primary schooling, were valued for their cheap labour, compliance and tolerance of harsh working conditions. Entering the new century, children of these rural migrants, having been raised in the post-reform period, are expected to benefit from the expansion of education and rapid economic growth. With higher education qualification, they should have better chances to move up the social hierarchy in an expanded labour market. However, due to the institutional discrimination in education and examination policies against rural children, most of them have been systematically diverted to vocational education. With a lower valued credential and poor quality of training, the Chinese migrant population and their children continue to stay at the bottom of the socio-economic structure, in the context of the coexistence of rapid economic growth and increased income inequality.
