605012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
605012.value: Photosynthetic antenna complexes have evolved to harvest energy from the Sun and funnel it to reaction centers with high efficiency and robustness. Understanding the underlying principles will greatly benefit the design of artificial solar energy conversion devices. The pigments-proteins complexes in biological light-harvesting antennas are nano-structured in three-dimensional space, where the pigment-protein interaction has the same magnitude as the pigment-pigment transfer coupling and the time scale of environment memory is about the same as that of excitation energy transfer. These characteristics require the non-Markovian and non-perturbative quantum dissipation methods of treatment. Among them, the hierarchical-equations-of-motion (HEOM) approach emerges as a promising method. HEOM is mathematically equivalent to the Feynman-Vernon influence functional path integral theory, but numerically and operationally much more tractable. However, the current existing HEOM machineries, as well as other non-Markovian/non-perturbative theories, are all far from satisfactory, especially for the proposed studies of energy transfer in light-harvesting complexes. We will simulate the nonlinear, including coherent two-dimensional, spectroscopy signals, as they are by far the most versatile and sensitive experimental probes for complex dynamic processes such as light-harvesting systems. We will also elucidate the mechanisms underlying light-harvesting systems in nature that facilitate efficient and robust energy transfer processes, in terms of the quantum coherence and the quantum interplay between multi-pigments geometries, energies and their surrounding proteins environment. Before HEOM could be implemented in these proposed studies, the efficiency of the current HEOM simulations must be improved by orders of magnitude. The proposed development of HEOM methods is itself of fundamental importance, as quantum dissipation plays a pivotal role in many fields of science and HEOM is by far the most implementable exact theory for quantum open systems in general. We address some importance issues on an optimized HEOM construction. These issues revolve around the minimum statistical environment basis set used to decompose the coupling environments into their memory-frequency components, the resulting HEOM construction, and its accuracy control criteria. We further propose block-HEOM dynamics, together with a mixed Heisenberg-Schrodinger scheme, for efficient evaluation of nonlinear optical response functions and coherent two-dimensional spectroscopy signals. Moreover, we will also develop a kinetic rate-modified HEOM theory and use it directly or as a benchmark to construct the energy transfer efficiency landscape in the multiple-parameters space, for the proposed mechanistic analysis. 自然进化让光合体系中天线复合物将太阳光能量高效的转移到反应中心，了解其中的基本原理对设计人造太阳能转换装置有很大帮助。生物体内参与光吸收的色素-蛋白复合物大小通常在纳米尺度；色素与周围蛋白环境，以及色素分子间的耦合强度相当，而且能量在色素分子间传递与环境弛豫的时间尺度十分接近。对于这类体系的研究，很有必要发展非马尔科夫和非微扰的量子耗散理论与计算方法，其中，级联运动方程 (HEOM ) 极具发展前景。HEOM 在数学原理上与Feynman-Vernon影响泛函路径积分理论等价，但应用操作上以及数值模拟上更容易处理。然而，目前已有的HEOM手段以及其它非马尔科夫、非微扰的耗散理论还有很大的局限性，尤其是应用到我们所感兴趣的光吸收体系。 我们将模拟光合体系的包括相干二维光谱的各种非线性光谱，它们是目前研究复杂动力学过程（如光吸收系统）最灵活和最灵敏的实验探测手段之一；研究色素分子的空间、能级结构以及周围的蛋白环境对能量传递的量子相干性以及量子相互作用的影响，进而了解生物体内光吸收系统高效率和鲁棒性的反应机理。为了实现这些研究工作，目前的 HEOM 的计算效率至少要提高几个数量级。 量子耗散在许多科学领域中起着举足轻重的作用。和其它非微扰的耗散理论方法相比，HEOM已是目前为止处理开放的量子多体体系最容易操作兼高效的精确方法，进一步发展HEOM方法对于如上述的复杂量子体系研究十分必要。本项目提出了一系列优化HEOM的手段，其中包括利用最小的基组分解耦合的环境为记忆-频率单元，统计的描述环境对体系的影响，并对其构建的HEOM的准确性进行有效评估。我们进一步提出了块分解的HEOM动力学，以及混合海森堡-薛定谔绘景的方案，使之能高效率的计算非线性光学响应函数和模拟二维相干光谱信号。此外，我们还将发展一套基于动力学速率的改进的HEOM理论，并用它直接或作为基准来研究多参数对能量传递效率的影响，并用于上述机理的分析工作。

605012.label: Realisation of objectives
605012.value: The research is the continuation of the PI’s efforts since 2005, on the systematic development of exact theories and efficient numerical methods to tackle various open quantum systems, such as dissipation and quantum transport problems. The objectives of the present project are fully realized through all-round optimizing HEOM, from its theoretical formulations, numerical methods to applications. All theoretical developments have been implemented in computation codes and demonstrated with applications in diversified research fields. The most important development during this project period is a second-quantitation generalization to the original HEOM theory. The resulting Dissipaton Equation of Motion (DEOM) offers clearly a quasi-particle picture for the bath influence [2,12,13]. The new theory unifies the treatment of three universal classes, fermionic, bosonic, and excitonic environment. Moreover, DEOM addresses not only the reduced system, but also the hybrid bath dynamics. As the numerical aspect is concerned, DEOM and HEOM are identical. In relation to Objective 1 (Pubs#1,9,15): The optimized HEOM/DEOM theory with accuracy control, in terms of the minimum construction basis set problem, is fully addressed in Pub#1 (AoE/P-04/08-2 acknowledged), based on the Pade spectrum decomposition method developed by the PI earlier (RGC/604709). The newly developed optimal HEOM/DEOM theory covers from strongly underdamped, underdamped, critically damped, overdamped, and strongly overdamped cases. The PI considered also some issues in relation to hierarchy level truncation (Pub#9). Recently progress includes the derivative-resum scheme (Pub#15 where AoE/P-04/08-2 is acknowledged). In relation to Objective 2 (Pub#1,3-13) Numerical HEOM/DEOM platform, covering all those three classes of bath, was established and updated routinely. HEOM/DEOM-based studies on various systems were carried out. These include the kinetic rates of energy / electron transfer processes [1,8,12], two-dimensional coherent optical spectroscopy on model energy-transfer systems [3,4], nonlinear Fano inference polarization spectroscopy [12], Kondo phenomena in various quantum transport setups [5-7,9,11], and current noise spectrum [13]. Proposed is also the HEOM/DEOM as an accurate and efficient Impurity Solver in the Dynamical Mean-Field Theory for strongly correlated electronic systems [10]. In relation to Objective 3 (Pub#8,14,15) One longstanding puzzle concerning photosystem II, a core component of photosynthesis, is that only one of the two symmetric branches in its reaction centre is active in electron transfer. In Pub#14, we investigated the effect of the photosystem II environment on the preferential selection of the energy transfer pathway (a prerequisite for electron transfer). Our results suggest that it is essential to take into account the dynamical fluctuations of protein conformations to accurately compute the site energies. Besides identifying CLA606 of active chain as the most probable site for the energy excitation, we further pinpoint a number of charged protein residues that collectively lower the CLA606 site energy. Our work provides insights into the understanding of molecular mechanisms of the core machinery of the green-plant photosynthesis. Despite of the fact that above observations were arise from classical statistical mechanics simulations, the results obtained by now do provide basic inputs to the complex quantum kinetics frameworks theory, as constructed in Pubs#8 and #15.

605012.label: Major findings and research outcome
605012.value: One major development is an extension of the original HEOM theory. The resulting DEOM becomes a very fundamental theory in quantum mechanics of open systems. The PI had received over ten invited talks, in international conferences and universities includuing Caltech, UC Berkeley, UC Irvine, UW Madison and Purdue Univ., on the development of the DEOM theory. The new theory offers clearly a quasi-particle (dissipaton) picture for the bath influence. It unifies the treatment of three universal classes, fermionic, bosonic, and excitonic environment [Pub#2]. DEOM addresses not only the reduced system, but also the hybrid bath dynamics. To the PI’s best knowledge, DEOM is by far the only theory has this capability. Accurate evaluations were demonstrated in Pubs#12 and #13 on some fundamental problems that are experimentally interested, but beyond the scope of the HEOM and other existing quantum dissipation theories. Another major finding is that we elucidated the vital roles of dynamical fluctuations of protein conformations in determining the energy/electron transfer mechanics in photo-systems [Pub#14].

605012.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
605012.value: Integrating the DEOM/HEOM theory with the existing computational physics/chemistry methods toward an accurate first-principles approach to strongly correlated and complex quantum dynamics systems in general. Some results along this direction have been published recently; for example, “Anisotropy Induced Kondo Splitting in a Mechanically Stretched Molecular Junction: A First-Principles based Study”, X. L.Wang, D. Hou, X. Zheng, and Y. J. Yan, J. Chem. Phys. 144, 034101 (2016).

605012.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
605012.value: The PI developed some fundamental theories and methods for open quantum systems. This remarkable achievement is of direct relevance to various fields of modern science, especially nano-materials, nano-devices and quantum biology. The DEOM theory developed recently by the PI is currently the most advanced and powerful method, with the capability of accurate evaluation for both reduced system and hybrid bath dynamics. This cutting-edge theory generalizes the celebrated hierarchical equations of motion approach that the PI is also a leading contributor in the world. The PI is well recognized for his pioneering and seminal contributions to the fundamental theories and methods for quantum mechanics of open systems, having received many invited talks in international conferences and universities including Caltech, UC Berkeley, and UW Madison.

605212.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
605212.value: Ultrasound is used in many areas of medical diagnosis and treatments and in structural diagnosis in industry. Conventional materials have their limits in ultrasound power delivery and imaging resolution. Phononic crystals (PCs) are artificial structures with periodic spatial variation of elastic properties, such as mass density and elastic modulus, and are usually made of two different materials with large acoustic contrast. They have extraordinary properties, such as self-collimation where sound beams propagate with much smaller divergence than in ordinary materials, or negative refraction where refraction of sonic beams at the boundary of a PC is in the ‘wrong’ direction, leading to highly focused ultrasound, or negative diffraction where sound beams converge instead of diverging while propagating. Most of these extraordinary properties are discovered in two dimensional (2D) PCs, as they are relatively easier to fabricate. To fully explore these properties for practical applications, however, three dimensional (3D) solid-state (instead of using liquid as one of the two materials components) PCs must be developed and their extraordinary properties investigated. Recently, we have successfully fabricated high quality solid-state PC samples made of close-packed tungsten carbide spheres in aluminum matrix. These PCs are expected to work well in the full range of ultrasound frequency from a few hundred KHz to several MHz, as both tungsten carbide and aluminum have little intrinsic absorption of ultrasound. Such solid-in-solid PCs are much more mechanically robust than solid-in-liquid ones, which is a must for almost all practical applications. Three dimensional gap and defects states have been observed in our PCs. Our preliminary success has established a solid foundation for the far-reaching exploration of the novel properties and device applications of PCs. In this project, we will use both experimental and theoretical investigations to explore extensively the novel properties of these PCs, with the ultimate goal of realizing a pulsed highly directional coherent ultrasound source. Such source is expected to deliver a much higher energy density to a small volume than conventional sources. The outcome of the project will not only greatly enrich the understanding of wave physics in artificial structures, but also provide a solid foundation for solid-state 3D phononic crystals in a wide range of applications in medical sciences and industrial diagnostics.

605212.label: Realisation of objectives
605212.value: The defects resonant states within the PC band gap in 3D WC/Al PC's have been studied in details, along with the cavities formed around the defects. Details are given in 6.1 and the attached papers.

605212.label: Major findings and research outcome
605212.value: A full band gap of the longitudinal mode of elastic waves centered near 2.8 MHz with a width of ~ 1 MHz has been observed in the phononic crystals made of body centered tetragonal tungsten carbide spheres imbedded in aluminum matrix. Two defects states in the band gap due to a 7-sphere defect cluster with silicon nitride spheres have also been observed. Transmitted pressure field pattern clearly shows that at the defect state frequencies the ultrasonic waves transmitted through the doped crystal are emitted from the defect cluster. We have also investigated another type of low transmission structures, namely the locally resonant sonic metamaterials. The basic decorated membrane resonator (DMR) structure has been investigated both experimentally and theoretically. A DMR consists of a rigid frame, which is made of 0.3 mm thick and 0.3 mm wide silicon backbone, a membrane fixed on the frame, which is made of thin SiN film, and the decoration mass is made of Cu droplet. Low transmission comparable to that of PC has been observed. The sample thickness, however, is only 0.3 mm, about 100 times thinner than PC's. Such thin metamaterials are good candidate for resonant cavities, flat focus lenses, etc., devices for ultrasound manipulations.

605212.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
605212.value: Explore further the concept of locally resonant sonic metamaterials, that are well developed in audible frequency range, in ultrasonic frequency range, including super absorption, total reflection, sound attenuation in channels while allowing free fluid flow.

605212.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
605212.value: Using periodically arranged sphere arrays, such as tungsten carbide small spheres embedded in aluminum matrix, we have created an artificial materials called phononic crystals that can manipulate the ultrasound propagation and emission. Such study addressed certain issues in fundamental physics regarding the wave propagation in inhomogeneous media, and could have potential application in ultrasonic medical and industrial devices.

605312.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
605312.value: Common medicines, cosmetics, personal care products (e.g., shampoo, soap) and household cleaners are sources of endocrine disrupting compounds (EDCs) that are rapidly becoming a global water pollution problem. Their presence in drinking water source is an emerging crisis that has far-reaching impacts on health and the environment. The situation is exacerbated by the inability of existing wastewater and water treatment plants to effectively treat EDC pollution. The potential risk of chronic exposure to EDCs cannot be ignored as some EDCs found in water also appear in human blood, milk and urine. This is particularly worrying as EDCs interfere with the normal functions of the endocrine system that regulates growth and development, reproduction, neurobehavior and the immune system. Most studies in animal models have shown that early life stages are the most vulnerable to the actions of EDCs, putting pregnant women and children at greater risk. There is extensive evidence that wildlife have been adversely affected by exposure to EDCs in the environment. EDCs have been implicated over changes in population sex ratios, reproductive patterns, sperm quality and developmental growth for various aquatic and avian species. There are scarce data on EDC occurrence in source water in Hong Kong and China, but it can be deduced from the data in neighboring Taiwan, South Korea and Japan that the likelihood of their presence is very high. Indeed, Hong Kong has a similar pattern of consumption and the products from which numerous EDCs originate are staples here. Also, Hong Kong employs a conventional drinking-water-treatment plant that has failed to effectively treat EDCs elsewhere. Therefore, there is great urgency to develop more effective drinking water treatment technologies to tackle the EDC crisis. The proposed study aims to develop an effective technology for the treatment of EDCs in water based on the synergistic combination of (1) catalytic ozone oxidation, (2) adsorption and (3) membrane separation. The compact treatment unit will employ membranes as an ozone distributor, catalytic contactor and water separator. Removal efficiency greater than ninety-nine percent is targeted to safeguard health and protect the environment. Mass measurements and biological-based monitoring will be developed to quantify the estrogenic, androgenic and microtoxicity of EDCs and EDC degradates during the treatment process. Key technologies to be developed include ozonation catalyst, membranes for the distributor, catalytic contactor and separator, and a membrane module for the catalytic ozone treatment of EDCs in water. 常見的藥物、化妝品、個人護理用品（例如洗髮液、洗手液）和家居清潔用品是水中內分泌干擾物的主要來源，它正在成為全球性的水污染問題。飲用水中存在的內分泌干擾物對健康和環境有著長遠的影響，由此導致的危機正在浮現；傳統的水處理設施並不能有效地消除內分泌干擾物，使這污染狀況正在進一步加劇；一些水中的內分泌干擾物也同時出現在人類血液、乳汁和尿液中，長期接觸這些內分泌干擾物導致的潛在風險不容忽視；特別令人憂慮的是，內分泌干擾物會影響調節生長與發育、繁殖和神經行為的內分泌系統和免疫系統的正常功能。大量的動物實驗發現生命初期是最容易受到內分泌干擾物危害的階段，也就是說，內分泌干擾物對於孕婦和幼兒的威脅更為嚴重。當前，大量證據顯示了環境中的內分泌干擾物對於野生動植物的不利影響，這些內分泌干擾物與不同水生生物和鳥類的性別比例、繁殖方式、精子質量以及生活習性的改變密切相關。當前，雖然缺乏分佈在香港和中國內地水源中內分泌干擾物的相關數據，但是從鄰近的台灣、韓國和日本的數據推斷其存在可能性非常之高；事實上，香港具有相似的消費模式，也存在著大量作為內分泌干擾物來源的日用品；同時香港採用傳統的飲用水處理設施，它們並不能有效消除內分泌干擾物，因此，迫切需要發展更有效的飲用水處理技術去解決內分泌干擾物危機。本研究的目的是發展一種有效的內分泌干擾物消除技術，它耦合了臭氧催化氧化、吸附和膜分離三種技術，利用膜作為臭氧分佈器、催化接觸器和水分離器的集成處理裝置將達到99%以上的內分泌干擾物消除效率，從而實現保護健康和環境的目的。本研究將發展質量測量和生物監測技術去量度內分泌干擾物及其降解物中的激素水平及微毒性；同時發展一系列關鍵技術：例如臭氧化催化劑、作為臭氧分佈器、催化接觸器和分離器的膜材料和用於臭氧催化處理水中內分泌干擾物的相關膜組件等。

605512.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
605512.value: A metal conducts electricity while an insulator does not. This is because a metal is gapless whereas an insulator has a band gap in the electronic band language. Physically, one can excite an electron in a metal with arbitrarily small energy whereas it would take energy larger than the band gap to excite an electron in an insulator. A superconductor is a material which can conduct electricity without dissipation. In other words, it is like a perfect metal. However, a superconductor behaves like an insulator in certain aspects. For example, an ordinary superconductor has a band gap and it takes energy larger than the band gap to excite a quasi-particle in a superconductor. Recently, new types of superconductors called topological superconductors are proposed to exist. A topological superconductor is a superconductor with a bulk band gap and gapless boundary modes which are localized at the sample boundary. The zero energy modes at the sample boundary are called Majorana fermions. Majorana fermions are strange particles in two aspects. First, a Majorana fermion has only half the degrees of freedom of a usual fermion and two spatially separated Majorana fermions can form a non-local fermion. Second, they are non-Abelian particles, e.g. braiding Majorana fermions can change the quantum state of the system. These strange properties of Majorana fermions make them potential platforms for decoherence-free quantum computations. Therefore, the search for topological superconductors and Majorana fermions has become one of the central topics in condensed matter physics recently. In this proposal, we first review three different proposed schemes for realizing topological superconductors. In the Background of Research section, we see how with strong spin-orbit coupling, semiconductors, metals and topological insulators can be used to realize topological superconductors when those materials are in proximity to an s-wave superconductor. A common problem of the aforementioned schemes is that the energy scales for creating topological superconducting phases are too small. We suggest that using quasi-one-dimensional Au wires in proximity to d-wave superconductors LSCO can increase the relevant energy scales by two orders of magnitude. Moreover, the topological superconductors obtained are in the so-called DIII class since both time-reversal symmetry and particle-hole symmetry are respected and spin-rotational symmetry is broken in these systems. We will discuss how these new DIII class superconducting phases and Majorana fermions can be probed in resonant Andreev reflection, crossed Andreev reflection, fractional Josephson effect and STM tunneling experiments. 金屬可以導電而絕緣體不能。這是因為，按照能帶理論，金屬具有連續能帶，和而絕緣體則有能帶間隙。在物理上的結果就是，金屬中的電子可以被任意小的能量激發，而絕緣體的激發能則需要大於帶間能隙才行。 超導體是一種可以無損耗導電的材料。換言之，它好像完美金屬。然而在某些方面，超導體卻表現的像絕緣體。例如，傳統的超導體具有能帶間隙，因此激發其中的准粒子需要超過帶間能隙的能量。 最近，人們預測存在一類名為拓撲超導體的新型超導體。這種超導體的體內能帶有間隙，而在其樣品邊界則存在著具有連續能帶的模式。在這些分佈在邊界的模式中，有一些零能量模式，它們被稱作馬約拉納費米子（Majorana fermion）。 馬約拉納費米子是一種奇特的粒子，其奇特性表現在兩個方面。第一，它的自由度只有一般費米子的一半，並且兩個空間分離的馬約拉納費米子能夠形成一個非局域性的費米子。第二，它們是非對易粒子，例如改變馬約拉納費米子的排布可以改變整個系統的量子態。馬約拉納費米子的這些性質使它可能成為免于退相干的量子計算平臺。因此，尋找拓撲超導與馬約拉納費米子最近已經成為凝聚態物理的中話題之一。 在這個提議中，我們首先回顧已提出的三種實現拓撲超導的方案。在「研究背景」部分，我們看到，在s-wave超導的近鄰作用下，有著強自旋-軌道偶合的半導體、金屬和拓撲絕緣體如何能用於實現拓撲超導體。 以前提出的方案有一個共同的問題，即產生拓撲超導相的能量尺度太小。我們建議用在d-wave超導體近鄰作用（proximity effect）下的准一維金（Au）線，這可以使相應的能量尺度提高兩個數量級。而且，這樣得到的拓撲超導體屬於DIII類，因為在這個系統中，時間反演對稱性和粒子-空穴對稱性都是成立的，而自旋旋轉對稱性不成立。我們將討論如何用共振安德列夫反射（resonant Andreev reflection）、交叉安德列夫反射（crossed Andreev reflection）、分數約瑟夫森效應（fractional Josephson effect）和電子遂道顯微鏡實驗來探測這些DIII類超導相和馬約拉納費米子。

605512.label: Realisation of objectives
605512.value: The proposed objectives were achieved through the publications of the PI and the details are given below. 1. Study the double Majorana fermion induced resonant Andreev reflections in DIII class topological superconductors. Related publication: Phys. Rev. B 86, 184516 (2012). This work is widely regarded as the first realistic realisation of a DIII class topological superconductor. It has been cited more than 100 times according to Google Scholar and NASA ADS as well. Majorana doublet induced resonant Andreev reflections are studied. This objective is fully addressed. 2. Study the Majorana fermion induced crossed Andreev reflections in D class, time-reversal symmetry broken, topological superconductors. Related publications: Physical Review B 88 , 064509 (2013) , Nature Communications 5:3232 (2014). The Nature Communications paper has been cited more than 50 times according to Google Scholar. The objective is fully addressed in the publications. Further important predictions had been made in the Nature Communication paper. For example, we showed that the two Majoranas in D class topological superconductor with Chern Number N=2 can induce a zero bias conductance dip ( such as in a quantum anomalous Hall/superconductor heterostructure). This prediction has been verified recently by my experimental colleague at HKUST. The experiment provided strong evidence that superconductivity is induced on a quantum anomalous Hall state and the system is in the Chern Number N=2 phase. The work is now submitted. 3. Study the Majorana fermion induced crossed Andreev reflections in DIII class, time-reversal invariant, topological superconductors. The study of cross Andreev reflections has also been addressed in Nature Communications 5:3232 (2014). The objective is fully addressed. 4. Study the Josephson effect between two DIII class superconducting wires. Related publication: Phys. Rev. X 4, 021018 (2014). This is also the first work which showed that double Majorana fermions in DIII class topological superconductors are non-Abelian particles. The Josephson effect was studied and used as a tool to detect fermion parity. The objective is fully addressed. This work has been cited 75 times. 5. Study the energy spectrum of the vortex bound states of two-dimensional DIII-class superconductors and STM detection of Majorana modes in these vortices. Phys. Rev. B 90, 235141 (2014). The vortex bound states of a special type of time-reversal invariant topological superconductor and the detection method has been studied in this work. The objective is fully addressed.

605512.label: Major findings and research outcome
605512.value: Besides fulfilling all the objects of the proposal as mentioned in Section 5 above, the PI is heavily involved in the study of Ising superconductors and other topological superconductors. Up to the last report period, the PI was heavily involved in exploring other topics related to topological superconductors. For example, the PI explained the theory behind a new type of superconductor, we called Ising superconductor. These two-dimensional Ising superconductors has extremely high in-plane upper critical magnetic fields ( estimated to be up to 60 Telsas and several times higher than the Pauli limit of the superconductors). These works are published in: "Possible Topological Superconducting Phases of MoS2" NFQ Yuan, KF Mak, KT Law Physical review letters 113, 097001 (2014). Citation 67. This is the first theoretical work studying the superconducting properties of MoS2 taking into account the spin-orbit coupling effects. “Evidence for two-dimensional Ising superconductivity in gated MoS2” J. M. Lu, O. Zheliuk, I. Leermakers, N. F. Q. Yuan, U. Zeitler, K. T. Law, J. T. Ye, Science (2015), DOI:10.1126/science.aab2277. Citation: 183. In this work, we helped to explain the unusually high in-plane upper critical observed in the experiment. “Ising pairing in superconducting NbSe2 atomic layers” X. Xi, Z. Wang, W. Zhao, J-H Park, K. T. Law, H. Berger, L. Forró, J. Shan and K. F. Mak, Nature Physics (2015), DOI:10.1038/nphys3538. Citation: 195. In this work, we helped to explain the unusually high in-plane upper critical observed in the experiment. "An unusual continuous paramagnetic-limited superconducting phase transition in 2D NbSe2" Egon Sohn, Xiaoxiang Xi, Wen-Yu He, Shengwei Jiang, Zefang Wang, Kaifei Kang, Ju-Hyun Park, Helmuth Berger, László Forró, Kam Tuen Law, Jie Shan, Kin Fai Mak Nature Materials, 17, 504-508 (2018). Citation:2, newly published. In this work, one of our earlier predictions [arXiv:1604.04898] concerning the superconductor to normal metal transition driven by in-plane magnetic field is verified experimentally by Prof. Kin Fai Mak's group at Cornell University. Moreover, our works significantly deepened the understanding of topological superconductors. Particularly, through the publications of "Selective equal-spin Andreev reflections induced by Majorana fermions" JJ He, TK Ng, PA Lee, KT Law Physical review letters 112, 037001 (2014) We pointed out that Majorana fermions can act as a perfect spin filter. Our prediction was later verified experimentally as well.

605512.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
605512.value: The work of the PI deepened the understanding of topological phases in various ways covering the creation, the detection and potential applications of topological superconductors. We hope that DIII class topological superconductors can be engineered and be used for quantum computation in the future.

605512.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
605512.value: Superconductors are materials which can conduct electricity without resistance. Besides conducting electricity, superconductors may have many other fascinating properties. In our proposal, we studied a new type of superconductors called topological superconductors. This kind of superconductor can support an exotic type of excitations called Majorana fermions ( or Majorana zero modes). Importantly, Majorana fermions can used for quantum computers which are immune to quantum decoherence. Through many of our publications, we significantly deepen the understanding of topological superconductors. We pointed 1) how to create DIII class topological superconductors, 2) what are the special properties of DIII class topological superconductors, 3) how to detect these special properties experimentally. 4) how to use topological superconductors to form qubits for quantum computation. In the process of searching for topological superconductors, we discovered a special type of superconductors which we called Ising superconductors. Superconductivity can survive even under extremely strong magnetic field and can be used to engineer topological superconductors. We believe that we indeed made important contributions toward the understanding of topological superconductors and other novel superconductors with the support of this Early Career Grant. The PI sincerely thank the support of RGC.

605612.label: Project Objectives
605612.value: Design algorithms for computing both forward and backward FTLEs using one single flow map, rather than treating them separately. This could significantly speed up the computation. Develop efficient Eulerian methods for extracting the LCS from the FTLE using the Level set method and also the GBPM. Such variation approaches have denoising power to minimize small perturbations in the eigenvector field from either the velocity measurements or from numerical errors in the Lagrangian ray tracing. Propose computationally efficient algorithms for the LCS in a high-dimensional phase-space (4D in spatial plus time) with an application to paraxial geometrical optics. Apply the proposed algorithms to compute the LCS from real velocity field measurements to demonstrate the computational efficiency.

605612.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
605612.value: One very important concept in understanding fluid motion is coherent structure. Such structure segments the domain into different regions with similar behavior according to a quantity such as the strain, the kinetic energy, or the vorticity. Since these quantities are measured locally at some fixed given locations and also instantaneously at certain times, coherent structures based on these quantities are classified as Eulerian coherent structures (ECSs). Another class of coherent structure is the Lagrangian coherent structures (LCSs) which tries to partition space-time into regions according to a Lagrangian quantity advected along with passive tracers. Among many, a simple definition of an LCS uses the finite-time Lyapunov exponent (FTLE). It measures the rate of separation between adjacent particles over a finite time interval with an infinitesimal perturbation in the initial location. In this study, we propose to develop novel Eulerian-based numerical methods which can efficiently compute and extract the LCS in a flow. The specific goal will be to develop computationally efficient numerical algorithms to compute the FTLE and to extract the resulting LCS based on the Level Set Method and on the Grid based particle method co-developed by the PI. To test the limit of these numerical algorithms, we are also going to extend these approaches to compute LCSs in high dimensional spaces and to apply them to velocity flow models from real measurements. The techniques developed in this study could help explain various complex dynamical systems, such as the spread of the Deepwater Horizon oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico in 2010 or the spread of the radioactive water dumped into the Pacific Ocean from the Fukushima nuclear power plant following the earthquake in Japan on 11 March 2011. 一致結構(Coherent Structure)在理解流體運動是一個非常重要的概念。這樣的結構將一個區域劃分成不同的子區域，每一個子區域裡具有相似的量，像張力、內能、渦旋。由於這些量都是在某些時刻同時測量的，因此基於這些量上面的一致結構就被分類為歐拉一致結構(Eulerian Coherent Structure)。另外一種的一致結構是拉格朗日一致結構(Lagrangian Coherent Structure)，它將時間和空間的區域根據一個拉格朗日類型的量劃分成不同的子區域。在諸多定義當中，一個簡單的LCS的定義跟李亞普諾夫指數（FTLE）有關。 FTLE衡量在初始時刻的擾動在一定的時間內的變化的速率。 在這個研究，我們計劃利用新穎的歐拉方法的數值計算去有效地計算並找出一個流動當中的LCS。我們的目標是利用水平集方法和網格粒子方法設計出有效的數值算法來計算FTLE和提取出相應的LCS。為了測試這些數值算法的極限，我們還將利用這些方法來計算高維空間的LCSs 和實際生活中的速度場模型。這個研究當中的技術可以幫助解釋不同的複雜的力學系統，比如2010年的墨西哥海灣的洩漏的石油的擴散問題以及在2011年3月11日日本地震中福島核電站裡被倒入太平洋的具有放射性的水的傳播問題。

605612.label: Realisation of objectives
605612.value: As per Objective 1, we developed a simple Eulerian approach to compute the moderate to long time flow map for approximating the Lyapunov exponent of a (periodic or aperiodic) dynamical system. Unlike the original phase flow method or the backward phase flow method which is applicable only to autonomous systems, the proposed approach can also be applied to any time-dependent (periodic or aperiod) flows. As per Objective 2, we developed a new semi-implicit level set approach to a class of curvature dependent flows. The method generalizes a recent algorithm proposed for the motion by mean curvature where the interface is updated by solving the Rudin-Osher-Fatemi (ROF) model for image regularization. Our proposal is general enough so that one can easily extend and apply the method to other curvature dependent motions. Since the derivation is based on a semi-implicit time discretization, this suggests that the numerical scheme is stable even using a time-step significantly larger than that of the corresponding explicit method. As an interesting application of the numerical approach, we proposed a new variational approach for extracting limit cycles in dynamical systems. The resulting algorithm can automatically detect multiple limit cycles staying inside the initial guess with no condition imposed on the number nor the location of the limit cycles. Further, we also propose in this work an Eulerian approach based on the level set method to test if the limit cycles are stable or unstable. To Objective 3, we developed an efficient Eulerian numerical approach to extract invariant sets in a continuous dynamical system in the high dimensional extended phase space (the x-t space). We extend the idea of ergodic partition and propose a concept called coherent ergodic partition for visualizing ergodic components in a continuous flow. Numerically, we first apply the level set method and extend the backward phase flow method Leung (2013) to determine the long time flow map. To compute all required long time averages of observables along particle trajectories, we propose an Eulerian approach by simply incorporating flow maps to iteratively interpolate those short time averages. Numerical experiments have demonstrated the effectiveness of the approach. As an application of the method, we apply the approach to the field of geometrical optics for high frequency wave propagation and propose to use the result from the coherent ergodic partition as a criteria for adaptivity in typical Lagrangian ray tracing methods. As per Objective 4, one research assistant was hired to implement a new algorithm for computing both forward and backward FTLEs using one single flow map. The code has been successfully demonstrated the possibility of such approach. We have already obtained some preliminary solutions. Further work is needed to have a more careful study on the algorithm in the future. The same RA has also been asked to write a small computer program to read and convert several datasets from the website of Ocean Surface Current Analysis, which is a pilot project of National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (http://www.oscar.noaa.gov). While we are deeply encouraged by these results, the numerical approach is not up to the publication level at the moment.

605612.label: Major findings and research outcome
605612.value: Supported by this project, we have published 6 articles in total and have trained one PhD student and one MPhil student. The PhD student is currently working at the Nanjing Audit University, China. The MPhil student is pursuing his PhD at the UBC, Canada. In Leung (2013), we generalize a recently proposed backward phase flow method which is specially designed for long time level set propagation. We developed an Eulerian approach to the FTLE and propose a partial differential equation (PDE) based phase flow approach to speed up the overall computations, even for aperiodic flows. This numerical method can efficiently compute the moderate to long time flow map for approximating the Lyapunov exponent of a dynamical system. In You and Leung (2014b), we have developed a new Eulerian tool to study complicated dynamical systems based on the average growth in the surface area of a family of level surfaces represented implicitly by a level set function. Since this proposed quantity determines the temporal variation of the averaged surface area of all level surfaces, we name the quantity the Variation of the Integral over Area of Level Surfaces (VIALS). The proposed method can be easily incorporated with the approach in Leung (2013) to speed up the overall approach. We have also proven that the proposed VIALS is closely related to the computation of the FTLE in the LCS extraction. This connects the proposed Eulerian approach to widely used Lagrangian techniques for understanding complicated dynamical systems. In You and Leung (2015), we have developed a new variational approach for extracting limit cycles in dynamical systems based on the level set method. In two other recent publications Wong and Leung (2015) and Glowinski, Leung and Qian (2016), we consider also the level set formulation and also its applications related to the Hamtilon-Jacobi equation. Published with a PhD student in You and Leung (2014a), the PI introducing a concept of coherent ergodic partition. We observe that for time-dependent flows, the partition will not necessarily be invariant sets in the phase space by simply computing the joint level sets of time averages of observables, and so the partition is in fact not ergodic. Having said that, all particles within the same partitioned component at a given time (all time averages are equal in the same component) should have very similar behaviors. This concept can still help us to better understand the structure of a dynamical system.

605612.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
605612.value: Visualization of dynamical system is still an extremely interesting and important field of research. There are plenty of problems we can continue to work on. For example, a more realistic assumption is to have uncertainties in the velocity measurements. We have been trying to extend the works supported by this project to FTLE computations with uncertainty or incomplete data measurements. We can also look into efficient schemes designed for flow map computations.

605612.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
605612.value: One very important concept in understanding fluid motion is coherent structure. In this project, we have successfully developed novel Eulerian-based numerical methods which can efficiently compute and extract the LCS in a flow. We have designed computationally efficient numerical algorithms to compute the FTLE and to extract the resulting LCS based on the Level Set Method and on the Grid based particle method. To test the limit of these numerical algorithms, we have extended these approaches to compute LCSs in high dimensional spaces and to apply them to velocity flow models from real measurements. The techniques developed in this study could help explain various complex dynamical systems.

605812.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
605812.value: In the past, metals have been predominantly used as catalysts for organic transformations. However, drawbacks of these metal-catalyzed processes invoke additional problems such as difficulty in removal of residue metals in the products, resuability of catalysts, environment compatibility. Development of new organic reactions that take advantage of organic acids or bases as catalysts, which have been dormant for the past few decades, have recently received considerable attention. These organocatalysts can access new modes of reactivity patterns that could not be achieved by metal catalysis. Chiral phosphoric acids, chiral amines, and nitrogen-containing heterocyclic carbenes (NHCs) represent important families of organocatalysts that have been demonstrated to be versatile for a variety of novel reactions. The goal of this proposed project is to further advance the discovery of new processes that take further advantage of these organic catalysts for the development of an array of novel and environmentally benign processes that would be particularly useful for modern agricultural chemistry, materials sciences, pharmaceutical industry, and other aspects of human life. 在过去很长的时间里，金属的被主要使用为有机反应的催化剂。然而，在有些催化过程中， 金属的使用可能带来一些问题，例如在产品中的残留微量金属的去除，催化剂的循环使用，对环境的兼容性等等。发展新型的有机催化反应，例如使用有机酸或碱为催化剂，在过去的几十年里一直没有得到广泛关注。然而最近得到了有机化学工作者越来越多的重视。这些有机催化剂可以实现某些金属无法实现的反应模式。其中，手性磷酸，手性胺，含氮杂环卡宾等催化剂已经被证明在一系列反应体系中表现出优越的催化性能。更多的这些新型反应需要得到发展。本项目的目标是进一步推动利用这些有机催化剂的新反应研究，发展新型的环境友好的催化过程，为现代农业化学，材料科学，医药行业等打下基础。

605812.label: Realisation of objectives
605812.value: In this project, we have successfully developed a range of new catalytic organic processes using organocatalysis, which have been mainly in two different areas. These processes have been achieved with N-heterocyclic carbene (NHC) catalysis and chiral Bronsted acid catalysis. These new outcomes have resulted in 29 publications in internationally recognized journals. Specifically, we have achieved our objectives focusing on the following sub-directions: (1) With chiral phosphoric acid catalysis, we have developed a series of asymmetric desymmetrization reactions of 3-substituted oxetanes and azetidines (2) We have developed a range of asymmetric conjugate addition reactions to quinone methides. In this area, we have played pioneering role. (3) We have achieved the first asymmetric fluorination using NHC catalysis. Some interesting chiral amine-catalyzed processes have also been developed. Overall, the objectives of this proposal have been realized as expected.

605812.label: Major findings and research outcome
605812.value: In this project, we have developed the following new catalytic processes leading to synthesis of useful chiral building blocks and synthetically important structural units. (1) We developed a catalytic enantioselective synthesis of tetrahydroisoquinolines and their analogues bearing a C-4 stereocenter. (2) We developed a new strategy for the synthesis of α,α-difluoroesters by NHC catalysis. (3) We discovered the first chiral Brønsted acid catalyzed asymmetric nucleophilic ring-opening reaction of meso-epoxides. (4) We developed an enantioselective synthesis of tetrahydrofuran and tetrahydropyran skeletons. (5) We developed the first intermolecular asymmetric synthesis of 2,3-allenoates by bifunctional catalysis. (6) We developed the first organocatalytic enantioselective formal [3+2] annulation between imines and 1,4-dithiane-2,5-diol. (7) We developed a catalytic asymmetric α-aldol reaction of vnylogous N-heterocyclic carbene enolates: formation of quaternary and labile tertiary stereocenters. (8) We developed an efficient asymmetric α-fluorination of NHC-enolates generated from simple aliphatic aldehydes and α-chloro aldehydes. (9) We demonstrated an unprecedented catalytic asymmetric intermolecular addition of o-QMs by indoles. (10) We demonstrated a new organocatalytic transfer hydrogenation strategy for the efficient asymmetric synthesis of 1,1-diarylethanes. (11) A highly efficient enantio- and diastereoselective synthesis of dihydronaphthalenes from isobenzopyrylium ions was developed. (12) We developed the first catalytic enantioselective desymmetrization of azetidines. (13) A new general and mild catalytic asymmetric 1,6-conjugate addition process of para-quinone methides was developed. (14) We developed the first catalytic asymmetric intermolecular alcohol and thiol addition to o-QMs. (15) A new catalytic asymmetric approach for the synthesis of chiral 1,4-dioxanes is achieved. (16) We developed a one-pot oxidation/cycloaddition cascade for the synthesis of 2,4-diaryl chromans. (17) We developed an efficient organocatalytic enantioselective intermolecular addition of naphthols to p-quinone methides. (18) We achieved the first asymmetric chloride opening of oxetanes. (19) The first intermolecular asymmetric aza-Piancatelli reaction was achieved. (20) We developed an NHC-catalyzed efficient dihalomethylenation process. (21) We achieved the first catalytic asymmetric reaction of aza-para-quinone methides (Ref 48) (22) We developed an enantioselective [4 + 2] cycloaddition of o-quinone methides and vinyl sulfides. (23) In our effort to develop organocatalytic synthesis of chiral diarylmethyl alkynes, we demonstrated a rare example of improving synthetic procedure by understanding the role of additive. (24) We developed the first catalytic enantioselective desymmetrization of azetidiniums. (25) We developed the first organocatalytic approach for direct conversion of racemic diarylmethanols to valuable chiral diarylmethylamines.

605812.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
605812.value: As an extension of this project, the development of additional useful catalytic carbon-heteroatom bond formation processes will continue to be our topic of pursuit in this area. In particular, we will continue to expand the utility of chiral Bronsted acids in asymmetric catalysis. Our effort in asymmetric strained ring opening, such as oxetanes and azetidines, will still be a topic for further research.

605812.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
605812.value: In this project, we have discovered a range of new organic processes with excellent efficiency and selectivity. These processes provide new methods to make useful chiral molecules that could lead to potential utility in medicinal chemistry and pharmaceutical industry. These findings will not only contribute to addressing this longstanding challenges in organic synthesis, but also benefit many aspects of human life, from public health to environmental protection.

605912.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
605912.value: The efficiency of chemical synthesis of molecules or substances is still the main issue of organic synthesis. Catalysis and cascade remain the two key strategies to improve chemical synthesis by reduction of waste, time, cost and environment impacts. Cascade catalysis, a combination of cascade reactions and catalysis, recently emerged as a third synthetic strategy and has been explored in organocatalysis and organometallic catalysis, respectively. Hybrid cascade organo-/organometallic catalysis, however, has not been fully studied yet due to the incompatibility in many systems. This proposed research is initiated to develop cascade reactions combining organocatalysis and organometallic catalysis by exploring N-heterocyclic carbenes (NHCs) unique reactivity. Compatibility issues of NHCs-mediated organo- and organometallic catalysis are analyzed in details and three hypotheses (ideas) with the corresponding solutions are proposed with two specifically designed model systems for each hypothesis. Key strategies in our proposal include: 1) full exploration of NHC reactivity towards carbonyl and transition metals; 2) critical selection of NHC- and organometallic catalyzed reaction types as well as intramolecular reactions to favor desired reaction pathways; 3) careful manipulation of cascade course by exploitation of cooperative catalysis and sequential catalysis; 4) extensive investigation and applications of NHC and phosphines as ligands for transition metals and as organocatalysts for cascade hybrid reactions. To address the scope of these strategies, different transition metal (palladium, ruthenium and gold) catalyzed reactions are proposed to combine with NHC-mediated reactions. One of the most important features in this program is the dual active role of NHCs in cascade organo- and organometallic catalysis: organocatalyst and ligand for transition metals. The findings of this research will shed light on mechanistic understanding of cascade reactions of NHC organo/organometallic catalysis, provide conceptual and practical solutions for compatibility of NHC and organometallic catalysts, and more importantly inspire further studies on the cascade hybrid processes employing organo/organometallic catalysis to significantly improve the efficiency of chemical synthesis. 有机合成的主要问题是合成分子的效率问题。现在的主要合成策略仍旧是催化和串联反应来提高反应并且减少副产物，节省时间和成本，同时也减低对环境的影响。催化串联作为最近出现的第三种合成策略是把催化和串联有机的结合起来，其包括有机催化和金属催化串联反应。但是，由于兼容性的问题，研究杂化的有机-金属催化串联还比较少。所以，我们这课题主要的目的是通过利用含氮卡宾的特殊反应活性发展新的杂化的有机-金属催化串联反应。我们将分析含氮卡宾有机-金属催化串联反应光能团的兼容性问题并建立模型体系和提出相应的解决方法。课题采用的主要策略包括：1）深入研究含氮卡宾的对羰基和金属的反应活性；2）仔细选择含氮卡宾和金属的反应类型而有利于分子内的串联反应；3）技术操作以达到反应协调的效果；4）广泛的研究含氮卡宾和有机磷作为配体和有机催化剂的相同和不同性质。 为了探讨和深入的研究这些策略，课题提出使用不同的过渡金属（钯，钌，金）跟含氮卡宾结合催化反应。这个课题的最重要的特点是在杂化有机-金属串联反应中含氮卡宾的双重作用： 有机催化剂同时也是过渡金属的配体。 这项研究的发现和结果将加深含氮卡宾的杂化有机-金属串联反应机理的理解，同时提供了一套有效的办法解决杂化串联兼容性的问题，更重要的是激发进一步的研究其他的杂化串联反应来提高化学合成的效率。

605912.label: Realisation of objectives
605912.value: 1. Explore the new reactivities of NHCs. NHCs have been found to be a new class of nucleophilic organocatalysts, which are able to promote a variety of organic reactions including benzoin condensation, redox esterification, Stetter reactions etc. This project found for the first time that NHCs was able to catalyze the redox amidation for the synthesis of the synthetically versatile Weinreb amides from epoxy aldehydes and methoxymethyl amine. This finding greatly expedites the chemical access to fully functionalized Weinreb amides, which are classically prepared by multiple steps (Annual report 2017). In the course of exploring the new reactivity of NHCs for possible dichlorination of conjugate aldehydes, we were not able to achieve the transformation although our mechanistic hypothesis was highly plausible. However, we found a green method to achieve the desired products by using oxone and halides (Annual reports 2014, Org. Biomol. Chem. 2013, 11, 4312). 2. Design and Synthesize NHCs. Following the similar procedures reported in the literature, more than 10 NHC catalysts have been prepared in multi-gram scales in our lab (Annual reports 2014 and 2017). The in-house preparation of these NHC catalysts allowed us to prepare NHC-metal complexes as new catalysts for developing new synthetic methodology and total synthesis of natural products. 3. Investigate NHC-catalyzed reaction of Achmatowicz rearrangement products. Our initial investigation of NHCs as nucleophilic catalysts on substrates such as Achmatowicz rearrangement products led us to discover new regio-divergent cycloadditions: oxa-[3+2] cycloaddition of Achmatowicz rearrangement products with 1,3-dicarbonyl compounds. In fact, commercially available and low-cost quinine is a better nucleophilic organocatalyst than NHC for the cycloaddition (Org. Chem. Front. 2016, 3, 714). Unexpectedly, we found palladium catalyst could reverse the regioselectivity and gave the polycyclic furopyranones. This new chemistry was inspired by this objective. 4. Investigate the NHC-Pd catalyst. Although our aim was to develop cascade catalysis using NHC-Pd complex, we found that NHC-Cu could be used as an efficient catalyst for regio- and stereospecific deoxygenation of epoxides to alkenes. This new catalytic system represents a significant advance in this field due to the use of earth-abundant, inexpensive metal catalyst as well as the unprecedented regioselectivity (Annual reports 2015, 2016, and 2017, Org. Lett. 2016, 18, 4734). Additionally, inspired by this new discovery, we found that NHC-Cu was able to promote ring expansion of oxetanes to tetrahydrofurans (Annual report 2016), which is under further investigation and will be published in a due course.

605912.label: Major findings and research outcome
605912.value: i) IMesCuCl (NHC-Cu) is an efficient catalyst for regio- and stereospecific deoxygenation of epoxides with diazo malonate to alkenes. In addition, Cu(TFA)2 was found to a competent catalyst for deoxygenation of some epoxides. The combination of Cu/diazo has been identified for the first time to be an efficient catalytic system for deoxygenation of a variety of epoxides to alkenes. In particular, the regioselectivity by exploiting the inherent steric difference of epoxides was showcased in the monodeoxygenation of three diepoxides, which is unprecedented in the literature and would be very useful in deciding the protection/deprotection technology of alkenes in natural product synthesis. When compared to the prior catalytic deoxygenation, this new catalysis system features (1) stereospecificity; (2) chemo- and regioselectivity; (3) broad substrate scope (30 examples); and (4) the use of inexpensive, earth-abundant transition-metal copper as the catalyst. These features would make the new catalytic protocols a good choice for deoxygenation in organic synthesis. (Org. Lett. 2016, 18, 4734) ii) Inspired by our investigation of the nucleophilic reactivity of NHCs, we developed a new dichlorination of alkenes with oxone and chloride. A safe and convenient protocol was developed for in situ generation of various dichlorinating agents (cf. Cl2, NCl3, Et4NCl3, ArICl2) from oxone and chloride. The synthetic utility of this protocol was demonstrated by diastereoselective dichlorination of a series of allylic and homoallylic alcohol derivatives with excellent yields and diastereoselectivity (Org. Biomol. Chem. 2013, 11, 4312). The finding from this project prompted us to explore the field of Green Chemistry of organic reactions (several papers published). iii) Inspired by our investigation of the nucleophilic reactivity of NHCs, we found a new mode of reactivity of Achmatowicz rearrangement products. Two new protocols for oxa-[3 + 2] cycloaddition reactions were developed, which allowed a rapid and highly efficient assembly of structurally interesting polycyclic furopyranones. Importantly, we have demonstrated for the first time that Achmatowicz products could be employed as bis-electrophiles for diastereoselective and regiodivergent oxa-[3 + 2] cycloaddition reactions with 1,3-dicarbonyl compounds, which greatly expands the synthetic utility of Achmatowicz rearrangement. In addition, we discovered an unexpected new cascade sequence: Michael addition/decarboxylation/acetalization. These two novel oxa-[3 + 2] cycloaddition reactions may find applications in drug discovery and natural product synthesis. (Org. Chem. Front. 2016, 3, 714)

605912.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
605912.value: i) NHC-Cu catalyzed ring expansion of oxetanes to tetrahydrofurans (THFs). We have optimized the reaction conditions and now are exploring the enantioselective version to synthesize optically active THF-containing products. The discontinued financial support substantially slows the progress. ii) Chiral NHC-Cu (NHC*-Cu) will find more applications in organic synthesis such as asymmetric cyclopropanation, C-H insertion, O-H insertion etc. These ideas will be explored in the near future and if preliminary results are positive, we will seek financial support for the further development of the research.

605912.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
605912.value: This research project mainly focuses on the development of new synthetic methodologies for organic synthesis by exploring and exploiting the chemistry of N-heterocyclic carbenes (NHCs), which have been shown to be a new class of good organic catalysts and ligands of transition metals. Our research on NHCs’ chemistry has led to development of three new organic reactions: dichlorination of alkenes, deoxygenation of epoxides, and oxa-[3+2] cycloaddition. All the products of these reactions are very important in organic synthesis because they can serve as building blocks for synthesis of more complex molecules or as drug candidates. These new methods provide chemists more tools to solve synthesis problems including operation and environment concerns.

606012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
606012.value: The dye-sensitized solar cell (DSSC) is a promising low-cost solar cell technology. To achieve widespread commercialization of DSSCs, higher efficiencies (e.g., 15%) are needed. However, the best DSSC efficiency has been limited to about 11% for the past ten years. New methods, materials or device structures are needed to break the 11% efficiency barrier. A conventional DSSC consists of a monolayer of dye adsorbed on the surface of a mesoporous TiO2. Here, a novel multi-layer DSSC structure is proposed based on a chemistry methodology that differs significantly from the COOH chemistry used in conventional DSSCs. The goal is to better understand and control two key fundamental processes (electron injection and recombination) that co-exist at the TiO2/dye interface in DSSCs. While electron injection is the “good” process that generates currents, recombination is the “bad” process that causes losses. Several methods have been tried to retard recombination, including inserting an insulating inorganic interlayer at the TiO2/dye interface. However, these insulating layers reduce both electron injection and recombination and the benefit of reduced recombination is somewhat offset by the reduced electron injection. The important fundamental question is: can we modify the TiO2/dye interface to selectively block recombination without hurting electron injection? The novelty of this proposal lies in two aspects. 1) Instead of using inorganic interlayers that reduce both injection and recombination, the interlayers used in this study will be based on organic electron-transporting building blocks with proper energy levels to selectively block recombination without hurting electron injection. 2) Conventional DSSCs are mostly limited to a dye monolayer structure because COOH anchors of the dye are not suitable for multi-layer assembly. Here a multi-layer DSSC structure is designed based on organosiloxane chemistry, which was demonstrated to form highly compact and uniform multi-layer molecular assemblies on metal oxide surfaces. This new approach involves relatively simple organic synthesis and allows for the choice of a wide range of organic materials with tunable energy levels and electronic properties. In addition, the multi-layer assembly is well controllable and extremely precise in thickness and offers a suitable platform to study the fundamental electron injection and recombination behaviors at key interfaces in DSSCs. These tools will open up new opportunities towards understanding several important fundamental problems that were difficult to solve using conventional methods: i) how to selectively block electron recombination; ii) how to assemble a multi-layer organic/dye structure; iii) to explore electrolytes for solid-state DSSCs. 染料敏化太陽能電池（DSSC)是一種新興的低成本太陽能電池技術。爲實現DSSC的大規模商業化應用，DSSC需要實現更高的效率。然而，DSSC的最高效率一直被限制在11％以下長達10年之久。我們需要發展新材料，新概念，或新的器件結構來突破這一瓶頸。 傳統的染料敏化太陽能電池有一層吸附在介孔二氧化钛表面的的單層染料組成。這裏我們提出一個基于新型化學方法的多層染料敏化太陽能電池結構的計劃，明顯區別于用于傳統染料敏化太陽能電池的羧基化學。我們的目標是更好的理解和控制同時存在于染料敏化太陽能電池的二氧化钛/染料界面的兩個關鍵的基本進程（電子注入和複合）。電子注入是個産生電流的“好”的進程，複合是一個引起損失的“壞”的進程。有幾種方法曾經嘗試去限制複合，包括在二氧化钛/染料界面插入絕緣的無機隔層。然而絕緣層同時降低了電子注入和複合，這樣降低電荷複合的收益某種程度上來說被電子注入的降低所抵消了。重要的基本問題是：我們能不能修飾二氧化钛/染料的隔層，可選擇性的阻擋複合而不傷害電子注入？我們這裡描述的方案的創新點在兩個方面。1）在本研究中使用的隔層材料具有合適的能級，可以選擇性的限制複合而不傷害電子注入。這可以替代同時降低電子注入和複合的無機隔層。2）傳統的染料敏化太陽能電池通常受限于染料單層結構，因爲染料的羧基錨不適合多層組裝。這裏設計了一個基于有機矽氧烷化學的多層染料敏化太陽能電池結構，可以在金屬氧化物表面自組裝形成高致密、均一的多層分子。 我們新方法涉及相對簡單的有機合成，有機材料的選擇十分靈活，便於我們調整能級和電子性能。另外，我們可以精确的控制多層組裝中每一層的厚度，於是提供了一個合適的平台來研究染料敏化太陽能電池中關鍵層的電子注入和複合的基本行爲。這些工具給我們一些新的機會去理解傳統方法難以解決的幾個重要的基本問題：1）如何選擇性地阻擋電子複合；2）如何組裝多層有機/染料結構；3）探索固態染料敏化太陽能電池的電解液。

610012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
610012.value: Approximating convex bodies by polytopes is an important and well studied problem. Considerable research efforts have been devoted to the issue of bounding the combinatorial complexity of an approximating polytope for a given error. Results are of two common types. In both cases, it is shown that the bounds hold if the approximation error is smaller than a certain threshold. In the first type, which we call nonuniform bounds, the value of this threshold depends on the given convex body, while in the second type, which we call uniform bounds, the value of this threshold is independent of the convex body. Unlike the nonuniform bounds, which tend to be inherently local in nature, the uniform bounds developed to date apply only to the entire convex body. Our recent work on data structures for geometric searching problems revealed a need for approximations that are uniform but can be applied locally to the boundary of the convex body. This area has not been studied so far, but we believe it is a source of rich and challenging problems. In this grant, we propose to address the following issues: (i) investigate local geometric properties of the boundaries of convex bodies and determine how they affect approximability, (ii) develop new bounds for polytope approximation that are local and uniform, and (iii) explore applications of local and uniform bounds to geometric searching. 如何以多面體去近似凸體，是重要且被廣為研究之問題。研究大都致力於，以最小組合複雜度之近似多面體，去達到既定準確度。研究結果主要有兩種。它們都能證明，如近似準確度在某一門檻上，則複雜度有如此之界限。但第一類結果，我們稱之為不均限(non-uniform bound)，它對準確度之要求的門檻取決於眼前的凸體。而第二類結果，我們稱之為均一限(uniform bound)，它的門檻適用於任意凸體。均一限目前皆應用於整個凸體，而不像不均限一樣，有著局部的本質。然而，我們研究發現，如將均一限用於凸體之邊界上，對設計資料結構，來處理幾何搜索問題，大有幫助。這研究領域迄今尚未被踏足，而我們相信，當中蘊含豐富的難題。在此撥款申請中，我們提議要： 一）研究凸體邊界的局部幾何特性，及其與可近似性之關係； 二）在多面體近似法，開發新的局部均一限； 三）探索局部均一限，在幾何搜索中之應用。

610012.label: Realisation of objectives
610012.value: All of the objectives of our project have been fully realized. Our first objective was to investigate local geometric properties of the boundaries of convex bodies and determine how they affect approximability. Our second objective was to develop new bounds for approximating convex bodies by polytopes. We begin with some definitions. Let K denote a convex body in d dimensions. A polytope P is said to eps-approximate K if the Hausdorff distance between K and P is at most eps. At issue is the minimum number of vertices (alternatively, the minimum number of facets) needed in an approximating polytope for a given error eps. Approximation bounds in the literature are of two common types. In both cases, it is shown that there exists a threshold, and the bounds hold whenever the allowed approximation error is smaller than this threshold. In the first type, called uniform bounds, the value of the threshold depends on the convex body, and in the second type, called uniform bounds, the value of the threshold is independent of the convex body. Our focus in this project has been exclusively on developing uniform bounds. Uniform bounds were first presented in 1974 by Dudley, who showed that any convex body K in d dimensions can be approximated by a polytope with O((diam(K) / eps)^{(d-1)/2}) facets. While this bound is optimal in the worst case, it can be suboptimal if K is skinny. In our work (J1), we present a new optimal bound for this problem that is sensitive to the surface area of the convex body. Our bound is never worse than Dudley's and can be significantly better for skinny bodies. Our approach is based on a sampling process that is sensitive to the local geometric properties of the boundary of convex bodies. We are writing up these results for journal publication. In another work (C2, J2), we consider the issue of the combinatorial complexity, that is, the total number of faces of all dimensions of an eps-approximating polytope. Before our work, there was a quadratic gap between the known upper and lower bounds for this problem. We establish an almost optimal bound for this problem. Our paper describing this result has been published in the Symposium on Computational Geometry (SoCG), 2016. The best papers accepted to this conference were invited to a special issue of the journal Discrete and Computational Geometry (DCG). Our paper received this honor and has just been accepted for publication in DCG. The third objective of our project was to explore applications of local and uniform bounds to geometric searching. In earlier works, we showed that improved local and uniform bounds for polytope approximation lead to more efficient data structures for approximate polytope membership queries. In turn, we showed that this leads to faster data structures for approximate nearest neighbor searching. In C1, we combine our ideas with the notion of discrete Voronoi diagrams to obtain the fastest algorithms known for several offline proximity problems such as diameter of a point set, approximate bichromatic closest pair, and Euclidean minimum spanning tree. Our paper describing this work has been published in Symposium on Computational Geometry (SoCG), 2014. Finally, in C3, we present an optimal data structure for approximate polytope membership. Our data structure is based on a new technique, a hierarchy of ellipsoids defined as approximations to Macbeath regions, which is a classical structure from the theory of convexity. As an application, we obtain major improvements to approximate Euclidean nearest neighbor searching. Our paper descibing this work has been accepted for the ACM-SIAM Symposium on Discrete Algorithms (SODA), 2017.

610012.label: Major findings and research outcome
610012.value: We elaborate on some of the contributions mentioned in Section 5.3. In J1, we consider the following problem. Given a convex body K in d-dimensional space (where d is fixed), the objective is to minimize the number of facets of an approximating polytope for a given Hausdorff error eps. We show that it is possible to approximate a convex body using O(sqrt(area(K)) / eps^{(d-1)/2}) facets, where area(K) is the surface area of K. This bound is never worse than Dudley's bound and can be significantly better for skinny bodies. Our improved bound arises from a novel approach to sampling points on the boundary of a convex body in order to stab all dual caps of a given width. This approach involves the application of an elegant concept from the theory of convex bodies, called Macbeath regions. In (C2, J2), we deal with the following related problem. Instead of minimizing just the number of facets of the approximating polytope, our objective now is to minimize the total combinatorial complexity of the approximating polytope whose Hausdorff distance from K is at most eps times the diameter of K. By combinatorial complexity, we mean the total number of faces of all dimensions of the polytope. A lower bound of Omega(1/eps^{(d-1)/2}) on the combinatorial complexity follows by considering the case of a Euclidean ball. Using results on lattice polytopes, the previous best upper bound on the combinatorial complexity is roughly O(1/eps^{d-2}). Thus, before our work, there was a near-quadratic gap between the lower and upper bound. We show that there exists an approximating polytope whose combinatorial complexity matches the lower bound up to a polylogarithmic factor in 1/eps. Our result again relies on the concept of Macbeath regions. In C1, we combined our ideas for approximating polytopes with the notion of discrete Voronoi diagrams to design faster algorithms for several fundamental offline proximity problems. Known algorithms for many such problems, including approximate bichromatic closest pair (BCP) and approximate minimum spanning trees (EMST), typically have eps-dependencies near (1/eps)^{d/2} or worse in their running times. We break the (1/eps)^{d/2} barrier, reducing it to (1/eps)^{d/3} for the aforementioned problems. In addition, we present a space-optimal streaming algorithm that reduces the time to maintain the diameter of a point set from O(1/eps^{d/2}) to O(1/eps^{d/3}) per point. Building on the techniques developed in C2, we present an optimal data structure for answering approximate polytope membership queries (C3). In this problem, the objective is to preprocess a convex body K so that, given a query point q, we return a positive answer if q lies in K, a negative answer if the distance from q to K is greater than eps times K's diameter, and either answer otherwise. Previous solutions were in the form of a space-time tradeoff, where logarithmic query time demands O(1/eps^{d-1}) storage, whereas storage O(1/eps^{(d-1)/2}) admits roughly O(1/eps^{(d-1)/8}) query time. In our work, we present a data structure that achieves logarithmic query time with storage of only O(1/eps^{(d-1)/2}), which matches the worst-case lower bound on the complexity of any eps-approximating polytope. Our data structure is based on a hierarchy of ellipsoids defined as approximations to Macbeath regions. As an application, we obtain major improvements to approximate nearest neighbor searching. Notably, the storage needed to answer eps-approximate nearest neighbor queries for a set of n points in O(log(n/eps)) time is reduced to O(n / eps^{d/2}). This halves the exponent in the eps-dependency of the existing space bound of roughly O(n/ep^d), which has stood for 15 years.

610012.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
610012.value: Our work raises several open questions. One, while we have almost resolved the issue of the total combinatorial complexity of an approximating polytope, it is still open whether the logarithmic factors can be removed or if is there is a fundamental reason why they appear. Two, we have reduced the eps-dependencies in the running times of algorithms for many fundamental offline proximity problems from (1/eps)^{d/2} to (1/eps)^{d/3}. An important question is whether these eps-dependencies are now optimal or if they can be reduced further. Three, while we have established the existence of an optimal data structure for approximate polytope membership, the question of constructing it efficiently is still open. In the future, we plan to tackle all these open problems and, thereby, further deepen our understanding.

610012.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
610012.value: Approximating convex bodies by polytopes is a fundamental problem in mathematics and computer science. In our project, we have developed new bounds on the complexity of the approximating polytope as a function of the allowed error. We have also explored applications of our work on polytope approximation to designing more efficient data structures and algorithms for many important geometric problems.

610112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
610112.value: Direct compression of image/video often introduces severe blocking artifacts at low bitrate, and hence researchers have proposed a "down-sample, compress, then interpolate " (DCI) scheme, which can provide superior performance than direct “compression at original size” (COS). Nevertheless, pixel-based down-sampling removes high frequency details forever, resulting in blurred reconstructed image. In order to improve the perceptual quality of low bitrate compressed image/video, we propose to explore subpixel-based techniques for low bitrate image/video compression in this research. Subpixel rendering takes advantage of the fact that each pixel on a modern LCD is composed of three independently addressable, spatially distinct red, green and blue subpixels, to increase the apparent resolution. However, since each subpixel can signal only one color, direct application of subpixel approach to images/video down-sampling would cause very annoying "color fringe'' artifacts. The proposed research aims to better understand how compression will affect subpixel rendering and the application of subpixel rendering on low bitrate image/video compression. In particular, we plan to develop analytical models to characterize compression of subpixel-based image/video, and to investigate the effect of compression on apparent luminance resolution and chrominance distortion respectively, from both the frequency domain behavior and human visual system perspectives. Based on the developed theories and models, we plan to develop filtering algorithms for pre-processing (e.g., subpixel-based down-sampling) of image/video before the encoder, for the purpose of preserving more original details after compression. We will also develop matching reconstruction methods for post-processing (e.g., up-sampling) of the decoded image/video, to make effective use of the extra apparent resolution to provide a sharper reconstructed image/video. We will demonstrate that these systems can significantly outperform conventional direct COS as well as pixel-based DCI schemes, in terms of both RD performance and perceptual visual quality. The developed theories and algorithms would further the understanding of color image/video compression systems and their interactions with the human visual system, and these advancements can potentially lead to new applications. 在低比特率下對圖像或視頻直接壓縮會產生嚴重的分塊效應，為此，研究人員提出了 “先下采樣，再壓縮，然後插值”（DCI）的技術方案。該方案比直接“用原始尺寸壓 縮”（COS）的方案有更優越的性能。然而，基於像素的下采樣會永久性的去除原圖片 中的高頻細節，致使重建圖像模糊。為了進一步提升低比特率下壓縮的圖像或視頻的視 覺效果，我們提議在本研究中探索基於亞像素的低比特率圖像或視頻壓縮技術。亞像素 渲染技術利用的事實是，現代化的液晶顯示屏上的每一個像素都由可獨立訪問的空間上 不同的紅色，綠色和藍色三個亞像素組成，以提高表觀分辨率。然而，由於每一個亞像 素只能表示一種顏色，把亞像素的方法直接應用到圖像或視頻的下采樣中將導致令人不 悅的彩色條紋效應。 本研究的目的是更好地了解壓縮對亞像素渲染的影響以及亞像素渲染在低比特率壓縮圖 像或視頻中的應用。特別是，我們計劃研發分析模型，用以表征基於亞像素的視頻或圖 像壓縮，用以從頻域表現和人類視覺系統兩個方面分別研究壓縮對表觀亮度分辨率和色 度失真的影響。基於研發出來的理論和模型，我們計劃研發編碼前預處理圖像或視頻的 濾波算法（如，基於亞像素的下采樣），使壓縮後的重建圖像或視頻含有更多原始的細 節。對解碼得到圖像或視頻，我們還將研發在後處理中相匹配的重建算法，有效地利用 額外的表觀分辨率，提供更銳利的重建圖像或視頻。我們將從RD性能和視覺質量兩個方 面證明，所提議的系統能顯著地優於傳統的直接COS方案和基於像素的DCI方案。而研發 出來的理論和算法也將促進人們理解彩色圖像或視頻的壓縮系統，及其與人類視覺系統 的相互作用。以上這些進步有可能產生一些新的應用。

610112.label: Major findings and research outcome
610112.value: We have studied the human sensitivity on the higher apparent luminance resolution (subpixel details) and chrominance distortion in subpixel-based generated image/video, and developed mathematical model of subpixel-based image/video compression from both frequency domain analysis and human visual system perspectives. By studying the effect of compression on apparent luminance resolution and chrominance distortion in different frequency bands (i.e. low and high frequency bands), we have successfully proposed effective ways to perform low bitrate subpixel-friendly image/video compression. The related works have been published in several top international peer-reviewed journals and conferences, such as IEEE TIP, TCSVT, TMM, JSTSP, DCC, ICIP etc. A few US and Chinese patents related to this project have been applied and approved.

610112.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
610112.value: As the future work, we plan to 1) develop a comprehensive objective assessment for subpixel-based approaches, since all the existing measurements are either subjective or unilateral。 2） explore the inherent relationship between subpixel-based downsampling and upsampling. By developing the mathematical cross-scale model, we plan to propose a subpixel-based super-resolution scheme, for better utilizing subpixel-based apparent resolution.

610112.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
610112.value: We expect this research to be ground-breaking with great significance in digital signal processing theory. We hope to demonstrate that these systems can significantly outperform both traditional pixel-based DCI schemes and direct COS, in terms of both RD performance and perceptual visual quality. The theories and algorithms to be developed can potentially further our understanding of color image/video compression, and their interactions with human visual system, leading to new application opportunities.
