715612.label: Major findings and research outcome
715612.value: This project has generated substantial details in explaining how different types of metal incorporation processes can be triggered by metakaolin precursor with the lower sintering temperatures. For example, with systematic evaluations of copper, zinc and lead systems in reacting with metakaolin. Using metakaolin to stabilize these targeted metals can be 100 to 200C lower than its well-crystalline mineral phase with similar chemical compositions. The reaction mechanisms were also found to highly depend on the types of metals, including their valence charges and atomic radii. With the successful implementation of amorphous content quantification through the SRM 676a internal standard, all the tested samples can obtain their amorphous contents to more truly reflect the overall property of the products. The task of comparing different internal standards have found that the calcium fluoride can be an accurate standard same as SRM676a for medium to light element compounds. Our work on synthesizing some other heavier element compounds revealed that the tungsten carbide (WC) would be a better internal standard for estimating their amorphous contents. Through high-temperature oxide melt solution calorimetry technique, the thermodynamic data of the products synthesized from the metakaolin precursors are similar to the products synthesized from the higher-temperature crystalline precursors, as long as the metal incorporation can be initiated to form spinels or spinel-like crystals. The comparisons of intrinsic leachability for different production phases show the superior acidic resistance for the metal containing products using metakaolin as a precursor. Surface-sensitive XPS and AFM results have also indicated the robustness of product surface after the leaching process. The amorphous content in the grain boundary regions was found to be effectively reduced by the prolonged sintering time, without the need of increasing the sintering temperature. This means the main limiting factor of further narrowing the gain boundaries in this system is largely kinetic-driven, instead of due to the thermodynamic limitation. Other strategies trying to reduce the mass-transfer barriers, such as designing the porous texture for the products, can effectively minimize this problem. Overall, the findings of this study suggest a promising technology to thermally incorporate metals into crystalline structures at lower temperatures via the metakaolin precursor. It provides an economical means to simultaneously reduce the environmental hazard and produce a wide variety of morphological features in the products for different application opportunities.

715612.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
715612.value: Further development of this research direction may be targeting at the pilot-scale operation of using metakaolin and/or its kaolinite precursor for hazardous waste stabilization. Many places of the world have to stabilize the hazardous industrial waste and the toxic incineration residues from their waste management systems. The continuing generation of such hazardous waste has now become one of the most urgent problems needed to be resolved in many fast-developing countries. Although the metakaolin reaction provide a more energy-saving reaction route, the optimal processing parameters derived from this project may need further tuning for applying in the larger scale operations. The product properties produced from the larger scale processing also require characterizations for confirmation. Nearly all existing pilots or full size plants in the world for waste beneficial use are solely based on empirical approach. The outcome of this project can significantly assist the reliability of such waste-to-resource operations and ensure the product safety. New knowledge and experience obtained from the large scale operations may further reveal the need of new understandings in certain details of the future scientific studies.

715612.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
715612.value: Hazardous metals in soils and waste sludge/ash pose environmental problems worldwide. Current policy for metal-bearing waste focuses on developing its potential to be recycled into usable products as a waste-to-resource strategy. However, the efficiencies of these strategies and many metal stabilization mechanisms need to be fully understood to ensure product safety in long-term applications. Metakaolin is a nanocrystalline material derived from the widely abundant kaolinite resource and it was found to be with a high chemical reactivity. By choosing copper, zinc and lead as the target metals, this project successfully revealed the key mechanisms of how kaolinite-based materials assist metal stabilization at moderate-to-low calcination temperatures, and what the metal-loading capabilities of metakaolin matrix at lower temperatures are. The new data of the thermal reactions between metakaolin and different metals suggested that using metakaolin as the precursor can promote metal incorporation at lower temperatures but still produce quality products for metal stabilization. These findings are crucial to environmental applications, such as fabricating products from waste materials, thermally treating metal contaminated soils, and synthesizing catalysts or composite materials in a more energy-saving route than is needed for reacting with common oxide or aluminosilicate matrices.

715712.label: Project Title(Chinese)
715712.value: 具有锚固系统的外贴材料加固工程结构的理论模型和设计方法

715712.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
715712.value: The strengthening of existing reinforced concrete (RC) infrastructure with externally bonded high-strength, light-weight and durable fibre-reinforced polymer (FRP) composites is a proven and now a relatively well utilised technology in practice. Two limitations inherent in this strengthening technique and strengthening with FRP composites though are premature FRP debonding failure and brittle member behaviour. Despite the abundance of research conducted to date by the research community, these two limitations remain prevalent. The addition of anchorage devices to externally bonded FRP can solve these two limitations, however, systematic research to date is limited. In addition, the coverage of anchorage devices in design guidelines and standards is very limited and the design engineer is generally given the option of imposing strict limits on the bond strength of the FRP or to conduct pilot testing. Extensive testing by the PI and his research group has proven mechanical devices made from FRP (also known as FRP anchors) to considerably enhance the strength of externally bonded FRP in addition to the ductility of FRP-strengthened systems. What is lacking to date though with the anchorage solution are robust analytical models to analyse and rigorous design approaches to design them. The aim of this project is to develop analytical models and design procedures for externally bonded strengthening systems which incorporate anchorage devices. The models and procedures will be developed in the context of FRP composites for strengthening as well as FRP anchors for anchorage for all stage of loading although the real innovation of the project rests in the generic nature of the theory. For calibration of the models and to also investigate a wider range of geometrical and material parameters already investigated to date, tests will be conducted on FRP-to-concrete joints as well as FRP-strengthened simply supported and continuous RC members anchored with FRP anchors. The research results will be directly applicable to any country with RC structures which require strengthening and repair and locally it is applicable to the Hong Kong construction industry as well as owners of buildings. The research results will also be helpful to the writers of anchorage design provisions in strengthening design guidelines. 纤维增强复合材料（FRP）具有高强、轻质及耐久等特性。外贴FRP法是一种有效的加固钢筋混凝土（RC）结构的方法，并且在实际工程中得到了较好的应用。然而，这种技术方法有两种局限性，即FRP过早的剥离破坏，以及加被固构件的脆性破坏的力学行为。尽管学术界迄今已经对此做过大量研究，上述问题仍然广泛存在。在加固中运用锚固系统可以解决这两个局限性，但是至今仍然缺乏对其系统性的研究。此外，设计规范之中关于锚固装置的内容非常有限，故而设计师只能严格依照FRP的粘接强度进行设计，或者需要进行试验来测定锚具的强度。申请人及其课题组所进行的试验研究表明，用FRP材料制成的锚固装置（又称作FRP锚具）可以显著提高FRP加固构件的强度和延性。然而至今仍然缺少可靠的分析模型和设计方法对其进行分析和设计。 本研究的目的是建立带有锚固装置的外贴加固方法的分析模型和设计方法。本课题建立在具有普遍性和一般性的理论基础之上，所建立的分析模型和设计方法将涵盖FRP复合材料加固及FRP锚具的各个受力阶段的力学行为。为了标定分析模型和进行更大范围的几何尺寸及材料参数的研究，需要对应用FRP锚具的FRP-混凝土结点试验以及FRP加固简支和连续RC构件进行试验研究。研究的结果将可被任何国家的RC结构的修复和加固工程、香港本地的建筑行业以及房屋的业主应用。同时，研究结果也能够为结构加固设计规范中锚具的设计方法的编制者提供帮助和依据。

716112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
716112.value: 隨著無線通信技術的發展，亞毫米波和太赫茲(THz)在擴展可用電磁頻譜方面引起了極大關注。在太赫茲頻段，針對多尺度、高密度的有源/無源混合結構的電磁兼容性能的預估對太赫茲電路的設計及優化至關重要。 在低頻段，很多種近似的模型可以被採納,其中電磁波的效應是可以被忽略的。然而，當工作頻率升至THz頻段時，器件間耦合以及電子與波之間的干擾急劇加大​​。在設計時,如果沒有充分考慮到這些偶合效應，整個系統的性能將迅速將得不到保證, 特別是含有大尺寸輻射單元,複雜互連線以及內嵌有源半導體器件的有源集成天線或其陣列更是如此。 過去，針對實際應用的全波電磁求解器的開發已經卓有成效。對於求解THz系統，開發針對解決上述難題的普遍適用的全波分析方法顯得愈發重要。但是，大多數現有數值求解器僅適用於純動態場或純靜態場，或者適用於有限帶寬的電磁場。 因此，我們提出一種全新的方法應對上述挑戰，該方法具備以下特點： 1)有效的集成了半導體物理模型，考慮有源與無源器件間的電子與波之間的相互作用。因為THz半導體材料屬性不再具有空間不變性，特別是強輻射集成天線，求解時應該考慮半導體的本身模型。 2)對集成電路（IC）的複雜版圖進行多尺度仿真。整個電路建模時，採用高度非均勻網格。針對不同算子產生的零空間，採用合適的基函數解決積分方程方法或微分方程方法的低頻崩潰問題。 3)對實際IC問題生成的大型病態矩陣，採​​用有效的預條件。求解此類矩陣時，直接算法將不可避免地被迭代算法取代，有效的預條件將用於改善多尺度矩陣的條件數，加速收斂。 4)THz頻段的寬帶求解。儘管使用了迭代​​算法，直接的矩矢相乘依然需要大量運算。寬帶快速算法將必不可少地運用於多尺度求解。 對THz系統而言，該方法與其它算法的區別在於其應用普遍，能精確求解多尺度、超寬帶、多物理問題。我們的長遠目標是為IC、微波及THz通信開發快速高效的全波求解器。

716112.label: Realisation of objectives
716112.value: 1. The accuracy of the multiscale full-wave EM solver for IC problems have been studied and improved by using Calderon preconditioned EFIE. We have proposed the perturbation method with CP-EFIE to obtain the correct electric currents at different frequency orders for arbitrary low frequencies. The new perturbation scheme works well for both scattering and low-frequency capacitive problems. Also, for inductive problems, traditional eddy current assumption at low frequencies is no longer accurate with increased frequencies. By considering the displacement current, we have proposed a full-wave semi-analytical solution to accurately calculate the self and mutual impedances of two coupled spiral inductors with rectangular cross sections. As applications, the obtained full-wave model could be used for both homogeneous and planarly layered media for circuit systems. 2. We have developed an efficient Calderon-based preconditioner to solve multiscale circuit problems. The preconditioner is suitable for multiscale problems since it is immune to both low-frequency and dense-mesh breakdown. On the other hand, we have studied the role of the right-hand-side excitation in determining the convergence rate of the iterative solvers, which is found to be important or even crucial at low frequencies for locally-excited circuit problems. The analysis is applied for both EFIE and CMP-EFIE. The detailed spectral analysis can be useful in developing an general preconditioner for improving the convergence of the iterative solvers. 3. A broadband fast algorithm has been succesfully developed, and the results have been reported in IEEE top conference and journal papers. We have accelerated the perturbation-based integral equation by using fast Fourier transform technique. Since the perturbed kernels satisfy Toeplitz property on the uniform Cartesian grid, the fast Fourier transform based on Lagrange interpolation can be well incorporated to efficiently accelerate the multiple matrix vector products. 4. The GIBC-based global modeling framework has been bulit by proposing new IE-based and FEM-based algorithms. The proposed FEM is developed in solving the magnetostatic physics, which is strongly coupled with semiconductor models. By expanding the magnetic flux density with new basis, the Gauss' law for magnetism is naturally satisfied. In the desire of modeling the electron transport in semiconductor or quantum devices, the FEM method in classic EM needs to be bridged to quantum and solid-state physics. A solution to the double curl equation with generalized Coulomb gauge is proposed based on the vectorial representation of the magnetic vector potential. The final FEM system, is built in a generalized and natural form.

716112.label: Major findings and research outcome
716112.value: For integral equation part: 1. The perturbation method is developed for CMP-EFIE method to obtain accurate electrical current at arbitrary low frequencies. The accuracy of the numerical modeling for scattering and capacitive problems is well-solved by using the proposed scheme. (Journal paper1) 2. A theory is built for analyzing the right-hand-side effect in studying the convergence of an iterative system. By investigating the weighted right-hand-side effect of the EFIE-based systems in solving capacitive problems, the corresponding stabilized forms of EFIE and CMP-EFIE are studied. (Journal paper 3) 3. The perturbation-based integral equation is accelarated with fast Fourier transform technique. By applying the technique to A-EFIE formulation, an efficient, stable and accurate algorithm is developed for real-world applications. (Journal paper 7) For differential equation part: 1. A full-wave semi-analytical solver is built for the modeling of inductive problems. By considering the displacement current with increased frequency. The self and mutual impedances of two coupled spiral inductors with rectangular cross sections is accurated calculated. The method is further applied to wireless power transfer systems with homogeneous and planarly layered media. (Journal paper 2) 2. The loop basis functions are introduced to expand the magnetic flux density to satisfy the Gauss' law. The magnetostatic subset equation in the Maxwell's equations is correctly solved with a compact straightforward finite element method. (Journal paper 4) 3. The potential-based differential equation with double curl is built with the generalized Coulomb gauge. Traditional Coulomb gauge is applied to remove the null space of the curl operator, guaranting the uniqueness of the solution. The mapping properties of the Whitney forms is applied in the choice of basis functions of the magnetic vector potential. By doing such technique, the original equation can be written into a generalized form and solved with finite element method in a natural way. (Journal paper 5) For potential circuit design: To make the device working at very high frequency like THz region, the patch-based circuit topology is also proposed. A miniaturized patch hybrid coupler with arbitrary power ratio and impedance transformation is proposed. A pair of asymmetric cross-slot ends on the squared patch is utilized to control the transforming impedance and output power ratio. The equivalent transmission line model is first derived to better understand the design procedure. The connection between the patch-based and traditional branch-line-based hybrid couplers is established. (Journal paper 6)

716112.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
716112.value: 1. The systematic investigation of the right-hand-side effect can be further undertaken, thus the system convergence issue can be modified by the controlling of the excitation of different modes; 2. The potential based method can be derived for integral equations, which in potential will solve the low-frequency breakdown problem and is a good candidate for bridging the classic EM physics with quantum physics. Also, after this method is built, the extension can be made to solve dielectric problems, thus, advanced applications, such as quantum optics, nano optics or nano EMC, can be solvable by combining with advanced physical concepts such as surface plasmon or quantum coupling effects. 3. By applying the GIBC framework based IE and FEM methods, one can solve many real-world problems, not only for the modeling of the electron transport in semiconductor, but also for other quantum physics interferance.

716112.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
716112.value: In order to realize the global modeling of an electromagnetic system, we have applied several numerical techniques to both integral and differential equations. The aim is to fix up the drawbacks of various formulations such as inaccuracy, instability and inefficiency. Moreover, the application of the fast algorithms makes it possible to solve real-world problems. These aspects are important in modeling circuit problems with complicated structrues which varies from micro to nanoscale and working at a frequency from milimeter to THz. This is the basic modeling framework of the project. For solving problems in nanoscale, it is desired that we combine our EM method with quantum and solid-state physics. One way to bridge the EM world and the quantum world is to reformulate the EM equations with potentials. We have done so for FEM framework based on potentials. By corporating with the boundary element method, an FE-BI modeling system can be built up, which should be a potential candidate in solving problems such as quantum optics, nano optics or nano EMC. These problems can be solvable only by combining classic EM physics with advanced physical concepts such as surface plasmon or quantum coupling effects.

716312.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
716312.value: Traffic congestion and emissions are major problems in Hong Kong and many other urban cities. These problems can be handled by appropriate transportation planning and traffic management, with the use of Dynamic Traffic Assignment (DTA) models. Currently, most of the analytical DTA models that can capture realistic queue spillback cannot be used for large-network applications unless heuristics are used to handle path sets. Moreover, different vehicle types and their interaction are seldom considered, particularly when hydrodynamic models are used. The computation burden and accuracy are the main issues for improving these models. This research will develop a new, multi-class DTA modeling approach to address the above issues, based on the proposed concept of intersection movements. Queue spillback will be captured without using the path set information, and multi-class traffic interaction will be considered, based on hydrodynamic theory. Efficient and convergent solution methods will be proposed, based on the properties of the resulting models. The computation performance and solution quality of the methods will be tested with various large networks and demand patterns. Numerical studies will also shed light on the implications for transportation planning and traffic management. The proposed modeling approach should open up a new way of formulating the DTA problem, taking queue spillback into consideration, for practical large-network applications. 在香港和許多其他城市，交通擁塞和車輛排放廢氣是兩個主要問題，這些問題是可以通過適當的交通規劃、交通管理和使用動態交通分配模型來處理的。目前，除非啟發式求解算法被用來處理動態交通分配模型的路徑集，否則大多數有考慮排隊後溢的動態交通分配模型不能應用於大型的交通網絡上。此外，特別是在基於流體動力理論的動態交通分配模型上，不同的車輛類型和它們的相互關係很少被考慮，求解算法的高效性和準確性也是主要問題。 本研究將研發一種基於交叉口流量和流體動力學理論的多類動態交通分配建模方法以解決上述問題，這模型考慮不同的車輛類型和排隊後溢，但在求解時不須要處理路徑集。根據模型的數學性質，本研究將提出高效和收斂的求解算法的方法，並使用各種大型交通網絡和需求模式來測試求解算法的計算效果。本研究的數值模擬研究也將對交通規劃和交通管理有所啟示。本研究開展了一種新的動態交通分配建模方法，它有考慮排隊後溢，又可以應用到實際的大型交通網絡上。

716312.label: Realisation of objectives
716312.value: To achieve objective (1), a novel variational inequality (VI) formulation of the dynamic user optimal (DUO) route choice problem was proposed using the concept of approach proportion [J1]. An approach proportion represents the proportion of travelers who select a turning or through movement when leaving a node or intersection. Approach proportions contain travelers’ route information so that the realistic effects of physical queues (such as queue spillback) can be captured in a formulation when a physical-queue traffic flow model is adopted, and so that route enumeration and path set generation can be avoided in the solution procedure. Link transmission model, a hydrodynamic traffic flow model, was modified and captured into the VI model to depict the effect of physical queues. The VI model was extended for the stochastic DUO route choice problem and reformulated as two fixed point (FP) problems [J2]. One was formulated with respect to origin-destination pair and another one was formulated with respect to destination. An efficient path set was defined and used in these models to avoid route enumeration and path set generation during the computation process for solving the FP models. The previous models were extended to consider traffic interaction between different types of vehicles [J3]. The extended model incorporated a multi-class network loading model to capture the effect of physical queues due to different types or sizes of vehicles such as cars and trucks. To achieve objective (2), the existence and uniqueness of the solutions to the VI problem was analyzed [J1]. The equivalence of the VI problem and the DUO route choice problem was proven. The continuity of the mapping function in the VI was proved under certain assumptions. Numerical studies were conducted to demonstrate the properties of the proposed DUO model. For the FP models in [J2], the relationship between the two FP models was analyzed. The existence and uniqueness of the solutions of the two FP models were examined. Numerical examples were also developed to demonstrate the properties of the stochastic DUO route choice problem. The proposed FP models were further used to evaluate the effect of information quality and road network improvement on the network performance in terms of total system travel time (TSTT) and the cost of total vehicle emissions. Numerical results showed that providing better information quality, enhancing link outflow capacity, or constructing a new road can lead to poor network performance. In [J3], the properties of the extended multi-class model were analyzed theoretically and numerically. In particular, the equivalence of the extended model formulation and the multiclass DUO route problem formulation was proven. Numerical examples were also set to illustrate the importance of considering multiple vehicle classes. In addition, a car-truck interaction paradox, which states that allowing trucks (or larger vehicles) to travel in a network or increasing the demand of trucks can improve total car travel time, was proposed, discussed, and examined. In particular, the occurrence of the paradox was elaborated and the effects of truck demand and speed on that occurrence were investigated. The findings have important implications for managing and planning road networks with multiple types of traffic. For example, it is possible to relax road restrictions for trucks or large vehicles so that the total car travel time can be further improved or vice versa. The findings also open up new research directions for traffic management such as road restrictions and priority control for specific vehicle classes as well as transportation planning for networks with class-specific roads. These important findings were presented at four international conferences [C3-C6] to transfer the knowledge to practitioners, policy makers, and engineers in additional to researchers and students. To achieve objective (3), a solution algorithm was developed based on the extragradient algorithm to solve the proposed VI problem [J1]. This solution algorithm makes use of the decomposition property of the constraint set, and is convergent if the travel time functions are pseudomonotone and Lipschitz continuous. It is not necessary to know the Lipschitz constant of the travel time functions in advance. Finally, numerical studies were performed to demonstrate the efficiency and convergence of the solution algorithm for solving various large, realistic networks. The results were presented in the biggest annual international transportation conference, Transportation Research Board Annual Meeting, in the USA [C1]. To solve the FP models, a self-regulated averaging method that incorporates a stochastic network loading method was proposed [J2]. Numerical tests were carried out to illustrate the effectiveness of the solution method. The results were presented at a biannual international symposium of dynamic traffic assignment (DTA) in Italy [C2]. To solve the multiclass model, an extragradient algorithm was used [J3, C3, C6]. The Nguyen and Dupuis network was used to test the performance of the solution algorithm under various background traffic levels. The Sioux Falls network was used to show the convergence of the algorithm.

716312.label: Major findings and research outcome
716312.value: There were three phases in this project. For each phase, one journal paper was produced. Two of the journal papers were published in prestigious journals in operations research and transportation. The research outcomes (in forms of modeling framework, model variants, solution methods, and properties of studied problems) and major findings from the numerical studies of each phase were published in three journal papers [J1-J3] and were presented in six international conferences [C1-C6]. The following summarizes the major findings of each journal paper. [J1] showed that the proposed DUO model is consistent with some other existing DUO models and that the proposed method can outperform the path-based method in terms of both efficiency and memory usage. [J1] also showed that the approach travel time may not be continuous with respect to the approach proportions due to queue spillback. However, the proposed algorithm can obtain a DUO solution under the point queue and physical queue settings if the existence of solutions is guaranteed. [J2] illustrated four interesting phenomena in DTA using examples: (1) an improvement of information quality results in an increase in TSTT and total vehicle emissions, (2) an improvement of road outflow capacity results in an increase in total vehicle emissions, (3) the addition of a link results in an increase in TSTT and total vehicle emissions, and (4) a decrease in travel demand may result in an increase in total vehicle emissions. These examples demonstrated that the information quality, the transportation network topology, link capacity, as well as the travel demand must be taken into consideration in any transportation policy measures and planning schemes aimed toward the reduction of TSTT and total vehicle emissions. [J3] demonstrated that the resulting solution of the VI satisfies the theoretical multi-class DUO conditions. Meanwhile, [J3] demonstrated that changes in truck demand and speed affect the route choices and travel times of cars. These results underline the importance of capturing multiple vehicle types and their interactions in a DTA model. [J3] also illustrated a car-truck interaction paradox in the context of DTA or, more generally, the interaction paradox between vehicles of different sizes. These findings have important implications for traffic management. For example, it is possible to relax road restrictions for trucks or large vehicles so that the total car travel time can be further improved or vice versa.

716312.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
716312.value: In this research, the models were developed based on the classical or stochastic DUO principle, where the main factor that affects route choice is travel time. In reality, a driver may consider other factors such as distance and number of signalized junctions when making route choice decisions. The route choice principle in these models can be replaced with more sophisticated and realistic principles without encountering fundamental difficulties. This generalization is left to future studies. Moreover, the car-truck interaction paradox opens up various new research directions, such as developing an optimal real-time, multi-class traffic management scheme, detecting the occurrence of a car-truck interaction paradox in a network, or simultaneously optimizing the performance measure for each vehicle class in transportation planning.

716412.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
716412.value: A lot of real world applications, such as VLSI placement, multiprocessor scheduling, balancing industrial assembly line, memory allocation, stocks cutting, and trucks loading, can be modeled abstractly as some multi-dimensional bin packing problem, in which there is a sequence of items and we are asked to put them into bins. The objective is to use as small number of bins as possible. For 1-dimensional packing, the items are specified by its size, and memory allocation and balancing industrial assembly line can be modeled as 1-dimension bin packing problems. For 2-dimensional packing, the items are rectangles, and VLSI placement and stocks cutting can be modeled as such problem. For 3-dimensional, the items are boxes, and the trucks loading problem can be modeled as a 3-dimensional packing problem. The bin packing problem is a well known NP complete problem, which means that it is almost impossible to have efficient algorithms to find optimal packing. Even worst, many applications are online in nature, and to solve them, an algorithm does not know the whole input when the execution starts; instead it has to read the items one by one, and needs to make the decision on how to put the ith item before it reads the (i+1)st item. Hence, we resort to look for competitive algorithms, which return provably good, but not necessary optimal, packing for every possible input. This project aims at developing general and powerful technique for the design and analysis of competitive multidimensional bin packing algorithms. The main idea is to reduce a higher dimensional packing problem to a lower dimensional one. For example, we may design a 2D packing algorithm by using a competitive 1D packing algorithm as a subroutine. Since we already have very competitive algorithms for 1D packing, our approach provides good chance for getting competitive 2D packing algorithm. We will also apply our techniques to design and analyze other variants of bin packing; in particular, we will study the bounded space bin packing and the selfish bin packing problem. 很多現實世界中的實際應用，包括VLSI佈局、多處理器調度、工業流水線負載均衡、內存分配、股票切割、貨車裝載等，都可以建模抽象為多維裝箱問題。裝箱問題是要將一個物品序列中的所有物品放置在箱子中，其目標是最小化佔用箱子的數量。在一維裝箱中，每個物品可以用一個一維長度來標識，其實際應用包括內存分配、工業流水線負載均衡，等等。在二維裝箱問題中，每個物品可以用一個矩形來表示，其實際應用包括VLSI佈局、股票切割，等等。在三維裝箱問題中，每個物品可以用一個長方體來表示，其實際應用包括貨車裝載等。 裝箱問題是一個經典的NP完全問題，除非P=NP，否則不存在有效的多項式時間算法來得到最優解。更糟糕的是，很多應用實際都是在綫問題，算法在每一步運行時，只知道當前和以往的信息，算法必須在將來信息未知時做出決策。對於這類問題，我們通過設計在綫算法來解決。在綫算法的結果可能不是最優的，但我們可以證明，對於任意的輸入，算法的結果都會有性能上的保證。 在本項目中，我們擬研究多維裝箱問題，並為其設計通用和高性能的在綫算法。本項目的主要研究方法是通過“降維”技術將高維問題轉化為低維問題來處理。比如，我們可以通過調用解決一維裝箱問題的算法來處理二維裝箱問題。由於在一維裝箱問題上，我們已經有了性能良好的算法，“降維”技術將為得到解決二維裝箱問題的高性能算法提供了極大的可能。本項目還計畫研究其他類型的裝箱問題，特別的，我們將研究有界裝箱問題和自私裝箱問題。

716412.label: Realisation of objectives
716412.value: For the first objective, we have applied the fusion technique to combine two 1-D bin packing algorithms, namely HARMONIC and super-HARMONIC to obtain a 2-D bin packing algorithm HSH, and we proved that HSH has competitive ratio 2.5545, which is the best ratio achievable by all known algorithms. We have also tried to combine other 1-D bin packing algorithms, and although some of the resulting 2-D bin packing algorithms have better empirical performance, we could not prove mathematically that they have better competitive ratios. We found that to use our analyzing techniques for HSH to analyze these algorithms, we needed to solve some non-linear programs instead of linear programs as in the case of HSH, and we did not know how to solve them. We have tried to use approximation to reduce the non-linear programs to some linear ones, and this helped us obtain some bounds on the competitive ratios; unfortunately the results could not give us competitive ratios better than 2.5545. For the second objective, we succeeded in designing an innovative online algorithm for d-dimensional bin packing for any d > 2, with the constraint that there can only be one active bin. We then proved that our algorithm has competitive ratio 4^d. Furthermore, we have adapted our algorithm to handle the special case when all the items are hypercubes, i.e., all of their sides have the same length, and we proved that for this case, the competitive ratio could be reduced to 2^(d+1). We have also obtained some non-trivial lower bound on the competitive ratio of any algorithm solving the problem. For the third objective, we succeeded in design a new online algorithm for 1-space bounded 2-D bin packing, and we managed to prove that this online algorithm has competitive ratio 5.06. We also proved that any online algorithm for the problem must have competitive ratio at least 3.17. We then focused on the problem of 1-space bounded 2-D square packing; we gave an online algorithm for this problem with competitive ratio 4.3, and then derived a lower bound of 2.94 on the ratio, We also studied the bounded-space bin packing problem with the assumption that there is a buffer of fixed size for us to store the items temporarily. We designed an interesting online algorithm for this case, and proved that it has competitive ratio 1.4243. We also proved that any online algorithm for the problem must have competitive ratio at least 1.4230; this implies that our algorithm is very near to optimal. For the last objective, we studied the selfish bin packing problem, in which each item is managed by a selfish player who just wants to minimize his own cost (instead of the total cost of the bin packing). This problem is a game-theoretic formulation of the classical bin-packing problem, and its main concern is to study packings that achieve Nash Equilibrium (NE). We proved that for any input, there always exists a NE packing with cost at most 1.69 times of that of the optimal packing (one that may not have NE). We also proved that given any packing of n items, we can always transform it into NE packing using at most n^2 steps.

716412.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
716412.value: The insights and techniques obtained in this project can be applied to other problems similar to bin packing. 716412.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
716412.value: In this project, we study a classical problem in Computer Science, namely the online bin packing problem, in which a sequence of items arrive over time, and when an item arrives, we have to put it in some bin immediately. The objective is to use as few bins as possible for packing all items in the sequence. But studying this problem, as well as many other theoretical and practical variants of the problem, we have invented several innovative techniques and powerful analytical tools. By using these techniques and tools, we succeeded in designing interesting online algorithms for these problems and proved that their performance surpass all previously known algorithms. These techniques and tools are significant not only because they enabled us to solve the bin packing problems, but they can be applied to solve other problems. In particular, we have applied them in this project to solve the Online pricing problem, and the Online bipartite matching problem and we proved that the online algorithm we have developed for these two problems have performance guarantee better than all known results. We believe that our tools and techniques are also applicable to solve other important practical problems such as the Online-Auction problem.

716612.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
716612.value: Testing is the most widely practiced activity that assures software quality. A multithreaded software application accepts an input and may execute different sequences of statements to compute an output. The huge number of possible interleaving sequences of statements for the same input makes it difficult to test the application and detect concurrency failures such as race conditions, which refer to multiple threads accessing the same memory location in an unsynchronized order, with at least one of them through a write access. Their presence often indicates serious problems. In this project, we propose a CARISMA framework to support a Context-sensitive Approach for Race-condItion test case Selection for Multithreaded software Applications. We study CARISMA in three dimensions: (a) We propose a memory-based partitioning strategy for race detection, and integrate it with code-based and time-based partitioning. Instead of treating all memory locations as equals, we classify them in terms of their execution contexts. The use of a "similarity" concept and an iterative approach allows us to significantly discard a large number of memory locations or skip the tracking of a large number of memory access operations without compromising the effectiveness of race detection. We further propose random, proportional sampling, and adaptive random test case allocation schemes for race detection. (b) We propose three context-sensitive test case selection techniques with different granularities: coarse location sampling, fine location sampling, and access sampling. Instead of counting memory accesses, we enhance the effectiveness further by counting only write operations. (c) CARISMA is designed to work with dynamic data race detection tools, most of which are either based on locksets or the happens-before relation. We construct prototypes and empirical studies to validate the feasibility of integrating our approach with various dynamic race detection tools. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first major project that comprehensively addresses the selection of test cases to detect race conditions in multithreaded software applications. Our initial finding shows that our proposed approach significantly outperforms existing sampling techniques for data race detection. 在保證軟件質量的過程中，軟件測試是最為廣泛應用的一種技術。一個多線程軟件應用接受一組輸入，並通過執行不同的語句序列來獲得相應的輸出。即使執行單一輸入，也可能產生的大量不同的語句交叉序列，使測試這樣的應用以及檢測並發錯誤變得十分困難。一類常見的並發錯誤是競態條件的出現，意思是指多個線程對同一內存地址進行不同步的訪問操作，而其中至少包括一個寫操作。出現並發錯誤往往意味著嚴重問題的存在。 我們在本項目中提出CARISMA框架來支持用於多線程軟件應用的上下文相關的針對競態條件的測試用例選擇方法。我們將對CARISMA進行三方面的研究： (a) 我們提出一種針對競態條件的基於內存的劃分策略，並將其與基於代碼和基於時間的劃分方法相集成。我們將內存地址按照它們的執行上下文進行分類，而並不是將所有內存地址視為等同。我們使用「相似度」的概念以及迭代的方法來擯除大量內存地址的檢測，或者跳過對大量內存訪問操作的跟踪，同時確保這樣的簡化沒有影響對競態條件的檢測效果。我們亦進一步提出針對檢測競態條件的隨機、按比例抽樣和自適應隨機的測試用例分配方法。 (b) 我们提出了三個不同的粒度的上下文相關的測試用例選擇技術：粗粒度內存地址採樣、細粒度內存地址採樣以及內存訪問操作採樣。我們僅計算寫操作的數量（而不是所有內存訪問操作的數量）來進一步提高這些技術的性能。 (c) 依照設計，CARISMA會與其他動態數據競爭檢測工具一起運作，而這些工具大部分是基於鎖集或「已發生」的關係。我們亦會構建一系列原形和實證研究，驗證將我們的方法與其他工具相集成的可行性。 據我們所知，本項目首次全面解決在多線程軟件應用中針對數據競爭條件的測試用例選擇的問題。初步調查結果顯示，我們所提出的方法顯著優於其他現有的數據競爭的檢測技術。

716612.label: Realisation of objectives
716612.value: EMPIRICAL STUDIES OF MULTITHREADED SOFTWARE APPLICATIONS (a) In regression testing, a tester can afford to apply one test case prioritization technique against each multithreaded component only once, even if it results in an adverse scenario. To what extent does the average effectiveness of prioritization correlate with the results in adverse scenarios? In [5, 14], we report the first empirical study on this research question through more than 300 million APFD and HMFD data points produced from 19 prioritization techniques, eight WS-BPEL benchmarks, and 1000 test cases prioritized by each technique 1000 times. (b) Mapping studies help gauge the landscape of a new research topic. However, the formulation of research questions is ad hoc. In [8], we propose a 5W+1H pattern to systematically examine a generic set of dimensions to identify the research questions. Our case study reveals that the pattern is practically useful to the discovery of systematic, generic, and complementary research questions. (c) Class attributes and values may be identified separately from various components in complex specifications using an incremental approach. In [13], we present an empirical study on the usefulness of the incremental approach through various commercial specifications and experienced software practitioners with a view to improving the effectiveness of the process. INNOVATIVE FRAMEWORKS FOR TEST CASE SELECTION (d) Dynamic detectors explore multiple executions of a multithreaded program over the same input to detect data races. Existing sampling-based detectors are ineffective for low sampling rates. In [18] we present a "context-sensitive approach to race-condition Sample-instance selection for multithreaded applications" (CARISMA) to address the problem. It estimates and distributes sampling budgets among location creation sites, and probabilistically collects a fraction of all accesses to the memory locations associated with such sites for subsequent race detection. Experimental results show that CARISMA is significantly more effective than current detectors. (e) Happened-before-based detectors for debugging multithreaded programs implement vector clocks to incrementally track the casual relations among synchronization events. In our paper in IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems [1], we observe that many such tracking comparisons and updates are removable. We implement our analysis through a technique titled LOFT. Experimental results show that LOFT identifies 63.9% of all synchronization operations as removable without any compromise of the efficiency. (f) Testing context-sensitive multi-candidate components is very difficult. We propose "preemptive regression testing" to address the challenges. For any detected change in test coverage, we preempt the current session, create a sub-session to verify the changes, and then resume the suspended session with refined test case priority. Our pioneering article [7] was selected as the spotlight paper of the September/October 2015 issue of IEEE Transactions on Services Computing. (g) A test oracle refers to the mechanism to determine whether the results of the software under test agree with the expected outcomes. The test oracle may be obscured in context-sensitive multithreaded applications. Metamorphic testing, algebraic term rewriting, and pattern classification techniques have been proposed to alleviate the problem. Our paper in ACM Computing Surveys [9] reviews the attainments of metamorphic testing and discusses the challenges yet to be addressed. Our paper in IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering [2] presents the formal criteria for real-world shortcuts in test adequacy to be the same as ideal targets in test adequacy. The innovative findings enable the shortcuts to be used without compromising service correctness. Our paper [10] proposes the use of a reference model, which is an existing program that serves the same purpose as the software under test but not necessarily implemented using the same algorithm. (h) Our paper in ACM Transactions on Autonomous and Adaptive Systems [4] defines "context diversity" to capture the extent of context changes. We report one of the largest case studies on the effectiveness of dataflow testing criteria for context-sensitive software. It shows that test cases with higher context diversity significantly enhance effectiveness. MEMORY-, CODE-, AND TIME-BASED STRATEGIES (i) Web services not only communicate in parallel by message passing but may also be context-sensitive by mutually modifying the behavior. In [3], we propose a family of test case prioritization techniques that selects pairs of test cases according to structural similarity. Empirical results show that pairwise techniques can be more effective than traditional coverage-based techniques. (j) Existing techniques that adjust CPU frequencies using dynamic voltage and frequency scaling can be classified into two categories: general and application-specific. The former ignores execution characteristics while the latter requires execution profiling. In [12], we propose non-intrusive algorithms to enhance the efficiency in regression testing without any compromise in effectiveness. (k) In [15], we propose a novel approach to formulating energy-efficient configurations. We report a multi-subject case study on the ability of the framework to determine energy-efficient configurations in three power models. The results show that we achieve up to 50% of energy savings. (l) Existing performance bug localization techniques cannot handle performance anomalies with unforeseen patterns, and cannot work well if the anomaly is fuzzy or evolves over time. In [16], we propose a novel model-based approach based on curve fitting and trend estimation. Our case study shows its success in locating three real-world performance bugs in MySQL. (m) Other memory- and specification-based strategies have been published [2, 13, 18]. See paragraphs (c), (d), and (g) above. RANDOM, PROPORTIONAL SAMPLING, AND ADAPTIVE RANDOM SCHEMES (n) Adaptive random testing algorithms make good use of the concept of even spreading and achieve 40 to 50% improvement in test effectiveness over random testing in revealing the first failure, which is close to the theoretical limit. However, efficiency is an issue. In [11], we propose an innovative divide-and-conquer approach to improve the situation. Experimental results show that the technique can provide much better efficiency while preserving effectiveness. (o) In [17], we propose a novel proportion-oriented randomized algorithm (PORA) for test case prioritization. It optimizes the distance between the prioritized test suite and a hierarchy of distributions of test input data. Experimental results show that PORA is as effective as (if not more effective than) total greedy, additional greedy, and adaptive random techniques. Moreover, the results show that PORA techniques are more stable in effectiveness. GRANULARITY LEVELS IN TEST CASE SELECTION (p) Many multi-component workflow services utilize context-sensitive XML technologies. Our paper in IEEE Transactions on Services Computing [6] proposes a subsumption hierarchy of test case prioritization techniques for these services. Selecting prioritization techniques according to the hierarchical model enhances cost-effectiveness significantly. IMPLEMENTATION OF TEST CASE SELECTION FRAMEWORKS AND COMPARISONS OF EFFECTIVENESS WITH EXISTING TECHNIQUES (q) We have implemented the frameworks and strategies in the above papers. Empirical studies have shown that they are significantly more effective than existing techniques. See the papers for details. REFERENCES The references are listed in Part C of this report. An additional reference is [18] K. Zhai, B. Xu, W.K. Chan, and T.H. Tse, "CARISMA: a context-sensitive approach to race-condition sample-instance selection for multithreaded applications", in Proceedings of the 2012 International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis (ISSTA '12), ACM, New York, NY, pp. 221-231 (2012). This paper was submitted after the GRF proposal but accepted before the funding was announced. It is, therefore, not included in the research outputs in Part C. It is highlighted in paragraph (d) of this section only because of its important research implications.

716612.label: Major findings and research outcome
716612.value: Our context-sensitive approach to test case selection for multithreaded applications received both international and local recognition. Seventeen refereed journal and conference papers were published, including six papers in ACM Surveys and IEEE/ACM Transactions. (a) We propose "preemptive regression testing" to address the challenges in testing context-sensitive multi-candidate components. For any detected change in test coverage, we preempt the current session, create a sub-session to verify the changes, and then resume the suspended session with refined test case priority. Our pioneering article [7] was selected as the spotlight paper of the September/October 2015 issue of IEEE Transactions on Services Computing. (b) Our other paper in IEEE Transactions on Services Computing [6] proposes a subsumption hierarchy of test case prioritization techniques for multi-component workflow services. Selecting prioritization techniques according to the hierarchical model enhances cost-effectiveness significantly. (c) The oracle to verify the correctness of test case execution may be obscured in context-sensitive multithreaded applications. Metamorphic testing and algebraic term rewriting have been proposed to alleviate the problem. Our paper in ACM Computing Surveys [9] reviews the attainments of metamorphic testing and discusses the challenges yet to be addressed. Our paper in IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering [2] presents the formal criteria for real-world shortcuts in test adequacy to be the same as ideal targets in test adequacy. The innovative findings enable the shortcuts to be used without compromising service correctness. (d) Happened-before-based detectors for debugging multithreaded programs implement vector clocks to incrementally track the casual relations among synchronization events. Our empirical results in IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems [1] show that 63.9% of all synchronization operations in existing approaches can be removed without any compromise of the efficiency. (e) Our paper in ACM Transactions on Autonomous and Adaptive Systems [4] defines "context diversity" to capture the extent of context changes. We report one of the largest case studies on the effectiveness of dataflow testing criteria for context-sensitive software. Prof. Tse was ranked by Arnetminer as no. 2 among international experts in the test oracle problem and no. 2 among international experts in metamorphic testing. He was invited to give a keynote speech in the 2016 IEEE International Conference on Software Quality, Reliability, and Security. A knowledge exchange project was set up to revamp the website of the Hong Kong Society for Rehabilitation using the context-sensitive and responsive approach. It was selected for a Gold Award in the Web Accessibility Recognition Scheme 2016. REFERENCES See Part Ct.

716612.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
716612.value: Prof. Tse, the original PI, retired in July 2014. He will continue to be active in research, knowledge exchange, and publications on the testing of adaptive, context-sensitive, and responsive software. In particular, a knowledge exchange project titled "Putting Brains in Muscles: Towards an Accessible Web-Based Health Education Platform on Neuromuscular Diseases" has been set up with the Hong Kong Society of Neuromuscular Diseases. It is supported in part by the Community Participation Fund of the Equal Opportunities Commission. Prof. Tse is grateful to Prof. Francis Lau for serving as the formal PI after his retirement. The excellent research outputs as well as the international and local recognition of the project would hardly be possible without Prof. Lau's kind help.

716712.label: Project Objectives
716712.value: Devise performance isolation and on-demand scaling techniques to enable a multitenant cloud-on-chip computing platform. By dynamic 2D spatial partitioning of tiles into “zones”, each of which hosts a single coherence domain, multiple applications can simultaneously run/scale in separate zones with minimal interference. Design a software cache coherence protocol tailored to non-cache-coherent tiled chips. We plan to adopt scope consistency model, home-based protocol, object-based virtual memory organization, and to leverage on-chip caches with low-latency inter-core messaging support to speed up coherence maintenance activities. The overall effect helps relieve the off-chip memory bottleneck by avoiding the heavy traffic associated with most page-based SVMs. Develop a mechanism which effectively caches shared objects on-chip and a home migration algorithm which dynamically relocates shared objects’ homes to trim/balance per-core memory consumptions while avoiding threads from losing object access affinity. Realize and evaluate the proposed ideas by system prototyping into a real CoC runtime system atop a multikernel OS.

716712.label: Realisation of objectives
716712.value: Objective 1: Dynamic Zoning of Tiles for Extensible Coherency Domains We have designed and implemented a "zone-based” power management scheme which is a feature differentiating Cloud-on-Chips (CoCs) from other HPC chips - each zone can run at their own preferred frequency/voltage via software-based power management protocols. We have modeled the problem, devised a power management protocol solution known as "Profile-based latency-aware DVFS" for realizing the zone-based power management. Our ideas and results have been published in CloudCom-Asia 2013, J. of Supercomputing (July 2015), and IEEE Systems Journal (Jan 2016). Objective 2: Tile-Oriented Home-based Scope Consistency Protocol A software shared virtual memory (SVM) system called Rhymes has been built atop the Barrelfish multikernel OS. The Rhymes SVM implements a home-based scope-consistent cache coherence protocol tailored to non-cache-coherent tiled chips with on-chip programmable buffers. We optimize Rhymes by implementing the proactive diffing and flushing techniques as per our original proposal. We further augmented the baseline system using a new idea of hybridizing the use of private memory and shared memory for improving cache locality. We evaluated the system performance on the 48-core Intel SCC. These results were published in our ICPADS 2014 paper -- “Rhymes: A Shared Virtual Memory System for Non-Coherent Tiled Many-Core Architectures”. Objective 3: Adaptive Runtime Optimizations To enable potential runtime optimization, we are enhancing the Rhymes SVM with a great performance booster --- a scratchpad module is added to boost the access speed of commonly accessed data. We extended the concept "on-chip home mirroring" to "home migration", making the technique more practical for real systems such as the case of Intel SCC. The module includes two important data structures. The first one is an on-chip directory (OCD) for locating a page cached on some on-chip programmable buffers (i.e., MPB of Intel SCC) which we would simply refer to as "scratchpads" in our system. The second one is an on-chip history (OCH) table which is stored in the scratchpads area as well. The OCD can be viewed as a software TLB-like structure that translates a virtual memory address to a scratchpad memory address, while OCH is used to keep memory access history metadata in a memory-efficient (or summarized) manner. The special point about the OCD and OCH is that they are designed with a distance-aware principle. On a mesh-based network-on-chip (NoC), visits to their entries are localized so that a core needs not travel too many hops (or tiles) on the mesh to query or modify an entry in OCD or OCH. In this way, many activities like access frequency maintenance, query of a cached page and cache replacement can all be done on a per-sector basis (a sector equals a few tiles). This helps increase the scalability of the overall system with on-chip home migration. These results were published in “Rhymes+: A Software Shared Virtual Memory System with Three Way Coherence Protocols on the Intel Single-Chip Cloud Computer” (PDCAT-2016). Objective 4: System Prototyping, Testing and Evaluation We have successfully joined Intel’s Many-core Applications Research Community (MARC) and get access to their manycore computer (i.e., Intel SCC) through Intel China Data Center of Parallel Computing (ICCPC) at Wuxi. The baseline Rhymes SVM has been built atop the 48-core Intel SCC system. As an innovation, we devise a hybrid memory model to enforce release consistency for pages allocated in shared physical memory (SPM) and scope consistency for page copies distributed in per-core private memory spaces (DSM). Our SVM system supports a per-core specific choice of page remapping. Embracing such diversity allows different memory access patterns to exploit enhanced cache effects. The memory model is implemented into a two-way cache coherence protocol which synchronizes SPM-mapped pages by partial hardware support (SCC's CL1INVMB) and synchronizes DSM-mapped pages via conventional SVM techniques. Our experimental results collected from a series of benchmarks, including Malstone and Graph 500, have proved the effectiveness of our coherence protocol. Though we have implemented the baseline Rhymes SVM on the 48-core Intel SCC, unfortunately Intel has closed their MARC Program and their support for SCC access has ended in December, 2013. Therefore, we decided to take the challenge and build a simulator by ourselves. The proposed Kilo-Sim is an event-driven simulator that is used to simulate the non-coherent tiled many-core architectures. Kilo-Sim used Gem5 to simulate the multicore tile unit and GarNet to simulate a 2D mesh interconnect to connect all tiles. To ensure the timing accuracy in the multi-threaded and distributed execution environment, we adopt a shared event queue and quantum-based synchronization method in Kilo-Sim system. Kilo-Sim supports the multi-level memory hierarchies and has integrated a programmable shared on-chip memory (PSM) component to each tile. Essentially, PSM is used to simulate the MPB in Intel SCC, which implemented a directory-based coherence MESI protocol for supporting consistent data accesses among cores within a single tile. Global cache consistency is achieved via our software-based protocol. Currently, Kilo-Sim can be used to simulate a 256-core system (16 2D-mesh connected tiles, with 16 cores per tile).

716712.label: Major findings and research outcome
716712.value: The rising core count per processor is pushing chip complexity to a level that hardware-based cache coherency protocols become too hard and costly to scale someday. We need new designs of many-core hardware and software other than traditional technologies to keep up with the ever-increasing scalability demands. Our Rhymes, tailored to the recent non-coherent many-core architectures and hybrid memory architectures, features a hybrid memory model to enforce release consistency for pages allocated in shared physical memory (SPM) and scope consistency for page copies distributed in per-core private memory spaces (DSM). It also supports page remapping on a per-core basis to boost data locality. Experimental results show that our Rhymes outperforms the pure SPM approach used by Intel’s software managed coherence (SMC) library by up to 12 times through improved cache utilization for applications with strong data reuse patterns. Moreover, the proposed zone scaling mechanism enables dynamic core grouping and isolation (i.e., “Cloud-on-Chips" (CoCs)) - each zone can run at their own preferred frequency/voltage via software-based power management protocols. It has shown that our PoweRock can significant reduce the energy and energy delay product (EDP) and achieved great improvements over a static power scheme (average: 37.1% and 25.5%; 26 best case: 64.0% and 65.4%, respectively). Overall, we have published 2 journal papers and 5 conference papers originated from this work. The PI has delivered a keynote: “When HPC meets Big Data in the Cloud”, in 2013 International Conference on Cloud Computing and Big Data (CloudCom-Asia), Fuzhou, China. (See: http://i.cs.hku.hk/~clwang/talk/2013-1217-CloudAsia-FNL-posted.pdf)

716712.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
716712.value: The team has further extended this research to work on the Fault-Tolerant support for next-generation multicore architecture. A new RGC-funded project "Software Architecture for Fault-Tolerant Multicore Computing with Hybridized Non-Volatile Memories" is ongoing (9/2015-8/2018). We assume a similar tile-based non-coherent many-core architectures with a hybrid memory hierarchy. With non-volatile main memory that always preserves data, we see new opportunities to bring some native support of fault tolerance to program execution, making data loss decoupled from power loss and transient software or hardware failures. In this project, we propose a new multicore architecture with a two-level memory hierarchy (on-chip and off-chip) containing both non-volatile SST-RAM and volatile SRAM/DRAM. We will investigate the challenges to the design of system software architectures and the associated programming model for reliable big data computing using such hybridized memory hardware.

716712.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
716712.value: Moving up to a parallelism with 1,000 cores requires a fairly radical rethinking of how to design system software. With a growing number of cores, providing hardware-level cache coherence gets increasingly complicated and costly, leading researchers to promote abandoning it if future many-core architectures are to stay inherently scalable. In this research, we address these issues and propose novel methodologies to build a scalable Cloud-on-Chip (CoC) runtime platform on the future 1000-core chip, with the ultimate goal to pack a data center onto a single chip. By our proposed zoning concept, the platform allows multitenant workloads to scale on a dynamic number of tiles of the processor, while keeping them in isolated coherence domains. Such Cloud-on-Chip concept, together with the proposed runtime support methodologies would altogether allow faster, greener and more flexible cloud usage, especially for large-scale data-intensive applications. We believe this work is among the pioneers developing new ideas and programmer-friendly tools to harness tiled architectures efficiently and productively for cloud computing, which will be, someday, geared by 1000-core chips.

717012.label: Project Title(Chinese)

717012.label: Project Objectives
717012.value: Adaptive shape representation: We will develop robust algorithms for using cyclide splines to model surfaces of general shape and topology. T-joints will be accommodated to support adaptive approximation and spherical patches will be included to represent regions around umbilical points. Surface fitting with shape preservation: We will develop an effective method that interpolates surface normals in surface fitting with cyclide splines. This scheme takes into account the normal vectors of target surfaces and therefore will produce high quality fitting surfaces in terms of improved surface fairness as well as reduced fitting errors. We will also develop a method for preserving curvature monotonicity in surface fitting. That is, when the target surface to be fitted has monotonic surface curvature, our method will generate a fitting cyclide spline that has the same monotonic curvature behavior. Shape design using cyclide splines: We will develop a subdivision scheme for creating cyclide splines to represent user-specified new shapes. We will also develop interactive editing functions that allow a user to modify the shape of a cyclide spline by editing surface features. Degree of approximation: We will study the degree of approximation of cyclide splines in the context of surface fitting. Knowing the degree of approximation helps to determine a priori the level of patch refinement needed to satisfy a specified fitting error bound in surface fitting

717012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
717012.value: 几何建模的主要目标之一是研究具有自由形状的曲面的数学表达形式，使得曲面具有实际应用中期望的某些几何性质。这些几何性质主要涉及曲面的光滑性、光顺性、曲面表达式简单（比如曲面具有较低的代数次数和参数次数），以及某些几何处理的需要（比如能够简单地计算出一个曲面的等距曲面，或者计算空间中一点到曲面的距离等）。 对于工业应用来说，已有的自由曲面的表达形式主要存在两个问题： 曲面的表达形式的代数次数都比较高； 曲面的等距曲面的计算比较复杂。针对已有曲面形式的这两个问题，我们计划研究基于四次圆纹样条曲面的自由曲面建模。 四次圆纹样条曲面由四次圆纹曲面片光滑拼接构成，具有很多优越的几何性质，非常适合几何建模的需要。 四次圆纹样条曲面是数学中的一种经典曲面，由法国数学家 Charles Dupin 在19世纪发现。在19世纪80年代，英国的Ralph Martin 首先把四次圆纹曲面引入到几何建模的领域。在之后的30多年中，出现了大量的工作研究四次圆纹曲面在几何建模中的应用问题。四次圆纹曲面之所以得到这么多的重视是因为它具有很多优越的几何性质： 比如比较低的代数次数（四次圆纹曲面的代数次数是四次甚至更低）；具有有理二次参数化形式等。更重要的是，四次圆纹样条曲面的等距面是同一类曲面，即也是四次圆纹样条曲面。然而，由于四次圆纹曲面的相对较少的自由度，过去的关于用四次圆纹曲面进行自由曲面造型的研究工作并不成功。经过一段时间的研究和尝试，研究人员普遍相信四次圆纹曲面的自由度太少，并不适合自由曲面的建模。 因此，到目前为止，四次圆纹样条曲面只限于曲面的过度拼接和管状曲面建模等简单应用。 我们的研究工作在基于四次圆纹曲面的自由曲面建模问题上取得了突破。我们的方法的关键思想是对顶点位置的释放和曲面的整体优化。我们采用一个带约束的优化框架对曲面的整体形状进行控制。在这个优化框架下，通过允许四次圆纹曲面片顶点位置的移动来克服自由度少的问题。我们的研究内容主要涉及四次圆纹曲面建模的理论基础和计算方法的研究，包括以下4个方面： 1） 高质量的曲面拟合； 2） 交互的曲面设计； 3） 曲面的逼近阶； 4） 推广到广义圆纹曲面。 该工作的研究成果将对几何建模领域产生较大的推动作用。我们的研究首次解决了光顺的自由曲面的建模问题，该曲面具有较低的代数次数，并且曲面的等距面的计算简单高效。这种曲面形式对计算机图形学、计算机辅助设计和制造，以及建筑曲面设计等领域都有重要的应用。

717012.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
717012.value: Cyclide surfaces are among the simplest curved surfaces that allow closed form offset operation, which is an important operation highly desired in surface modeling practices. However, spline surfaces consisting of cyclide surface patches, called cyclide splines, seem to have insufficient degree of freedom for representing smooth free-form surface shapes. in early 1980 Ralph Martin raised the problem of using cyclide splines to model free-form surfaces. This problem has been studied actively for about two decades in the field of CAGD, only to produce little progress, basically leading to the belief that cyclides surfaces are too inflexible to represent smooth free-form shapes. In this project we have demonstrated a novel method for computing a cyclide spline surface to represent or approximate any smooth surface, thus providing a solution to this long outstanding problem.

717112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
717112.value: 重複是大自然的一部分。我們不可能去與我們的日常生活中，在自然重複的不遵守或票面參與。實例包括表面圖案（如牆壁，地板，衣服等），幾何結構（如石頭，植物），和動態的運動（如人類行走，動物放牧）。這種重複是在文獻中通常被稱為紋理。無處不在，自然一直重複的一個重要課題的研究，為各種科學和工程學科。然而，由於自然重複的多樣性，現有方法往往具有有限的一般性，並且適用於只有特定的現象。他們也可以使用，需要深入了解所涉及的方法和正確設置其參數。 數據驅動的計算提供了機會，一般和易於使用的設計算法。為了產生特定的效果，用戶只需為例子，例如一個小的大片的圖像模式，運動領域的一小部分，或一個小的幾何元素的集合。然後，該算法將這些用戶分析範例及觀察用戶指定的整體的輸出特性，例如大小，形狀和方向的同時，合成相應的輸出，類似的詳細重複輸入。請參閱圖1的例子。 儘管成功的數據驅動的計算，現有的方法不能充分處理的一類重要的現象：含有天然重複的空間（幾何）和時間（運動）域的動態元素的紋理。一些常見的例子包括移動組/牛群，皺巴巴的衣服，和搖曳的頭髮/皮草線程。本研究的目的是解決這一具有挑戰性的問題。之前的數據驅動的方法類似，用戶應該能夠提供一個小時空的典範和某些特定領域的，和我們的算法會自動計算出所需的輸出。該項目將包括兩個核心組件組成：分析，到小規模的紋理和大規模的主題，以及合成分解的現象，涉及兩個尺度的計算小說的影響。這個項目的成果代表：（1）通過分析部分，揭示了許多動態重複的性質和（2）促進數字內容創作（如遊戲和電影）的合成部分，包括物理現實和藝術效果。 ，超越了傳統的物理模擬。

717212.label: Project Objectives
717212.value: Design a high-performance wideband optical amplifier and wavelength converter The proposed optical parametric amplifier for life-science (OPALS) is based on a one-pump optical parametric amplifier (OPA) configuration at the initial stage of the project. This helps to demonstrate the feasibility of achieving wideband optical amplification and wavelength conversion with low-noise and high-sensitivity performance over the 700-1750-nm wavelength window. Such kind of wideband wavelength conversion converts the biological signal at the shorter wavelength up to the state-of-the-art telecom wavelength window with high-speed and low-noise detection. It is useful for endoscopic applications with high detection sensitivity, without compromising the high-speed due to the ultra-fast response time of OPALS. Transform OPALS into a widely tunable laser source The dual-wavelength windows (“signal” and “idler”) realized by the oscillator configuration of OPALS can be utilized as excitation sources for those kind of nonlinear optical imaging systems. Such configuration of OPALS is expected to provide a wide tuning range (at least 150 nm) and narrow pulse width (few picoseconds) laser source at output powers required for nonlinear optical endoscopic imaging applications. Design a multi-core OPALS (MC-OPALS) for the nonlinear optical endoscopic system The wideband OPALS established in the first and second objectives of this proposal in the 700-1750-nm wavelength window can be utilized to amplify and convert the backscattered endoscopic signal to be detected by a high-speed and high-sensitivity detector in the telecom wavelength window. In addition, we will also explore OPALS in the new regime of multi-core (MC-OPALS) configuration which better matches with the conventional endoscopic launching and collecting probe.

717212.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
717212.value: The ever-growing demands of life-science and health care services and solutions call for continuous substantial advancements in various biophotonic applications, particularly in diagnostic endoscopic imaging. Telecommunications and its well-developed photonics components offer a powerful knowledge base that can be utilized in addressing the demanding requirements of these biophotonic applications, and we envision new regime via biophotonic signal processing through a novel device proposed here. In this project, we propose to develop a novel device, an optical parametric amplifier for life-science (OPALS), to provide a fundamental platform for various optical endoscopic imaging modalities, which enable functional and morphological in vivo imaging, such as optical coherence tomography (OCT), coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS), and second-harmonic generation (SHG) microscopy. Through a three-phase implementation, we will demonstrate OPALS as a core technology to meet some of the critical challenges among next-generation optical endoscopic imaging systems. Such challenges include high-speed imaging capabilities with high detection sensitivity, a versatile working wavelength window for various imaging modalities, and robustness of the system. First, we plan to demonstrate OPALS as both a wideband optical amplifier and a wavelength converter over the 700-1750 nm wavelength window, leveraging some of the state-of-the-art photonic components. It can provide a promising solution for applications that require high-speed and high detection sensitivity. Such a broad wavelength window readily benefits a large number of optical imaging systems. Second, the dual-wavelength windows ("signal" and "idler") realized by the oscillator configuration of OPALS can be utilized as excitation sources for such kind of nonlinear optical imaging systems. Finally, we also explore OPALS in the new regime of multi-core (MC-OPALS) configuration, which matches better with the conventional endoscopic launching and collecting probe. Therefore, the knowledge established so far will be consolidated as essential modules for the next-generation endoscopic imaging modalities, which leverages the optical amplification, wavelength conversion and source generation capabilities of OPALS. With these efforts, this project will impact the advancement of fundamental solutions for next-generation optical endoscopic imaging applications, in the context of versatile optical amplification, wavelength conversion and source generation, and thereby high-speed optical imaging capabilities with high detection sensitivity over various desirable wavelength windows. The wide spectrum of knowledge developed here will contribute to the research community as well as to the industry, and will also give a glimpse of the new regime of biophotonic signal processing. 生命科學以和醫療保健服務及其解決方案的需求不斷增長，要求人們能夠連續大幅度提升各種生物光子學應用的發展，特別是在內窺鏡成像診斷中。電信系統及其發達的光電子器件提供了強大的知識基礎，可以用來解決這些生物光子學應用的需求，因此，我們設想通過一種基於生物光子學信號處理的新穎的設備滿足上述需求。 在這個項目中，我們提出開發一種新的設備——用於生命科學的光參量放大器，來為各種光學內窺鏡動態成像方式提供一個基本的平台，包括光學相干層析掃描(OCT) ，相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射(CARS)，以及二次諧波產生(SHG)顯微技術。通過三個階段的實施，我們將展示使用“用於生命科學的光參量放大器”作為核心技術來滿足下一代光學內窺鏡成像系統中的一些嚴峻挑戰。這些挑戰包括：高速成像的同時保證高的檢測靈敏度，為各種成像方式提供靈活的工作波長窗口，以及系統的健壯性。首先，我們計劃證明利用一些最先進的光電子元件將"用於生命科學的光參量放大器"作為一個寬帶光放大器以及波長轉換器工作在700納米到1750納米的波長范圍。它能夠為一些需要高速率高靈敏度的應用提供一個可行的解決方案。這樣一個高範圍的波長窗口可以使大量的光學成像系統獲益。其次，基於"用於生命科學的光參量放大器"振盪系統的雙波長窗口（信號光以及閒頻光窗口）可以作為激勵源用於非線性光學成像系統中。最後，我們將探討將其用於一個多核心配置的系統中，使其更好地配合傳統的內窺鏡發射及接收探針。因此，這些利用"用於生命科學的光參量放大器"系統的光放大，波長轉換以及光源產生功能建立的知識將會成為下一代內窺鏡成像的重要模塊。 通過這些努力，這個項目會對下一代光學內窺鏡成像應用的根本解決方案產生深遠的影響，尤其是基於其在各種波長范圍的需求下靈活的光放大，波長轉換，光源產生以及高速高精度光成像能力。在這裡開發的廣泛的知識將會對研究界以及工業界都會作出突出的貢獻，並且對新興的生物光電子信號處理也將給予幫助。

717212.value: In this project, we proposed and demonstrated a novel device, an optical parametric amplifier for life-science (OPALS), to provide a fundamental platform for various optical imaging modalities, which enable functional and morphological in vivo imaging, such as optical coherence tomography (OCT), and time-stretch microscopy, particularly in addressing challenges include high-speed imaging capabilities with high detection sensitivity, a versatile working wavelength window for various imaging modalities, and robustness of the system. First, we demonstrated OPALS as both a wideband optical amplifier and a wavelength converter for applications that require high-speed and high detection sensitivity. Such a broad wavelength window readily benefits a large number of optical imaging systems (e.g. OCT). Second, the dual-wavelength windows ("signal" and "idler") realized by the oscillator configuration of OPALS can be utilized as excitation sources for such kind of nonlinear optical imaging systems (e.g. coherent Raman scattering). Finally, we also explored OPALS in the new regime of conventional endoscopic launching and collecting probe. With these efforts, this project impact the advancement of fundamental solutions for next-generation optical endoscopic imaging applications, in the context of versatile optical amplification, wavelength conversion and source generation, and thereby high-speed optical imaging capabilities with high detection sensitivity over various desirable wavelength windows. The knowledge developed here also contribute to the research community as well as the industry.

717512.label: Project Title(Chinese)
717512.value: 交通燈控制路口的行人安全研究

717512.label: Project Objectives
717512.value: To collect pedestrian exposure data To determine the relationship between pedestrian exposure and relevant factors To develop risk models for pedestrian-related crash frequency and injury severity
rows: To determine the relationship between pedestrian exposure and relevant factors
To develop risk models for pedestrian-related crash frequency and injury severity

717512.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
717512.value: In addressing the need for sustainable urban development, the expectations for knowledge and practices of transportation engineering and planning related to pedestrians have risen notably. However, pedestrians are vulnerable road users, and pedestrian injury and mortality remains a major road safety issue. In 2010, pedestrian-related crashes constituted 24% of total road crashes in Hong Kong, and pedestrians accounted for almost half of all killed and severely injured road casualties. Signalized intersections are the most probable locations of pedestrian-vehicle conflict. It is thus of paramount importance that we understand the factors that contribute to pedestrian injury and mortality risk at signalized intersections, including geometric design, signal timing plan, and crossing behavior. Rich information on traffic volume, speed, and speed dispersion are available for analyzing risk exposure in vehicle-vehicle collisions. However, there is a lack of comprehensive studies that analyze pedestrian exposure and its influence on injury and mortality risk. In the proposed study, we aim to estimate pedestrian volume and crossing time at signalized intersections in Hong Kong through extensive observation surveys. This will allow us to establish profiles of pedestrian exposure to crash and injury risk. We will also investigate pedestrian crossing behavior and propensity for violating traffic signals through observation and questionnaire surveys, in which the influences of both site-specific factors and individual-specific factors will be taken into account. The safety perceptions and views of pedestrians toward various road safety strategies will be revealed in a stated preference (SP) survey. The study will make a valuable contribution to the development of comprehensive road safety strategies for pedestrians and the improvement of sustainable pedestrian safety in the long run. 面對城市可持續發展的需要，社會對有關行人的交通工程與規劃的知識和實踐的要求顯著提高。然而，行人是相對弱勢的道路使用者，行人傷亡依然是一個重要的道路安全問題。在2010年，與行人相關的事故佔香港道路交通事故總量的24%，在全部死亡和重傷的個案中，行人更佔了接近一半。交通燈控制路口是最有可能發生人車相撞的地方之一。因此，瞭解構成行人傷亡風險的因素非常重要，包括路口的幾何設計，交通燈切換時間，以及行人過路的行為。對於車與車之間的碰撞，我們可以利用交通流量，速度和速度分佈進行風險分析。然而，目前還缺少對行人曝光率以及其對傷亡風險之影響的分析。在擬進行的研究中，我們計劃通過大量的實地觀測，對香港的交通燈控制路口的行人流量以及通過時間作出估計。這樣我們便可以得到行人曝光率的概況並評估人車碰撞和傷亡的風險。我們還將在考慮包括客觀環境因素和行人個體因素的情況下，通過觀測和問卷調查探討行人過馬路的行為和違反交通燈號的傾向。陳述偏好形式的調查將會揭示行人的安全意識和行人對一系列道路安全策略的看法。長遠來看，本研究將對完善行人道路安全策略和改善行人安全作出寶貴的貢獻。

717512.label: Realisation of objectives
717512.value: To achieve Objective (1), pedestrian movements at signalized intersections were observed to collect pedestrian exposure data using both video-capturing technique and manual count method. These procedures generated abundant pedestrian data. Pedestrian flow (counts), speed, and density were measured and analyzed. The within-day temporal distributions of the pedestrian counts at selected signalized intersections were compared with the walking trips extracted from the database of the Travel Characteristics Survey maintained by the Transport Department of the Hong Kong SAR Government. Adjustment factors were then derived to predict the temporal distributions of pedestrian movements at other signalized intersections, thus enabling the estimation of pedestrian exposure data across Hong Kong. These exposure data served as essential inputs for determining the pedestrian risk levels at signalized junctions for the analyses in Objective (3). To achieve Objective (2), the pedestrian movement patterns under different conditions were analyzed. Both macroscopic and microscopic pedestrian models to describe pedestrian movements were investigated. To study the conflicts between traffic and pedestrian movements, procedures were also developed to describe traffic movements at signalized junctions. By combining the traffic information extracted from the Base District Traffic Models and Annual Traffic Census, both of which are maintained by the Transport Department of the Hong Kong SAR Government, the annual average daily traffic volume at signalized intersections, which is an important factor affecting pedestrian-related crashes at these intersections, was estimated. Pedestrian jaywalking behavior at signalized intersections was also studied in detail. Other pedestrian-related risk factors, such as walking behavior and characteristics, geometric design elements, and signal control attributes, were also investigated. The pedestrian exposure data, together with these relevant factors, were used to develop the pedestrian crash frequency and injury severity models in Objective (3). To achieve Objective (3), for the crash frequency analyses, the effect of road network patterns was investigated. In addition, the quasi-induced exposure method for pedestrian safety at signalized junctions was studied. A model was developed to explicitly consider the effect of both pedestrian exposure and traffic volumes, together with other influencing factors, on the risk of pedestrian-involved crashes. For pedestrian injury severity in traffic crashes, a two-stage bivariate logistic-Tobit model for the pedestrian-relevant safety analysis of signalized junctions was investigated. In addition, a Bayesian spatial logit model was developed to study the severity of pedestrian injuries due to traffic crashes at signalized intersections. Road safety strategies to improve traffic and pedestrian safety were also explored.
