720012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
720012.value: To improve performance and power-efficiency of computing systems, researchers have routinely turned to the use of field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and graphic processing units (GPUs) as accelerators. Unfortunately, the techniques and engineering efforts that go into the implementations are usually so specific to a particular problem that they cannot be applied to other systems and scenarios easily without incurring major reengineering efforts. One major challenge that hinders wide-scale collaborations among researchers hinges on the lack of a consistent abstraction model that describes the interaction between the host CPU and the accelerators. Different accelerator vendors and research groups tend to create incompatible interfaces and models of the accelerators that are tightly tied to the underlying physical platform. In addition, different applications, or even different portions of an application, may demand different types of accelerators at different time. An ideal computer system should therefore be able to provide different modes of computing during run-time depending on the executing application. We propose a unified computer model that supports different accelerators as first-class entities in the machine architecture. We call this computer model MURAC, a multiple run-time architecture computer. Under the MURAC model, the processor architecture can be adapted to compute using different auxiliary architectures according to the user application during run-time. Both FPGA and GPU can thus be equivalently modeled as auxiliary architecture providers, allowing a user application to take advantage of both GPU and FPGA computing under a unified machine model. The theoretical and practical trade-offs of the MURAC model in terms of performance, user-machine interaction and operating system design in a multi-user environment will be studied. We expect that the MURAC model will incur minimum impact on the machine performance while providing a unified heterogeneous computing model that is useful to researchers in operating system, compiler as well as system designs. The unified model will enable a new paradigm in heterogeneous computing where multiple, heterogeneous accelerators may be employed to accelerate the same application, providing additional power-performance advantage over system with only one type of accelerator. 這個項目的主旨在於發展一個名為MURAC的統一的計算機模型來支持FPGA和GPU同時作加速器。跟據MURAC的運算模式，計算機可根據用戶應用程序在運行時期間使用包括FPGA和GPU不同的輔助架構。 研究的重點將會放在用戶在多用戶環境中的人機交互和操作系統設計方面的理論和實踐權衡。務求MURAC模式對計算機產生的影響降到最低。同時，也力求提供一個統一的混合計算模式，以提高操作系統，編譯器和系統設計的研究人員的效率。

720012.label: Realisation of objectives
720012.value: This project set out to explore the performance trade-offs of heterogeneous computing systems and to explore common computing model that can help bridge the gaps between the different architecture. To that end, this project has realized these original objectives through the work on multiple fronts. In the early exploratory work of accelerating k-means computing with multiple FPGAs, we have already demonstrated the benefit of FPGA computing over equivalent software solutions. When compared to a software solution in Hadoop MapReduce framework, we have demonstrated that 15.5x to 20.6x performance improvement can be achieved across a range of input datasets. This work successful laid down the ground work for our subsequent work in the following years. In order to bridge the gap in programming model between software and hardware, a series of work on FPGA overlay and OS scheduling have been developed. In the work of QuickDough, a hardware/software co-synthesis system was developed. By using a custom-designed FPGA overlay, high-level programs can be compiled to run on both the host processor as software as well as FPGA hardware design in a tightly coupled system. The key innovation in this series of work was that not only can the FPGA hardware be automatically generated within the same framework as the software, but the use of the FPGA overlay can actually generate the hardware with near-software compilation speed, i.e., within the order of seconds instead of the usual hour-long generation time. This significant reduction in compilation time, and thus the improved productivity, was an essential factor to allow successful integration between software and hardware and to allow users to explore the trade-offs involved efficiently. At the same time, when such hybrid hardware-software processes are executing in a multi-user system, new issues with respect to OS scheduling arise. To accommodate the highly asymmetric context switch times between a software process and a hardware process, new OS scheduling algorithms are needed. In that regard, this project has devoted a series of works exclusively on the issue of hardware-aware OS scheduling algorithms. Results from this series of works indicate that with proper changes incorporated to the OS scheduler, such as to avoid changing the preemption frequency of hardware processes, it is possible to allow both hardware and software processes to coexist in the same system executing on a heterogeneous fabric. On the hardware level, in order to support efficient heterogeneous computing that require high-precision floating point implementations, we have developed a series of work on multi-mode and variable precision floating point arithmetic for FPGA as well. In this line of work, we illustrate new low-level hardware architectures that are able to efficiently compute in floating-point arithmetic with variable and/or multi-mode operations. While the general purpose innovations in mixed hardware-software design at the OS and compiler level are important, we have also found that optimizing design at higher application abstraction level can bring much wider impact toward the overall system-wide partitioning and communication optimization. For that, we have engaged in 3 different projects that exploit these opportunities. In the work on GraVF, we have developed a generator framework that automatically generates computing fabric of a distributed FPGA cluster. Both the core computing architecture and the communication infrastructure, including the graph vertices partition and allocation are generated automatically with just a few lines of Python code. The idea of this work is that by expressing distributed graph computation in a unified high-level framework, the generator will be able to produce computing structures that target FPGA, CPU and/or GPU automatically. Our experiments show that our multi-FPGA system can result in much better power-efficiency for distributed graph processing when compared to a software solution executing on a CPU cluster. In another case of accelerating machine learning algorithms, we have explored the use of FPGA for accelerating the training process of a SVM image classifier. When compared to a equivalent software solution that is based on Hadoop and Spark, our design has again demonstrated superior performance and power-efficiency. This work has led to a new RGC funded GRF project on utilizing the underlying resilient distributed dataset (RDD) model of the Spark framework to further develop parallel applications on heterogeneous systems. Finally, these developments have also underpinned the third application area in accelerating machine learning and image processing algorithms for biomedical system. For this line of work, we have developed a high-speed cell image processing system that is able to interact with the high-speed imaging frontend and to perform image classification using convolutional neural network (CNN) in real time. We have also developed the algorithms to post-process these raw data into quantitative phase images for further analysis. For this backend processing, we have again demonstrated superior power efficiency of the FPGA solution, but have also illustrated the importance of GPU in producing the best design with the shortest development time. In short, although the project is subdivided into different lines of research work, overall speaking, the objectives of the projects have been adequately accomplished through the above listed of work. An overall conclusion is that heterogeneous computing is useful, and with suitable abstract computing model, particularly in the application level, it is possible for such hybrid mode of operation to be carried out efficiently and automatically.

720012.label: Major findings and research outcome
720012.value: The major findings regarding each project objectives have been mentioned in Section 5.3 above and are not repeated here. Below summarizes the major findings and their associated research outcome for this project. Reference are labeled as [cX] for conference paper number X, and [jX] for journal paper number X as listed in Part C. * Computing using heterogeneous architectures including CPU, GPU and FPGA is possible and advantageous in a number of application domains as demonstrated in this project: machine learning [c14,c15,c16], big data processing [c3], graph processing [c13,c18], image processing [c8,j4,j5]. * High-level automatic generation frameworks are able to improve usability of these systems as they hide most of the differences of the underlying heterogeneous computing fabric, while these generators are able take advantage of them [j1,j2,j3,c3,c5,c11,c12,c13,c15,c17,c18]. * A unified model for computing on heterogeneous fabric is possible, but would require innovation in the machine model and significant engineering effort to facilitate the unified model in hardware [c1,c2,c4,c9,c10]. * The use of overlay can help abstract away the heterogeneity in computing fabric while improving design productivity at the same time [c5,c9,c10].

720012.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
720012.value: * It is apparent from the results of this project that FPGA overlay is going to be extremely important in the future to support high performance and high productivity heterogeneous computing. In the future, more efficient implementation of FPGA overlay and to use them as a bridge to also compute on GPUs in a cluster system warrant further investigations. * Machine learning applications, such as the use of convolutional neural network, are seeing increasing importance across many real-world applications. Efficient implementation of these algorithms, when taking a system approach that may utilize FPGA and GPU at different processing stages, is going to be highly impactful. Future work should focus on that direction to allow edge computing platforms and backend cloud computing platforms to compute with different architecture while maintaining tight communication.

720012.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
720012.value: There are many ways to construct computers to achieve a given computing task, such as for machine learning applications, image processing applications, etc. This project explores the benefits and trade-offs in using different ways to compute (the use of FPGAs, GPUs, and CPUs) across many different applications and demonstrated that different ways of computing can benefit different applications at different time in terms of performance and power consumption. Despite the advantages of using different ways to compute, it is very difficult for a user to be able to efficiently utilize all of them. As a result, this project has also developed tools and models that facilitate the use of these different ways of computing. With these tools and models, users can now develop very complex large-scale applications with only minimal input and are mostly shielded from the complex underlying system architecture.

720112.label: Project Title(Chinese)
720112.value: 啾頻波長編碼的空間圖案結構 – 步向高分辨率, 高速, 及高敏度的光學顯微技術

720112.label: Project Objectives
720112.value: Develop high-speed programmable patterned illumination: This will be achieved by encoding the user-defined temporal pattern into the chirped-wavelength waveform using a high-speed arbitrary waveform generator (AWG) (>1–10 GS/s). This temporal pattern is later transformed into a spatial illumination pattern by a 2-D spatial disperser at a pattern refresh rate of ~100 kHz – 1 MHz. Two enabling elements are essential for achieving high-speed programmable patterned illumination in SPACE: (i) High-speed near-infrared (NIR) chirped-wavelength source – We will develop the chirped-wavelength source with the repetition rates of ~100kHz – 1MHz, widely-tunable in the NIR range (700–900 nm), a well-known and favorable window for numerous biophotonic applications [21-22]. Operating SPACE at NIR enables high-resolution microscopy in NIR without significantly sacrificing the speed. This NIR chirped-wavelength source can be realized using the wavelength-tunable-filter-based techniques developed for high-speed coherence optical tomography (OCT) [23-28]. (ii) 2-D spatial disperser – We will construct a 2-D spatial disperser that maps the encoded wavelength spectrum (by AWG) of the chirped-wavelength waveform into a 2-D patterned illumination in space [13, 29-31]. This is done without the need for mechanical scanning and with orders-or-magnitude improvement in speed compared with the current pattern-generation technologies [10]. Although SPACE still requires multiple image frames to reconstruct one high-resolution image, it can greatly alleviate the common speed-versus-resolution trade-off in patterned illumination imaging as SPACE is capable of delivering an ultrahigh pattern refresh-rate (up to MHz) in the first place. Develop the SPACE imaging system and characterize its imaging performance: Since the illumination pattern is first encoded serially in time, the 2D image information acquired in SPACE is also captured in a time-domain serial data format, which can also be optically-amplified simultaneously to enhance the detection sensitivity [12-16]. Optical amplification in the back-end imaging acquisition system of SPACE plays an important role to overcome the speed-versus-sensitivity tradeoff. In particular, two imaging modalities will be adopted for evaluating the imaging performance of SPACE: confocal reflectance [32-34] and fluorescence imaging [8-10]. Explore the potential of SPACE imaging: We will explore the possibility of utilizing SPACE in high-resolution, high-speed and high-sensitivity cellular imaging with the support from Faculty of Medicine at HKU (letters of support attached). Apart from validating the standard cellular imaging performance, we will also explore an interesting direction: imaging flow cytometry, especially for high-throughput enumeration of blood cells in flow. Most existing flow cytometers for such applications fall seriously short of imaging individual cells with sufficient throughput [35-36]. The ability to deliver high-throughput and high-resolution imaging allows SPACE to address these downsides and to greatly expand the clinical diagnostics applications of cytometry.

720112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
720112.value: 在光學顯微技術上的持續突破一直是生命科學研究及醫學應用的發展中一大重要推動力. 應用於生物醫學上的光學顯微學一向追求有效地解構生物組織及細胞當中的生理資訊的複雜性. 直至現時為止, 要達到此目標的主要挑戰是如何去發展一個同時符合三大主要標準的強大成像工具: 高速, 高分辨率,及高敏度. 一般傳統顯微技術無法在捕捉快速動態過程同時又不失去偵測的敏感度. 這主要是由於成像傳感器（即電荷耦合器（CCD）和互補式金屬氧化物半導體(CMOS)）基本上不能同時兼顧敏感度與幀率. 這速度與敏感度之間的取捨, 在任何傳統光學成像系統中都可以見到. 另外, 對於研究提高空間解像度的興趣與日俱增，正因如此近來得以開發出一系列「納米顯微」工具，成績驕人。不過, 這些納米顯微技術普遍都不能同時增加成像速度及分辨率. 這正是速度與分辨率之間的取捨. 我們的目標是基於首席研究員及其同工最近展示的全新影像程式 (其幀率和敏感度為連續實時影像的全球記錄)，開發出一種新型超高速的影像技術 – “啾頻波長編碼的空間圖案結構” (Spatial Patterning by Arbitrary Chirped-wavelength Encoding (SPACE)). SPACE能夠提供速高分辨率的影像技術, 它透過一個全新的空間圖案結構策略, 提供對比起其他高分辨率的影像技術級數上的影像速度改進. 這大大減輕了速度與分辨率之間取捨的難處. SPACE 更加採用光學影像放大技術和其他新發明，克服上述有關影像敏感度與速度之間的取捨問題. SPACE可以打開全新結合高分辨率技術與高通量生物醫學診斷的領域. 因此我們會去探索此技術於醫學診斷上之應用: 包括成像流式細胞儀. 此技術有機會以高通量拍攝個別細胞的速度（約每秒100,000個細胞）, 可以用於高通量血液學分析必須具備的功能.

720112.label: Realisation of objectives
720112.value: We have developed high-speed near-infrared (NIR) chirped-wavelength source at the repetition rates of ~100kHz – 1MHz. The source have been used for a number of high-speed imaging modalities, including time-stretch optofluidic imaging as well as MHz optical coherence tomography (OCT) (Objective 1). We have also employed the combination of diffraction grating and virtually imaged phase array (VIPA) as the 2-D spatial disperser as a key element for programmable patterned illumination - the illumination pattern is flexibly generated at high speed by spectral shaping together with wavelength-to-2D space mapping, i.e. spectral-encoding. We demonstrate imaging experiments based on a multiobjective optimization routine using a genetic algorithm to validate our optimization model as well as to show the feasibility of patterned illumination (Objective 2). We have also demonstrated the utility of the time-stretch imaging based on spectral-encoding with improved spatial resolution in a number of high-throughput flow cytometry applications, namely cancer cell imaging in microfluidic platform, as well as micro algae imaging and classification - both at an imaging throughput as high as 10,000 cells/sec (Objective 3).

720112.label: Major findings and research outcome
720112.value: The project has partially and fully supported over 20 peer-reviewed publications (including Nature publishing's Scientific Reports, and Optica), as well as over 30 international conference publications all related to high-speed and high-resolution spectrally-encoded imaging and illumination based technologies. 1 US patent application related to methods for high-resolution imaging based on spectral-encoded imaging. Specifically, we in this project have developed a new high-speed imaging technique that could greatly mitigate the limitations common in many optical microscopy/imaging modalities, i.e. speed-versus-resolution trade-off. This technique is built on the ultrafast and sensitivity imaging modality, called time-stretch or spectral encoding imaging. In the front-end illumination part, this technique adopts the idea of time-to-space conversion, for generating high-speed all-optical patterned illumination – a prerequisite for high-resolution imaging. We formulated the concept of transforming a spectrally-modulated optical chirped-pulse train into into a 2D spatial illumination pattern by a 2D spatial disperser, assembled from a diffraction grating and a virtually imaged phased array (VIPA). We developed a genetic algorithm to quantify the design objectives for robust 2D spectrally encoded pattern generation and revealed a set of efficient designs with various performance characteristics by multiobjective optimization. This makes the pattern generation rate equivalent to the repetition rate of the pulse laser source, which can scale up to tens of MHz—1000 times the rate of current techniques of patterned illumination. Note that this 2D arbitrary pattern-generation concept is applicable to any types of high-speed wavelength-swept sources. In this project, we also built the similar wavelength-swept sources tailored for high-speed multi-MHz (>10MHz) optical coherence tomography (OCT). The current all-optical and inertia-free OCT system enabled high-quality biological imaging in-vivo in both 2D and 3D. We have also applied this high-speed technique for optofluidic single-cell imaging at a throughput of up to 100,000 cells/sec while preserving the sub-cellular resolution.

720112.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
720112.value: The pattern illumination strategy can also be extended to other optical imaging modalities, especially computational single-pixel imaging (e.g. based on speckle or other user-defined patterned illumination) as well as super-resolution microscopy based on structured illumination. The uniquely fast pattern-refresh rate offered by this technique could potentially be applied to scale the imaging speed and throughput of many of these emerging computational imaging approaches, which are mostly bound to be slow.

720112.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
720112.value: We have developed new optical imaging technique which is capable of offering high-resolution imaging at a speed order-of-magnitude faster than that of the conventional high-resolution microscopy by an entirely new high-speed all-optical patterned-illumination strategy – greatly alleviating the speed-versus-resolution trade-off. It can also deliver optical image amplification and capturing the images with a single-pixel detector, eliminating the need for the CCD/CMOS imager and overcoming its speed-versus-sensitivity trade-off. This technique could open up a new paradigm translating the high-resolution imaging to high-throughput biomedical cellular diagnostics, namely imaging flow cytometry.

740012.label: Project Title(Chinese)
740012.value: 孤立语言的复杂性和简单性

740012.label: Co - Investigator(s)
740012.value: Dr Gong, Tao Dr Matthews, Stephen Dr Minett, James

740012.label: Project Objectives
740012.value: To elaborate a notion of hidden complexity in language, to complement our current understanding of overt, morphological complexity. To describe and explain features of isolating languages that involve different types of complexity, in particular: (i) zero-forms, or covert functional categories; (ii) inferential processes required in the interpretation of polyfunctional morphemes; complex syntactic-semantic patterns, such as serialization. To elaborate on the notion of structural redundancy for a number of grammatical rules typical of inflecting languages, such as agreement systems. To develop a methodology for the analysis and quantification of linguistic complexity (through empirical approaches including syntactic/ semantic analysis, EEG, computational modelling).

740012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
740012.value: Languages can have different types of grammar. In some languages almost every word consists of one single form (or morpheme), such as Chinese, where there is a transparent one-to-one mapping of word and function; in other languages words can be composed by combining several forms (or morphemes), i.e. there is a one-to-many correspondence of word and function. The former are called isolating (or analytic), and can be said to be morphologically simple; the latter are called inflected (or synthetic), and can be seen as morphologically complex. An example from Mandarin illustrates the nature of isolating morphology tā kàn shū: he read book, ‘he reads a book’. On the other hand, take an inflectional language like Italian: un mio amico: one+male my+male friend+singular+male, ‘a male friend of mine’, in which one word condenses several types of information, such as gender and number, shown in the inflection of the basic word. Within linguistic theory there is a long-standing tendency to identify languages with abundant morphology (highly inflecting) as representing a higher degree of sophistication or complexity, as well as being more mature or older. It is typically pointed out that Creole languages, which are relatively young in age, are isolating, i.e. lack inflection, and can thus be considered relatively simple. This is however debated in the growing field of linguistic complexity where scholars question whether morphological abundance can be equated to overall complexity. One must consider that many languages of the isolating type are old, e.g. Chinese, Thai etc. Are these languages to be considered ‘simpler’ or ‘younger’ than, say, Indo-European ones? Our project aims to investigate whether complexity of form necessarily entails complexity of function. Based on recent and growing evidence we suggest that we must distinguish at least two types of complexity in language: (1) overt complexity (i.e. morphological), and (2) hidden complexity i.e. functional and inferential complexity. While (1) has been relatively clearly defined and quantified in linguistics, (2) is yet poorly understood. This project aims to develop our understanding of hidden complexity and ways in which to measure it, based on the investigation of isolating languages such as Chinese and Creoles. 语言可以具有不同类型的语法。在一些语言（如中文）中，几乎每个词都由单一形式（词素）组成，词与功能的一一匹配是透明的；在其他一些语言中，词由多个形式（或词素）组合而成，词与功能的匹配是一对多的。前一类语言被称为孤立（或分析式）语言，其词态是简单的；后一类语言被称为曲折（或合成式）语言，其词态是复杂的。普通话的一个例子（如“他看书”）很好说明了孤立语言的词态特性。另一方面，以曲折语言（如意大利语）的一个例子，“Un mio amico”: 一+雄性 我的+雄性 朋友+单数+雄性,意为"我的一个男性朋友"，一个词浓缩了多种信息，如性别和数，这些信息由在基本词上添加的曲折变化来表达。 语言学理论中的一个长期趋势认为，具有丰富词态（多种曲折变化）代表了更高程度的灵活性和复杂性，这类语言通常被认为是更加成熟和历史悠久的。相对年轻的混合语则一般是孤立的，缺乏变化的，因此被认为是相对简单的。然而，在正在兴起的语言复杂性领域中，学者们质疑是否词态的丰富性等同于语言的复杂性。很多孤立语言，如中文、泰语等，都是历史悠久的，难道这些语言可被认为是比印欧语言更“简单”或“年轻”么？ 我们的项目旨在研究是否形式的复杂性充分说明功能的复杂性。基于最新的、不断增加的例子，我们主张必须区别至少两种类型的语言复杂性：（1）表面复杂性（如词态上的）和（2）隐含复杂性（如功能上和推论上的）。尽管（1）已经相对清楚的在语言学中被定义和类化，（2）还没有被充分的理解。通过分析孤立性语言，如中文和混合语，此项目旨在发展我们对隐含复杂性及其其测量方法的认识。

740612.label: Project Objectives
740612.value: Conduct a thorough analysis of media-based merger arbitrage. 740612.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
740612.value: Merger arbitrage matters because it is one of the most common investment strategies in the hedge fund industry. Despite its importance, the existing literature has largely focused on merger arbitrage strategies that are purely unconditional. By unconditional we mean that the arbitrageur always opens his stock trading position shortly after the deal's announcement. In contrast, a rational arbitrageur uses a conditional strategy. Conditional here means that depending on the information available to him, it is sometimes optimal for the arbitrageur to stay out of the stock market or to defer his entry into the stock market. This project fills this gap in the literature by considering rational merger arbitrageurs who condition their stock trading on all available information. Because arbitrageurs are betting on deal completion risk, the most relevant information for merger arbitrageurs are predictors of the likelihood of deal completion. By far the strongest such predictor is the information content of the financial media, as shown by Buehlmaier (2011). The media thus plays a key role for merger arbitrage. To investigate this role, this project studies the following questions. First, how do merger arbitrageurs incorporate existing information from the financial media into their trading strategy? For example, is it optimal to defer stock trading until further information from the media is released? When making this choice the arbitrageur faces the following tradeoff. If he defers trading, then on the one hand the arbitrageur fails to capture the initially high stock returns after the deal's announcement. On the other hand, while deferring his trading, more information is released over time and he becomes more certain about whether the deal is going to fail. This increase in certainty helps him to minimize losses. Second, merger arbitrageurs like Carl Icahn often appear in the media to voice their views and disseminate information. This information can impact the likelihood of deal completion because deal insiders and target shareholders rationally react to it when deciding on the deal's outcome. This project thus investigates how arbitrageurs disseminate information through the media to influence the likelihood of deal completion. Third, how does the information released by arbitrageurs influence the stock trading behavior of other market participants and what is the price impact of arbitrageurs' own trading? Furthermore, this project makes the empirical media measure used for merger arbitrage available on a public website, which will be useful for other researchers. 併購套利是一個重要的研究課題，因為它是對沖基金行業裏的一種最常見的投資策略。儘管它很重要，現有的文獻大多集中於純粹的無條件併購套利策略。我們所說的無條件併購套利策略，是指套利者總是在交易公告後不久，開始他的股票交易。與此相反，一個合理的套利者，會使用有條件併購套利策略。有條件在這裡是指，憑借可利用的信息。對於套利者來說，有時最好不進股市或者推遲進入股市。本研究課題填補了在文獻中的這一空白。我們研究理性的併購套利者，他們以所有可用信息為基礎來買賣股票。因為套利商賭的是交易能否完成，所以對於合併套利者最相關的信息，是對於交易完成可能性的預測。Buehlmaier（2012）發現，對這種預測最有幫助的是財經媒體所囊括的信息。媒體因而對於合併套利起著關鍵的作用。為了考察這一作用，本研究計劃研究以下幾個問題。首先，合併套利者是如何在他們的交易策略中融入從財經媒體獲取的信息？例如，推遲股票買賣，直至媒體發布進一步的信息,對他們來說是否是最優的選擇？在作出選擇的時候，套利者面臨著如下的權衡。如果他推遲交易，則一方面套利者未能夠（及時）在交易通告後獲取初始的較高的股票收益。另一方面，由於推遲了交易，隨著時間的推移更多的信息被發表，套利者對於該交易是否能夠成交，變得更加有把握。這種更大的把握有助於套利者減少損失。第二，合併套利者例如卡爾•伊坎（Carl Icahn），經常出現在媒體上表達自己的觀點和傳播資訊。這些資訊可以影響交易完成的可能性，因為跟交易相關的內部人士和目標公司（被並購公司）的股東會理性地對此作出反應，來決定交易的結果。因此，本研究計劃研究，套利者如何通過媒體傳播信息，來影響交易完成的可能性。第三，套利者發布的信息如何影響其他市場參與者的股票交易行為？套利者自己的股票交易對股票價格有什麽影響？此外，本課題將測量併購套利的媒體數據放於一個公共網站上。這將有助於其他研究人員。

740612.label: Realisation of objectives
740612.value: All objectives have been achieved. We analyzed media-based merger arbitrage thoroughly, investigating how the financial press and media influence merger arbitrage returns. We found that the financial media does affect arbitrage returns, especially if the financial press is measured using media content instead of media coverage. In addition to analyzing firm characteristics, deal characteristics, and stock price data, we investigated the link between merger arbitrage and textual media content. We found that even when controlling for other characteristics, the financial media variable is not subsumed and instead provides additional explanatory power. This holds both in the cross-section as well as in time series tests. We also studied the merger arbitrageur's investment strategy, using the financial media as a conditioning variable. A simple trading strategy using textual information from the financial press increases risk-adjusted returns by more than twelve percentage points per year.

740612.label: Major findings and research outcome
740612.value: Our major finding is that financial markets can be slow to incorporate novel information. This result has important implications for market efficiency. Specifically, we find that markets need not several minutes or hours, but even several days to fully absorb the information from textual media content. This is important, given that financial markets have effects on the real economy and that financial markets are important for economic growth and development.

740612.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
740612.value: We believe that our research, which uses textual analysis of press articles, contributes to the growing literature involving information extracted from textual content. This literature is fast-growing, which novel results published in top journals on a frequent basis. While it is not easy to find such strong market inefficiencies as we have found, it is fully convincing to assume that further development of research using textual analysis of press articles or other sources of textual data, e.g. company filings, will have a broad impact with far-reaching implications for financial research. Our proposed course of action is to further investigate these important questions.

740612.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
740612.value: Our research is significant and has value because it sheds new light on a concept that was previously thought to be well-understood. Specifically, the concept of market efficiency means that markets reflect all publicly available information, and importantly, markets do so immediately. We find novel evidence contradicting this notion, because the information we quantify is only absorbed very slowly into asset prices, instead of being absorbed quickly, as it would be in a fully efficient market. These findings have broad implications for the real economy, economic growth and development, because it is well-understood that these important topics are influenced by how well financial markets work, including their efficiency.

740712.label: Project Title(Chinese)
740712.value: 中國在非洲的私人商業拓展: 溫州商業特區在尼日利亞

740712.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
740712.value: China has dramatically intensified its economic engagement with Africa since the turn of the new century. A broad multidisciplinary literature has addressed China’s state-led extractive investment projects in resource-rich African countries. However, less scholarly attention has been paid to diasporic Chinese communities in Africa and their relationship to the Chinese state. This proposed research investigates the dynamics of the Chinese private commercial presence in Africa by focusing on the Wenzhou trade diaspora in Nigeria--Africa’s most populous consumer market and leading oil producer. Wenzhou merchants, known as aggressive, speculative entrepreneurs back home and in large parts of Europe and the Middle East, have a rising presence in African businesses. Their small and medium-scale trading activities in Nigeria have been increasingly encouraged and driven by the Chinese state in the context of implementing the national development strategy of “going out to the world.” By examining Wenzhou merchants’ business operations in Nigeria, this project seeks to study the intertwined relationship between a household-based market economy and a state-led model of capitalist development and how this relationship unfolds in the current context of China’s rise in Africa. It will also explore the diasporic contexts in which these merchants combine commitments to native community, the Chinese nation-state and transnational commercial activity. To collect data for this research, I shall rely mainly on ethnographic interviews, participant observation, and analysis of secondary data. The diasporic experiences of these mobile Wenzhou merchants will illuminate emerging patterns of Chinese private entrepreneurship and state-business relations in a globalized world. 在新世紀一頁翻開之際，中國顯著地加強了對非洲的經濟拓展，廣泛、跨學科的前人研究針對以中國政府為主導，投資資源豐富的非洲國家的項目已有所着墨，可是中國移民在非洲的社區和他們跟中國政府之間的關係卻鮮有學者關注，本研究計劃旨在探討中國人在非洲的私人商業拓展，並致力研究在尼日利亞(非洲人口最稠密的消費市場和最主要的石油生產地) 的溫州商業特區。溫洲商人被認為積極、投機，他們的存在在許多歐洲及中東的非洲企業正日益擴大着，溫州商人在尼日利亞的中小型商貿活動愈發受中國政府的國家發展策略「走出去」所鼓勵及驅動。通過研究溫州商人在尼日利亞的商業運作，本項目探索家庭市場經濟與國家主導的資本主義發展之間的交織關係，及這種關係放諸中國在非洲的崛起的背景中將如何呈現。本研究還會探討這些商人在移民情境之下如何結合對當地社區的應許及中國國有及跨國商業活動。筆者主要透過民族志訪談、參與觀察及分析二手研究搜集研究資料，這群流動的溫洲商人的移民經驗將為中國私人商業拓展與國家商業關係，在全球化的世界中點亮一種新興模式。

740812.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
740812.value: Assessment in higher education is central to the student learning experience because it deeply affects what and how they study. Improvements in assessment are, however, hard to achieve or sustain because of the compromises inherent in a process that needs simultaneously to judge, certify and stimulate productive learning This project will collect data from the classes of selected award-winning teachers at The University of Hong Kong to investigate empirically a previously proposed (Carless, 2007) and recently reworked (Carless, 2011a) draft learning-oriented assessment framework. Learning-oriented assessment seeks to focus all assessment, both formative and summative in orientation, on the development of productive student learning. The framework involves three interlocking elements: assessment task design; participative assessment through engagement with standards and criteria; and dialogic feedback (from peers, self and teachers). The research strategy involves theorizing from qualitative case studies of four award-winning teachers in different disciplines. Well-designed case studies are particularly suitable for providing the in-depth understanding which underpins theoretical development. Research methods used for the study are classroom observations to probe how classroom activities relate to the proposed learning-oriented assessment framework; interviews with teachers to analyze their understandings of relevant issues; and interviews with students. Inductive analysis is used to generate theoretical insights from the data. The project will contribute to the theory and practice of assessment in terms of the relationship between assessment and student learning; and how its inevitable tensions are managed. The research is timely because ongoing attempts to renew the undergraduate curriculum, as part of the shift to four-year programs, have shown that curriculum reform is hampered unless it is aligned with congruent renewal of assessment. It will also inform assessment policy within the University and beyond. The intended outcomes of the project are: 1. theorizing about assessment through the verification, modification or extension of the proposed learning-oriented assessment framework; 2. a set of practice-oriented principles for effective assessment derived from the analysis of assessment-related pedagogy in the cases; 3. an analysis of the tensions arising in handling the multiple functions and purposes of assessment; 4. an in-depth understanding of how students are responding to the teaching, learning and assessment in the cases under discussion; 5. recommendations for policy arising from the analysis. 在大學，評估佔據學生的學習體驗的核心位置，它對學生怎麽學和學什麽有着深刻影響。然而，由於評估需要同時兼顧評價，證明以及促進有效學習的功能，而評估的過程中這些因素不得不相互折中與妥協，這就造成了評估手段的改進和優化難以實行或保持。 本研究項目將從數位香港大學杰出教學獎獲得者的課堂收集數據，以實證研究來探索和完善促學性評估框架。這個框架最早由Carless在2007年提出，并在2011年得到更新完善。促學性評估不再局限於區分形成性評估或者總結性評估，而意在通過各種評估手段來激發有效的學習成果。這個框架包含緊密聯繫的三要素：評估任務的設計；參與性評估（調動學生一齊參與討論，制定和修改評估標準）；以及（來自同伴，自己或者老師的） 互動式反饋。 本研究通過對四位不同專業的獲獎教師採取定性的個案研究，來建立理論框架。設計精良的案例研究特别適合爲理論的發展提供深度的認識。將用到的研究方法有1）課堂觀察，通過觀摩課堂來找尋課堂活動同促學性評估的關聯；2）採訪，通過對老師與學生的訪談來瞭解他們對相關問題的看法。本研究將採用歸納分析法從研究數據中構建理論。 這個項目將對評估與學習的關係以及如何處理好它們之間必然的衝突做出理論與實踐兩方面的貢獻。本研究正好趕上香港大學向四年的本科學制轉換，轉換過程中的種種課程改革嘗試都顯示如果没有配套的評估方法的改進，課程改革將不能順利進行。因此，本研究旨在爲香港大學以及其他大學的評估政策提供更多建設性意見。 本項目希望達到的成果有： 1. 通過論證，修改以及拓展初期的促學性評估理論框架來建立更加完善的理論模塊。 2. 通過對案例中與評估相關的教學活動的分析與研究，以此總結出一套關於怎樣實施有效評估的實踐準則。 3. 對評估過程中不同的評估功能與目的之間產生的衝突進行分析。 4. 深入瞭解案例中的學生如何看待教學，學習與評估。 5. 爲政策的制定提出建設性的意見。

740812.label: Realisation of objectives
740812.value: The objectives are well-achieved. In relation to objective 1, the revised learning-oriented assessment framework appears in an article in the journal Higher Education (Carless, 2015a), pg. 965. The revised framework drops the notion of participative assessment which may be hard to interpret and focuses more clearly on the need for students to develop evaluative expertise so that they can more effectively self-monitor their own work in progress. The revised framework also emphasizes student engagement with feedback rather than dialogic feedback in that it is what students do with feedback which is more central to its use. The attainment of objective 2 is documented in some detail in section 6.1 of this report. In relation to objective 3, the research has also shed further light on the tensions between assessment for grading; assessment for learning; and assessment for certification. It was striking that the award-winning teachers in the study tended to prioritize assessment for learning over the other two elements because student learning was most prominent in their hearts. Objective 4 is also well-achieved. As part of the research 90 individual interviews were carried out with 54 students with some of them being interviewed more than once. Students expressed support for assessment tasks which related to real-life uses of the discipline; and provided some flexibility or choice so that they could tailor assessment to their own needs and preferences. They found rubrics in the form of lists of criteria to be vague and abstract. Instead they believed that the analysis of exemplars (samples of previous student work) was helpful in clarifying expectations and indicating what quality work looked like. In relation to feedback, they most favored timely comments which they could act on while the course was still in progress, whereas end-of-semester comments were seldom useful for that purpose. Objective 5 is partially achieved. This objective relates to the research but was not the most immediate concrete focus making it hard to achieve more comprehensively. A policy implication of the study is to focus all assessment on the development of student learning. A major policy recommendation arising from the study is the need for higher levels of assessment literacy and feedback literacy amongst teachers. These are, however, difficult to develop due to the competing demands of academic life. Promising strategies include links to institutional quality enhancement and the development of communities of practice.

740812.label: Major findings and research outcome
740812.value: The main findings and research outcomes are published in a journal article in a high impact journal (Carless, 2015a) and in fuller form in a book published by Routledge (Carless, 2015b). The detailed nature and richness of the case studies suit the more extended exposition in book form. The following summarizes the key findings and research outcomes. A primary aim of assessment should be to resolve competing priorities by focusing on the promotion of student learning. Assessment should be rigorous but not cowed by quality assurance, and use resources wisely so that it is not excessively time-consuming. Quality assessment encourages deep approaches to learning in which students develop new meanings rather than just reproduce knowledge with a goal of achieving higher order learning outcomes. These may emanate from sustained engagement with tasks which mirror real-life applications of the discipline. Well-designed assessment permits flexibility and student choice so that students can engage with topics and issues which they find important and stimulating. Integrated and coherent assessment tasks progressively build capacity to achieve complex learning outcomes. Good assessment practices encourage dialogues between learners themselves and with their teachers. Teachers need to engineer student engagement with criteria so as to develop their evaluative expertise and understanding of quality in the discipline. The analysis of samples in the form of exemplars is one of the most effective ways of enhancing student capacities to engage with criteria and quality work. Feedback needs to engage with students, their needs and interests. Its goal is to support students in enhancing their capacities to self-regulate their own learning. Guidance and dialogue during the process of working on assignments are often more useful than end-loaded unidirectional comments. The integration of task design, student development of evaluative expertise and engagement with feedback is at the heart of good learning-oriented assessment.

740812.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
740812.value: The research examined three integrated aspects: assessment task design; the development of student evaluative expertise; and student engagement with feedback. Worthwhile and significant findings were generated in all of these three areas with probably a major area of significance being the framing of assessment task design. Obviously when three areas are investigated, there are tensions between breadth and depth so follow-up could be done by exploring one of the areas in more depth. Feedback is critical for student learning and the research provided some evidence of worthwhile feedback practices and students’ related perceptions. There is potential for further development of research in relation to feedback. As a follow up, I have proposed in GRF 2015-16 a study entitled ‘Theorizing how teachers in higher education manage feedback processes’. The aim of this study is mainly threefold: to understand how university teachers in different disciplines manage feedback processes; to interrogate existing theorizations of feedback; and to generate a process theory explaining how teachers manage feedback. It is intended to investigate similar disciplines in this next research project to those explored in the current research. The disciplinary understandings generated by the current project provide insightful grounding for the next project.

740812.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
740812.value: An assumption underpinning the project was that university teachers who had won awards for excellence might be using assessment strategies which are worthy of analysis and dissemination. The research identified a number of significant principles of assessment design amongst these teachers which were analyzed in relation to existing literature. Key aspects included: assessment tasks which mirror real-life uses of the discipline; assessments which engage students in meaningful engagement over time (rather than being one-off such as an examination); enabling students to engage in feedback dialogues with peers or teachers; and forming part of a coherent and integrated whole so that sub-skills were revisited and extended. The research also provides evidence of how assessment serves multiple functions: assessment for learning; for certification; and for accountability. Tensions between these three functions were mainly addressed by the award-winning teachers in terms of emphasizing student learning over the other two elements. Finally, assessment needs to be implemented in an integrated and coherent manner. Students need rich assessment tasks which develop worthwhile learning outcomes; they need activities which develop a sense of what quality work looks like; and they need feedback which supports them in refining their own judgments of their work in progress.

740912.label: Project Title(Chinese)
740912.value: 廣東十三行時代︰英國人在鴉片戰爭前的中國

740912.label: Project Objectives
740912.value: To question the conventional image of this period as a historical episode that should be understood mainly in terms of the Opium War, and challenge the notion that eighty years (1759-1839) of contact between Britain and China can be understood primarily through the Opium War (1839-42) and the immediate years leading up to it. To examine how members of a rapidly expanding British Empire tried to understand another empire, the Qing, which had ruled China since 1644, and show how problems such as determining the size of China's population were often part of a much larger attempt to attain a "true" knowledge of China. To document the ways in which Britons in Canton reconciled their preexisting conceptions of China with the local knowledge they acquired in Canton, and how Canton became a place for confirming or refuting these conceptions. To illustrate how Canton provided opportunities for the kind of deep observation that were unavailable elsewhere in China, such as witnessing medical practices, religious rites, and the consumption and physiological effects of opium, as well as the conniving and corruption associated with the contraband opium trade. To demonstrate how the conventional practice of seeing the end of the Canton System as a watershed in Chinese history, British imperial history, and the history of Sino-British relations overlooks the many commercial, social, and cultural continuities which endured well beyond the Treaty of Nanking (Nanjing) of 1842.

740912.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
740912.value: This research project aims to expand our understanding of the first sustained encounter between Britain and China: the Canton Trade period. From 1759 to 1842, trade between China and the West was confined under the Canton System to a small area within the city of Canton (Guangzhou). This system was abolished in 1842 under the Treaty of Nanking (Nanjing), which ended the Opium War (1839-42) and opened five Chinese ports to foreign trade and residence. Despite its importance, the Canton period remains one of the least studied parts of modern Chinese history and British imperial history. The teleology of the Opium War has made this era primarily one of conflict and culture clash. Most scholarship has focused on how the system fell apart in the 1830s as disputes over free trade, diplomatic recognition, and, above all, the rapid expansion of the opium trade led to war between Britain and China in 1839. My project examines how Britons, who by the late 1700s constituted the overwhelming majority of the foreigners in Canton, tried to make sense of China, its people, and its civilization through the narrow lens of Canton, and to cope with the restrictions of the Canton System. Primarily missionaries and merchants, these men (Western women were barred from entering China until after the Treaty of Nanking) produced a massive archive of letters, papers, and records. They wrote at length about a China that could simultaneously frustrate, confound, intrigue, and mystify. Their diverse experiences in China, before the Treaty of Nanking and the subsequent "unequal treaties," will help us question and challenge conventional notions of imperialism and "informal empire." The findings from this research project will be published as a scholarly monograph aimed at both academic and popular audiences and two articles in high-impact journals. My approach and methodology will engage theoretical advances in many disciplines that have begun to investigate encounters between empires, peoples, and cultures, not only as sites of conflict and tension but also as multifaceted processes of accommodation and adaptation, engagement, and curiosity. In doing so, my findings will advance our understanding of this great encounter between Britain and China, providing a more complete picture of the Western presence in China. This project will also add an important historical and geographical dimension to our knowledge of encounter. It may even help us better understand cultural relations between China and the West today. 本研究計劃的目標在於擴闊我們對中英首次持久遭遇——廣東十三行時代——的認識。由1759年至1842年為止，中外貿易被置於廣東十三行制度的限制下，只能局促在廣州城的一隅進行。這種制度最終在1842年，於宣告鴉片戰爭(1839年-42年)結束、開放五口通商口岸的《南京條約》中被廢除。 雖然廣東十三行時代甚為重要，但它仍然是現代中國史和英國帝國史中其中一個缺少研究的範圍。對於鴉片戰爭的定性論述，將這時代單純理解為衝突和文化碰撞。大部分的學界研究集中於分析該制度在十九世紀三十年代瓦解的情況、對自由貿易的爭論、外交承認的問題，以及鴉片貿易的高速膨脹如何導致中英兩國在1839年發生戰爭上。 我的研究計劃將會審視，作為在十八世紀晚期廣州主要的外藉人士，英國人如何以廣州作為狹窄的視角，嘗試去了解中國、中國人和其文明，以及應付廣東十三行制度所帶來的局限。在廣州，主要是男性傳教士和商人 (在《南京條約》簽訂前，西方女性被清廷禁止進入中國)，他們撰寫大量的書信、報紙和紀錄，詳細記述「中國」如何同時為西方人士帶來挫敗、困惑、好奇和神秘等感受。在《南京條約》和其後「不平等平約》簽訂前，以上人士在中國的親身經驗，將有助我們對現時帝國主義和「非正式帝國」的話語，提出詰問和挑戰。 本計劃的研究成果，將會出版一本以學者和大眾為對象的學術專著，以及兩篇刊登於高影響力期刊的文章。我的研究路徑和方法，在於應用近期不同學科對於帝國、人群、文化遭遇的理論進路。因此，本研究不單將這種遭遇作為衝突與緊張局勢的場所來研究，而且將之作為適應、調節、交往和好奇等多方面的過程來審視。通過以上的研究方法，我的研究發現將會增加我們對於中英兩國這種大規模遭遇的認識，以及提供一幅更全面的畫面，反映當時西方在中國的存在。此外，本計劃亦為我們對遭遇的認識，增加一種重要的歷史和地理學視角。最終，本研究將有助我們更好理解現今中西文化的交流關係。

740912.label: Realisation of objectives
740912.value: The original objectives (and, as with any good project, many more added along the way as I conducted my research) have been achieved. Thanks to the generous funding from this grant, I was able to conduct research in five British archives: the National Archives at Kew; the British Library, School of Oriental and African Studies (SOAS) Library, and Wellcome Library in London; and the Jardine Matheson Archive at the University of Cambridge. Presenting the same findings to very different scholarly communities (as I did with the subject of British mortality in South China at the Association of Asian Studies annual meeting (the most important conference in the field of Asian studies) and at the Britain and the World conference) enabled me to obtain invaluable feedback from scholars working in diverse fields. My only regret is that although I have already published three articles and written ten book chapters of around 15,000 words each, two more chapters still need work. Rather than apply for a full sabbatical leave during the period of research, I opted to take teaching relief but remain as postgraduate coordinator in my department during the first part and then become associate dean in my faculty. (Currently I am both postgraduate coordinator and associate dean.) With hindsight, I should have taken a full sabbatical to work on my book. I should also have requested a full-year extension rather than only six months, but I did not need to make any more research trips and preferred to return the remaining funding.

740912.label: Major findings and research outcome
740912.value: Some findings have already been presented in conference papers listed in Section 9, all of which have become chapters. Others have been presented in articles listed in Section 8, in volumes with contributions from some of the most prominent scholars in Chinese and British imperial history, including Robert Bickers, Hans van de Ven, David Arnold, Philippa Levine, and Sir Christopher Bayly. • As a "contact zone" between East and West, Canton was as much a site of accommodation and adaptation as of conflict and cultural clash. Studying this period chiefly through the lens of the Opium War, as so many scholars have, overlooks its complexities and contradictions. • Although this encounter is known best for resulting in war, it also generated a massive corpus of writings. Frustrated with the restrictions on trade, these Britons devoted thousands of pages in journals, memoirs, and books trying to understand China, its people, and their culture. They discussed almost everything they saw, and speculated about much of what they could not see. Indeed, it is no exaggeration to say that this period saw the birth of Western ethnography of China. • The conventional emphasis on the two leaders of the Britons in China, William Jardine and James Matheson, overlooks the diversity of this tiny community. This is a story not only of trade but also of personalities and eccentricities, including merchants and missionaries, naturalists and botanists, inventors and tinkerers, and rogues and swindlers. • Although by the 1830s several hundred foreigners in Canton were restricted to a tiny enclave no larger than the size of a football field, this confinement created a sense of cohesion not found in other British communities overseas. Despite the disagreements about how to respond to the restrictions of the Canton System, the Canton Britons were a close-knit and structured community. • Especially by the 1830s, Britons in China complained mightily about the "crying abuses" of the Canton System. However, there was never any one solution for how these restrictions might be ended, let alone a unified call for war with China. • Likewise, even on the eve of the Opium War, the Canton Britons disagreed on the opium trade. Many British traders agreed that the Qing government had every right to prohibit this trade, some were convinced that the Chinese themselves had caused the demand for opium, while others argued that the opium trade threatened Britain's legitimate trade with China.

740912.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
740912.value: Thanks to this grant, I have been able to collect sufficient research materials on the Canton Trade period and on the British in China during this time to write at least one more book and several articles. (One article, on the Amherst embassy of 1816-17, is in preparation and will be submitted to a top-tier journal such as Past & Present or the Journal of Imperial and Commonwealth History.) I have also recently been invited to contribute a chapter on trade and the origins of British sinology for the forthcoming Oxford Handbook of the China Trade. Furthermore, I hope to edit a documents reader on this topic and have already discussed this with several publishers. In the meantime I have begun another research project, on the history of tourism in post-WWII Hong Kong. I have recently been awarded seed funding for this project and will submit an application for RGC funding in the 2017 round.

741012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
741012.value: The late Qing international law and relations history is the key to an understanding of the trouble spots of East and South East Asia and a framework within which to guess at how the present PRC will deal with them. The hot spots are the Korean mainland, Dokdo/Takeshima, Senkkaku/Daoiyu, Okinawa/the Riyuku Kingdom, Taiwan, the South China Sea Islands and the North Eastern Indian Frontier/the MacMahon Line. This was the Chinese Empire’s system of Vassel States or actual territory (Taiwan, the South China Seas Islands and the Tibet Frontier). Its replacement by the Westphalia nation-state system brought with it the Western colonialism. Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam were annexed or put under protectorate.UK annexed Burma and left an undetermined North Eastern Frontier to India. The Chinese relationship to the South China Seas was destabilized in the late 19th century and remains so. The project will study, as international legal history, the process whereby the Chinese imperial system was broken up. The USA did not leave in place after 1945, a complete alternative international legal order, a feature of PRC and USA relations now. The project will trace in Western (mainly UK) as well as official Qing sources the all the major conflicts with the West and Japan from 1839 till 1912. It will trace the attitudes of Qing officials in terms of their growing awareness of the nature of Western international law and the comparisons they make of it with their own traditional concept of Confucian order and justice. It will consider the reactions of the wider Chinese intelligentsia about the nature of this international law and its relationship to Chinese civilization in terms of classical Chinese civilization versus Western modernity. It will not go beyond the collapse of the Qing Dynasty, e.g. to Mongolian independence in the 1920s. The hypothesis of this research is that the Chinese then evolved the idea that international law has no autonomous cultural or ethical pull, but rests upon a balance of strength, which consequently obliges China to strengthen itself industrially and technologically, before it makes any appeal to international law. Hence the dominant intellectual heritage of Qing China to the present is a “realist” attitude to the role of law, priority to self-strengthening and, while international law will be used prudently within limits, many Chinese still prefer the model of Confucian virtue among its leaders, exercised from an independently acquired position of strength.

741012.label: Realisation of objectives
741012.value: Brief Overview Objectives 1-4 have substantially been completed, the result being the Carty & Nijman book by Oxford. There has been genuine progress in respect of the fifth objective, concerning how the results under the first four objectives may yet exert an influence on present-day events. The last objective was helped by an extension of one year following the original Principal (now Co-) Investigator’s retirement and entry of the new Principal Investigator. The new PI specializes in China’s effort to integrate into the global economic order and a new focus on contemporary economic treaty relations became a crucial supplement. China’s current initiatives present a fast moving picture, not only in respect of the Belt and Road Initiative (the BRI) but also in relation to the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) negotiations, and the proposals for a Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific (FTAAP) and a multilateral investment treaty. Although there was an expansion into the economic aspects we did not consider this to be an additional objective because the economic aspects too have a political and diplomatic dimension. Objectives 1 to 4 The premise of the original proposal in 2012 was that late Qing international law and relations history is key to understanding the trouble spots of East and South East Asia, and provides a framework within which to guess at how the present PRC will deal with these trouble spots. The methodology proposed involved archival work as well as an evaluation of how international law was thought of flowing from events in the late Qing period, and how that may have a present impact. Briefly, this study sought to confirm that China adopted a realist approach in international relations following the late Qing engagement with Western imperial international law. Considering the history of China's experience of that law in the 19th century Sino-French and Sino Japanese Wars, Chinese thinkers and officials had begun with a belief, encouraged by US missionaries, that international law was a form of natural law akin to Confucianism but gradually came to believe that the balance of power governed world society and international law worked only among those equal in strength. Moreover, following the Second World War, no Western order through a multilateral peace treaty based upon the sovereign equality of states was properly established in East Asia. This incomplete order leaves important questions about China’s future international law positions in East Asia, especially in connection with Chinese territorial disputes. If the dominant intellectual heritage of Qing China to the present is “realism”, and priority is given to the self-strengthening of China, then international law will be used prudently within limits, exercised from an independently acquired position of strength. However, questions remain about the old Confucian worldview that was so disrupted. It is also safe to say that the Chinese do not consider any of the diplomatic/international law events of the late Qing as absolutely just or settled. These events have simply happened because of a balance of forces. International law is not to be discounted, but a measuring of its actual importance continues to be a matter of judgment as to the real relationship between three elements - the balance of power, international law and guidance from traditional Chinese culture. This study had culminated, in the Summer of 2015, in a workshop which mainly covered 1870s – 1890s East Asia, focussing on the Sino-Japanese and Sino-French relationships in the areas of politics, diplomacy, sovereignty and jurisprudence. Scholars from the United States, the Netherlands, and Germany were invited to evaluate the achievements of this project with positive results. That workshop is now captured in the coming Oxford book. The Fifth Objective But how does all this sit with a broader and deeper appraisal of China today? Particularly with China’s international economic relationships and economic treaty arrangements, as well as the range of choices China faces in the WTO, in the sphere of regional trade arrangements, in China's investment treaty policy, in the field of international financial institutions and in the developmental field? After all, the main weight of China's recent strategy for relating to and integrating with the world currently relies upon economic development cooperation and even integration – trade, investment and financial - with important implications for how China perceives itself. There were other subsidiary concerns and left-over puzzles. What we had ended up with in 2015 was a realistic view that international law was simply not fairly applied to China at the time and cannot be expected to be applied fairly now. This argument is represented most strongly in the theses of Zhang Xiaoshi and Xu Bijun. An alternative view, however, is that international law was applied at the time of the late nineteenth century in the terms in which it was understood at that time. Times have changed and international law has changed with it. Therefore there is little point in blaming the West or what it did in the nineteenth century by the standards of the twenty-first century. Therefore this history would itself have little significance or interest. Significantly, this view is not held in China where the whole subject is connected with the Chinese concern about its “Century of Humiliation”, also especially in relation to Japan. In legal terms, a first issue is whether there is a doctrine of unequal treaties, starting in the nineteenth century and continuing today. Secondly, was it the case that “unjust war” was an unknown concept in the nineteenth century, and therefore the justice or injustice of the use of force at that time does not continue to have any legal interest? Zhang and Xu argue to the contrary. The EU and the US position on China’s market economy status in the WTO is similarly problematic today, as is the US position concerning the South China Sea. The Research cannot resolve such present controversies but it does help to put them in a longer perspective. These controversies drove the international conference held at HKU in September 2016, which was the principal aim of the one-year extension granted in 2015 following the compulsory retirement of the original PI which had been disruptive. In 2016, we were in a position again to explore what, at bottom, is a tension between a “backward-looking” and a “forward-looking” focus. We can summarise the issues thus. Should China concentrate strongly on its past and look for apology or recompense? Can international law envisage or conceive of such an approach? Or should China “forget the past”, treat it as relatively insignificant compared to the possibilities it enjoys, especially economically, in the present world? Should China not recognize that the West accepts it into the international economic and financial system? How does China see itself now in 2016 compared to 1906? So doubt lingers. It is easy to caricature our own position as a tension between the forward and backward-looking aspects but the PRC now also emerges as an inheritor and proponent of globalization. Much of the past continues still to be invoked while the separation of law, diplomacy and economics seems artificial. We are at 80% in terms of realising the fifth objective as originally conceived. This is because the size and enormity of the work needed to address that objective changes and grows with fast-moving events.

741012.label: Major findings and research outcome
741012.value: For Objectives 1-4, and to an extent objective 5 as well, the principal outcome – aside from the conferences detailed in this report - is the Carty and Nijman book, Morality and the Responsibility of Rulers, in Press, November/December 2017. Part I includes texts by Anthony Pagden, Joseph Canning, Susan Kerr, John Witte on Renaissance European Legal Thought, etc. Part II and Part III of the book are conceived, edited and partially written by Carty.The concept of the book is that as Western international law fell away from natural law in the 17th century and became positivist and modernist it also became imperialist. What China experienced is the later imperialist international law. Part II looks critically at this historical interaction, but also in the context of the earlier more cosmopolitan Western traditions. The book asks whether West and East bear any constructive comparison now, in light of what the Oxford Handbook of International Legal Theory calls the Carty-Nijman “postmodern natural law approach” to international law. There is, secondly, Carty’s and Zhang’s Irish Yearbook piece, which develops a theory of unequal treaties from the Chinese and UK archives and monographs on Chinese unequal treaties. It also describes the bitter Anglo-Irish negotiations especially in the 1930s in an effort to have many clauses of the Anglo-Irish Treaty of 1921 rescinded. Finally, a piece by Lim is in press with the Yearbook of International Investment Law and Policy (Oxford, forthcoming, December 2017). This piece describes two tribunal awards and a Singapore Court of Appeal judgment which rejects the prescription of the Sino-British and Sino-Portuguese Joint Declarations on treaty succession in respect of HK and Macao. Instead, the moving treaty frontiers rule is favoured. This ends up rejecting Beijing’s view that the relevant territories were not ceded lawfully in the 19th century in the first place, that there was no cession of these territories to the PRC, no succession, and no question of treaty succession. The article tries to explain, in nineteenth century terms so-to-speak, Beijing’s contemporary treaty view and the recent official reaction to what essentially are “private” international investment claims today.

741012.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
741012.value: At the time of completion, the senior research assistant who had presented on the Sino-Japanese relationship in 2015, and a new French speaking research assistant working on the Sino-French materials, continued to explore their areas. The former has been working on Gu Hongming Tomson (1857-1928), while the latter has been adding to the archival work of Lucy Qi on Sino French relations. Two PhD students worked within the grant’s framework of inquiry – one on the Sino-Japanese War, (Xu Bijun), another on the Sino French War (Zhang Xiaoshi). The second has now obtained her PhD while the first awaits confirmation that her resubmission with amendments is satisfactory. Two others came later within the framework, one works on the educational formation of late Qing officials (Tan Jing) and another on China’s economic treaty initiatives (Chao Junqing) but are left out of the PhD students' section as they were brought in only peripherally. The new PI now explores nineteenth century events which have a contemporary significance for Bejing’s economic treaty policies, such as in the Yearbook piece. We are exploring having a new grant take the 2016 Conference further, or perhaps publishing the papers now.

741012.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
741012.value: We ask whether the past matters in Beijing’s contemporary official view, and in the views of the intelligentsia, of international law. China’s international legal disputes deal with historical issues left over from the past, as with many international law disputes in the world. But we ask a more fundamental question about how the past, if at all, has shaped – and even if it has, whether it ought to shape – China’s overall approach to international legality itself. It matters because we hear statements like these: “China does not comply with international law”. We find that Chinese official and unofficial attitudes were shaped by China's experience of Western international law as it occurred at the end of the 19th century, going into the early 20th century. This was characterised by considerations of power, a conception at odds both with Western international law’s view of itself as a civilizing mission and the Chinese Confucian worldview. The question is, understanding this, how should we now approach the past, and whether Beijing’s official view and general opinion should not simply – or perhaps already does - look forward, shaping how we look at some major issues in the world we live in today.
