770212.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
770212.value: 高血壓作為引發缺血性心臟病及繼發的中風，心功能衰竭或腎臟衰竭的主要風險因素，其發病率逐年上升。據統計，高血壓已成為全世界人口的主要死亡原因之一，其直接導致的死亡人數高達每年七百萬以上。引發高血壓的原因，除了水鹽平衡失調外，在血管緊縮素II(ANGII)和抗利尿激素(VP)控制下的心血管功能對於維持人體正常灌注過程也具重要意義。我們近期研究指出胰泌素(SCT)在機體水鹽平衡控制方面具關鍵作用。此外，曾有學者提出SCT在心血管系統中的潛在功能: SCT可以調節心肌收縮力，並對動脈收縮幅度和頻率都有顯著影響。基於上述發現，我們假設，除ANGII和VP外，SCT同樣可起到維持正常血壓的作用。我們使用原發性高血壓大鼠(SHR)，胰泌素敲除小鼠(SCTKO)，胰泌素受體敲除小鼠(SCTRKO)對SCT與高血壓間的關係進行了初步研究。為檢測SCT及SCTR是否同SHR的漸進型高血壓相關，我們測量了大鼠部分組織內SCT和SCTR的表達水準。值得注意的是，在SHR大鼠心臟中，SCTR未存在顯著的表達(僅及對照大鼠的0.34%)，說明在高血壓的發展過程中，SCTR的表達被顯著及特異性的抑制。同時我們還發現大鼠內SCTR的表達水準和年齡顯著相關：自1月齡始到5月齡止，SCTR轉錄活性隨年齡逐漸下降。這一趨勢和SHR大鼠體內高血壓的發展和cAMP反應活性的下降相吻合。綜上所述，SCTR在SHR大鼠內表達水準的改變趨勢說明SCT和SCTR對心血管功能和血壓調控具潛在作用。為進一步研究兩者間關係，我們測量了野生型，SCTKO和SCTRKO小鼠尾部動脈收縮壓，並發現SCTKO和SCTRKO動物的收縮壓顯著高於野生型。這一結果進一步驗證了SCT-SCTR調控路徑的破壞可能誘發高血壓。有鑑於此，我們提出如下假設：SCT和SCTR是調控新血管功能及血壓的關鍵因素。這一研究專案將著重驗證上述假設，並可能為未來抗高血壓藥物的研究提供關鍵性幫助。

770212.label: Realisation of objectives
770212.value: Objective 1: In this project we generated secretin, (SCT-/-) secretin receptor (SCTR-/-) knock-out and double knock-out mice (SCT-/-, SCTR-/-). Our results suggested that right ventricular systolic pressure (RVSP) is significantly increased in SCT-/- and SCT-/-SCTR-/-. Thus, the actual pulmonary arterial systolic pressure is most likely to be increased in those two genotypes and due to deficient in secretin and secretin receptor. Objective 2: We found that the lean right ventricular wall weight to left ventricular wall plus septum ratio is significantly high in SCT-/- and SCT-/-SCTR-/- mice. For cardiac tissue histology, we found an increased longitudinal and cross sectional area of cardiac muscles of SCTR-/-. Cardiac functional parameters changes were studied using echocardiography. Several significant differences were found: (1) The posterior wall of the double knock-out group is increased. (2) Left ventricular end diastolic diameter and end systolic diameter is decreased in SCT-/- and SCTR-/-. (3) In double knockout, the left ventricular end diastolic diameter, stroke volume and cardiac output are decreased. (4) Heart rate of the double knockout group is increased. About the lung, we found an increased perivascular fibrosis activity, intima proliferation and arterial wall thickening in SCT-/- and SCT-/-SCTR-/- mice. With IVIS 3D spectrum imaging machine, significant amount of apoptosis activity is detected in SCTR-/- and SCT-/-SCTR-/-. Increased apoptosis activity in lung might be the reason for pulmonary hypertension and the heart might be the due to cell death because of pressure overload in pulmonary arterial system. Objective 3: We found that the transcript levels of SCT in adrenal gland and kidney were significantly lowered in SHR, while no change in SCT expression was detected in the heart. Regarding SCTR, interestingly, we found drastic down-regulation of its transcript in the hypertensive SHR hearts comparing to WKY. The expression of SCTR was found age-dependent, there were gradual reductions in SCTR transcripts from 1-to 5-month old rats. Objective 4: Basal plasma ANGII, secretin, vasopressin were measured in wild type, SCT-/-, SCTR-/- and SCT and SCTR double knockout mice. Our results suggested that the basal level of plasma ANGII is significantly increased in SCTR-/- group. The basal plasma level of secretin and vasopressin are also increased in SCTR-/- group but not significant. We found that plasma aldosterone level is significantly high in all knock-out mice. There is no difference in plasma VIP and serotonin level. The increased in ANGII and aldosterone level can be important factors for the cardiovascular phenotypes.

770212.label: Major findings and research outcome
770212.value: Since PI is leaving Hong Kong to join other institute, this report is finished earlier than expected completion date. Therefore, most of the data are not published yet. Right now, we are preparing at least two manuscripts to report the data involved in Objective 1, 2 and 4 to describe the relationship between SCT/SCTR with hypertension in lung and the abnormal cardiovascular function in SCT and SCTR knock-out mice. We also expect to publish one more article regarding objective 3, after collecting more data about the detail regulation mechanism of SCTR in SHR and WHY mice. By the support of this grant, three articles were published in international peer-review journal and six conference papers/presentation were published (see Part C for detail).

770212.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
770212.value: Supported by this GRF grant, we studied the effects of SCT and SCTR-deficiency on blood pressure, blood volume, and heart rate in in vivo conditions. Since we also found phenotype in lung, we therefore propose to investigate the underlying molecular mechanisms for the development of pulmonary arterial hypertension in SCT or SCTR knock-out mice. A recent study by other research has shown that SCT can stimulate cardiac perfusion in pig through a nitric oxide and beta-adrenoreceptor pathway. Therefore, by using knock-out models, we could perform studies for understanding cardiovascular actions of SCT. Particularly, the NO pathway that induces vasodilation will be tested. Our data also suggested left ventricular hypertrophy in SCTR knock-out mice. The observed ventricular hypertrophy could either be pathological or physiological. In future studies, this could be determined by measuring various cardiac fetal gene expression levels including atrial natriuretic peptide (ANP) and brain natriuretic peptide (BNP). Physiological nature of cardiac hypertrophy could be characterized by the following observations: (a) completely reversible hypertrophy, (b) lack of fetal cardiac gene induction, (c) lack of interstitial fibrosis, and (d) preserved contractile function. These experiments can further describe the role of SCT/SCTR in cardiovascular system.

770212.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
770212.value: From this research, we can soundly conclude that lack of secretin can cause significant hypertension in lung, moderate hypertension in whole body, fibrosis in the heart and increased cell death in the lung and heart. Secretin receptor deficiency can cause increased heart size and this might be due to increased renin-angiotensin activity. The hypertension in lung is serious enough to effect the heart and it is similar to a disease called pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Thus the secretin deficient mice can be used for research activities in pulmonary arterial hypertension as a translational animal model. Secretin or secretin analog might be used as a drug to cure PAH. Since heart fibrosis is also important health issue, role of secretin in heart fibrosis will be beneficial to study and the knowledge can apply to other organ fibrosis conditions such as fibrosis of liver, kidney and other organs. Investigating the role of secretin in cell apoptosis will also be fruitful for inflammation and cell death study for tissue degeneration.

770612.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
770612.value: Porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome is one of the most economically important diseases in global swine industry causing a significant financial impact on both sow and finishing herds. A large-scale outbreak of an unknown porcine disease associated with high fever symptom emerged in China in 2006. The disease spread over 10 provinces in China affecting 2 million pigs with about 400,000 fatalities brought a huge loss in agricultural sector. A mutant strain of PRRSV with discontinuous deletion of 30 amino acids in the non-structural protein (nsp2) was identified as the agent involved. However, further research is required to prove that such deletion is directly related to the increased virulence of the virus. The question whether this deletion plays a functional role in the gain of virulence or it is just a disease marker remains to be answered. Besides, it is also important to identify possible selective pressure that induces the deletion of nsp2 gene, together with other probable variations occur in this event. Apart from nsp2, other genetic components may also contribute to the variations in pathogenicity of the virus. Hence knowing the relationship between PRRSV genotypes and the corresponding molecular responses in the infected alveolar macrophage may help to identify the key viral factor in PRRSV-induced pathogenesis. We propose to examine the variations in the transcript expression pattern upon infection with different PRRSV genotypes using the transcriptome pyrosequencing (RNAseq) technique. Furthermore, PRRSV has been associated with a number of diseases in pigs. Our previous study demonstrated that co-infections of PRRSV with porcine cirocovirus 2 (PCV2) are a common event in local pig farms. We hypothesize that co-infection with PCV2 may exert influence on PRRSV replication machinery in the host. In the occasion that two viruses replicate simultaneously in a host cell, both viruses may act as a selective pressure to each other, and resulting in the change on replication efficiency and virulence of the progenies. To determine the effects of PCV2 infection on PRRSV activities in alveolar macrophage, PAM will be infected with these viruses in sequential orders and its differential expression pattern will also be evaluated with RNAseq. Further in vivo study on SPF animals will be conducted in order to verify the in vitro result. By this project, we may pick up a clear picture on pathogenicity of various Type 2 PRRSV genotypes and the interactions between PRRSV and PCV2 in the host alveolar macrophage.

770612.label: Realisation of objectives
770612.value: We have completed objective 1 and more than 75% of objective 2 before the project ran into a complete halt. Due to the fact that the only PhD student supported by this project Manreet’s parents (Dad and Mom) passed away during 2013-2014 within 6 months apart from each other and Manreet is the eldest of three children, he had to shoulder much of the burden to take care the family and significantly impacted his research as well as research of this project. Manreet cannot be in the lab during most of this year because of his parent sickness and had to take care all the funerals. He only managed to finished one PLoS ONE and one Journal of General Virology papers all related to PRRSV but though NOT directly address the objectives set for this project. He did promise me that he will finished the RNASeq/transcriptome studies in the near future! However, I have recruited another RA to fill in and have managed to further the in vitro cell culture first set up by Manreet and my other post-doc for the co-infection studies. We should be able to finish the RNA sequencing part in the next 6-8 months.

770612.label: Major findings and research outcome
770612.value: Porcine Reproductive and Respiratory Syndrome virus (PRRSV) is a positive-sense RNA virus that poses a continual threat to domestic swine populations. Although formally recognized only two and half decades ago, molecular dating estimation indicates a more ancient evolutionary history, which involved divergence into two genotypes (type 1 and type 2) prior to the ‘initial’ outbreaks of the late 1980s. Type 2 PRRSV circulates primarily in North America and Asia. We have examined the mechanisms by which PRRSV generates variability, describe a means of organizing type 2 diversity captured in voluminous ORF5 sequences in a phylogenetic framework and provide a holistic view of known global type 2 diversity in the same setting. This phylogenetic framework has become the standard for PRRSV Type 2 classification used and cited by scientists worldwide. Most significant of our research funded from this project has to be our findings that the marked increase in the number of infections with highly pathogenic porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus (HP-PRRSV) in China causing outbreaks between 2009 to 2010 was originated from a single recombination event.

770612.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
770612.value: We will continue this line of research and soon we will have big enough sequences database to start predicting where and how the virus spread and development of much more effective vaccine.

770612.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
770612.value: Our scientific findings will provide better understanding of the evolution of the PRRSV which will aid in the development of better vaccine toward this viral disease. We will continue our research direction and one day in the future we will be able to predict the super spreader of PRRSV much earlier and develop effective vaccine for farmers to fight against this viral disease

771212.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
771212.value: Organotin (OT) compounds are commonly used as anti-fouling biocides on ship hulls and underwater facilities, while some of them are frequently used as biocides or preservatives for agriculture and industrial purposes. Among them, tributyltin (TBT) and triphenyltin (TPT) are well-known endocrine disruptors which can inhibit the growth of oysters and induce imposex in marine gastropods. Imposex is generally defined as the superimposition of male sexual organs (i.e., development of vas deferens and penis) on female gastropods. Such abnormalities can lead to reproductive failure, resulting in population decline of this group of animals. The rock shell Thais clavigera, which is an intertidal predatory gastropod species commonly found along Western Pacific coasts, has been widely used as a biomonitor for OT-contamination through examination of its imposex status in Hong Kong, Mainland China, Taiwan, Japan and Korea. Our recent studies in Hong Kong waters have showed that the proportion of females in the T. clavigera population decreased with increasing imposex severity (as reflected by the Vas Deferens Stage Index), T. clavigera at all 29 study sites were suffering from imposex and their tissues contained elevated levels of both TBT and TPT. Up to now, it is still an unanswered question how TBT or TPT can trigger the imposex development in marine gastropod species, although many attempts have been made worldwide to explicate the possible mechanisms through testing a number of specific hypotheses. This proposed study is, therefore, designed to uncover the molecular mechanisms of the OT-mediated imposex through global analyses of the expression levels of genes. First, we aim to establish a comprehensive and putative transcriptome database for T. clavigera using the next-generation sequencing technology. The analysis will cover three major tissue types, namely reproductive organ, digestive gland and head ganglia. The established tissue-specific transcript database will provide an important “back-bone” resource for genome-wide association studies of this species. Second, we will make use of the established genome information to further investigate gene expressions in T. clavigera after waterborne exposure to TBT or TPT at environmentally realistic levels. The results will enable us to holistically elucidate the endocrine disruption and toxic mechanisms of TBT and TPT, and to identify a suite of genes in T. clavigera that are involved in the OT-mediated imposex mechanisms. The findings will be further employed to develop diagnostic tools such as gene- or protein-chip for rapid assessment of OT-contamination. 有機錫化合物常被用作於船體和水下設施之防污生物滅除劑，也廣泛應用於農業和工業殺菌防腐劑。眾所周知，內分泌干擾物三丁基錫（TBT）和三苯基錫（TPT）可抑制牡蠣生長及誘導海洋腹足生物性畸變。性畸變（即雌性雄化）通常是指雌雄異體的腹足類雌螺身上長有雄性的生殖構造（如輸精管和陰莖）。這些異常可能導致腹足類繁殖障礙，進而降低該物種種群數量。疣荔枝螺（Thais clavigera）是西太平洋海岸沿線潮間帶常見的一種捕食性腹足生物。在香港、中國內地、台灣、日本和韓國，疣荔枝螺之有機錫誘導的性畸變常被利用於生物監測。根據我們最近的研究結果顯示，嚴重的性畸變程度（表現為輸精管發育指數）可顯著降低香港水域T. clavigera的雌體數量。在香港所研究的29個考察點中，全部T. clavigera受到性畸變的影響，此外生物體內亦含有大量的TBT和TPT。迄今為止，儘管大量研究已經開始嘗試闡明有機錫影響下性畸變現象的潛在機制，但是TBT或TPT如何激發海洋腹足類生物性畸變的產生仍然是個未知數。因此，本研究項目旨在通過全球化基因表達分析來研究有機錫介導下性畸變的分子機制。首先，利用次世代定序技術建立綜合的T. clavigera的轉錄組數據庫。該技術主要涵蓋疣荔枝螺的三大組織類型，包括生殖器官，消化腺以及頭節。根據組織類型建立的轉錄組數據庫，將給該物種全基因組關聯分析提供重要的數據資源。其次，利用以上基因組信息，本項目會進一步調查T. clavigera在水體中TBT或TPT的實際環境濃度下的基因表達。我們可以利用以上研究結果全面闡述內分泌干擾機制以及TBT和TPT的毒性機理，確定有機錫介導下性畸變所表達的基因類型。本研究結果亦可用於開發快速評估有機錫污染的監測工具，例如基因或蛋白芯片。

771212.label: Realisation of objectives
771212.value: Using Illumina sequencing, this study aimed to establish tissue-specific transcriptomes of the marine gastropod Reishia clavigera which covered their digestive gland, gonad, head ganglia, penis and the remaining body part of the male and female, respectively (Objective 1). By combining the results, a global transcriptome was obtained with a total of 578,134,720 high-quality filtered reads. After de novo assembly, there were 24,743 assembled transcripts and 19,291 assembled unigenes annotated with at least one gene ontology term, while 7,461 assembled transcripts and 6,045 assembled unigenes were associated with 335 Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes pathways. Although the numbers of assembled unigenes were similar among the five target tissues and between sexes, tissue-specific expression profiles were revealed by multivariate statistical analyses. Putative steroid hormones associated unigenes were identified via function annotation. We postulated that steroid hormone receptor homologues present in R. clavigera could be targets for mechanistic studies of the organotin-mediated imposex development. Subsequently, we examined the toxic mechanisms of tributyltin (TBT) and triphenyltin (TPT) on R. clavigera, with a focus on the underlying mechanism of imposex development (Objective 2). We selected head ganglia, gonad and digestive glands in female R. clavigera for the transcriptomic analysis, and examined their transcriptomes under a 120-day chronic exposure to TBT or TPT. We observed the imposex development and an increase in tissue concentration of total organotins in the females after the exposure to TBT/TPT. We found that the rapid bioaccumulation and slow metabolism of TPT resulted in a faster promotion of imposex than that triggered by TBT. The transcriptome analysis uncovered the tissue-specific gene expression profiles. TBT/TPT exposure induces the gene expression of steroidogenic unigene CYP17A1 in digestive gland and gonad. CYP17A1 further increases the biosynthesis of androstenedione and possibly elevation of free testosterone, which may promote imposex development in female gastropods. Concurrently, the up-regulation of PPARγ in the female gonad may be initiated by the activation of PPAR/RXR heterodimer. The up-regulation of PPARγ can then trigger the regulation of its downstream biological processes that may lead to the development of imposex. The regulation of phosphorylation and inhibition of proteases by TBT/TPT can indirectly modulate the nuclear receptor activities in head ganglia, which possibly play a key role in the imposex development. The newly generated transcriptome databases provide valuable molecular resources for ecotoxicological studies. Our results underpin the importance of organotin-mediated testosterone biosynthesis and their interaction with nuclear receptors, in triggering the imposex development.

771212.label: Major findings and research outcome
771212.value: Objective 1 We successfully established tissue-specific transcriptomes of Reishia clavigera for five tissues (i.e., digestive gland, gonad, head ganglia, penis and remaining body part) of the male and female, respectively, using Illumina sequencing. By integrating all results, a total of 578,134,720 high-quality filtered reads were obtained with 24,743 assembled transcripts and 19,291 assembled unigenes annotated with at least one gene ontology term while 6,045 assembled unigenes were associated with 335 Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes pathways. Although the difference of the transcriptomes between sexes was very small, the transcriptomes and gene expression profiles were significantly different among different tissue types. The results have been written up and submitted as a research article to Aquatic Toxicology (Impact Factor: 3.451; Journal Rank: 5/103 in Marine and Freshwater Biology) [Publication #6 in Part C]. We also published the transcriptome of the gonad as a separate article in Marine Pollution Bulletin (IF: 2.991; JR: 9/103) [Publication #1]. The transcriptome databases generated from this study have been deposited to NCBI (accession number: SRP058745), making them available to other researchers and facilitating further ecotoxicological studies using molluscs. Objective 2 To elucidate the toxic mechanisms, we examined the transcriptomes of digestive gland, gonad and head ganglia of female R. clavigera after 120-days of chronic waterborne exposure to tributyltin (TBT; 1000 ng/L) and triphenyltin (TPT; 500 ng/L). After the 120-days of exposure, we observed the imposex development and an increase in tissue concentration of total organotins in the animals. Interestingly, we found that the rapid bioaccumulation and slow metabolism of TPT resulted in a faster promotion of the imposex development than that triggered by TBT. The transcriptomes and gene expression profiles varied significantly among different tissue types. Based on the transcriptome results, overall mechanisms for the imposex development in female R. clavigera were suggested and summarized in the Publication #7. Our results highlight the importance of organotin-mediated regulation of testosterone biosynthesis, and the direct and indirect interactions between nuclear receptor activity and organotin exposure, in triggering the imposex development. Additional Discoveries We studied the organotin contamination in R. clavigera along the coastal areas of Hong Kong and Shenzhen (Publications #3, 5 and 8), and in local seafood (Publication #2). With funding from State Key Laboratory in Marine Pollution, we established the transcriptome database for various tissues of the green-lipped mussel, Perna viridis (Publication #4), and investigated the toxic mechanism of TPT in this bivalve species (Publication #9).

771212.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
771212.value: Our results suggested the potential involvement of CYP17A1 and PPARγ in organotin-mediated imposex development in R. clavigera but the sequence homology and function of these two unigenes have yet to identify. Further enzymatic study, cloning study and targeted gene expression analysis are warranted to clarify the biological roles of CYP17A1 and PPARγ in molluscs and elucidate their roles in imposex development. The animals used in this study were not free from imposex, and might confound the observed results. The comprehensive global transcriptome database of Reishia clavigera generated in this study enables us to further investigate the molecular mechanism of imposex development in imposex-free female gastropods which are cultivated in laboratory or collected in a pristine environment without organotin contamination. A global analysis of differentially expressed genes before, during and after imposex development in these imposex-free females will further improve our understanding of the complete molecular pathways of imposex development. With the transcriptome databases, it is possible for us to study toxic mechanisms of other common or emerging chemical pollutants in R. clavigera, and identify and develop a suite of reliable exposure- and effect-related molecular biomarkers for pollution monitoring (e.g., via real-time qPCR with primers and/or enzyme linked immunosorbent assays).

771212.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
771212.value: The marine gastropod, Reishia clavigera, is a common biomonitor of chemical contamination in coastal environments along the Western-Pacific region. They are widely adopted as a model organism for studying why and how organotin compounds (widespread biocides) can induce imposex development in its females (i.e., superimposition of male sex organs onto the female sex organs in the female gastropod). However, limited genomic resources of R. clavigera restrict its role for investigation of molecular mechanisms of such endocrine disruptions. To fill this knowledge gap, this study, for the first time, successfully established a comprehensive genomic database for R. clavigera which covers RNA sequences obtained from digestive gland, gonad, head ganglia, penis and the remaining body part of the male and female, using Illumina sequencing. Tissue-specific gene expression profiles were observed. Furthermore, we conducted a 120-day exposure experiment to elucidate toxic mechanisms of two selected organotin compounds to R. clavigera based on their RNA expressions and the newly generated genomic databases. We discover that organotin compounds can influence testosterone biosynthesis and interact with nuclear receptor activities, and these may concomitantly trigger the imposex development in the female gastropod. The newly generated transcriptome databases provide valuable molecular resources for ecotoxicological studies with gastropod molluscs.

The title of Kevin's winning poster was 'Organotin contamination in market seafood and its implication for human health risk in Hong Kong'. Kevin Ho was also the recipient of the “Marine Pollution Bulletin Young Scientist Award for an Outstanding Oral Presentation” at the 7th International Conference on Marine Pollution and Ecotoxicology held in Hong Kong in June 2013. His wining talk was also about organotin contamination in market seafood. Mr Jack Chi Ho IP, an MPhil student, won “The Outstanding Oral Presentation Award” at the 11th International Symposium on Persistent Toxic Substances (ISPTS), held in Hong Kong during October 2014. The title of Jack’s presentation was “Establishing a platform of environmental omics for the green-lipped mussel Perna viridis”. Kevin Ho also won the 2nd Runner Up in the 3 Minute Thesis (3MT) Competition held in June 2013 at the University of Hong Kong. His presentation topic was "Ecological and human health risks associated with organotin contamination in the marine environment of Hong Kong". Collaboration with other research institutions Since the commencement of this GRF project, we have been closely working with the Co-I Dr. J.W. Qiu and his team at the Hong Kong Baptist University. Dr Qiu makes significant contributions to the experimental designs, bioinformatics analyses and database management of the transcriptomomes. A knowledge/technology transfer from Prof. Paul K.S. Lam’s group of the State Key Laboratory of Marine Pollution (SKLMP), City University of Hong Kong was obtained, regarding the organotin extraction method from biota samples and chemical analysis using gas chromatography and mass spectrometer (GC-MS) for quantifying the organotin compounds in tissues of the marine invertebrates including gastropods, mussels and barnacles. Workshops attended by the team members Our MPhil study, Mr. Jack Ip, had chances to attend two training workshops, namely, the Next-Generation Sequencing and Microarray Data Analysis Workshop and the Next-Generation Sequencing Data Analysis Workshop which were held at HKU in April and May 2015, respectively. Data sharing As mentioned above, we have deposited the transcriptome databases generated from this study to NCBI (accession number: SRP058745), making them available to any researchers who are working on ecotoxicology, environmental genomics and/or evolution with molluscs.

771712.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
771712.value: Recent studies have demonstrated that adult human and animal hearts contain a pool of stem/progenitor cells, which contribute to cardiomyocytes turnover and tissue regeneration. Cardiac stem/progenitor cells may migrate to the damage zone, proliferate, and generate a population of young cardiomyocytes to repair the injured myocardium or reverse partly the aging myopathy. Little is known regarding mechanisms underlying cell migration and proliferation in adult human cardiac progenitor cells. Ion channels have been shown to regulate cell migration and proliferation. Nevertheless, roles of functional ion channels in cell migration and proliferation are not understood in human cardiac progenitor cells. We have recently isolated in cardiac c-kit+ progenitor cells from human atrial specimens and obtained important experimental data about ion channels in these cells. Three types of ionic currents, a large conductance Ca2+-activated K+ current (BKCa), an inward rectifier K+ current (IKir), and a voltage-gated sodium current (INa), are recorded in human cardiac c-kit+ cells. Interestingly, our preliminary experiments have shown that the stem cell-homing factor SDF-1alpha (stromal cell-derived factor-1alpha) augments BKCa current, while bFGF (basic fibroblast growth factor) increases IKir in human cardiac c-kit+ progenitor cells. The aims of the present study are 1) to determine how BKCa, IKr, and INa channels regulate cell migration and proliferation in cultured human cardiac c-kit+ progenitor cells, and 2) to investigate the interaction of these ion channels with SDF-1alpha and bFGF in regulation of cell migration and proliferation. The results of this study will provide important information about the role of ion channels in modulating migration and proliferation of cultured human cardiac progenitor cells. 771712.label: Major findings and research outcome
771712.value: In the present project supported by Research Grant Council of Hong Kong, we found that a large conductance Ca2+-activated K+ current (BKCa) in 86% of cells, an inwardly-rectifying K+ current (IKir) in 84% of cells, a transient outward K+ current (Ito) in 47% of cells, a voltage-gated tetrodotoxin-sensitive Na+ current (INa,TTX) in 61% of cells. Molecular identities of these ionic currents were confirmed with RT-PCR and Western blot analysis. Then we demonstrated that inhibition of BKCa with paxilline, but not INa.TTX with tetrodotoxin, decreased both cell proliferation and migration. Suppression of IKir with Ba2+ had no effect on cell proliferation, while enhanced cell mobility. Silencing KCa.1.1 reduced cell proliferation by accumulating the cells at G0/G1 phase and decreased cell mobility. However，silence of Kir2.1 increased cell migration without affecting cell cycling progression in human cardiac c-kit+ progenitor cells. Finally we found that SOCE channels mediated Ca2+ influx, and TRPC1, STIM1 and Orai1 were involved in formation of SOCE channels in human cardiac c-kit+ progenitor cells. Silence of TRPC1, STIM1, or Orai1 with the corresponding siRNA significantly reduced the Ca2+ signalling through SOCE channels, decreased cell proliferation and migration, and reduced expression of cyclin D1, cyclin E, and/or p-Akt.

771712.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
771712.value: The results provide the first information of cellular physiology in human cardiac progenitor cells, which is an important basis for understanding cardiac regeneration.

771712.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
771712.value: These results demonstrate for the first time that four types of ionic currents including BKCa, Ito, IKir, and INa.TTX, are heterogeneously present in human cardiac c-kit+ cells, which may be involved in regulating cellular physiology These results demonstrate the novel information that blockade or silence of BKCa channels, but not INa.TTX channels, decreases cell cycling progression and mobility whereas suppression of Kir2.1 channels increases cell mobility without affecting cell cycling progression in human cardiac c-kit+ progenitor cells. Our results demonstrate the novel information that Ca2+ signalling mediated by SOCE channels participates in regulating cell cycling and migration by activating cyclin D1, cyclin E and/or p-Akt in human cardiac c-kit+ cells.

772012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
772012.value: 擬南芥中紫色酸性磷酸酶（AtPAP2）的過表達會促進植株生長、提高種子產率（+40%-50%）。亞細胞定位研究結果顯示，這種磷酸酶能夠雙重靶向兩種植物的產能細胞器——葉綠體和線粒體。研究表明，AtPAP2能夠通過其C末端疏水基團錨定于葉綠體與線粒體的外膜，若去除該末端則會導致AtPAP2失去促進生長的功能。僅有少數蛋白質能夠特異定向于這兩個細胞器的外膜之上，其中許多扮演著從細胞質運輸蛋白的角色，例如TOC（葉綠體外膜轉位因子）和TOM（線粒體外膜轉位因子）複合體。 磷酸化與去磷酸化參與了通過TOC複合體的蛋白質運輸過程。諸多以葉綠體為目標的蛋白質轉運肽均在絲氨酸（Ser）和蘇氨酸（Thr）殘基處發生磷酸化，例如核酮糖-1,5-二磷酸羧化酶（Rubisco（pSSU））和OE23的前體蛋白。已有研究表明，14-3-3蛋白質能夠連結pSSU與OE23蛋白質轉運肽的磷酸化絲氨酸殘基，但在其S→A突變體中卻無此現象。PSSU的S34磷酸化並非蛋白質運輸的必要步驟，但其磷酸化轉運肽的去磷酸化去舉足輕重。已發現有三種酶參與了pSSU與Poe23轉運肽的磷酸化，但有關去磷酸化相關磷酸酶的鑒定依然不甚明確。 我們的酵母雙雜交資料顯示，AtPAP2能夠與pSSU和某些前體蛋白相互作用。由於AtPAP2是葉綠體外膜上唯一的磷酸酶，類似于TOC複合體的前體蛋白受體（Toc33，Toc34，Toc159）。其通過C末端的疏水殘基錨定於葉綠體的外膜，我們推測在特定蛋白質運輸進入葉綠體的過程中，AtPAP2通過去磷酸化其轉運肽發揮調控作用。AtPAP2 OE品系的快速生長的現象可能是由於光合作用蛋白質組成元件的運輸增加所致（例如SSU、LHC、OE23），本課題的主要目標便是對該假說進行檢測。關於AtPAP2 在線粒體中的生理功能，由於至今沒有以線粒體作為靶向的前體蛋白轉運肽的磷酸化的報告，因此無法確定膜錨定AtPAP2在轉運進程中的作用。因此必須開展有關其功能的進一步研究，但是由於資金與人力的限制，無法在此次計畫中得以完全討論。雖然如此，我們將會開展有關OE品系、T-DNA品系和野生型純化線粒體的蛋白質組研究。而本次研究中，我們將聚焦AtPAP2在葉綠體中生物學功能。

772012.label: Realisation of objectives
772012.value: We have achieved 100% of our six objectives and published six research articles and is preparing two more manuscripts for submission. Objective 1: We have created transgenic plants that have AtPAP2 targeted to only chloroplasts or to mitochondria and found that targeting of AtPAP2 to either chloroplasts or mitochondria is not sufficient for plant growth enhancement. The lines (chloroplast only) grow like wild-type (WT) plants but the lines (mitochondria) exhibited early senescence, low seed yield, low sucrose but high ATP phenotypes. Some of the data were published in Plant Physiology 169:1344-55. Objective 2: Yes. AtPAP2 can interact with some proteins involved in photosynthesis, including the small subunit of Rubisco, and modulates protein import. Some of the of the data were published in Plant Signaling & Behavior (in press). Objective 3: We have found >30 proteins that can interact with AtPAP2, including a number of proteins of photosystem (chloroplasts) and multiple organellar RNA editing factors (chloroplasts and mitochondria). Some of the of the data were published in Plant Physiology 169:1344-55.Plant Signaling & Behavior (in press). Objective 4: We proved that AtPAP9 is also dually-targeted to chloroplasts and mitochondria and can interact with most of the proteins that interact with AtPAP2. However, some proteins interact with AtPAP9 but not AtPAP2. We postulated that the difference in protein substrate specificity may be the reason why overexpression of AtPAP9 does not result in the fast growth phenotype. A manuscript is under preparation. Objective 5: Yes. We proved that the C-terminal hydrophobic motif of AtPAP9 also target it to the outer membranes of chloroplasts and mitochondria. A manuscript is under preparation. Objective 6: Yes. We have reported the impact of AtPAP2 overexpression on the leaf metabolism, including transcriptome, proteome and metabolome, of Arabidopsis thaliana. The data was published in Frontiers in Plant Science 6:922.

772012.label: Major findings and research outcome
772012.value: We have successfully delineated the biological roles of AtPAP2 in chloroplasts and mitochondria and explained its mechanism in promoting plant growth. Many nuclear-encoded proteins (>2000) are translated in cytosol and have to be imported into the chloroplasts or mitochondria to function. The N-terminal protein sequences (transit peptides or presequences) of these proteins are responsible for correct sorting of these proteins to these two organelles by binding to the receptor-channel complexes on the outer membranes of chloroplasts (Toc33/34 of the TOC complex) or mitochondria (Tom20 of the TOM complex). Some cytosolic kinases (e.g. STY kinases) can phosphorylate the transit peptides/presequences of some of these proteins and therefore some phosphatases are required to dephosphorylate these transit peptides/presequences before protein import can proceed. AtPAP2 and AtPAP9 are two of the phosphatases that can play this biological role. Like Toc33/34 and Tom20, the C-terminal hydrophobic motifs of both AtPAP2 and AtPAP9 can target the phosphatases to the outer membranes of chloroplasts and mitochondria. We showed that both proteins can interact with the transit peptides/presequences of a number (>30) proteins and modulate their import into chloroplasts or mitochondria. However, only overexpression of AtPAP2, but not AtPAP9 can promote plant growth and seed yield. We attribute the phenotypic differences are due to different protein substrate specificity. For example, AtPAP9 can interact with the beta-subunit of the ATP synthase of mitochondria and PsaE2 of photosystem I but AtPAP2 cannot. Overexpression of AtPAP2 in chloroplasts and mitochondria modulates their activities. The overexpression of AtPAP2 in chloroplasts enhances the linear electron flow and thus produces more reducing power from chloroplasts. Overexpression of AtPAP2 in mitochondria enhances their ability to produce ATP by consuming energy harvested from chloroplasts. Therefore, overexpression of AtPAP2 on both organelles can boost energy harvest efficiency in chloroplasts and ATP production efficiency in mitochondria and thereby promote plant growth. In the project we have published six research articles in referred journals. In addition, two manuscripts entitled "Functional Similarity and Dissimilarity of Homologous Proteins AtPAP2 and AtPAP9 in Arabidopsis thaliana" and "The interaction of AtPAP2 with MORF proteins: Influence on RNA editing in Arabidopsis thaliana." will be submitted in Oct, 2016.

772012.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
772012.value: Our project provides a unique and valuable model to study energy outputs from organelles and their interactions. Photosystems in chloroplasts harvest light energy and convert it into reducing power (NADPH) and chemical energy (ATP), which are then used for CO2, nitrogen and sulfur fixation in plants. By contrast, mitochondria consume the reducing power (malate valve) and carbon (TCA cycle) to produce ATP molecules. Overexpression of AtPAP2 on these two orgenelles must have significantly changed the physiology of these two organlles. We shall therefore characterize the photosystems (chloroplasts) and respiratory chain (mitochondria) of the fast-growth lines (e.g. by proteomics and blue native 2D electrophoresis). We shall also measure the activities of various TCA enzymes and respiratory complexes (by oxygraph). The findngs will allow us to understand how energy outputs from these two organelles can be enhanced. Brassica is the only species that have two PAP genes (AtPAP2 and AtPAP9) encoding C-terminal hydrophobic tails in their genomes. All other plant genomes contain only one PAP gene with a C-terminal hydrophobic tail. We shall compare the substrate specificities of AtPAP2 and AtPAP9 by screening of yeast two-hybrid array. The findings may have application values in crop agrobiotechnology.

772012.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
772012.value: We have developed a new strategy to promote plant growth and seed yield by 38% to 57% in a model plant Arabidopsis thaliana, hence increasing CO2 absorption from the atmosphere. We have identified a plant-growth promoting gene, designated as “Purple acid phosphatase 2” (AtPAP2) from the model plant Arabidopsis thaliana. AtPAP2 is dually targeted to two energy-generating organelles of plant cells: chloroplasts and mitochondria. Chloroplasts carry out photosynthesis, a process that fixes CO2 in atmosphere into sugars using solar energy. The sugars are then used for plant growth including cell wall, biomass and seeds, or consumed by mitochondria to produce adenosine triphosphate (ATP), an important energy source for many cellular processes. We found that by dual expression of AtPAP2 on chloroplasts and mitochondria, the engineered plants can grow faster and produce more sucrose and ATP. It is because AtPAP2 can modulate the import of a number of specific proteins into chloroplasts and mitochondria, and subsequently boost their capability to harvest solar energy and generate ATP. AtPAP2 is found to be the first protein that can modulate energy outputs from these two organelles simultaneously.

772712.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
772712.value: 瘦素是脂肪組織分泌的激素，對營養攝入，能量代謝及免疫有重要調節作用。近年的研究證明瘦素能調控T，B細胞和樹突狀細胞的功能，但目前尚不清楚瘦素是否調節分泌白介素17的T細胞（Th17）功能。 我們初步研究發現自身免疫性關節炎小鼠的關節組織和滑液中瘦素表達顯著增多，且關節局部注射瘦素，關節炎症加重，組織破坏嚴重並伴有Th17細胞增多，提示瘦素可能促進Th17細胞功能，加重關節炎病程進展。 在本研究中我們將深入研究瘦素促進Th17細胞形成和機制，證實瘦素在關節炎發病中的作用，探討將瘦素作為靶標來治療關節炎的新方法。

772712.label: Realisation of objectives
772712.value: 1. To determine the effect of leptin on the generation of Th17 cells. (1). To determine whether leptin exerts any direct effect on Th17 cells, we first detected leptin receptor (Ob-Rb) transcripts in splenic naïve CD4+ T cells and in vitro-differentiated Th17 cells from normal mice by semi-quantitative PCR analysis. In addition, the expression of leptin receptor (Ob-R) in CD4+ T cells and Th17 cells was further confirmed by flow cytometry and immunofluorescence microscopy, respectively. (2). To determine a direct function of leptin in the generation of Th17 cells, naïve CD4+ T cells were purified from the spleen of normal mice and cultured for 3 days under a polarized condition for Th17 differentiation. We found that leptin treatment significantly enhanced Th17 cell generation with a 1.5-fold increase in total cell numbers, an effect that was completely abolished when Ob-R chimera (Ob-R:Fc), a soluble blocker of leptin, was added into the culture of naïve T cells. Consistently, leptin treatment showed no obvious effect on Th17 cell differentiation from naïve T cells of db/db mice, indicating a direct effect of leptin in enhancing Th17 generation via leptin-receptor-mediated signaling transduction. Notably, significantly elevated IL-17 levels were detected in culture supernatants of leptin-treated T cells from normal mice. 2. To elucidate the mechanisms by which leptin modulates the generation and function of Th17 cells. (1). To determine whether leptin affects the expression of key transcription factors in Th17 cells, increased levels of Retinoic acid–related orphan nuclear receptor γt (ROR γt) and Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (Stat3) transcripts were readily detected when naïve T cells were cultured in the presence of leptin under serum-free Th17-polarized condition for 15 minutes, reaching a peak level by 30 minutes. Upon treatment with leptin at concentrations of 50 and 250 ng/ml for 30 minutes, levels of RORγt and STAT3 transcripts in naïve T cells were significantly increased by 3- and 6-fold, respectively, when compared with those in T cells cultured in the absence of leptin. Moreover, leptin showed synergistic effect with inflammatory cytokines IL-6 and TGF-β in promoting RORγt and STAT3 transcription. (2). To verify whether leptin promotes Th17 cell expansion via enhancing the proliferation of Th17 cells, we cultured CFSE-labeled naïve CD4+ T cells in the presence and absence of recombinant leptin under a polarized condition for Th17 differentiation for 3 days. Although the frequency of Th17 cells was substantially increased in culture, the proliferative rate of Th17 cells showed no obvious changes upon leptin treatment. (3). To further investigate whether leptin affects effector functions of Th17 cells, we examined the chemotactic migration of Th17 cells by transwell assay in vitro. Th17 cell migration was significantly enhanced by leptin in a dose-dependent manner, suggesting an important role of leptin in Th17 recruitment to arthritic joints. Together, these results indicate that leptin may play a role in driving Th17 cell-mediated immune response in vivo. 3. To examine the role of leptin in the pathogenesis of autoimmune arthritis in CIA mice. (1). Using a collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) model, we found a close correlation of increased leptin expression with the severity of autoimmune arthritis. During CIA induction, markedly elevated levels of leptin were detected in the inflamed synovium of mice with CIA at both acute and chronic stages by immunohistochemical staining, consistent with markedly elevated levels of leptin transcripts in joint tissue as detected by qPCR analysis. Moreover, we detected significantly elevated IL-17 levels and increased numbers of Th17 cells in the synovial fluid and synovial tissue, respectively, indicating a correlation of leptin with Th17 differentiation in vivo. (2). To further elucidate the cellular source of leptin, joint tissues from CIA mice were analyzed by immunohistochemical staining for leptin expression. We found that synoviocytes and chondrocytes are the major source of leptin in the synovim and joint especially during acute and chronic CIA stages. (3). To determine whether locally elevated leptin concentration can enhance CIA progression, we intraarticularly injected 5 μg recombinant leptin in 10 μl of phosphate buffered saline (PBS) into the knee joint every 3 days for 3 consecutive times starting from day 17 after the 1st CII immunization of DBA/1J mice. Leptin-treated mice showed a one-week earlier onset of arthritis than that in PBS-treated control mice. Accordingly, leptin-treated CIA mice exhibited markedly increased severity of arthritic symptoms. Interestingly, enlarged sizes of draining popliteal lymph nodes with significantly increased cellularity were also observed in leptin-treated CIA mice. Moreover, histolopathological examination on joint samples revealed more pronounced synovial hyperplasia, cartilage damage and bone erosion in leptin-treated CIA mice when compared with PBS-treated CIA controls. To further examine the potential sources of IL-17 production in vivo, we detected IL-17-producing γδT cells and Ly-6G–positive neutrophils in draining lymph nodes of both PBS–treated and leptin-treated mice with collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) by flow cytometry. However, these populations were 24-fold smaller than that of IL-17–producing Th17 cells. Notably, both IL-17–expressing γδT cells and neutrophils were slightly increased in leptin-treated mice but did not show any significant difference when compared to mice treated with PBS. Therefore, Th17 cells represent the major source of IL-17 produced in the synovial tissue of CIA mice. To evaluate the effect of local leptin injection on T cell responses in vivo, we found that intraarticular injection of leptin in the knee joint of collagen-immunized mice resulted in significantly expanded Th17 cells in both draining lymph nodes and joint tissue by flow cytometry analysis and elevated IL-17 levels in synovial fluid as detected by ELISA assay. (4). To define the function of IL-17 in the pathogenesis of CIA, we immunized wildtype (WT) and IL-17 knockout (KO) C57BL/6 mice with chicken type II collagen for CIA induction. IL-17A KO mice showed significantly reduced incidence and delayed onset of CIA. We further examined whether adoptive transfer of Th17 cells could promote the development of CIA in IL-17 KO mice. Th17 cells were generated under a polarising condition in vitro and transferred into immunized IL-17 KO mice. Th17 cell transfer markedly increased the incidence of arthritis development in IL-17 KO mice. These results suggest that IL-17 acts as a key effector cytokine for leptin-mediated exacerbation of CIA development. (5). To identify whether leptin affects the inflammatory milieu of Th17 differentiation, we examined various cytokines in synovial fluid of intraarticularly leptin-injected mice. Significantly increased expression of IL-6 and TGF-β in synoviocytes was detected compared with non-treated CIA controls. Interestingly, we detected expression of leptin receptor in synovial cavity lining cells and synoviocytes, implying an important involvement of leptin signaling on modulating inflammatory microenvironment. (6). To further determine whether leptin also plays a critical role in Th17 generation in human patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA), we obtained joint tissues from healthy individuals and RA patients. We detected significantly higher levels of leptin in synoviocytes from RA patients compared to healthy controls by semi-quantitative and real-time PCR. Moreover, the mRNA levels of RANKL, TGF-β and IL-6 also markedly increased in RA patients, suggesting a role of leptin in modulating inflammatory responses in the joint of RA patients. Together, these results indicate that local increased leptin concentration contributes directly to the exacerbation of synovial inflammation and joint pathologic changes during CIA development.

772712.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
772712.value: Leptin, a peptide hormone produced by adipose tissue, has been identified as a key player in regulating nutrient intake and metabolism. Early studies have characterized a proinflammatory activity of leptin in regulating functions of various immune cells such as T cells, B cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells. Recent studies have demonstrated that IL-17, a potent proinflammatory cytokine produce by T cells, plays a critical role in the pathogenesis of autoimmune arthritis in both mice and humans. However, the microenvironmental factors that promote the differentiation of IL-17-producing T cells remain much less investigated. In this project, we found that leptin promotes IL-17-producing T cell generation by upregulating the transcription of Retinoic acid–related orphan nuclear receptor γt (ROR γt) and and Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (Stat3). Using a collagen-induced arthritis mouse model, we identified a critical role of leptin in accelerating autoimmune arthritis by promoting IL-17-producing T cell generation in the synovial tissue. These findings reveal a novel function of leptin in regulating T cell function and exacerbating autoimmune arthritis, which contributes to a fuller understanding of the physiological role of leptin in immune regulation and may facilitate the future design of alternative therapeutic strategies for the treatment of patients with RA and other autoimmune diseases.

773112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
773112.value: Low back pain is a major cause of disability and suffering globally. From our previous study, 60% of the local population has/had suffered from low back pain and intervertebral disc (IVD) degeneration is the major causes. Recently, whole IVD transplantation for disc degeneration has resulted in satisfactory graft union with improved neurological symptoms and preserved spinal motion in large animal and human being, however, mild degeneration of the allograft was observed, and the mechanism was still not fully understood. Although viable nucleus pulposus cells were found in the transplanted frozen allografts, the degeneration of the disc is believed to be due to the lack of timely nutrition supply. Apart from a sparse vascular supply to the outer lamellae of the annulus, the adult IVD is avascular and reliant on diffusion of nutrients and metabolites across the endplate. Nutrients are transported from the marginal capillaries to the disc cells while product of metabolism is removed reversely. Change in the homeostasis of nutritional environment is associated with disc degeneration; direct information on the pattern of nutrition flow across the endplate is yet to be unraveled because the sensitive measurement of nutrients and metabolites can only be made invasively. During IVD transplantation for disc regeneration, the endplate was preserved well; however, how the nutrition supply re-established is still unknown which may contributes to the mail degeneration of the allograft disc. The development of non-invasive magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) technologies has provided insights into evaluate IVD degeneration in routine clinical. Several new MRI technologies have been applied in to the disc assessment no-invasively, such as UTE MRI, DCE MRI and CEST. Combination of serial MRI technologies can be utilized to understand the nutrition pattern in disc degeneration and the reestablishment of nutritional pathways in the allograft disc. Thus, we propose to 1) to investigate the nutritional pathway of normal disc in a goat model using MRI-based technologies; 2) to apply imaging assessment of endplate function to assess how the endplate restores the nutritional pathways for disc degeneration prevention in allograft disc transplantation. Assessing the nutrients transportation using no-invasive techniques is impractical on a large scale in human patients; this proposal will utilize sate-of-art imaging technologies for the non-invasive and continual assessment of endplate function and nutrition transportation in large animal to validate potential application for early diagnosis of DDD and optimize disc transplantation strategies in human. 下腰痛是造成人群功能障礙的主要病因，椎間盤退變是引起下腰痛最常見的退化病變之一。目前，針對椎間盤退變尚無完美的治療手段。我們的研究表明，利用異體移植冷凍保存的椎間盤可以明顯改善頸椎病的臨床神經癥狀並保持頸椎的活動度。與椎體融合和人工椎間盤置換相比，椎間盤異體移植可能會成為椎間盤退變非常有效的生物學治療手段。但對於以往病例的5年內隨訪結果分析，我們發現部份移植後椎間盤發生退變，其具體機制尚不清楚；我們認為，異體椎間盤營養通道的及時恢復可能是其中主要的原因。 椎間盤的營養供給主要依賴於終板的滲透作用，同樣代謝產物也主要通過終板排出，如果這種營養平衡受到破壞，那麼椎間盤就會發生退變。在椎間盤異體移植的過程中，雖然終板是被完整保護的，但是移植後的營養通路重建機制尚不清楚。這也許能為延緩或阻止移植後椎間盤發生退變提供有效的依據。以目前現有的有創檢測手段，難於得到椎間盤營養通道的研究，本研究計畫建議使用無創的新型核磁共振技術（MRI）。 目前， MRI已成為臨床上椎間盤退變有效的診斷方法，一系列新的技術如已逐步的應用於椎間盤的評價上。聯用這些技術可以用於評價椎間盤營養的運輸模式以及異體移植椎間盤營養通道的重建。本項目的主要研究內容有以下兩個方面： 1） 以山羊為研究模型，用MRI技術評價正常椎間盤的營養運輸模式； 2） 評價終板在異體移植椎間盤中的作用及移植後椎間盤營養通路的重建機制。 通過該項目的研究，將可能為椎間盤早期退變提供無創MRI診斷技術；優化椎間盤的異體移植技術，為椎間盤退變的診斷和治療提供可靠的治療方法。

773112.label: Realisation of objectives
773112.value: 1. To investigate the nutritional pathway of normal disc in a goat model using MRI-based technologies. This is the final report for this grant. A series of MRI sequences (T1weighted, T2 weighted, T1rho, Dynamic contrast-enhanced (DCE), Ultrashort TE (UTE), and Chemical exchange saturation transfer (CEST)) were developed and compared in observing the anatomy of the lumbar intervertebral disc in goats. In considering the reproducibility and reliability of MRI results in this study, contrast-enhanced MRI (T1w) and UTE were proposed to investigate the nutritional pathway of the disc in a goat model. Therefore, contrast-enhanced MRI (T1w) was done to observe the nutrient channels in normal goats. In addition, based on the UTE data, a new computational method for cartilaginous endplate signal extraction and assessment was developed. The morphology, thickness distribution and signal intensity distribution of cartilaginous endplate could be well assessed. 2. To apply imaging assessment of endplate function to assess how the endplate restores the nutritional pathways for disc degeneration prevention in allograft disc transplantation. Using the goat model of lumbar disc allograft transplantation, reestablishment of the nutrient pathway was investigated. Healing and remodeling of the host-graft interfaces were conducted by radiography, micro-CT analysis and histological staining; changes in the bony endplate were evaluated by micro-CT analysis, histology and SEM-EDX mapping; the cartilaginous endplate was assessed by UTE-MRI scanning and histology. Additionally, the revascularization pattern of the disc allograft was investigated by histology. These anatomical investigations would help to understand the reestablishment of nutrient pathway and its role in the degeneration of disc allograft postoperatively. Nevertheless, continuous and dynamic imaging of the goats after disc allgrafting was not well conducted; also the nutrient perfusion of the disc allograft may be explored based on the recent development of the new sequence parameters.

773112.label: Major findings and research outcome
773112.value: 1) Disc allograft transplantation in goat model. The detailed surgical technique for lumbar intervertebral disc transplantation without internal fixation was successfully developed in a goat model (J6). Careful selection of size-matched disc allograft and meticulous preparation of the recipient sites were key elements to successful disc transplantation. Using the goat model of disc transplantation, it was demonstrated that the fresh-frozen disc transplantation could maintain the mobility of the functional spinal unit without adjacent segment degeneration (J5, C1&2). 2) The parameters of series MRI scanning for goat lumbar spine. A series of MRI technology to study the anatomy of goat lumbar spine was developed using a 3T Achieva scanner. The protocols for T1-weighted, T2-weighted, and Ultrashort TE (UTE) were validated. Based on the UTE data obtained from the goat lumbar spine, a new method for CEP signal extraction and assessment was developed (J2). The morphology, thickness distribution and signal intensity distribution were also obtained to facilitate CEP evaluation, which is useful for accurately qualitative and quantitative assessment of the CEP structure to understand the nutrient pathway of the postoperative disc allograft. 3) Healing and remodeling process after disc allograft transplantation; In the goat model of lumbar disc allografting, the bony endplate was well preserved initially, but gradually replaced by trabecular bone afterwards; on the other hand, the cartilaginous endplate became atrophic at 6 months and disappeared at the final follow-up. These findings (J4, C3, C4, C6) indicated alterations of the nutritional pathways, which may affect the normal nutrient supply. In addition, blood vessels were noted in the marrow space of the bony endplate and the outer annulus at 1.5 month postoperatively. Then, they needed to be able to penetrate to reach the cartilaginous endplate and the inner annulus after 6 months. Revascularisation has been found with a different pattern from adult normal discs, suggesting the typical nutrient diffusion pattern after transplantation (J3, C5). 4) Importance of nutrients in disc regeneration and transplantation Based on the above experiments, we reported the nutrient supply to normal discs and summarized how this supply is impeded in disc degeneration, outlined current approaches to biological repair of degenerate discs and highlighted the importance of nutrient balance (J1,J7). We discussed future research directions required for understanding how nutrient supply affects disc regeneration. We emphasized the importance of developing diagnostic criteria for determining whether biological repair in a patient is feasible or not.

773112.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
773112.value: 1) Further development of in vivo MRI sequences is needed to test the pH, endplate perfusion, GAG concentration in the normal discs; these new parameters would provide more information to understand the nutrient pathways and nutrient reestablishment of the postoperative allograft. 2) Loss of EP integrity was observed at 6 months after transplantation. Its reasons should be multifactorial. Further study can be designed to longitudinally monitor the morphology of both the bony and cartilaginous EPs in the disc allografts after transplantation. Furthermore, according to the histological results, in some cases, loss of bony EP integrity was found on only one side; it will thus be interesting to compare the cell behaviours in the damaged EP with those from the normal side. 3) With the established experimental platform, the intradiscal microenvironment will be assessed and monitored to identify disc allografts in which the microenvironment permits cell survival, matrix production and cell implantation.

773112.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
773112.value: Low back pain (LBP) is the major cause of disability worldwide and disc degeneration is one of the major causes. To replace the whole degenerated disc, we developed a disc allograft transplantation in the human cervical spine with acceptable outcomes. Nevertheless, many questions needed to be addressed before this new technique can be extended to lumbar spine to treat LBP, one of which is whether and how the transplanted disc obtains nutrients from the host vertebral bodies. In this project, above question was partially answered. We firstly developed a goat model for lumbar disc allograft transplantation. We found that the disc allograft was able to heal with the host bone, which was the first step to reestablish the nutrient pathway. As the key regulator for nutrients transportation into the disc, the endplate was well preserved initially but it was gradually disappeared afterwards. Additionally, host blood vessels were able to reach the bony endplate, outer annulus, and finally to approach the cartilaginous disc centre. In this project, we found that the nutrient channels of the disc allograft were altered which may affect the nutrition reestablishment postoperatively.

773412.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
773412.value: 肝细胞癌（HCC）在东南亚地区尤为常见。在香港，HCC是导致死亡的第二大疾病。高复发率和高转移率导致了HCC的总体预后不佳。因此，为了更有效地临床治疗这种高侵袭性疾病，鉴定有效的治疗靶点、发展新的治疗策略将必不可少。我们早前的研究发现， microRNA(miR)-130b过表达和肿瘤蛋白P53诱导的核蛋白1（TP53INP1)下调之间的平衡调控CD133+肝癌的发生、发展和自我更新（Ma et al., Cell Stem Cell 2010)。以上研究结果提示TP53INP1是驱动肝癌发生的一个关键效应分子。我们最近的关于TP53INP1在HCC中的作用的研究也显示，与非肿瘤肝组织相比，原发性肝癌组织中的TP53INP1普遍下调。TP53INP1的显著下调强烈提示TP53INP1在肝癌发生过程中起到肿瘤抑制的作用。稳定抑制TP53INP1基因在体外实验中能增强细胞增殖，在老鼠模型中能够促进肿瘤生长。我们目前的初步研究结果显示TP53INP1下调不仅仅诱导肿瘤形成，而且增强HCC浸润、诱导上皮细胞向间充质样细胞的形态学改变和促进上皮-间质转分化的标志物表达改变。进一步我们发现，在p53野生型（PLC8024)和突变型（H2P）肝癌细胞中，TP53INP1基因抑制能够减少鼠双微体2（MDM2）基因表达，同时上调Snail 和 Slug 表达。我们推测，TP53INP1除了具有肿瘤抑制作用，还可能通过涉及p53/p73-MDM2和下游EMT信号级联（Snail and Slug)的分子机制对HCC转移发挥重要作用。在以上研究的基础上，我们作出以下计划：1）利用体外实验和体内转移模型，确定TP53INP1在HCC转移过程中的功能效应；2）阐明TP53INP1介导HCC转移的内在机制；3）评估临床HCC肿瘤标本中TP53INP1表达的临床意义和预后价值。据我们所知，本研究在国际上 首次发现TP53INP1在HCC转移中的作用，同时也对TP53INP1在HCC转移过程中发挥的功能效应提供了强有力的体内实验证据。在野生型或突变/缺失型p53基因背景下，TP53INP1调节EMT和HCC转移的机制将会得到进一步研究。此外，根据本研究将会得到的TP53INP1的临床病理意义，TP53INP1有可能作为HCC患者治疗和预后新标志物。我们期望找到促进HCC疾病进展的新分子途径，并且在这些分子靶标基础上发展HCC治疗新策略。

773412.label: Realisation of objectives
773412.value: TP53INP1 is down-regulated in advanced stage and metastatic HCC tumors. We first evaluated the expression of TP53INP1 transcripts in two public gene expression databases. We found that in advanced stage HCC samples (Stage IV of AJCC and TNM) that is more likely associated with recurrence and metastasis , the expression of TP53INP1 was significantly lower than that in early stage samples (Stages I, II and III) (GSE25097). In a second, independent data set (GSE40367) that compares metastatic free HCCs and HCCs with extrahepatic metastases, we also observed significantly lower expression of TP53INP1 in HCC samples with extrahepatic metastases. To confirm these observations experimentally, we carried out immunohistochemical analyses in 37 pairs of matched primary and metastatic HCC tissue samples. Consistently, TP53INP1 was found to be down-regulated in metastatic HCC. Only 28/37 metastatic HCC samples were strong or moderately positive for TP53INP1 and 9 were weak or negative. In contrast, moderate or strong immune positivity for TP53INP1 was present in all 37/37 primary HCC cases, suggesting that a down-regulation of TP53INP1 expression is involved in HCC metastasis. We then carried out Western Blot analyses in a panel of immortalized normal liver and HCC cell lines. The expression of TP53INP1 was high in the immortalized normal liver and hepatoblastoma cells, while 7/8 HCC cell lines examined displayed significantly lower or undetectable levels of TP53INP1 expression. TP53INP1 knockdown promotes HCC metastasis. To assess the functional role of TP53INP1 in cancer cells, we knocked down expression of TP53INP1 in immortalized normal liver cells MIHA and HCC cells MHCC97L using two TP53INP1-specific shRNA lentiviruses (sh-TP53INP1 464 and 3834). Efficient TP53INP1 knockdown was confirmed by Western Blot. We found that TP53INP1 shRNA-expressing cells had a significantly enhanced ability to migrate and invade compared with control cells. To confirm these findings, we further examined the effects of TP53INP1 expression in an in vivo experimental metastasis model where cells were orthotopically injected into the liver for observation of metastasis to the lung. TP53INP1 suppression induced a potent increase in the ability of MHCC97L cells to not only form tumors in the liver, but also metastasize to the lung (sh-464: 7/10 tumors formed in the liver with 6 developing extrahepatic metastasis in the lung; sh-3834: 8/10 tumors formed in the liver with 4 developing extrahepatic metastasis in the lung). In contrast, MHCC97L control cells only resulted in tumor growth in the liver in 6/10 mice injected, with only 2 mice going on to develop lung metastasis. Mice were sacrificed after 8 weeks and both livers and lungs were removed for histological analyses. H&E staining of the tumors confirmed the bioluminescence signals observed to indeed represent tumor cells and that there is altered ability of the cells to metastasize to the lung as evident by increased number of tumor nodules present there. Phopsho-kinase array profiling analysis identifies activation of ERK to be involved in TP53INP1-mediated HCC metastasis. To elucidate the molecular mechanism of TP53INP1 in regulating HCC metastasis, a Proteome Profiler Human Phospho-Kinase Array Kit was utilized to compare the relative levels of 43 human protein kinase phosphorylation between HCC cells with or without TP53INP1 knocked down. Altogether, 6 phospho-kinases were found altered, of which only pERK1/2 could be validated to be commonly overexpressed in both MIHA and MHCC97L cells. To further validate the role of pERK1/2 signaling in TP53INP1 regulated metastasis, we analyzed the impact of introducing an ERK inhibitor (U0126) or stable shRNA against ERK1/2 into HCC cells with TP53INP1 stably repressed on these altered metastatic phenotype. Introduction of U0126 or sh-ERK1/2 in TP53INP1 suppressed HCC cells attenuated in vitro cell migration and invasion abilities, as well as lung metastasis in vivo, suggesting that ERK signaling is needed to drive metastasis in TP53INP1 deficient HCC. TP53INP1 inhibits HCC metastasis through DUSP10-dependent modulation of ERK. Dual-specificity MAP kinase (MAPK) phosphatases (MKPs or DUSPs) are well-established negative regulators of MAPK/ERK signaling in mammalian cells and tissues. The MKPs constitute a distinct subgroup of eleven catalytically active enzymes within the larger family of DUSPs, which all share a conserved cluster of basic amino acid residues involved in MAPK recognition. A screen of these DUSP members at the genomic level by qRT-PCR in HCC cells with or without TP53INP1 suppressed identified DUSP10/MKP-5 to be consistently down-regulated in both MIHA and MHCC97L cells following TP53INP1 knock down. This observation was further validated at the proteomic level by Western Blot where DUSP10 was found to be significantly down-regulated, concomitant with p-ERK1/2 activation in TP53INP1 shRNA-expressing cells as compared with control cells. To further validate the role of DUSP10-mediated pERK1/2 signaling in TP53INP1 regulated metastasis, rescue experiments where DUSP10 was re-introduced into HCC cells with TP53INP1 stably repressed was carried out. Introduction of DUSP10 in TP53INP1 suppressed HCC cells resulted in a marked decrease in phosphorylated ERK concomitant with attenuated abilities of HCC cells to migrate and invade in vitro, suggesting that down-regulation of DUSP10 could alter p-ERK1/2 expression and activity by dephosphorylation in TP53INP1 low/absent HCC cells to promote metastasis. Consistently, we also observed a significantly lower expression of DUSP10 in human HCC samples with extrahepatic metastases as compared to metastatic free HCC samples in the GSE40367 dataset and that TP53INP1 and DUSP10 expression to positively correlate with each other (R=0.4152; p=0.0001) in these samples. p73, which transcriptional activity is known to be modulated by TP53INP1, binds and regulates DUSP10 via promoter binding and cooperatively drive ERK activation in HCC. To determine the link between TP53INP1 and DUSP10 mediated ERK signaling in regulating HCC metastasis, the upstream region of DUSP10 (-1 to -4400) was analyzed using JASPAR. Four predicted binding sites of p73, which activity is known to be modified by TP53INP1, was found in the upstream region of DUSP10, with a high relative score of >0.75. ChIP assays showed high physical binding affinity of endogenous p73 to DUSP10 in MHCC97L cells in two of the four predicted sites. To delineate the involvement of TP53INP1 in the regulation of p73 activity and its subsequent binding to the promoter of DUSP10, we knocked down TP53INP1 in MHCC97L and repeated the ChIP assay again. Silencing of TP53INP1 attenuated binding of p73 to DUSP10 promoter in the same two binding sites, suggesting that TP53INP1 does indeed play a role in modulating the binding affinity of p73 to the DUSP10 promoter. Notably, both MIHA liver and MHCC97L HCC cell lines that were used for functional experiments in our current study are either p53 absent (MIHA) or mutant (MHCC97L). Both cell types are however p73 wild type. Luciferase reporter assays showed high transcriptional activity of endogenous p73 to DUSP10 in MHCC97L cells, as knockdown of p73 would decrease the activation of DUSP10 promoter by two folds. Stable knockdown of p73 in MHCC97L cells led to a marked decrease in DUSP10 and concomitant increase in pERK1/2 expression. Further, we found stable TP53INP1 knockdown in MHCC97L cell to also result in a similar decrease in DUSP10 promoter activation. Taken together, TP53INP1 can enhance p73 ability to drive DUSP10 transcription, thereby altering downstream ERK signaling to drive HCC metastasis. In HCC tumors where p73 mutations are rarely observed, TP53INP1 down-regulation promotes HCC metastasis through DUSP10 inactivation via p73-dependent DUSP10 promoter binding and regulation, resulting in activation of the ERK signaling pathway.

773412.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
773412.value: The recurrence and metastasis of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) portends a poor prognosis and represents important clinical challenges. There is a great need to identify critical factors involved in HCC metastasis that will facilitate the development of new therapeutic strategies. Here, we showed that tumor protein 53 inducible nuclear protein 1 (TP53INP1) is frequently down-regulated in advanced stage IV and metastatic human HCC tumors as compared with early stage (I-III) and primary HCCs. Functionally, down-regulation of TP53INP1 in HCC promoted metastasis through DUSP10-dependent activation of the ERK pathway. Importance of DUSP10 inactivation and ERK activation in TP53INP1-mediated HCC was experimentally substantiated with rescue experiments where HCC cells with or without TP53INP1 stably suppressed were co-expressed with DUSP10 ectopic expression, short hairpin (sh)RNA ERK1/2 knockdown or co-treated with an ERK inhibitor U0126. Subsequent analysis of the DUSP10 promoter region by open-access database revealed four putative binding sites for p73, of which transcriptional activity has previously been found to be modulated by TP53INP1. Chromatin immunoprecipitation and luciferase reporter assays collectively demonstrated that p73 regulates DUSP10 via promoter binding and that TP53INP1 plays a critical in this process via modulating p73 transcriptional activity. Conclusion: TP53INP1 down-regulation promotes HCC metastasis through a p73-dependent DUSP10/ERK signaling pathway.

773612.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
773612.value: 慢性阻塞性肺病是一種複雜的疾病，其特徵是逐漸加劇的氣流阻塞，肺泡壁被破壞，這是伴隨促炎症細胞流入的不完全可逆的慢性氣道炎症。預計到二零二零年, 慢性阻塞性肺病將成為全球第三大致死疾病, 這必將帶來巨大的社會和經濟負擔。儘管慢性阻塞性肺病的確切發病機制尚不清楚，但仍有一些機制被認為具有重要的影響：如增強的慢性氣道炎症，氧化/抗氧化劑和蛋白酶/抗蛋白酶失衡。由於高濃度自由基充斥，所以吸煙成為慢性阻塞性肺病的主要危險因素。目前，還未有具體的治療方法來阻止吸煙的惡化進程，除了戒煙，新的慢性阻塞性肺病潛在靶向治療方法尚未滿足目前的需要。五羥色胺能使支氣管收縮，在肺功能中起著重要的作用。雖然現有證據表明，大部分循環的五羥色胺在經過肺部的時候被清除，但五羥色胺在肺的生物活性尚未清楚。有證據顯示五羥色胺系統在哮喘的病理生理中起著對氣道重塑的生長和維護作用，這是在慢性阻塞性肺病中尚未清楚的。我們假設，代謝中消融而增加的五羥色胺，刺激在呼吸道中特定的五羥色胺受體2A而導致細胞損傷。我們將檢驗這一假設，在體外和在大鼠模型體內檢測香煙煙霧刺激呼吸道上皮和平滑肌細胞而導致細胞損傷的時間過程。我們將首先確定香煙煙霧培養液誘導的人類氣道上皮細胞的改變或平滑肌細胞活性氧的產生，及促炎性細胞因子的表達和細胞凋亡的發生，並在體外實驗中使用五羥色胺作對比。使用特定的五羥色胺受體激動劑或拮抗劑，選擇性抑制劑或活化劑，以確定潛在的治療目標，最終闡明其信號通路。繼而用接觸過香煙煙霧的大鼠作進一步研究，利用生物化學、分子生物學、組織學和免疫組織化學技術來檢測血清學指標，呼吸道形態及肺實質的改變，並利用全身體積描記法檢測動物的肺功能,以比較特定的療法治療前後肺功能和肺損傷的情況。這項研究將為五羥色胺平衡與香煙煙霧誘導的慢性阻塞性肺病的關係提供重要的理論基礎，並可能為廣泛氣道阻塞之前阻止或減緩氣道受阻或受損的進程提供治療方向。

773612.label: Realisation of objectives
773612.value: Objective 1: For the in vitro cigarette smoke medium (CSM)-exposed airway epithelial models, we have successfully detected the presence of MAOs (MAO-A and MAO-B) mRNAs by semi-quantitative RT-PCR, protein expression by Western blot analysis, and activity by biochemical assay in the cell lysates of BEAS-2B cells. We also localized 5-HTR2A on the cell surface of BEAS-2B cells immunofluorescent staining. For the in vivo CS-exposed rat model, the distributions of MAOs (MAO-A and MAO-B) and 5-HT receptor 2A (5-HTR2A) were localized in rat lung sections using immunehistochemistry. Due to the unsuitability of anti-serotonin transporter (SERT or 5-HTT) antibody, we were unable to detect or to localize this protein in bronchial epithelial cells or rat lung sections. Objective 2: Elevated levels of serum 5-HT but not bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BAL) 5-HT were found in the in vivo CS-exposed rat model, which was reversed by the pretreatment with a known antioxidant, epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG), in relation to the degree of lung injury. Objective 3: For the in vitro model, we have evaluated the downstream signaling pathways after CSM, 5-HT or an analog of 5-HT, i.e. serotonin creatinine sulfate monohydrate (SCSM) exposure in BEAS-2B cells. Primary human normal bronchial epithelial cells (NBECs) and tracheal epithelial cells (NTECs) were further used to verify the findings in BEAS-2B cells. Objective 4: For the in vitro model, we have identified that ROS production is a prerequisite for inflammatory response in BEAS-2B cells, along with the induction of phase II enzymes, NAD(p)H:quione oxidoreductase 1 (NQO1) and heme oxygenase 1 (HO-1) after CSM or SCSM exposure. Selective inhibitors such as TEMPO (a free radical scavenger), U0126 (an ERK inhibitor) and SB203580 (a p38 MAPK inhibitor) were found to inhibit 5-HT-induced IL-8 release in BEAS-2B cells. In addition, selegiline (a selective MAO-B inhibitor), produced anti-inflammatory effects on CSM-induced release of IL-8 in BEAS-2B cells. For the in vivo model, we found induction of NQO1 after either CS exposure or treatment with EGCG alone, in agreement with the in vitro data. Objective 5: Pulmonary function test using non-invasive whole-body plethysmography (WBP) was carried out at 1 month and 2 months after CS exposure, which found to be increased in Penh, representing resistance of the airways in comparison to sham air-exposed group.
