785612.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
785612.value: One of the important lessons learnt from the 2009 pandemic H1N1 outbreak is that the domestic pig could serve independently as a ‘mixing vessel’ to facilitate the genesis of a human pandemic strain. Another lesson learnt is that a virus with the same subtype as current human seasonal influenza viruses could still cause a pandemic if their antigenicity is significantly different. After prevailing in humans, the 2009 pandemic H1N1 (pdm/09) virus has been repeatedly transmitted back to pigs and frequently reassorted with other endemic swine viruses to generate novel variants. Our ongoing surveillance has shown that the pdm/09-like virus was frequently detected, and that novel H3N2 and H1N1 reassortant viruses with surface genes from swine viruses and internal genes from the pdm/09-like virus were generated, in pigs in southern China in 2010. More recent findings suggest that these novel reassortant viruses might have become established in the pig population of this region. In the post-pandemic phase, questions and concerns include: 1) whether the pdm/09-like virus will evolve into an endemic virus in pigs; 2) how the recently generated swine reassortant variants evolve and whether they will become established in this host; and 3) whether such reassortants will pose a threat to humans. Here we propose, based on our surveillance data, to elucidate the process leading to the development of novel lineages of swine viruses; to examine the bases of their pathogenicity and transmissibility in domestic pigs; and further to investigate their potential pathogenicity and transmissibility in humans using the ferret model. The information generated in this proposal will provide a comprehensive understanding of the evolution of these novel swine influenza viruses and a systematic risk assessment for their potential to infect humans. The findings may also provide insights into the emergence of the pdm/09 virus. 2009年新甲型H1N1大流感（pdm/09）的爆發，為世人提出了兩項重要的警示：（1）家豬可以作為“混合器”，獨立促成人類大流感流行株的形成；（2）只要抗原性差異足夠明顯，大流行流感可以由和當前季節性流感病毒具有相同亞型的毒株引起。自2009年新型H1N1爆發以來，該病毒已經反復多次在家豬中被檢測到，它和各地流行的豬病毒頻繁發生重組，并已產生了不少變異株。 根據本課題組在華南地區豬群中持續進行的流感病毒監測結果，pdm/09樣病毒可以被頻繁檢測到；2010年，豬群中出現了H3N2和H1N1兩種新型突變體，它們的內部基因全部來自於pdm/09樣病毒，但表面基因來自於其他的豬流感病毒。最近的監測數據表明，這兩種變異病毒很可能已經在本地區豬群中流行開來。 進入后流感大流行時期（post-pandemic period）后，人們關注的問題包括：1）2009大流感樣病毒是否會在家豬中進化成一種地方性流感病毒；2）近期產生的新型豬流感病毒重組變種的進化情況如何，它們是否會在豬群中形成穩定的病毒系（lineage）；以及3）這些新的豬流感重組變種，會不會對人類搆成威脅。 本項目的研究目標是，以我們的流感監測資料為基礎，系統闡明豬流感新病毒系的形成和發展規律；研究這類病毒在家豬中的致病性、傳播性及相關的分子機制；利用雪貂動物模型，進一步探討和評估這些病毒感染人類并在人群中致病、傳播的可能性。 本研究的結果和數據不僅可以幫助我們深入了解新型豬流感病毒的進化方式，系統評估豬流感病毒感染人類的潛力和風險，還可能為2009新型H1N1病毒的形成途徑提出新的解釋。

785612.label: Realisation of objectives
785612.value: - To address Objective 1, we have sequenced each of the swine influenza virus (SIV) isolates (n=1158) obtained from our surveillance in Hong Kong and mainland China since the 2009 pandemic (pdm/09) outbreak. Systematic phylogenetic analysis was conducted to understand the evolution and lineage development of the pdm/09-like swine influenza virus and its reassortants. A manuscript reporting the first 387 whole genomic sequences of the SIVs isolated during 2009-2012 has been published in Journal of Virology (Liang et al, 2014), revealing 17 reassortant genotypes with the pdm/09-like genes. A follow-up study sequenced the remaining 771 SIVs and found 27 genotypes during 2012-2015. Manuscripts are now under preparation. Clear genotypic and lineage replacement were observed in SIVs after the introduction of pdm/09 viruses into the swine population. Even though the purely 2009 pandemic virus and its surface genes cannot persist, its internal genes have become established and are now the predominant lineages in local pigs, replacing the previously enzootic swine influenza virus lineages and generating lots of new reassortant variants. Purely avian-like and human-like SIVs were also obtained sporadically in the pigs, some with altered hemagglutination characteristics and posing renewal threats to the agricultural and public health. - To address Objectives 2 and 3, we selected representative strains from the most prevalent lineages with the novel reassortant genotypes, to test for their pathogenicity and transmissibility in the swine and ferret models. We also tested the virus infectivity and growth properties using different cell culture models or ex vivo lung tissue models, using the pdm/09, enzootic SIVs or human seasonal H3N2 influenza virus as the controls. It was found that the novel swine H3N2 and H1N1 reassortant viruses established recently in south China could efficiently transmit and cause mild disease within experimentally exposed pigs. They could also cross the species barrier to infect ferrets via airborne exposure. Though efficient in direct contact transmission in ferrets, the reasortant H3N2 virus with internal genes derived from the pdm/09 viruses only showed limited airborne transmissibility from ferret to ferret. The potential for this H3N2 virus to infect humans cannot be excluded, but its airborne transmissibility was expected to be much lower than those of the contemporary human seasonal H3N2 and pdm/09 viruses. However, a novel H1N1 virus possessing surface genes from the European avian-like (EA) lineage but internal genes from the pdm/09 viruses showed efficient airborne transmissibility both in pigs and in ferrets, to a level comparable to the prototype pdm/09 virus. This novel reasortant H1N1 virus may pose an increased risk to human beings, as current human population is mostly immunologically naïve to this virus. Serologcial survey and infection studies in a swine model found that a newly identified avian-like H3N2 virus detected in Guangxi province was just an opportunistic deadend virus introduced into pigs. It could neither efficiently replicate in the respiratory tract of the pigs, nor transmit among this mammalian species. A pdm/09-like H1N1 virus with reduced hemagglutination titers (i.e. the low-HA variant) showed decreased infectivity, pathogenicity and transmissibility in the mammalian models. The virus was also found to be a transient variant that just opportunistically occurred during the virus evolution. - To address Objective 4, we first identified gene segments or amino acid residues that might be associated with the altered pathogenicity and transmissibility, based on the previous epidemiological, experimental and phylogenetic studies. We then used reverse genetic techniques to reconstruct viruses with the mutated residues or reassorted gene segments. Infection experiments were subsequently conducted to evaluate the change of virus infectivity, pathogenicity and transmissibility. We have now identified a number of amino acids that occurred during the genesis of the low-HA variant, and found that these residues may be responsible for the receptor binding. Compensative mutations may occur at different sites in the neighboring regions, to recover the virus hemagglutination capacity. We also found that introduction of the pdm/09-like internal gene cassette to the H3N2 and EA-like H1N1 viruses could enhance the virus infectivity and pathogenicity in mice. The EA-like H1N1 surface genes (HA and NA) conferred significantly higher virulence to the mice when compared with the H3N2 surface genes. Compatibility of the surface genes with the internal genes contributed to the virus fitness and replication in the mammalian host. Overall, we have sufficiently addressed all objectives proposed in this project, and have further developed our research capacity by establishing and optimizing several experimental and analytic platforms. These include the optimization of the next generation sequencing methodology and a sequence assembly platform, and the development of some in-house programs, tools and data analysis pipelines that facilitate the large-scale evolutionary studies and display of the huge phylogenetic trees. Continuous surveillance and monitoring of the swine influenza virus evolution in the field, combined with timely risk assessment of the emerging variants, will define their epizootic potential and threats both to agriculture and human health.

785612.label: Major findings and research outcome
785612.value: From 2009 to 2012, a total of 387 SIVs (1.04%) were isolated from 37,213 swabs and sequenced. Although the purely pdm/09 virus and its surface genes cannot persist, its internal genes have established and are now predominant in pigs, replacing the enzootic EA- or triple reassortant-like internal genes (Liang et al, J Virol, 2014). From 2012 to 2015, a total of 771 viruses (1.4%) were isolated from 55,772 swabs, with 27 genotypes identified. Genotypes with pdm/09-like internal genes contributed to over 90% of the total isolates, which showed good compatibility with different surface genes. The altered diversity of the SIV gene pool needs to be closely monitored for changes in the potential for transmission to humans. An established H3N2 reassortant virus with pdm/09-like internal genes efficiently transmited and caused mild disease in pigs. It could also be transmitted from pigs to airborne exposed ferrets, but only showed limited airborne transmissibility within ferrets. The potential for this virus to infect humans cannot be excluded, but its airborne transmissibility was expected to be lower than those of the contemporary human seasonal H3N2 and pdm/09 viruses. However, a novel H1N1 virus possessing EA-like surface genes and pdm/09-like internal genes showed efficient airborne transmissibility both in pigs and in ferrets, to a level comparable to the prototype pdm/09 virus. This novel reasortant H1N1 virus may pose an increased risk to humans, as current human population is mostly immunologically naïve to this virus. Several purely avian-like H3N2 or human H1N1 like virus isolates were found to be dead-end infections in pigs, as sustained transmission and infection cannot be observed either in the herd or in the animal models. A pdm/09-like H1N1 virus with reduced hemagglutination titers was found to have a reduced receptor binding to red blood cells and a decreased infectivity, pathogenicity and transmissibility in mammals. Introduction of the pdm/09-like internal gene cassette to the H3N2 and EA-like H1N1 viruses could enhance the virus infectivity and pathogenicity in mice. The EA-like H1N1 surface genes (HA and NA) conferred significantly higher virulence to the mice when compared to the H3N2 surface genes. Compatibility of the surface genes with the internal genes contributed to the virus fitness and replication in the mammalian host. Capacity in large-scale whole genomic sequencing and evolutionary analysis has been established, with 10 RPg students trained and several softwares developed for the sequence analysis and phylogeny display.

785612.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
785612.value: As the swine influenza viruses continue to circulate, close monitoring of the virus prevalence, evolution and risks posed on agriculture and public health is warranted. Potential molecular signatures identified through the systematic evolution and animal experiments can be tested, using reverse genetic technique and functional studies.

785612.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
785612.value: Pigs have long been considered as “mixing vessels”, facilitating reassortment events among avian, swine and human influenza viruses. These might lead to generation of novel viruses capable of infecting humans and even causing a pandemic, as exemplified by the emergence of the 2009 H1N1 pandemic (pdm/09). After prevailing in humans, the pdm/09 virus has been repeatedly transmitted back to pigs and reassorted with other enzootic swine influenza viruses (SIVs) to generate novel variants with potential to infect humans. This RGC funded project conducted systematic analysis on the evolution and genotypic changes of the SIVs isolated from our long-term surveillance program, and revealed that with the introduction of pdm/09 virus into the swine population, a marked change has occurred to the evolutionary patterns and ecosystem of SIVs in China. The pdm/09-like internal genes have become established and predominant in pigs, replacing the previously circulating lineages and generating lots of new reassortant variants. Some of these variants showed increased infectivity, transmissibility and pathogenicity in the mammalian models. The information generated by this project provides a better understanding of the evolution and lineage development of the SIVs and the threat they pose to humans. Continuous surveillance and timely risk assessment of the novel SIVs will help to inform the disease control and prevention.

785812.label: Project Title(Chinese)
785812.value: 應用磁場刺激治療中風後吞嚥障礙研究計劃

785812.label: Project Objectives
785812.value: To determine the short and long-term effects of high-frequency Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation on tongue and swallowing functions (oral and pharyngeal phases) in post-stroke individuals with oropharyngeal dysphagia.
rows: To determine the short and long-term effects of high-frequency Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation on tongue and swallowing functions (oral and pharyngeal phases) in post-stroke individuals with oropharyngeal dysphagia.

785812.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
785812.value: 吞嚥障礙是指食物或飲品從口腔進入胃部的過程中出現了問題。臨床上常見吞嚥障礙的症狀包括進食時食物從口腔溜出，不能把食物吞下和進食時咳嗽。吞嚥障礙可能會導致營養不良、脫水、吸入性肺炎、降低生活質素，甚至危及生命。醫學研究指出高達六成的中風人仕會出現短期的吞嚥障礙，約五成的中風人仕會出現長期的吞嚥障礙。 吞嚥障礙是第四個最常見的中風後遺症。吞嚥障礙的其中一個病因是舌頭功能變弱。最近的研究顯示，強化舌頭功能的訓練可改善中風後的吞嚥能力。不幸的是，有吞嚥困難的中風康復者可能同時有認知、溝通或口腔肌肉功能問題以致他們不能跟從指示進行練習。因此，有必要尋找其他治療吞嚥障礙的方法。 重複高頻透顱磁場刺激（rTMS）是一種無創性的腦刺激方法，能夠調節大腦皮層的神經活動。rTMS治療已被用於改善中風後的運動功能。初步研究顯示，rTMS可改善中風康復者的吞嚥功能。但是這些研究只函括少量的參加者，並採用了較簡單的臨床吞嚥功能檢查。因此需要更有力的證據去証明磁場刺激對改善中風康復者的吞嚥功能的效用。 本項研究旨在探討重複高頻透顱磁場刺激對改善中風康復者吞嚥功能的短期和長期效能。參加者人數會隨之增加至66人，參加者會隨機分為兩組：實驗組（n = 33）會接受高頻透顱磁場刺激來增加控制舌頭運動的皮層活動；對照組（n = 33）會接受模擬高頻透顱磁場刺激。除了臨床吞嚥功能檢查，評估方法還包括口腔肌能測試、X光鋇餐吞嚥檢查及生活質素問卷調查。本項研究推測實驗組的舌頭和吞嚥功能會有顯著改善，但對照組則沒有顯著改善。

785812.label: Realisation of objectives
785812.value: The project achieved the objectives in determining the short-term (2 months) and long-term (6 months to 1 year) effects of high-frequency repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (rTMS) on tongue and swallowing functions in chronic post-stroke individuals. A total of 21 post-stroke individuals completed the study. The participants were assigned to a genuine rTMS group (n=17) and a sham rTMS group (n=4). Although group analysis did not find any statistically significant treatment effects across time, individual analysis revealed that 10 out of the 17 participants in the treatment group had improved swallowing functions 2 months after rTMS and the improvement was maintained up to six months and 1 year after rTMS in 6 of these participants. Interestingly, the tongue strength did not improve across time in all individuals. The project concluded that rTMS has the potential to improve the long-term swallowing functions in post-stroke individuals. However, it is hypothesised that post-stroke individuals may react to rTMS differently, depending on their cortical excitability, lesion sites and baseline swallowing functions. This hypothesis is in line with the most recent rTMS treatment protocol in the literature, which proposed an individualised stimulation protocol based on the daily cortical activities of the participants. In addition, the findings of this project did not support the use of rTMS as the only treatment method for improving tongue and swallowing functions. The fact that the participants did not improve in the tongue strength suggests that active tongue strengthening exercises are still needed to bring about tongue strength improvement in post-stroke individuals. Future study may examine the effect of rTMS as an adjunct treatment method rather than as the sole treatment method for post-stroke swallowing functions. The major obstacle faced in this project was difficulty in recruiting stroke survivors who had swallowing problems and were able to meet all the exclusion and inclusion criteria. rTMS has strict safety guidelines which excluded individuals who had a history of epilepsy, were on anti-depressants and had any types of metal implants (including those from heart and brain surgeries). These criteria excluded many stroke individuals who were interested in joining the study. The Principal Investigator tried to overcome this difficulty by expanding the recruitment network. Open recruitment announcements were made regularly in the media, through free screenings at community centers and nursing homes and seeking referrals from geriatricians, neurologists and speech therapists from public hospitals. Unfortunately, it was still not possible to reach the targeted participants (n=66). The smaller than expected sample size limited the power of the study and this could have led to the statistically insignificant treatment changes across time. To compensate for the small sample size, an additional 38 healthy adults across the age span (18-78 years old) were included as controls when examining the cortical excitability of the tongue muscles. Statistically significant differences were found in the cortical excitability (as reflected by the resting motor thresholds) between young and old healthy adults and between healthy and post-stroke individuals. This finding confirmed that the post-stroke individuals needed to increase their cortical excitability in order to improve their tongue and swallowing functions. The project then further examined the cortical excitability changes in 6 post-stroke participants who were receiving genuine rTMS. It was found that rTMS was able to increase the cortical excitability in the post-stroke participants after 1 session and 10 sessions of rTMS, such changes were maintained up to 6 months post rTMS. These findings supported the use of rTMS as a treatment method to improve the long-term cortical excitability in post-stroke individuals. Future studies may further compare the changes in cortical excitability and cortical activities after rTMS and tongue strengthening exercises.

785812.label: Major findings and research outcome
785812.value: The study found that rTMS did not lead to significant improvement in tongue and swallowing functions when examining the participants as a group. However, upon individual analysis, 10 out of 17 participants who received rTMS had improved swallowing functions. The improvement was maintained up to 1 year in 6 of these participants. In addition, the study found that post-stroke participants had significantly lower cortical excitability than their healthy age-matched controls. rTMS was able to increase the cortical excitability in the post-stroke participants after the first and 10th session of rTMS. The increased excitability was maintained up to 6 months. It is concluded that rTMS has the potential to increase the cortical excitability in chronic (more than 1 year) post-stroke individuals and such increased excitability may facilitate improvement in swallowing functions. It is recommended that rTMS is used as an adjunct treatment for swallowing functions, together with active strengthening exercises rather than using rTMS as the only treatment modality. The overall treatment effect was published in the Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine in 2017. A manuscript related to the cortical excitability of healthy individuals and post-stroke individuals will be submitted to Clinical Neurophysiology by mid-July 2017. The study was also presented in 7 international conferences, including swallowing disorders related conferences and brain stimulation related conferences.

785812.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
785812.value: The Principal Investigator plans on submitting another proposal on rTMS in the next round of GRF application (2017/2018). A reliable method for examining the cortical excitability of the tongue muscles was developed in the current study and it was shown that the excitability changed with age, stroke and rTMS treatment. Further study may compare the effect of rTMS and active exercises on facilitating cortical changes in both healthy and post-stroke individuals. The future study may use the equipment and outcome measurements technique that were acquired and refined in the current study.

785812.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
785812.value: The research project aimed at examining the short- and long-term effect of using repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) to improve the swallowing functions in post-stroke individuals. rTMS is a non-invasive external stimulation method to modulate brain activity. It was hypothesized that stroke patients who had reduced tongue and swallowing functions had reduced activity in the brain region that controls tongue movement. The use of rTMS was to increase the brain activity in such brain region with the aim to improve tongue and swallowing functions. A total of 21 post-stroke individuals participated in the study, 17 of them received genuine rTMS and 4 of them received sham rTMS. The participants were assessed 1 week before rTMS, 2 months, 6 months and 1 year after rTMS. Individual analysis of the participants' swallowing functions revealed that 10 out of the 17 participants who received rTMS had improved swallowing functions and 6 of them were able to maintain such improvement 1 year after rTMS. The study recommended that rTMS is used as a supplemental treatment method for improving swallowing functions in post-stroke individuals. Further study is needed to identify how rTMS may help to improve the effect of active behavioural swallowing exercises.

786012.label: Project Title(Chinese)
786012.value: 心電圖PR段與心血管健康及死亡風險研究: 神經內分泌及遺傳隨機的影響

786012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
786012.value: PR interval of the electrocardiogram (ECG) is an estimate of atrioventricular conduction. PR interval prolongation, traditionally defined as duration >200 millisecond, is a common abnormality. While there was longstanding perception that PR prolongation has a “benign” nature with no implications for adverse clinical sequelae, latest data opposes this traditional school of thought by showing that otherwise healthy persons who have prolonged PR interval are at substantially increased risk for adverse clinical outcomes including incident atrial fibrillation, pacemaker implantation, and all-cause mortality. Nevertheless, causality cannot be inferred from conventional observational studies, and underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Recently, our pilot study showed interesting preliminary data which may shed light on the pathogenic mechanisms of PR prolongation. Conducted in 83 young healthy subjects free of cardiovascular disease, this pilot demonstrates for the first time that abnormal vascular function is seen in healthy subjects with lone PR prolongation, thus pointing towards the existence of an intermediate pathologic stage in these individuals prior to the occurrence of clinical cardiovascular events. Strikingly, such association was present even in the conventional normal range of PR interval <200ms. Based on this novel data, we hypothesize a patho-physiological mechanistic model in which PR prolongation is causal for cardiovascular death and abnormal vascular function, through activations of the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS). We will test this model by carrying out two complimentary but independent sub-studies in a large population-based prospective study: the Guangzhou Biobank Cohort Study (GBCS). Firstly, using the recently identified genetic polymorphisms associated with PR prolongation, we will conduct a Mendelian randomization study in 8000 subjects, which allows minimally-biased, translational interpretation of data (genetic polymorphisms, measurable ECG changes, and vascular/ clinical endpoints) to elucidate the causal role of PR prolongation in cardiovascular death and abnormal vascular function, and examine the underlying mediating mechanisms. Additionally, we will carry out a nested case-control study in which 250 subjects with extreme ECG phenotype (PR interval >200ms) will be compared against 1000 controls (PR interval <160ms) to maximize the potential to detect any observable differences in vascular function and echocardiogram findings. Specific serum analyses of RAAS activation will be tested for mediating pathway. This proposal presents the unique opportunity to provide timely, ground-breaking evidence to the causal role of PR prolongation in cardiovascular death and abnormal vascular function. This will certainly impact on clinical practice by helping re-define the “norm” of PR interval, and potentially identify important mediating targets for therapeutic interventions. 心電圖為普遍應用的臨床心臟健康檢查，而心電圖PR段是心電傳導的一種指標。當中，心電圖PR段過長是很普遍的醫學現象，並一直理解為對健康無礙的自然差異。但是最近有研究顯示，患有心電圖PR段過長的人，其房顫及死亡的風險大增，箇中原因不明。 最近，我們的先導性臨床試驗(於83位健康人仕進行)首次發現，血管功能的異常跟心電圖PR段過長有著密切的關係，或對病變的演進有著重要的啟示，並且此異常觀察竟見於PR段低於200ms (傳統正常標準)。建基於此觀察，我們提出一個病理機制模型，假定心電圖PR段過長會誘發神經內分泌的上調，繼而導致血管功能異常及心血管病猝死。 我們將會於＜穗港英合作研究: 廣州生物庫＞進行兩個互為表裡、但獨立的研究來測試此假定以及病理機制模型。利用心電圖PR段相關的遺傳基因變異及其遺傳的隨機性作出深入研究，輔以病例對照研究，我們將得以探討心電圖PR段過長是否誘發神經內分泌的上調，繼而導致心臟血管功能異常及心血管病猝死的元兇。 是次研究針對心電圖PR段過長，透過血管功能的非入侵性檢查，藉以闡釋PR段與心血管功能的關係，對臨床心臟學中PR段過長的定義、病理機制、以及防治將有突破性的重大含意。

788012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
788012.value: 在細胞分裂過程中，細胞必須將其遺傳信息DNA均等地傳遞給子細胞。染色體的錯誤分離將導致染色體數目異常，可引起自然流産和癌症。着絲粒（或稱為中節）是染色體中唯一的特别的染色體結構域，它可以引導染色體的分離。盡管着絲粒DNA的序列和大小在不同生物體中存在差異，但是它們共有一些類似的序列特徵，並且組裝在着絲粒上的動粒蛋白也是保守的。所有活性着絲粒都包含一個組蛋白H3變異體，稱爲CENP-A，它形成了動粒組裝的基礎。研究人員認爲，在細胞分裂過程中，着絲粒上的CENP-A以及獨特的組蛋白修飾標記可用於維持既有着絲粒的特性。 每個染色體保持一個着絲粒可以確保染色體的穩定性。然而，在癌細胞中或者染色體重排後，新的着絲粒可以在非着絲粒的異位的位置形成，這表明着絲粒活性能被非序列依賴性的（表觀遺傳學）機製調控。另外，在導入含有着絲粒序列的純化的DNA的細胞中，也能形成新的着絲粒，製造出可用於基因治療的能自主分離的人工染色體，這表明着絲粒的形成偏好着絲粒DNA的某些序列特徵。基於這些研究結果，我們假設着絲粒活性受到表觀遺傳學通路以及DNA序列特徵的雙重調控。然而，由於新的着絲粒在剛開始形成的時候通常不易被及時識別出來，加上人工染色體在人細胞中形成的頻率極低，因此，關於着絲粒形成的機製方面的研究一直備受考驗。 本研究旨在闡述着絲粒形成的機製問題。我們已通過顯微注射外源DNA於秀麗隱杆線蟲(Caenorhabditis elegans)的生殖細胞系中，建立了一個研究着絲粒形成的活细胞模型。該模型能導致線蟲胚胎中形成人工染色體，並能有效地形成着絲粒。這个模型可以使人們通過活細胞觀察的方法機械論研究着絲粒的形成過程。該體系不僅克服了以往的技術障礙，而且能發現新的着絲粒形成所需的條件。 爲了驗證我們關於表觀遺傳學和DNA序列特徵調控着絲粒活性的這一假設，我們將利用秀麗隱杆線蟲人工染色體系統，來研究特定的表觀遺傳因子和DNA序列特徵在着絲粒形成中所起的作用。我們將觀察人工染色體均等分離的頻率並將其作爲新的着絲粒形成的功能性指標。我們的初步研究表明，異染色質（以特異性組蛋白修飾爲特徵的致密染色質的表觀遺傳學標記）抑制着絲粒的形成。本研究將闡述着絲粒活性的調控機製以及病理狀態下新的着絲粒形成的分子基礎，並改進用於基因治療的人工染色體的製備工程方法及提高其效率。

790012.label: Project Title(Chinese)
790012.value: 威權政體下的制度創新：當代中國地方政府改革的徑路

790012.label: Project Objectives
790012.value: To empirically map the defining features of different local reformist pathways in post-Deng China and the political processes behind them. To explore the incentives and constraints that have shaped political leaders’ direction choices for the pathways of institutional reform under authoritarianism. To explain the varied influence of socialist legacies on the dynamism of adaptive institutional reforms across regions. To compare local political reforms in post-Deng China with successful and failed attempts of institutional change in Eastern Europe, the former Soviet Union, the Middle East and Latin America.

To compare local political reforms in post-Deng China with successful and failed attempts of institutional change in Eastern Europe, the former Soviet Union, the Middle East and Latin America.

790012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
790012.value: Institutional innovation under authoritarianism is a significantly understudied area in comparative politics. In addition to coercive repression, many authoritarian regimes have also attempted—more or less successfully—to use either incremental or “big-bang” political reforms to release social tension, neutralize potential opposition, maintain a winning coalition of the élite, and survive radical political contention. Compared to the falling dictatorships of the Arab Spring, the People’s Republic of China (PRC) since the 1990s has demonstrated a particularly strong capacity to adaptively reform its ruling apparatus and extend the regime’s longevity. For students of Chinese politics, the incentive, dynamism, repertoire, and impact of these institutional reforms undertaken by the authoritarian Party-state should not be overlooked. Since the 1990s, growing tensions between the Leninist polity and a gradually opened society have compelled local governments in China to test a vast set of institutional innovations, hoping to channel political pressure, enhance state-society interaction, and safeguard social stability. Although such innovations range from administrative streamlining to ideological reconstruction, reforms that aim at increasing political participation within the authoritarian regime are particularly salient. Deemed primarily as political experiments, sub-national level participatory reforms always have officially designated “themes”—in essence, they represent different pathways of institutional reform. Based on our pilot study, four basic pathways can be identified: the representation pathway, the electoral pathway, the governmental transparency pathway and the policy consultation pathway. Facing pressure for change, what accounts for local political leaders’ choice of a particular reformist pathway over possible alternatives? Whilst the literature provides three sets of theories—historical institutional theory, human agency theory, and structural determinism theory—to depict the underlying dynamics and forces that shape authoritarian reforms, none have been systematically tested by China scholars, leaving a significant gap in the study of post-Deng Chinese (1997-present) politics. By comparing different local political reforms, we seek to map the main pathways of sub-national participatory reforms in China and explore the driving forces that shape local leaders’ choice of a particular reformist pathway over alternatives. Our aim is to sketch out the “repertoire” of institutional innovation in post-Deng China and identify the most salient shaping forces that streamline local cadres’ political choices. Drawing on studies of regime change in Eastern Europe, Central Asia, the Middle East and Latin America, this research will inform not only the study of Chinese politics but also the study of authoritarian and hybrid regimes, institutional durability and change, and post-communism transitions through a comparative lens. 威權政體下的制度創新是比較政治學中一個被忽視的重要課題。自20世紀90年代以來，中華人民共和國政府顯現出相當強的適應性變革能力, 與世界其他地區的威權政權構成鮮明對比。20年以來，中國的各級地方政府都開展了一系列政府治理體制的改革，以消解社會矛盾、改善治理質量、促進國家與社會的互動關係及增強政府的認受性，並最終保持社會政治的基本穩定。這些政府治理方式的變革主要是由於列寧主義政體與逐漸開放的市場經濟之間的緊張關係所導致，並常常被視為對未來中國政府治理模式改革的政治試驗。通過系統性考察20世紀90年代以來由中國各級地方政府開展的諸種政府改革實驗，本研究試圖描畫這些地方政治改革實驗所顯現出的體制創新徑路，並探討導致不同地方政府在面對改革壓力時採取迥然不同之改革徑路的主要原因。基於國際學術界關於東歐、蘇聯、中亞和中東政體轉變的有關研究成果，本研究不僅僅尋求加深我們對於中國政治改革現狀及前景的理解，並同時也尋求對政府改革、體制革新與地方治理等方面的比較政治學研究做出相應貢獻。

790012.label: Realisation of objectives
790012.value: Popular political participation in policy making and governance does not exist only in democratic countries, but can occur in developing nations under authoritarian rule. Autocratic rulers may choose to promote limited citizen participation in low-risk policy areas to pacify social tension, reign-in corruption, improve financial accounting, and/or strengthen political legitimacy. In this project, we examined and compared three styles of participatory reform undertaken by the communist regime of the PRC in the specific area of local fiscal and budgetary accountability. The three principal models — namely, the representative, consultative, and transparency pathways — are all managed by the local Party-state with the consent of higher authorities, but take remarkably different forms. Using the local budgetary process as their touchstone, we addressed the following questions in our research deliverables: Why does an authoritarian regime seek to attract citizens to participate in policy making? What participatory models are promoted by the Party-state? What are the implications of these reforms on China’s long-term political future? As an anonymous reviewer of one of our journal publication pointed out, given the trends of growing apathy and distrust in citizen-state engagement in Western democracies, our research on China’s local budgetary reforms is particularly illuminating for scholarly understanding of the power of citizen participation. Especially for local governments in other parts of the world where fiscal austerity measures are being imposed and the people demand ‘a Plan B for local government which is focused less on implementing austerity and more on stimulating growth and building socially productive relationships’ (Lowndes and McCaughie, 2013:56), the Chinese experiences on citizen participation may be particularly meaningful and suggestive. To look back, during the past five years or so, we have successfully realized the objectives as set out in the original application and published our research findings on leading SSCI indexed journals, completed a book manuscript and presented on various international conferences. Object 1: In our research, we identify three major reformist pathways: The Representative Pathway focuses on the creation or reinvigoration of representative bodies that wield de facto (if not de jure) legislative authority (e.g., village councils, community committees or representative assemblies). Local reforms under this category usually require institutionalised change and involve some degree of reconfiguration of the basic structure of local politics. The Transparency Pathway features reform to bring about increased transparency of and/or public access to governmental information, including policy processes and administrative procedures. Reforms that take this pathway usually create moderately institutionalised mechanisms (e.g., e-government and periodic live televised broadcasts of crucial government meetings) that aim to increase governmental transparency in some fashion. The Consultative Pathway highlights the expansion of non-institutionalised and informal forums (e.g., ad-hoc committees, casual town hall meetings, citizen brainstorming sessions or political consultation meetings) to allow policy consultation with a wider range of citizen participants, civic groups or collective actors. Object 2: Absolutist regimes do not always rely upon coercion to govern the societies under their rule. More often, authoritarian rulers also attempt to use either incremental innovations or ‘big-bang’ reforms of their institutions to release social tension, neutralise potential opposition, maintain power-sharing arrangements amongst the elites or survive increasingly globalised movements for democracy. Such innovative reforms are a crucial and defining aspect of authoritarian governance that reflect the self-renewing and self-enhancing capacities of such political systems. In this research, we not only mapped the main pathways of participatory reforms below the national level in China, but also explored the driving forces that shape the local leaders’ choices of particular reformist pathways over the alternatives. We provided an ‘incentive-contingent framework’ that can partially explain the variation of local reformist pathways in the PRC. This framework suggests that a local government’s adoption of a specific pathway in its reformist project is contingent upon the primary driving incentive at that locality. In other words, in facing different socio-political crises, the local Party-state’s choice of a reform pathway corresponds to the particular issues at hand in its area of governance. In this project, instead of attempting to establish specific pairs of causal relationship or identifying particular incentives that have given birth to certain local institutional reforms, we point out a novel direction to explain the variation of local reformist pathways. We demonstrated that, the variation in local reformist pathways is both incentive-contingent and context-dependent. The type of reformist pathway adopted by a local government is, by and large, shaped by the socio-political context and by the primary incentive that necessitates reform in the first place. Object 3: By our intensive fieldwork in Hebei, Hunan and Zhejiang Provinces, we carefully examined the socialist legacies in each fieldwork locale. However, we have not found significant influence of socialist legacies on either the form or the extent of participatory reform across regions. Nevertheless, the ‘incentive-contingent’ framework that we suggest in this article demonstrated the importance of the agency of powerful political elites in managing crises as the shaping force behind institutional reforms. The most urgent problem that must be addressed in their dealings with potential crises and the primary objective they must achieve shape the ruling elites’ decision as to what institution to choose and how to use the institution to weather the crisis. Object 4. In our book manuscript, we compared the Chinese case with cases of participatory democracy in Brazil, South Africa and India. Also, my Ph.D. Student—Mr. Xin Ge—was trained under this research project (period of study: 2012-2016). In August 2016, he successfully completed and defended his doctoral thesis entitled “Bootstrapping Public Participation in the Global South: Participatory budgeting Reforms in Brazil, China and South Africa”. His thesis studied participatory budgeting practices in the local communities of three developing countries: Brazil, China and South Africa. It argued that the party politics of specific country determines the choice of a particular mode of participatory mechanism. The thesis provided a novel perspective – party politics— to explain the emergence of participatory budgeting in different countries from a comparative perspective. Notes: Lowndes, V. and McCaughie, K. (2013). ‘Weathering the Perfect Storm? Austerity and Institutional Resilience in Local Government’, Policy & Politics, 41 (4): 533-549.

790012.label: Major findings and research outcome
790012.value: We mapped and compared three styles of participatory reform undertaken by the communist regime of the PRC in the specific area of local fiscal and budgetary accountability. The three principal models — namely, the representative, consultative, and transparency pathways — are all managed by the local Party-state with the consent of higher authorities, but take remarkably different forms. We examined this disparate family of local political reform projects and revealed significant divergence in terms of their content, strategies and goals. Concerning content, these reforms range from introducing measures to increase government transparency to the creation or reinvigoration of representative institutions. In terms of strategy, although some reforms boldly remove existing institutions and replace them with new institutional creations (‘displacement’), other reforms introduce new institutions on top of the existing institutions (‘layering’). Still other reforms only change the practices related to existing rules or institutions by attributing new political functions to them (‘conversion’). As for the goals of these reforms, despite their congruence in the long-term aims of improving governance and maintaining political stability, local reformist projects differ significantly in their immediate or intermediate-term objectives. We study three cases of local participatory reform to demonstrate the different reformist pathways involved and their main features. We presented an incentive-contingent framework with which we seek to explain the choice of pathways for political reforms below the national level under the PRC regime. This framework suggests that a local government’s adoption of a specific pathway in its reformist project is contingent upon the primary driving incentive at that locality. In other words, in facing different socio-political crises, the local Party-state’s choice of a reform pathway corresponds to the particular issues at hand in its area of governance. Rather than trying to illustrating how a particular driving force sparks off a certain type of participatory reform at a given locality, we seek to suggest a new perspective to make sense of the variance of local participatory reforms under authoritarianism. We compared the Chinese case with cases of participatory democracy in Brazil, South Africa and India and found the different form and structure of party politics in each country may shape its unique pathway of participatory budgeting reform. We published four articles on leading SSCI indexed refereed journals. We completed a book manuscript and would submit it to a university press very soon. We presented our findings at more than ten international conferences.

790012.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
790012.value: (1) Increasing the number of fieldwork sites within China and comparing more cases of grassroots participatory democracy experimentation. (2) Comparing the Chinese case with other countries/regions other than the BRICS countries, such as the US, Taiwan, Eastern European countries etc. (3) Carrying out large-sample questionnaire research and use quantitative methods to testify the findings and hypotheses of this research.

790012.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
790012.value: Many authoritarian regimes and hegemonic political parties attempt to use adaptive institutional innovations to maintain their grip on power. However, in terms of institutional reforms under authoritarian regimes, two questions remain understudied. First, what major pathways of institutional reform do autocratic rulers use when the need for political reform arises? Second, as they face pressure for institutional change, what accounts for the authoritarian leaders’ eventual choices of particular reformist pathways rather than the alternatives? Post-Deng China provides an ideal natural laboratory in which to explore these issues. Reform in China since 1978 has involved a growing imbalance between a Leninist polity and a variety of gradually liberalised socioeconomic spaces. In response to these profound challenges, a vast set of institutional reforms have been implemented at the local level. By studying three major local approaches to reform of the public budgeting process, we provided a systematic empirical study of the forces for change and the repertoire of solutions that have shaped authoritarian political reform in China. This research sheds light on the dynamism, process and effects of institutional evolution under the Chinese Communist regime.

790112.label: Project Title(Chinese)
790112.value: 江戶時代日本音樂的復古主義與政治正統論

790112.label: Project Objectives
790112.value: To develop an interdisciplinary model for the study of pre-modern intellectual history through a musicological perspective; To analyze the morphology of the Japonified qin music through re-constructing the composing process of Tokugawa qin players; To offer a much more complete picture of Ogyū Sorai and his coterie, the Ancient Learning School’s political philosophy through re-examining the role of music antiquarianism in Tokugawa intellectual history; and To re-evaluate the vitality of Tokugawa Confucians’ music antiquarianism through its interaction with, or even intervention in, the dynamics of shogunal politics, especially on the issues of political legitimacy.
rows: To develop an interdisciplinary model for the study of pre-modern intellectual history through a musicological perspective;
To analyze the morphology of the Japonified qin music through re-constructing the composing process of Tokugawa qin players;

To offer a much more complete picture of Ogyū Sorai and his coterie, the Ancient Learning School’s political philosophy through re-examining the role of music antiquarianism in Tokugawa intellectual history; and

To re-evaluate the vitality of Tokugawa Confucians’ music antiquarianism through its interaction with, or even intervention in, the dynamics of shogunal politics, especially on the issues of political legitimacy.

790112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
790112.value: No matter how idiosyncratically Chinese it has been deemed, the qin flourished in Japan from the 17th through the 19th centuries. According to Robert van Gulik, the Tokugawa cultivation of qin was due to the arrival in Japan of the Chinese monk Donggao. Moreover, an entirely new playing style to perform the ancient Japanese imperial court music gagaku on the qin emerged under the cover of music restoration. Why did such a drastic change of musical practice suddenly appear in early 18th century Japan? In order to answer this puzzling question, my research project seeks to build a connection between the intellectual history of Tokugawa Japan and music antiquarianism. In particular, the ideological forces behind the so-called restoration of Chinese qin music launched by the Tokugawa bakufu, the last pre-modern feudal military government of Japan, are explored through the dilemmas of legitimacy in Tokugawa politics: 1) being a military junta, the legitimacy of the Tokugawa bakufu in Edo had to come through its being approved by the imperial court in Kyōto; and 2) regarding the world outside Japan, the Tokugawa chose not to be involved in the Sino-centric world order, another important hierarchy for monarchs in the legitimization of their dynasties in East Asia. I suggest that, in their version of Confucianism, bakufu ideological advisers saw music as a highly specific tool to bolster one of the ritual foundations of Tokugawa rule, namely, if the bakufu institute the proper cultural practices (i.e., the Japonified qin, among other means of rituals) that accord with its de-facto position as ruler of the realm, it will convert itself from a military government to a kingly government; and sage-hood would thus be obtained by the Tokugawa family. As a result, the final source of political legitimacy would shift from Kyōto to Edo, and the superiority of Japan over her neighboring states, including China, could also be proclaimed. To articulate these ideas, my research explores the philosophy and music writings of Confucian fundamentalists Ogyū Sorai, Dazai Shundai, Yamagata Daini, and the criticism from their Neo-Confucian opponents Hayashi Razan, Kumazawa Banzan, Arai Hakuseki, Kani Yōsai, and Tominaga Nakamoto, as well as the Japonified qin music prepared by Onoda Tōsen, Koma Chikatō, Murai Kinzan, and Urakami Gyokudō. 縱然古琴音樂被視為純然中國的藝術，它卻在十七世紀到十九世紀的日本盛極一時。高羅佩認為江戶琴學不過是中國僧人東皋心越東渡的産物。但是，憑借復古的口號，一種以中國古琴彈奏日本古代宮廷雅樂的全新音樂形式卻隨即登上樂壇。為何如此激烈的轉變會突然出現在十八世紀早期的日本？ 本研究通過溝通江戶時期日本思想史和音樂史兩個領域的學術資源，嘗試解答以上問題。特別是德川幕府推行的「琴樂復興運動」將會在江戶政權正統性的悖論中加以考究：一、在國內，作為軍事集團，江戶德川幕府的合法性源於京都朝廷的任命；二、國際間，德川幕府又選擇不參與東亞「朝貢體系」。幕府的儒學家將音樂視為德川統治的禮樂基礎。他們認為，如果幕府能創造與其統治者地位相符的禮樂(比如日本化了的琴樂)，就能實現「王」、「霸」角色的轉換，德川家族也能晉身為聖人，實現政治正統由京都到江戶的轉移，從而奠定日本在新「朝貢體系」中的核心地位。 為證明以上論述，本研究將分析古學派儒學家荻生徂徠、太宰春臺、山縣大貳的哲學與音樂論著，宋明理學家林羅山、熊澤蕃山、新井白石、蟹養齋、富永仲基等對以上古學派諸人言行的尖銳批判，以及小野田東川、狛近任、村井琴山和浦上玉堂等創作的日本琴樂。

790112.label: Realisation of objectives
790112.value: The ripple effect of this research project is realized as forming three concentric circles: (1) The first and smallest “ripple” is to clarify the identity of the two earliest scrolls of qin music preserved in Japan, since this is the foundation of Ogyū Sorai’s argument and the whole assumption of this research project. In nature, this step of research is musicological. Major findings at this stage have been published in my paper entitled “A Tale of Two Manuscripts: The Making and Origins of the Earliest Scrolls of Qin Music,” Acta Musicologica (Journal of International Musicological Society) 86/1 (2014): 32-73. This paper takes methodologies evolved from European musicology and uses them to provide a codicological examination of the two earliest extant examples of qin musical notation. By so doing, it comprehensively overturns the eighteenth century Japanese Confucianist Ogyū Sorai’s assertion that these two scrolls had a common provenance in Confucius himself, whilst also furnishing evidence as to their actual origins. (2) The second, wider objective is to offer a more complete picture of Ogyū Sorai and his coterie’s political philosophy through re-examining the role of music antiquarianism in Tokugawa intellectual history (research objective 2); to analyze the morphology of the Japonified qin music through re-constructing the composing process of Sorai and his Tokugawa followers (research objective 3); and to re-evaluate the vitality of Tokugawa Confucianists’ music antiquarianism through its interaction with, or even intervention in, the dynamics of shogunal politics (research objective 4). The nature of the second stage of research is closely related to the intellectual history of Japan. The PI discovers that behind a mask of naïveté, Sorai’s compilation, which deliberately manipulated the facts, is an emotional and ideological force to be reckoned with. The musical studies of Sorai were not intended for academic purposes alone, and indeed are far from trifles. Rather, these works were rich in political meanings, for the conceptualization of Sorai’s political agenda resulted in the cultural appropriation of qin music into Japan. As we now know, the importation of qin music was in fact the product of the Nara nobility’s enthusiasm for Chinese culture; the re-contextualization of the two earliest scrolls on qin music and the ensuing localization of Japanese qin music, on the other hand, were enabled by the de-Sinification of Tokugawa Confucianism. Such a dramatic change emblematically reflects the functional shift of Japanese Sinology during the early eighteenth century. These major findings have been involved in (a) PI’s paper entitled “Discovering the Music of the Sages: Ogyū Sorai’s Compilation of the Earliest Scrolls on Qin Music,” which has been submitted to Monumenta Nipponica, the most reputable journal in Japanology and (b) three conference papers. (3) Third and more significant is to develop an interdisciplinary model for the study of pre-modern intellectual history through a musicological perspective (research objective 1). This research project, by re-examining the Sino-Japanese intellectual history musicological, sheds new light on the formation of the Japanese identity in the pre-modern period. The interdisciplinary nature of this research project itself has been verified by providing research outputs in both Musicology and Japanology. During the first half of the grant period, as a junior researcher who has just started his academic career with this EGS grant, the PI was not experienced in time management. Thanks for the invaluable comments offered in the mid-term progress review, the PI overcomes this problem and brings concrete results to this project.

790112.label: Major findings and research outcome
790112.value: Major research outcome of the project includes two research articles and a series of international conference papers. In terms of peer-reviewed journal publication arising directly from this research project, the PI has produced two lengthy articles: (1) “A Tale of Two Manuscripts: The Making and Origins of the Earliest Scrolls of Qin Music.” Acta Musicologica (Journal of International Musicological Society) 86/1 (2014): 32-73 (for full paper, see Part C, section 8, item 1); and (2) “Discovering the Music of the Sages: Ogyū Sorai’s Compilation of the Earliest Scrolls on Qin Music.” Submitted to Monumenta Nipponica for review (for full paper, see Part C, section 8, item 2). In terms of recognized international conferences in which papers related to this research project were delivered, the PI has produced three conference papers: (1) “Interpreting the Qin in Tokugawa Japan: Ogyū Sorai's Studies on Chinese Music.” The 57th Annual Meeting of Society for Ethnomusicology, New Orleans, 1-4 November 2012 (for abstract, see Part C, section 9, item 1). (2) “Ogyū Sorai’s Studies on Chinese Music.” The 19th International CHIME Conference, 21-25 October 2015, Geneva (for full paper, see Part C, section 9, item 2). (3) “Japonifying the Qin: Ogyū Sorai's Studies on Chinese Music.” The Inaugural IAFOR International Conference on Japan & Japan Studies, Kobe, June 2-5 2016 (for full paper, see Part C, section 9, item 3). For major research findings, please see section 5.3 above.

790112.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
790112.value: Through completing this research project, the PI notices that the morphology of the Tokugawa practice of gagaku music, which was the musical exemplars of the Japonified qin music, has been inadequately addressed. In the future, the PI would like to propose new project on the Tokugawa practice of gagaku, so that the music morphology of the Japonified qin music can be further explored through a comparison between this hybrid genre and its Japanese melodic prototype.

790112.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
790112.value: The story of the qin in 7th century Japan began when two scrolls on qin music were brought over by Japanese missions from Tang China. The scrolls were placed in Japan’s imperial library and stayed hidden from view until 1,000 years later, during the Tokugawa period (1603-1867), when China itself was in turmoil. This research project deals with the appropriation of Chinese music in Tokugawa Japan within the circle of scholars and military aristocracy, and the intellectual forces behind that appropriation. It’s about how this idiosyncratic Chinese musical instrument became Japanese. Tokugawa Confucian fundamentalist Ogyū Sorai (1666-1728) tried to use the two scrolls as a cultural trophy to claim Japan is the sole inheritor of authentic ancient Chinese music. He and his followers developed their own repertory of more than 100 pieces and tried to integrate the qin music with Japanese imperial court music. To present-day researchers, the music is actually Japanese, but in Tokugawa Japan they thought of it as a restoration of the qin. The cultural appropriation of the qin has a subtle influence on the formation of the Japanese identity in the modern period.

790312.label: Project Title(Chinese)
790312.value: 精神分裂症基因建模研究 - 泛歐洲雙胞胎樣本

790312.label: Project Objectives
790312.value: Combine cognitive data from all available European twin samples with or without schizophrenia to increase power for genetic modeling. Examine the relative contributions of genetic and environmental influences on the association of cognitive deficit and schizophrenia through genetic model fitting approaches based on the method maximum likelihood. This will replicate the existing small body of research in a large sample. Quantify the extent to which cognitive impairment and structural brain deficit share the same genetic influences. This will fill a significant gap in the schizophrenia endophenotypic literature.

Examine the relative contributions of genetic and environmental influences on the association of cognitive deficit and schizophrenia through genetic model fitting approaches based on the method maximum likelihood. This will replicate the existing small body of research in a large sample.
Quantify the extent to which cognitive impairment and structural brain deficit share the same genetic influences. This will fill a significant gap in the schizophrenia endophenotypic literature.

790312.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
790312.value: Psychotic illnesses like schizophrenia are defined by the presence of delusions, (fixed, usually untrue bizarre beliefs) and hallucinations (perceptions without stimuli in the outside world). Despite their huge impact on patients and their families, we know relatively little about their causation. For example, although the best predictor of developing schizophrenia is having a first-degree biological relative with the disorder most results from the molecular genetic studies aiming to identify genetic variants for schizophrenia remain inconsistent and effect sizes small, even for the best supported genes. Identifying the underlying genetically mediated traits (endophenotypes) that increase risk for the disorder could advance our understanding of the underlying pathophysiology and assist our hunt for genetic variants for schizophrenia with important implications for treatment and prevention. Despite a wealth of evidence on candidate traits thought to increase risk for the disorder only now are we beginning to see the fuller picture. For example, we now know the extent to which some of these traits are genetically determined, and the degree to which they are genetically linked with schizophrenia. Despite this there are few existing published studies, they tend to be based on small samples, and do not consider models incorporating multiple endophenotypes. The project was designed to address precisely these issues.

790312.label: Realisation of objectives
790312.value: The project's objectives have been met fully. In aetiologically complex illnesses such as schizophrenia there is no direct link between genotype and phenotype. Intermediate phenotypes could help clarify the underlying biology and assist in the hunt for genetic vulnerability variants. We have previously shown that cognition shares substantial genetic variance with schizophrenia, however it is unknown if this reflects pleiotropic effects, direct causality or some shared third factor that links both e.g. brain volume changes. We quantified the degree of net genetic overlap and tested the direction of causation between schizophrenia liability, brain structure and cognition in a pan-European schizophrenia twin cohort consisting of 1243 members from 626 pairs.

790312.label: Major findings and research outcome
790312.value: We found that cognitive deficits lie upstream of the liability for schizophrenia with about a quarter of the variance in liability to schizophrenia explained by variation in cognitive function. Brain volume changes lay downstream of schizophrenia liability with 4% of brain volume variation explained directly by variation in liability. This is the first study to demonstrate that schizophrenia liability is expressed partially through cognitive deficits. One prediction of the finding that brain volume changes lie downstream of the disease liability is that the risk loci which influence schizophrenia liability will thereafter influence brain volume and to a lesser extent. By way of contrast cognitive function lies upstream of schizophrenia, thus the relevant loci will actually have a larger effect size on cognitive function than on schizophrenia. These are testable predictions.

790312.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
790312.value: We hope to be able to combine DTI data in the same pan-European sample.

790312.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
790312.value: Our findings are important for a number of reasons. They fundamentally challenge the prevailing schizophrenia phenotype, demonstrate that schizophrenia liability is expressed partially through cognitive deficits, and suggest that future molecular genetic studies would enhance their ability to identify the genes by stratifying for cognitive ability. This will advance our understanding of the underlying pathophysiology and subsequently improve treatment and outcome for patients.

800312.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
800312.value: 在世界各地廣泛使用有機化學品已導致重大廢水問題。一個例子是草酸，廣泛應用於稀土冶金、 製藥工業有機酸。單在2009年，全球對草酸的需求是約 45 萬噸，而其在中國大陸的需求超過了 30 萬噸。其他常見的工業廢料如氰化物、 偶氮染料、 胺、 和有機磷農藥。能夠將工業污染物同時選擇性檢測和高效降解是一項挑戰。化學感應器能夠提供可靠的讀數；催化劑能夠將有機污染物快速氧化或礦化。如果有一部智慧的分子設備能夠檢測污染物，而且在達到特定的污染值時自動降解所選的有機污染物，污染這問題可能獲得緩和。我們的研究將集中在這一領域上。

800312.label: Realisation of objectives
800312.value: This project aimed to design a supramolecular chemical method to simultaneously detect and degrade organic pollutants. All the objectives were achieved. Throughout the period of investigation, (i) we designed and synthesized a novel bimetallic complex, [RuII(tBubpy)(CN)4]2–[FeIII(H2O)3Cl]24H2O, RuII-FeIII, (tBubpy = 4,4’- Di-tert-butyl-2,2’-bipyridine); (ii) we found out that this complex could act as a chemodosimeter for oxalic acid; and most importantly it can simultaneously function as catalyst for its degradation; (iii) basically we understood the analyte-selectivity of the system is controlled by the thermodynamics of formation of the cyano linkage between ruthenium–iron and adducts between the iron(III) metal and the anionic analytes; and (iv) we applied the developed technology to detect the analyte in real water bodies such as river, pond and sea water.

800312.label: Major findings and research outcome
800312.value: Through supramolecular design and simple synthetic procedures, several novel bimetallic complexes based devices could be generated as a chemosensor for different organic pollutants such as oxalate, cyanide, dimethyl sulfide and pesticides; and most importantly the devices could simultaneously function as catalyst for the degradation of the pollutants. The selectivity and sensitivity of the systems were found to be controlled by both the kinetics and thermodynamics of formation of the cyano linkage between bimetallic complexes. The developed technology could be applied to detect the pollutants in real water bodies or food bodies.

800312.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
800312.value: Based on the major finding from the project, a knowledge transfer project entitled "Development and Application of Supramolecular Devices on the Area of the Detection of Water Pollutants" is being prepared to submit the Innovation Technology Funding from the PRC Guangdong Province and Ministry. This project will make use of the research results generated from the RGC project to detect and degrade pesticides in drinking water in a very sensitive and selective way.

800312.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
800312.value: Selective detection and efficient degradation of persistent industrial pollutants are major challenges in the world. Stable chemosensors that can provide reliable readouts and quick responses and advanced catalysts that can quickly oxidize and mineralize organic contaminants are in high demand. In this project, smart molecular devices were made to automatically degrade selected organic pollutants when specific levels reach a certain detection threshold is highly desirable. This discovery shed new light on how to real-time monitor and treat other dangerous chemical wastes. The scientific background of how the device can take up multi-functions simultaneously for detection, amplification, and elimination upon detection of organic pollutants was now understood. The researchers were using the new smart devices for detection and degradation of various hazardous chemical wastes, such as oxalate, cyanide, pesticides and organic sulfide. Finally, the team applied this new technology on the complicated industrial wastewater and food systems.

810012.label: Realisation of objectives
810012.value: 1. Suffix Array Construction in External Memory (100% completed) Based on our previously introduced suffix array construction algorithms (SACAs), SA-DS and SA-IS, we have developed several algorithms, EM-SA-DS, DSA-IS, DSA-IS+, SAIS-PQ and SAIS-PQ+, for constructing and checking suffix array using a commodity computer with external memory (a hard disk). 1.1 EM-SA-DS In contrast to the well-solved status of SACAs on RAM, only a few practical solutions for SACAs on external memory have been proposed [Crauser and Ferragina 2008]. Among them notably are DC3-disk [Dementiev et al. 2008] and bwt-disk [Ferragina et al. 2012]. We introduced EM-SA-DS and demonstrated its performance by comparing with that of bwt-disk. The purpose of our work was: (1) to explore an intuitive and fast algorithm for building the big suffix array for an input string of length of Giga characters, using a modern commodity computer with a typical memory configuration and a single disk; (2) to establish a basis for further developing efficient external-memory suffix-sorting algorithms using the induced sorting technique. We were interested in adapting the original RAM-based algorithm SA-DS to an external-memory-conscious variant because its divide-and-conquer solution samples fixed-size substrings suggests a convenience that gives advantage to the design of efficient-external memory SACAs. EM-SA-DS uses novel cache data structures to help construct big suffix arrays in a sequential scanning manner. As a result, EM-SA-DS achieves good data spatial locality. 1.2 DSA-IS Although experimental results had showed that algorithms based on the induced sorting principle outperform the known best techniques, their designs were rather complicated and challenging to be engineered, and their time-and-space performance is needed to be improved. Following our work in developing EM-SA-DS, we come up with a new solution called DSA-IS for sequentially retrieving the preceding character of a sorted suffix to induce the order of the preceding suffix. Pleasingly, different from the eSAIS and EM-SA-DS, DSA-IS emulates SA-IS merely by replacing random accesses to RAM with sequential accesses to external memory. Like SA-IS in RAM, the algorithm for induced sorting suffixes in external memory can be reused for sorting the LMS substrings. 1.3 DSA-IS+ Apart from constructing the SA, ensuring the correctness of the SA being built is also important. The existing SA checker verifies an SA by performing two passes of integer sorts that are time and space consuming especially when running in the external memory. By employing new methods for sorting and naming substrings, we redesigned the reduction phase of DSA-IS to an enhanced algorithm to DSA-IS+ which runs as fast as that for eSAIS while its peak disk usage is about two-thirds as that of eSAIS. Moreover, we proposed a fast and lightweight SA checking method and combined this method with DSA-IS+ to produce a unified solution for constructing and checking SA at the same time. It was observed that the performance overhead for verification is considerable small in comparison with that for construction. In details, the peak disk usage for the unified solution remains at the same level of that for DSA-IS+, while the growth in both time and I/O volume is negligible. 1.4 SAIS-PQ and SAIS-PQ+ After re-investigating the problem of induced sorting suffixes in external memory and propose a new algorithm SAIS-PQ (SAIS with Priority Queue) and its enhanced alternative SAIS-PQ+. Using the library STXXL, the core algorithmic parts of SAIS-PQ and SAIS-PQ+ are coded in around 800 and 1600 lines in C++, respectively. The time and space performance of these two programs are evaluated in comparison with eSAIS that is also implemented using STXXL. In our experiment, eSAIS runs the fastest for the input strings not larger than 16 GiB, but it is slower than SAIS-PQ+ for the only two input strings of 32 and 48.44 GiB. For the average peak disk requirements, eSAIS and SAIS-PQ+ are around 23n and 15n bytes, respectively. 2. Updating a suffix array (100% completed) We finished the investigation of efficient ways for reconstructing the suffix array of a modified string. It was shown by [Léonard et al. 2012] that the number of entries to be updated is related to the longest common prefix (LCP) of the suffixes of the text which is modified by adding an existing character in the alphabet, and, on average, the average number of the LCP values. It is clear that when the number of entries to be updated is larger, rebuilding the suffix array of an updated string would be more efficient. Moreover, for big suffixes which should be constructed in external memory, their LCPs would also be large such that the updating their SA would become more inefficient. Together with time for verification of the correctness of the updated SA as well as their LCP arrays, updating the SA will be as complicated as rebuilding the whole SA of the updated string. We then further investigated on new methods for checking big suffixes and their LCP arrays. We proposed two methods to check its suffix and LCP arrays in external memory. Given the suffix and LCP arrays, both methods check them probabilistically using a Karp-Rabin fingerprinting function in two ways, in terms of that the checking result is wrong with only a negligible probability. For each pair of neighbouring suffixes in the suffix array, the first method computes and verifies the fingerprints of their LCPs. The second method employs the induced-sorting principle to first verify a subset of the suffix and LCP arrays, then ensure the inducing process is correct using fingerprints, resulting in the final suffix and LCP arrays augmented from the subset are correct. This method can be integrated into any algorithm for inducing suffix and LCP arrays to build and check the arrays simultaneously, i.e., building and checking are done in the same time. The experimental results indicate that the first method is about 20% faster, while the latter consumes about 40% less space. 3. Suffix Array-based Indices for Bioinformatics Applications (100% completed) Lempel-Ziv (LZ77) factorization, named after its inventers Abraham Lempel and Jacob Ziv, is one of the most important concepts in computer science. Due to its high efficiency in string processing, it has been wildly used in many applications such as file compression, pattern discovery, sequence alignments and full-text indexes. Very recently, several powerful instances have testified that compression schemes based on LZ77 are effective in modern datasets, especially in those collections of highly repetitive characteristics such as genome sequence. However, in all these applications, computing LZ77 has been shown to be a time and space bottleneck in practice. Now, we are investigating another algorithm called Xone for computing LZ77. Xone also has two versions, XoneT and XoneSA, corresponding to BGoneT and BGoneSA respectively. Comparing with the performance of BGone, Xone runs much faster than BGone do, but it uses also one auxiliary array and O(1) extra working space. To achieve this efficiency, Xone computes the sorted L-suffixes (L_SA) or the sorted S-suffixes (S_SA) regarding their numbers, instead of the sorted LMS-suffixes (LMS_SA) which is a necessary step in BGone. By avoiding the computation of LMS_SA, Xone outperforms BGone. 4. Test-bed for Third-party Applications (100% completed) We are developing and uploading a routine library which would implement all the algorithm developed in this project. A software test-bed system is also being constructed to demonstrate the algorithms which can be used to build third party applications.

810012.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
810012.value: Upon extending the well-known internal memory algorithms SA-IS and SA-DS to DSA-IS and EM-SA-DS for sorting suffixes in external memory, the experimental results show that the induced sorting technique can work efficiently in both internal and external memory. With these new developments, we are able to use a computer with a massive disk to build big suffix trees and suffix arrays with much better time and space efficiency. In the next move, we need to consider further developing efficient distributed algorithms for scaling the problem’s size and solving speed. Design of a general-purpose distributed algorithm for building a big suffix tree using a cluster of computers in a high-speed local area network could then be considered. Moreover, optimizing the general-purpose distributed suffix tree construction algorithm for building a k-order truncated suffix tree, in which each suffix is truncated to a fixed length of at most k characters, where k is far small than the length of the input string, could be investigated. Once a big suffix tree (full-order or truncated) has been efficiently built, we may go further to explore new algorithms for using big suffix trees to provide the capability of full-text search in large-scale genome and text databases.

810012.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
810012.value: The aim of this project is to develop a scheme for constructing suffix arrays (SA) for huge database in bioinformatics applications. One of the major applications of stringology is sequence search in bioinformatics. The tasks on biological sequences include matching, clustering and sequence alignment. In order to accomplish these tasks, huge databases of biological sequences have to be well-indexed. However, the amount of data in the domain has been growing rapidly, and so the indexing task become unmanageable by general purpose computers. To tackle this problem, we developed auxiliary data structures with SAs for building new SA-based indices for use in bioinformatics founded on our proposed SA construction and reconstruction schemes. As the space required for constructing the SA for such huge database is usually found to exceed the capability of a general purpose computer, the only way to tackle the problem instead of using expensive super-computers would be the use of external memory. In this project, we successfully developed several algorithms to construct and check the correctness of the SA of a huge string in external memory, probabilistic methods to check big suffixes and LCP arrays, and lightweight algorithms for computing a basic structure for the use in bioinformatics.

840012.label: Project Title(Chinese)
840012.value: 中國少數民族地區的三語教育模式

840012.label: Project Objectives
840012.value: To deepen understanding of the genesis of the four trilingual education models described above and the contextual factors sustaining them To identify models that are effective in promoting additive trilingualism in students To broaden the international literature on models of trilingual education, currently dominated by Eurocentric models, by presenting Chinese models of trilingual education

840012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
840012.value: Since 2002, the People’s Republic of China (PRC) has instigated various language policies in education designed to foster trilingualism in ethnic minority groups. Trilingualism, if implemented effectively, enables marginalized groups to engage in the social and political life of mainstream society and enjoy educational and economic benefits. Poorly conceived and ineffectively implemented policies, however, could exacerbate marginalization and deprivation. The policies in the PRC were implemented in a decentralized fashion, according to local priorities and contexts. In recent years, the research teams for the proposed study investigated the implementation of trilingual (i.e., the ethnic minority language, Chinese and English) education policies in different minority regions in Yunnan, Sichuan, Guangxi, Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang, Jilin, Gansu, Qinghai and Guangdong. Four major, distinctive models of trilingual education emerged. The first model focuses strongly on the ethnic minority language, which is used throughout the nine years of compulsory education from Grade 1 in primary schools to Grade 3 in junior secondary schools. Chinese and English are taught as subjects in the curriculum. The second model is a balance between Chinese and the ethnic language, with both languages used as the medium of instruction and with English taught as a school subject. The third model is the reverse of the first. Chinese is used as the medium of instruction and the ethnic minority language is taught as a major subject to all students in the school, irrespective of their own ethnicity or mother tongue. English is again taught as a school subject. A fourth model is represented by schools that proclaim to be an ethnic minority language school but which, in reality, do not use the minority language as the medium of instruction nor even teach it as a school subject. Such schools also claim to be bilingual in the sense that Chinese and English are studied as languages in the curriculum and Chinese serves as the medium of instruction. The proposed research seeks to deepen our understanding of the genesis of these models and their sustaining contextual factors, so that the Chinese models of trilingualism can be added to the literature, where European models currently predominate. Also, given that the first two models appear to be effective in producing “additive” trilinguals (i.e., the learners develop three languages without one negatively impacting on the others), the in-depth understanding of the mechanics of these models will allow for their propagation inside and outside of the PRC. 自2002年以來，中華人民共和國已實施了各種不同的教育語言政策，旨在促進少數民族地區的三語主義。三語主義若能推動得宜，可使被邊緣化的群體參與主流社會的民生和政治，並享受教育和經濟的好處。然而，考慮不周及政策執行上的失當，或會加劇邊緣化和被剝削的問題。 這項在中國推行的政策，按照各地方的優先級別和背景，以權力下放的方式實施。近年來，建議此項研究的團隊在不同的少數民族地區考察三語（即少數民族語言、中文和英文）教育政策，地點包括：雲南，四川，廣西，內蒙古，新疆，吉林，甘肅，青海和廣東等地，發現了四種主要且獨特的三語教育模式。 第一種模式，高度重視少數族裔的語言，主要應用於小學一年級到初中三級的九年強制教育，而中文和英文屬於課程內的學科。第二種模式，平衡了中文與民族語言的比重，同時以這兩種語言作為授課語言，英語則是一個學科。第三種模式是第一種模式的相反，以中文作為授課語言；而不論學生的種族或母語，少數民族語言也是全體學生的主要學科，英語仍然是課程內的一個學科。第四種模式，可見於一些宣稱是少數民族語言的學校，他們實際上並沒有使用少數民族語言來授課，甚至不把它作為一個學科。這些學校聲稱自己屬於雙語學校，因為他們把中文和英文作為課程內的語言科目，並以中文作為授課語言。 此項研究旨在加深我們認識這些模式的起源及其持續發展的相關因素，使中國模式的三語主義，能被納入現時以歐洲模式為主導的文獻中。此外，鑑於前兩種模式似乎能呈現 “入迷”的三語主義（即學習者學習三種語言時，某一種語言並沒有負面地影響其餘的語言），深入地了解這些模式的運作，可讓它們有效地在中國國內和國外傳播。

840012.label: Realisation of objectives
840012.value: The project objectives have been fully achieved through research, coordination of findings and strategic dissemination. The project was designed to cover 11 ethnic minority regions in China by establishing a research team in each region, with overall coordination provided by the PI and Co-I in terms of research design, data collection and analysis, and dissemination. The research network system operated effectively, with the PI and Co-I ensuring the coherence of the research across the multiple sites. (The project website and the regular symposia bringing together the research teams were particularly useful in this regard.) At the same time, the research teams were encouraged to explore aspects of trilingual education that were particular to their own region and to develop innovative pilot programmes where possible. This allowed for contextual sensitivity in the project. The contribution to the international literature has been considerable (see output list). We received several invitations to provide keynote speeches and to contribute to training workshops for ethnic minority teachers (using our research as the theoretical foundation for the training programme). Also, policymakers in the Ministry of Education and in provinces such as Qinghai have requested more information about our findings, with a view to enhancing language policies.
