843612.label: Major findings and research outcome
843612.value: All SEN students were entitled to receive their senior secondary education in Hong Kong. As an exploratory study, the findings and research outcome were useful for the discussion. Qualitative findings: • It was difficult for SEN students in mainstream schools to enter universities, as compared with regular students. Most SEN students at a higher ability would study in the vocational institution. In comparison with other regions, the career planning and education were the concerns. • The major barriers encountered by SEN graduates were the low academic achievement, disabilities, limited places in universities or tertiary institutions, skills in social interaction and communication. Students needed to seek the continual support and advice from their teachers. • Schools provided support to post-school transition for senior classes of students, such as career-related seminars and workshops. However, all these arrangements were not especially tailor-made to suit the needs of SEN students. • It was recommended that schools should be strengthened in the areas of resources, manpower, guidance, individual consultation and teacher training for supporting SEN students in schools. Career support from NGOs might play an important role in SEN students’ post-school transition. Other support included the support and admission policy of SEN students in universities, more alternative post-secondary education opportunities and job matching and placement. Quantitative findings: • Family support, peer support, and mental health significantly positively predicted self-determination among students without SEN, while only family support and mental health were found to significantly positively predict self-determination among students with SEN. Family support was the most significant predictor for self-determination among students with SEN. Mental health significantly positively mediated the relationships between social support and self-determination among students with and without SEN. • It was the fact that students with SEN had low academic achievement. In comparison to students without SEN, those with SEN were with a limited choice of subject study and institutions. • Most students had expectations to their future and held a positive attitude towards a further development in the future. Over one third students mentioned that the current support for them were inadequate. • In the study, the graduates with and without SEN might get the part-time jobs with less working hours in the week but higher hourly rate. In addition, both students with and without SEN started to pursue High Diploma and studied the two-year course. • For students with and without SEN, their mental health and social support were significantly related to their post-school outcomes.

843612.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
843612.value: As a longitudinal study for SEN students before and after their graduation, it might be difficult to keep the reasonable sample size of SEN students for the follow-up survey study. However, following the introduction of the career planning and education in schools in the years, there would be great potential development for future research. Furthermore, parents of SEN students expressed their concerns on the career development of their kids. It will be a good strategy if we gain the help from the parent associations or resource centers, in which there will be a large group of SEN students. The research focused on SEN students in mainstream schools. Thus, the design might be applicable to those SEN students in special schools. The results will have great implications for the comparative study and career planning for SEN students. The present research only conducted preliminary data exploration among parents of students with SEN. Future research needs more insightful inquiries into the role of parents play in SEN students’ post-school outcomes. Also, it is noted that parental empowerment will be essential for the support of SEN students, particularly in the transition stage of the post-secondary.

843612.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
843612.value: The present study examined the post-secondary school outcomes of students with SEN by using the mixed-methods, including the main survey study, focus group interviews, and the follow-up survey study. This study was significant because it investigated how different modes and practices established by Western researchers fit the data collected the Chinese cultural settings, and what characteristics in Chinese culture contributed to the discrepancies in the model fitting. This study made important contribution to theoretical knowledge about how culture modulates the relationships between different predicting factors of adolescent-to-adulthood transition among students with disabilities. The study not only examined the possibility of transition models in Hong Kong, a Chinese society, but also identified the cultural differences in terms of key factors investigated in this study. The findings provided valuable evidence for policy makers and key school stakeholders to improve 3-3-4 new senior secondary education curriculum. This study also provided timely information to facilitate SEN graduates in mainstream senior secondary education to adopt better transition plans and provide them more support when they made attempt to explore their paths into further education, work, community participation and independent living. The outcome also brought about change in transition support and career planning for SEN students.

843912.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
843912.value: The world’s population is ageing rapidly. The ageing of populations has a strong impact on all aspects of human life, including its social, economic, cultural and political domains. Understanding and providing for ageing is an important issue worldwide for the twenty-first century. Recent research suggests that learning is critical for active ageing. To date, very little research has assessed the impact of cultural influences on elder learning, and none has examined learning for and by the elderly within and across different cultural contexts. Our research should go a long way towards filling this gap. Our research is original in several respects. Empirically, it will produce entirely new knowledge about elders and their education in Hong Kong. This will help fill a critical gap in the existing literature, which is largely based on Western research. Analytically, it will build upon previous research about elder learning and further develop it in the light of a cross-cultural study that encompasses two cultural contexts. Generally, it will promote wider debate on cultural similarities and differences to contribute to the global understanding and knowledge base of elder learning. The research is structured around four objectives. The first is to examine and elucidate conceptualizations of learning by elders in Hong Kong and Australia. The second is to investigate why and how senior adults engage, or do not engage, in learning, by comparing within the Hong Kong and Australian samples the differences between the study and non-study groups in their conceptualizations of learning, and the facilitators or barriers to participation. The third is to identify and examine key learning issues for elders in the two cultures, including their needs, motivations, interests and instructional preferences. The fourth is to compare among elders across and within the two cultural contexts the similarities and differences in their conceptualizations of learning, engagement in learning, and other important elder learning issues. The resulting comparisons will provide insights into the experience and views of elders concerning learning, including reasons for non-participation. This will serve to inform policy and the development of learning activities and programmes for active ageing in the two locations. The team comprises a strong partnership between leading elder-learning researchers in Australia and active researchers from elder-learning and ageing research centres of local institutions, demonstrating an unrivalled capacity to undertake a cross-cultural study of international significance. 世界人口正在迅速老化。人口老齡化問題對於人類生活的各個層面有著深遠的影響，包括社會、經濟、文化及政治等領域。因此，如何理解和解決老齡化問題將是二十一世紀的世界性重要課題。近期研究發現學習對於積極老齡化非常重要。目前，很少研究涉及文化對高齡學習的影響，尤其是沒有研究從跨文化角度探討高齡學習。是項研究可以填補這一空白。 是項研究之獨到之處在於幾個方面：從實踐角度，這項研究將建構一些關於香港長者及其教育的全新知識，彌補現有文獻極大程度依賴西方研究的缺憾；從分析角度，這項研究會在以往高齡學習研究的基礎上由跨文化學習角度進一步深入分析探討，包括兩個不同的文化環境；總體來說，它將引起關於文化差異更廣泛的討論以促進全球對高齡學習的理解和知識。 是項研究圍繞四個目標。首先，探究和闡述香港及澳洲關於高齡學習的概念；其次，透過比較香港及澳洲，學習及非學習組別樣本之差異，調查高齡人士是否參與學習的原因，瞭解他們關於學習的概念、參與學習的促進因素與障礙；此外，發現並指出在兩個文化環境下高齡學習的關鍵要素，包括動機，興趣及教學喜好；最後，比較兩個不同文化背景的長者關於學習的概念、參與度及其它重要問題。比較的結果將可以深入理解長者對於學習的經驗和看法以及他們不參與學習的原因。這將為香港和澳洲兩地高齡學習相關計劃及政策發展作出貢獻。 項目團隊由澳洲高齡學習領域的資深研究者及本地大專院校高齡學習研究中心的研究人員共同組成，將能成功進行這項具有國際意義的跨文化研究。

843912.label: Realisation of objectives
843912.value: All the four objectives were achieved through completion of the GRF research that aimed to obtain knowledge and develop understanding about successful ageing and elder learning by senior adults in two cultures: Hong Kong and Australia. Both survey and interview data gathered from two groups of elders, one from Hong Kong and the other from Australia, were used for within-group analysis. Achievement of the first objective was by analysis focusing on the meanings older learners from Hong Kong and Australia attached to the concept of 'learning'. For the second research objective, insights were gained about learning engagement, or the lack of it, by older adults due to certain facilitators or barriers to participation. The third objective was achieved by having identified the needs, motivations, interests, and instructional preferences for learning in later life. For the fourth objective, t-tests, ANOVA and correlation analyses were conducted to identify the relationships between learning and successful ageing, and between learning and other variables, including background characteristics, motivations and the overall well-being and satisfaction of elders in Hong Kong and Australia. Survey data gathered from two large groups of elders, one from Hong Kong (N=: 519 in Hong Kong) and the other from 421 in Queensland, Australia (N=421), and interview data from 40 elders in each location were used for within-group analysis. Comparison of the respective findings from each location indicated that there were in fact more commonalities, rather than differencess, between the two groups of elders living in these two different cultural contextsoups in terms of their background characteristics, conceptualizations of the meaning of ageing and learning, and other important learning issues, including reasons for learning, barriers to learning, subject areas of interests, and instructional preferences.

843912.label: Major findings and research outcome
843912.value: Major findings: The focus of this research was on the comparison between Hong Kong and Australian elders in terms of their background characteristics, engagement in learning, conceptualizations of successful ageing and later life learning, and other important learning issues, including reasons for learning, barriers, areas of interests, and instructional preferences. With respect to background characteristics, there were in fact more similarities, rather than differences, between the two groups. Both groups rated learning as being very important in later life, which was also found to be related significantly with their self-ratings of successful ageing, happiness, life satisfaction, and general health conditionstatus. With respect to their conceptualizations of successful ageing, both groups saw the importance of ‘remaining in good health until close to death’ in the ageing process. Both groups considered ‘living a long time’ not important in the process of ageing. The commonality between the two groups was that they both valued quality of life rather than quantity when it comes to successful ageing As regards the barriers to their participation in later life learning, the two most important common barriers were ‘personal health reasons’ and ‘money (programmes are too expensive)’. Commonalities were also shown in their learning interests in subject areas. Both groups wanted to learn things related to ‘health’, ‘leisure’, and ‘art’. But there were differences between the two groups in terms of what they preferred least to learn. The Hong Kong group least preferred subjects like ‘humanities’, ‘sciences’, and ‘finance’. But the Australian elders least preferred ‘basic education’, ‘literacy and grammar’. Their reasons for engaging in later life learning are similar too. They both indicated reasons including ‘for self-fulfillment’ and ‘interest in specific courses or subjects’. The Hong Kong group expressed their desire of ‘always wanting to go to school’ as their top reason for continued learning; while the Australian group cherished the goal of learning new knowledge and skills. However, they were not motivated by instrumental reasons of getting qualifications and seeking employment or re-employment. Research outcomes: A total of 10 publications, either as refereed journal articles or book chapters, were resulted from this GRF project (as listed in Part C). In addition, two conference papers related to the GRF research were presented, plus two more conference presentations to be made at international conferences in October 2015. Also, a total of 3 doctoral students were supervised with their theses on a topic related to this GRF project.

843912.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
843912.value: The findings from this study suggest that older learners differ from learners of other age groups in significant ways, particularly in terms of their reasons for learning. They predominantly wish to learn for expressive and not instrumental purposes such as re-skilling as a means to gain employment or qualifications, and this needs to be given due attention by those who seek to provide learning opportunities to older people. Further research is therefore needed to identify the different learning styles and preferences between older and younger adults to investigate if a distinct theory of learning and pedagogy is more appropriate for older learners. The findings have also provided evidence of more similarities than differences between elders in Hong Kong and Australia. To date, there has been limited international research on the impact of cultural differences on elder learning, and very little has examined learning for and by elders from their perspectives, and across different cultural contexts. It is of further research interest to conduct a similar cross-cultural study between Hong Kong and other cultural contexts, such as the European, American and even Asian.

843912.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
843912.value: This cross-cultural comparative study has obtained knowledge and developed understanding about the conceptualizations of learning held by senior adults from two cultural backgrounds: Hong Kong and Australia. It has examined the differences, as well as commonalities, of their conceptualizations of learning, involvement in elder learning, and important learning issues including interests, instructional preferences. It has also examined the facilitators and barriers to participation in the two different cultural contexts. This research makes a significant contribution to yielding new knowledge and insights into the similarities and differences in the reasons, choices, and processes used by elders in different cultural contexts as they conceptualize, experience and negotiate ongoing learning. The results provide an essential cross-cultural perspective that will contribute to the global understanding and knowledge base for elder learning. More specifically and locally, the outcomes of this study can provide policy makers and researchers in Hong Kong with sound empirically supported theory and comparative data for the development of policy and practice geared to the planning and provision of programmes for later life learning.

844012.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
844012.value: 成語是中華文化的一種獨特標誌。在日常交際中，我們經常使用成語。一個人的文化水平與修養可以透過所用的成語反映出來。成語讓我們可以理解語言、修辭、文學修養和文化歷史等幾個範疇之間的關係。漢語四字格成語有以下幾個特點：(a)大多以四個音節為單位，並以特定模式出現；(b)成語的意義大多超越字面義，背後並含有豐富的文化信息；(c)運用成語時需要同時掌握附帶的語義信息，如正負面義，引申義等。 部份亞洲語言跟漢語一樣都有成語，如日語、韓語和越南語；但有些沒有，如維吾爾語、蒙古語和滿州語。要了解為何這些語言在成語方面有剛剛相反的發展，我們需要進一步了解它們的社會語言狀況和對漢語的情況。 另一方面，中國西南部的少數民族語言（如壯語和白語）雖然還未發展出成熟的文字系統，但它們也有四字格成語，當中值得探討的是這些少數民族語言運用成語是因為跟漢語有親屬關係，抑或是跟漢語長期語言接觸的結果。 然而，過去對漢語和週邊非漢語語言四字格成語的綜合研究不多和不夠深入。基於以上的初步觀察，本研究項目將探討以下兩個相關範疇: (1)四字格成語可否視作一項語言特徵來判斷語言親屬關係？以廣西壯語為例，它跟鄰近的粵語有很多相近的語言特徵，同時也有不少跟漢語相似的四字格成語。當中是否反映壯語跟粵語（甚至南方漢語）有深層的語言親屬關係，而不是過往一般大多認為的非親屬語言接觸下的結果？ (2)為何漢語（以四字格成語為例）會對週邊的語言有不同程度的影響？漢語的表意文字系統和成語對日語、韓語和越南語等已有長久的影響，相反，對於西部和北部的阿爾泰民族，如曾經統治過中國的蒙古和滿州族，在文字系統和成語兩方面都沒有受到顯著的影響，原因是什麼呢？文字系統的影響是否為四字格成語影響的必需條件呢？換句話說，四字格成語在漢語圈子裏功能與地位是否比文字系統更重要？對於這些問題，我們認為，除了語言之外，也要考慮其他因素，如社會結構（包括宗教）。我們將會以壯語為基礎，測試以上的推論。 本項目將建立一個大型的四字格成語資料庫，通過漢語和週邊語言的跨語言比較，進一步探討漢人文化和週邊文化的形成和發展。

844112.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
844112.value: Educational tests may contain examinee-selected (ES) items in which examinees are allowed to choose a fixed number of items from a set of given items to answer (e.g., choose three out of five given items). The use of ES items has a long history and is still in practice, including the National Higher Education Entrance Examination in Mainland China, and the Certificate of Education Examination and the Advanced Level Examination in Hong Kong. ES items allow students to demonstrate their best responses and enhance their intrinsic motivation to learn. ES items may also enhance test validity because examinees can be better measured when the items are more consistent with what they have studied. Although ES items have these desirable properties, test fairness is threatened because ES items almost always have different levels of difficulty such that test scores from examinees choosing different ES items cannot be compared directly. ES items also present a great challenge to existing item response theory (IRT) models, because more capable examinees may have an advantage by making wiser choices thus rendering existing IRT models inapplicable. The technical problem of score incomparability is so serious that ES items have been abandoned by many countries for many years, and the desirable properties of ES items have been lost. In this project, we aim to resolve the problem of score incomparability in ES items by developing a new class of IRT models to consider the choice effect of ES items so that scores of ES items are comparable, test fairness is ensured, and ES items can be adopted safely to serve their educational purposes. In general terms, the new models will be embedded in a multiparameter, multifaceted, multilevel and multidimensional framework. To validate our models, we will conduct a series of simulations, real data analyses, and an experiment. The simulations aim at investigating how well and under what conditions the parameters of the new models can be recovered and the consequences of model misspecification. The real data analyses aim to demonstrate the implications and applications of the new models. In the experiment, secondary school students will be invited to take an exam with ES items. This experiment will reveal that the choice of ES items is not ignorable, that existing IRT models are not applicable, that the new models can resolve the problem of score incomparability and ensure test fairness, and that ES items can be used safely. 教育測驗常包含選考題型，即允許考生從一組試題中挑選部份題目來作答（例如：五題選三題）。運用選考題型的歷史悠久，直到現在仍相當普遍，例如中國的「國家高等教育入學測驗」，以及香港的「中學會考」與「高級程度會考」。選考題型容許學生呈現他們最好的表現，以及提高他們的內在學習動機。當作答試題與考生所學相符時，考生的能力可以被測量得更精準，因此使用選考題型亦能提高測驗效度。 儘管選考題型擁有許多優良特質，卻它卻威脅測驗的公平性，因為各選考題的難度不同，導致考生選答不同試題之後，其分數無法直接比較。選考題型同樣挑戰既有的試題反應理論模式，因為優秀的考生在選答試題時容易做出較優勢的抉擇，這違反了多數試題反應理論模式的假設，使得既有模式不再適用，陷於分數無法比較的困境。近年來許多國家已捨棄選考題型，選考題型的優良特質已不復存。 為解決選考題分數不可比的困境，本研究將發展一組新的試題反應理論模式，以考慮選考題型的選擇效果，使得選考題的分數變得可比，以確保測驗的公平性，也就可以放心的使用選考題型，以達到其在教育的目的。這種新的模式將置入於多參數、多面相、多層次、以及多向度的架構中。為了要驗證這些模式，我們將進行一系列的模擬研究、真實資料分析，以及實驗。模擬研究的目的在於探討參數的回復性和模式錯用的後果。真實資料分析則在於展示這些新模式的意涵和應用。透過實驗，我們將展示選考題型的選題效果是不可忽略的，目前的模式並不適用，以及使用新模式將能成功解決分數不可比的難題，以確保測驗的公平，使得選考題型可以放心的使用。

844112.label: Realisation of objectives
844112.value: Upon the completion of the project, the four objectives have been successfully achieved. The objectives and the activities we carried out during the period are given below: Objective 1: Develop a new class of IRT models to make scores of ES items comparable (November 2012 to February 2014) To achieve Objective 1, we have developed a new and general class of IRT models for ES items that can account for different missing mechanisms in ES items, consider both effects of ES items and raters simultaneously, and accommodate different testing designs of ES items. (1) Modelling Missing Mechanism in ES items In our previous work (Wang, Jin, Qiu & Wang, 2012), we proposed an examinee-selected item model (ESIM) via a random-effect approach to account for ES mechanisms. In this project, we have further developed two IRT models to investigate the choice mechanisms in ES items. The first one is referred to as the general examinee-selected item model (GESIM), in which different groups of examinees (e.g., high ability vs low ability) are assumed to have different patterns in choosing the same ES items (Wang & Liu, 2015). The second one is referred to the non-ignorable missing examinee-selected item model (NMESIM) in which some ‘unknown’ or ‘unpredictable’ mechanism in ES items can be accounted for (Liu & Wang, 2014). Both models are very general and flexible and include the ESIM as a special case. (2) Multiple Facets Modeling Since ES items are often constructed-response items, and raters are recruited to mark the responses, rater effects should be addressed. We have developed a multi-faceted IRT model to consider both choice mechanisms in ES items and rater effects (Qiu & Wang, 2015). (3) Model Generalizations In this project, the new class of models have been generalized to account for complicated testing design. For example, the GESIM has incorporated multiple blocks of ES items (i.e., examinees are required to select two items in one block, and select three items from five items in another block). More generalizations of the new models are possible. The new frameworks have been presented at various invited addresses, including at the 11th Cross-Straits Conference on Educational and Psychological Testing (Taichung, Taiwan, 2014), East China Normal University (Shanghai, China, 2015), National Taiwan Normal University (Taipei, Taiwan, 2015), and Jiangxi Normal University (Nanchang, China, 2015). (4) Sample-free Estimation of ES Items In the ESIM, GESIM, and NMESIM, it is assumed that the missing data for examinees in ES items follow a specific IRT model. The estimation of item parameters will be biased if the assumption is violated. In practice, the missingness mechanism is often unknown. To address this concern, we have successfully proposed two conditional estimation methods to analyze ES items, in which the estimation of item parameters does not depend on the assumption of the missingness mechanism, that is, the estimation is “sample-free.” Objective 2: Assess parameter recovery and the consequence of model misspecification in serials of simulations (July 2013 to December 2014) To achieve Objective 2, we have conducted extensive simulations to evaluate parameter recovery and consequence of model misspecification. The manipulated variables included numbers of blocks, sample sizes, dichotomous or polytomous ES items, types of missingness mechanism, magnitudes of nonignorable missingness of ES items, magnitudes of rater effects, estimation methods, and so on. For the new class models, both of data-generating models and conventional IRT models which ignore the effects of ES items were fit. The dependent variables were bias and root mean square error (RMSE) of the estimation. It was found that the parameter recovery of the true models were satisfactory using freeware WinBUGS/JAGS or Mplus; ignoring the effects of ES items by fitting conventional IRT models resulted in poorer item and person parameter estimation. The results suggest the necessity of the new classes of IRT models to calibrate students’ ability and items’ difficulty when the ES items are used. For the sample-free estimation methods, it was found that the proposed methods yielded good recovery of the item parameters, no matter what type of missingness mechanism was involved in the ES items. Objective 3: Demonstrate implications and applications of the new models through empirical data analyses (July 2013 to May 2015) To achieve Objective 3, we have applied the new initiatives to several empirical data sets. These analyses demonstrate the applications of the new models to various tests (including the high-stake tests) with different testing design. (1) The History Test of the College Entrance Examinations of China in 2009 The empirical example consists of 15,899 examinees responding to 25 multiple-choice items, 3 open-ended questions, and ES items in which the examinees were required to choose two out of six given items. The ES items in this example were constructed-formatted items and were analyzed using the GESIM model. (2) The Politics Test of the College Entrance Examinations of China in 2010 The empirical example consists of 19,578 students responding to 22 multiple-choice items and polytomous ES items (1 out of 3). The NMESIM was applied to this empirical example. (3) The Mathematics Test for Primary School Students This dataset was collected from one of our experiments in which 501 fifth grade students answering 10 items and was analyzed using the GESIM. This empirical example showed the advantages of the GESIM over traditional IRT models. (4) The Liberal Studies Test for Secondary School Students This dataset was collected from an experiment in which raters were involved in ES items. It consisted of 309 secondary school students answering two constructed-response format ES items, which were retrieved from the Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education (HKDSE). A total of 19 college students were recruited to rate the papers. This dataset was analyzed using the multifacet ESIM. (5) The Mathematics Test of for Secondary School Students This empirical dataset was collected from an experiment in which 517 eighth graders responding to 16 mathematical items. In this experiment, irrelevant variables were better controlled and the advantages of the new models over traditional models were further confirmed. Objective 4: Validate the new models and verify their superiority to existing IRT models through an experiment (October 2013 to May 2015) To achieve Objective 4, three experiments which were shown in Empirical examples of 3-5 were conducted. The experiments covered different subjects (Mathematics and Liberal Studies), different ages of students (primary and secondary students), different ES items (dichotomous and polytomous ES items), and different testing design (whether raters are involved or not). Hence, the missingness mechanism of ES items was thoroughly investigated. Over 1,300 students participated in our experiments. The results from different experiments consistently showed that the new initiatives yielded more accurate estimation of persons’ ability and item’s difficulties when ES items were used. Thus, the new models were crossed-validated and their superiority to existing IRT models was supported.

844112.label: Major findings and research outcome
844112.value: This project has successfully developed a new class of IRT models for ES items. The parameters of new class of IRT models for ES items can be well recovered by using freeware WinBUGS/JAGS or Mplus. Fitting conventional IRT models to ES items, which ignore choice effects in ES items, result in poorer person and item estimations. Those empirical examples demonstrate the applications of the new class of models to various tests (including high-stake tests) where ES items are used. The new models have been successfully crossed-validated using three experiments and their superiority to existing IRT models is confirmed. Our team has published one book chapter, have one journal article under review, and one under preparation. Moreover, we have presented five conference papers in prestigious international meetings including the annual meeting of Pacific Rim Objective Measurement Symposium (PROMS), the International Meeting of Psychometric Society (IMPS), and the annual meeting of American Educational Research Association (AERA) to disseminate the results of the project. Due to space constraints, the titles and the publishing years are listed below. The detailed information can be found in Part C of this report. 1) New IRT models for examinee-selected items (2015, book chapter) 2) Sample-free estimation of examinee-selected item (under review) 3) Nonignorable missing examinee-selected item model for choice items (under preparation) 4) An empirical analysis of choice effects in examinee-selected items (PROMS, 2015) 5) The multifaceted IRT Model for examinee-selected items (IMPS, 2015) 6) Modeling selection effects in examinee-selected items (IMPS, 2014) 7) The nonignorable missing examinee-selected item model (AERA, 2014) 8) A new class of IRT models for examinee-selected items (RROMS, 2013) In addition, I have conducted two seminars to disseminate the findings to researchers and practitioners including policy makers in educational sector. For example, on December 2014, I gave a talk entitled ‘New Class of Item Response Theory Models to Ensure Test fairness’ to the Education Bureau delegation which was led by the Deputy Secretary for Education (Dr. Chan Ka-Ki). The delegation was very interested in the research since ES items are widely used in the HKDSE Public Exams. The use of the new models for these high stake exams is feasible. Finally, computer codes and guidelines of analyzing the ES items are available on request for users.

844112.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
844112.value: I will submit research findings for publications and generate more outcomes in the near future. A few manuscripts are under preparation. In this project, I focused on ES items in educational assessment. In many other areas, such as composition tests and performance appraisals in beauty, singing, dancing, and sports, also widely use ES items (e.g., allowing participants to choose topics to perform). Applications of the new models to these situations can be investigated. Sometimes, it is possible that test-takers with the same proficiency level but have different group membership (e.g., gender or ethnicity) have different probability of success in the selected ES items. It is referred to as differential item functioning (DIF). I plan to apply the methods of DIF assessment developed in my another GRF project (844110) to ES items, so test fairness and equity of ES items can be further improved.

844112.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
844112.value: In some educational tests, examinees are allowed to choose a fixed number of items to answer (e.g., choose one from three given items). This examinee-selected (ES) item design has a long history and is still in practice. Although ES items have some desirable educational merits, test fairness is seriously threatened. In this project, we have successfully resolved the fundamental problem of score incomparability by developing a new class of item response theory models to consider choice effects of ES items, such that the test scores could be comparable across students choosing different items to answer. Empirical examples are provided to demonstrate the implications and applications of the new models. The experiments we conducted in this project have revealed that the choice effects in ES items are not ignorable, exiting IRT models are not applicable for ES items, and our new models can resolve the fundamental problem to ensure test fairness. Thanks to the continued support from the RGC, HKIEd, and my collaborators, I have been awarded as a fellow of the American Educational Research Association in 2014. In addition, I received the President’s Awards for Outstanding Performance in Research (HKIEd) in 2016.

844512.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
844512.value: Previous research on pragmatics has concentrated on the learning of English or other European languages as a second language by adults. Not much is known regarding pragmatic development among young children learning a second language. Recently, in Hong Kong, the lack of empirical evidence in inter-language pragmatics, with special regard to child language (i.e., Cantonese as L2) development, has complicated the decision-making process of policy makers and educators regarding Chinese language (as L2) education instruction and intervention for education equity of ethnic minority children studying in mainstream schools. A request is a prominent speech act in daily interaction in which the speaker has to learn to manipulate appropriate linguistic forms to make the hearer perform an action to fulfil the speaker’s needs. Variations in the use of request forms largely reflect the communication competence of the speaker. The expression of the request is seen as a major milestone in the pragmatic development of children. Request data from young children provide reliable information on the language development of young learners. Because the L2 of children has not been widely studied, scholars urge that more research be conducted to construct a theory of development. The availability of such data would also provide useful information and insights for educators and policy makers in the design of a developmentally appropriate Chinese language (as L2) education curriculum and intervention. Speech pathologists could also make reference to such pragmatic data for diagnosing the Cantonese communicative ability and needs of potentially ‘at risk’ school children who have no or limited Chinese language knowledge for learning in the mainstream. The proposed three-year study is longitudinal in nature. In all, 80 Hong-Kong-born Pakistani children (40 from K1 and 40 from K2) who do not or seldom speak Cantonese at home will be recruited to participate in the project. The aim of the project is to examine (i) the development of Cantonese proficiency (i.e., receptive and expressive skills) of Pakistan pre-schoolers who study in mainstream kindergartens in Hong Kong over a three-year period; (ii) the Cantonese request strategies/forms realised by Hong Kong Pakistani pre-school children; (iii) the relationship between request strategies/forms and Cantonese proficiency of the target children; and (iv) impact of pragmatic/language socialisation in classroom routines and on playground at school, as well as parental factors (e.g., language attitude, educational aspirations of their children, etc.) on the development and realisation of Cantonese request strategies of the target children. 語用學的研究，一直以來，都集中在成人學習英語或其他歐洲語言。有關兒童學習第二語言語用發展的研究不多。香港不少少數族裔兒童上學後便開始學習廣州話。他們廣州話語用能力的發展可以揭示非華語學童廣州話習得所面對的問題。可是廣州話作為第二語言的研究數據甚為缺乏，令香港教育工作者及決策者在為少數族裔學童編寫中文課程或作出支援對策時，面臨頗大的挑戰。另一方面，語言病理學家亦因缺乏有關少數族裔學童中文習得的研究資料，難以為有廣州話語言障礙的非華語學童作出較準確的斷症及提供適切的治療。 本研究為期兩年，研究對象為60位在香港出生的巴基斯坦裔學前兒童 (幼班-K1；N= 30, 低班-K2；N = 30)。 我們會透過兒童與訪問員在角色扮演時的語用數據，及學童廣州話評估測試結果，分析巴裔學前兒童的廣州話聽講能力和廣州話請求語的策略。我們亦會以問卷方式調查巴裔學童家長的廣州話能力，及其對子女的語文教育期望與態度，並探討此等因素對學前兒童請求語策略發展的影響。

844512.label: Realisation of objectives
844512.value: To achieve objectives 1 (Cantonese Chinese development of Pakistani preschoolers) and 2 (relationship between Cantonese proficiency development and forms of Cantonese request strategies used by the sample subjects) : A total of 74 Pakistani preschoolers from K1 and K2 in Cantonese medium kindergartens had been recruited as sample subjects for the study. Their Cantonese proficiency was assessed in terms of their knowledge of Cantonese receptive vocabulary and oral language skills (i.e. expressive ability). Cantonese Receptive Vocabulary Test (CRVT) (Cheung et al., 1997) and Cantonese Oral language Deficiency Early Identification Test (COLDEIT) for Pre-primary Children (Po Leung Kuk, 2008) was used to assess participants’ knowledge of Cantonese receptive vocabulary and Cantonese oral language skills respectively. Six scenarios incorporating contextual factors of familiarity, power status and imposition were designed for researchers to role play with Pakistani preschoolers for the elicitation of L2 Cantonese request data which were coded and analyzed by making reference to Blum-Kulka’s (1980) taxonomy of request strategies in their Cross Cultural Speech Act Realization Project (CCSARP). Analysis of Cantonese proficiency data was performed by the IBM SPSS 20. Descriptive statistics like mean and standard deviation (SD) of the Cantonese receptive vocabulary knowledge, oral language skills and request ability at each grade level were first calculated. One-way ANOVA was used to compare the mean scores in CRVT (score 0-65), COLDEIT (score 0-49) and requests (score 0-24, 0-4 for each item) of Pakistani children at each grade level. The correlations between receptive, expressive and request scores of the participants at each grade level were assessed by Pearson correlation coefficients. Distributions of request strategies realized by Pakistani preschoolers in time 1 and time 2 were reported using percentages. In order to understand the difference in the development of L2 Cantonese request strategies at two different assessment time points, Chi-square exact test was used. (Objective 3 has been deleted as reported in the revision of objectives when funding was awarded) To achieve objective 4 (analyze the relationship between the Cantonese proficiency of parents, their attitude/expectations of children’s language education and the pragmatic competence of Pakistani preschoolers) A total of 34 Pakistan parents had been recruited to participate in a questionnaire interview with the researcher. Parents had to answer three questions: (i) their perceived Cantonese ability; (ii) frequency of watching Cantonese television at home; and (iii) their expectation of their children’s achievement in Chinese language education. T-tests were applied to assess the relationship between the Pakistani preschoolers’ Cantonese request scores (i.e. ability) with Pakistani parents’ perceived Cantonese ability of themselves, frequency to watch Cantonese television programmes at home (attitude towards the use of Cantonese at home), and parents’ expectation of their children’s achievement in the Chinese language education at school.

844512.label: Major findings and research outcome
844512.value: 1. Development of Cantonese proficiency: (a)Paired t-test shows that there was significant increase in receptive, expressive and request scores of the Pakistani preschoolers from time 1 to time 2 at all grade levels. The increase in receptive scores was larger among K1P children but smaller among K2P children. (b)Results of the Pearson’s correlation in time 1 showed no correlation between the Cantonese receptive, expressive and request scores of the Pakistani preschoolers. However, the correlations between receptive and expressive ability , receptive and request ability, as well as expressive and request ability were found significant in time 2 assessment. 2. L2 Cantonese request development and realization: (a) Chi-square exact test results showed that there were no significant difference in terms of K1P children’s realization of L2 Cantonese requests strategies in all six scenarios at two different assessment time points (i.e. all p-values in the six scenarios were greater than 0.05). (b) Total percentage in the use of direct L2 Cantonese request strategies by the K1P participants was higher than that in the indirect L2 Cantonese requests. (c) Chi-square exact test results found that no significant difference in K2P children’s use of L2 Cantonese requests strategies in all scenarios in the two assessments except in scenario three (p=0.022). In scenario three, the use of ‘mood derivable’ and ‘locution derivable’ by the K2P participants had significantly dropped to 2.2% in assessment two. 3. Relationship between Pakistani parents’ attitude, expectations and Pakistani preschoolers’ competence in the use of L2 Cantonese request strategies: T-tests results showed that there was no significant difference in the Cantonese request mean scores of K1P children whose parents knew Chinese (Mean (M)=0.4, Standard deviation (SD)=1.7) when compared with scores of K1 Pakistani participants whose parents did not know Cantonese (M=0.4, SD=1.7) (t(16)=0.34, p=0.738). On the other hand, it was noticed that K2 Pakistani children would have significantly higher mean score in L2 Cantonese requests if their parents knew Cantonese (M=5.2, SD=3.3) than those whose parents did not know Cantonese (M=3.2, SD=4.9, t(14)=2.21, p=0.044). 4. Research outcome: (i) Findings of research had been disseminated at three international conferences. (ii) One paper had been submitted to Mutilingua (see attached) and another paper had been drafted for future submission (see attached) (iii) L2 Cantonese request data had been prepared for release on CHILDES in the future; i.e. after papers have been published.

844512.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
844512.value: Since research findings showed that not many Pakistani parents were competent in Cantonese Chinese, teachers at kindergartens would play an important role to support and facilitate the Cantonese language proficiency and pragmatic (e.g. request) development of the Pakistani preschoolers at kindergartens. Action research on the impact of changes in curriculum, i.e. teaching and learning strategies, on the Cantonese language proficiency and pragmatic development can be further developed.

844512.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
844512.value: The nature of the research project was a longitudinal study of the development of Cantonese request strategies by Pakistani children attending Cantonese medium kindergartens in Hong Kong. The significance of the study to explore whether some of the English-based theoretical issues in L2 (second language, dominantly English) pragmatic development of young children also apply to Cantonese Chinese learnt by Pakistani preschoolers as a second language in Hong Kong. Findings of the study not only confirmed the fact that patterns of L2 Cantonese request development were very similar to previous research results, but also indicated that Pakistani preschoolers may not be too sensitive to social variables in the context of communication where the target language was used. The second finding of the study actually had not been reported in previous research on L2 pragmatic development of young children. In addition, our study was one of the pioneers in studying Cantonese language proficiency development of Pakistani children at kindergarten level. Such data would be very useful for future research on the Chinese language education of the growing number of non-Chinese speaking linguistic minority children at school in Hong Kong.

844812.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
844812.value: This study aims at understanding the self-assessment of the well-being of three student groups in Hong Kong, namely the South Asian minority students, cross-boundary and Chinese immigrant students, as compared with that of mainstream Hong Kong students. The study employs an integrative method using Scott Huebner’s (2001) Multidimensional Student Life Satisfaction Scale (MSLSS) and John Fisher’s (2008) Spiritual Health And Life Orientation Measurement (SHALOM) coupled with follow-up narrative interviews to uncover the life experiences of all participant students. The objectives of the study include to: (1) examine critically the self-appraisal of the well-being of three student groups and mainstream Hong Kong students; (2) determine the roles of the educational experience, self-identity and spirituality in contributing to the well-being of these student groups; (3) evaluate the comparability of interrelationships in educational experiences, ethnic identity, and spirituality of the student groups with reference to the mainstream students; (4) analyze the responsiveness of connected support services to the well-being of these student groups; and (5) contribute to theory building on the roles of educational experiences, self-identity, and spirituality in promoting the well-being of immigrant and minority student groups in Hong Kong and to share our findings with the international educational community. 本研究的目的是了解香港三個不同的學生群體，即：南亞裔學生、內地跨境學生和中國移民學生在教育經驗、自我身份及靈性等方面的自我評估與香港主流學生的異同。本研究採用綜合性研究方法，研究工具包括Scott Huebner (2001) 的學生多向度生活滿意程度量表(MSLSS)和John Fisher (2008)的心靈健康及生命導向問卷(SHALOM)；再加上後續的深入訪談，對各學生群體的生活經驗作進一步的探討。本研究目標為：(一) 審視三個不同的學生群體與香港主流學生對個人福祉的自我評估；(二)確定「教育經驗」、「個人身份」和「靈性」與個人福祉的關係；(三) 評估和比較上述三個變項對各學生群體的相互關係；(四)分析校本支援措施對各學生群體福祉的針對性和；(五) 與國際教育群體分享研究成果，促進對少數族裔和移民學生的相關理論的建構。

844812.label: Realisation of objectives
844812.value: The five objectives have been fully realised through a range of data collection methods and dissemination channels. Critical document and literature analyses were conducted to validate the adapted Chinese versions of the two instruments: the Multidimensional Student Life Satisfaction Scale (MSLSS) and Spiritual Health and Life Orientation Measure (SHALOM). To realise objectives 1-3, questionnaire surveys were conducted with 15000+ students from 28 secondary schools. The sample comprised 73% Hong Kong mainstream students (HKMS), 7% South Asian students (SAS), 16% Chinese Immigrant students (CIS) and 4% Cross-Boundary Students (CBS). To realise objective 4, we subsequently interviewed principals, policy makers, teachers and students of all cultural groups to seek their views on the effectiveness of support measures. Objective 5 was fully realised by a range of dissemination activities to transfer the knowledge into public understanding and to raise the impact. Details are listed below. 1. Media / Community-Wide Advocacy • Preliminary findings disseminated via a press conference (10 June 2014), attracting more than 10 local newspapers and radio media to report findings. • Live interview conducted by Radio 5 on the well-being of South Asian youth in HK, inspired by the results of the study. • Interview broadcast on Aljazeera on understanding Ethnic Minorities in HK • Practical student support programme offered by the HKIEd: 12 school-based feedback sessions conducted with frontline teachers, policy makers and curriculum developers of the project schools together with a dissemination seminar held on 6 March, 2014 (≈30 people attending). • Dissemination via digitalized e-TV talks and RTHK programmes. • A UGC-public lecture was conducted on 5 December, 2015 to have dialogues with general public about the findings. 2. Dialogues with the multiple student groups • Sharing with student leaders organized by the 5th Leadership Empowerment Action Project (LEAP) on July 30 2014 on understanding the education circumstances of CBS. • Face to face dialogues conducted with 100 secondary students from diverse cultural backgrounds and broadcast by RTHK Online e-TV (10 Oct 2015 at Delia Broadway School) in promotion of intercultural sensitivity and integration. • Invited to deliver an address at the Kowloon Exhibition Center on Integrating Ethnic Minorities into the Host Society in HK (≈100 university and secondary students attended), organized by the HK Outstanding Students’ Association for Project Resonance (28 July 2014). 3. Sharing findings with international community for theory building • The findings have been presented at five significant international conferences. • Three international refereed articles and two refereed chapters have been published or are in-press. • A team from HKU is now employing the validated Chinese version of MSLSS in their own research.

844812.label: Major findings and research outcome
844812.value: The key findings of this GRF project include the following: (1) Life satisfaction (LS) and spiritual well-being (SpWB) is found differentiated across the four student groups. (2) South Asian (SA) adolescents scored highest in both LS and SpWB. Religious belief was substantially important for SA adolescents’ LS and SpWb in particular (Yuen, 2015, International Journal of Children's Spirituality). (3) Our findings confirm international studies that adolescents varied in terms of LS and SpWB across gender, level of study, religious affiliation and family background (Yuen, Lee & Leung, 2016, International Journal of Beliefs and Values). SpWB was also identified as both a mediator and moderator on students' self-rated LS. (4) Girls were found generally more religious and satisfied with their life than boys, again confirming prior research (Yuen, 2015, Ibid.). Specifically, SA girls were found to be the most satisfied and religious compared with the Hong Kong Chinese and Chinese immigrant students (CIS), despite many of them being affiliated to Islam, a patriarchal and male-dominated religion. (5) The disadvantageous situation of CIS in Hong Kong was confirmed by our studies where they reported a lowest level of LS and SpWB across all student groups (Yuen, IJER, 2016). (6) Chinese boys without religious faith or affiliation rated the lowest in their LS and SH than their female and/or South Asian counterparts (Yuen,2015, International Journal of Children's Spirituality). Our study has fueled public discussions on the role of gender, ethnicity and spiritual and value education in the curriculum to promote a whole person development. South Asians represent one of the fastest growing communities in Hong Kong schools. Their well-being and social adjustment have a direct bearing on the welfare of local society. The findings have been widely reported by local newspapers and radio Hong Kong to generate thoughts and awareness on promoting positive youth development and engagement. Moreover, our empirical data are both original and relevant to public policy development and are facilitating professional dialogue between us and NGOs (e.g. Oxfam Hong Kong; Missions to New Arrivals Ltd.), the government (the Curriculum Development Institute) and the Central Policy Unit. The differentiated spiritual health (SH), life satisfaction and school engagement across student groups provides evidence-based policy recommendations for various sectors. The principal investigator received the HKIEd Knowledge Transfer Award in 2015.

844812.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
844812.value: This empirical study has yielded surprising and interesting results and it has stimulated new directions of research. The PI had submitted a related GRF proposal for further investigation of the situation titled: Well-being and success for all: mapping the pathways of engagement with school and society of immigrant, minority and mainstream students in Hong Kong (GRF Ref. 18406214; 2015 - 2017). This is the second year of the project. Deliberated efforts were made and are continuing with regard to developing a comprehensive support and preventive system for all adolescents. To advance the theory, we have constructed and validated a culturally fair and integrated student engagement instrument in the follow-up on-going GRF project. This will help determine the structural relationship between individual factors (cultural identity, spirituality and well-being) and contextual factors (family structures and school environments) with school and societal engagement of migrant and mainstream students in Hong Kong. To apply our knowledge in practice, the PI has also submitted a Quality Education Fund proposal entitled “Transition from Early Years to Primary Education: Increasing Successful Immigrant and Minority Family Engagement with Children’s Learning in Hong Kong” in October 2015. It is currently under review.

844812.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
844812.value: The study appraised and determined the role of educational experiences, self-identity, spirituality and the well-being of the groups of students, namely, ethnic minority South Asian students (SAS), cross boundary students (CBS), Chinese immigrant students (CIS) from mainland China and comparing them with the Hong Kong mainstream students (HKMS). A mixed method was employed. A total of 15428 students, aged 12-19, from 28 secondary schools were surveyed during 2012-2013. Also, 60 individual interviews were conducted with students from five schools. The research team found that LS and SpWB differentiated across the four student groups. In contrast to the media and common understanding, SAS scored highest in both LS and SpWB. Religious belief was significant for their LS and SpWB. Findings confirmed international studies that adolescents varied in terms of LS and SpWB across gender, level of study, religious affiliation and family background. SpWB was identified as both mediator and moderator on students' self-rated LS. Integrating life education, spiritual and value education should be implemented in the curriculum to promote a whole person development for students. Taken together, this study has filled a knowledge gap in terms of increasing social awareness of the importance of the well-being and spirituality of young people.

845212.label: Project Objectives
845212.value: To identify the key stages in each management option and collect data on each stage of food waste management systems, such as waste generation amount, composition and transportation distance from generation points to treatment sites in Hong Kong; To obtain real data on air, water and soil emissions from four different management facilities in local or national greenhouse gases inventories; To investigate and compare which stage(s) contribute to significant environmental impact to global warming (positive and negative) by the LCA-EASEWASTE method; To assess and compare the economic costs of each management option by the LCC method; To draw implications for policy and suggest alternative solutions for the existing problems of food waste management in Hong Kong; To provide a database for more sustainable management of food waste in Hong Kong and China.

845212.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
845212.value: 生命週期評價也被稱為“從搖籃到墳墓”的分析方法，是一個評價一件產品或者一個活動在其生命週期中對環境產生的影響的工具。生命週期經濟效益評估則用於量度一件產品或者一個活動在其生命週期中產生經濟損益。生命週期評價法起源于二十世紀六十年代，并從七十年代起開始發展成一個分析方法。九十年代起在環境領域中許多人開始關注此方法。在不同地區和不同範圍內有許多研究採用此方法分析都市固體廢物處理技術或者處理系統整個週期的環境影響研究。最近，此方法也被用於評價天津，杭州和北京等地的廢物管理系統。但是在所有生命週期評價和經濟效益評估研究領域內，較少研究關注于廚余廢物的管理，也沒有有關香港的研究報導。在密集的人口和高收入經濟體系下，香港產生越來越大量的廚余。大量的廚余對香港的環境質量和人口健康會產生影響，例如排放出大量的溫室氣體。香港政府需要從生命週期的角度去評價不同廚余管理方法產生的環境影響和經濟損益來制定相關的環保政策。本研究從溫室氣體排放角度採用生命週期評價法和經濟損益法來評價四種不同的廚余處理方法（填埋，焚燒，厭氧消化和廚余機堆肥）對環境的影響及其經濟損益。本研究是香港首個評價廚余不同處理方法的研究。研究結果能夠為香港和中國地區在制定低碳管理廚余的相關政策時提供有關的科學證據。

845212.label: Realisation of objectives
845212.value: Throughout the period of inverstigation, (1)three food waste management strategies,with landfilling, composting, and combined anaerobic digestionand composting as major technologies, were modeled were identified; (2)data on each stage of food waste management systems, such as waste generation amount, composition and transportation distance from generation points to treatment sites in Hong Kong were collected; (3)three food waste management strategies were compared to assess their environmental impacts on global warming; (4)we have found thatthe landfilling of food waste has an obvious impact on global warming, althoughthe power recovery from landfill gas counteracts some of this;(5)the life-cycle costs (LCC) of the three scenarios were investigated from the perspective of greenhouse gas emissions using the EASEWASTE life-cycle assessment model; (6)we found that mechanical composting and anaerobic digestion are potential treatment options, with lower energy consumption and lower greenhouse gas production than landfilling.

845212.label: Major findings and research outcome
845212.value: The environmental impacts of food waste management strategies(landfilling, mechanical composting and anaerobic digestion) and the effects of energy mix wereevaluated using a life cycle assessment (LCA) model, EASEWASTE.Theresults indicate that the landfilling of food waste has an obvious impact on global warming, althoughthe power recovery from landfill gas counteracts some of this. Food waste composting causes seri-ous acidification (68.0 PE) and nutrient enrichment (76.9 PE) because of NH3 and SO2 emissions duringdecomposition. Using compost on farmland, which can marginally reduce global warming (-1.7 PE),acidification (.0.8 PE), and ecotoxicity and human toxicity through fertilizer substitution, also leads tonutrient enrichment as neutralization of emissions from N loss (27.6 PE) and substitution (-12.8 PE). Acombined digestion and composting technology lessens the effects of acidification (-12.2 PE), nutrientenrichment (-5.7 PE), and global warming (-7.9 PE) mainly because energy is recovered efficiently, whichdecreases emissions including SO2, Hg, NOx, and fossil CO2 during normal energy production. The change of energy mix by introducing more clean energy, which has marginal effects on the performance of composting strategy, results in apparently more loading to acidification and nutrient enrichment in the other two strategies. These are mainly because the recovered energy can avoid fewer emissions than beforedue to the lower background values in power generation. The life-cycle costs (LCC) of the three scenarios were investigated from the perspective of greenhouse gas emissions. The global warming potential (GWP) generated from 1 ton of food waste for each disposal system was analyzed. The environmental benefits of each scenario per 1 ton of food waste management were estimated using the price of carbon resulting from CO2 reduction by avoided impact. The results show that about 619 kg CO2-eq of greenhouse gases would be produced by landfilling, 535 kg CO2-eq by mechanical composting and 481 kg CO2-eq by anaerobic digestion. The LCC analysis results indicate that mechanical composting and anaerobic digestion are potential treatment options, with lower energy consumption and lower greenhouse gas production than landfilling. Mechanical composting and anaerobic digestion are more sustainable options for food waste management. However, CH4 contributes more than 85% of the total GWP in all three scenarios from a LCA perspective. These results provide quantitative evidence that can be used to enhance food waste management in Hong Kong.

845212.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
845212.value: The results from this study can provide quantitative evidence fortechnical selection and pollution control in food waste management.The potential for further development of the research will be LCA and LCC of sludge generated in sewage treatment plant. The data on sludge, such as generation amount, properties, treatment strategies, etc will be collected and modeled by LCA method, so that to find out a more environmental friendly method in Hong Kong.

845212.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
845212.value: In most cities around the world, food waste as the major constituent of organic waste in municipal solid waste, can have seriousconsequences for the environment and community health.At present, more than 3600 tons food waste disposal in Hong Kong is highly dependent on landfilling, but given the high water contentand organic component involved, environmental problems such as greenhouse gas emissions, odor and leachate problems occur.A science-based environmental impact assess-ment of food waste management alternatives is thus likely to besignificant for decision-making.Life cycle assessment (LCA) is a scientific methodology widelyused to assess solid waste systems by providing an objective quantification of the overall environmental impacts related to various management scenarios.In this study, three food waste management strategies,with landfilling, composting, and combined anaerobic digestionand composting as major technologies, were modeled by using the data of Hong Kong and compared to assess their environmental impacts on global warming, nutrient enrichment, acidification, stratospheric ozone depletion,photochemical ozone formation, ecotoxicity, human toxicity, andother impact categories. Specially, the effects of energy mix on the environmental impacts and thus on the technology selection were further investigated. The results provide quantitative evidence fortechnical selection and pollution control in food waste management.

845612.label: Project Title(Chinese)
845612.value: 對香港課室內教師效能、學習過程與目標取向之間的關係的探究

845612.label: Project Objectives
845612.value: To examine how teacher effectiveness can be maintained or vary across classrooms where students and situations differ. To understand how classroom practices may affect learning processes and goal orientation of students. To investigate how goal orientation and self-regulated learning can facilitate teaching and learning over time.

To understand how classroom practices may affect learning processes and goal orientation of students.

845612.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
845612.value: The current study addresses two paradoxes in teaching and learning research. The first paradox is on the inconsistency in teaching effectiveness between and within teachers. Although both inspection and research evidence shows similar sets of characteristics in the instruction of effective teachers, research evidence has also suggested a teacher’s effectiveness as a non-static characteristic that varies throughout his/her career. Further evidence shows that the effective aspects of the same teacher may vary considerably across lessons. The second paradox is on the contradictory goal orientations on learning. Students are expected to achieve the objectives of education set by policymakers that demand a mastery of the learning goal and deep learning. However, the examination-oriented culture prevailing in society actually emphasizes performance in examinations and encourages social comparison by performance. The current study is framed in the recent findings in foreign contexts that may offer insights to solve these paradoxes. The research on effective teachers and teacher training suggests that a high level of consistency in teaching effectiveness may only be found in a small number of teachers, whereas other teachers may struggle in some areas and their effectiveness may fluctuate even after they have received relevant training. Moreover, recent research on self-learning finds that students, with teachers’ assistance, can control their learning with sufficient regular and constant feedback. This mode of learning is compatible with deep learning and a mastery goal. However, research on these emerging areas is still inadequate in Hong Kong. The current research proposes to study consistency and variation in teachers in different classrooms and schools in Hong Kong by measuring teaching effectiveness with classroom observation protocols in the first phase. The results will be used to establish a model of teacher behavior ranked based on their relative level of difficulty, relating teacher effectiveness with students’ learning goals and processes. The second phase explores the reciprocal relationship between teaching practices and students’ learning processes and goal orientations. The case studies on four teachers selected investigate whether interventions initiated by these teachers would establish students’ self-regulated learning by transforming their goal orientations and whether these changes would, in turn, facilitate teaching over time. The current research will contribute to the broader literature on classroom research and the Chinese learner with strong implications for both teacher development and learning assessment. This subject is timely, when education reforms in Hong Kong are called calling for greater teacher accountability and a paradigm shift in teaching. 是項研究牽涉教學和學習研究中的兩個矛盾。 第一個矛盾，關乎在教師個人及教師之間，都會出現一些教學效能高低不一致的情形。視學和教學研究中，皆有證據顯示教學效能高的教師，有些相類似的教學特點。可是，也有研究證據顯示，在教師的職業生涯中，其教學效能又不是靜止不變的。有研究證據進一步表明，在不同課堂上，同一位教師的教學效能，於不同方面的變化可能很大。 第二個矛盾，出現在學習目標取向上。一方面，我們教育政策的制定者期望學生能達到制定的教育目標，做到既可掌握學習的目標，又能深入學習。然而，在社會上盛行的卻是應試文化，學習上既強調考試上的成敗，復以考試成績來論英雄。 是項研究的框架建基在國外最近的一些研究成果，有助解釋這些矛盾。首先，對高效能教師及對教師培訓的研究結果分別表明，只會有少數的教師，能在各教學效能領域中，均達到一致的高水平；而在某些教學效能領域上，大多數教師是免不了出現波動，甚至有了相關的培訓之後，仍會感到力不從心。 此外，最近對學生自主學習的研究發現，在教師的協助下，有足夠不斷持續的反饋，學生便能夠控制他們的學習進度。這種學習方式能兼容深入學習和通達的目標。然而，香港仍十分缺乏對這些新興領域的研究。 這項研究建議利用有系統的觀課，來對教師的教學效能進行研究。在第一階段裹，在香港不同的教室和學校，測量教師的教學效能的一致性和變化。利用這些結果，進一步建立教師行為的典範，並排出它們的相對難易度，這樣便可把學生的學習目標及過程與教師的教學效能關聯起來。在第二階段，將利用第一階段的結果，選出四名老師作案例研究，深入探索教學實踐與學生的學習過程及其目標取向之間的相互關係。研究的重點放在這些教師干預學生學習的措施，是否能改變學生的學習目標取向，使他們從而學會調節自己的學習；同時研究隨著時間的推移，這些學習上的變化是否反過來能提升教學素質。 本項研究將促進針對課堂和中國學生的學習形態兩方面的研究，對教師專業發展和學習評估會有深遠的影響。在現時香港教育改革浪潮下，高唱提高教師的問責及教學上的範式轉移的呼聲中，突顯了這研究主題的迫切性。

845712.label: Project Title(Chinese)
845712.value: 教師專業網絡在持續教育改革的作用 解讀可持續教育改革中的教師專業網絡 解讀可持續教育改革中的教師專業網絡 解讀可持續教育改革中的教師專業網絡

845712.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
845712.value: A persistent challenge facing schools in Hong Kong is not the absence of innovative reform policies, but reform sustainability, given that many reform measures end in episodic, inconsistent or short-lived innovative projects (Cheng, 2009, 2010). How can educators ensure the sustainability of reform implementation? Heroic teachers alone, as depicted in Hollywood films (e.g., Dead Poet's Society, Mr. Holland's Opus), cannot ensure sustainable educational reform or change (Toole & Louis, 2002). A more promising approach is to investigate the role of teachers' professional networks in conveying opportunities and resources to sustain educational reform. The primary goal of this project is to test this hypothesis. Notably, despite emphasis on the importance of teachers' professional networks (hereafter TPNs) in school change in the literature on professional learning community and teachers community of practice, research focusing on the linkage between TPNs and reform implementation from a longitudinal perspective is extremely thin (Coburn et al., 2010; Orlina, 2010). As such, little is known about key features of TPNs (e.g., evolution, resiliency, and sustainment) that continuously convey opportunities and resources for organizational learning, which is critical to reform sustainability. In this regard, I have three additional goals in this project. First, I intend to identify the links between TPNs and reform sustainability. Based on this, I aim to decode how and why TPNs influence reform sustainability. Second, I aim to identify school organizational factors that facilitate or impede the sustainability of TPNs over time. Third, in doing this, I purposively focus on international schools, the most rapidly growing, but the least researched schooling division in Hong Kong and internationally (Lee et al., in press) in order to address a dearth of research on international schools (Hayden, 2006). Using a mixed-method design covering a two-year period (i.e., four measurement points in time), the project follows the trajectory of international schools in Hong Kong which have recently adopted an ambitious instructional reform known as inquiry-based teaching and learning (Hallinger et al., 2011). The project will contribute to research, practice, and policy, given its educational significance (i.e., illuminating links between TPNs and reform sustainability), theoretical soundness (i.e., theory of social capital), methodological advancement (i.e., multi-level latent growth modeling coupled with social network analysis and follow-up qualitative analysis), and wide implications for educators and policy makers interested in reform sustainability as well as for those involved in the rapidly growing international school movement, both in Hong Kong and globally.

845812.label: Project Objectives
845812.value: To identify the developmental progression of speech-print awareness at the syllable and the word levels in two different language environments of Hong Kong and Beijing. To distinguish developmental variations of speech-print awareness in children from the first, second to third year of kindergarten in Hong Kong and Beijing. To examine the role of mapping skills in Chinese word reading across three grades in kindergarten years and two language environments of Hong Kong and Beijing. To investigate developmentally the unique contribution of speech-print awareness to Chinese word reading beyond phonological awareness, visual-orthographic ability, and morphological awareness in Hong Kong and Beijing.

845812.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
845812.value: Despite recent research providing solid evidence regarding the roles of phonological awareness, visual-orthographic ability, and morphological awareness in Chinese children’s reading development, there is little research about the fundamental ability to map sound units (phonology) to visual symbols (visual-orthography). The proposed study will examine children’s ability to map speech to print, and its role in Chinese word reading development longitudinally among children in the first year to third year (K1-K3) of kindergarten in two different language environments of Hong Kong and Beijing. Four major goals will guide the study. First, it will identify the developmental progression of speech-print awareness at two levels, namely, syllable mapping awareness and word mapping awareness, in both Hong Kong and Beijing kindergarteners. Second, it will distinguish developmental differences across grades (K1-K3) and societies (Hong Kong and Beijing) that use different written Chinese scripts (traditional and simplified) and have different spoken languages (Cantonese and Mandarin). Third, it will examine the role of speech-print awareness in Chinese reading acquisition in each grade and each society. Fourth, the unique contribution of speech-print awareness to Chinese word reading, beyond those of phonological awareness, visual-orthographic ability, and morphological awareness, will be examined over time across different language environments of Hong Kong and Beijing. This study will be an attempt to delineate an important cross-modality constituent in reading acquisition, and to investigate its unique contribution to Chinese reading development. The results could significantly affect Chinese reading research by reconstructing its theoretical framework. On the practical side, the study may generate a significant early indicator of Chinese reading difficulties or developmental dyslexia. In addition, the results may bring important practical contributions to curriculum design, development of teaching materials, and pedagogy in early childhood education. 當前的研究結果充分地表明了語言意識、視覺加工和正字法意識、以及語素意識對兒童中文閱讀能力發展起重要的作用。然而當前甚少有研究對閱讀的本質進行直接的探討﹕即視覺符號 (傳統視覺加工和正字法意識探討的範疇) 與語音信息 (傳統語音意識探討的範疇) 採取跨視覺和聽覺通道的對應匹配。有鑑於此，本研究將於香港及北京兩地分別採取樣本，深入探討學前兒童從幼稚園一年級到幼稚園三年級一聲一字匹配意識的發展情況;以及其對早期中文閱讀能力發展的影響。本研究主要有四大目標﹕第一、本研究將對詞水平和字水平兩種不同層面的一聲一字匹配意識進行理論上的鑑別，並開發相應的測量工具;第二、本研究將追蹤測量並比較香港及北京兩地兒童在幼稚園三年期間一聲一字匹配意識的發展軌跡;第三、通過相關以及回歸分析，本研究將探討各地各年級兒童一聲一字匹配意識與中文閱讀能力的關係;第四、通過控制傳統研究的語音意識、視覺加工和正字法意識、以及語素意識，本研究將追蹤分析並比較香港及北京兩地兒童一聲一字匹配意識對中文閱讀能力發展的獨特影響作用。 通過建構一個跨視覺和聽覺通道的認知要素，本研究將在理論上對中文閱讀領域產生重要貢獻。另外，適用於香港及北京兩地的一聲一字匹配意識測量工具的開發將對今後在該問題上的進一步探討有極大的幫助。而在實際應用方面，本研究將從新的角度為中文閱讀困難或發展性閱讀障礙的早期鑑別提供指標。振奮人心的是，有別於英文，中文一聲總是對應於一字的明顯特性;如果訓練方法恰當，從一聲一字匹配意識著手以培養兒童早期的中文閱讀能力則是一個相對較為容易的入口。因此，本研究結果對幼兒教育課程的設計，教學材料的開發以及中文教學法等各方面都有重大意義。

845812.label: Realisation of objectives
845812.value: All the four objectives have been fully achieved. Before conducting the formal testing, a pilot test was conducted to develop and refine the new measures of word mapping awareness and syllable mapping awareness in both Hong Kong and Beijing. Words used in the measures were carefully selected and balanced with the number of morpheme, number of object contained in words, and simplified/traditional scripts across Hong Kong and Beijing. The two measures of word mapping and syllable mapping were then pilot tested in both Hong Kong and Beijing and confirmed its reliability and sensitivity (good variance across grade and individuals) being good. Additionally, we also developed, pilot-tested, and refined the word reading measures in both one-character and two-character measures in Hong Kong. All these measures could be useful for further research. In the formal testing, 3-wave data across K1, K2, and K3 in both Hong Kong and Beijing were successfully collected as proposed. To achieve Objective 1 & 2, a mixed ANOVA analysis with 2 (2 levels of mapping tasks; within-subject) x 3 (3 grades in terms of K1, K2, & K3; between-subject) x 3 (2 societies of Hong Kong and Beijing; between-subject) was conducted to examine the main effects of mapping tasks, grade, and society and their interactions. To achieve objective 3&4, correlation, regression and growth modelling analysis were conducted. Our original hypothesis was confirmed that mapping skills uniquely and longitudinally predicted word reading beyond phonological awareness, visual-orthographic ability, and morphological awareness in both Hong Kong and Beijing. The importance of explicit understanding of one syllable mapping to one character in Chinese reading in beginning readers are highlighted.

845812.label: Major findings and research outcome
845812.value: The project has produced some important findings, leading to a number of publications in top journals in education and psychology research (as listed in part C). First, speech-print mapping measures were developed and can be potentially useful for further research. Chinese word reading measures, in terms of single-character word and two-character word, were developed. This offers the opportunity for examining the Chinese word reading in specific details. Second for objective 1, comparing the developmental progression of word mapping and syllable mapping in Hong Kong and Beijing, the results showed that there was basically no difference between word mapping and syllable mapping (larger vs. smaller unit) in either Hong Kong or Beijing in any grade (K1-K3). This was not consistent with our original hypothesis based on the grain size theory (Ziegler & Goswami, 2005). This may be because in Chinese the boundaries of squared character in print form are quite obvious. Additionally the clear principle of one character corresponding to one syllable may decrease the gap of the children’s developmental progression from word mapping to syllable mapping. Third for objective 2, word and syllable mapping tasks were compared in Hong Kong and Beijing across different grades. Impressively, Beijing children performed significantly better in both syllable mapping and word mapping than Hong Kong children did in all the grades of K1 to K3. This may be most likely due to the availability of Pinyin (a phonological coding system) in Beijing but not in Hong Kong (Cheung & Ng, 2003). The explicit speech, print, and speech-print connection information (i.e., Pinyin) in children’s learning resources facilitate their understanding of the sound-print mapping in Beijing. Fourth, significant longitudinal associations were found of the two mapping tasks and Chinese word reading in both Hong Kong and Beijing (Lin, Shiu, Liu, 2016). In a recent paper (Lin, Liu, & Shiu, under review), we showed that syllable -character mapping in K2 uniquely predicted the initial level as well as growth rate of Chinese character reading in Chinese kindergarteners beyond age, nonverbal IQ, visual-spatial skills, phonological awareness, and morphological awareness. The findings together suggest the importance of making beginning readers explicitly aware the correspondence between spoken language and its written codes in learning to read Chinese. Fifth, given the rich data derived from this project, we are able to additionally produce some more papers published in top psychology and education journals as listed in part C.

845812.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
845812.value: The study can be further developed in at least two directions. First, the longitudinal pathways of mapping skills, potentially through metalinguistic skills, to reading abilities across Hong Kong and Beijing can be further analyzed and examined more systematically. Current analysis showed a significant role of mapping skills in reading with metalinguistic skills controlled, yet their hierarchical relationships (or mediation mechanism) are unknown and can be better understood by performing more systematic analysis with the current data. Second, the longitudinal bidirectional relationship between mapping skills and/or metalinguistic awareness and word reading can be additionally analyzed. With this approach, the current project has produced a paper titled “Bidirectional relationship between visual spatial skill and Chinese character reading in Chinese kindergartners: A cross-lagged analysis” published in Contemporary Educational Psychology. It would be interesting to see how reading experience (i.e., reading simplified/traditional Chinese) influence more fundamental linguistic-related cognitive skills.

845812.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
845812.value: Literacy are started as early as children being three years old in the Hong Kong society and effective learning in early years is highly valued by teachers, parents and educators in Hong Kong. The current project found that children’s understanding of one syllable mapping to one character in Chinese in four years old significantly predicts not only the initial level but also the growth of Chinese reading ability till the end of the kindergarten years in Hong Kong. This prediction has taken other cognitive covariates into consideration including nonverbal IQ, visual-spatial skills, phonological awareness, and morphological awareness. Theoretically the study delineate an important cross-modality constituent in early Chinese acquisition. Practically, the current study suggests the importance of making explicitly aware of the clearest principle of one character corresponding to one syllable in learning Chinese in very young children. Educators may consider to incorporate this explicit formal and informal one-syllable-one-character instruction into the development of curriculum design, development of teaching materials, and pedagogy in early childhood education.
